rows.original: You cross your arms and wait. After a few awkward seconds, Signi looks from Arona to her feet. "We're, um... we're sorry, miss orc." "Arona." Your companion claps the elf's shoulder. "Name's Arona." "Sorry, Arona," Feyra says. "We were just having fun..." "There's less bitchy ways to have fun. Like shootin' these big stupid arrows. C'mon, chins up. No harm done." Arona gives you and Vilda both a slap on the back and stomps back towards the targets, seemingly entirely satisfied. The rest of the elves follow her quickly enough. Dagny nods your way and resumes barking instructions at all of her trainees, Arona included. All that's left for you to do is find somewhere to sit and enjoy the show. It's a few hours before Arona decides she's done, covered in sweat and fresh bruises on her fingers, but she grins at you and slings the bow over her back. "Ryn said I could keep this. You get a lot less resistance than you accounted for, and almost fall over yourself from the momentum as her head sails off her body, knocked away by the force of your blow. Her tattoos flash as the light in them dies. You rush toward her head, puzzling over what could have happened. You hadn't thought the attack had that much force. As you pass her body it suddenly jerks into motion, hand clasping around a charred bit of wood. A phantasmal sword materializes in her grip, pressed against the front of your chest before you can overcome your surprise. You stick your hands in the air, [party.isJustPC|not wanting to do anything rash.|signaling your allies to stand down.] If you can behead someone and they keep fighting, what the hell can you do to stop them? A second female voice booms through the courtyard, with a tone that's angry but controlled. "Cease this foolishness at once! Atugia, what is the meaning of this?" |You stagger, falling to a crouch under the force of the knight's blows. She leaps at you, raising her halberd above her head for a doublehanded strike. Suddenly, the knight starts, her head literally falling from her shoulders as a second female voice booms through the courtyard. You stare in shock as the body regains its poise before you, weapon at the ready. "Cease this foolishness at once! Atugia, what is the meaning of this?" ] Some kind of magic carries her words, so that you can hear them from all around you with perfect clarity. The knight's grip on her blade falters at the sound, and the wispy weapon fades slightly. Now that you have time to look, you can see a thick blue smoke trailing from the base of the knight's neck. It dissipates quickly in the air, but points in the head's direction, as if blown by a light wind. "B-baroness, ma'am. I was just trying to catch stragglers from the cult that blew the old temple down." The knight's voice echoes timidly from the severed helmet. You can see a similar wisp of blue fog streaming toward her body before dissolving. The head shudders once before floating swiftly back to her body, righting itself in place with a resounding thunk. She stands at attention, dropping the section of charred wood she'd been carrying. You turn to see where she's looking, and are greeted with a breathtaking sight. A tall, stunning woman stands atop the stairway leading to the keep's front door. Her eyes are the first thing you gaze upon, twin oceans of deep blue that appraise you[party.som|| and [companion1.name]| and your allies] for a moment before fixating on the knight — Ah-two-yah? Is that her name? — with a stormy glare. She wears a simply-woven cloth dress, obsidian black with flares of opalescent red that accent her willowy curves. A sash of sanguine silk ties the dress around her waist, with a cut in the outfit's side revealing the pale flesh of her hip and a long, slender leg. "[party.isJustPC|This [pc.manWoman] looks|These people look] nothing like them," the noblewoman snaps. Atugia visibly shrinks at the assertion, her hands searching for something to fidget with. It's hard to believe this is the same person who you were fighting a moment ago. The baroness raises an eyebrow, waiting for a response. "B-but that doesn't mean they aren't related, ma'am. I was just making sure the castle was sa-" "You were just trying to pick a fight. Return to your quarters at once. I'll deal with you when I finish with our guests," the imposing woman interrupts. Atugia jolts into motion, her body seeming to follow the command instinctively before her head can make a decision. With what happened after the fight, maybe that's literally the case. The baroness follows her till she enters the castle, turning back to you and taking a deep breath. When she exhales, none of the stern authority remains in her expression. "Now then. I know my huscarl gave you a... less than warm welcome, but I hope you don't hold it against us. I'm afraid I cannot offer you much in the way of hospitality at the moment. The March is currently beset by island orc marauders, crazed centaurs, and strange new beasts in the Old Forest... my attention is stretched thin as it is. I'm sure you can find accommodations in the tavern down in the village, if that is what you've come seeking. If not... you have my permission to remain in the courtyard and guardhouse if you wish." She smiles benevolently, eyeing [party.isJustPC|you up|up each member of your group in turn]. "Now I must return to my duties... and discipline a rowdy huscarl. Farewell." Her dress swirls as she returns to the castle, giving you a nice view of her sashaying hips. It looks like you won't need to sneak into the castle, at least... You could look around now, or come back some other time.
rows.translation: [var0 |[finisher.CombatNames]最后一击让那位骑士措手不及，使得她那虚幻的戟影瞬间消散，你立刻瞄准她的头部发动了致命一击，确保她彻底倒下。然而，你遇到的阻力远比预想的要小得多，由于这一击的力量过于巨大，她的头部甚至被击得脱离了身体，你几乎被这股冲击力撞得摔倒在地。当那些纹身上的光芒逐渐熄灭时，它们依然闪烁着微弱的光芒。 你冲向她的头部，心中充满疑惑——究竟发生了什么？你完全没有想到那次攻击会如此猛烈。当你经过她的身体时，她的身体突然动了起来，手中紧握着一块烧焦的木头。一把虚幻的剑突然出现在她的手中，紧接着就被她抵在了你的胸前。你还来不及从惊讶中回过神来，她就举起了双手。 [party.isJustPC|不想做出任何轻率的决定。|向你的盟友发出信号，让他们停止行动。]如果你砍下了某人的头，他们却仍然继续战斗，那你到底还能用什么办法来阻止他们呢？ 这时，另一个女性的声音在院子里响起，肌肉度愤怒而克制：“立刻停止这种愚蠢的行为！阿图吉娅，这到底是什么意思？ |你在骑士的连续攻击下踉跄着后退，最终被迫蹲了下来。她猛地朝你冲过来，将长柄斧高高举过头顶，准备用双手同时发动攻击。就在这时，骑士突然停下了动作——她的头竟然从肩膀上掉了下来，因为另一个女性的声音在庭院中响彻开来。你惊愕地瞪着眼，看着她的身体重新恢复平衡，武器也重新举在了手中。 “立刻停止这种愚蠢的行为！阿图吉娅，这到底是什么意思？ ] 她的言语仿佛蕴含着某种魔力，使得你能够清晰地听到周围每一个角落传来的声音。听到这些话时，骑士握住武器的手部微微一颤，那把细长的武器也似乎变得暗淡了一些。现在你有时间仔细观察，会发现骑士的脖颈后方正冒着浓浓的蓝色烟雾。它在空气中迅速消散，但却朝着头部的方向飘去，仿佛是被一阵微风吹动的。 “巴-女男爵，夫人。我只是想抓住那些摧毁了古老寺庙的邪教徒中落单的人而已。”骑士的声音从那被砍下的头盔中怯生生地传来。你可以看到有一缕类似的蓝色雾气朝她的身体飘去，然后逐渐消散。那个头颅颤抖了一下，随后迅速重新回到她的身体上，稳稳地恢复了原来的位置。咚她立正站好，放下了手中那段烧焦的木头。你顺着她的视线望去，眼前出现了一幅令人叹为观止的景象。 一位高挑而美丽的女子站在通往城堡正门的楼梯顶端。你的目光首先落在了她的眼睛上——那双深蓝色的眼睛仿佛两片无边无际的海洋，正凝视着你。[party.som|| 以及[companion1.name]| 以及你的盟友们]她愣了一会儿，然后将目光定在那位骑士身上——啊，二呀？这是她的名字吗？她的眼神中充满了怒火。她穿着一件简单编织的布裙，裙色为漆黑的曜石色，上面还点缀着一些闪烁着红光的图案，这些图案更加突出了她那柔美的身姿。一条鲜红色的丝带将裙子系在她的腰间，而裙子的侧面有一道开口，露出了她白皙的臀部以及修长笔直的腿。[party.isJustPC|这个[pc.manWoman]看起来|这些人看起来……]完全不是她们那样的，”那位贵族女士厉声说道。听到这番话，阿图吉娅明显缩了缩身子，双手不知该摆放在哪里，显得有些局促不安。很难相信，这个人就是刚才还在与你交战的那个人。男爵夫人挑了挑眉毛，等待着她的回应。 但、但这并不意味着他们没有关系，夫人。我只是想确认城堡的安全状况而已……” “你只是想找茬而已。立刻回你的住处去。等我们招待完客人，我会处理你的问题。”那位威严的女士打断了他的话。阿图吉娅突然动了起来，她的身体似乎在头部做出反应之前就已经本能地遵从了那个指令。考虑到战斗之后发生的一切，或许真的是这样吧。女男爵跟着她进入了城堡，然后转身对你深深地吸了一口气。当她呼气时，她脸上的那种严厉威严已经消失得无影无踪了。 那么，我知道我的亲信们对你的接待并不热情，但我希望你不会因此对我们怀有怨恨。目前，我们的领地正遭受着岛上的兽人劫掠者、疯狂的半人马，以及古林里那些奇怪的新生物的侵扰，因此我也无法为你提供太多的招待条件。我的注意力已经够分散了。如果你是来寻找住处的，我相信在村里的酒馆里一定能找到合适的安排。如果不是的话……如果你愿意的话，我允许你留在院子里或者警卫室里。" 她慈祥地微笑着，注视着[party.isJustPC|你准备好了吗？|依次与小组成员每个人进行交流。]现在我必须回去履行我的职责了……还要管教那个吵闹的卫兵。再见了。”她转身回到城堡时，裙摆随风摆动，让你得以欣赏她那摇摆生动的臀部。看来至少你不需要偷偷潜入城堡了…… 你现在可以四处看看，或者改天再来也行。

rows.original: [var0 |[finisher.CombatNames] last blow staggers the knight enough for her phantasmal halberd to dissipate, and you aim for a blow to the head to make sure she goes down. You get a lot less resistance than you accounted for, and almost fall over yourself from the momentum as her head sails off her body, knocked away by the force of your blow. Her tattoos flash as the light in them dies. Much to your surprise though, her body doesn't drop. What it does do is spin on its heels to chase after her head, fumbling to catch hold of it as it rolls away... |You stagger, unable to continue fighting against the runic knight. In one last-ditch attempt, you kick up at her head as she leaps at you with her halberd raised over her head in preparation for an overhand strike. To your shocked surprise, the kick topples her head right off her shoulders. You're even more surprised when she fumbles, but gets right back up without a head. The glowing runes blanketing her body snuff out, along with the halberd, and she frantically grabs for her rolling helmet. ] "No, no. Damn it Tui, you're makin' a fool of yourself! I'm gonna scare the shit out of all these nice townspeople, ugh," she says in muffled self-chastising grumbles as the helmet comes to a stop. Her body picks it up, gives it a brief dusting, and places it right back on her shoulders. It takes her a second, but she even gets it aligned perfectly! What in the world? You may have heard stories about mythical monsters that can grow new heads, or perhaps don't need them at all, but you never thought one would be this, well, non-threatening. The odd knight looks around, somehow managing to look sheepish behind the expressionless facade of her helmet. Before she can speak again, you watch as Cait [party.has Cait |bops |comes out of the Frost Hound to bop ] her on the head with a roll of parchment. "You, you... Stupid. Magic. Whatever-you-are! We aren't cultists!" she bursts out, tearing up and crushing her improvised club till her knuckles turn white. "Y-you aren't? I'm... I'm real sorry. Can we get a do-over? Carmen's gonna kill me if she finds out I scared a bunch of townspeople and was wrong like she said I was," the other woman cries, breaking into frantic hyperventilation as she fiddles with a block of charcoal-tipped wood between her hands. Cait deflates in an instant, looking more weary and confused than angry. Grasping the anxious paladin's wrist in one hand, she pulls her toward the Frost Hound. You follow close behind, so as not to miss whatever explanation is forthcoming.
rows.translation: [var0 |[finisher.CombatNames]这一记重击让骑士措手不及，使得她那虚幻的戟瞬间消失无踪。你立刻瞄准她的头部，想要确保她彻底倒下。然而，你遇到的阻力远小于你的预期，由于这一击的力量太大，她的头部竟然被击飞了，你几乎被这股冲击力撞得摔倒在地。当那些纹身上的光芒熄灭时，她的纹身也随之黯淡无轻型。 然而，令你惊讶的是，她的身体并没有倒下。相反，它竟然转过身来，追着那滚动的头部跑去，试图抓住它…… |你踉跄着，再也无法继续与那位身着符文铠甲的骑士战斗了。在最后的绝望尝试中，当她举着长柄斧准备从上方攻击你时，你朝她的头部踢去。令你震惊的是，这一脚竟然将她的头从肩膀上踢掉了。更让你吃惊的是，她虽然手忙脚乱，却依然没有头地站了起来。她身上那些闪烁着光芒的符文以及长柄斧都消失了，她疯狂地试图去抓自己滚落的头盔。 ] 不，不。该死，阿图，你简直是在出洋相！我这样会把这些善良的镇民们都吓坏的，呃……”她边说边懊恼地抱怨着，头盔终于停在了那里。她捡起头盔，轻轻拍去上面的灰尘，然后又把它戴回了肩上。她只花了一秒钟，就把它调整得完美无缺！这到底是怎么回事？你可能听说过那些能够长出新头部的神秘怪物，或者有些怪物根本就不需要头部，但你从来没想过会有这样的怪物，而且……还这么不具威胁性。 那位奇怪的骑士环顾四周，不知怎的，即便戴着面无表情的头盔，还是让人觉得他显得有些尴尬。在她再次开口之前，你看到凯特[party.has Cait |敲击声 |从寒霜猎犬中冲出来进行攻击 ]她用一卷羊皮纸猛击她的头部。 “你、你……蠢货。魔法也好，什么也好！我们根本不是邪教徒！”她突然爆发出来，泪流满面，把那根临时制作的棍子捏得指关节都变白了。 “你、你们不是吗？我……我真的很抱歉。我们能重新来一次吗？如果卡门知道我吓到了镇上的居民，她一定会杀了我的以及她说的我确实错了，”另一位女子哭着说道，一边慌乱地喘着气，一边手中摆弄着那块炭笔头制成的木块。凯特瞬间泄了气，看起来更多的是疲惫和困惑，而非愤怒。她用一只手抓住那位焦虑不安的骑士的手腕，将她拉向霜犬酒馆。你也紧随其后，生怕错过即将到来的任何解释。

rows.original: "They took your sister!? That's awful! I would've... If I coulda... I just heard the explosion and saw some people runnin' away. I never thought I'd end up attackin' the victims instead of the cultists," the rune knight says, hanging her head dejectedly after Cait finishes filling her in on what actually happened. Cait puts a hand on hers, and gives her an understanding smile. "Hey, don't beat yourself up too hard, you were trying to help. Relax a little, maybe start with that scary helmet," she offers, trying to break the glum atmosphere. The other woman cocks her head, oblivious for a second before she hooks her thumbs under the helm's upper gaps. "Oh gosh, I forgot all about that! I get so used to wearing it on patrol duty that sometimes I go to sleep with it on," she remarks, pulling the gray metal cage over her head and releasing a shock of utterly crimson locks. Getting a good look at her for the first time, you see that she looks about the same age as Cait, with a round face that's thoroughly mottled with freckles. Peridot green eyes peek out from between her bangs, astonishingly bright against her pale skin. The surprise must show on your face, because her cheeks flush as red as her hair as she shifts awkwardly. "I-I'm Atugia, by the way. Sorry about the whole attacking you thing. Oh! I could make it up to you! I'm a really good bodyguard! Carmen even says 'she'd be perfect if she weren't so exhausting'," she suddenly gushes, seemingly ignorant to what was probably an insult. You sit, stunned for a moment by the sudden proposal. "You'd do that? Don't you have a job already?" Cait asks, giving the excitable dullahan an incredulous look. "Well... when you put it that way... I kind of... look, the longer I can put off getting yelled at by Carmen for making a fool of myself, the better. I was even the one who suggested the whole 'bodyguard' thing, cause I was bored of sitting around. Less a job and more a distraction from sitting in the barracks all day reading the same books over and over. It's not like she really needs me to protect her or anything. Look. If it makes you feel better we can go up there [silly|when the content for Carmen is more fleshed out and Savin has gotten time to fill out her plotline. For now I'll take advantage of the fact that companions ignore the Frost Hounds oversaturation.|when it becomes relevant. I'll just tell her I'll be staking out in the Frost Hound for a little bit. Not like I've never done that before.]" She flops back onto the bed and kicks her legs out, spreading her arms on the blanket. Well, you guess you've made a new friend?
rows.translation: “他们抓走了你姐姐！？太可怕了！我本来会……要是我能……我只听见爆炸，又看见一些人跑开。我从没想过自己最后攻击的会是受害者，而不是邪教徒。”凯特向符文骑士说明完真正发生的事情后，她沮丧地垂下了头。凯特将一只手放在她手上，朝她理解地笑了笑。 “嘿，别太责怪自己，你当时也是想帮忙。放松一点，也许先把那顶吓人的头盔摘下来？”她提议道，试图打破低落的气氛。另一位女子偏了偏头，一时没反应过来，随后才将拇指勾进头盔上方的缝隙。 “天啊，我完全忘了还戴着它！我巡逻时早就习惯戴着头盔了，有时甚至会戴着它睡觉。”她边说边将灰色金属牢笼般的头盔从头上拉开，一头鲜红的秀发顿时弹散开来。你第一次看清她的长相：她似乎与凯特年纪相仿，圆圆的脸上布满雀斑。一双橄榄石般翠绿的眼睛从刘海间探出，在苍白皮肤的衬托下亮得惊人。你的惊讶想必写在了脸上，因为她局促地挪动身体时，双颊红得几乎与头发一样。 “顺、顺便说，我叫阿图吉娅。攻击你们的事很抱歉。噢！我可以补偿你们！我是很厉害的保镖！卡门甚至说‘要不是她太让人心累，她简直完美’。”她突然滔滔不绝，似乎完全没意识到那大概是一句挖苦。面对这突如其来的提议，你一时惊得坐在那里说不出话。 “你愿意那么做？你不是已经有工作了吗？”凯特难以置信地看着兴奋的无头骑士，问道。 “嗯……你这么一说……我有点……听着，越晚因为出丑而被卡门训斥越好。最初还是我觉得整天坐着太无聊，才提议要当‘保镖’的。与其说这是工作，不如说是为了逃避整日待在营房里，把同样的书翻来覆去地读。她其实根本不需要我保护什么。这样吧，如果能让你们安心，我们可以一起上去，[silly|等卡门的内容更加充实，而萨文也抽出时间补完她的剧情线之后再说。现在我就先利用同伴们不受霜冻猎犬人数过多影响这一点吧。|等这件事变得有必要的时候再说。我只要告诉她，我会在霜冻猎犬待一阵子。反正也不是没这么做过。]”她一头倒回床上，踢直双腿，将双臂摊开在毯子上。 嗯，看来你交到了一位新朋友？
rows.raw: ""They took your sister!? That's awful! I would've... If I coulda... I just heard the explosion and saw some people runnin' away. I never thought I'd end up attackin' the victims instead of the cultists," the rune knight says, hanging her head dejectedly after Cait finishes filling her in on what actually happened. Cait puts a hand on hers, and gives her an understanding smile. "Hey, don't beat yourself up too hard, you were trying to help. Relax a little, maybe start with that scary helmet," she offers, trying to break the glum atmosphere. The other woman cocks her head, oblivious for a second before she hooks her thumbs under the helm's upper gaps. "Oh gosh, I forgot all about that! I get so used to wearing it on patrol duty that sometimes I go to sleep with it on," she remarks, pulling the gray metal cage over her head and releasing a shock of utterly crimson locks. Getting a good look at her for the first time, you see that she looks about the same age as Cait, with a round face that's thoroughly mottled with freckles. Peridot green eyes peek out from between her bangs, astonishingly bright against her pale skin. The surprise must show on your face, because her cheeks flush as red as her hair as she shifts awkwardly. "I-I'm Atugia, by the way. Sorry about the whole attacking you thing. Oh! I could make it up to you! I'm a really good bodyguard! Carmen even says 'she'd be perfect if she weren't so exhausting'," she suddenly gushes, seemingly ignorant to what was probably an insult. You sit, stunned for a moment by the sudden proposal. "You'd do that? Don't you have a job already?" Cait asks, giving the excitable dullahan an incredulous look. "Well... when you put it that way... I kind of... look, the longer I can put off getting yelled at by Carmen for making a fool of myself, the better. I was even the one who suggested the whole 'bodyguard' thing, cause I was bored of sitting around. Less a job and more a distraction from sitting in the barracks all day reading the same books over and over. It's not like she really needs me to protect her or anything. Look. If it makes you feel better we can go up there [silly|when the content for Carmen is more fleshed out and Savin has gotten time to fill out her plotline. For now I'll take advantage of the fact that companions ignore the Frost Hounds oversaturation.|when it becomes relevant. I'll just tell her I'll be staking out in the Frost Hound for a little bit. Not like I've never done that before.]" She flops back onto the bed and kicks her legs out, spreading her arms on the blanket. Well, you guess you've made a new friend? "

rows.original: You step into the castle guardhouse, curious to see what such a building even looks like in a castle with no garrison to speak of besides the headless knight. Things [pc.bgMulti soldier noblescion|look like a standard barracks, a little lavish even|seem perfectly normal for a high-class guard house|seem fairly standard, as far as you know], with a number of cleanly-made bunks evenly spaced in rows of two going back along each wall. You can make out a vague sign directing you toward the bathing area behind one of the beds at the back. Further into the room the cleanliness changes to an ungodly mess. Bedding and clothing are strewn about in a seemingly random manner, creating a path of chaos you don't feel safe stepping in. As you try to see past the clutter, you accidentally knock over a basket of unkempt shirts. You hear a commotion from the washroom, and are surprised to see a young woman with a shock of bright red hair and more freckles than you can count come rushing out. She begins talking before she sees you, still drying her hair with an already damp towel. Another towel is wrapped around her midsection and hips, perfectly obscuring a pair of what can't be more than perky B-cups. Her mess of freckles extends across her chest and to both shoulders, creating numerous constellations on her otherwise pale skin. Her neck catches your eye as well, the flesh of it suffused with a deep sapphire light. It looks almost like a cross section of ocean water, peppered with bright stars. "Sorry! Carmen never tells me when she's sendin' guests out for tours, so blame her if you've been waitin'. So who are you, one of the townsfolk? Someone from out of tow- Y-you!" she shouts, her whole face flushing red in an instant. She makes no move to cover herself further, appearing more embarrassed about confusing you for one of the baroness's [flags.TODO_BARON_SECRET|virgins|guests]. Beads of water still adorn her arms and legs, falling in thick droplets as she hurries to finish drying her hair. She holds the towel on her face when she finishes, mumbling through the cloth. "Sorry for jumpin' you earlier. I really thought you were with those guys who blew up the temple, but I guess I coulda talked first," she apologizes, lowering the towel enough to glance at you with peridot green eyes. "Don't worry about it. [pc.dcb|Practice fighting is good exercise anyway, and you weren't a total slouch,|It was an honest mistake, and you did a good job trying to protect the castle,|A fight is a great time to show off, and you look, like, mega sexy in armor!]" you explain. The change in the guard's demeanor is astounding. "Oh good! I wasn't stressin' about it or anything, but Carmen gets mad when I pick fights. She says 'it's improper for an upstanding noblewoman's bodyguard to be fighting like some brawling Jassiran gladiator.' D-don't tell her I was talkin' about her like that, or callin' her by her first name," she rambles, dropping the towel that was around her midsection. "Name's Atugia by the way." You get a full view of her muscular stomach, glistening with moisture. You also get confirmation on the perky B-cups, along with a pair of cherry pink nipples and more freckles that pepper her chest. They bounce gently as she hops over to a slightly cleaner-looking pile of outfits, drying off her legs one at a time. "So why'd you come down here, then?" she asks, muffled by the gray leather jerkin she's in the process of pulling over her head. She gives you an inquisitive look, pulling up a pair of matching pants and tying them off with a rope belt. The pants provide a good amount of coverage, but she makes no move to do any of the jerkin's numerous buttons, leaving her stomach and cleavage exposed. "I was just looking around. Wanted to see what kind of rooms the castle servants had, but it looks like you have this whole place to yourself," you explain. She looks around, as if noticing the mess for the first time. "Oh... Y-yeah I usually have this place to myself. I don't know when there got to be this much stuff lyin' around. The important guests usually stay in the more comfortable rooms in the house near Carmen's quarters. Sometimes even in Carmen's quarters if she enjoys their company enough. Séverine hibernates, but that's not really the same, so she doesn't need a bed." She attempts to scoot a pile of laundry under one of the bunks, only for another pile to slide out from under your end of the bed. "Eh-heh... I should really clean up. B-but I usually am down here when I'm not patrollin'. If you need me for anythin' it's the best place to find me," she nods, a slight blush still reddening her freckled cheeks. She moves to try and clean some of the mess, leaving you to continue your explorations.
rows.translation: 你走进城堡的卫兵室，好奇地想看看：在一个除了那个无头骑士之外根本没有任何驻军的城堡里，这样的建筑到底是什么样子的。 [pc.bgMulti soldier noblescion|看起来就像普通的营房，甚至还有点豪华呢。|对于一所高级警卫室来说，这一切看起来都完全合乎常理。|据你所知，这些似乎都相当标准。]房间内，沿着两面墙排列着多张制作精良的床铺，它们两两成排地摆放着。在房间后面的某张床旁边，你能看到一个模糊的指示标志，指向淋浴区。然而，继续往房间深处走，卫生状况就会变得一团糟：床单和衣物被随意地扔得到处都是，形成了一条混乱不堪的通道，让人踩上去时甚至会感到不安。 当你试图拨开那些杂乱的东西时，不小心碰倒了一篮子乱七八糟的衬衫。这时，你听到洗手间那边传来一阵嘈杂声，惊讶地看到一个拥有亮红色头发的年轻女子冲了出来——她的雀斑多得数都数不过来。她还没看到你，就开始说话了，手里还拿着一条已经有点湿的毛巾在擦头发。另一条毛巾缠在她的腰间和臀部，将她那显然非常紧致的B罩杯完美地遮住了。她身上那些零星的雀斑遍布在她的胸口和双肩上，在她原本较为苍白的皮肤上形成了许多“星座”。她的脖颈也吸引了你的目光，那肌肤呈现出深邃的蓝宝石般的光泽，看起来简直就像一片海洋的横截面，上面点缀着璀璨的星星。 对不起！卡门从来不会告诉我她什么时候会安排客人去参观，所以如果你等了很久的话，那就怪她吧。那么你到底是谁呢？是镇上的居民吗？还是从外地来的……你……”她喊道，整个脸瞬间变得通红。她没有采取任何动作来遮掩自己，看起来因为被误认为是男爵夫人的随从而感到更加尴尬。 [flags.TODO_BARON_SECRET|处女们|客人]她的身上还挂着水珠，匆忙地擦干头发时，水珠纷纷掉落下来。擦完后，她把毛巾敷在脸上，透过毛巾喃喃自语。 “刚才突然跳出来打扰你，实在不好意思。我真以为你和那些炸毁寺庙的人是一伙的，不过我想我本应该先打个招呼的。”她边说边把毛巾往下拉了拉，用那双橄榄绿色的眼睛看着你。 “没关系，别放在心上。”你说道。 [pc.dcb|练习战斗反正也是很好的锻炼方式，而且你也不是完全不行嘛。|这确实是一个无心的错误，但你为保护城堡所做的一切确实非常出色。|打架可是展示自己实力的好机会，而且你穿上盔甲后，看起来简直性感极了！]你来说说吧。那些卫兵的态度变化真是太惊人了。” “哦，太好了！我本来也没太担心这个，不过每次我故意惹事的时候，卡门都会生气。她说：‘一个正派贵族女性的保镖，不应该像那些好斗的贾西兰角斗士一样打架。’千万别告诉她我是这么评价她的，也别叫她的名字哦。”她边说边把围在腰间的毛巾扔掉了。“顺便说一下，她的名字叫阿图吉娅。 你可以清楚地看到她那肌肉结实、泛着水光的腹部。同时，你也能清楚地看到她那饱满的B罩杯，以及那对樱桃粉色的乳头，还有散布在她胸前的那些雀斑。当她跳到那堆看起来稍微干净一些的衣物旁，逐一擦干自己的双腿时，那些胸部会轻轻地上下晃动。 那你为什么来到这里呢？”她问道。此时她正把一件灰色皮夹克套在身上，声音因此有些闷闷的。她好奇地望着你，然后拉上了一条配套的裤子，并用一根绳子将它们系紧。这条裤子为她的身体提供了足够的遮盖，但她却没有去扣那件夹克上的许多纽扣，因此她的腹部和胸部仍然暴露在外。 我只是在四处看看而已。想看看城堡里的仆人们住的是什么样的房间，不过看起来这一整处地方都是你自己在用的啊，”你说道。她环顾四周，似乎也是第一次注意到这里如此凌乱。 “哦……嗯，是的，通常这一处地方都是我自己在用。我不知道这些东西是怎么会堆得这么多的。重要的客人通常都会住在房子里靠近卡门住处的那些更舒适的房间里。有时候甚至在……里面如果卡门喜欢和她们待在一起的话，可以让她们住进卡门的房间。塞维琳会进入冬眠状态，但那其实和正常生活不太一样，所以她并不需要床。”她试图把一堆洗好的衣物塞到其中一张床铺的下面，结果另一堆衣物却从你那边的床铺下面滑了出来。 呃……我确实应该打扫一下。不过平时我不在巡逻的时候就会待在这里。如果你需要我帮忙什么，这里就是找我的最佳地点。”她边说边点头，那些带着雀斑的脸颊依然带着一丝红晕。她开始动手清理那些凌乱的物品，让你可以继续你的探索了。

rows.original:
You approach the redheaded guard at the far end of the guardhouse. She's dressed more modestly than the last time you saw her, but not by much. Her long pants have been traded for a skirt that would provide ample coverage... if she weren't lying on her back with her knees up. As it is, the garment shows off nearly every inch of her muscled legs, leaving only her hips to the imagination. All the buttons are done up on her jerkin, and she's reading from what looks like a leather-bound tome on the [rand|natural history|culture|social etiquette|fashion|folklore|various species|gods] of ancient Savarra. She glances up as she sees you, giving you a small wave and happily tossing the book onto another bunk.

    "Thank the gods. Carmen makes me read all these books about history and stuff, but they're all written by loquacious windbags who couldn't make a battle between the gods and the wraiths sound interestin' if they'd seen it themselves. I'm pretty sure anythin' you've got to say is more interestin'," she says, scooting herself into a straighter position.
rows.translation:
你走向警卫室尽头的那个红发女卫兵。与上次见面时相比，她的穿着显得更为端庄一些，但差别也不大。她之前穿的长裤已经被一条裙子取代了——这条裙子本应该能很好地遮盖她的身体……除非她当时是仰躺着，双膝弯曲的。这样一来，这条裙子几乎把她那结实的双腿全都暴露无遗，只有臀部还留给了人们的想象空间。她的上衣所有纽扣都扣得整整齐齐，而她此刻正在阅读着一本看起来是用皮革装订的书[rand|自然历史|文化|社交礼仪|时尚|民间传说|多种物种|神明]来自古老的萨瓦拉地区。当她看到你时，抬头冲你微微一笑，然后开心地把那本书扔到了另一张床上。

    “谢天谢地。卡门总让我读这些关于历史之类的书，但这些书都是那些喋喋不休的蠢货写的——就算他们亲身体验过神明与幽灵之间的战斗，也写得毫无趣味可言。我敢肯定，你说的任何事情都会比这些书有趣得多。”她说着，坐得更加端正了一些。

rows.original: "[pc.dcb|So what actually are you?|So what race are you?|So, like, how do you do that thing with your head?]" you ask. "You look human apart from your neck... but humans can't survive getting their heads knocked off." "No way, I woulda never known. I am human. This is just a... a war wound? Yeah! My very own relic of the Godswar," she beams proudly, rubbing the glowing blue mark. Wait, the Godswar? "Wasn't that over two hundred years ago?" you ask, raising an eyebrow. "Well, yeah. And? Is that not a normal thing to you? Well, I guess maybe it's weird for me to be a human who was alive back then, but I'm sure you could easily find one of these fae or god-servants who are still alive," she retorts, hefting one of her books as an example. "Fair enough, but still, what's it like? It doesn't look like your head would just fall off," you ask, curious about what kind of magic could have caused this kind of transformation. "Well that's easy. It's like if you could take your head off but still have the two parts be connected," she initially looks happy, but frowns as she realizes her explanation wasn't really all that informative. "I-I guess it's tough to describe, actually. I can still feel everythin', though if I leave the room it gets harder to control my body. It'll do what I'd do without any head to tell when its a bad idea. I got in trouble once cause it flipped Carmen a double bird when she asked where my head was. Mostly it just tries to get back to me though, if there's not anythin' pressing to do. It can sense what's around it, and I can get hints of what it's sensin' that way. Smells, sounds, sights." As she speaks she gives her head a slight tug. The starry blue coloration bursts with color, transforming from solid looking flesh to a small poof of wispy smoke. She continues to talk, gesturing with her free hand to punctuate her statements. When the smoke billows away you can see a flat plane of solid blue light where her neck would meet her body. "When it's together nothin' feels different at all. We didn't have much spooky stuff where I grew up, so when Carmen started bringin' in her guests I was afraid of scarin' 'em off. Imagine my surprise when half of the younger guests actually wanted to carry my head around to help me relax when I'm off duty. Once they realized I wasn't some kind of undead wraith-monster I think they just wanted someone a little more relatable than Carmen to talk to." Her head snaps back into place with an audible crack, returning to how it looked from the start. "You sure don't look like an undead monster. Or like you're over two hundred. What's up with that?" you ask. "Carmen tried to explain it to me a couple of times. Something about my body being overfull of life-force? The important part is all my bits and parts work, but they don't get any older. It's inconsistent though, and she didn't really understand the whole thing, so I just kinda tuned some of it out. My hair still grows out, but I can't grow any hair below my neck. It means I don't have to shave, so it works for me," she replies, stretching her arms above her head. "Do you mind if I touch it?" you ask with slight hesitation. You wonder what kind of magic it would take to cause something like this to happen. Atugia shakes her head with a soft chuckle. "Not a bit. I've been poked and prodded by most of the people who come to the castle, and the ones who don't are probably scared to ask," she replies, craning her neck to the side as you reach in to brush the starry blue part of it. It doesn't feel any different from your neck, just like smooth skin. Atugia tugs up on her head while you're still touching it, letting you feel the approximate amount of strength needed to knock it off. Her neck seems to just disappear and your fingers fall onto the bright plane of cerulean energy that remains. It doesn't feel like anything at all, totally smooth on your fingertips. You can't seem to press against it with any kind of usable strength, and so pull your fingers back. "Weird, right? It stops knives and stuff too. Probably wouldn't protect me if some huge orc with a hammer decided to play whack-a-mole, but I'm sure it could be useful in a fight. There isn't really anythin' else excitin' about it though," she says with a bored sigh. [party.has arona|"That some kinda challenge?" Arona grins, patting the head of her grandhammer. "I'm always up for whackin' off on cute girls' heads." "You're face looks like it's taken more than a few whackin's" Atugia snaps back. Before Arona can decide whether or not to take her up on the challenge, she turns back to you with a huff. ]"Was there anythin' else you wanted to ask about?"
rows.translation: "[pc.dcb|那么，你到底是什么东西呢？|那么，你属于哪个种族呢？|那么，到底是怎么用头部做出那种动作的呢？]你说得对。除了脖子之外，你看起来确实像人类……但人类要是被砍掉了头，是活不下来的。” “怎么可能，我根本就没想到会这样。我是人类的伤口？只不过是……一场战争留下的伤痕而已吗？没错！这就是神战留给我的纪念品啊，”她自豪地笑着说，一边摩挲着那道闪烁着蓝光的痕迹。 等等，这个《神战》那不是发生在两百多年前吗？”你挑了挑眉毛问道。 “嗯，没错。那又怎样？这对你来说不是件很平常的事吗？不过，对我来说，或许这确实有点奇怪吧人类那些人在那个时候还活着，但我相信你肯定能找到那些至今仍然活着的精灵或神仆之一，”她边说边拿起其中一本书作为例子。 “有道理，不过还是想问问，那种转变到底是什么感觉？看起来你的头并不会因此而掉下来啊，”你好奇地问道，想要了解究竟是哪种魔法才能造成这样的变化。 嗯，这很简单。就好比你可以把头摘下来，但头的两部分仍然连接在一起一样。”她一开始看起来很高兴，但当她意识到自己的解释其实并没有提供太多有用的信息时，她的眉头就皱了起来。 “我……我想其实这种感觉很难描述吧。我仍然能感觉到一切，不过一旦离开房间，我就更难控制自己的身体了。它会不假思索地做出我想做的动作，根本没有任何机制来告诉我哪些行为是错误的。有一次，卡门问我头在哪里，结果我的身体竟然对她竖起了中指，因此我惹上了麻烦。大多数时候，它只是试图与我保持联系，当然，如果没有什么紧急的事情需要处理的话。它能够感知周围的环境，而我也能通过这种方式了解到它在感知些什么——气味、声音、景象等等。她边说边轻轻拉了拉自己的头。那星星点点的蓝色光芒瞬间迸发出绚丽的色彩，原本看起来像实体的皮肤瞬间变成了袅袅升起的淡蓝色烟雾。她继续说着话，同时用空闲的手势来辅助自己的表达。当烟雾散去后，你会看到在她脖子与身体相连的地方，出现了一片平坦的纯蓝色光幕。 当它们在一起的时候，根本感觉不到有什么不同。在我成长的地方，并没有太多恐怖的故事或场景，所以当卡门开始邀请她的朋友们来家里的时候，我担心会把他们吓跑。可当你看到有一半的年轻客人竟然愿意在我下班后帮我带着‘我的头’，让我放松下来时，你一定会感到非常惊讶。当他们意识到我并不是什么不死的幽灵怪物时，我想他们只是想要一个比卡门更容易让人产生共鸣的对话对象吧。”她的头猛地弹了回去，发出清脆的声响，恢复了最初的状态。 你看起来可一点都不像什么不死怪物，也不像是个超过两百岁的人啊。这是怎么回事？”你问道。 “卡门曾经试着向我解释过几次。说是我的身体里充满了生命力之类的原因吧…… 关键在于，我身体的各个部分都能正常运作，而且它们也不会变老。不过这种情况并不一致，她也不太明白其中的原理，所以我就选择忽略掉其中的一些细节。我的头发仍然会生长，但脖子以下的部位却再长不出头发来了。这意味着我不需要刮胡子了，所以这个方法对我来说很有效，”她一边说，一边将双臂举过头顶。 我可以碰它吗？”你略带犹豫地问道。你不禁想知道，究竟需要什么样的魔法才能创造出这样的奇迹。阿图吉娅轻笑着摇了摇头。 “完全没关系。来这座城堡的人，几乎都有很多人来触碰它；而那些不敢问的人，大概是因为害怕吧。”她边说边把脖子侧向一边，让你能够更方便地抚摸那片闪耀着蓝光的区域。它的触感与你的脖子没有任何区别，就像光滑的皮肤一样。当你的手指还触碰着它的时候，阿图吉娅会轻轻抬起头部，让你感受到将其摘下来所需要的力量。她的脖子仿佛瞬间消失了，而你的手指则落在了那片湛蓝色的能量光幕上。它完全没有任何感觉，触感极为顺滑。你似乎无法用任何力量去按压它，因此只好把手指抽回来。 真奇怪，对吧？它甚至能挡住刀刃之类的东西。不过如果有个拿着锤子的巨型兽人决定来玩‘打地鼠’游戏的话，它可能也保护不了我……不过在战斗中，它肯定能派上用场。其实，它并没有什么其他特别吸引人的地方。”她说着，叹了口气，显得有些无聊。 [party.has arona|什么挑战啊？”阿罗娜咧嘴一笑，拍了拍她那把巨锤的锤头，“我随时都乐意敲碎那些可爱女孩的脑袋呢。” “你的脸看起来好像已经被敲了好几下啊。”阿图吉娅反驳道。还没等阿罗娜决定是否要接受这个挑战，她就气呼呼地转过身去，不再理你了。 ]还有其他你想询问的事情吗？

rows.original: Talk about what she is, since she obviously isn't totally human.
rows.translation: 说她到底是什么吧，显然她并不完全是人类。
rows.raw: "Talk about what she is, since she obviously isn't totally human."

rows.original: "What's it like living with the baroness? You must know each other really well if you've been living here since the Godswar," you ask. "Honestly not as well as you'd think. I don't think she'd want me going too far into specifics, but when she isn't entertaining guests she usually goes out on night visits. Earlier on we spent time together, but it was less getting to know each other and more her teaching me how I should act. Not that we didn't talk, but anything I learned about her was more from slips of the tongue or accidents. She knows all about me, but it was more that she was interested in the hows and the workings of the magic than anything personal." Atugia looks a little dejected as she specifies further. "What about Séverine? You mentioned her earlier," you ask, changing the subject. "Oh! She's great. I was a little afraid she'd be jealous when the baroness was helping me with my magic, but she was just as interested! She acts kinda rough usually, but she was like a kid on her birthday. Normally runic magic requires the runes be applied on your skin, but she helped me develop variants that could be applied to armor, weapons, and even just everyday clothing!" she says, full of awe and wonder. "We get along pretty good, but she's not really the kinda lady you hang out with every day. Work is fun for her, can you imagine? I mean, she likes to have fun while she works, but she's always gotta be doing something." Atugia seems happier now, spouting words like a fountain. "Some of the guests wanna try harder drinks, so I drink and listen to them talk every once in a while. We've got alcohol I bet you've never even heard of in the cellars, but the 'bartender' isn't really... you know... talkative." She tugs at a cloak hanging on the bedside. You wonder what she means by that...
rows.translation: “和女男爵一起生活是什么感觉？你从诸神之战时期起便住在这里，想必你们十分了解彼此吧？”你问道。 “老实说，没有你想象中那么了解。我觉得她不会希望我谈得太具体，但她不招待客人时通常会在夜里外出拜访。早些时候我们会一同相处，但与其说是在了解彼此，不如说是她在教导我该如何举止。我们不是没有交谈，只不过我对她的了解，大都来自她偶然说漏嘴或意外暴露的信息。她对我了如指掌，可她感兴趣的更多是魔法的原理与运作方式，而不是什么私事。”阿图吉娅进一步解释时，显得有些沮丧。 “塞弗琳呢？你刚才提到了她，”你换了个话题问道。 “噢！她很棒。女男爵帮助我掌握魔法时，我还有点担心她会嫉妒，但她居然也同样感兴趣！她平常举止有些粗鲁，当时却像生日那天的孩子一样。符文魔法通常需要把符文绘在皮肤上，可她帮助我研发出能施加在盔甲、武器，甚至普通日常衣物上的变体！”她满怀敬佩与惊叹地说道。 “我们相处得很好，但她实在不是那种会每天陪你闲逛的女士。工作对她而言居然很有趣，你能想象吗？我是说，她喜欢一边工作一边找乐子，可她总得不停做些什么。” 阿图吉娅现在开心多了，话语如喷泉般不断涌出。“有些客人想尝试更烈的酒，所以我偶尔会边喝边听他们说话。酒窖里有些酒，我敢说你连听都没听过，只是那个‘酒保’实在不怎么……你知道的……健谈。”她扯了扯挂在床边的一件斗篷。你不禁好奇她是什么意思……

rows.original: Talk about her life with Baroness Reverra.
rows.translation: 与雷维拉女男爵聊聊她的生活吧。
rows.raw: "Talk about her life with Baroness Reverra."

rows.original:
You ask Atugia if she'd like to join you in exploring Savarra. She doesn't seem to be having much fun here, and a change of pace could be nice after being cooped up for so long. She stares at you for a few seconds, unsure of what to say.

        "Well... Thanks for askin' I guess, but I really don't think I could. I mean probably, or, err... You'd need to get Carmen's permission... I talk a lot of shit but she really did help me when I wasn't nothin' or nobody. I couldn't just walk out and leave her, not even [silly|for a fuckin' snacc like you.|for someone... someone who cared enough to talk after I tried to beat them up.]" She shifts on the bed, not looking you directly in the eye. 
        
        "Maybe I will ask," you declare, raising an eyebrow. It's impossible not to catch the hopeful glance she flashes in your direction, but she returns to aloof shyness in seconds, albeit with a bit of a flush on her freckled cheeks.
        
        "C-cool. Tell me how it goes. I'll be around. Around here, in this room, or patrollin'. You know..." her blush intensifies as she struggles to stop talking, eventually leaving her freckles emblazoned like stars on a crimson night sky. You give her a sly smile, not pushing her any further.
rows.translation:
你询问阿图吉娅是否愿意和你一起探索萨瓦拉。她在这里似乎并不觉得开心，而且在被关了这么久之后，换个环境或许会让她感觉好一些。她盯着你看了几秒钟，似乎不知道该说什么。

        “嗯……谢谢你的邀请，但我真的觉得不行。我的意思是，也许可以，不过……你得先得到卡门的支持……我虽然有时候会说些傻话，但在我一无所有的时候，她确实帮助了我很多。我不能就这样离开她，不是吗？ [silly|就为了你这种家伙。|对于某个……某个在我试图揍他们之后还愿意和我交谈的人来说。]她在床上翻来覆去，没有直视你的眼睛。
        
        “也许我会问的，”你挑了挑眉毛说道。她朝你投来的那充满希望的目光，实在让人无法忽视。不过几秒钟后，她又恢复了那种疏离而害羞的神情，只不过她那长满雀斑的脸上泛着一丝红晕。
        
        好……好啊。告诉我进展如何吧。我会在附近，就在这个房间里，或者在外面巡逻。你知道的……”她的脸颊越来越红，努力想要停止说话，最终，那些雀斑就像夜空中闪烁的星星一样，清晰地显现在她的脸上。你对她露出一个狡黠的微笑，没有再逼她继续下去。

带阿图吉娅去见卢米娅。

rows.original:
You walk up to the barracks, finding it bereft of inhabitants and devoid of light. Undeterred, you look around the courtyard, collecting rocks and bits of crumbled wall from the temple's detonation. Even now there's still little bits and pieces of debris all over. Once you gather a suitable load, you begin chucking rocks atop the wall. The clunk of stone on stone carries no echo, but the noise can be heard all through the courtyard. After three stones you hear the scuff of heavy boots from along the rampart.

    "I fuckin' told you damn kids next time I saw you tossin' shit over the wall [silly|I'd bash ya fuckin' 'ead in, I swear on me mum|I'd nail you to it]! Don't think you can just hide behind rocks till I get bored, I have eyes like a fuckin' harpy and the patience of a Jassiran dune-worm!" 
    
    You can hear movement on the wall directly above you, and back up slightly as the footsteps come to your side. Atugia appears, fully armored, on the inside wall. She tears her helmet off, staring from the familiar looking rock in her hand to you with utter bewilderment. She grows flushed as she makes the connection, easily visible even from her height.
    
    "What are you doin'? You can't just be tossin' rocks like some kinda cheesy romance novel. Get up here," she beckons urgently, letting down the ladder from atop the wall with casual ease. You climb up, [party.isJustPC|scaling the wall in short order|followed closely by your party]. Atugia looks grumpy, but you think you see her struggling to suppress a grin.
    
    "Well now that you're up here I guess it'll be a little less borin'. Whatever you've got to talk about'll be better than the same landscape I see all the time," she says, sounding genuinely relieved.
rows.translation:
你走到营房前，发现里面空无一人，也没有任何光线。但你并没有气馁，环顾四周，捡起了寺庙爆炸后留下的石头和碎墙块。直到现在，那些碎片仍然散落在各处。当你收集到足够的石头后，就开始把它们扔向墙顶。石头相互碰撞发出的声响并没有回声，但这种噪音在整个庭院里都能听到。在扔了第三块石头之后，你听到城墙那边传来了重型的靴子声。

    我他妈早就告诉你们了，下次再看到你们把垃圾扔到墙外，我就[silly|我真想一拳打爆你的脑袋，我发誓，我妈妈可以作证。|我一定会把你抓个正着。]别以为你能躲在石头后面等着我无聊为止——我的眼睛可像那些该死的哈比女妖一样敏锐，而我的耐心更是堪比贾西兰沙漠里的沙虫！”
    
    你听到头顶的墙壁上有人正在移动，于是稍微后退了一步，因为那些脚步声已经逼近到了你的身边。阿图吉娅全身披甲地出现在内墙上。她摘下头盔，手中拿着那块看起来很熟悉的石头，满脸困惑地望着你。当她终于意识到发生了什么时，她的脸颊立刻涨红了，这种变化即使从她的高度来看也清晰可见。
    
    你在干什么？不能就这样像那些老套的爱情小说里那样扔石头啊。快上来吧，”她急切地喊道，然后轻松自在地从墙顶放下梯子。你爬了上去。 [party.isJustPC|迅速爬上了墙壁|紧随其后的是你的团队。]阿图吉娅看起来有些不高兴，但你觉得她其实在努力忍住笑意。
    
    “好吧，现在你上来来了，应该会不那么无聊了吧。无论你要谈些什么，总比一直看着同样的风景要好吧，”她说，语气里确实带着一丝宽慰。
rows.raw:
"
    You walk up to the barracks, finding it bereft of inhabitants and devoid of light. Undeterred, you look around the courtyard, collecting rocks and bits of crumbled wall from the temple's detonation. Even now there's still little bits and pieces of debris all over. Once you gather a suitable load, you begin chucking rocks atop the wall. The clunk of stone on stone carries no echo, but the noise can be heard all through the courtyard. After three stones you hear the scuff of heavy boots from along the rampart.

    "I fuckin' told you damn kids next time I saw you tossin' shit over the wall [silly|I'd bash ya fuckin' 'ead in, I swear on me mum|I'd nail you to it]! Don't think you can just hide behind rocks till I get bored, I have eyes like a fuckin' harpy and the patience of a Jassiran dune-worm!" 
    
    You can hear movement on the wall directly above you, and back up slightly as the footsteps come to your side. Atugia appears, fully armored, on the inside wall. She tears her helmet off, staring from the familiar looking rock in her hand to you with utter bewilderment. She grows flushed as she makes the connection, easily visible even from her height.
    
    "What are you doin'? You can't just be tossin' rocks like some kinda cheesy romance novel. Get up here," she beckons urgently, letting down the ladder from atop the wall with casual ease. You climb up, [party.isJustPC|scaling the wall in short order|followed closely by your party]. Atugia looks grumpy, but you think you see her struggling to suppress a grin.
    
    "Well now that you're up here I guess it'll be a little less borin'. Whatever you've got to talk about'll be better than the same landscape I see all the time," she says, sounding genuinely relieved."

rows.original: You ask Atugia what she does around the castle when she's working. Surely she must have seen some interesting nooks and crannies that a guest like you would overlook. "I mean... there's some cool places, like the bar, and some of the bedrooms that don't get used. All the parts that don't see much use are actually real neat. It's not 'cause I'm workin' though, that's just from explorin'. The cleanin' all gets done with Carmen's magic, so the extent of my work in the castle is just seein' if any spells need correctin'," she says, glancing around the upper wall. "I don't really have a 'job,' I guess. This whole wall guard thing's just what I do so I don't get bored. Carmen might say I'm her bodyguard, and I'm more than capable, don't get me wrong, but she could do a damn good job herself. I come up here most of the time cause it's got the best view, with the best amount of space to move. A couple of the upper rooms in the castle have better views from a raw distance standpoint, but it's just through one or two window angles and there isn't really anything to do, that high up," she explains, pointing to the windows in question as she does. Unlike down in the village, these windows are actual glass, too, frosted from the mountain chill. "Has anything actually attacked the castle since you've been here?" Besides the damage from the cult, you didn't see any indication of such an attack. "Nah, I might get the rare harpy popping down from the mountains to try and harass Carmen's guests as they head back to the town, but they get scared off easy most of the time. Once a decade or two, there'll be a couple kids coming up to get a look at the 'spooky castle' and pitchin' rocks up onto the wall, and they definitely scare off easy." She grins wickedly, leaving no doubt of her experience on the matter. "Most of my time not spent walkin' around and enjoyin' the view is spent either readin' in the barracks or goin' into town to get the various supplies and niceties me and Carmen need. Séverine don't need much, of course. There might be some nooks and crannies of the castle I haven't seen, but I know just about anything important that isn't personally Carmen's business," she finishes. "Anythin' else? This beats the shit out of starin' at the skyline."
rows.translation: 你问阿图吉娅，在她工作的时候，她在城堡里都会去哪些地方。她肯定看到了一些有趣的地方，比如酒吧，还有一些没人使用的卧室。 “我是说……那里有些很酷的地方，比如酒吧，还有些没人用的卧室。那些很少被使用的部件其实都相当精致。这并不是因为我在修理它们，而只是因为在探索的过程中发现了它们。所有的清洁工作都是靠卡门的力量完成的，所以我在城堡里真正需要做的，就是检查是否有哪些咒语需要调整而已。”她一边说，一边环顾着上面的墙壁。 其实我并没有什么‘正式工作’，这么说吧。担任这墙卫的工作，只是为了不让自己感到无聊而已。卡门可能会说我是她的保镖，而且我的能力确实足够，别误会，但她自己完全也有能力胜任这份工作。我大多数时候都会来到这里，因为这里视野最好，活动空间也最充足。城堡里的一些高层房间虽然从距离上看视野也不错，但只能通过一两个特定的窗口角度来欣赏风景，而且那些地方实在没什么可做的，”她边说边指向那些窗户。与村里的窗户不同，这些窗户确实是真正的玻璃制成的，只是因为山区的寒冷而变得模糊了。 自从你来到这里之后，真的有什么东西攻击过这座城堡吗？”除了那些邪教组织造成的破坏之外，你并没有看到任何关于此类攻击的迹象。 “没有啊。偶尔会有罕见的哈比从山上飞下来，试图骚扰那些准备回镇上的卡门家的客人，但大多数时候它们都会被吓跑。每隔个一二十年，就会有一些孩子跑过来看看这座‘阴森的城堡’，然后往墙上扔石头当然这么容易就被吓跑了？”她坏笑着，显然在这方面她可是很有经验的。 “我大部分时间并不是用来四处走动欣赏风景的，而是要么在营房里读书，要么去镇上采购我和卡门所需要的各种物资和用品。当然，塞弗琳并不需要太多东西。也许这座城堡里还有一些我还没去过的角落，但那些重要的地方，除非与卡门个人有关，否则我几乎都知道。”她说道。 “还有别的什么吗？这可比盯着天际线看有趣多了。

rows.original:
You ask Atugia about Hawkethorne. How often does she visit the town? Surely she must have some stories, having lived here for so long.

        "I go down quite a bit actually, at least once a week to get food from the market. The people who saw me up here when they were kids think I'm some kind of spooky monster knight, so I just go in plain clothes. The villagers probably think I live down towards the valley and travel up from some little farmstead," she chuckles, pointing at the admittedly monstrous helmet under her arm. 
        
        "It requires a bit of an odd route, but it's nice. People think I'm some kinda wyld elf offshoot cause of my neck, and I've somehow managed to not have a single accident with my head down there. Carmen prepares most of the meals up here, but I have to cook on the odd occasion she goes out. I'll have you know I'm a pretty good cook for being self-trained," she puffs up proudly. 
        
        "I'm sure you are."
        
        "H-hey, I'll have you know I can cook an egg four different ways. Four!" she holds up four fingers, standing defiant in the face of imagined mockery. 
        
        "I remember one time another visiting trader challenged me to a drinkin' contest — the look on the innkeeper's face when he collapsed and I asked for somethin' stronger was worth tastin' the swampy ale he requested for the challenge." She mock gags, making a bitter face at the memory.
        
        "You get used to having hundreds of years' worth of hand-picked good liquor, available whenever you want. On top of years of practice, I channel the tolerance of my ancestors without thinkin' about it, and this headless stuff mucks with the deleterious effects anyway. Some of it just gets lost on the way through. Gets annoyin' cause I gotta drink double to get drunk if I don't stop constantly to putz around with runes." She gives an exaggerated pout. 
        
        "It's not like I ever lived there, but I still don't want anythin' bad to happen to the people in town. Sounds kinda cheesy, but you get used to seein' people. Havin' 'em get old is one thing, but it's worse when it's somethin' that could've been stopped," she grows serious as she talks, looking down at the sprawl of Hawkethorne. 
        
        "Hey now, I'm sure you'd fit right in defending the city if any evil monsters show up, especially after the zeal you had fighting me," you offer, prompting a smile that cracks her brooding.
        
        "Gee thanks. So! You got anything more cheerful you want to talk about?" Her tone belies her visibly improved mood.
rows.translation:
你向阿图吉娅询问了关于鹰棘镇的事情。她多久去一次那个小镇呢？毕竟她在这里住了这么久，肯定有一些故事可以讲吧。

        “其实我挺经常去的，至少每周会去一次市场采购食物。那些小时候在这里看到我的人，都以为我是什么可怕的怪物骑士，所以我现在总是穿着便装出门。村民们大概以为我住在山谷的下方，是从某个小农场过来的吧。”她笑着说，同时指了指自己胳膊下那个确实看起来很吓人的头盔。 
        
        虽然路线有点奇怪，但还不错。因为我的脖子那个样子，人们总以为我是某种野精灵的后裔，不过奇怪的是，我从来都没有因为低头而发生过任何意外。卡门通常会在这里准备大部分饭菜，但当她外出时，我就得自己做饭。不过说实话，我完全是靠自学成才的，我的厨艺还挺不错的呢。”她自豪地说道。 
        
        我敢肯定你是这样的。”
        
        “嘿，我得告诉你，我可以用四种不同的方法来做鸡蛋——四种方法哦！”她伸出四根手指，坚定地站在那里，仿佛在面对想象中的嘲笑。
        
        “我记得有一次，有位来访的商人向我发起了一场饮酒比赛——当酒馆老板昏倒在地，而我要求喝一些更烈的酒时，他脸上的表情，真的让我觉得，为了尝尝他为了这场比赛准备的那种难喝的麦芽酒，也是值得的。”她模仿着当时的情景，脸上露出苦涩的表情。
        
        你早就习惯了随时都能享用那些经过数百年精心挑选的优质美酒。再加上多年的练习，我自然而然地继承了祖先们的耐酒能力，但这种没有酒头的酒却总会带来一些不良影响……有些成分在酿造过程中就会流失掉。真让人恼火，因为如果不不停地研究那些符文，我就得喝双倍的量才能喝醉。”她夸张地撅起了嘴。 
        
        虽然我从来没在那里生活过，但我还是不希望镇上的人们遭遇任何不幸。这么说可能有点老套，但人们总是会习惯看到彼此的。看着他们慢慢变老是一回事，但当有些本可以避免的事情真的发生时，那就更让人难过了。”她说着，神情变得严肃起来，目光投向鹰棘镇镇那片广阔的区域。 
        
        嘿，我觉得要是有什么邪恶怪物出现，你肯定能很好地协助我们保卫这座城市，尤其是考虑到你刚才与我战斗时表现出的那种斗志。”你说道，这让她原本阴沉的表情终于露出了笑容。
        
        “哎呀，谢谢你。那么！你还有没有什么更愉快的事情想聊吗？”她的肌肉度虽然如此，但显然她的情绪已经好转了许多。

"[var0|I think that's all I had for you," you relay with a smile. rows.original:
As you approach the barracks, you stagger from a sudden impact, losing the fight with balance after a moment and falling on your [pc.ass]. You shake your head, looking to see what hit you, and need to rub your eyes to confirm it.

    It's Atugia! Or well, it's her body. The headless dullahan stands before you, fully nude and still dripping with water. She dusts herself off, seeming to notice you for the first time. She points excitedly, clapping and trying to pull you to your feet when she sees it's you. Sees? Senses? Ugh, how does that even work? The fit bodyguard doesn't give you a chance to think about it, pulling you up and toward the castle. [party.isJustPC||Seeming to notice your companion[party.manyCompanions|s] for the first time, she beckons for [party.oneCompanion|[companion1.himHer]|them] to follow.]
    
    Still reeling with confusion, you follow the headless naked knight through the hallways and stairs into the upper wings of the castle. She pauses outside a door to peek inside before dragging you into one of the more lavish bedrooms, complete with a set of gossamer curtains on a four-post bed with more pillows than you can think of what to do with. Atugia's body dances over to the bed and pulls the curtains wide. With no further obstacles, the headless knight plops down onto the cushiony mattress, spreading her legs in an obvious display of her intentions. 
    
    Considering how wet she is, it looks like Atugia's body only has one thing on its mind, but should you be indulging this..?
rows.translation:
当你接近营房时，突然受到一股冲击，身体失去平衡，瞬间摔倒在地。[pc.ass]你摇摇头，想看看是什么击中了你，还得揉揉眼睛才能确认。

    那是阿图吉娅！或者说，是她的身体。那个没有头部的杜拉汉站在你面前，全身赤裸，身上还滴着水。她拍掉身上的灰尘，似乎这才第一次注意到你的存在。看到是你后，她兴奋地指着你，拍手示意，还想拉你站起来。看到？感知到？唉，这到底是怎么回事呢？那个身材火辣的保镖根本不给你思考的时间，直接拉着你朝城堡走去。 [party.isJustPC||似乎注意到了你的同伴[party.manyCompanions|]这是她第一次主动邀请别人。 [party.oneCompanion|[companion1.himHer]|他们]请继续关注。]
    
    你仍然处于困惑之中，跟着那个没有头、光着身体的骑士穿过走廊和楼梯，来到了城堡的上层区域。她在一扇门外停了下来，往里面瞥了一眼，然后把你拉进了其中一间装饰极为豪华的卧室。那里的四柱床上挂着薄如蝉翼的窗帘，而枕头的数量多得让你根本不知道该如何使用它们。阿图吉娅的身体缓缓走向床边，将窗帘拉开。没有了任何阻碍，这个没有头颅的骑士便重重地坐在了柔软的床垫上，双腿分开，显然是为了表达她的意图。
    
    考虑到她此刻的身体状况，看来阿图吉娅现在只有一件事放在心上……但你是否应该满足她的这个愿望呢？

rows.original: As you enter the courtyard, you're surprised to see baroness Reverra exiting the door with a very embarrassed looking Atugia at her side. The baroness looks anything but flustered herself, with a stern glare directed straight at you. You continue toward her, figuring whatever it is, leaving could only end badly for the feisty dullahan. The cold stare follows you as you approach, staying level with your eyes. "[flags.TODO_BARONESS_MET||[pc.name], is it? ]I do not appreciate [pc.bg noblescion|foreign nobles|peasants] that go behind my back, especially when it concerns my bodyguard," she glares for another second before the hardness in her eyes dissipates a little. She looks back over her shoulder to give Atugia a look-over. When her gaze returns to you her expression is softer, more resigned. "... But I am not her mother, and I suppose I should be happy she's lasted this long." The harshness in her tone melts away, and she tosses you a faint smile. You see Atugia visibly relax behind her, and let some of your own tension drop. "However, I have no real use for a bodyguard who sleeps with the first trespasser to [flags.ATUGIA_ENCOUNTERED 1 2|beat her in combat|put up a fight]. You may take her if you wish," the baroness grins slyly, her eyes remaining on you. The sullen dullahan at her side looks up, bright green eyes wide with confusion. "W-what? Wait a second. You can't just go givin' me away to people! Why would [pc.heShe] even wanna take somebody who can't even win a fuckin' fight? I mean I'd be ok with somethin' like that maybe, but like, it's not normal," she bursts out, rubbing her temples with both hands. "I can in fact give you away to whomever I want. Your contract is right here, and watch your language." The baroness narrows her eyes, and Atugia springs to attention, a blush dying her cheeks as red as the taller woman's dress. She snaps her fingers, and a rather plain looking vellum scroll appears in your hand. The document details Atugia's all but eternal obligation to protect the owner, in painstakingly precise terms. There's no small print or hidden clauses that you can see, but nonetheless such a deal would require no small amount of trust on her end. "You need not cart her around everywhere you go, but you must have some place you're staying long term. Keep her there if you don't require her services; I'm sure the townsfolk would be happy to have another pair of hands," she offers, gesturing dismissively with one hand as she turns to re-enter the castle. Her bodyguard — or, you guess, your new bodyguard now — stares after her, but offers no further comment until the baroness disappears. "W-well, I guess I'm yours now. Gods that sounds dumb. I mean I guess I'm your bodyguard now. Like Carmen said though I'm totally fine just hangin' around if you don't need me. That's mostly the kinda stuff I did around here..." She looks back to the barracks, her eyes lingering a little too long. "I gotta grab some books and stuff... Are you stayin' at the inn? I can move my stuff down there, the owners know me pretty well. Haven't been there in a while. Wonder if Garth'll remember me, or think I'm some kinda god-blessed servant. He still runs the inn, right?" You assure her that Garth is indeed still very much alive. She runs off to gather her things, and you prepare to return to town. It looks like you'll have another new option for a traveling companion.

rows.original:
Well... If you're going to ask the baroness about recruiting Atugia, you might as well get it over with. You find the fiery-haired dullahan and inform her that you'd like to make good on that offer to talk to the baroness about recruiting her. Unfortunately you'll need her to actually get in contact with the woman. When it comes to actually talking with her, you'll handle it, but you need to be able to talk to her first.

    "O-oh! Yeah, I guess I didn't think of that..." she says, blushing a little and gently bonking herself on the forehead. "I'll go get her. You can come wait in the dinin' hall, and I'll bring her there."
    
    You follow her into the castle and through several doors to a quaint dining hall. It's not the type to host grand dining parties, but rather a small room fit for a family or a few select guests. The table is large enough to seat maybe eight people, though it's not set at the moment. While Atugia hurries out of the room to search for the baroness, you sit and relax for a while. You've only had a few minutes to unwind and begin examining the room before you hear approaching footsteps and straighten in your seat.
    
    Atugia re-enters the room, stopping to hold the door open. Following close behind her, Baroness Reverra leaves her to close the door as she crosses the room to take a seat at the head of the table. Her expression is level, and she regards you with calculated curiosity. The diligent dullahan takes a seat next to her along the side of the table, back straight and face forward. Despite the formality, you can still see [atugia.fucked|an embarrassed|a hopeful] blush on her cheeks.
    
    "[flags.CARMEN_MET|[pc.name]. We meet again.|[pc.name], is it? I remember you from earlier.] Atugia tells me you have something important to ask me about. If it's [var0|another request for aid, I'm afraid my answer will be the same as it has been in the past.|a request for aid, I'm afraid you'll find my resources are quite non-existent.] I won't be able to spare much, if anything, to aid in your efforts," she says.
    
    As she speaks, a magical servant brings in several glasses of water to set the table. You take a sip and try to think of the best way to ask for the specific type of aid you intend to request.
    
    "It's aid of a type, but not the kind that requires your resources. I've gotten to know your bodyguard here, and was wondering if you would let her tag along with me on my journeys. I could use someone like her, and I'm sure she could find time to return and help out around the castle while I'm staying at the Frost Hound. [var1|You know me well enough to know I won't leave her in a ditch somewhere, and I've already discussed the matter with her -|You may not know me all that well yet, but I've discussed the matter with her as well -]" you begin, stopping when the baroness holds a hand up to silence you.
    
    "Please, [pc.name]. You don't need to convince me. [atugia.fucked|Take her, please. I know you've grown quite acquainted with her," she says, smirking at Atugia.
    
    For her part, the red-headed girl chokes on her water, and her flush deepens.
    
    "Are you sure? That was markedly easier than I thought it would be. She's your bodyguard, right?|I would be willing to let her go with you. I believe she'll be in good hands with someone like you," she says, offering a tired smile.
    
    For her part, the red-haired girl's eyes widen.
    
    "Are you sure? That was markedly easier than I thought it would be. She's your bodyguard, right?]" you ask, looking between the two of them.
    
    "Please. I think, or at least I hope, that she knows well enough that I don't really need a bodyguard. I enjoy her company, but I don't want her to stay here and stagnate any longer. Besides, it's like you said. She'll have plenty of opportunity to visit me while you're staying in Hawkethorne," she says, turning to Atugia before continuing. "You need to spend some time doing things. We've been cooped up in this castle for what? Two hundred years and change? Go, use some of your life for living. Just, you know, come back and see me sometimes."
    
    "Of course I'm going to do that!" Atugia says, sighing with exasperation. "But, if it's really ok, then I'll go start moving my things to the Frost Hound!"
    
    "Go. Don't waste any more time moping around here. If I have to hear another 'patrol report,' my ears will fall off," Carmen laughs.
    
    Tui takes her cue, standing and giving a short bow before briskly walking out the door. The baroness stands as well, and you follow suit. Before she leaves, however, she gives you a more stern look.
    
    "I'm sure I don't need to be as crass as outright threatening you, but I trust you won't let any harm come to her? Don't mistake my desire for her to see the world for a lack of care," she says.
    
    "I wouldn't dream of thinking such a thing. [pc.isBimbo|Anyone that wants to do bad stuff to her would have to do badder stuff to me, first!|If it's at all possible I won't let anything take her out while I'm around.]"
    
    "I'll keep you to that promise," the baroness says, leaving through the same door she entered.
    
    You're left to retrace your steps to the exit, leaving you standing in the courtyard. Atugia might need to take a couple trips, but it looks like she's gone to set up her room at the inn ahead of time.
rows.translation:
嗯……既然你打算去问那位女男爵关于招募阿图吉娅的事，那还不如干脆把事情办妥。你去找到那个红发的女子，告诉她你希望履行之前的承诺，和她谈谈招募的事。不过可惜，实际上需要她来联系那位女士。至于与她本人进行交谈，那就由你来负责了，但首先你得能够和她取得联系才行。

    哦哦！是啊，我想我确实没考虑到这一点……”她说道，脸上微微泛红，轻轻敲了敲自己的额头。“我去把她叫过来。你可以去餐厅等着，我会把她带过去的。”

你跟着她走进城堡，穿过几扇门，最终来到一个古朴典雅的餐厅。这里并不是适合举办盛大宴会的场所，而只是一个适合一家人或少数几位贵宾使用的小房间。餐桌的大小大概可以容纳八个人，不过现在还没有摆好餐具。当阿图吉娅匆忙离开房间去寻找男爵夫人时，你就坐下来休息一会儿吧。你才刚刚有几分钟的时间放松下来，开始观察这个房间，就听到了有人走来的脚步声，于是立刻坐直了身子。
    
    阿图吉娅重新走进房间，停下来把门扶住。雷维拉女男爵紧随其后，她走进房间后在桌子的另一端坐了下来。她的表情十分平静，以一种刻意表现出的好奇目光注视着你。那位勤勉的杜拉汉则坐在她旁边，坐姿端正，面朝前方。尽管场面很正式，但你仍然能够看出[atugia.fucked|感到尴尬的|充满希望的]她的脸颊上浮现出了红晕。[flags.CARMEN_MET|[pc.name]我们又见面了。|[pc.name]，是吗？我之前就见过你。]阿图吉娅告诉我，你有重要的事情要问我。如果这是[var0|又一次求援，恐怕我的答复仍会和过去一样。|一项求援，恐怕你会发现我的资源几乎已经耗尽。]我实在抽不出多少力量帮助你，”她说。

就在她说话的时候，一名魔法仆从端来了几杯水放在桌上。你喝了一口水，努力思考着该如何最恰当地表达自己所需要的那种帮助。
    
    这算是一种帮助，但并不需要你投入任何资源。我认识你这里的保镖，所以想问问你是否允许她陪我一起出行。我确实需要这样的人帮忙，而且我相信在我住在寒霜猎犬城堡期间，她肯定也能抽时间回来帮忙打理城堡的事务。 [var1|你太了解我了，应该知道我绝不会把她丢在某个地方不管的。我已经和她讨论过这件事了。|你可能还不太了解我，不过我也已经和她讨论过这个问题了。]你开始说话，但当女男爵举起手示意你停止时，你就必须立刻停下来。

“请[pc.name]你不需要说服我。 [atugia.fucked|请带上她吧。我知道你和她已经很熟了，”她一边说，一边对着阿图吉娅露出 smirk。

而那个红发女孩则被水呛得直咳嗽，她的脸更是涨得通红。

“你确定吗？其实这比我想象的要容易多了。她应该是你的保镖吧？|我愿意让她跟你一起去。我相信有你这样的一个人照顾她，她一定会安全的，”她说道，脸上带着一丝疲惫的笑容。

而那个红发女孩的眼睛则瞪得大大的。

“你确定吗？这比我想象的要容易多了。她应该是你的保镖吧？]你在看他们两个人，心里在想些什么。

“拜托了。我希望，至少我是这么希望的，她能够清楚地明白：我其实并不需要保镖。我喜欢和她在一起，但我也不希望她继续留在这里，停滞不前。另外，就像你说的那样，你在鹰棘镇逗留期间，她有很多机会来看我。”她转向阿图吉娅继续说道，“你也需要花些时间去做些事情。我们一直被困在这座城堡里，到底是为了什么呢？两百年啊？去吧，好好享受你的生活吧。不过，记得偶尔回来看看我哦。”

“我当然会这么做的！”阿图吉娅无奈地叹了口气说道，“不过，如果真的没问题的话，那我就会开始把我的东西搬到霜犬酒馆那里去了！快走吧，别再在这里浪费时间了。要是再听到一次‘巡逻报告’，我的耳朵都要掉下来了。”卡门笑着说。

崔听到这话，立刻站起身来，简短地鞠了一躬，然后快步走出了门去。女男爵也站了起来，你跟着做了同样的动作。然而，在她离开之前，她给了你一个更加严厉的眼神。

“我相信我不需要用如此直白、威胁性的方式来说话，但我相信你不会让她受到任何伤害，对吧？不要把我想让她去看看这个世界的心情，误解成是我不在乎她，”她说。

“我绝对不会想到会这么想。 [pc.isBimbo|任何想对她做坏事的人，都必须先对我做出更恶劣的行为才行！|如果有可能的话，只要我在她身边，我就绝不会让任何事情影响到她。]我会遵守那个承诺的，”女男爵说道，然后从她进入的那扇门离开了。

你只好原路返回，重新走出出口，最终站在了庭院里。阿图吉娅可能需要往返几次，但看起来她已经提前去那家旅馆安排好自己的住处了。

rows.original: You watch your dullahan companion go about her routine, plotting out what exactly you want to do. Outright talking to her or discussing other desires is an option, but you could just swoop in and surprise her.
rows.translation: 你看着你的杜拉汉伙伴按部就班地做着她的日常事务，同时也在思考自己究竟想要做什么。直接和她交谈或者讨论其他欲望也是个办法，但你也完全可以突然出现，给她一个惊喜。

rows.original: [rand |Atugia is sitting near the fire, stripped naked as she removes and reapplies her runic markings with laser focus. She takes next to no notice of [party.isJustPC|you|you or anyone else] as she works. [flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_RUNES|It would be impossible to notice if you hadn't seen her do it up close, but each reworking leaves the runes slightly different from the last. ]When she finishes the marks on one arm, she finally notices you watching. "Hey [pc.name]![flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_RUNES| Want another lesson?]" |Atugia sits cross-legged by the fire, reading from one of the myriad history books she brought from Castle Hawkstone. For all the complaining she did about them before, she seems totally absorbed in them now. She flushes when she sees you watching her read, falling to her back and letting the book rest on her face. |Atugia is near the tents, practicing her runic magic and testing her skills at the same time. Threads of glowing energy course inches above the equally bright tattoos that cover her body. One second, a suit of elaborate armor covers her body, in the next, the same energy forms a halberd that she swings with fluid grace. [flags.ATUGIA_ALEWDIA|After a few minutes she shifts her focus to perfecting her new techniques. The energy flows to caress her body, seeming to ebb and flow around her attributes. Her explanations of what's going on don't help you see through the illusions that sift over her frame.] |Atugia's body is doing stretching exercises near the tents. She must be double jointed with the angles she's pulling off, or at least incredibly limber. You peek inside the tent, finding her head snoring softly on a pillow. A part of you envies that level of multitasking, but you can't help but worry about the shenanigans your body would get into. ]
rows.translation: [rand |阿图吉娅坐在火堆旁，全身赤裸，她正用极其精准的手法去除并重新绘制那些符文标记。她几乎完全没有注意到周围发生的一切。 [party.isJustPC|你|你或任何其他人]在她工作的时候。 [flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_RUNES|如果你没有近距离观察她所做的这些改动，根本不可能注意到这些细微的变化；但每一次重新设计之后，这些符文都会与上一次有所不同。 ]当她完成一只手臂上的纹身图案后，终于注意到了你在注视着她。 嘿[pc.name]！[flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_RUNES| 还想再上一课吗？]" |阿图吉娅盘腿坐在火堆旁，正在阅读从霍克斯通城堡带来的那些历史书籍中的一本。尽管之前她还经常抱怨这些书，但现在她似乎完全沉浸在了阅读之中。当你看到她在看书时，她的脸会立刻红起来，然后她就会仰躺下来，让书盖在脸上。 |阿图吉娅站在帐篷附近，一边练习她的符文魔法，一边测试自己的能力。一缕缕发光的能量在她身上那些同样闪耀的纹身上方流淌。转眼间，一套精巧复杂的盔甲便覆盖了她的身体；而下一瞬间，同样的能量又凝聚成一把长柄战斧，她以流畅而优雅的动作挥舞着它。 [flags.ATUGIA_ALEWDIA|几分钟后，她将注意力转移到完善自己的新技巧上。那种能量仿佛在抚摸着她的身体，在她的身形周围流动着。然而，她对自己所经历的一切的解释，并不能帮助你看穿那些笼罩在她身上的幻象。] |阿图吉娅正在帐篷附近做伸展运动。她做出的那些动作所展现出的关节活动范围，肯定意味着她的关节灵活性极高，或者至少她的身体柔韧性超乎常人。你偷偷窥视帐篷内部，发现她的头正靠在枕头上轻轻打着呼噜。你有些羡慕她这种能够同时进行多项活动的能力，但同时也忍不住担心自己的身体会做出什么奇怪的动作来。 ]

    那头火红色的头发，其中一侧被剪得较短，使得这个外国女孩苍白的肌肤显得更加明亮。未剪过的那一侧，较长的头发被掖在她的耳后，只有一缕头发松散地垂下来，搭在她的脸颊上。她的脸上始终带着一种柔美的气质——无论是她的微笑，还是她饱满的嘴唇，以及她那双充满活力的橄榄石色眼睛，都散发着这种柔美。一些雀斑从她的脸颊延伸到鼻子、眼睛，再到下巴。不，这不仅仅是零星的雀斑，看起来就像是一位疯狂的画家将颜料随意泼洒在她那白皙的肌肤上。
    [var0]
    从颈部以上看，她完全像一个普通的人类，但这种想法在看到她的下颌部位时立刻就被打消了。她的下颌下方，皮肤之下散发着深蓝色的光芒，仿佛湛蓝的夜空中漂浮着闪烁的星星，这与她身体其他部位的雀斑有些相似，但这种颜色是完全不透明的。在那种单调的肤色背景下，几乎无法分辨她脖子的轮廓，但往下，她的皮肤又恢复了正常的颜色。
    
    她穿着自己声称是她们部落常见的服装：一件厚实的皮制紧身上衣，系得恰到好处，既能起到遮盖作用，又不会过于暴露；下面还搭配了一条及臀长的裙子，这种设计竟然能带来相当程度的遮羞效果。这件服装让她能够进行各种动作，同时也能让她在想要展示的时候做到这一点。在大多数情况下，她会选择不穿内衣，这样她身上绘有的符文图案就能充分展现出来。
    
    这些符文几乎覆盖了她的整个身体，从领口下方开始，一直延伸到脚趾处。 [flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_MARKINGS|你非常清楚，她用来制作符文的那些化合物组合，即使经过剧烈的劳动，也不会发生混合不均或变质的情况。|你不知道她是怎么做到的，但即使经过一整天的使用，她的作品也不会出现任何污迹或损坏。 ]这些复杂的标记每一部分都各不相同。在某些地方，这些标记呈螺旋状延伸；而在其他地方，它们则与类似网格结构的图案相连。
    
    阿图吉娅看到你还在注视着她，便狡黠地笑了笑，假装伸懒腰地拉了拉自己背心的前襟。这个动作让你看到了她那挺拔的身材的侧面轮廓[atugia.cupSize]那些杯状突起，以及顶端那颗淡粉色的乳头……她的胸膛上也布满了扭曲的痕迹。 [atugia.isBimbo|那些令人着迷的漩涡，会吸引你的目光。|那些覆盖她身体的相同形状。]那些色彩鲜艳的纹身在她苍白的皮肤上格外醒目，凸显出她的肌肉线条以及那紧致的身材曲线。
    
    在腰部以下，她的短裤起到了更好的遮盖作用，将她纤细的臀部和大腿轮廓都隐藏了起来。而从膝盖以下的部分，她依然裸露着，她的动作显得十分娴熟、自然，仿佛早已习惯了这样的状态。
    
    “你只是想看看而已，还是其实有什么别的想法？”她调皮地问道，一边慢慢向你靠近。
    
    难道你真的有什么别的想法吗？
rows.raw:
"
    Atugia waves when she sees you looking at her, brushing a stray lock of ginger hair out of her eyes. She doesn't stare back, but makes an obvious effort to slow her pace and give you time to look.

    Fiery red hair, cut short on one side, makes the foreign girl's pale skin look even brighter. Longer strands on the uncut side remain tucked behind her ear, except for a loose lock that drops to hang over one cheek. Her face somehow manages to keep a hint of softness, in her smile, the fullness of her lips, and the eagerness in her intense peridot eyes. A spattering of freckles run from cheek to cheek, over her nose, eyes, and chin. No, it's more than a mere spattering, it looks like a mad painter threw pigments onto the blank canvas of her skin.
    [var0]
    For all intents she looks like a regular human from the neck up, but that's where such thoughts are banished. Starting just below the underside of her chin, a deep sapphire glow emanates from under her skin. Sparkling stars float in the azure void, reminiscent of the freckles on the rest of her body, but otherwise the color is totally opaque. You can barely make out the anatomy of her neck against the flat hue, but below that her skin returns to its normal coloration. 
    
    She's dressed in what she insists is common attire for her home tribe. A thick leather jerkin, tied just tight enough to provide some coverage, with a hip length attached skirt that provides a surprising amount of modesty. The garment allows her a full range of movement, and also let her show off when she wants to. On most occasions, she opts to skip out on undergarments, allowing her rune painted skin space to breathe.
    
    The aforementioned runes nearly cover her entire body, starting just below the neckline and ending at her toes. [flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_MARKINGS|You know for a fact that the blend of compounds she uses for the runes won't smear or be ruined by even hard labor.|You aren't sure how she does it, but even a days exertion doesn't smear or ruin her handiwork. ]Each section of the elaborate markings is different. In some places they swirl and flow, while others connect to grid-like blocks. 
    
    Atugia sees you still watching her and grins slyly, pulling at the front of her vest in a mock stretch. The gesture gives you a naked side view of one of her perky [atugia.cupSize]-cups, along with the pale pink nipple that tips it. Twisting marks cover her chest as well, [atugia.isBimbo|hypnotic whorls that draw your eyes.|the same shapes that cover her body.] The rich color of the marks stands out on her pale skin, highlighting her muscle and the curves of her fit frame.
    
    Below the waist her short pants do a better job at concealment, covering her svelte hips and well defined thighs. She remains bare from the knees down, moving with the deft grace of someone used to being that way. 
    
    "Are you just gonna look or is there somethin' you actually want," she teases, stepping closer to you. 
    
    Is there?
    "

rows.original:
You ask Atugia what her marks do, exactly. You've gathered that they serve as some kind of channel for her magic, but beyond that you've never seen anything like them.

        "Oh! I need to change some things anyway, would you like to watch? I can try to explain as I go. Dunno how in depth you want it but I'll try and start simple," she says, talking as she walks toward her room and pulling a heavy looking cloth sack out from her belongings. She opens a tie at the top, revealing the bag to be full of a chalky blue substance, the same color as her markings. Additionally, she brings out a small wooden cage.
        
        "First, I need to remove the old markin's. Technically, a fresh set of markin's can last for months under ideal circumstances, but re-applying is a good way to keep in touch with your sources of power. Runic magic is all about that. Having a good connection with whatever you use as a power source," She opens a small door on the cage as she continues, pulling out what is quite possibly the fattest beetle you've ever seen. Its carapace shines like some kind of silvery metal, and it buzzes softly as she holds it, legs kicking out to try and find the ground. The lithe redhead doesn't acknowledge the bug in the slightest.
        
        "So for me, my tribe uses —used, I guess— the runes on our bodies to channel the power of our ancestors. Nothin' as fancy as communicatin' with 'em or what all, but to use the essence of their strengths to improve our own. Don't know a thing about healin'? Don't matter, just use the right patterns to call up all the ancestors who used healin magic. Same thing goes for the strong ones, the quick ones, not really the smarts for the smart ones but if they knew magic you can channel a little of that. My tribe used to have all kinds of ancestral relics they wore while doin' big magic, but I don't have anythin' like that. It looked really pretty, but I guess it's not neccessary cause I haven't had any trouble," She waves the poor beetle around with her hands as she speaks, talking with her hands in vague gestures that accompany her words. Seemingly noticing it for the first time, she blushes and holds up the harried insect.
        
        "Anyways, this is a Goliath Moost beetle. They're all over the place back home, but really rare up north because they're really lazy and can't handle looking for food in the less hospitable areas. I brought this one from home. They live for an age as long as you feed them, so it works out just fine." It's certainly very pretty for a bug and looks healthy for its age, but you can't help but wonder why it's relevant to the runic discussion.
        
        "I'm gettin' there. This stuff is... uh... boy I've never had to explain it before. It's kinda like paint, where you mash paints and stuff, but it's made from these rocks from back in Teiglache," She rummages with her free hand and pulls out a blue speckled stone. Chalky dust crumbles at her touch, and she quickly places it back into the bag it came from.
        
        "You crumble them up, mix them with a little paste and water, and one fist sized rock can make 5 gallons. It's more durable than any regular paint you could find around here once it's on, too. Its waterproof, sweatproof, all kindsa stuffproof. But!" she shakes the steadily humming beetle in her hands, lowering it onto the marks on her arm.
        
        "It's not beetle proof." When the bug touches her arm, the blue lines and shapes around it seem to simply fade into fine powder, brushing off and falling to the ground in a growing pile. She moves the insectoid sonic cleaner around the entirety of her body, brushing off all the marks till her body is totally clean. She strips out of her clothing as she goes, totally nude and cross legged by the end of the cleaning.
        
        "See, simple as that!" She smiles, sticking the buzzy beetle back in its cage. Placing the bug box back into her baggage, she pulls the bag of marking material to the front.
        
        "I kinda do this by memory, but I'll try to go slowly so you can see," she explains, dipping her hand into the azure mixture. It looks easy when she starts, drawing swirling marks around her navel. As she spreads past her chest and hips, her fingers get harder to follow, streaking across her extremities like shooting stars. The substance sets almost instantly, going from a shiny gloss to a tattoo-like dryness. She works with a master's precision, moving by pure instinct and still managing to keep each line even and clean. She finishes at her toes, finally looking up with a smile.
        
        "Piece of cake. Now that I've drawn the runes I just need a clear image of what I want and I can make it happen." As if on cue, her markings begin to glow softly, filling the room with pale blue light. You can feel the energy of whatever power she's working in the air, filling you with vigor and a sense of calm stillness.
        
        "That's really all there is too it. If you wanna know more I might be able to... I dunno, teach you or somethin'. It wouldn't be as flashy as mine but it might work short term," she offers, setting her things back into the corner and blushing a little.
        
        "Anythin' else you wanna talk about?"
rows.translation:
你询问阿图吉娅，她的那些标记究竟有什么作用。你已经了解到，它们其实是她施展魔法的一种媒介，但除此之外，你从未见过类似的东西。

        “哦！反正我也需要修改一些设置，你想看看吗？我可以边走边解释。不知道你希望了解多详细的程度，但我会尽量从简单的内容开始讲。”她边说边走向自己的房间，从行李中拿出了一个看起来很重的布袋。她解开了袋子顶部的系带，发现袋子里装满了那种粉蓝色的物质——颜色和她身上的标记完全一样。此外，她还拿出了一个小型木笼。
        
        首先，我需要去除旧的标记。从理论上讲，在理想条件下，一套新的标记可以使用数月时间，但重新涂抹标记是保持与能量来源保持联系的好方法。符文魔法其实就是围绕这个原理运作的。确保与你所使用的能源有良好的连接，”她一边说着，一边打开笼子上的一个小门，取出了你见过的最胖的甲虫。它的外壳呈现出银色金属般的光泽，当她握住它时，它还会发出轻柔的嗡嗡声，它的腿不断挣扎着，试图找到地面。那个身手敏捷的红发女孩丝毫没有注意到这个漏洞。
        
        对我来说，我们部落会利用身体上的符文来汲取祖先的力量。虽然这种方式并不像与祖先进行交流那么复杂，但通过运用他们身上的力量，我们确实能够提升自己的能力。对治疗一无所知？没关系，只要使用正确的法术模式，就能召唤出所有会使用治疗魔法的先祖。对于那些强大的、行动迅速的敌人，虽然不需要太高的智慧，但如果你懂魔法，也可以稍微运用一下这些知识。我的部落过去拥有各种各样的祖传遗物，他们在施展强大的魔法时会佩戴这些物品，但我却什么都没有。那些遗物看起来真的很漂亮，不过我想其实并没有必要，因为我在使用魔法时从来都没有遇到过任何麻烦。”她边说边用手挥动着那只可怜的甲虫，她的动作和话语一起，构成了一种富有表现力的交流方式。似乎是第一次注意到这一点，她脸红了，然后把那只忙得不可开交的昆虫拿了起来。
        
        不管怎样，这是一种巨型苔藓甲虫。在它们的家乡，这种甲虫随处可见，但在北方却非常稀有，因为它们太懒了，无法在环境较为恶劣的地区寻找食物。我这是从家乡带回来的。只要定期喂食，它们就能活得很久，所以养起来没什么问题。”对于一只昆虫来说，它确实非常漂亮，而且就它的年龄而言，看起来也很健康。不过，你不禁会想，它与那些关于符文的讨论究竟有什么关联呢？
        
        我快弄明白了。这种东西嘛……呃……说实话，我以前从来没必要解释过它。它有点像颜料，你需要把各种颜料混合在一起，不过这种颜料其实是用泰格拉赫地区的岩石制成的。”她用空闲的手翻找着，最终拿出一块带有蓝色斑点的石头。触碰到它的瞬间，一些粉状的物质从石头上脱落下来，她迅速把石头放回了原来的袋子里。
        
        你把它们捣碎，再加入一点浆料和水，这样用一个拳头大小的量就可以做出5加仑的涂料。这种涂料涂上去之后，比这里能买到的任何普通油漆都更耐用。它防水、防汗，各种恶劣环境都适用。但是！”她把手中那只不停地嗡嗡作响的甲虫摇了摇，然后把它放在自己手臂上的那些标记处。
        
        这东西根本防不住虫子。”当那只虫子触碰到她的手臂时，手臂上那些蓝色的线条和图案仿佛瞬间化作细粉，纷纷脱落，堆积在地面上。她将这种类似昆虫的声波清洁器在全身各处移动，把所有残留的痕迹都清理干净。清洁结束后，她脱掉了衣服，最终全身赤裸地盘腿坐了下来。
        
        看，就是这么简单！”她微笑着，把那只会发出嗡嗡声的甲虫放回笼子里。然后她把装着甲虫的盒子放回行李中，接着把那袋用于做标记的材料拉到前面来。
        
        “其实我都是凭记忆来操作的，但这次我会尽量慢慢来，这样你们就能看清楚了。”她一边解释，一边将手伸进那蓝色的混合液中。刚开始的时候，她画出的只是围绕肚脐旋转的线条，看起来非常简单。但当她将这些线条延伸到胸部和臀部时，手指的移动轨迹就变得难以追踪了，那些线条像流星一样划过她的四肢。这种物质几乎瞬间就会凝固，从有光泽的状态变成类似纹身的干燥质地。她以极其精准的动作进行操作，完全依靠直觉来控制每一个步骤，却依然能够保证每一笔都整齐划一。她一直认真地工作着，直到最后才抬起头，脸上带着微笑。
        
        小菜一碟。既然我已经画出了那些符文，现在只需要清楚地想象我想要的东西，就能让它成为现实。”仿佛应她的要求一般，她画出的那些符号开始微微微发光，整个房间都被淡蓝色的光芒笼罩。你能感受到她所运用的那种力量正在空气中流动，这种能量让你感到充满活力，同时也带来一种宁静与平和的感觉。
        
        其实也就这些了。如果你想了解更多，也许我可以……嗯，教你一些东西吧。虽然不会像我的方法那么花哨，但应该也能起到短期的效果。”她说着，把东西放回角落，脸上泛起了红晕。
        
        还有其他什么你想聊的吗？

rows.original: Ask Atugia what her runemarks are all about.
rows.translation: 去问问阿图吉娅，她的那些“运行印记”到底代表着什么。
rows.raw: "Ask Atugia what her runemarks are all about."

rows.original:
You ask Atugia how exactly she came to be... whatever she is? She mentioned she was human, but you've never heard of magic that could separate someone's head without killing them. That comment earns a giggle from the boyish bodyguard.

        "I think you'll be a little disappointed. I draw up a blank whenever I try and think about it. It was back in my home country, and I learned later it was around the time of the wraithswar, but all I remember is my parents starting a ritual we always did around that time of year. After that it's just a lot of pitch dark and a sensation of sharpness." Almost unconsciously, one of her hands rises to rub her neck as she talks. It doesn't seem like she's hiding anything. If she has any memory of what happened it must be repressed somehow.
        
        "B-but instead I can maybe elaborate a bit on how it works. I know last time you had your hand there when I tugged it off, but that's not a good gauge of the force you need. When I do it there's not really any resistance at all. It's just kinda second nature. Early on I think there was a weird feelin' attached to it, but now it's no different than... I dunno, yawnin'? I can just tug it off or make it fall off at my whimsy." You're treated to an immediate demonstration as her head simply tumbles into her open hands. Her eyes stay locked on yours as her hands continue to move in emphasis, and it looks nothing less than effortless.
        
        "No resistance unless I want there to be. If some [silly|donk|dumb kid] comes up behind me and [silly|gives me a scoot|knocks me over the head], though, it's not gonna just fall off. Unless it's somethin' that would hurt me, the head stays on. On top of that, my runic protection pretty much guarantees I don't get ambush killed like the bookish sidekick in some horrible fairy tale. Carmen said she thought it was some kinda curse, but those are bad things in all the stories I ever read. This isn't like that. I can even do all kinds of runic magic without tiring myself out," she continues with a smile. 
        
        "My mom and dad used to be dead tired after ritual time, but I can do way more than that and hardly break a sweat. Ever since this whole incident I'm just a wellspring of energy. Carmen said it too. [flags.TODO_BARON_CUMPIRE|Not like I was any more potent than anything else she'd eaten, just that there was %"more" of me there,|Something about there being a whole lot of me-ness in there. I dunno,]" she shrugs. 
        
        "I don't understand most of it, but overall I'm glad to have it," She places her head back on her neck and awkwardly dusts her hands. You smile and fight back a laugh. That's good enough for now.
rows.translation:
你询问阿图吉娅，她究竟是如何变成这样的……她究竟是什么身份？她自称是人类，但你们从未听说过有任何魔法能够在不杀死人的情况下将人的头颅分离出来。听到这个说法，那个看起来还像男孩的保镖不禁笑了起来。

        我想你可能会感到有点失望。每当我试图回想这件事时，脑海中都是一片空白。那件事发生在我祖国，后来我才知道，大概是在‘怨灵之战’发生的那个时候，但我唯一记得的就是，我的父母在每年这个时候都会举行我们一直以来的那个仪式。之后，就只剩下一片漆黑，以及那种刺骨的寒冷感了。”她边说边几乎是无意识地抬起一只手，揉了揉自己的脖子。看起来她并没有在隐瞒什么。如果她对发生的事情还有任何记忆的话，那一定是以某种方式被压抑在了她的潜意识里。
        
        嗯，其实我可以详细解释一下它的运作原理。我知道上次我拔掉它的时候你们都在旁边，但那并不能真正反映所需的用力程度。当我操作的时候，其实根本没有任何阻力。这已经成了我的习惯。刚开始的时候，我觉得这样做有点奇怪，但现在，这已经和……嗯，打个比方，打哈欠一样自然了。我想什么时候这么做就什么时候这么做，完全随心所欲。”她立刻做出了示范，她的头就这样掉进了她张开的双手中。她的目光始终紧锁着你的眼睛，而她的双手却继续动作着，以此来强调她的话语，整个过程看起来毫不费力。
        
        除非我愿意，否则不会遇到任何抗性。如果有人[silly|笨蛋|笨蛋]他走到我身后，然后[silly|快让我走吧。|让我完全搞不懂了]不过，它并不会自己掉下来。除非它是那种会伤害到我的东西，否则我的头就会留在上面。更何况，我的符文护身符几乎可以确保我不会像那些愚蠢的配角在可怕的童话故事里那样，被埋伏杀害。卡门说她觉得这某种是一种诅咒，但在我读过的所有故事里，这类东西都是不好的东西。不过这次不一样。我甚至可以施展各种符文魔法，而且一点也不会感到疲惫，”她边说边笑着。 
        
        我爸爸妈妈在完成仪式后总是累得筋疲力尽，但我却能做更多的事情，而且几乎不会出汗。自从发生了那件事之后，我就仿佛变成了一个能量源泉。卡门也这么说。 [flags.TODO_BARON_CUMPIRE|并不是说我的效果比她吃过的其他东西更显著，只是在我的成分中，所占的比例更高而已。|总觉得其中蕴含着很多属于我的东西。我也不太清楚，就是有这种感觉。]她耸了耸肩。
        
        “大部分内容我都不太明白，但总体来说，能得到它我还是挺高兴的。”她把头靠回脖子上，笨拙地擦了擦手。你笑了笑，强忍住想要发笑的冲动。目前这样就已经足够了。

rows.original: Ask Atugia how she came to be a dullahan.
