[flags.LUMIA_SEEN| Well, except for that thing that came out of the portal, that oily shadow-monster. THAT was just like what a demon is supposed to be like!]" "What's a demon supposed to be like, then?" "A formless monster, made of shadow and hunger," Cait answers, running her fingers along her holy staff. "Creatures that swallow souls and render down bodies into mindless, savage monsters that come screaming over the ramparts of civilization's ever-waning bastions. At least Kasyrra got the soul-stealing part right, but I never would have thought it would change somebody's body like that. It doesn't match up with the sermons and histories at all." She sounds almost sad about it. "Crisis of Faith?" you ask. Cait forces a little grin. "No, no... The Godswar and the coming of demons was much more recent than Seven Gods' first divine revelations. The histories were written by mortal men, mostly scholars after the fact. I'm a little shaken that something I thought was true is now totally false, but that's a failing of my fellow clergy long ago. Not of Mallach." [var0 |"You want to talk about a crisis of faith, though?" she continues, narrowing her eyes at you. "You and Kasyrra, flying off after the battle. I thought you two were a little too friendly, but that... you actually fucked a demon! No, not just a demon, the queen demon! What's gotten into you, [pc.name]!?" What does she want you to say to that? You like Kas. She might be the kind of woman that wants to steal your soul, but there's something... irresistible about her. As a cleric of the fuck-god, Cait should be able to understand what you want from the most beautiful creature on this world. ] Cait furrows her brow, squeezing her staff. "Listen, you and her... I worry about you, [pc.name]. I need you. Not just to get my sister back, but as a friend. I don't want to see her destroy you. Even Mallach teaches that passions must be tempered; that we can't let ourselves be made slaves to our desires, but that we need to learn to control ourselves. I'm afraid that she's blinding you to how dangerous she is. You saw what happened in the city, the chaos and death. That could happen all over the world again if she's allowed to continue unchecked. rows.translation: 嘿，凯特，现在我们遇到的恶魔可不止卡斯这一个了……” 你的猫科伙伴在座位上坐得不太自在，尾巴紧紧缠在腿上。“哦，天哪，艾莉莎发生了什么事……那座宫殿里发生的一切……我真的不知道该怎么想。我本来就觉得卡希拉很奇怪，但现在我确信，那些经文里——以及关于神战的历史记载里——关于恶魔的所有描述都是错误的。 [flags.LUMIA_SEEN| 嗯，除了从传送门里出来的那个油滑的阴影怪物之外，其他的确实都符合恶魔该有的样子！]那么，恶魔到底应该是什么样的呢？” “是一种没有形态的怪物，由阴影与饥饿构成，”凯特一边说，一边用手指轻轻抚摸着她的神圣法杖。“这种生物会吞噬灵魂，将人类的身体变成没有思想、充满野性的怪物，然后它们会尖叫着冲破文明最后防线的大门，侵袭人类。至少卡希拉把“窃取灵魂”这个环节处理得当，但我从未想过这种行为会让人体的形态发生如此巨大的变化。这与那些教义和历史记载完全不符。 她的语气听起来似乎对此感到有些难过。信仰危机？”你问道。 凯特勉强挤出了一个微笑：“不，并非如此……神战以及恶魔的出现，其实都比七神最初的启示要晚得多。这些历史记录都是凡人撰写的，大多是事后由学者们整理而成的。我感到有些震惊，因为那些我原本认为是事实的事情，现在却被证明是完全错误的。但这其实是很久以前我的同僚们犯下的错误，而不是马拉克的错。 [var0 |不过，你其实是想谈谈信仰危机的问题吧？”她继续说道，眯着眼睛看着你，“你和卡希拉在战斗结束后一起离开了。我本来觉得你们俩的关系有点太亲密了……但没想到你竟然和一个恶魔发生了关系！不，不仅仅是一个恶魔，而是女王恶魔！ 你这是怎么了，[pc.name]她想让你对她说什么？你喜欢卡丝。她可能是那种会试图夺走你灵魂的女人，但她的某些特质……确实让人无法抗拒。 [pc.ptcd |除此之外，尽管她做了那么多事，你仍然相信，自己有能力拯救她。你能够把她从困境中拯救出来。 |尽管她总是吹嘘、威胁别人，但你仍然相信，你们两个人……一定能够让她不再只是一个恶魔，她内心深处依然有一个女人，一个美丽而坚强的女人。 |她如此美丽，如此强大，如此坚韧。不知为何，你总想和她在一起。但是，为了自己的欲望，你真的愿意牺牲整个世界吗……真的可以吗？每当想到卡丝，就很难保持清醒的头脑。 |你绝对听不到凯特那些自以为是的废话。你和卡斯一定会成为一对非常完美的情侣，是最强大、最激情的情侣。作为那位“该死之神”的牧师，凯特应该能够理解你对这个世界上最美丽的生物所怀有的渴望。 ] 凯特皱起了眉头，紧握着手中的法杖说道：“听着，你和她……我真的很为你担心。[pc.name]我需要你。不仅仅是为了让我的妹妹回到我身边，也是因为我们是朋友。我绝不希望看到她毁掉你。就连马拉克也说过，情感必须得到克制；我们不能让自己成为欲望的奴隶，而应该学会控制自己。恐怕她正在蒙蔽你的双眼，让你忽视她其实有多危险。你看到了城市里发生的一切——混乱与死亡。如果让她继续为所欲为而不受任何约束，同样的事情可能会在世界各地再次发生。那将会是另一场“神战”。那么我会好好管住她的，”你这样说道。也许这确实是可行的。你能阻止卡斯在萨瓦拉地区继续释放那些可憎的生物吗？毕竟，如果你们俩都被那些暗影恶魔吞噬，那就根本不可能在一起了。 凯特叹了口气：“希望你是对的。但是，我想让你知道：我永远不会离开你。直到最后一刻，无论你什么时候需要我，我都会在你身边。我欠你这个。只是……请一定要在处理卡希拉的事情时保持冷静。也许她还能被拯救，或者至少被控制住。但我实在不希望看到她最终控制了你。 |至于卡希拉本人，”凯特继续说道，同时叹了口气，“她既美丽又危险，而且很可能有点疯狂。阿丽莎看起来也是这种类型。但她们两个人都缺乏那种让人类成为真正人类的东西——或者说，让猫科动物成为猫科动物的东西，我讨厌用那个说法……但你应该明白我的意思吧？那种对他人充满关怀、理解与爱的情怀。而他们所关心的，唯有自己的欲望，以及如何增强自己的权力。他们正是马拉克向我们发出的最严峻的警告——当我们完全屈服于自己的欲望时，将会发生什么；当一个人缺乏自律与控制力时，最终会落得怎样的下场。她叹了口气：“我内心有一部分希望他们能够被拯救。或者至少能够被控制，让他们……我不知道，用他们的力量去做好事吧？哈，这个想法还挺美好的！” 是啊，但可惜，这个可能性应该不大吧。对吧？ ]

rows.original: "Barney's not quite what I expected," you tell her. The kitten snickers, wiggling her tail. "Dad's great! I mean, I'm incredibly lucky to have a dad at all — most girls that come to the Temple don't know their parents at all, and the ones born in the temple usually only know their mothers more than a passing yearly visit from their fathers. That... probably sounds harsher on the harlot lifestyle than I mean it to, but I just want to make it clear that the fact that my father cared enough to stick around is something special all on its own. I mean, sure, my mom being my mom, he had to pay a fooooortune to have me and Calla with her, so there's certainly more investment than with most harlots' children, but even the other blue-blood harlots can't expect the kind of relationship Dad had with us." "And what kind of relationship was that?" "One that... well, it felt like a family. He genuinely loves my mother — and she him, don't doubt it for a second — and he loves me and Calla. Being a harlot's children, basically owned by the faith, we couldn't leave the Forbiddence much, so he would come to us as often as he could. He'd teach us, tell us stories about his travels, play with us, tuck us in at night..." Cait sighs wistfully, resting her chin in her hands. "I knew that he had another family. A 'real' family with a 'real' wife, somewhere else in the city, but that never mattered to me. He made it very apparent that he cared about me and Calla and our mom, no matter how we'd come into his life." "Another family?" you ask. "I remember Barney mentioned being a lord and all." "Right, he's a Jassiran magister — it's like being a village elder, but with more scholarship and traveling around the country to make sure things are okay in the lands the Sultana's conquered. He's supposed to go around listening to peoples' problems and take them to the court. His wife, Lady Randa, is the state treasurer, too. Very rich family, hers. I never knew her that well, though. She... I think she found us distasteful." "She didn't approve?" Cait shrugs. "Lady Randa didn't mind that my dad visited the Temple, if that's what you're asking. She and my father are quite friendly, and I've seen them together smiling hand in hand... Maybe they're not as close as he is with my mother, but that's just how noble marriages work in Jassira: you're to breed with your court-arranged spouse so you can give the empire good heirs, then you find love in the arms of concubines and harlots. The problem was me and my sister." Ah. "You see, Lady Randa was, well, she can't... ah, I don't want to make her out as some jealous witch that just hates me for the sake of it! But she has no living children of her own, and not by choice. Every time she and my father were to give me siblings, they..." Wrapping her arms around herself, Cait gives a full-body shudder. Her tail coils around her leg, and her eyes drop. "So I guess me and my sister, when we came along... we were just proof that the problem was with her. It's enough to make a woman bitter in her soul, and make me glad I have the Brand. I couldn't stomach the thought of going through what she did!" "Right. I can see the issue..." "Yeah." Cait sighs. "So Dad dug into the fortune and paid off the Temple so he and my mom could have children instead. I think his plan in stealing us away from the Temple was that we'd become his legal heirs. You see why Dad dotes on me like he does? Especially now with Calla missing... I'm all that's left." You lean across the table and give the downcast cat-girl a much-needed hug and an ear-rub, making her purr and loosen up that tail for you. "Sorry, [cait.fucked|lover, ]I didn't mean to kill the mood. I just... with everything that's happened, I'm not going to hold back anything from you. If you ask, I'll tell. Darkest secrets and all." Oh, Cait...
rows.translation: 巴尼并不完全像我想象的那样，”你对她说。 小猫咯咯地笑了起来，摇着尾巴：“爸爸很棒！我的意思是，能遇到他，我真的太幸运了。拥有一个真正的父亲——大多数来到这座寺庙的女孩根本不认识自己的父母，而那些在寺庙里出生的女孩，通常也只知道自己的母亲，因为他们的父亲每年只会偶尔来看望她们一次。这么说……可能听起来对那些从事这种生活方式的女孩来说有些苛刻，但我只是想明确一点：我的父亲能够坚持留在我身边，这个事实本身就已经非常特别了。我的意思是，当然了，我妈妈毕竟是我的妈妈，所以他肯定付出了巨大的代价才让我和卡拉能够和她在一起生活。所以，相比大多数其他女人的孩子来说，他确实投入了更多的精力和资源。但是，即便是那些出身贵族的其他女人，也永远无法期待我父亲与我们之间那种特殊的亲密关系。" 那是一种什么样的关系呢？” “嗯，那种关系就像家人一样。他真的非常爱我的母亲——而她也同样爱他，这一点绝对不要怀疑——同时他也非常爱我和卡拉。作为那些被教会掌控的孩子，我们基本上不能离开那个地方，所以他会尽可能经常来看我们。他会教我们知识，给我们讲他旅行中的故事，和我们一起玩耍，晚上还会哄我们睡觉…… 凯特黯然地叹了口气，双手托着下巴。“我知道他还有另一个家庭——一个‘真正的’家庭，有一个‘真正的’妻子，就在这座城市的某个地方。但那对我来说从来都不是什么重要的事。他一直都很明确地表示，无论我们是以什么样的方式走进他的生活，他都关心我、关心卡拉，也关心我们的妈妈。 又是一个家族？”你问道，“我记得巴尼说过自己是位贵族之类的。” “没错，他是一位贾西兰地区的法师——这种身份有点像村里的长者，只不过他学识更渊博，还会走遍全国各地，确保苏丹娜征服的土地上一切正常。他的职责就是倾听百姓们的诉求，然后将这些问题呈报给宫廷。他的妻子兰达女士还担任着国家的财政官，他们家非常富有。不过我其实并不太了解她……我觉得她对我们这些人不太感兴趣。 她没有同意吗？” 凯特耸了耸肩：“如果你是在问这个的话，兰达夫人并不反对我父亲去神庙。她和我的父亲关系相当不错，我见过他们手牵着手一起微笑……也许他们的关系没有我父亲和我母亲那么亲密，但在贾西拉，贵族婚姻就是这样的：你要和宫廷安排的配偶结婚，这样才能为帝国生下优秀的后代；而真正的爱情，则可以在妾室和妓女的身边找到。问题就在于我和我的妹妹。 您看，兰达夫人嘛，她其实……啊，我并不想把她描绘成一个只是因为嫉妒而讨厌我的女人！但她确实没有自己的孩子，而且这也不是她自己的选择。每次她和我的父亲试图让我有兄弟姐妹的时候，总是…… 凯特双臂环抱自己，全身不由得颤抖起来。她的尾巴缠在腿上，目光也黯淡了下来。“所以，我想我和我妹妹的出现……只不过证明了问题出在她身上。这种事情足以让一个女人在内心变得怨恨不已，而我也因此庆幸自己拥有‘烙印’。我实在无法忍受再经历她所经历的一切！ 对，我现在明白问题出在哪里了……” “是啊。”凯特叹了口气，“爸爸把那些财宝拿出来，还清了神殿的债务，这样他和妈妈就能再生孩子了。我觉得他把我们从神殿带走，就是想让我们成为他的合法继承人。现在卡拉失踪了，爸爸为什么这么宠爱我呢？因为现在只剩下我了吧…… 你凑近桌子，给了那个情绪低落的猫女一个她非常需要的拥抱，还轻轻揉了揉她的耳朵，让她发出满足的呼噜声，尾巴也不再那么紧绷了。“对不起，[cait.fucked|爱人， ]我并不是想破坏气氛。只是……经历了这么多事情之后，我不会再对你隐瞒任何事情了。如果你问的话，我会全部告诉你的，包括那些最隐秘的事情。 哦，凯特……
rows.raw: " "Barney's not quite what I expected," you tell her. The kitten snickers, wiggling her tail. "Dad's great! I mean, I'm incredibly lucky to have a dad at all — most girls that come to the Temple don't know their parents at all, and the ones born in the temple usually only know their mothers more than a passing yearly visit from their fathers. That... probably sounds harsher on the harlot lifestyle than I mean it to, but I just want to make it clear that the fact that my father cared enough to stick around is something special all on its own. I mean, sure, my mom being my mom, he had to pay a fooooortune to have me and Calla with her, so there's certainly more investment than with most harlots' children, but even the other blue-blood harlots can't expect the kind of relationship Dad had with us." "And what kind of relationship was that?" "One that... well, it felt like a family. He genuinely loves my mother — and she him, don't doubt it for a second — and he loves me and Calla. Being a harlot's children, basically owned by the faith, we couldn't leave the Forbiddence much, so he would come to us as often as he could. He'd teach us, tell us stories about his travels, play with us, tuck us in at night..." Cait sighs wistfully, resting her chin in her hands. "I knew that he had another family. A 'real' family with a 'real' wife, somewhere else in the city, but that never mattered to me. He made it very apparent that he cared about me and Calla and our mom, no matter how we'd come into his life." "Another family?" you ask. "I remember Barney mentioned being a lord and all." "Right, he's a Jassiran magister — it's like being a village elder, but with more scholarship and traveling around the country to make sure things are okay in the lands the Sultana's conquered. He's supposed to go around listening to peoples' problems and take them to the court. His wife, Lady Randa, is the state treasurer, too. Very rich family, hers. I never knew her that well, though. She... I think she found us distasteful." "She didn't approve?" Cait shrugs. "Lady Randa didn't mind that my dad visited the Temple, if that's what you're asking. She and my father are quite friendly, and I've seen them together smiling hand in hand... Maybe they're not as close as he is with my mother, but that's just how noble marriages work in Jassira: you're to breed with your court-arranged spouse so you can give the empire good heirs, then you find love in the arms of concubines and harlots. The problem was me and my sister." Ah. "You see, Lady Randa was, well, she can't... ah, I don't want to make her out as some jealous witch that just hates me for the sake of it! But she has no living children of her own, and not by choice. Every time she and my father were to give me siblings, they..." Wrapping her arms around herself, Cait gives a full-body shudder. Her tail coils around her leg, and her eyes drop. "So I guess me and my sister, when we came along... we were just proof that the problem was with her. It's enough to make a woman bitter in her soul, and make me glad I have the Brand. I couldn't stomach the thought of going through what she did!" "Right. I can see the issue..." "Yeah." Cait sighs. "So Dad dug into the fortune and paid off the Temple so he and my mom could have children instead. I think his plan in stealing us away from the Temple was that we'd become his legal heirs. You see why Dad dotes on me like he does? Especially now with Calla missing... I'm all that's left." You lean across the table and give the downcast cat-girl a much-needed hug and an ear-rub, making her purr and loosen up that tail for you. "Sorry, [cait.fucked|lover, ]I didn't mean to kill the mood. I just... with everything that's happened, I'm not going to hold back anything from you. If you ask, I'll tell. Darkest secrets and all." Oh, Cait..."

rows.original: "So I've met your father," you say, grinning at Cait. "[silly|Tell me how he met your mother...|Wanna tell me about your mom?]" Cait bites her lip, running a hand up her [cait.chest]. You feel a tail snaking around your [pc.thigh]. "Why the curiosity? She's an ocean away, and bound for life to the Great Temple. She might be the most beautiful rose in the deserts of Jassira, but you've got the second-best right here in front of you..." Unable to keep that up for any longer, Cait snickers and leans forward in her seat, resting her [cait.boobs] on [atFH|the table|her knees] while she laughs. "Sorry, I just... when most people ask after my mom, they mostly want to know when she's free next and for how much." "So!" she continues, "My mother, huh? Well, her name's Nadira. Like me, she was born and raised in the Great Temple of Mallach. She's... well, I wasn't kidding about her being the beauty of Jassira: even in her forties she's by far the most beautiful woman I've ever laid eyes on, like she was sculpted by the gods with perfect symmetry and curves that have inspired our greatest poets. The Temple knew what a treasure they had on their hands, too, and the clerics put her in reach of the sultanate's richest and most powerful men. Men like my dad. And if her looks don't charm you, she can wrap you around a finger with her words — she's a talented writer, and whenever she isn't working, she's penning verse." "Sounds like a hell of a woman." Cait smiles. "She is, and I adore her so. Some people like to poke fun of me being a harlot's daughter, but I grew up in absolute safety, with a classical education and a whole family that loved me dearly. Most people can't claim even one of the three." That's more than true. "So it wasn't awkward for you, knowing what she did?" The kitty just quirks her head to the side. "Why would it be? I grew up in the Forbiddance, where hundreds of harlots and countless children of the Great Temple live together, all tended to by priests of Mallach, the god of passions both mental and physical. I've seen more naked women, well used from a day giving praise on their backs and knees, than all of Hawkethorne put together. The idea that laying in euphoria's embrace with someone else should be shameful is just silly to me. It's the most natural thing in the world. My mother, her sisters, their mother... we've been sharing our bodies in Mallach's name for generations now." "Wait, sisters?" "Well, it would be a waste for one of the Temple's most prestigious bloodlines to only make one heir per generation, wouldn't it? My mother was the eldest of three; my youngest aunt's barely older than I am! Calla and I not having any siblings caused some consternation with the clergy, but Mom was very emphatic about only having children with Dad, and I guess the priests decided not to risk a very good passive income for one or two lump sums that would mostly be spent off raising the children anyway. Besides, consent is very important to Mallach, even for his harlots. At least, that's how it should be."

rows.original: "You mentioned your bloodline being prestigious..." "Oh. Yeah, I guess." Cait shifts uncomfortably[cait.thicknessRange 50| on her [cait.butt]], avoiding eye contact for a moment. "It's not as big a deal as you might be thinking. Like, reeeeeeeally not something to put too much thought into. But, uh, yeah. About five generations ago, my ancestors on my mother's line were the rulers of a small country, far north-east of the Jassiran heartland." She continues evenly, almost dispassionately, as if reciting mere history disconnected from herself. "The Kingdom of Arkacia sat between vast mountains and the Sea of Kacia, full of deep forests and placid lakes. Rich in timber and honey. I'm told it's very beautiful, though I've never so much as set foot there myself. Jassira was expanding aggressively back then, not too long after the Godswar. My ancestors refused to bow and become subjects of the sultan, so Arkacia was conquered by force. After the king died in battle, the crown prince was forced to marry one of the sultan's nieces, who become the amira of the new princedom; the queen and all her daughters were either sent to the royal harem or given to the Temple of Mallach to get them out of the way." "That's where I come from, of course," Cait finishes with a shrug. "No doubt I have some many-times-removed cousins born from the harem. I think I heard something about a General Caitriona recently, leading some distant border war for the Sultana. That's my grandmother's name too, so... probably related." "You don't sound too thrilled to be royalty." [pc.bg noblescion|You can understand the sentiment; you left your ancestral lands too.] Cait shrugs again, crossing a leg. "I just... don't care, I guess? It was a long time ago, very far away, and it's not like it's a story with a happy ending to be excited about. My many-greats-grandfather got run through by the Sultana's many-greats-grandfather, probably followed by a lot of very unconsensual sex with my female ancestors. As much as I love studying history and all, that's not something I really want to dwell on, you know?" Fair enough. [var0 ||Though, gently, you have to ask... now that she's freed herself from the Temple of Mallach... has she ever thought about going to Arkacia? "What, to press my claim and become queen for... all of a year, maybe two, before that General Caitriona wheels around with an army and hangs me? No way! Just setting foot on my ancestral lands would put a target on my back for the rest of my life — a probably very short life, until one of the Sultana's assassins finds me! Besides, I'm not a leader... that's you, your destiny! I'm happy to be [cait.fucked |submissive in bed and out," Cait says with a wink, running a hand over your thigh. "Where you go, I'll follow. |a follower: first of Mallach, and then of you. ] Having ambitions is anathema to a harlot, we exist to be used." [pc.dcb |Well, it's good to hear that Cait knows her place at least. |"Now you're just putting yourself down," you tell her, taking her hand. Cait just shakes her head. 再想想，或许这件事最好留到以后。你还能通过许多其他方式和凯特找乐子。
    
    [cait.hasRimescore
        |凯特微笑着，将一只手搭在你肩上。她张开嘴，仿佛想要说些什么，却又停下来闭起眼睛，双肩也随之绷紧。你询问她是否还好，她从喉咙发出肯定声作为回答。[pc.isCunning
            |要你来猜，应该只是她与霜刻之间的事情
            |你不知道发生了什么，但会在这件事上相信凯特的话
        ]。你继续观察凯特，时刻警惕是否还会发生其他事情。几秒钟过去，幸好没过多久，她就用鼻子长长叹息一声，明显放松下来。
        
        “好了。我回来了。抱歉吓到你，[pc.name]。看来我心里有一部分比想象中更加急切地想要使用这东西，”凯特边说边摇晃冰冷的假阳具。“现在一切都没事了。”随后，她望向水晶棒说道：“好了，公主。该回到棒子里了。”
        
        霜刻在一股浓重白雾中消失，白雾随即被吸入凯特的手杖。一股无形力量将法杖圆形冠部的碎片拉回原位，再以玻璃般的水晶丝线缝合在一起。中心的粉红爱心变成深沉的冬日蓝色，随后褪回平常的色调。
        |一股突如其来的[pc.highLibido
            |迫切感冲刷着你。你察觉到一份馈赠：极乐。清爽寒意开始安抚你的心灵。你从未像此刻这样欣喜若狂。一切都无比美好。你努力回想除欢愉之外的事情，却什么也记不起来。然而，[pc.willpowerRange 0 66
                |你调动全部意志力，终于
                |充分享受之后，你集中精神，毫不费力地
            ]挣脱出来，并在过程中驱散虚幻的快感。
            
            尽管你坚持拒绝，仍无法忽略霜刻的悲伤；[pc.hisHer]冰冷的手指无力地抵着你的[pc.isSoulbound
                |心智
                |灵魂
            ]。但没过多久，心中的下沉感便化作认命；随即
            |困惑冲刷着你。冰冷的手指探入你的[pc.isSoulbound
                |心灵
                |灵魂
            ]。这种感觉迅速消失，取而代之的是一份接纳。
        ]霜刻依照你的意志重塑形态；表面化作不断变动的峰峦沟壑，随后恢复成[var0
            |剑般的
            |矛般的
            |原本的
        ]形态。
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    On second thought, perhaps something like this is better left for later. There's still many other ways you could have fun with Cait.
    
    [cait.hasRimescore
        |Cait smiles and rests a hand on your shoulder. She opens her mouth, as if to say something, but stops and closes her eyes, her shoulders tensing up. You ask if she's okay, and she answers with an affirmative noise from her throat. [pc.isCunning
            |If you had to guess, you'd reckon it's something strictly between her and Rimescore
            |You don't know what's going on, but you'll trust Cait's word on this
        ]. Seconds pass as you keep an eye on Cait, staying vigilant for if anything else happens. But, thankfully, it's not long before she lets out a long sigh through her nose and visibly relaxes.
        
        "Alright. I'm back. Sorry if I scared you, [pc.name]. I guess a part of me was more eager to use this thing than I thought," Cait says, waggling the icy dildo. "We're all good now." She then looks at the crystalline rod and says, "Alright, princess. Time to go back in the stick."
        
        Rimescore vanishes in a puff of thick, white mist, which is then drawn into Cait's walking staff. The broken pieces of her staff's circular crown are pulled back together by an invisible force, and are then stitched together by threads of glassy crystals. The pink heart at its center turns to a deep, wintery blue before fading back to its usual hue.
        |An unbidden wave of [pc.highLibido
            |desperation washes over you. You sense an offering: ecstasy. A refreshing chill begins to soothe your mind. You've never felt more elated than you do right now. Everything feels good. You struggle to remember anything other than euphoric joy. However, [pc.willpowerRange 0 66
                |you muster every bit of willpower you've got to
                |once you've had your fill of it, you center your mind and effortlessly
            ] shake yourself free, dispelling the phantasmal pleasure in the process.
            
            Despite your insistence, you can't help but feel Rimescore's sadness as [pc.hisHer] cold fingers limp against your [pc.isSoulbound
                |mind
                |soul
            ]. But, shortly after, that sinking feeling in your heart settles into one of resignation and
            |confusion washes over you. Cold fingers probe against your [pc.isSoulbound
                |psyche
                |soul
            ]. The feeling quickly vanishes and is then replaced with a sense of acceptance.
        ] Rimescore reshapes itself to your will, its surface becoming a shifting cluster of peaks and valleys before returning to its [var0
            |sword-like
            |spear-like
            |original
        ] form.
    ]

rows.original: As you saunter over to where Cait's usually sat, you see she's not alone: she's [silly |beeing |been ] joined by Azyrran, sitting across from Cait and sharing a honey-mead with her. The two are deep in conversation, and while Azzy's drinking, Cait has a bit of charcoal and parchment out, doodling what looks like a portrait of the [azzy.kdb |hive knight |dragon knight |busty bimbo ]. But neither activity is enough to keep her from looking up with a smile when you wander by, ears perking up merrily in anticipation of your hand. "Hey, [cait.fucked |cutie |[pc.name] ]!" she says, waving her charcoal at you. "Me and the muscle-buzz were just getting to know each other." [azzy.isDragoon |"Soon to be carnally, I hope," Azzy says with a sultry smirk. "Until then, come and join us. Or during, too. That would be fun." |"Come and join us!" Azzy says. ] She scoots a chair out with a chitinous foot, and you slip yourself into it. "So what're you two talking about?" "Faith," Azzy says simply. "Mmm!" Cait nods, turning her drawing pad to show you her work. It is, indeed, a portrait of Azyrran from the waist up (if somewhat exaggerated in the bust and musculature), with a glorious Lumian sunburst cresting behind her. Quite heroic looking. "You mighta noticed from all the flashing lights when I cast my spells, but Mallach and Lumia have a real shared love of sunfire. In Jassira, the Prince of Passion's sometimes called the Sunrise King, since the desert sunrise is, well, just about the most beautiful thing in the world. A lot of us Mallachites channel it in our spells." "And we Lumians call on the light all the time," Azzy says, "[azzy.kdb |to bring light to the darkness wherever it lies! |to sear our enemies to ash and dust. |to positively blind baddies with our beautiful bodies! And, uh, spells too. ]" [var0 |"We've got something else in common too," Cait says, giving you a wink. |"Turns out our faiths have some things in common," Cait says with a sunny smile. ] "Actually, that reminds me, Azzy, I've got something I wanted to give you. Dad brought this with him — it belonged to an old friend of his, back in the day, but he always said he was waiting for the right person to give it to. The right Lumian paladin. And we think we know just the one." Cait dusts her hands off and reaches into her pack, producing a golden sunburst on a silvery chain, about the size of her fist. Azzy blinks those well-deep black eyes of hers, cupping her hands to take it. The chain pools into her fingers, golden sun facing skyward. "[azzy.kdb |Thank you, Cait. I don't know what to say," |A worthy tribute, Caitriss," |Aww, Cait, thankies!" ] Azzy says, closing her hand around it. "And thank you, [pc.name], for bringing me here. I really am feeling at home with you all." [pc.dcb |"As long as you pull your weight," you tell her. Cait just giggles. |"We're glad to have you, Azzy." |You throw your arms around Azzy and give the bug a hug. "Yay, friends!" ] Azyrran now has access to the Lightbearer set!
rows.translation: 当你漫步走到凯特通常坐的位置时，你发现她并不孤单：她身边还有其他人。 [silly |存在 |已经 ]与凯特相对而坐的还有阿兹兰，他们一起享用着蜂蜜酒。两人正沉浸在热烈的交谈中。当阿兹兰喝酒时，凯特则拿出了木炭和羊皮纸，正在绘制着似乎是某个人的肖像[azzy.kdb |蜂群骑士 |龙骑士 |丰满的性感美女 ]但是，这两种活动都不足以阻止她在你经过时开心地抬起头，耳朵也兴奋地竖起来，期待着你能伸出手来。 “嘿， [cait.fucked |可爱的人或物 |[pc.name] ]哼！”她说着，用炭笔指着你，“我和那个肌肉男才刚刚开始了解彼此而已。 [azzy.isDragoon |即将推出肉体上希望如此，”阿齐带着一丝撩人的微笑说道，“在那之前，过来和我们一起吧。或者就在活动进行的时候也来吧，那一定会很有趣。 |过来加入我们吧！”阿齐说道。 ] 她用那条细长的腿拖出一把椅子，你便坐了进去。“你们俩在聊什么呢？” “关于Faith。”阿齐简单地回答道。 “嗯！”凯特点了点头，然后把她的画本翻过来给你看她的画作。这确实是一幅描绘阿兹兰从腰部以上形象的画像（虽然她的胸部和肌肉线条有些夸张），她的背后还装饰着绚丽的卢米安式太阳光芒纹章，看起来相当英勇。“当我施展法术时，那些闪烁的灯光你应该已经注意到了吧？事实上，马拉克和卢米亚都非常喜爱太阳火焰这种元素。在贾西拉，这位被称为“激情王子”或“日出之王”的君主，其实是因为沙漠中的日出景象确实是世界上最美丽的景色之一。我们马拉克信徒一族很多人都会在施法时借助这种自然力量。 “而我们卢米安人则是一直都在召唤光明，”阿齐说道。[azzy.kdb |无论黑暗存在于何处，都要用光明将其驱散！ |将我们的敌人烧成灰烬。 |用我们美丽的身体，再加上各种法术，让那些坏蛋彻底目瞪口呆吧！ ]" [var0 |我们还有另一点共同之处呢，”凯特眨了眨眼对你说。 |原来我们的信仰有一些共同之处，”凯特笑着说，脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容。 ]其实，这让我想起了一件事，阿齐，我有样东西想要送给你。爸爸带着这个东西来的——它曾经属于他的一位老朋友，但爸爸一直说，他在等待把这件东西送给合适的人。正是那位合适的卢米安圣骑士。而我们相信，我们确实知道那个人是谁。” 凯特拍掉手上的灰尘，从背包里取出一枚挂在银色链子上的金色太阳图案饰品，它的大小大约和她的一只拳头相当。阿齐眨着她那双深黑色的眼睛，双手接过了那枚饰品。链条汇聚在她的手指间，金色的光芒直射天空。[azzy.kdb |谢谢你，凯特。我真的不知道该说什么好。 |这是一份值得尊敬的致敬，凯特。 |哇，凯特，太感谢你了！ ]阿齐握住它，说道：“还有，谢谢你们。[pc.name]，感谢你们把我带到这里。和你们在一起，我真的感觉像在家里一样。 [pc.dcb |只要你尽到自己的责任就行了，”你对她说道。凯特只是咯咯地笑了起来。 |我们很高兴有你加入，阿齐。 |你紧紧抱住阿齐，然后也拥抱了那只小虫子。“太好了，朋友们！ ] 现在，阿兹兰可以使用“轻型之使者”套装了！

rows.original: You produce the strange, hoarfrost-crusted grimoire you purchased and hand it to Cait. "What do you make of this?" She winces when she takes it. "That it's cold as balls, for one thing! I'd say its enchanted, but this feels more like a curse sitting heavy on it to me." "A curse? But it's got Mallach's holy symbol on it." "Yeah," Cait admits, covering her hand with her cloak before she cracks the book open. "But it just feels off. There's not much holy left to speak of here, no matter what it might have started out as." She taps her thumb on a radiant red heart that adorns the first page for emphasis. The book's so cold that it's formed a thin veneer of frost over even that most holy of the Prince of Song's symbols. She flips a few more pages, humming under her breath. "This is a spellbook. It's like mine, too, all personal notes instead of old rote formulas." She pats the pink-colored tome slung on her hip. "It looks like an old church cipher, like a shorthand for traveling monks. I've seen some of this in the library back home, but it's centuries out of date. Must have come here during, or maybe right after, the Godswar." Her trepidation seemingly forgotten, Cait begins leafing through the book more intently now. There's a faint crunch of ice every time she turns the page, but Cait ignores it completely after a few moments, blue eyes scanning pages quickly. "I don't know if I can translate everything here, but it's not too complex. The first pages seem orderly, but here, look at this chicken scratch..." She points at a page halfway through. It's a chaos of diagrams, margin-writing, and coded notes that don't even attempt to keep to straight lines. Half of them go in circles, surrounding magical runes that make your eyes swim when you behold them. [var0 |She's not kidding about this looking cursed. These runes, the wild and sprawling patterns... this is the work of a mad priest, not a priest. |The more you look at these spells, half white magic and half madness, you can see more and more why Cait said it felt cursed. There's nothing holy here. Barely anything sane. | ] "What can you make out?" Cait flashes you a thin-lipped smile. "A name, for starters. Aenisa Meriel. I've heard of her, too. A mothfolk priest that went missing on a mission to Belhar after the Godswar. She's the lady that invented the White Fire spell, you know — a staple of white magic, practically fundamental. But this is... it's like the fire went out of her halfway through her journey. There's notes about her bringing warmth and comfort to ailing beastfolk tribes up here — maybe some of Garth's ancestors — but then something must have happened to change that." She flips a few more pages, scanning the writing in the margins. "I don't... I don't understand. She talks about finding something out in the Frostwood. A warmth that hypnotized her, I guess... and seems to have sucked the warmth out of her. Left her heart cold as ice. Look at these spells, they're twisted up on themselves, like pale mirrors of what they should be." The pink-dyed kitten may come across as a bubbly bimbo at times, but she's got a sharp mind when she wants to use it. Especially when it comes to magic. "Do you think they could still be cast?" Cait's ears perk up. "Can they... huh. I, well, maybe! These are still Mallachite spells at their core. I'm not kidding when I talk about this book being a little cursed, though. Whatever happened to Aenisa spilled over even to her books. I'd like some time to research this, and try to find some work arounds. Maybe I can... I don't know, find a way to breathe some warmth back into her work? I don't want to risk cursing either of us with whatever happened to her."
rows.translation: 你拿出了那本被霜冻覆盖的奇怪魔法书，递给了凯特。“你觉得这是什么？” 她接过书时不禁皱起了眉头：“首先，这本书冷得要命！我觉得它肯定被施了魔法，但更像是一个重型的诅咒压在上面。” “诅咒？但上面还有马拉赫的神圣符号啊。” “是啊，”凯特承认道，她用斗篷遮住了手，然后翻开了这本书。“但感觉起来……算了，这里已经没有什么神圣的东西可言了，无论它最初是什么样的。” 她用拇指轻敲着封面上那个鲜红色的心形符号，以强调自己的意思。这本书实在太冷了，就连象征着宋王子神圣地位的那个符号上也覆上了一层薄薄的霜花。她又翻了几页，轻声哼着曲子。“这是一本法术书。和我的一样，里面都是个人笔记，而不是那些老套的公式。”她拍了拍挂在腰间的那本粉红色的法术书，“看起来像是古代教堂使用的密码，就像是游方僧侣们使用的速记方式。我在家乡的图书馆里看到过一些这样的资料，但那些内容都已经过时几个世纪了。这些书肯定是在“神战”期间，或者就在那场战争之后传到这里的。 凯特似乎已经忘记了先前的紧张情绪，现在她开始更加专注地翻阅这些书籍了。每当她翻开一页书时，都会听到轻微的冰块碎裂声，但过了一会儿，凯特就完全忽略了这种声音，她那双蓝色的眼睛快速地扫过书页。“我不知道自己是否能够把这里的所有内容都翻译出来，但至少太真复杂。前几页看起来还挺有条理的，但看看这里……这些乱七八糟的符号……” 她指到了中间某一页。上面密密麻麻地画满了图表、边角备注以及各种编码符号，这些符号甚至都没有按照直线排列。有一半的符号是绕着圆圈绘制的，而那些魔法符文更是让人一看就觉得眼花缭乱。 [var0 |她绝对不是在开玩笑，这看起来简直像是被诅咒了。这些符文，那些杂乱无章、蔓延开来的图案……这绝对是一个疯狂的牧师的作品，而不是一个普通的牧师所能做出的。 |你越是仔细观察这些法术——它们一半是白魔法，一半则是疯狂的表现——就越能理解为什么凯特会说它们给人一种被诅咒的感觉。这里没有任何神圣的东西，也几乎没有任何理智可言。 | ] 什么？可以你指的是谁呢？” 凯特露出一个淡淡的微笑：“首先，需要一个名字。叫艾妮莎·梅里尔。我也听说过她。在神战之后，她作为一名蛾人祭司，在前往贝尔哈尔执行任务时失踪了。据说就是她发明了…… 白火你知道的，咒语是白魔法的基础，几乎是不可或缺的。但这次……就好像她在施法的途中突然失去了力量。有记载称，她曾为这里那些生病的兽人部落带来温暖与慰藉——也许其中还包括加斯的某些祖先——但后来某个东西肯定发生了什么，才会导致那种变化。” 她又翻了几页，仔细阅读页边的文字。“我不……我不明白。她提到在霜木林发现了什么，某种让她着迷的温暖力量，大概就是这个意思吧。……似乎把她体内的温暖都吸走了，让她的心变得冰冷如冰。看看这些法术，它们彼此纠缠在一起，就像它们本该呈现的样子的苍白镜像。” 这只被染成粉色的小猫，有时看起来可能会像个活泼可爱的傻姑娘，但当她想要运用自己的智慧时，她其实拥有非常敏锐的头脑。尤其是在涉及到魔法的时候。“你觉得那些魔法现在还能施展吗？” 凯特的耳朵立刻竖了起来。“真的可以吗……嗯，也许吧！这些书的核心中确实仍蕴含着马拉克信徒的魔法。说这本书有点“被诅咒了”，我可不是在开玩笑。艾妮莎身上发生的一切，甚至影响到了她的作品。我需要一些时间来研究这个问题，试着找到一些解决办法。也许我能……我不知道，能不能想办法让她的作品重新焕发生机？我可不想因为她身上发生的事情，而让我们俩都陷入麻烦。

I'd say its enchanted, but this feels more like a curse sitting heavy on it to me." "A curse? But it's got Mallach's holy symbol on it." "Yeah," Cait admits, covering her hand with her cloak before she cracks the book open. "But it just feels off. There's not much holy left to speak of here, no matter what it might have started out as." She taps her thumb on a radiant red heart that adorns the first page for emphasis. The book's so cold that it's formed a thin veneer of frost over even that most holy of the Prince of Song's symbols. She flips a few more pages, humming under her breath. "This is a spellbook. It's like mine, too, all personal notes instead of old rote formulas." She pats the pink-colored tome slung on her hip. "It looks like an old church cipher, like a shorthand for traveling monks. I've seen some of this in the library back home, but it's centuries out of date. Must have come here during, or maybe right after, the Godswar." Her trepidation seemingly forgotten, Cait begins leafing through the book more intently now. There's a faint crunch of ice every time she turns the page, but Cait ignores it completely after a few moments, blue eyes scanning pages quickly. "I don't know if I can translate everything here, but it's not too complex. The first pages seem orderly, but here, look at this chicken scratch..." She points at a page halfway through. It's a chaos of diagrams, margin-writing, and coded notes that don't even attempt to keep to straight lines. Half of them go in circles, surrounding magical runes that make your eyes swim when you behold them. [var0 |She's not kidding about this looking cursed. These runes, the wild and sprawling patterns... this is the work of a mad priest, not a priest. |The more you look at these spells, half white magic and half madness, you can see more and more why Cait said it felt cursed. There's nothing holy here. Barely anything sane. | ] "What can you make out?" Cait flashes you a thin-lipped smile. "A name, for starters. Aenisa Meriel. I've heard of her, too. A mothfolk priest that went missing on a mission to Belhar after the Godswar. She's the lady that invented the White Fire spell, you know — a staple of white magic, practically fundamental. But this is... it's like the fire went out of her halfway through her journey. There's notes about her bringing warmth and comfort to ailing beastfolk tribes up here — maybe some of Garth's ancestors — but then something must have happened to change that." She flips a few more pages, scanning the writing in the margins. "I don't... I don't understand. She talks about finding something out in the Frostwood. A warmth that hypnotized her, I guess... and seems to have sucked the warmth out of her. Left her heart cold as ice. Look at these spells, they're twisted up on themselves, like pale mirrors of what they should be." The pink-dyed kitten may come across as a bubbly bimbo at times, but she's got a sharp mind when she wants to use it. Especially when it comes to magic. "Do you think they could still be cast?" Cait's ears perk up. "Can they... huh. I, well, maybe! These are still Mallachite spells at their core. I'm not kidding when I talk about this book being a little cursed, though. Whatever happened to Aenisa spilled over even to her books. I'd like some time to research this, and try to find some work arounds. Maybe I can... I don't know, find a way to breathe some warmth back into her work? I don't want to risk cursing either of us with whatever happened to her." "

rows.original: "Oh, hey, [pc.name]!" Cait says, waving energetically as you come over. "I think I cracked Aenisa's cipher!" "That fast?" you ask, drawing close. Cait's got the rimebound book in her lap, seemingly unaffected by its chill after spending the night deep in its pages. She shoots you a grin. "I told you it'd only take me a night. I've got a talent for magic, you know! And this is.. well, it's not all holy anymore, but I'm sure it's not unholy! I think Aenisa might have gone crazy here in the dark north, but her mind was still razor sharp at least. Even what she didn't write down in full, I think I can use as a stepping stone to work on my own spells. My Sun on Jassira for example — she was on the edge of discovering something like it, even all those years ago, but it's cold and dark as the winter solstice. With a little finesse, I think I've got something that bridges the gap! C'mon, I can show you!" You follow Cait [atFH |outside, to Garth's training grounds |to a patch of clear ground ], and watch the kitty-cleric raise her hand skyward. Rather than a ball of glorious, blinding sunfire, she chants a spell that produces an arc of hard ice across her fingers, and then with a flick of her wrist is hurled into the ground like a stone. Frost erupts all around it, leeching the very ground, spreading like roots all around her. She pirouettes, and produces a ball of searing light that's pale as moonlight, and shatters against the ground in an eruption of ghostflame. "Pretty neat, huh?" "I'll say." You glance between her and the book. "So what about the curse?" Cait winces. "Oh, I don't think... well, it's cursed, but not the spreading kind. More like it soaked a curse up, maybe for Aenisa. There's a darkness on this book for sure, but it's also potently magic, and it seems pretty harmless. I think that, if I use it like a catalyst for holy spells, I can keep whatever shadow's hanging over this thing in check. I'm sure of it!" If she's sure she can keep it under control, then you suppose you're happy to have a new source of power on hand. New Set Unlocked: Frostheart
rows.translation: 哦，嘿，[pc.name]看吧！”凯特一边说，一边热情地向你招手。“我想我破解了艾尼萨的密码！” “这么快就搞定了？”你走近问道。凯特把那本布满韵文的书放在腿上，尽管整夜都在研读，但它似乎并没有因此而变冷。 她冲你灿烂地一笑：“我就说只需要一个晚上吧。你知道的，我在魔法方面确实有天赋！而且这个……嗯，虽然现在已经不再那么神圣了，但我敢肯定它还是很有价值的。不天啊！我觉得艾妮莎在这个暗影的北方地区可能已经有点疯掉了，但她的思维依然异常敏锐。即使有些内容她没有完整记录下来，我想这些也能成为我研究自己法术的起点。真是太有帮助了…… 贾西拉岛上的阳光比如说——即使在那些年之前，她也几乎就要发现类似的东西了，但现在的环境却冷冰冰的，一片暗影，就像冬至时节一样。只要再稍微动点脑筋，我想我就能找到一种方法来填补这个空白！来吧，我可以让你们看看！” 你跟着凯特走了过去。 [atFH |在户外，也就是加斯的训练场那里。 |来到一片开阔的地带 ]然后，你看到那位穿着教士服装的少女将手高高举向天空。她并没有释放出一团耀眼夺目的太阳之火，而是念出一道咒语，让自己的手指上凝聚出一道坚硬的冰弧，随后手腕一抖，那道冰弧就像一块石头一样被抛向地面。周围的冰雪开始剧烈蠕动，仿佛从地面中汲取养分，像根须一样向她四周蔓延。她旋转身体，手中凝聚出一团淡如月光的灼热光球，随后将其投向地面，光球瞬间爆裂，化作一片幽幽的火焰。 还挺不错的，嗯？” “确实吧。”你将目光在她和那本书之间来回移动，问道：“那么那个诅咒是怎么回事呢？” 凯特皱了皱眉头：“哦，我觉得……嗯，它确实是个诅咒，但不是那种会扩散的诅咒。更像是某种被吸收了的诅咒，也许是为了保护艾妮莎吧。这本书确实蕴含着某种暗影力量，但同时也拥有强大的魔力，看起来并不会造成什么危害。我认为，如果我把它当作施展神圣法术的催化剂来使用，就能控制住笼罩在这本书上的那股阴影。我敢肯定！” 如果她确信自己能够控制好它，那么你应该也会很高兴能拥有这样一个新的能量来源吧。 新内容已解锁：冰心

rows.original: "I still can't believe this stuff just grows here like a weed," Cait murmurs, bouncing a clump of manticore nip in her hand. "This stuff is so precious back home, so expensive... and here, those vulperines? They're ripping it out of their scrappy little gardens like it's trash. I just wish I'd brought Sally's hookah with me." She lets out a wry laugh, and folds the herb into a bit of scrap paper. She ignites the tip with a spark of magical flame, and takes a deep inhalation of the smoke. "Gods, I need the warmth. [cait.isLeothran |Even with my leo-bits and magic I'm still freezing up here! |I've never been more jealous of those leothrans than I am up here! ]" "You Jassirans really love that stuff, huh?" "Love might be an understatement. The Great Temple always had a faint odor of this stuff, in the back rooms where the wealthy clients met the courtesans, and more than once I even caught a whiff in the matron's offices. Dad says even the Sultana indulges, though you didn't hear it from me. Back home it's just... nice. A comfort, a social lubricant. Or an anxiety mellower, according to my sister. Here, though, the warmth spreading through my bits is a lifesaver!" Cait takes a deep puff. "I'd rather it be through a hookah, but beggars can't be choosers." She offers the roll to you[pc.isPregnant |, then glances at your tummy and thinks better of it ]. "Let's just get off this mountain before we all freeze to death! Or fall off! Or... I don't know, get added to a manticore's harem." You grin at her. "You'd like that last one." "Well, yeah," Cait says, giving you a wink. "But I've got unfinished business, and so do you! So let's cut this side excursion short as we can, 'kay?"
rows.translation: “我还是不敢相信这种植物在这里竟然能像野草一样随意生长，”凯特喃喃道，手里摆弄着一把蝎狮乳头。“在老家，这东西可是非常珍贵的，贵得吓人……可在这里，那些狐人族？他们把它从自家那些破败的小园子里连根拔掉，就像扔垃圾一样。真希望我当时把莎莉的水烟带来了。” 她苦笑一声，把这些草药折进一张废纸里，用一丝魔法火焰点燃纸的一端，深深吸了一口烟。“天啊，我真需要这点温暖。[cait.isLeothran |就算有这副利奥血统和魔法，我在这上面还是冻得发抖！ |我在这上面，从没像现在这样嫉妒那些莱奥特兰族！ ]” “你们贾西拉人真的很喜欢这东西，对吧？” “说‘喜欢’可能都算是轻描淡写了。大神殿里，那些富有的顾客与交际花见面的密室里，总是弥漫着这种气味；我不止一次在女管事的办公室里也闻到过。爸爸说，就连苏丹娜也会偶尔放纵一下，不过这话可不是从我这儿听来的。在老家，这东西就是……很不错。算是一种慰藉，一种社交润滑剂。用我姐姐的话说，也是一种缓解焦虑的调剂。可在这里，这种暖意在我全身散开，简直就是救命稻草！” 凯特深深吸了一口。“我倒是更想用水烟来抽，但穷人有得抽就不错了。”她把烟卷递给你[pc.isPregnant |，然后瞥了一眼你的肚子，又改了主意 ]。“咱们赶紧下山吧，免得全都冻死！或者摔下去！要不然……天知道，被蝎狮抓去当后宫成员。” 你冲她笑了笑。“最后那种，你倒是会喜欢。” “嗯，没错，”凯特说着，朝你眨了眨眼。“可我还有没做完的事，你也是！所以咱们尽量快点了结这趟绕路，好吗？”

rows.translation: 你穿行于这座摇摇欲坠的古老堡垒时，开始听见某种声音……一阵微弱的啜泣，打破了始终笼罩废墟的寂静。你竖起[pc.ear]，循声向西穿过一扇小门，重新来到铺有石板的庭院。 随后，啜泣变成尖叫。 你循声向前冲去，来到院子中央一座雕像破碎的残骸前；它也许曾是一位骄傲举斧的狼族战士。而那把斧头上竟然挂着……一个人！ 一个蓝色皮肤、金黄色头发的女孩被倒吊在[silly |自己的内裤上，内裤被拉起来挂在斧头上！这可真是核弹级卡裆！ |由细绳组成的复杂绳网里。 ]她的亚麻色鬃发在风中狂舞，霜蓝色斗篷则全部垂落脸前，彻底蒙住双眼。尽管戴着这顶临时兜帽，你仍能从凌乱发丝中看见一对刀锋般尖锐的长耳朵。她无疑是个精灵。[pc.bg scholar |而且还是北境精灵！对南方人而言，遇见他们中的一员是件意义非凡的大事；见鬼，你的大部分同僚都认为他们早已灭绝。[silly |可这下事情失控了——现 |现 ]在居然有两个！ ] “救——命！”她在绳索里扭动着喊道，却只让身体像钟摆一样左右摇晃。“有人吗？谁都行！？救救我！” [party.has cait |“别担心，小可爱！”凯特举起法杖旋转着，朝上面喊道。“我们来帮你！” |你环顾四周，没有发现任何埋伏的迹象。那么她到底在上面做什么？这不像阿尔劳妮的手笔。无论如何，她不可能隔着这么多石造结构伸手过来。好吧，问问也没坏处：“你怎么了？”你拉近距离，朝上方喊道。 ] 女孩倒吸一口气，更加剧烈地扭动。“噢，感谢卢米娅！求你们了，快把我弄下来；她马上就会回来！” “谁会回来？” “那个红色恶魔！”女孩尖叫道。 你无需猜测她指的是谁。既然她见过卡希拉，也许她知道那位[kas.fucked |你最喜欢的 |来自地狱的 ]灵魂收割者去了哪里？只有一种办法能够查明。
rows.raw: ' As you're making your way through the crumbling old fort, you start to hear something... a faint, sobbing sound breaking the ever-present silence hanging over the ruins. You perk your [pc.ear] and follow the sound westward, out a small door and back onto the paved courtyard. Then the sobs become a scream. You dash forward, following the sound to the shattered remains of a statue in the center of the yard; what might have once been a proud lupine warrior holding his axe aloft. And from that axe is hung... a person! A girl with blue-hued skin and golden-blonde hair dangles upside-down from a [silly |her own panties, hiked up onto the axe! Talk about a nuclear wedgie! |complex network of thin ropes. ] Her flaxen mane blows wildly in the wind, and her frosted blue cape has pooled around her face to completely blind her. Despite the impromptu hood, you can make out the distinctive knife-shaped points of long ears protruding from her messy hair. She's an elf, no doubt about it. [pc.bg scholar |And a boreal elf at that! Meeting one of them is a momentous event for a southerner; hell, most of your colleagues think they've gone extinct. [silly |But this is getting out of hand — n |N ]ow there are two of them! ] "Heeeeelp!" she cries, squirming in her bonds. All it accomplishes is making her sway from side to side like a pendulum. "Somebody? Anybody!? Help me!" [party.has cait |"Don't worry, cutie!" Cait calls up, whirling her staff to bear. "We're here to help!" |You glance around, looking for signs of ambush and finding none. What in the world is she doing up there, then? This doesn't seem like the Alraune's doing. There's no way she could reach through all this stonework anyway. Well, doesn't hurt to ask: "What happened to you?" you shout up, closing the distance. ] The girl gasps, redoubling her wiggling. "Oh, thank Lumia! Please, you gotta get me down; she's going to come back soon!" "Who's coming?" "The red demon!" the girl shrieks. You don't have to guess who she means. And if she's seen Kasyrra, maybe she knows where [kas.fucked |your favorite |the infernal ] soul-reaper's got to? Only one way to find out.'

rows.original: [var0 |You take careful aim and loose a missile at [silly|her undergarment|the rope], severing it with one solid hit. The girl screams and tumbles into your arms, hitting with enough force to knock the wind out of her. |[party.has cait |Cait conjures up a ball of whitefire and lets loose, searing the [silly|panties|rope] holding her to the axe. The elf girl screams and falls right into your waiting arms. |You take a deep breath and start climbing, scrambling up the side of the statue and [silly|Unhooking her panties from the axe.|finding a weak point in the rope. "Brace yourself," you tell her before untying it.] Sure enough, she plummets with a scream, [party.hasCompanions|right into [companion1.name]'s waiting arms|landing hard on a shoulder. She groans and rolls onto her back, moaning from the impact.] ] ] [silly |The elf groans, rubbing her grievously-chafed butt with both hands before she's |What's left of the ropes fall away, and the elf is ] able to slowly stagger to her feet. She yanks her azure cloak back down into place, revealing a soft-featured, feminine face with large blue eyes and cute pink lips. She lets out a weary sigh, moves to shake your hand, and then stumbles down onto a knee. "Oof! O-oh wow I'm dizzy... b-but thank you! A th-thousand times thank you! I was sure I was going t-to hang there until my head burst. Or worse — that I'd be there 'til that red demon came flying back." She runs the back of a leather-braced hand over her brow and locks eyes with you, staring like she's only just now really seen you. Suddenly, her cheeks flush. "S-sorry. I ought to ask what you're doing out here... nobody's used this fort in decades... but I know better than t-to look a gift horse in the mouth.[var1| Um, no offense.] I'm Etheryn, by the way. Of Njorhaalt — th-that is, um, Belharans knew it as the Winter City... formerly of, I suppose." "[pc.name]," you say in answer. "Now what's this about a demon?" Etheryn gasps. "Right! She said she's... she's coming back for me. Th-that I'm a special snack for l-later. We gotta get out of here! That woman came winging out of the sky and plucked me right off my horse. Said she was gonna do all sorts of horrible things to me before she left me tied up here. I thought things were bad in the city, but now I've seen everything!" She forces a nervous giggle, but you notice her elven ears drooping precipitously and her eyes start darting around the battlements. "I promise I'll tell you whatever you need to know when we get out of here. I can follow you out, right? I don't wanna have to sneak all the way to Castle Hawkstone by myself." "To the castle?" you ask. She nods, turning her attention from you to a beautiful whitewood bow and a quiver of arrows that had been lying in the statue's shadow. Hers, you imagine, by how deftly she flips it under an arm and belts on the quiver. "Y-yes! Do you... do you know if it's still standing? My people, we've lost contact with the south for a generation. Too few of us left, a-and the bridges and roads are all ruins beyond here!" [party.has atugia |"The castle's fine," Atugia confirms for her. "Carmen's kinda lost contact with everyone outside, too, though. Maybe you'll get along." ] You nod[party.has cait |, glancing at Cait ]. That's where you first met the demoness, after all: the temple just outside the castle walls. You'll hardly ever forget it. "Good," Etheryn says. "Th-then I must speak to th-the lady of the castle! P-please, if it's not too much trouble... could you g-guide me? I've never been south of the River Ridell. I'm sure I c-could make it on my own, if I have to, but... but it would be a lot easier with help. And I can be useful, if you need. [silly |Elves can fulfill a variety of roles in a party! ]It might not seem like it given my circumstances, but I'm pretty good with a bow, and I know some magic. I'm a falconer, too! My war-bird got chased off by the demon with a hurt beak when he went for her eyes, but I'm sure he'll turn up if I call!"
rows.translation: [var0 |你仔细瞄准，然后发射了一枚导弹。 [silly|她的内衣|绳子]一记有力的击打，将它彻底切断。女孩发出尖叫，重重摔进你的怀里，那冲击力之大，简直让她喘不过气来。 |[party.has cait |凯特凝聚出一团白火，然后将其释放出来，那火焰灼烧着一切[silly|内裤|绳子]你一把将她抱在怀里。那个精灵女孩尖叫着，就这样落入了你张开的双臂之中。 |你深吸一口气，开始攀爬，沿着雕像的侧面艰难地向上爬去。 [silly|将她的内裤从斧头上解下来。|找到绳子上的薄弱环节。“抓紧了，”你在解开绳子之前对她说。]果然，她尖叫着坠了下去。 [party.hasCompanions|直接进入[companion1.name]张开双臂等待|重重地摔在肩膀上，她疼得呻吟着翻到了背上。] ] ] [silly |精灵呻吟着，用双手揉搓着自己那被磨得通红的屁股，然后才…… |剩下的绳子全都掉了下来，那个精灵…… ]她勉强站了起来，脚步有些踉跄。她将那件蔚蓝色的斗篷重新拉回身上，露出一张五官柔和、充满女性魅力的脸庞——那双蓝色的大眼睛，以及那双可爱的粉色嘴唇。她疲惫地叹了口气，走上前想要与你握手，却突然跪了下来。 哎哟！天啊，我头晕得厉害……不过还是谢谢你！真的太感谢你了！我本来以为自己会挂在那里，直到脑袋炸开才掉下来呢。或者更糟的——我会一直挂在那里，直到那个红色恶魔飞回来为止。” 她用一只戴着皮革护手的手轻轻按了按自己的额头，然后直视着你的眼睛，仿佛直到这一刻才真正注意到你的存在。突然，她的脸颊涨红了。“对、对不起。我应该先问问你在这里做什么……几十年来根本没人使用过这个堡垒……但我知道，不能不看好了才接受别人送来的礼物。[var1| 嗯，没有冒犯的意思。]顺便说一下，我叫伊瑟琳。来自恩乔哈尔特——嗯，也就是贝尔哈兰人称之为冬城的地方……我想，我以前就住在那里。[pc.name]，你是这么说的，”你回答道，“那这个关于恶魔的事情到底是怎么回事呢？” 伊瑟琳倒吸了一口凉气：“对！她说她要……她要来了。后退对我来说……我就像是以后用来招待客人的特别点心一样。我们必须离开这里！那个女人从天而降，直接把我从马背上抓了下来。她说在把我绑在这里之前，会对我做出各种可怕的事情。我原本以为城里的状况很糟糕，但现在我亲眼看到了这一切！” 她勉强挤出一丝紧张的笑声，但你可以注意到她的精灵耳朵正急速下垂，目光也在城墙上四处游移。“我保证，等我们离开这里后，会告诉你所有你需要知道的事情。我可以跟你一起出去吧？我可不想独自偷偷摸摸地前往霍克斯通城堡。” “去城堡？”你问道。 她点了点头，然后将注意力从你身上转移到那把放在雕像阴影处的漂亮白木弓和一束箭上。你看，她多熟练地将箭袋挂在手臂上啊。“是、是吗！你知道它还在那里吗？我们族人已经与南方失去了联系，已经有一代人的时间了。剩下的人太少了，而且这里的桥梁和道路都已成废墟！" [party.has atugia |这座城堡很不错，”阿图吉娅向她保证道，“不过卡门似乎已经与外界失去了联系，也许你们会相处得来。 ] 你点了点头。[party.has cait |瞥了凯特一眼 ]毕竟，你就是在那里第一次遇见那位女恶魔的：城堡墙外的那座寺庙。你绝对不会忘记那个地方的。” “好的，”伊瑟琳说道，“那么我必须去见城堡里的那位女士！拜托了，如果不会给您带来太多麻烦的话……能请您指引我一下吗？我从未去过里德尔河以南的地区。如果实在不行，我相信我自己也能找到路，但是……有您的帮助的话肯定会方便很多。而且，如果您需要的话，我也能够帮上一些忙的。 [silly |在团队中，精灵可以承担多种不同的角色！ ]从我的处境来看，可能不会有人这么认为，但实际上我使用弓箭的技术相当不错，也掌握了一些魔法。我还是个驯鹰师呢！我的战鹰在试图攻击那只恶魔的眼睛时，它的喙受了伤，因此被恶魔赶走了。不过我相信，只要我呼唤它，它一定会回来找我的！

rows.original: "Alright," you tell her, waving her forward. "You can come with me."
rows.translation: “好吧，”你对她说，同时示意她向前走，“你可以跟我一起来。”
rows.raw: '\n            "Alright," you tell her, waving her forward. "You can come with me."'

rows.original: She breathes a heavy sigh of relief and scampers into your shadow. "Thank you! I was afraid everyone south of the river had turned into a brute... that's what my sister was always saying. But you're decent! Real decent! I'm with you until we can get down to Hawkstone Castle; I've got to talk to the baroness of the place as soon as I can!" Sounds like Hawkstone's the place to go, then.
rows.translation: 她松了一口气，快步跑进了你的阴影里。“谢谢你！我本来害怕河以南的所有人都已经变成了野蛮人……我姐姐总是这么说。但你真的很好！非常的好！在我们到达鹰棘石堡之前，我会一直跟着你；我必须尽快和那里的女男爵谈谈！” 听起来鹰棘石堡应该是我们应该去的地方。。

rows.translation: 你想让谁离开，以便给伊瑟琳腾出位置呢？
rows.raw:
"
                

Who would you like to remove to make room for Etheryn?"

rows.translation: \n\n你想请谁离开，为伊瑟琳腾出位置？
rows.raw: "\n                \\n\\nWho would you like to remove to make room for Etheryn?"

rows.original: You shake your head, telling the elf that she'll have to make it on her own for right now. She makes a pathetic little whining sound in the back of her throat and takes a few steps back. "O-oh, right. Uh, okay, I'll just... I'll go then. Gotta get to the castle, even if I gotta walk. All by myself." She takes a deep breath to steady herself, turns on a heel, and starts marching back the way you came. She said she'd be at Castle Hawkstone, right?
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头，告诉那位精灵，目前她必须自己想办法了。 她从喉咙深处发出一声可怜的呜咽声，然后后退了几步。“哦，对，好吧，那我……那我走了。不管怎样，我得去城堡，哪怕只能独自步行。” 她深吸一口气，稳住情绪，然后转身开始沿着你来时的方向走去。 她说她会去鹰棘石堡，对吧？

rows.original:
As you approach the gates of Castle Hawkstone, you find them closed, as you might expect. They've rarely been open since first arriving here, after all. What's out of the ordinary though is the skinny blonde elf pacing a trench in the dirt just outside it, arms wrapped around herself.

    "Where are all the guards?" Etheryn asks the moment she sees you. "There should be staff... servants... men at arms. And the village... it was half the size of what I was expecting, and that's being generous. What happened to this place? Does anyone even live here?"
    
    [party.has atugia|"Well, Carmen didn't really need any staff. She kinda just... Magics all the cleaning and stuff. She didn't really need guards either, I was just there to scare kids away," Atugia mumbles, rubbing the back of her neck and giving the stressed pale elf an apologetic grin. "It was really just me, her, and the smith. And whatever people she brought in for 'private parties.' Unfortunately she doesn't really come out much anymore, and the castle is invite only,"]
    
    You take a few steps closer, and ask, [pc.dcb|"What's your problem now?"|"Is there something I can do to help?"|"You okay, cutie?"]

当你接近霍克斯通城堡的大门时，你会发现它们紧闭着，这也在意料之中。毕竟，自从你第一次来到这里之后，这些大门几乎从未被打开过。不过，不寻常的是，在大门外的泥土中，有一个身材瘦削的金发精灵正来回踱步，双臂紧紧地抱在身上。

    所有的守卫都去哪儿了？”伊瑟琳一看到你就问道。“这里应该有工作人员……仆人……武装人员才对。而且这个村庄……它的规模只有我预期的一半，这都已经算是很大的了。这个地方到底发生了什么？真的有人住在这里吗？
    
    [party.has atugia|嗯，卡门其实并不需要什么工作人员。她就是用魔法来处理所有的清洁工作之类的。她也不需要守卫，我在那里只是为了把那些小孩子吓跑而已，”阿图吉娅一边揉着后颈，一边对着那个看起来压力很大的苍白精灵露出歉意的微笑。“其实就只有我、她和那个铁匠，还有那些她邀请来参加‘私人聚会’的人而已。可惜，她现在很少出门了，而且这座城堡也是只有被邀请的人才能进入的。]
    
    你走上几步，问道： [pc.dcb|你现在又怎么了？|有什么我可以帮忙的吗？|你没事吧，小可爱？]
    
    她叹了口气，揉了揉后脑勺。“我、我们之间有条约在先。我应该得到会面的机会。我不可能白白跑这么远的路……我必须见见这里的男男爵、女男爵，或者任何负责此事的人。我的城市正处于极大的危险之中！那你打算怎么做呢？”你问道。现在有一个大恶魔在四处肆虐，怪物们正在侵扰整个王国，腐败也正在蔓延，影响着大自然以及生活在其中的人们……她究竟期望自己和女男爵能够取得什么成果呢？
    
    伊瑟琳停了下来，眨了眨眼。“该死的，我……我不知道该怎么办！我只是……需要帮助！”她悲惨地说道，然后滑坐下来，靠在石墙上。她的眼睛突然充满了泪水，耳朵也耷拉了下来，双手紧紧地抱住自己。我一路走到了这里……每一步都充满了危险……我知道我再也不能回家了。我的姐姐……现在她一定会对我做出一些可怕的事情来。她曾经警告过我，如果我试图逃跑，她一定会对我不客气。我……我真的太害怕了。”

    [party.has brint|该死，她的行为举止就像个小孩子……不过其实她的年龄可能比我们所有人加起来还要大，”布林特喃喃道。]

“现在不行，阿罗娜。]

rows.original: Now that you've got a few calm minutes, you decide it's time to question your newest acquisition. You step over to where Etheryn is sitting and take a seat beside her. ... Yet the mere act of approaching makes her recoil. Like a shy puppy, Etheryn leans away from you and bites her lip, as if she's afraid you're about to come over and hit her. After a moment passes where you decidedly do not come over and beat her, the boreal elf slowly forces herself to relax her tensed-up muscles and turn to you with wide, dark blue eyes. "H-hi," she says sheepishly, cutting her gaze over to the [atFH |hearth |camp ]fire. More silence hangs in the air. "[pc.isDK |Real conversationalist, aren't you? Come on, talk." |Do you... want to talk?" you ask. ] "Talk?" she asks, dropping her eyes to the ground. "Um... o-okay. Uhhh. I'm sorry, do you... am I needed for something?" "No," you tell her. "I just want to talk." She shrugs. "O-okay. Uh, what about?" God damn she's not making this easy. Fine, let's start with something simple. "You said you're from the Winter City? [pc.bg scholar |Is it really still standing after all these years? Tell me about it, please!" |What's that?" [party.has cait |Cait perks up from nearby. "Oh! Oh, I know!" You give her a look and turn back to Etheryn. ] ] The elf-girl shrugs slightly. "It's my home. Where all the boreal elves live. Or pale elves, snow elves, frost elves... whatever you want to call us in your tongue. The boer'alvar. It's been... a long time since anybody from Njorhaalt has come this far south. A hundred years at least. I don't know what southerners know about us now. But it's a big city; bigger than any you've probably ever seen, with our great castle built into the side of a huge glacial cliff. It's beautiful, like a thousand spires of ice rising from the snow-packed ground and surrounded by evergreen trees as far as the eye can see." And just like that, you've gotten more words out of her than every exchange before combined. Let's see if you can keep that up. "Why'd you leave?" Etheryn crosses her arms and sighs. "I had to. S-something's wrong in the city. The queen's locked herself away in her chambers and the guards are... changing. Gone from mean to evil, lashing out at anybody that gets near the palace. Nobody in the city will listen to me, like they're all blind to the change, or just don't care. So I had to leave. I need to find help. That's why I want[var1 |ed ] to go to Castle Hawkstone. It's very, very old, but the Winter City and the Frost Marches have a treaty of alliance, g-guaranteeing mutual aid in times of crisis." "[pc.bg noblescion scholar |And who are you to call upon old treaties? |And you think the baroness will just listen to you? ]" The elf shrugs. "I'm, uh... I mean, I'm a princess. D-Duchess Etheryn var Ridell, Daughter of Queen Alraince. B-but please just call me Ryn. I prefer it, really. I never liked titles or formality like my sister, the queen..." You blink. "Wait, you're a princess?" She blinks back, doing that thing where she stares at you like you're a bear ready to maul her again. "Y-y-yes? That's why I had to leave. I was afraid my sister's guards were going to hurt me. I mean, really hurt me now. [var1 |That's why I was hoping Baroness Carmen would help me. She was the only person for a hundred leagues that could. Now... now I'm on my own." |And whoever's the Lord of Hawkstone now is obligated to protect me... and if I can get in the door, maybe I can make the baroness listen to me." [var0 |"Yeah, I think the baron[flags.TODO_BARON_MARRIED |ess ] will listen to you," you grin. "Let's get you to Hawkstone and sort all this out." |"I'm sure we can get the baroness to listen to you," you tell her. ] ]
rows.translation: 现在你有了一些平静的时间，你决定是时候仔细审视你最近得到的这个“新成员”了。你走到伊瑟琳坐的地方，坐在她旁边。 ……然而，仅仅是靠近她的这个动作，就让她不由得退缩了。就像一只害羞的小狗一样，伊瑟琳躲开了你，还咬住了自己的嘴唇，仿佛害怕你会突然走过来打她。过了一会儿，你确实没有靠近她也没有打她，于是这位极北精灵慢慢放松了自己紧绷的肌肉，用那双深蓝色的眼睛看着你。 嗨，”她羞涩地说道，然后将视线移开了。 [atFH |炉灶 |营地 ]枪声。 空气中再次陷入了沉寂。[pc.isDK |你真是个擅长聊天的人，对吧？来吧，说点什么吧。 |你……想谈谈吗？”你问道。 ] 聊天吗？”她低下头问道，“嗯……好吧。呃，对不起，你需要我帮忙什么吗？” “不需要，”你告诉她，“我只是想聊聊而已。” 她耸了耸肩：“好吧。那……聊些什么呢？” 该死，她真不让人省心。好吧，那就从简单的话题开始吧。“你说你来自冬城，对吧？ [pc.bg scholar |经过这么多年，它真的还完好无损地矗立在那里吗？请告诉我吧！ |那是什么？ [party.has cait |凯特从附近走了过来，兴奋地说道：“哦！哦，我知道了！” 你看了她一眼，然后又转过头去继续和伊瑟琳交谈。 ] ]那位精灵女孩微微耸了耸肩：“这里是我的家园。所有极北精灵都生活在这里——或者说，苍白精灵、雪精灵、霜精灵……无论你们用什么样的词汇来称呼我们。这里被称为‘博尔阿尔瓦’。自从Njorhaalt的人来到这么南边的地方，已经过去很久了。至少有一百年了。我不知道现在的南方人对我们了解多少。但那是一座大城市——比你们见过的任何城市都要庞大，我们的宏伟城堡就建在一片巨大的冰川悬崖之上。那里美得令人窒息，仿佛有成千上万的冰柱从积雪覆盖的地面上耸立而起，而周围则是连绵不绝的常绿树木，目光所及之处都是这样的景象。就这样，你从她口中得到的信息，比之前所有对话加起来还要多。看看你能否继续保持这个状态吧。“你为什么要离开？” 伊瑟琳双臂交叉，叹了口气：“我不得不离开。这座城市里出事了。女王把自己关在房间里，而守卫们也……变了。他们从原本的凶狠变得更加邪恶，只要有人靠近宫殿，就会遭到他们的攻击。城里没有人愿意听我的话，仿佛他们都对这种变化视而不见，或者根本就不在乎。所以我不得不离开。我需要寻求帮助，这就是我想要这么做的原因。[var1 |ed ]要去霍克斯通城堡。那座城堡非常非常古老，但是冬城与霜冻边境地区缔结了同盟条约，保证在危机时刻能够互相提供援助。[pc.bg noblescion scholar |你又有什么资格去援引那些古老的条约呢？ |你真以为那位女男爵会听你的吗？ ]精灵耸了耸肩。“我，呃……我是说，我是一位公主。伊瑟琳·瓦·里德尔公爵夫人，阿尔兰斯女王的女儿。不过，请你们叫我小琳吧。我更喜欢这个称呼。我和我姐姐那位女王不同，我从不喜欢那些头衔和正式场合……” 你眨了眨眼：“等等，你真的是一位公主？” 她也眨了眨眼，然后用那种仿佛你在准备攻击她的目光盯着你：“是啊。正因为如此，我才不得不离开。我害怕我姐姐的卫兵会伤害我真的现在真让我难受。 [var1 |这就是为什么我希望卡门女男爵能帮助我。在方圆一百里范围内，她才是唯一有能力帮助我的人。现在……现在我只能独自面对这一切了。 |现在，无论谁成为了霍克斯通的领主，都有义务保护我……如果我能进入那里，或许就能让女男爵听我的话。 [var0 |是啊，我觉得那个男爵[flags.TODO_BARON_MARRIED |ess ]我会听你的，”你笑着说，“我们带你去霍克斯通，把这一切都解决掉吧。 |我相信我们一定能让女男爵听你的意见，”你对她说。 ] ]

As she's about to say something, a raptor with bloody-red feathers and hateful gold eyes bursts in[atFH
                | through a window
                |to your camp
            ] with a banshee-like screech.
            
            Before you can blink, Etheryn is on her feet and running... right at the beast.
            
            "Harrick!" she exclaims, throwing her arms open. The bird screeches again, flapping violently before landing on one of her leather bracers. "You came! Oh, good boy! Such a smart bird!"

rows.original: Etheryn has changed out of her more comfortable ranger's garb and into an extremely beautiful white gown, somewhere between royal attire and a wedding dress; it's richly adorned with silk capes and veils around the arms, belted around the waist with cloth-of-gold, and trimmed with embroidered sunbursts — the symbol of the city's goddess. The dress leaves the shoulders bare, supported in place by a firm leather corset around the midriff, as expensive as any other part of the garment but, like the heeled leather boots and long bleached gloves resting beneath, it looks hardened enough to deflect sword thrusts.
rows.translation: 伊瑟琳换下了那套舒适的运动装，换上了一件极其华丽的白色礼服，这件礼服介于皇家服饰与婚纱之间；礼服上装饰着精美的丝绸披肩和袖子上的面纱，腰部用金色布料束紧，边缘还绣着象征这座城市女神的太阳花图案。这条裙子将肩膀裸露在外，腰部则用一条结实的皮革束腰带固定住。这条束腰带的价格与裙子其他部分一样昂贵，但就像下面那双高跟皮革靴子和那双长长的漂白手套一样，它看起来也足够结实，足以抵挡剑锋的攻击。

rows.original: The rest of her outfit is the sort of bronze protection a true warrior queen deserves. At first glance, it looks more ceremonial than protective, festooned with silks and flowing Lumian designs while leaving her belly and upper chest bare — the sort of outfit one adopts to show off one's body, not protect it. But the winged top that cups Ryn's chest is true bronze, and the winged-sun icon that hangs beneath it glows with the sort of enchantment that bespeaks more than mere metal protection. Her neck and greaves are properly armored, and the wide aspis shield that rests behind her is more than enough to cover the rest of her body in combat. Her forearms are clad in simple white-and-gold, but her upper arms are bare, and show a hint of the muscle definition she's developed over years of practice with first a bow and now a spear. With her crown completing the ensemble, she is clad as the sort of monarch that could dominate a battlefield or outshine all the nobles in a palace, and [etheryn.lnhConfidence |despite her obvious nervousness, you can tell that she's doing her best to live up to the promise of her outfit. |she's calm and at-ease enough in the outfit to make it seem like it could genuinely belong. |her manner has the sort of natural queenly grace that makes her perfect for both roles. ]

My sister... protected me from the harshness of the northlands. She led our armies against the foul beastmen of the ice plains and saved us time and again from the depredations of the frost giants. She blinks, taken off-guard. "O-oh. Yes, of course. I'm sorry, there's just... not much to tell. Every time somebody asks, they really want to know about Alissa." "Well I don't." [etheryn.lowConfidence |it's not like my opinion matters. |I don't think it's what you meant, but there's nothing wrong with being halfsex. I'm fine being what I am. ] Though, maybe if I'd been a man, my sister wouldn't have tortured me like she did. [flags.RQ2_ALISSA |Then again, now that we know what she'd been planning, perhaps it would have been worse for me. |I'm sure she wouldn't have locked me in this cage, at least! ] If I absolutely had to choose to be something else, I'd rather be a woman than a man. I've always been a girl, so that's what I'd rather stay as.[etheryn.libidoRange 50 | Besides. It's a lot easier to get fucked when you have a pussy to take the load, Cait tells me. rows.translation: 去问问伊瑟琳关于她的族人的事情吧。

rows.original: "So, what can you tell me about the Winter City?" "Less than I'd like," Ryn answers. "I was never allowed to go into the city unescorted, and I lived far above it. Most days, all I saw of the city were its snow-covered rooftops and the spires of the Lumian church reaching up halfway to the palace." Alright, well, can she describe the city? What does it look like? "It's... I guess it used to be a motte and bailey, but backed up against an icy cliff; the edge of the Frosthewn Plateau that goes further north than anyone's ever been. The city is encircled by tall stone walls that replaced the old wooden ones, and at the far end huge walled stairs leading up the cliffside to the palace. In the middle of the city is the Cathedral of the Dawn, the Lumian church, which towers way high above all the houses and shops surrounding it. Most of the houses are relatively small, I guess, for how old they are — not much bigger than the wood ones in Hawkethorne, though most are hundreds of years old and a mix of stone and wood, they've been repaired so many times. And the roofs... always covered in snow, with thick clouds of black woodsmoke pouring out of the chimneys. The city always smells like a hearth, or a cookfire. I'll never forget that much." "Does it snow all the time that far north?" Ryn giggles. "ALL the time. I mean it... it never stops. Most days it's a gentle dusting, but in winter or when a storm blows through, the snow's enough to blind you. The whole city disappears under the flurries, and all I can see from my window is whiteness as far as the eye can see. When the storms end, everyone goes out and has to shovel the snow off their roofs before it melts. Sometimes the cathedral will send out its sun priestesses to melt the snow with their holy magic. You can always tell when they're out by the cheering, so loud that I could hear it from the palace as clear as day." The elf smiles to herself and starts to play with one of her golden braids, twisting it between two fingers. "Even from where I was, I could tell the city was full of life and happiness. Most boreal elves come across as big boisterous warriors, but most... most of them are so full of love and fire, too. Not like Queen Alissa." [etheryn.confidenceRange 50|Ryn sighs and flicks the tip of her braid away. "She and her guards and courtiers are the exception. Hearts like ice, all of them."|"A-at least, I hope that's the case..."]
rows.translation: “那么，关于冬城，你能告诉我些什么？” “比我想说的少，”小琳回答道。“我从来不被允许独自进城，而且我住在城市上方很高的地方。大多数时候，我能看到的只有白雪覆盖的屋顶，以及卢米娅教会高耸的尖塔；它们从城里向上延伸，几乎抵达宫殿的一半高度。” 好吧，那么她能不能描述一下那座城市？它是什么样的？ “那里……我想它以前应该是一座土丘城堡，只不过背靠着一道冰封的悬崖；那是霜削高原的边缘，再往北延伸的地方，从未有人抵达过。城市四周环绕着高大的石墙，取代了原先的木墙；而在城市尽头，则有一道筑有围墙的巨大阶梯，沿悬崖向上通往宫殿。城中央是黎明大教堂，也就是卢米娅教会；它高高耸立在周围所有房屋和商铺之上。我想，那些房屋大多都比较小，毕竟它们年代久远——比鹰棘镇的木屋大不了多少，尽管大多已有数百年历史，由石木混合建成，而且修缮过无数次。还有那些屋顶……总是覆盖着积雪，烟囱里不断涌出浓浓的黑色木烟。城里总有一股壁炉或炊火的气味。这一点，我永远也忘不了。” “那么靠北的地方，雪会一直下吗？” 小琳咯咯笑了。“一直都在下。我是说真的……从来没有停过。大多数日子只是轻轻飘落一层薄雪，但到了冬天，或者暴风雪袭来时，雪大得足以让人什么都看不见。整座城市都会消失在漫天飞雪之下，从我的窗户望出去，视野所及只有一片白茫茫。风暴结束后，每个人都得出门，在屋顶积雪融化前把它们铲掉。有时，大教堂会派出太阳女祭司，用神圣魔法融化积雪。只要听见欢呼声，你就知道她们出动了；那声音响亮得连我待在宫殿里都能听得一清二楚。” 精灵微微一笑，开始用两根手指把玩自己的一条金色辫子。“即使身处我那样的地方，我也能看出城里充满了生机与快乐。大多数极北精灵给人的印象都是喧闹豪爽的高大战士，但他们中的大多数……也都满怀爱与热情。和艾莉莎女王不一样。” [etheryn.confidenceRange 50|小琳叹了口气，将辫梢拨到一旁。“她、她的卫兵，还有她的廷臣，都是例外。他们一个个都心如寒冰。”|“至、至少，我希望事实确实如此……”]

rows.original:
"So, who's your friend?" you ask, glancing at the large hawk perched behind the elf.

            The beast itself answers your question first, screeching at you and opening up its wings in challenge. [pc.dcb|You snarl right back at it, cowing the bird into its place.|"Easy there, bird."|You coo at the bird and crane your head to the side. It blinks and slowly lowers its wings, unsure what to do with that information.]
            
            Etheryn giggles, reaching up the stroke the feathers atop the hawk's head. "This is Harrick! He's my best friend and loyal companion. His grandfather was given to me in my father's will, and I've been raising Harrick's bloodline ever since I was old enough. He's the best little murder-bird a girl could ask for."
            
            Harrick squawks his agreement.
            
            "W-would you like to, um, pick him up?"
            
            Harrick fixes you with his bold, golden eyes as if to say, "Don't you fucking dare."
rows.translation:
那么，你的朋友是谁呢？”你问道，同时瞥了一眼站在精灵身后的那只巨大的鹰。

            那只野兽率先回答了你的问题，它对着你发出尖锐的叫声，同时展开翅膀，似乎在向你发起挑战。 [pc.dcb|你立刻厉声回应，把那只鸟吓得乖乖待在原地。|小心点，小鸟。|你轻声对那只鸟说话，同时把头偏向一边。那只鸟眨了眨眼，然后缓缓地放下了翅膀，似乎不知道该如何回应这个举动。]
            
            伊瑟琳轻声笑了起来，伸手抚摸着鹰头上的羽毛。“这是哈里克！他是我最好的朋友，也是我最忠实的伙伴。他的祖父在我父亲的遗嘱中被留给了我，从那时起，我就开始抚养哈里克这一支血脉。他绝对是任何女孩都会梦寐以求的最佳同伴。”
            
            哈里克发出一声赞同的叫声。
            
            “嗯，你愿意……把他带回去吗？”
            
            哈里克用他那双大胆的金色眼睛盯着你，仿佛在说：“你他妈的敢吗？"

rows.original:
"Sure," you say, grinning down at the war-hawk. He ruffles his feathers and makes a huffing sound as Etheryn takes the falconry glove from her belt and hands it up to you. As soon as you slip the gauntlet on and hold it out, Harrick flaps up and perches on it — seemingly despite himself, if the bewildered look on the hawk's face is any indication.

                Then again, he seems to always look either shocked or hateful. Not much middle ground with a war-bird you guess.
                
                Harrick flaps his wings and looks around, largely ignoring you in favor of fussing at Etheryn herself. Ryn pets the bird's head, trying and failing to direct his attention back to you. "Well, I guess he's still getting used to you. Harrick's the least personable of all the war-hawks I've ever raised, I swear."
                
                Harrick squawks in agreement and pecks at your thumb through the gauntlet. Guess that's... how he gets to know people?
                
                Before he has the chance to worry his way through the leather, you hand Harrick back to Ryn.
rows.translation:
当然可以，”你笑着说，同时低头看着那只好战的猎鹰。猎鹰扑动着翅膀，发出愤怒的叫声。这时，伊瑟琳从腰带上取下猎鹰手套，递给了你。你刚戴上手套并伸出手，哈里克就立刻振翅飞了上去，落在了你的手上——从猎鹰那困惑的表情来看，它似乎也是迫不得已才这么做的。

                不过，他看起来总是要么表现出震惊，要么流露出憎恨之情。对于这样一个人来说，似乎根本不存在中立的态度吧。
                
                哈里克拍打着翅膀，环顾四周，却基本上无视了你，而是开始对伊瑟琳本人发号施令。小琳轻抚着那只鸟的头部，试图让它把注意力重新转回到你身上，但几次尝试都失败了。“嗯，我想它还在适应你吧。我发誓，哈里克是我养过的所有好战分子中最不善于与人打交道的一个。
                
                哈里克发出同意的叫声，然后透过那只护手啄你的拇指。看来……这就是他认识新朋友的方式吧？
                
                在他还有机会为这些皮革制品烦恼之前，你赶紧把哈里克交还给了小琳。

rows.original: "Hello, Harrick," you say, glancing past Ryn to her falcon friend. Harrick perks up, glancing around before settling his cold, hateful gaze on you. "Who's a good bird?" "SCREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!" [atCamp|A number of birds and beasts take flight in response to the thunderous shriek.|Everyone in the bar cranes their head around to stare at Harrick.] Ryn giggles and digs a piece of jerky out of her pack, flicking it straight into Harrick's waiting maw. He snatches it out of the air and swallows, tottering side to side with giddiness. It appears that he is, in fact, the good bird. With his immediate demand for attention satisfied, [ etheryn.confidenceRange -100 10 50 80 |Harrick just resumes glowering at you. It doesn't look like he's a big fan... |Harrick ruffles his feathers and folds in on himself, content to nap. Doesn't seem like he's terribly interested in you right now. |the bird hops towards you and begins bobbing his head up and down at you, like he's dancing to a beat only he can hear. Ryn grins up at you and takes your hand in hers, guiding it down to rest on top of the bird's head. Harrick makes a low sound in his throat and nuzzles against your hand. "I think he likes you," Ryn giggles. |Harrick hops along the table to you and head-butts you in the stomach, which eventually turns into a nuzzle and a trilling sound in his throat. "Wow!" Ryn says, smiling ear to ear. "I've never seen him do that with anybody before. He really is warming up to you, [pc.name]." "Only him, hmm?" She giggles and leans in to plant a kiss on your cheek. "Not by a long shot." ]

rows.original: "So... would you mind telling me about your sister? The queen?" [etheryn.confidenceRange 75|"If you like," she answers. You watch her jawline tighten, though, and her voice comes out slow and measured — even for Etheryn. It's clear this isn't her favorite line of discourse.|Etheryn just squirms, clearly uncomfortable with the topic even with her sister nowhere nearby. It takes several minutes of cajoling before the introverted elf finally breaks down and agrees to tell you anything at all.] "Okay. Alissa is my older sister. Older by, well, a lot even by elven standards. She was a well-known and respected huntress decades before I was born, beloved by all. From what I gather, she was free-spirited and prideful, a bit of a wild child. Women, men, wine, fighting... she reveled in all the joys in life." "But my mother did not long survive my birth, and my father... did not long survive his beloved wife, either. So my sister became queen amidst a year of tragedy, and I became her ward. She resented me terribly, and made sure I knew it. [etheryn.confidenceRange 50|According to her, ]I'm the cause of everything bad to ever happen to her. At least I'm the only one she seemed to take her frustrations out on... the people still love her, especially the warriors. The way they fawn over her when she walks among them, throwing flowers at her feet and praising her name like a goddess's... [etheryn.confidenceRange 50|Even if I'd spoken up, I doubt anyone would have believed that their beloved queen was capable of being such a monster.]" Alright. What about her fighting style? If you have to confront the queen someday... Etheryn shudders at the thought. "Then I hope you come prepared! She's the finest warrior in the Winter City. Alissa is everything an elven huntress could hope to be: she's a master of the bow and the curved sword, and though she's no archmage, Alissa certainly knows some dark magic. She made my enchanted cage, and... and I've seen her cast combat spells when she trains, freezing her partner to the ground or coating her weapons with ice." You ask, "Does she have any weaknesses?" A moment passes as Ryn thinks. [ etheryn.confidenceRange -100 25 50 90 |Finally, she shakes her head. "I-I don't know. I'm sorry, I was always so in awe, watching her... I knew I'd never compare. I don't think you can beat her." |"I don't know," she finally sighs, shrugging helplessly. "She's a deadly marksman, a swordsmaster, a sorceress... she's learned a little of everything, and how to defeat everything. I don't think fighting her head to head would be very smart..." |"Maybe... maybe. Alissa's a braggart and a bully, and she just throws herself at her enemies. I never really studied her fighting style — I'd never have stood up to her like that in a thousand years! — but whenever I watched her sparring, she'd go all out on the offense. No defense at all. If you could outlast her attacks, or hit her hard enough to disrupt her stance before she can get going..." she trails off, thinking. |"Maybe!" Ryn grins, side-eying you. "She's an overconfident bully, my sister. She knows she can defeat anybody, so she goes all-in on the offense; I don't think I've ever seen her parry more than a blow or two, and she wears no armor to speak of. rows.original: The interior of the vault is... surprisingly empty. A few gems and old golden coins are scattered around, but as you step inside, you're struck by just how barren the royal treasury is. The supposed wealth of the Winter City is nowhere to be seen. Ryn gasps, biting her lip as she takes it in. "What... what have you been doing, Alissa? The stories about our hidden mountain of gold, our ancient coffers overflowing... were they all lies?" "... Or has Kasyrra taken it all?" you wonder aloud. If so, the demoness's war chest is likely vast indeed. An entire kingdom's wealth stolen away to fund whatever dark devices she has in store. The only thing of any considerable value you can spy in the vault is a single dress stand, planted firmly in the middle of the chamber. It's supporting an extremely beautiful white gown, somewhere between royal attire and a wedding dress; it's richly adorned with silk capes and veils around the arms, belted around the waist with cloth-of-gold, and trimmed with embroidered sunbursts — the symbol the city's goddess. The dress leaves the shoulders bare, supported in place by a firm leather corset around the midriff, as expensive as any other part of the garment but, like the heeled leather boots and long bleached gloves resting beneath it, looks hardened enough to deflect sword thrusts. "This..." Ryn breathes, reaching out to touch the silky garment. "This is too small for Alissa. Even when we were young, her boobs would have torn right through this. And the skirts wouldn't have reached her shins." "But it's a perfect fit for you." It's true: seeing Ryn stand beside the dress, there's no denying that it's been made for her among all the elves of this palace: its sized exactly to her waist and shoulders. [etheryn.cupRange C|Somehow it's even been let out around the chest, like it would snugly hold against Ryn's now-heftier rack. Was Alissa planning much the same treatment for her sister, or has she been spying on you?] There's one other thing, too: resting on a rack beside the dress is a greatspear taller than Ryn herself, adorned with an edged crossguard and the symbol of the sun holding its three blades together. "Sister..." Ryn murmurs, reaching up and taking the spear. It's heavy enough that she nearly buckles, but with effort, hefts it up and stands it at her side. "Did you... you couldn't have had all this made for me. You wouldn't... why would you?" [flags.WC_QUEEN_DEF|It's hard to deny that Ryn and her sister had a... very intimate, if not necessarily voluntary, relationship. Considering how uncannily this armored dress resembles a Belharan wedding gown, did Alissa really mean to take that to another level entirely?] You'll probably never get a straight answer out of the fallen queen, but after all the effort you just put into opening this vault — and how fine the dress and its accompanying war-leather and holy spear are — it would be insane not to take it with you.
