"Even when I was young, I could tell the city was full of life and happiness. Most boreal elves come across as big boisterous warriors, but most... most of them are so full of love and fire, too. I'm glad I'm finally getting the chance to meet them face to face. [etheryn.lnhConfidence|I... I just hope... I hope I can be the queen they expect me to be.|I know I'm behind the curve, but... but I hope I can be the queen they need.|I've been isolated so long, but now... now I have to do everything in my power to catch up, to be the queen they need. And I know I'll have your support every step of the way. That's the only thing that keeps me sane through all this." She smiles, taking your hand. "Thank you."]
rows.translation: 那么，让我们来谈谈冬城吧，”你开口说道。 [etheryn.lnhConfidence|伊瑟琳尴尬地扭动着身体，尽量避免与你对视。“如果你想知道的话……但实际上，我所知道的并没有你想象中那么多。在我们占领这座城市之前，我根本不被允许离开宫殿。|小琳叹了口气说道：“当然，但我并不像你想象的那么了解这个城市。我在学术上确实有些研究，但实际经验……其实并不多。在艾莉莎执政期间，我根本不被允许离开宫殿。|当然，”小琳微笑着说，“我真希望能告诉你们我在他们中间生活了整整一生的经历，但艾莉莎坚决阻止了我这样做。不过，我还是会尽我所能告诉你们尽可能多的信息。] 这座宫殿原本是一座带有外堡的城堡，但它坐落在一片冰冷的悬崖边上——那是弗罗斯赫恩高原的最北端，从来没有人能够到达那里。整个城市被高大的石墙环绕着，这些石墙取代了原有的木墙。在城墙的尽头，有一段巨大的有围墙的阶梯，通向悬崖峭壁上的宫殿。在城市中央，矗立着黎明大教堂——这座卢米安教会的教堂，它的高度远远超过了周围所有的房屋和商店。我想，这里的大多数房屋都相当小，大概和鹰棘镇的木结构房屋差不多大小吧。尽管这些建筑大多已有数百年的历史，由石头和木材建造而成，但它们已经被修缮过很多次。而那些屋顶……总是被积雪覆盖，烟囱里不断冒出浓浓的黑烟。整个城市总是弥漫着炉火的气息，或是炊烟的味道。我永远都不会忘记那一幕。” “在这么靠北的地方，雪会一直下个不停吗？” 小琳轻声笑了起来。全部就是那个时候。你们都看到了吧！雪从来都不会停止。大多数时候，它只是轻轻覆盖在地面上，但到了冬天，或者当暴风雪来袭时，积雪就会多到让人睁不开眼睛。整个城市都被雪覆盖了，即使是从宫殿的阳台上望去，也能看到一片白茫茫的景象，一直延伸到地平线的尽头。当暴风雪结束时，大家都会出来把屋顶上的积雪铲掉，以免积雪融化后造成麻烦。有时候，大教堂会派出那些擅长使用神圣魔法的“阳光女祭司”来帮助融化积雪。每当她们出动时，人们会发出震天的欢呼声——那些欢呼声曾经大到足以把我从睡梦中惊醒。精灵暗自一笑，开始玩弄自己那条金色的辫子，用两根手指轻轻捻动着它。“即使在我还是个孩子的时候，我就能感觉到这座城市充满了生机与欢乐。大多数极北精灵给人的印象都是那些高大强壮、充满活力的战士，但大多数情况下确实是这样。他们中的大多数也都充满了爱心与热情。我很高兴终于有机会与他们面对面见面了。 [etheryn.lnhConfidence|我……我只是希望……希望能成为他们所期望的那位女王。|我知道我落后了，但是……我希望自己能成为他们所需要的那个女王。|我被孤立了这么久，但现在……现在我必须竭尽全力去追赶，成为他们所需要的那位女王。我知道，在每一步路上，你都会给予我支持。正是这份支持，让我能够在这一切之中保持理智。 她微笑着，握住了你的手：“谢谢你。]
rows.raw: " "So, let's talk about the Winter City," you prompt her. [etheryn.lnhConfidence|Etheryn squirms awkwardly, trying not to look you in the eye. "If you want... but I really don't know as much as you'd think. Until we took the city, I-I wasn't allowed to leave the palace."|Ryn sighs, "Sure, but I don't know as much as you'd think. Academia, sure, but not... I don't have a lot of first-hand experience with the city. I wasn't allowed to leave the palace while Alissa ruled.|"Of course," Ryn smiles. "I wish I could tell you about a lifetime of living among its people, but Alissa made sure that never happened. Still, I'll tell you as much as I can."] "The palace used to be a motte and bailey, but backed up against a icey cliff; the edge of the Frosthewn Plateau that goes further north than anyone's ever been. The city is encircled by tall stone walls that replaced the old wooden ones, and at the far end is a huge walled stairs leading up the cliffside to the palace. In the middle of the city is the Cathedral of the Dawn, the Lumian church, which towers way high above all the houses and shops surrounding it. Most of the houses are relatively small, I guess, not much bigger than the wood ones in Hawkethorne. Even though most are hundreds of years old and a mix of stone and wood, they've been repaired so many times. And the roofs... always covered in snow, with thick clouds of black woodsmoke pouring out of the chimneys. The city always smells like a hearth, or a cookfire. I'll never forget that much." "Does it snow all the time so far north?" Ryn giggles. "ALL the time. You've seen it! It never stops. Most days it's a gentle dusting, but in winter or when a storm blows through, the snow's enough to blind you. The whole city disappears under the flurries, and all you can see, even from the palace balcony, is whiteness all the way to the horizon. When the storms end, everyone goes out and has to shovel the snow off their roofs before it melts. Sometimes the cathedral will send out its sun priestesses to melt the snow with their holy magic. You can always tell when they're out by the cheering, so loud that it used to wake me up." The elf smiles to herself and starts to play with one of her golden braids, twisting it between two fingers. "Even when I was young, I could tell the city was full of life and happiness. Most boreal elves come across as big boisterous warriors, but most... most of them are so full of love and fire, too. I'm glad I'm finally getting the chance to meet them face to face. [etheryn.lnhConfidence|I... I just hope... I hope I can be the queen they expect me to be.|I know I'm behind the curve, but... but I hope I can be the queen they need.|I've been isolated so long, but now... now I have to do everything in my power to catch up, to be the queen they need. And I know I'll have your support every step of the way. That's the only thing that keeps me sane through all this." She smiles, taking your hand. "Thank you."]"

rows.original:
You pat Ryn's shoulder and tell her that from what you've seen so far, from what she's been willing to put herself through in the name of helping her city, there's no doubt she's going to be a fine queen so long as she maintains that level of dedication. 

                She smiles shy, relief obvious on her features. "Th-thank you, [pc.name]. Hearing you say that... it means a lot. I'll try... try to live up to your expectations."
                
                You've got no doubt she will.
rows.translation:
你轻拍着小琳的肩膀，对她说：根据你目前所见，以及她为了帮助自己的城市而愿意付出的种种努力，毫无疑问，只要她能保持这种奉献精神，她一定会成为一名出色的女王。 

                她害羞地笑了起来，脸上洋溢着如释重负的神情：“谢、谢谢你，[pc.name]。听到你这么说……对我来说意义重大。我会努力的……尽力不辜负你的期望。”
                
                毫无疑问，她一定会做到的。
rows.raw:
"
                You pat Ryn's shoulder and tell her that from what you've seen so far, from what she's been willing to put herself through in the name of helping her city, there's no doubt she's going to be a fine queen so long as she maintains that level of dedication. 

                She smiles shy, relief obvious on her features. "Th-thank you, [pc.name]. Hearing you say that... it means a lot. I'll try... try to live up to your expectations."
                
                You've got no doubt she will."

rows.original: Tell Ryn she'll be a fine queen, if she keeps working at it.
rows.translation: 告诉小琳，只要她继续努力，她一定会成为一名出色的女王。
rows.raw: "Tell Ryn she'll be a fine queen, if she keeps working at it."

rows.original:
"You need to toughen up," you tell her. "Stop worrying about what people think about you and live for yourself."

                "I... but I'm responsible... for all these people," Ryn whines. "They're all counting on me now."
                
                Counting on Etheryn for confidence and leadership seems like a recipe for disaster. Gods help the Winter City now...
                
                Her ears flatten against the side of her head, but she doesn't try to protest your point any further; she knows she's weak, and you don't know that she has it in her to toughen up. All you can do is try to help.
                
                Or take advantage.
rows.translation:
“你得坚强起来。”你对她说道，“别再担心别人怎么看你，为自己而活。”

                “我……可我得对……所有这些人负责。”小琳呜咽道，“他们现在全都指望着我。”
                
                指望伊瑟琳拿出自信和领导力，听起来简直就是灾难的配方。现在只希望诸神保佑冬城了……
                
                她的耳朵贴在头侧，却没有再试图反驳；她知道自己软弱，而你也不确定她是否真有办法变得坚强。你能做的只有尽力帮助她。
                
                或者趁机利用她。

rows.original: Tell Ryn she doesn't owe anything to the city. Fretting over her performance isn't going to help her rule.
rows.translation: 告诉小琳，她并不欠这座城市什么。为自己的表现而烦恼并不会帮助她更好地统治这个城市。
rows.raw: "Tell Ryn she doesn't owe anything to the city. Fretting over her performance isn't going to help her rule."

rows.original: Talk about the Winter City — its history, its people, and its future.
rows.translation: 让我们来谈谈这座冬城——它的历史、它的人民，以及它的未来。
rows.raw: "Talk about the Winter City — its history, its people, and its future."

rows.original: [flags.RQ2_ALISSA |[alissa.dead |"How are you holding up?" you ask. "After Alissa..." Ryn glances to the ground, hugging her knees to her chest. "You don't sound thrilled," you say. "Didn't she-" "She was horrible," Ryn sighs. "[etheryn.highConfidence |Even after all this time, I still sometimes have nightmares about the way she treated me. |I-I have nightmares every n-night about what she did to me. ] But still. She was my sister. I can't... I can't bring myself to be happy she's gone. I can't help feeling like I could have, should have, done more to try and help her. Nobody else could have. [pc.dcb|Now she's got you to take Alissa's place.|You'll help Ryn get over her sister's torment, one day at a time.|Now she's get a super best friend like you!]|"I'm... I'm still trying to cope," Ryn sighs after a moment's thought. "After so long being tormented by her, I still don't know how to live without her. [kas.hlr|You can't fathom how that kind of weakness could have been hiding in a so-called warrior-queen's soul.|You've got some... intimate idea... how someone could fall on their knees with one look at Kasyrra, but even then, Alissa doesn't seem the type.|You can't say the same. The moment you first saw Kasyrra, you were all but smitten with the curvaceous, dominant demon milf. Even a proud warrior like Alissa would have no chance at resisting Kas's charms. rows.translation: [flags.RQ2_ALISSA |[alissa.dead |你最近怎么样？”你问道，“在艾莉莎的事情之后……” 小琳低头望着地面，双膝紧抱在胸前。过了好一会儿，她才说道：“我还不错。当她第一次变成恶魔的时候，我就以为她已经死了，以为我认识的那个姐姐已经不在了。现在，这只是一个事实罢了。” “你听起来并不高兴啊，”你说，“她不是……” “她太可怕了，”小琳叹了口气。[etheryn.highConfidence |即便过了这么久，有时候我仍然会做关于她当时对待我的方式的噩梦。 |我、我每隔几个晚上就会做噩梦，梦到她对我做过那些事。 ]但无论如何，她毕竟是我的妹妹。我无法……我实在无法为她的离去感到高兴。我不由得觉得，自己本应该、本可以做得更多来帮助她。没有人能够做到这一点，就连可怜的吉莎也始终无法影响她。似乎只有卡希拉才能对她产生一些影响，而我们也看到了那最终导致了什么…… 又过了一会儿，小琳说道：“我并不想念她，但我确实为她感到悲痛。她本可以成为那样的女王姐姐她本应该这样的。但我知道，那从来就不是命中注定的…… 她向后靠在椅背上，叹了口气：“我只是希望有一天，能有人找到办法来帮助像她这样的人——那些灵魂深处被邪恶所侵蚀的人。或许作为女王，我可以推动人们去研究这类问题？我也不确定……但我一定会尽我所能，确保再也没有人像我一样遭受痛苦。一定有办法的。 |你最近有和艾莉莎聊过吗？”你问道。 小琳叹了口气：“我去见过她了。 [etheryn.lowConfidence |不过，我不确定自己是否还能再忍受一次…… |如果可能的话，我打算每隔几天就做一次。 ]她的行为就像一只被关在笼子里的动物，在栅栏后面徘徊游荡。看着她实在让人难受，听她说话更是如此。她不是在默默地怒火中烧，就是在肆意地倾泻恶言秽语。 [etheryn.lowConfidence |我实在受不了了！ |我真不愿意看到她变成这样。 ]你后悔我们抓了她吗？” 那么，你们有没有线索知道她可能去了哪里？” “看起来她并没有和卡希拉一起离开，”小琳低声说道，“她应该是往南方或者东南方去了。 rows.original:
"Sure," you say, grinning down at the war-hawk. He ruffles his feathers and makes a huffing sound as Etheryn takes the falconry glove from her belt and hands it up to you. As soon as you slip the gauntlet on and hold it out, Harrick flaps up and perches on it — seemingly despite himself, if the bewildered look on the hawk's face is any indication.

                Then again, he seems to always look either shocked or hateful. Not much middle ground with a war-bird you guess.
                
                Harrick flaps his wings and looks around, largely ignoring you in favor of fussing at Etheryn herself. Ryn pets the bird's head, trying and failing to direct his attention back to you. "Well, I guess he's still getting used to you. Harrick's the least personable of all the war-hawks I've ever raised, I swear."
                
                Harrick squawks in agreement and pecks at your thumb through the gauntlet. Guess that's... how he gets to know people?
                
                Before he has the chance to worry his way through the leather, you hand Harrick back to Ryn.

                不过，他看起来总是要么表现出震惊，要么流露出憎恨之情。对于这样一个人来说，似乎根本不存在中立的态度吧。
                
                哈里克拍打着翅膀，环顾四周，却基本上无视了你，而是开始对伊瑟琳本人发号施令。小琳轻抚着那只鸟的头部，试图让它把注意力重新转回到你身上，但几次尝试都失败了。“嗯，我想它还在适应你吧。我发誓，哈里克是我养过的所有好战分子中最不善于与人打交道的一个。

                在他还有机会为这些皮革制品烦恼之前，你赶紧把哈里克交还给了小琳。

rows.original: Ryn nods. "So, what did you [etheryn.lowConfidence |f- ]find out, [pc.name]?" You briefly recount everything you'd heard from Elthara, Daliza and Hethia; Ryn takes it all in, especially when it comes to the latter. Her gaze grows distant for several moments, then she hangs her head and sighs. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |The first two a-aren't anything I hadn't heard of before. The last, though... Hethia's done us a big favor by admitting t-that the druids could have done it, that they had the means. I'd have expected h-her to simply deny it even if they had... that's a big gesture of goodwill on her part. I can only hope she doesn't get into trouble with her p-people for it." Well, if she doesn't say anything, you don't say anything and Ryn doesn't say anything, who'll know? Ryn closes her eyes. "T-to be perfectly honest, [pc.name], I don't think I want to actually know the answer. The druids may have h-had a means and a motive, but I don't believe that there's any evidence left over if they did somehow do something to that boar. And if I knew the a-answer... and if the answer was one I didn't like... I don't know if I could hold myself back, especially given that my mother's generation of leaders on their side is g-gone as well. I wouldn't want to hold the current Xadaron responsible for her parents' a-actions the same way I wouldn't want her holding the current var Ridell responsible f-for her parents' actions..." That's assuming that the druids had something to do with the king dowager's death in the first place. Hethia didn't say that her people did it, she just acknowledged the possibility; Ryn shouldn't let her imagination run wild with baseless what-ifs. Motive, means, evidence. That last one's the most important. "Yes." Drawing a shuddering breath, Ryn squares her shoulders and pulls herself together. |前两个我以前确实听说过。不过最后一个……赫希娅承认德鲁伊们的存在，真是帮了我们大忙。可以他们确实有能力做到这一点。我本以为她即使有这样的能力，也会坚决否认这件事……她这样做，实在是表现出了极大的善意。我只希望她不会因此而惹上麻烦。” “嗯，如果她什么都不说，你也不说，小琳也不说，谁会知道呢？” 小琳闭上了眼睛。“说实话[pc.name]，其实，我并不想知道答案。那些德鲁伊或许有他们的手段和动机，但我相信，如果他们真的对那头野猪做了什么，现在应该已经没有任何证据留存下来了。而如果我真的知道了那个答案…………而如果得到的答案是我不喜欢的……我不知道自己是否能够控制住自己，尤其是考虑到我母亲那一代领导者也都已经离世了。我并不想让现在的Xadaron为她父母的所作所为负责，就如同我不希望她将她父母的行为归咎于现在的瓦·里德尔一样。……” 不过，这前提是德鲁伊们确实与王太后的死有关。赫希娅并没有明确表示是她的族人干的，她只是承认了这种可能性；小琳不应该让自己的想象力在毫无根据的猜测中天马行空。动机、手段、证据。其中最后一点最为重要。 “是的。”小琳深吸一口气，挺直肩膀，努力让自己平静下来。“根本没有任何证据。 话虽如此，她还是需要记住，当初让她让你进行这次看似毫无意义的追寻的真正原因是什么。到目前为止，埃利昂有什么反应吗？他根本没有因为你探究他的过去而责备你；事实上，自从这件事开始以来，除非你主动去找他，否则你根本见不到他的踪影。当然，他毕竟是个猎人[pc.bg hunter barbarian |你可能会认为，过去你自己已经观察过足够多的动物，因此能够立刻察觉到有人也在试图对你做同样的事情。 [pc.isDK |哎呀，她真的太依赖别人了吧？你根本不明白其中的好处啊…… |嗯，你为小琳已经付出了这么多努力；再迈出这最后一步吧。 ]达莉莎确实说过，宫廷卫兵和她的族人们在那里搜寻了很长时间，试图找出一些线索，但最终什么也没找到。不过，如果这能让小琳安心，同时也能让你进入荒野以便别人能够找到你，那你就去做吧。 “谢谢。[pc.name]我会等着听你有什么要汇报的。

[etheryn.crowned|女王们|摄政者]包括……尤其是那些最近经历了这么多事情的人。如果这样还不够的话，她可以把这次行动称为一次“探险”，以此来更好地了解她的研究对象。 这话引来了笑声。“在我看来，这种说法有点带有倾向性啊。[pc.name]，不过我还是会去的——去和朋友一起度过时光。” “好吧，那这就算是一次约会了。” 摆脱了那些负担，这位精灵君主在你们穿过冰蓝色的入口走廊时，开心地跟在你们身边走着。[hethia.isHostile | | 那个总是露出讥笑表情的德鲁伊，还有…… ]几名皇家卫兵。随着一阵刺骨的寒风，大门缓缓打开——冬城正在等待着他们。 |当然，[pc.name]，是吗？”她微笑着说道，“为什么？你为什么想要一次私人导览呢？” 她似乎读懂了你的心思。 小琳走下台阶，握住了你的手：“我其实一直想邀请你一起参观这里，但我们总是忙于其他事情，一直没有找到合适的时机。不过如果你现在有时间陪我，我真的很想带你逛逛这座城市。”她那双湛蓝的宝石般的眼睛闪烁着光芒，“或许我们可以把这叫做一次约会吧。” 嗯，听起来简直太完美了。你立刻回应了她，亲了她那双“皇家手指”一下，而作为回报，你也收到了她爽朗的笑声。 你们手牵手，沿着长长的走廊走去，经过华丽的精灵挂毯，经过那些恭敬地站立、行礼的守卫，最终推开门，外面是明媚的日光。 ] ]
rows.raw: ' [flags.RYN_DATE |[etheryn.lowConfidence |Once again, you approach the shy elven monarch with an offer: after having such a fun sojourn in the city with her last time, you'd love to have her guide you again today. "I... I'd like that. I'd like it a lot better than sitting on this throne, anyway." Etheryn massages her temples as she descends from the dais, clearly glad to be free of the burden of rulership — at least, temporarily. "Where to, [pc.name]?" |[pc.hasHelmet |You doff your [pc.helmet] with a flourish, then |[pc.bg noblescion |Drawing on all the courtly manners you can muster, you genuflect to the throne, then |With your best impersonation of proper ceremonial, you ] ] ] take a knee in front of the dais. Raising your hand to Ryn, you ask, with just the right amount of seriousness, if she would give her Champion the honor of her company on a visit to the city. [etheryn.highConfidence |Etheryn giggles and claps, rising from her seat to take your hand in hers. "You know I don't like to stand on ceremony," she says softly, "but I can't help myself when you're being romantic. Of course I will. I love going on dates with you..." |"I'm sorely tempted," she admits, "but there's always so much to do..." Hey, now. She knows what they say about all work and no play. "I guess I do. All right, [pc.name]." Ryn stretches as she leaves the throne, yawning out the tension of monarchical responsibility, then offers a friendly hand to you. "El can manage anything that comes up while we're gone. Let's go have some fun!" ] |From your place next to the dais, you have a pretty good view of the throne room and its decor. One tapestry in particular stands out: a red-maned valkyrie soaring above a glacier and raining blazing glory on unseen foes below, none other than the Sunbringer Queen herself. The artist chose to depict Atheldred as an uncomplicated heroine, a warrior of light... not entirely untruthfully, and it's an understandable tack to take for something on display in her descendants' throne room. But from your encounter with Athel's shade in the crypt, you know what isn't on the tapestry, namely an awful lot of messy reality — shattered hearts and sundered peoples. [pc.isChamp |It's pretty heavy to think about, and you can only imagine how Ryn feels[var0|; even the happy reunion she did have with her grandmothers was almost unbearably bittersweet]. As much as the two of you have been through together, what you could both probably use at this point is something straightforwardly pleasant and fun. Something the pair of you could do as monarch and Champion. Hmm... |As far as you're concerned, being cooped up in the palace with all that nonsense is suffocating. You haven't got time for that shit. What you need is some fresh air, away from all the ice and misery in this palace. And apropos of that... ] Ryn clears her throat softly, breaking you out of your reverie. "What's on your mind, [pc.name]?" You were wondering: how well did she get to know the city while she was Alissa's prisoner? "Not as well as I'd like," she sighs. "I've learned about our history from books and tutors, but I never got to visit unless I sneaked out... and when I did that, I tried to hide in the shadows as much as possible. It's been strange to just walk in the streets without having to worry about the guards snatching me and taking me back to the palace." But she does know her way around, more or less? [etheryn.lnhConfidence |"I... I guess," she mumbles confusedly. Perfect. Wouldn't it be fun to be able to visit the streets without fear or worry? Just the two of you, taking in the sights and having fun[pc.isChamp |. maybe as a sort of pick-me-up after everything the two of you have been through together ]? Ryn gapes at the sheer audacity of your proposal. "R-really? We'd just... go out? But what about..." [pc.isDK |Seriously? You |You ] raise a finger: no buts. It'll be fine. You promise. "I... I..." It takes several seconds for her to steady herself from babbling querulously to quiet resignation. "O-okay, [pc.name]. I'll... go out." Attagirl. This'll be great. Fortified by your cajoling and guided by your hand on her shoulder, Ryn finally comes down off the dais and leaves the throne room. Slowly, the two of you walk down the blue-lit entrance corridor and to the enormous wooden portal. As the guards haul the doors open, one of them gives you a surreptitious thumbs-up, and then you and Ryn emerge into light and frost. |Ryn's look turns pensive. "I do. Why do you ask?" Well, you'd been thinking about spending some time in the Winter City, and who[silly |mst ] better to be your guide then a genuine native? Somebody who could use a break from being a [etheryn.crowned|queen|regent] in order to enjoy herself with her friend? "I don't know," comes her sheepish reply. "I'd like to, but it'd be a little irresponsible, wouldn't it? With everything else that we have on our plates?" Nonsense. Everybody needs to relax once in a while, [etheryn.crowned|queens|regents] included... especially ones who've been through so much lately. If that's not enough, she can call it an expedition to better get to know her subjects. That draws a laugh. "That sounds a little tendentious to me, [pc.name], but I'll go — to spend time with a friend." All right, then: it's a date. Relieved of her burdens, the elven monarch fairly skips alongside you as you traverse the ice-blue entrance hallway, passing[hethia.isHostile | | a certain smirking druid and ] several royal guards. With a blast of icy chill, the doors open: the Winter City awaits. |"Sure, [pc.name]," she says with a smile. "Why — did you want a personal tour?" She read your mind. Ryn descends the dais to take your hand in hers. "I'd been thinking about offering to show you around, but we've always been rushing off somewhere or other and I never managed to find the right moment. But if you have the time to spend with me now, I'd love to show you around the city." Her big sapphire eyes sparkle. "Maybe we can call it a date." Well, now. That sounds perfect. You punctuate your assent by bestowing a big, wet smooch on the royal fingers, and receive a royal giggle in return. Hand in hand, the two of you walk down the long corridor, past sumptuous elven tapestries and waiting, saluting guards, and open the doors to reveal the cool light of day. ] ] '

rows.original: Visit the Dawn Maiden's enormous cathedral in the heart of the Winter City. Ryn's Lumian faith is very important to her, and you're sure that she'd love to share more about it with you. But it's also a pretty building in its own right, and it might be worth taking a look inside.
rows.translation: 前往位于冬城中心的黎明少女那座宏伟的大教堂吧。对小琳来说，卢米安信仰至关重要，她肯定很乐意与你分享更多关于它的故事。而且，这座建筑本身也非常壮观，进去看看肯定很有意思。
rows.raw: "Visit the Dawn Maiden's enormous cathedral in the heart of the Winter City. Ryn's Lumian faith is very important to her, and you're sure that she'd love to share more about it with you. But it's also a pretty building in its own right, and it might be worth taking a look inside."

rows.original: See what the elves trade with each other in the market square [flags.WAY_WINTER|around the Waystone statue|around the statue of the elven maiden]. Whether it's just browsing, trying on clothes, or meeting Etheryn's subjects, the two of you can probably find lots to do there!
rows.translation: 看看精灵们在市场广场上互相交易些什么吧。 [flags.WAY_WINTER|在路石雕像的周围|在那位精灵少女的雕像周围]无论是随便浏览一下，试穿衣服，还是去见见伊瑟琳的臣民们，你们俩在那里肯定能找到很多事情做！
rows.raw: "See what the elves trade with each other in the market square [flags.WAY_WINTER|around the Waystone statue|around the statue of the elven maiden]. Whether it's just browsing, trying on clothes, or meeting Etheryn's subjects, the two of you can probably find lots to do there!"

rows.original: Just like Ryn says, it snows ALL the time here. Why not take advantage of that and spend some time together in a wintry wonderland?
rows.translation: 就像小琳说的，这里总是下雪的。为什么不利用这个机会，一起在这个冬日仙境中度过一段美好的时光呢？
rows.raw: "Just like Ryn says, it snows ALL the time here. Why not take advantage of that and spend some time together in a wintry wonderland?"

rows.original: Stark and beautiful amid the lightly flurrying snow, the church of the Dawn Maiden towers above the wood-and-stone dwellings around it. You and Ryn pace the perimeter, examining every angle: the glowing sunburst icons in relief; the enormous dual welcoming and warlike statues of Lumia flanking the portal; the multitude of smaller spires ringing the roof around a central tower bearing an open eternal flame, blazing a beacon of the Mother's love to every corner of the city. From within the cathedral's many windows, an otherworldly, if gentle, light shines, making it just possible to discern a multitude of colored glass panes[pc.bg acolyte scholar | showing classic Lumian motifs | in beautiful religious designs ]: the goddess lovingly hugging her children, descending from the heavens near the walls of the Winter City, raising a flaming greatsword against a horde of wraiths emerging from the Frostwood, comforting an expectant woman. Normally, you'd expect stained glass to only be visible from the inside of a building, through the shafts of sunlight coming in from without. This close to the walls, though, the light coming from within is just enough to make the window art discernible to the casual [pc.race] on the street. You mention this to Ryn, and she nods. "Like sunlight, Lumia's love radiates to the whole city. It's reflected in the architecture, with the internal light of the temple making the window designs more easily visible from the outside, and it's also reflected in the temple's activities. Sun priestesses come out to the rest of the city to minister to the people, whether by tending to the sick and needy or just using their magic to melt snow. But just like Lumia herself, the cathedral has two roles: its love shines out to the rest of the city, but it also enfolds all who come to worship in a motherly embrace. You'll see when we go inside." Has she actually been in to worship, then? "Only a few times, and those mostly since we freed the city; as a prisoner of Alissa, all I could visit was the royal chapel," she says with a wan smile. Your feet crunch through the snow as you continue to circle the cathedral's walls. "But I've read a lot about its design and construction. Building it was one of the crowning achievements of Grandmother Athel's reign, so of course there were a lot of books about it and panegyrics to it. Now that I know what I know, I have to wonder about the people of that time. How much of what they said and did was belief? How much was fear? Even in the most effusively praising works, it was sometimes awkward for the poets and writers to discuss imported materials and a then-freshly imported goddess." Imported materials? Does she mean the glass? "It's all from Tychris," confirms Ryn as you stand beneath one depiction of an apocalyptic struggle against the wraiths and their corrupted armies in magical reds, purples, and greens. Snowflakes drift onto the panes and melt instantly on contact. "Delivered back when we still traded with the outside. Then the glasswork dried up, the Frostwood became the preserve of the druids, we turned our eyes to the north... and we found different problems to handle." She crosses her arms and sighs heavily. "We made such beautiful things with others' help." That sounds like a good reason to try to reestablish trading ties; even if there's more important things to do right now than create beautiful art, once the crisis has passed... A golden-blonde braid twists through Ryn's fingers as she thinks. "It'd be wonderful, no question. But trade only works if each party has something the other wants, and if it's worth enough to both to justify the cost of travel. [var0|If our traders could make use of the Ways Between, it'd certainly be much easier.|But it'll be a lot of hard work to make the roads and rivers safe enough to travel quickly again.] It's something to work toward when we can, but I don't want to underrate its difficulty. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |It feels like just about everything a ruler has to do is difficult. |Besides, what with everything that's been going on, it might take a long time for our people to trust outsiders again. |With you at my side, though, I know we can do it. You showed me just how much elves and outsiders can help each other. Maybe we can't be friends with everybody out there, but some ties are better than none! ]" [pc.isDK |Hmp. Well, you can't say that you're terribly interested in the Winter City's isolation, but you are interested in being compensated for fixing the problem. |You'll be sure to keep an eye out for anything that makes that burden easier. ] [etheryn.lowConfidence |"Th-thanks, [pc.name]." She exhales tiredly. "I think I'm done with politics for now. Let's j-just go inside." |Ryn gives you a little side-squeeze. "Then I'm glad I have a Champion of Winter to do that. Come on, let's go in." ] You understand what Ryn had meant about the temple's embrace as soon as you cross the threshold. Well-lit and warm despite its cavernous size, the interior feels as safe as being in a mother's arms without being cloying and uncomfortable[pc.bg acolyte |; it's the same sense of palpable divine power that you remember from your initiate days ]. There's no service going at the moment, so robed acolytes walk to and fro, cleaning the surfaces and maintaining the candle lighting. In the pews and alcoves, congregants hold quiet, private meetings with elven priestesses in gauzy, revealing clothes. You can see a few couples, [party.has azyrran | Azzy — who waves at you and Ryn cheerfully from across the sanctuary before returning to her conversation with an acolyte — ] one off-duty guardsman, and many women at varying stages of expectancy... several of whom, of course, belong to the clergy.[pc.isPregnant | You rub your own [pc.belly], more attentive than ever to the growing life inside you. Any worries you may have had about delivery and your beautiful bab[var1|y|ies]-to-be melt away like stray snowflakes in the cathedral vestibule. |[pc.hasKids | They remind you of your own child[var1||ren], bringing a sigh to your lips; whether through the goddess' power or through your own subconscious desires, you can't help but think fondly about the possibility of having another baby. |[pc.fertilityRange 4 | The sight of them all is enough to spur a powerful urge inside you, a more-than-idle dream of lovemaking, pregnancy, and holding a beautiful child in your arms.[silly | It's a case of baby rabies severe enough to make your ovaries sob. ] ] ] ] A blue-skinned priestess walks up to greet you, but she stops short, mouth open in shock, when she realizes her visitors' identity. With a placating smile, Ryn introduces you, but then [etheryn.lowConfidence |shyly |gently ] pushes her away, saying that you're just visiting and don't want to be a burden.[pc.isValk | Even so, after that little exchange you can sense the awe-struck eyes of all on your angelic wings, and hear the susurration of religious business die down to a bare whisper. For the elves in the cathedral, seeing their monarch out for a stroll with their goddess' living Champion is a religious experience all its own. ] Arm in arm, you and Ryn peek into alcoves to examine religious statuary and crane your neck up to gaze on the brightly woven tapestries. Ryn has a description for everything, from the statues of the other Six Living Gods to votive dedications in unreadable boer'alvarin script. The sweet thing's enthusiasm is infectious as she greets art she's barely seen outside a book like an old friend, and you let her carry you along as she goes, borne on the wave of her excitement about her people and what they can do.[pc.bg acolyte scholar | You add what you can from your own studies, contrasting the designs and themes of the art from similar temples elsewhere, and Ryn thrills to your tales of what southern Lumians have created for the glory of the Dawn Maiden. ] You end up in a pew, illuminated by the warm light of the immense sun icon at the altar. Firmly clasping her hands together in prayer, Ryn stares up at it with wet eyes. "For the longest time, I didn't have anybody. El and Jael'yn were... they were nice to me, but I couldn't confide in them. I couldn't share how awful I felt about everything that was happening. The only person I could share my feelings with was Lumia. For even a tiny bit of comfort..." [pc.isChamp |And, for the briefest moment, she is with you, too. MY CHILD... YOU ARE LOVED. Then the presence of awesome majesty passes through you and beyond. That was more than a tiny bit of comfort. You give Ryn a reassuring pat on the shoulder. |Hmm. Well, if that's what helps her live with herself. ] Ryn whispers something under her breath, then looks[etheryn.lowConfidence | furtively ] around the sanctuary. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |"The palace chapel is a safe place where I can be alone with her. But here I can just feel everybody watching me. All their lives depend on me, and I can't live up to that. I can't be the queen they need me to be." She exhales a dejected sigh. "Visiting this place is nice, but... but it's intense, [pc.name]. Can we go do something else now?" You think she's being a bit hard on herself, but sure, if that's what she wants. |"For a long time, all I had was the chapel. It's more personal there. It's a place where I can imagine that it's just me and Lumia, and it feels... more powerful that way. I don't know. I liked coming here, but I don't know if it'd be right for me to intrude on the rest of the city's worship. The cathedral is supposed to be for everybody, and normal elves probably don't want to think that I'm watching them even when they're trying to be closer to her." Maybe so, but Ryn worshiping alongside her people could also make them feel closer to her, as though all elves pray to the same goddess, rather than having a Lumia for royalty and a Lumia for everybody else. "That's true," she says, chewing on her lip. "Maybe there's a way I can balance those things. It's something to think about. Anyway, this was fun! What else should we do?" |"I'm going to come here more often. Not all the time, but much more frequently than Alissa used to. In the palace chapel, worship is more personal, but it's really just for the great and good. Here, I can be with everybody else." Accessibility to one's subjects is a laudable goal, but what about the majesty of her office, and suchlike things? "There's a time and place for that," Ryn says firmly. "Someone needs to govern in the palace, or nothing works; you saw what happened under my sister's rule. But as for religion? I need to be able to show my people that both they and I worship the same goddess... especially if I want us to welcome the druids into the fold." That's pretty clever, even if striking the proper balance of royal dignity and accessibility will take some thought. Still, you can't imagine the likes of Alissa ever bothering to ratiocinate to that degree. It's attention to questions like these that makes Ryn out to be a ruler with a lot of potential. The elven monarch accepts the compliment with an inclined head and a grin. "A hungry one, too. Let's get something to eat, [pc.name]." ]
rows.translation: 在轻轻飘落的雪花中，这座黎明少女教堂显得格外庄严而美丽，它高耸于周围那些木石结构的房屋之上。你和小琳沿着教堂的周边走了一圈，仔细观察着每一个细节：那些浮雕上闪耀的太阳图案；大门两侧那对巨大的、既象征欢迎也象征战争的卢米娅雕像；还有那些环绕在中央塔楼周围的众多小尖塔——这些尖塔上燃烧着的永恒之火，将母亲的爱意传递到了城市的每一个角落。从大教堂的众多窗户中，透出一道仿佛来自另一个世界、柔和而神秘的光芒，这使得人们能够隐约辨认出那些色彩斑斓的玻璃窗格。[pc.bg acolyte scholar | 展现了经典的卢米安风格元素 | 以精美的宗教图案呈现 ]女神满怀爱意地拥抱着她的孩子们，从天而降，降临在冬城的城墙附近；她举起燃烧着的巨剑，对抗那些从寒冰森林中涌出的幽灵军团；同时，她也安慰着那位怀有身孕的女性。 通常，彩绘玻璃得从建筑内部借着外面透入的阳光欣赏。不过，靠墙这么近，里面透出的灯光也足够让街上随意路过的[pc.race]辨认出窗上的图案。 你把这件事告诉了小琳，她点了点头：“就像阳光一样，卢米娅带来的爱意照亮了整个城市。这种影响体现在建筑上——寺庙内部的灯光使得窗户的设计从外部也能清晰地看到；同时，这也体现在寺庙举办的各类活动中。太阳女神祭司们会走出大教堂，前往城市的其他地方为人们服务——无论是照料病患和需要帮助的人，还是运用她们的魔法来融化积雪。但就像卢米娅本人一样，这座大教堂也肩负着双重使命：它的慈爱之轻型会洒向整个城市，同时，它也会以母亲般的怀抱接纳所有前来祈祷的人们。等我们进去后你就会明白了。 那么，她真的去参加过宗教仪式吗？ “只有几次，而且都是在我们解放这座城市之后；作为艾莉莎的囚犯，我只能去皇家礼拜堂。”她带着一丝苦涩的微笑说道。你的脚步在雪地上发出咔嚓声，你继续沿着大教堂的围墙绕行。但我读过很多关于它的设计与建造过程的资料。建造这座建筑是阿塞尔祖母执政期间最伟大的成就之一，因此自然也有许多关于它的书籍和赞美之词。现在了解了这些信息，我不禁会思考那个时代的人们究竟是怎样的。他们所说和所做的事情，有多少是出于信念？又有多少是出于恐惧？即使在那些充满赞美之词的作品中，诗人和作家们在讨论那些引进来的元素以及当时刚刚被引入的神祇时，有时也会感到有些尴尬。” 进口的材料？她是指那些玻璃吗？ “所有这些材料都来自提克里斯，”当你站在一幅描绘人类与那些幽灵及其腐化军队进行殊死斗争的画作下方时，小琳确认道。画中的色彩充满了魔法般的红、紫和绿。雪花飘落在窗玻璃上，但一接触到玻璃就立刻融化了。“这些材料是在我们还能与外界进行贸易的时候运过来的。后来，那些玻璃制造工艺就消失了，霜木之地也变成了德鲁伊们的领地，我们把注意力转向了北方……然后，我们就遇到了其他需要解决的问题。 她双臂交叉，重重地叹了口气：“在别人的帮助下，我们创造出了如此美好的东西。” 这听起来确实是一个重新建立贸易关系的好理由；即使现在有比创作艺术更重要的事情需要处理，但一旦危机过去…… 当小琳思考着这些时，一束金色的辫子从她的手指间穿过。“那肯定会很棒，毫无疑问。但是交易只有在双方都拥有对方想要的东西，并且这些东西对双方来说都足够有价值，从而能够弥补旅行的费用时，才会成立。 [var0|如果我们的交易员能够利用这些途径，事情肯定会变得容易许多。|但是，要让道路和河流重新变得安全，从而能够让人们快速通行，还需要付出大量的努力。]这是我们应当努力实现的目标，但我并不想低估其中的难度。 [etheryn.lnhConfidence |感觉差不多就是这样。一切当统治者面临困难时，他所能做的其实并不多。 |此外，考虑到最近发生的一切，我们的人民可能需要很长时间才能再次信任外人。 |但有你在我身边，我知道我们一定能够成功。你让我看到了精灵族与外人之间是如何互相帮助的。也许我们无法与所有人成为朋友，但有些联系总比没有要好得多！ ]" [pc.isDK |哼，好吧，你也不能说自己对冬城的孤立状态有多感兴趣，对吧？是有兴趣因解决问题而获得补偿。 |你一定要留意任何能够减轻这种负担的方法或事物。 ] [etheryn.lowConfidence |谢谢[pc.name]她疲惫地叹了口气，说道：‘我想我暂时不会再涉足政治了。我们还是进去吧。 |小琳轻轻捏了捏你的胳膊：“幸好有‘冬之冠军’在，才能做这种事。快，我们进去吧。 ] 一旦你跨过门槛，就会立刻明白小琳所说的“寺庙的怀抱”是什么意思。尽管空间宽敞如洞穴，但这里灯火通明、温暖舒适，让人感觉就像置身于母亲的怀抱之中，既不会感到压抑，也不会觉得不舒服。[pc.bg acolyte |这就是你在初次接触这些概念时所感受到的那种强烈的神圣力量。 ]目前没有提供任何服务，因此那些身着长袍的侍从们正在来回走动，清洁各种表面并维护蜡烛的照明。在长椅和角落里，信徒们正与穿着轻薄透明衣物的精灵女祭司们进行安静的私密交谈。你可以看到有几对情侣也在那里[party.has azyrran | 阿齐——她从圣所的对面欢快地向你和小琳挥手致意，然后又继续与她的随从交谈起来。 ]一名下班后的警卫，以及许多处于不同怀孕阶段的妇女……其中当然也有一些属于神职人员。[pc.isPregnant | 你自讨苦吃。[pc.belly]现在，你比以往任何时候都更加关注自己体内正在成长的生命。无论你之前对分娩过程或是自己即将迎来的可爱宝宝有什么担忧，[var1|y|ies]那些东西会像在大教堂门厅里飘落的雪花一样，悄然消失不见。 |[pc.hasKids | 它们会让你想起自己的孩子。[var1||ren]这会让你不禁轻叹一声；无论是出于女神的力量，还是源于你内心深处的渴望，你都会不由自主地开始想象再要一个孩子的可能性。 |[pc.fertilityRange 4 | 看到他们所有人，就足以在你内心激起一股强烈的欲望——一种关于做爱、怀孕，以及将一个可爱的孩子抱在怀中的美好憧憬。[silly | 这简直就是“婴儿狂犬病”的典型案例，严重到会让你的心都为之揪痛。 ] ] ] ] 一位皮肤呈蓝色的女祭司走上前来迎接你，但当她意识到来客的身份时，她突然停住了脚步，惊讶地张大了嘴巴。小琳露出安抚的笑容，为你做了介绍，然后[etheryn.lowConfidence |害羞地 |轻轻地 ]将他推开，说道你只是来拜访一下，并不想成为负担。[pc.isValk | 即便如此，在那段简短的对话之后，你依然能感受到所有人那充满敬畏的目光，仿佛他们都被你的“天使之翼”所震撼；同时，也能听到那些与宗教仪式相关的低语声逐渐减弱，最终只剩下微弱的耳语声。对于大教堂里的精灵们来说，看到他们的君主与他们的女神的活体捍卫者一起散步，本身就是一种极具宗教意义的体验。 ]你们手牵着手，一起探进各个壁龛，仔细观察那些宗教雕像，还伸长脖子去欣赏那些色彩鲜艳、编织精巧的挂毯。对于每一件艺术品，小琳都能给出详细的描述——从其他六位至高神明的雕像，到那些用难以辨认的博尔阿尔瓦林文字写成的献词。她那充满热情的态度实在令人感染；当她见到那些在书本中才见过的一次次的艺术作品时，表现得就像在迎接一位老朋友一样。于是，你也就让她带着你一起探索，让她那对自身民族及其成就的热爱之情带动着你前行。[pc.bg acolyte scholar | 你根据自己的研究补充了一些内容，将这些艺术作品的设计风格与主题与其他类似寺庙中的艺术作品进行了对比。而小琳则对你讲述的关于卢米亚南部人们为荣耀黎明女神而创作的各种艺术作品听得津津有味。 ] 你最终坐在一张长椅上，祭坛上那巨大的太阳图标散发出的温暖光芒照亮了你。小琳双手紧握，虔诚地凝视着它，眼中噙着泪水。“很长一段时间里，我都没有可以倾诉的人。埃尔和杰琳……他们对我很好，但我无法向他们倾诉我的心事。我无法告诉他们，发生的一切让我感到多么痛苦。唯一能让我倾诉的人，就是卢米娅。哪怕只是为了获得一点点安慰 [pc.isChamp |有那么一瞬间，她也与你同在。我的孩子……你是被深爱的。 随后，那种令人敬畏的庄严感便会穿透你，超越你，弥漫四周。 那个这确实给了她莫大的安慰。你轻轻拍了拍小琳的肩膀，给了她一种安慰和鼓励。 |嗯，如果这样能帮助她更好地面对自己，那也没关系吧。 ] 小琳低声说了些什么，然后看向了某处。[etheryn.lowConfidence | 偷偷地 ]在圣所的周围。 [etheryn.lnhConfidence |宫殿的小教堂是一个我可以和她独处的安全地方。但在这里，我只能感受到在场的每一个人都在注视着我。他们的命运都寄托在我身上，而我却无法不负众望。我无法成为他们所期望的那种女王。”她沮丧地叹了口气，“来这个地方参观固然不错，但是……这种压力实在太大了。[pc.name]我们现在能去做点别的事情吗？” 你觉得她对自己要求太严格了，但既然她是这么想的，那就随她吧。 |很长一段时间里，我只有那座小教堂。在那里，我感到更加自在。我可以想象只有我和卢米娅在一起，那种感觉……更加强烈。我不知道，我喜欢来这里，但我也不确定，闯入这座城市其他人的宗教活动之中，是否合适。这座大教堂本应是属于所有人的，而普通的精灵们大概也不愿意承认，即使他们试图与她更加亲近，其实我也在注视着他们。 也许确实如此，但小琳与她的族人一起进行崇拜，或许也能让他们感受到彼此之间的紧密联系。她就好像所有的精灵都在向同一位女神祈祷一样，而不是说皇室成员使用卢米娅，而普通民众则使用其他型号的卢米娅。 “确实是这样，”她边说边咬着嘴唇，“也许有办法可以平衡这些矛盾。这确实是个值得思考的问题。不管怎样，今天真的很有趣！我们还应该做些什么呢？ |我会经常来这里。不是每次都来，但频率会比艾莉莎以前高很多。在宫殿的小教堂里，祈祷活动更加私密，而且主要是为那些伟大而善良的人准备的。而在这里，我可以和大家在一起。能够方便地接触自己的臣民确实是一个值得称赞的目标，但她的职位所应具有的威严以及类似的东西又该如何处理呢？” “对于这些事情，也有合适的时机和场合。”小琳坚定地说道，“总得有人在宫殿里进行治理，否则一切都会陷入混乱；你应该还记得在我姐姐执政期间发生了什么吧。但至于宗教信仰呢？我必须让我的子民们明白，他们和我都崇拜同一位女神……尤其是如果我想让我们接纳德鲁伊们加入我们的行列的话。 这个想法相当聪明，不过要恰当地平衡皇室的尊严与亲和力，确实需要一些思考。不过，你绝对想象不到像艾莉莎这样的人会费心去进行如此深入的思考。正是这种对这类问题的关注，才让小琳显得是一位极具潜力的统治者。 这位精灵君主微微低头，露出微笑，接受了这番赞美。我也饿了。我们去找点东西吃吧。[pc.name]。” ]
rows.raw: " Stark and beautiful amid the lightly flurrying snow, the church of the Dawn Maiden towers above the wood-and-stone dwellings around it. You and Ryn pace the perimeter, examining every angle: the glowing sunburst icons in relief; the enormous dual welcoming and warlike statues of Lumia flanking the portal; the multitude of smaller spires ringing the roof around a central tower bearing an open eternal flame, blazing a beacon of the Mother's love to every corner of the city. From within the cathedral's many windows, an otherworldly, if gentle, light shines, making it just possible to discern a multitude of colored glass panes[pc.bg acolyte scholar | showing classic Lumian motifs | in beautiful religious designs ]: the goddess lovingly hugging her children, descending from the heavens near the walls of the Winter City, raising a flaming greatsword against a horde of wraiths emerging from the Frostwood, comforting an expectant woman. Normally, you'd expect stained glass to only be visible from the inside of a building, through the shafts of sunlight coming in from without. This close to the walls, though, the light coming from within is just enough to make the window art discernible to the casual [pc.race] on the street. You mention this to Ryn, and she nods. "Like sunlight, Lumia's love radiates to the whole city. It's reflected in the architecture, with the internal light of the temple making the window designs more easily visible from the outside, and it's also reflected in the temple's activities. Sun priestesses come out to the rest of the city to minister to the people, whether by tending to the sick and needy or just using their magic to melt snow. But just like Lumia herself, the cathedral has two roles: its love shines out to the rest of the city, but it also enfolds all who come to worship in a motherly embrace. You'll see when we go inside." Has she actually been in to worship, then? "Only a few times, and those mostly since we freed the city; as a prisoner of Alissa, all I could visit was the royal chapel," she says with a wan smile. Your feet crunch through the snow as you continue to circle the cathedral's walls. "But I've read a lot about its design and construction. Building it was one of the crowning achievements of Grandmother Athel's reign, so of course there were a lot of books about it and panegyrics to it. Now that I know what I know, I have to wonder about the people of that time. How much of what they said and did was belief? How much was fear? Even in the most effusively praising works, it was sometimes awkward for the poets and writers to discuss imported materials and a then-freshly imported goddess." Imported materials? Does she mean the glass? "It's all from Tychris," confirms Ryn as you stand beneath one depiction of an apocalyptic struggle against the wraiths and their corrupted armies in magical reds, purples, and greens. Snowflakes drift onto the panes and melt instantly on contact. "Delivered back when we still traded with the outside. Then the glasswork dried up, the Frostwood became the preserve of the druids, we turned our eyes to the north... and we found different problems to handle." She crosses her arms and sighs heavily. "We made such beautiful things with others' help." That sounds like a good reason to try to reestablish trading ties; even if there's more important things to do right now than create beautiful art, once the crisis has passed... A golden-blonde braid twists through Ryn's fingers as she thinks. "It'd be wonderful, no question. But trade only works if each party has something the other wants, and if it's worth enough to both to justify the cost of travel. [var0|If our traders could make use of the Ways Between, it'd certainly be much easier.|But it'll be a lot of hard work to make the roads and rivers safe enough to travel quickly again.] It's something to work toward when we can, but I don't want to underrate its difficulty. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |It feels like just about everything a ruler has to do is difficult. |Besides, what with everything that's been going on, it might take a long time for our people to trust outsiders again. |With you at my side, though, I know we can do it. You showed me just how much elves and outsiders can help each other. Maybe we can't be friends with everybody out there, but some ties are better than none! ]" [pc.isDK |Hmp. Well, you can't say that you're terribly interested in the Winter City's isolation, but you are interested in being compensated for fixing the problem. |You'll be sure to keep an eye out for anything that makes that burden easier. ] [etheryn.lowConfidence |"Th-thanks, [pc.name]." She exhales tiredly. "I think I'm done with politics for now. Let's j-just go inside." |Ryn gives you a little side-squeeze. "Then I'm glad I have a Champion of Winter to do that. Come on, let's go in." ] You understand what Ryn had meant about the temple's embrace as soon as you cross the threshold. Well-lit and warm despite its cavernous size, the interior feels as safe as being in a mother's arms without being cloying and uncomfortable[pc.bg acolyte |; it's the same sense of palpable divine power that you remember from your initiate days ]. There's no service going at the moment, so robed acolytes walk to and fro, cleaning the surfaces and maintaining the candle lighting. In the pews and alcoves, congregants hold quiet, private meetings with elven priestesses in gauzy, revealing clothes. You can see a few couples, [party.has azyrran | Azzy — who waves at you and Ryn cheerfully from across the sanctuary before returning to her conversation with an acolyte — ] one off-duty guardsman, and many women at varying stages of expectancy... several of whom, of course, belong to the clergy.[pc.isPregnant | You rub your own [pc.belly], more attentive than ever to the growing life inside you. Any worries you may have had about delivery and your beautiful bab[var1|y|ies]-to-be melt away like stray snowflakes in the cathedral vestibule. |[pc.hasKids | They remind you of your own child[var1||ren], bringing a sigh to your lips; whether through the goddess' power or through your own subconscious desires, you can't help but think fondly about the possibility of having another baby. |[pc.fertilityRange 4 | The sight of them all is enough to spur a powerful urge inside you, a more-than-idle dream of lovemaking, pregnancy, and holding a beautiful child in your arms.[silly | It's a case of baby rabies severe enough to make your ovaries sob. ] ] ] ] A blue-skinned priestess walks up to greet you, but she stops short, mouth open in shock, when she realizes her visitors' identity. With a placating smile, Ryn introduces you, but then [etheryn.lowConfidence |shyly |gently ] pushes her away, saying that you're just visiting and don't want to be a burden.[pc.isValk | Even so, after that little exchange you can sense the awe-struck eyes of all on your angelic wings, and hear the susurration of religious business die down to a bare whisper. For the elves in the cathedral, seeing their monarch out for a stroll with their goddess' living Champion is a religious experience all its own. ] Arm in arm, you and Ryn peek into alcoves to examine religious statuary and crane your neck up to gaze on the brightly woven tapestries. Ryn has a description for everything, from the statues of the other Six Living Gods to votive dedications in unreadable boer'alvarin script. The sweet thing's enthusiasm is infectious as she greets art she's barely seen outside a book like an old friend, and you let her carry you along as she goes, borne on the wave of her excitement about her people and what they can do.[pc.bg acolyte scholar | You add what you can from your own studies, contrasting the designs and themes of the art from similar temples elsewhere, and Ryn thrills to your tales of what southern Lumians have created for the glory of the Dawn Maiden. ] You end up in a pew, illuminated by the warm light of the immense sun icon at the altar. Firmly clasping her hands together in prayer, Ryn stares up at it with wet eyes. "For the longest time, I didn't have anybody. El and Jael'yn were... they were nice to me, but I couldn't confide in them. I couldn't share how awful I felt about everything that was happening. The only person I could share my feelings with was Lumia. For even a tiny bit of comfort..." [pc.isChamp |And, for the briefest moment, she is with you, too. MY CHILD... YOU ARE LOVED. Then the presence of awesome majesty passes through you and beyond. That was more than a tiny bit of comfort. You give Ryn a reassuring pat on the shoulder. |Hmm. Well, if that's what helps her live with herself. ] Ryn whispers something under her breath, then looks[etheryn.lowConfidence | furtively ] around the sanctuary. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |"The palace chapel is a safe place where I can be alone with her. But here I can just feel everybody watching me. All their lives depend on me, and I can't live up to that. I can't be the queen they need me to be." She exhales a dejected sigh. "Visiting this place is nice, but... but it's intense, [pc.name]. Can we go do something else now?" You think she's being a bit hard on herself, but sure, if that's what she wants. |"For a long time, all I had was the chapel. It's more personal there. It's a place where I can imagine that it's just me and Lumia, and it feels... more powerful that way. I don't know. I liked coming here, but I don't know if it'd be right for me to intrude on the rest of the city's worship. The cathedral is supposed to be for everybody, and normal elves probably don't want to think that I'm watching them even when they're trying to be closer to her." Maybe so, but Ryn worshiping alongside her people could also make them feel closer to her, as though all elves pray to the same goddess, rather than having a Lumia for royalty and a Lumia for everybody else. "That's true," she says, chewing on her lip. "Maybe there's a way I can balance those things. It's something to think about. Anyway, this was fun! What else should we do?" |"I'm going to come here more often. Not all the time, but much more frequently than Alissa used to. In the palace chapel, worship is more personal, but it's really just for the great and good. Here, I can be with everybody else." Accessibility to one's subjects is a laudable goal, but what about the majesty of her office, and suchlike things? "There's a time and place for that," Ryn says firmly. "Someone needs to govern in the palace, or nothing works; you saw what happened under my sister's rule. But as for religion? I need to be able to show my people that both they and I worship the same goddess... especially if I want us to welcome the druids into the fold." That's pretty clever, even if striking the proper balance of royal dignity and accessibility will take some thought. Still, you can't imagine the likes of Alissa ever bothering to ratiocinate to that degree. It's attention to questions like these that makes Ryn out to be a ruler with a lot of potential. The elven monarch accepts the compliment with an inclined head and a grin. "A hungry one, too. Let's get something to eat, [pc.name]." ] "

rows.original: The harsh sunlight glinting off the snowy roofs of Winter City dwellings turns dull as clouds begin to darken the sky. By the time you and Ryn reach the main market square, fat snowflakes are slowly spiraling down from above. But whereas in the south the snow'd be enough to drive pedestrians indoors, the boer'alvar pay it little mind, apart from putting the food under cover. Casual customers drift from shop to shop, tarpaulin-covered wagonloads of fish and grain roll through the square, and in the out-of-the-way spaces, you can even see children diving into the deepening snowdrifts. "Didn't I tell you it snows all the time here?" Ryn giggles. "This isn't really a big deal. Now, if it gets to be a proper blizzard... well, in that case, [etheryn.libidoRange 25 |we'll just have to go inside and warm up together, hmm? |getting under a roof would probably be best. ] But for now? Let's take a look at what's available!" She seems pretty happy about being in the marketplace. You wouldn't have really figured her for someone who likes to shop. "I'm not — well, what I mean is, it's not why I like being here. When I could get away from Alissa, this was one of the best places to just... be. I'd hang in the shadows, or near one of the side streets, and just watch people being people. I'd watch kids play in the snow, or old friends take each other out to dinner, or couples buy each other gifts. Even the arguments and the haggling over prices never seemed too mean-spirited." Sort of a way for her to live vicariously through the rest of the city? "In a way, maybe," Ryn muses. "But it was more like reassurance. Reminding myself that most people are just good people, with love in their hearts and joy on their faces. Not... monsters.[etheryn.lowConfidence | That's what I hoped, at least. ]" She shakes her head. "Anyway! Let's start over there." The 'there' in question happens to be a stand with leatherwork — with no tannery out back, thank the gods. You see soft leather messenger bags, belts, and boots, all with a sort of interwoven geometric pattern stitched, and sometimes embossed, along the edges.[pc.bg noblescion | Conspicuously, however, the river emblem of House Ridell is missing; you guess that it's probably restricted to the livery of royal guards and other such servants of the crown. ] It's all good leather, if not quite up to the standards of, say, Alissa's armor. Actually, come to think of it, none of the gear here seems to be particularly martial in nature. Ryn looks up from the water-skin she's examining. "It wouldn't be. Apart from the royal guards and the aristocracy's retinues, there's not much call for leather armor in the Winter City. It's not like we have an endless stream of thugs, soldiers of fortune, and mercenary companies passing through the city like in Hawkethorne or Tychris; from what I've seen, hardly anyone south of the river even knows we exist. So without public demand, the military tanners and armorers just deal directly with their buyers rather than setting up shop in the marketplace. Even poorer huntresses usually skin their kills themselves and work one-on-one with a tanner." In an actual city, unlike underdeveloped little Hawkethorne, it'd make sense for merchants to specialize more. And for someone who produces gear for combat, you could see how it'd be less than profitable to open a premises on the square[pc.bg slumrat |, especially if they have a problem with light-fingered people like... well, like you, for one, but let that go ]. Does she think that'll change if the city opens up to outsiders more? "Probably. It's not really a good or bad thing, it just is — at least for the moment." She hefts the water-skin. "I think I'll get this. It'll be good to have a replacement in case my old one gets damaged in a fight." A fine purchase indeed. You wonder, though, if there are any places to get clothes rather than just accessories. "Sure! There's one down this way." [flags.RYN_MARKET |Telfir, the seamster, waves the usual cheerful greeting at you. [flags.WC_BALL|Ever since you showed off his outfit at the ball, he's apparently had quite the uptick in business, and as a result he's happy to let you and Ryn idly try on clothes even if you don't intend to buy.|Your outfit's not quite ready yet, but that's okay: the real reason you're here is to try on clothes.] [etheryn.lowConfidence |Putting Ryn in dresses is enough to make the normally-shy elf perk up, so that's where you start, sorting through different styles to properly suit her. Whether from your encouragement or from the excitement of trying on new outfits, a smile slowly spreads across her face, and by the time she actually gets into one, she's happy enough to do little spins for you to show off. |Ryn goes straight for the dresses, asking for your opinion about each one; when she tries them on, she twirls and preens for you, soaking up your approval. You work together to make sure her hair is perfect as she tries pose after pose in the lovely outfits, and eventually, she alights on one, [rand |a frilly, poofy thing suited for an outrageous social debut |a slinky backless v-neck that [etheryn.breastRange C |offers an eyeful of her lush cleavage |she wears with poise ] |a deep blue gown that brings out her eyes with some sort of magical weave that glitters with starlight |an off-the-shoulder dress with a leg cut that the newly confident beauty inhabits perfectly ]. ] But eventually it's your turn to shine. [pc.mf |Ryn fusses over your outfit, insisting on the absolute best look for her dashing Champion. Eventually, you settle on something appropriate, and once you try it on, she fawns over you, posing together as if you were attending a royal ball. |As usual, Ryn insists on putting you in a dress, and after careful consideration you select a daring, eye-catching outfit that'd have everyone in a southern court utterly besotted[etheryn.highConfidence | — and one with a style and color that aligns perfectly with hers ]. When you emerge from behind the screen, she greets you with her usual enthusiasm, suggesting poses[pc.hasHair |, adjusting fit, and fiddling with your [pc.hair] to try different looks. | and adjusting fit to give you something that presents just right. ] ] The two of you look amazing together in your formal duds, and it's with great reluctance that you finally return to your everyday outfits and bid farewell to the shopkeep: until next time. |The seamster's is an actual building rather than a stand, decorated well enough to imply at least something of a well-off clientele, and[etheryn.lowConfidence | fortunately for your shy elven companion, ] it's empty of anyone save the proprietor — which means that, after the usual effusive greeting, it isn't too hard to steer him toward business. After a critical look at both you and Ryn, he pulls out a widely-varied array of outfit types to help you narrow things down. Elven outerwear, from what you can see, tends toward two extremes. Many of the garments reflect the boreal elves' indifference to cold: soft leather that leaves a great deal of skin exposed, the sheerest of silks, and so on.[pc.bg courtesan | Some of them aren't even that different in style from what you used to wear as an escort. ] But even ignoring the cold, the frozen north is still quite the hardy environment, and some of the other outfits the seamster lays out are sturdy traveling clothes and work outfits that wouldn't really be that amiss elsewhere in the Frost Marches.[kiyoko.isFree |Although many of the clothes are either undyed or in relatively muted colors, one garish orange cape brings to mind your beloved Kiyoko. Missing the feel of her divine fluff, you finger the bright twill... but, of course, it isn't the same. Sadly, she can't come out into the Winter City, not without you there to chaperone her, and that would've turned this little date into something else entirely. Even though she'd probably disavow any special claim on your time — "I don't wish to monopolize you, beloved" — you still feel a little guilty about not having her out with you. You'll have to think of some way to make it up to her the next time you see her. ] [pc.mf |Ryn breaks into your thoughts with a cough. "You know, [pc.name], it would probably be a good idea for us to get you fixed up with some formal wear — you know, for court functions [flags.WC_BALL|like the Festivus Ball. I like your outfit now, but it would've been really lovely to have you in some proper elven formal wear.| and all, in case you have to attend any of them as my Champion]." That's a pretty good idea. You and the proprietor work together to select something that looks appropriate. The eventual choice is relatively light and airy, smart without being quite so ornate as some of the fancier clothes down south. Not being born a boreal elf yourself, you'll probably have to add a cloak to keep warm in the Palace of Ice or wherever else these social functions might happen, but with the right color coordination, even that could work out quite well. You duck behind a screen to try it on, and when you emerge, the seamster goes over you with a fine-toothed comb, asking about adjustments, fit, and feel as Ryn looks on approvingly. Once everything's noted down, you strip off the outfit and put on your [pc.armor], letting Ryn hash out the price. Before you leave, though... this establishment wouldn't happen to deal in anything other than outerwear, would it? [etheryn.highLibido |"You mean intimates? For Her [etheryn.crowned |Majesty |Highness ]? Sure, easy peasy. I mean, it'll take a little longer to source some materials appropriate for you, Your Worship, but we can absolutely handle the job." Ryn giggles. "[flags.ETHERYN_PANTIES |You're building quite the collection for me, [pc.name]. |Oooh, thank you, [pc.name]. ] I can't wait to show them off for you..." Well, you do want her to be at least a little surprised. You'll have to visit the seamster's on your own sometime later to go over the details. "That works for me, Champion," he says easily. Your elven lover's still giggling as you walk her back out into the snow, all aglow at the thought of getting to look feminine and sexy for you. |Ryn's eyes bug out at you. "[pc.name]![etheryn.lowLibido | N-not in front of... ]" "Oh, absolutely, we can do intimates," the seamster says smoothly. What a professional. "Might take a little while to make something fit for a queen, but I'm sure we can manage." Outstanding. You'll be in touch later to talk about the details... in private. "Sure, sure." You thank the proprietor and guide Ryn back out into the square. ] |[etheryn.highConfidence |Ryn clears her throat. "If you had to pick a formal dress to wear at a court function[flags.WC_BALL| like the Festivus Ball], [pc.name], what would you choose? And yes, it has to be a dress," she adds sheepishly. "I can bend a lot of our traditions, but not all of them." [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |Ooh! You know exactly what would work; you've had to dress for the high and mighty plenty of times before, after all. You sort through the clothes on the counter, searching for what you'd noticed earlier, and eventually pull out a sheer dress on clean lines, with just enough ostentation to fit the aesthetic of the elven court without going too far overboard into absurdity. From the impressed looks on the two boreal elves' faces, you know you chose well. |A court function? You? W-why would you need to...? "Because you're my Champion, of course! You'll need an outfit appropriate to your station." Okay, but you don't know the first thing about fancy dress! Or the second, or... "Well, let's see if we can figure something out between the three of us." Ryn and the seamster walk you through the rudiments of lines, shape, comfort, and color selection, illustrating their points with outfits from the shop's back room. Eventually, with their help, you alight on something gorgeous that, before you turned to adventuring, would've cost more than you'd have made in a year. ] Satisfied with the selection, you head behind a screen to try it on. As you remove your [pc.armor], you can't help but overhear little quiet snippets of conversation in the boreal elves' native tongue. That distraction aside, though, it's not too difficult to slip into the dress. The two elves ooh and aah when you emerge, and met by compliments like those, you can't help but do a little twirl to show off your new look. Then they swarm all over you, measuring and adjusting, asking your opinion about colors and fit, and interweaving compliments about how lovely you are. A blush warms your cheeks as they flatter you; the praise of a [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess ] is enough to make you feel like the prettiest [pc.boyGirl] ever. Eventually, the details are ironed out and the proprietor has the adjustments to send on to the tailors. You re-dress, leave him the outfit and a bagful of hawks, and wave as you walk out the door, arm in arm with Ryn. "I can't wait until it's done, [pc.name]!" she gushes. "It's going to look so amazing on you..." Awww! You have her to thank for her help. By the way, what was she talking about back there? Something in boer'alvarin? "It's a surprise. Forget you heard anything!" [pc.cunningRange 40 |Wait, what other clothing could she have been... wait... R-RYN! She's inordinately pleased with herself. "I know you're going to look [pc.mascFem |stunning |gorgeous ] in it, [pc.name]. Just, um, pretend to be surprised, okay?" Despite the falling snow and the frigid air, you feel incredibly warm. |You affect a gentle smile. [silly |All right then, she can keep her secrets. |Well, whatever it is, you can't wait. ] ] |"[pc.name]?" Ryn looks a little flushed. "What do you think of that dress?" What, this one? Well, it's — "C-could you keep looking at it? For, um, for a while?" Okay... Ryn hesitantly taps the counter and asks the proprietor something in quiet boer'alvarin. He leans in inquisitively and she repeats herself, a little louder and more intelligibly, and then the two of them start up a quick, staccato series of questions and responses, punctuated by several glances at, well, you. An embarrassed smile spreads across your face as you pretend to look at the dress Ryn mentioned, but otherwise, you try not to intervene in the awkward conversation. Once they're done, though, you turn back to them — Ryn sporting a deep, scarlet blush while the seamster grins smugly — and ask what that was all about. The waifish elf stammers, "It's... um... it's a s-surprise." [pc.cunningRange 40 |Is that so? Well, you know you're going to love showing it off for — er, that is, you can't wait to see what it is. |Well, whatever it is, you know you're going to love it. ] Ryn's blush creeps up the length of her long elven ears. She musters a "y-yeah", nervously tapping her fingers against each other. "D-do you like that dress, too?" It does look very nice, but you'll need to try it on and compare it with other dresses, of course. Why does she ask? "Well, if you're the Champion of Winter, you should probably have formal wear... you know, so you can be dressed for [flags.WC_BALL|fancy things like the Festivus Ball|negotiations, court functions, and things]. If you like it, we could get something for you now." Aha. Well, that sounds like a lot of fun! You, Ryn, and the seamster sort through the dresses, trying on a few and discussing adjustments and color. Eventually, you settle on an appropriate one, along with the necessary modifications. Ryn passes a bag of hawks to the smiling proprietor, and awkwardly marches you back out into the square. ] ] ] Moving from stand to stand, you notice that there's a remarkable amount of high-quality stone- and metalwork on offer. Even elves that don't look particularly well-off at least have artistic brooches for their cloaks, intricate bracelets, rings, and ear-studs. There's plenty of decoration about, if not finery.[pc.bg arcanist | Many of them even seem to be minor magical foci, cheap means to make spellcasting easier for the average elf. ] "That's right," says Ryn as she fingers her own falcon pendant. "A brooch, pendant, or belt buckle can be a symbol of office or affinity for people, even if they're not in the nobility... but we often just wear them because we like the design. Sometimes they have a little history behind them, too! Take a look at this one." She gestures to a large, disc-shaped brooch with a hole in the middle and a fastening pin. "This is a quoit clasp, called that way because of the shape — quoits are like rings or hoops, you know. See how there are little designs of game animals facing each other in pairs around the outer edges? This used to be a huntress's brooch style, but then it just kind of... got popular. People really ate it up during Alissa's reign; she didn't care much for Lumia, not like Grandmother did, but she loved to show off her hunting prowess, so fashion took a cue from that instead. Now pretty much anybody can wear huntress styles." [silly |Brooches, she says? It strikes you that having an extra inventory slot for something with such obvious cultural and sartorial value would be quite nice. "Hey, stop it," she says plaintively. "There aren't going to be any more changes to the inventory system. Just leave it be. Besides, Hirrud Grune's cloak already has a brooch." Fine, fine. |Beautiful and useful without being ostentatious, the quoit brooch is certainly a fine example of craftsmanship[pc.bg soldier |, far prettier than the sorts of cloak-fasteners that officers in your old outfit used to wear ]. It's also the kind of thing that'd make a lovely gift. You make a mental note to see about getting Ryn a cloak fit for a queen, along with a House Ridell river clasp or Lumian sun brooch. ] Fingernail-sized flakes keep falling as you stroll over to a smithy further down the way. As with the leatherworker's, it doesn't look like there are many implements of war on offer. Just like Ogrish[flags.JEN_OGRISH_TS | — before the arrival of the Marked Merks, anyway — |, ] the well-muscled elf-maiden sweating away at her forge mostly has everyday tools available for sale: bronze nails, hammers, and so on. The amazonian bronzesmith puts on a real spectacle for the small crowd outside, exaggerating the movements of her glistening arms to throw real power into her hammerblows as she shapes a large cauldron. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |A sudden bump at your side jolts you out of your appreciation of the scene. It's Ryn, tugging on your arm insistently. "[pc.name], can we... can we move on? It feels like people are noticing us." Briefly scanning the crowd doesn't turn up anything in particular. It's probably just her nerves. "N-no — just, can we please get out of here? Everybody's staring at me. Look at the little boy over there." You finally notice a small blue-skinned elf-child, one hand holding onto his inattentive father, whose eyes keep sliding between the hardworking smith and Ryn. He's just a kid — why doesn't she say hi to him? Press the flesh and all that? "I can't, [pc.name]," she whines. "P-please." Okay, then. You wrap your arm around her shoulder and guide her out of the crowd. None of the other elves turn their heads. Ryn beelines for an alleyway between two shops, apparently a favorite hiding place from back when she'd been running from Alissa. Once you're both safely ensconced in the shadows, she gloms onto you in an embarrassed hug, sniffling into your [pc.armor]. Hey, now. You give her a pat on the head and hold her closer. It's okay. "[pc.name], I couldn't... I couldn't even look at them..." It was a lot of people to deal with at once. She's... well, she's definitely going to have to get a better handle on that if she's going to be a good queen. Maybe baby steps would be best. Besides, before that happened, your trip to the marketplace had been going great! You really enjoyed wandering the shops with her. Maybe the rest of it'll be easier next time. "O-okay," she sniffs. "I thought... well, I thought that it was fun, too... at least for awhile." There, there. How's about taking a few moments to catch her breath, and then going to find some food? A tasty snack will make everything right as rain. Ryn swallows and nods. "That sounds good, [pc.name]. Thank you." |"She's really putting on a show, isn't she?" comes the murmur at your shoulder. Indeed. It's an interesting blend, raw power with just a touch of finesse. You suppose elven amazons have that reputation, though, even when they aren't huntresses. "Yeah..." Something wrong? When she doesn't answer, you turn, to see Ryn looking awkwardly at a young boy a few paces away, holding tightly to his father's hand. While everybody else's eyes are on the smith, the boy's looking at Ryn with the sort of wide-eyed stare usually reserved for Living Gods or particularly exotic insects. Cautiously, she raises a hand and daintily waggles her fingers at him; just as cautiously, he raises his unoccupied hand and waves. Then, with a shy smile, Ryn raises her finger to her lips, and once again, the little kiddo imitates her. Finally, they exchange farewell waves before Ryn takes your arm and steers you out of the crowd. What was that all about? "I didn't want to make a big scene," she says bashfully. "But... you know... it was kind of cute to be able to say hi." After a fashion, anyway. If she keeps up with this queen thing, she'll need to do a lot more meeting and greeting than just that. "You mean, with the negotiations and everything? Yes, I know. But being the center of attention in a crowd really isn't my style." Ryn grimaces ruefully. "Well, not yet." Center of attention or no, you certainly enjoyed wandering the marketplace with her. Ryn opens her mouth to respond, but a low rumble from her tummy interrupts her. "Um. Well! I had fun, too, but I think it's probably a good time to get something to eat." You couldn't agree more. |[flags.RYN_MARKET |The pair of you see little Del and his dad Findis in the mass of spectating elves, and you wave them out of the crowd for a little small talk. Now that the kiddo's familiar with you, he's happy to open up about all kinds of things, chattering about the new hammer the smith's using, and how he's learning to read, and how much hard work it was to dig their way out of the house after the last big snowfall. Then, he insists on playing "I Spy" with you, and the four of you pass several minutes finding the things that the eagle-eyed boy notices in the marketplace. When it comes to your turn, all the elves laugh hysterically when you inform them that you spy with your little eye something... white. When it finally comes time for you to part ways, Ryn makes sure to give the little guy a big ol' hug before leaving. As you walk off in the direction of some food, you give her a little nudge. She really likes spending time with kids, huh? "Yeah," she says dreamily, as her eyes mist over a little. "Kids — everyone's kids — deserve all the love you can give them." She blinks a few times. "A-anyway. Let's go get some food." |Ryn, however, is a bit distracted from the show; a few feet away, a little elf-boy — looking as young as five, not that that means the same thing to the boer'alvar — stares at her as he holds his father's hand. "Hey, there, little guy," she murmurs, leaning down with her hands on her knees. "What's your name?" Both the blue-skinned kiddo and his father have eyes the size of dinner plates now, but instead of making a scene, the dad nudges his son. "Can you tell the... nice lady your name?" The son shakes his head mutely, eyes still locked on Ryn, and the father lets out a tolerant sigh. "His name's Del, m... ma'am. Delanel." And he himself is...? "Findis, ma'am. It's, ah, it's an honor." "It's okay to be shy, Del," Ryn offers. "I used to be extra-shy, too." She glances over at the smith meaningfully. "Do you like watching her work?" Del nods silently. "Every time we have to buy from here," his father adds, "he'll just stand and watch her as long as he can. You want to try it for yourself, don't you, kiddo?" That gets a nervous, jerky nod from Del. As a parent, how does he feel about that? Findis grins. "Smithing's better than what I do for a living." "It's a pretty good job," Ryn agrees. "I know [flags.RAGS_MET |a few orcs who're really good at it. Just like this lady, they're big and strong, they love what they do, and you're going to have to work hard to be just like them! |an orcish smith who's really good at it. He's a little small for an orc, but he really gives it his all. If you work as hard as he does, you'll turn out to be a great smith, too! ]" She kneels down in front of Del and gently touches his arm. "And when you do, maybe you can sell what you make to me or my children. How does that sound?" Little Del smiles despite himself as he nods vigorously. "Thanks for that," his father says. "I... um, Your —" Ryn straightens up and lifts a coy finger to her lip. "You don't have to say anything. Thank you... thank you both. Lumia bless you. Come on, [pc.name]." After a few dozen feet of walking, she blows out the breath she was holding. "Gods, that was hard." Maybe so, but it was also pretty awesome. "Thanks. I don't know if I have the energy to do that with everyone I meet — at least, not yet — but yeah. It was good." She wipes a thin layer of sweat off her brow. By the way, what was that about her children? [pc.hasVag |"W-what?" Ryn jumps slightly, her mask of composure slipping. "I just — I — I mean, queens have to — and you —" She swallows. "Uh, l-let's just get something to eat." |"I wouldn't be a very good queen if I didn't have heirs," Ryn says evenly. "But they're a long way off. Anyway, I don't know about you, but I'm pretty hungry. Let's see if we can find some food." ] ] ]
rows.translation: 当云层开始笼罩天空时，冬城房屋屋顶上反射的刺眼阳光也变得暗淡起来。当你和小琳来到主市场广场时，厚厚的雪花正缓缓从天而降。但在南方，大雪足以迫使行人躲进室内；而在那些高原地区，人们却对此毫不在意，只不过会把食物妥善地藏起来而已。偶尔会有顾客穿梭于各家商店之间，装在防水布覆盖的货车上运来的鱼和粮食会经过广场，而在那些人迹罕至的地方，你甚至可以看到孩子们跳进越来越深的雪堆里玩耍。 我不是告诉过你这里经常下雪吗？”小琳笑着说，“其实这没什么大不了的。不过，如果真的下起了暴风雪……嗯，那样的话就另当别论了。 [etheryn.libidoRange 25 |我们只好一起进去暖和一下吧，嗯？ |最好还是住在一起吧。 ]但就目前来说呢？让我们先看看有哪些选择吧！” 她似乎对能够参与这个市场活动感到非常开心。你真很难想象她竟然会是一个喜欢购物的人。 “其实并不是因为购物……我的意思是，这并不是我喜欢来到这里的原因。每当我能摆脱艾莉莎的纠缠时，这里就是最适合让我安静地待着的地方之一。我会躲在阴影里，或者站在那些小街旁，静静观察人们过着自己的生活。我会看着孩子们在雪地里玩耍，看着老朋友们一起出去吃晚餐，也会看着情侣们互相赠送礼物。即使是那些争论和关于价格的讨价还价，也似乎从未带有恶意。” “对她来说，这或许是一种间接的方式，让她能够体验这座城市里其他人的生活吧？” “从某种意义上说，也许吧，”小琳沉思道，“但更像是一种安慰。提醒自己，大多数人都是善良的人，他们心中充满爱，脸上洋溢着欢乐。而不是……怪物。[etheryn.lowConfidence | 至少，这也是我所希望的。 ]她摇了摇头，说道：“不管怎样，我们还是从那边开始吧。” 所说的“那边”，实际上是一个出售皮革制品的摊位——谢天谢地，后面并没有制革厂。在那里，你可以看到各种柔软的皮革制品：信使包、腰带和靴子，这些产品的边缘都缝有或雕刻着某种几何图案。[pc.bg noblescion | 然而，值得注意的是，里德尔家族的河流标志并没有出现；想必这种标志只限于皇家卫队以及其他为王室服务的队伍使用吧。
