All told, you've got a pair of ceramic cups with some kind of weird-smelling liquor in them, plus the herring, with bread, butter, and a hard cheese on the side. |but Ryn's still feeling a bit skittish. While she quietly keeps your table in an out-of-the-way corner, you brave the line, sandwiched between boisterous frost elves with a middling command of heavily-accented Belharan. At one point, you make the mistake of actually introducing yourself, and end up buried in a sea of backslapping amazons and elf-men, all calling out "Shampion!" and raving in boer'alvarin about... well, probably about whatever rumors have made it into the city since your battle in the Palace. It takes several minutes for you to finally reach the half-sexed vendor, who leans on her wooden counter with a faintly amused expression on her face, and negotiate for a meal of bread, butter, cheese, herring, and some very cheap liquor. ] Ryn perks up once you're safely ensconced in the corner with your food. "Okay! First comes the liquor. Now, you don't want to shoot this." Really? It's in the right kind of little cup and everything. "No, don't! We sip it slowly, over the course of the meal." She raises her cup to yours. "[silly |Skål! |Tal'asha! ]" The liquor's — oof, it's fucking hard, but not bad-tasting; weirdly, it reminds you of elven bread. Then, at Ryn's recommendation, you taste a fragment of the herring. It's firm, easy to bite through, with a sort of vinegary taste. As fish, it's pretty good, not too overwhelming, and extremely salty. Ryn beams to see your smile of approval as you chew, and pushes more ingredients at you, mixing and sequencing the bread, butter, liquor, and cheese to push your tongue into a whirlwind of new taste sensations. Your dinnermate keeps pace with you in both food and drink, but she starts developing a rosy blush before her liquor cup's halfway gone, and you can't help but bring it up. At first, Ryn's eyes widen, but then she lets out a delayed "Whaaaaaat? Noooooooo!" that she only barely finishes before collapsing into helpless giggles. When they subside, she continues, "[pc.name], I grew up in the palace. I don't drink much hard liquor." And when she does, she doesn't drink much. She leans forward. "Right." So all that stuff about sipping it slowly... "It's true! It tastes better this way. Well, it tastes... something." Okay. Well, if that's the case, she's going to need to have a little more bread. "Yes!" Some time later, you and Ryn lean against the back wall of the establishment, gazing idly at your empty plates. The highlights of a commoner's meal are that it must be cheap and filling, and this herring serviced both ambitions quite nicely. Happy with your choice, you sit back, rub your [pc.belly], and sip from your waterskin to wash out some of the taste of fish and liquor. Ryn, slightly less flushed than before, yawns and stretches in her seat. "I... I... aaahhhhmmm. I told you it was good, right?" she mumbles sleepily. She certainly did, and she was completely right. As far as [flags.RYN_FISH|boer'alvarin|new] foods go, this one hit the mark, and it made for a lovely capstone to your fun trip to the city. "I'm glad you think so. You're the one who makes it all special, you know. For me." What an astonishing coincidence. You were about to say the exact same thing. "Well," she says, "that makes me happy, too." [etheryn.highConfidence |With that, her lips meet yours in a tender, drawn-out kiss. |Shy though she normally is, Ryn's buzzed enough to lean over and give you a quick, unprompted peck on the cheek. ] When she pulls away, she notices your unfocused eyes and frowns. "Something wrong, [pc.name]?" No, nothing.[pc.isChamp | Nothing could ever be wrong. ] That was just the right way to end this little trip. It's just that... given her current semi-ebriated state, Her [etheryn.crowned|Majesty|Highness] is probably going to need a steadfast and doughty escort back to the palace. "Mmm, I will," she agrees. "I think that my Champion would be perfect for that role.[etheryn.libidoRange 25 | Maybe I should even reward [pc.himHer] for [pc.hisHer] help when we return..." [pc.isBimbo |Ooooh, does that mean cummies? You'll work extra-extra-hard for those! |You promise to take that under very serious consideration. ] [party.has quin |You and Ryn manage to keep to a more or less straight path as you make your way out of the fish market and back toward the palace, but you're still unsteady enough for others to notice — like Quin, relaxing with his book by the fountain. The bunny-boy chuckles and shakes his head, throwing you an approving thumbs-up before returning to his reading. |The walk back passes uneventfully, apart from the both of you getting your sea legs back; it hadn't really been that much alcohol, after all. You weren't drunk. You were just tipsy. Weren't you? ] As you walk arm in arm, you ponder whether to call it a day here or to abscond with your [etheryn.crowned|queen|princess] to her chambers, and by the time you reach the throne room, you have an answer. |" She rises, more or less steadily, and holds out her hand for you. Still feeling the effects of the booze, you shakily make your way out of the fish market.[party.has quin | Naturally, Quin happens to be relaxing with his book near the fountain and sees you and Ryn as you push through the plaza crowd on rubbery legs; he laughs knowingly and throws you a joking salute before returning to his reading. ] You both manage to regain your equilibrium on the walk back to the palace, and as you do, you consider whether your little date has to be quite over just yet. You're sure that Ryn wouldn't mind a more, ah, explosive ending to your little meet-cute. Should you bring it up when you return to the throne room? ]
rows.translation: 冬城的日常捕捞物散发出的恶臭令你的鼻孔不由得收缩。在巨大的市场广场上，有一整个区域专门用来售卖海产食品：那些声音嘶哑的拖网渔民们正在向那些正在为晚餐寻找食材的精灵们兜售各种各样可以想象得到的鱼类。你和小琳穿梭在人群之中，寻找那些准备得更周全的食物，但当你们经过那里时，却发现了鱼市另一个重要的功能：八卦。虽然“鱼妇”这个称呼听起来有些夸张——但在冬城，实际上有一半甚至更多的“鱼妇”其实是“鱼夫”，而剩下的那些也很多是半性人——但当你看到精灵们闲闲地排着队，喋喋不休地谈论着他们的邻居、价格、德鲁伊，以及最近发生的政治动荡时，这个称呼似乎再合适不过了。 在鱼贩们喧闹的叫卖声以及顾客们热闹的讨论声中，根本没有人注意到你们两个。然而，小琳却肯定注意到了。他们你可以看到，每当她听到一些政治讨论的内容时，她的耳朵就会不停地抽动。 [etheryn.lowConfidence |听到自己的行为受到如此严厉的审视，这个可怜的女孩顿时面红耳赤。不过，就你目前所了解的情况来看，似乎还没有人对她执政期间的表现提出过过于激烈的批评。 |她聚精会神地皱着眉头，试图从这些零星的对话中获取尽可能多的政治情报。 ]但尽管市场上有各种议论，你依然保持着快速的节奏，尽量避免引起公众的注意。 [party.has cait |事实上，唯一那个……的人就是做你注意到，那是凯特，她正站在一辆堆满新鲜捕获的鳕鱼的马车另一边，兴奋地挥手向你招手。你和小琳绕到马车旁边，找了个相对私密的地方，而就在你们刚站定的时候，这位“小猫女祭司”立刻给了你们两个一个热情的拥抱。 [flags.RYN_CAIT_FISH |见到你们真是太好了！”她兴奋地叫道，“哦，你们绝对不能让我一个人待在这个鱼市场里，实在太可怕了！我尝了一些鲱鱼……还有那些熏制食品……还有那些发酵过的鲨鱼肉……哦，马拉克，要是在用精灵的方式准备鱼不需要花费这么长时间的话，我就可以经常自己做了！” 嗯，那些北方精灵商人肯定很乐意接受她的订单。如果她继续留在那里，他们甚至可能会开始给她打折。 小猫娇媚地眨了眨眼睛，然后把手放在胸口，假装愤怒地说：“我真不知道你在说什么……那可太…………滥用我的神职权力，[pc.name]你的意思是希望她能成为回头客，但如果她真的想往那个方向发展的话……” “哦，对。”凯特清了清嗓子，继续说道：“总之，那次浪漫的约会进行得怎么样？ |哦，马拉克，我从来不知道你拥有这么多鱼就这里吧！”她开心地笑道，“我也许会留在这里，再也不回到鹰棘镇去了。这里简直就像我家乡贾西拉的市场一样！我真没想到你这么喜欢！”小琳笑着说，“我们为自己准备鱼的各种方法感到非常自豪。你尝过我们用肉末、鸡蛋、面粉和牛奶做的那些小球吗？” 凯特点了点头：“嗯，那些小球搭配虾一起吃，味道真的很不错。太棒了哦，如果你喜欢这些做法，那你一定会爱上我们用来处理鱼的其他所有方法！我们有将鱼发酵后再晾晒数月的做法，也有把鱼埋在土里的方法，还有用盐腌制、泡酸的方法—— 腌鱼！”你的猫娘朋友抓住小琳的肩膀，坚决地说道：“绝对不行。” “是啊，我们经常会腌制很多鱼，尤其是鲱鱼。这是我最喜欢的食物之一，尤其是当它配上这种美味的腌料时。你没闻到吗？” “嗯……”凯特咬了咬嘴唇。[var0|好吧，你说服我了——其实这也并不难嘛！毕竟，我还有很多空间呢。|我其实不应该这样，但我对那些鱼腥味重的菜肴实在毫无抵抗力……我得看看能不能找到卖这种菜的地方。只是为了，嗯，将来能有机会尝尝而已！]不过，关于我自己的事情就说到这里吧。你们那次重要的约会进行得怎么样了？ ] [etheryn.lnhConfidence |小琳害羞地笑了：“这……这是我很长时间以来最开心的事情了。” “哇，真好啊！真是太贴心了。 |太好了！真是太放松了。”你的精灵伙伴开心地笑着说，“我们正在创造一些美好的回忆呢。” “嘻嘻，你们俩真是太可爱了。我很高兴一切进展得这么顺利。 |[etheryn.libidoRange 50 |小琳没有做出任何回应。 [pc.heightRange 70 |跳进你的怀里，然后直接在你脸上亲了一个大大的吻。[pc.lipsChaste]让你将她高高举在空中几秒钟，然后她又会重新落回地面。 |他倾身过来，深深地吻了你，这个吻持续了很长时间，直到你们中的任何一方忍不住想要停止，然后他才带着自豪的微笑转向凯特。 ] |你和小琳对视了一眼，那种眼神充满了深意。“这……真是太神奇了，”她温暖地说道，“能有这样一位[pc.manWoman]相伴，和[pc.himHer]共度时光，我真是太幸运了。”她让这些时刻对你们两个人来说都变得如此美好。你们一定会永远珍视与她共度的这些时光。 ] 凯特开心地拍手说道：“你们两个真是最浪漫的笨蛋了，我爱就是它！ ]不管怎样，别管我啦！”那只漂亮的猫咪边转身离开边朝他们挥了挥手，“你们继续玩得开心吧，回头见！ |当你继续前行时，鱼腥味变得愈发浓烈，为了转移注意力，你转向了小琳，问道：“这些鱼都是从哪里来的？哪一种看起来比较好吃呢？” “这里的鱼确实非常多，不是吗？对每个精灵来说，鱼都是常见的食物——它既丰富又便宜。我知道我们这里并不紧靠大海，但距离也不算太远。而且这里的天气足够寒冷，因此鱼可以在被捕捞后一直保持新鲜，直到被运送到市场。至于鱼的种类呢？几乎有你能想象到的所有种类！我们有鳕鱼、黑线鳕、鲱鱼、三文鱼、狭鳕、鳕鱼苗，还有各种贝类和甲壳类动物…… 你明白的。在这样寒冷的气候条件下，鱼类自然会成为人们饮食中的主要组成部分。对于极北精灵来说，他们根本没有足够的空间来饲养大量的牲畜，也没有可能种植广阔的谷物田地。 没错！我们可以在霜木边缘种植一些耐寒的黑麦和大麦——那些就是制作面包的材料——但在这个地区，主要依靠的是猎物和鱼类。因此，我们在烹饪方法上必须发挥创造力。我们把它发酵，把它埋在土里，把它挂起来晾上几个月，用它来包饺子，给它加盐……而我最喜欢的方法就是：把它腌制起来！”小琳半闭着她那双蓝宝石般的眼睛说道，“嗯……现在我真的很想吃一些腌鲱鱼啊……" 这真是个发自内心的推荐。那么，谁做的腌鲱鱼最好吃呢？ “我完全不知道！”她笑着说，“让我们一起去弄清楚吧。 ] 冬城的那些与世隔绝的精灵们，吸引的游客数量实在太少，因此那些客栈根本无法盈利。不过，他们还是有一些类似于普通人类的设施：比如室内酒馆，这些酒馆为市场广场周围的城市劳动者提供便宜的食物，同时也为他们提供避风挡雪的场所，帮助他们度过最猛烈的暴风雪。[flags.RYN_FISH| 你选择了与上次不同的地点，这并非因为不满意之前的选择，而是因为你一直在寻找这座城市里最棒的鲱鱼餐厅。]随着降雪量减少，这个地方的顾客数量也有所减少。 [etheryn.highConfidence |但当你们俩排队点餐时，还是引起了一阵骚动，小琳立刻被那些五颜六色的顾客围住了。由于你们不得不不断地安抚他们、道谢，过了好几分钟，你们才终于买到了食物，然后找了一个安静的角落开始品尝。最后，你们得到的是两个陶瓷杯，里面装着某种味道奇怪的酒，还有鲱鱼，以及面包、黄油和一块硬奶酪作为配菜。 |但小琳仍然感到有些紧张不安。当她悄悄地将你的桌子摆在一个僻静的角落时，你却勇敢地排起了队，站在那些说着带有浓重贝拉兰口音的吵闹的霜之精灵中间。有那么一刻，你犯了一个错误——竟然主动介绍了自己，结果立刻被一群亚马逊女战士和精灵男们围住，他们纷纷喊着：“冠军！他们在布尔阿尔瓦林大街上议论纷纷，谈论的……嗯，大概就是自从你在宫殿里那场战斗之后传到城里的那些谣言吧。过了好几分钟，你终于找到了那个半男半女的商人。她靠在木制柜台上，脸上带着一丝略带笑意的表情，你与她协商后，买到了面包、黄油、奶酪、鲱鱼，还有一些非常便宜的酒。 ] 一旦你安全地躲在角落里，拿着食物，小琳立刻变得活跃起来。“好了！首先来喝这种酒。不过，你可不能直接喝下去哦。” 真的吗？它本来就是装在那种小杯子里的啊。 “不行，不能直接喝！我们得在吃饭的过程中慢慢品尝。”她把她的杯子举到你的杯子旁边。[silly |干杯！ |塔拉莎！ ]这酒啊——哎呀，真是太辣了困难虽然味道有些奇特，但并不难吃；奇怪的是，它让人联想到精灵面包的味道。在小琳的建议下，你尝了尝那条鲱鱼的一小块。它的肉质紧实，很容易咬碎，带有一种酸味。作为鱼类来说，它的味道还算不错，不会过于浓烈，而且盐分含量极高。当你咀嚼食物时，小琳看到你满意的笑容，便又往你面前推了些食材，将面包、黄油、酒和奶酪巧妙地搭配在一起，让你的舌头体验到一系列全新的味觉享受。 你的晚餐伙伴在进食和饮酒方面始终与你保持同步，但她的酒杯才喝到一半，脸上就已经泛起了红晕，你忍不住提到了这件事。起初，小琳的眼睛瞪得大大的，但随后她迟疑着喊出了“什么？不——！”这句话，说完后便忍不住放声大笑起来。等笑声平息后，她继续说道：[pc.name]，我在宫殿里长大的，所以我不太喝烈酒。 而且就算喝，也不会喝很多。 她向前倾了倾身子：“没错。” 所以那些关于要慢慢品尝的说法…… “都是真的！这样尝起来确实更好。嗯，味道……有点特别。 好吧，如果真是这样的话，她就需要再吃一点面包了。 “没错！” 过了一会儿，你和小琳靠在店里的后墙上，漫不经心地望着自己空荡荡的盘子。对于一个普通人来说，一顿饭最关键的就是要便宜且能填饱肚子，而这种鲱鱼正好满足了这两个要求。你对自己的选择感到满意，于是坐下来，揉了揉肚子[pc.belly]然后喝点水来冲掉口中残留的鱼腥味和酒味。 小琳的脸色已经没有之前那么红了，她打了个哈欠，在座位上伸了个懒腰。“我……我……啊……我说过这东西很好吃吧？”她困倦地嘟囔道。 她确实这么说过，而且她的评价完全正确。作为一道[flags.RYN_FISH|布尔阿尔瓦林|新尝试的]食物，它确实美味，为你们这次愉快的城市之旅画上了圆满的句号。 “我很高兴你这么认为。你知道，正是你让这一切变得如此特别，对我来说。” 真是太巧了，你正好也要说同样的话。 “嗯，”她说，“听到你这么说，我也很高兴。 [etheryn.highConfidence |就这样，她的嘴唇轻轻触碰到你的嘴唇，一个温柔而绵长的吻就此开始。 |虽然平时很害羞，但小琳今天似乎心情不错，她主动凑过来，未经邀请就轻轻吻了你的脸颊一下。 ] 当她拉开距离时，她注意到你目光呆滞的样子，于是皱起了眉头。“出什么问题了吗？[pc.name]？” 不，没什么。[pc.isChamp | 没有什么能够曾经错了。 ]这样的结局简直再合适不过了。只是……考虑到她现在这种微醉的状态[etheryn.crowned|陛下|殿下]嗯，我会去的，”她答应道，“我觉得我的冠军最适合担任这个角色。[etheryn.libidoRange 25 | 也许我甚至应该给予奖励。[pc.himHer]为了[pc.hisHer]等我们回来后再帮忙吧 [pc.isBimbo |哦哦哦，这是不是意味着你可以得到一些奖励啊？为了得到那些奖励，你可得加倍努力哦！ |你承诺会认真考虑这件事。 ] [party.has quin |你和小琳在离开鱼市、朝着宫殿方向前进的过程中，还算能够保持大致笔直的路线，但你们的步态仍然不够稳，因此引起了其他人的注意——比如正在喷泉旁悠闲地读书的昆因。那个兔人男孩轻笑着摇了摇头，然后朝你竖起了大拇指表示赞许，之后又继续他的阅读了。 |回去的路上一切都很顺利，除了你们俩还需要重新适应在海上的生活而已；其实并没有什么其他麻烦发生。真的毕竟喝了那么多酒，你并没有喝醉，只是有点微醺而已，对吧？ ] 手牵着手走在路上，你们开始思考是应该在这里结束一天的时光，还是应该一起悄悄离开[etheryn.crowned|女王|公主]她回到了自己的房间，而当你来到王座厅时，你已经得到了答案。 |她站了起来，脚步还算稳当，然后伸出手来向你搭讪。 此时你仍能感受到酒精带来的影响，摇摇晃晃地走出了鱼市。[party.has quin | 当然，昆因正好在喷泉旁看书休息，当他看到你和小琳在人群中艰难地移动时，他会会心一笑，开玩笑地向你们敬了个礼，然后继续他的阅读。 ]在返回宫殿的路上，你们俩都重新找回了平衡，此时你们不禁思考，这场短暂的约会是否真的就该就此结束。你们相信，小琳应该不会介意让这场偶遇有一个更加……嗯，戏剧性的结局吧？等回到王座厅后，是不是应该提这件事呢？ ]
rows.raw: " Your nostrils flare at the stench of the Winter City's daily catch. A whole corner of the great market square is devoted to the bounty of the sea, where hoarse-voiced trawlers hawk every kind of fish imaginable to crowds of elves seeking ingredients for their evening meal. You and Ryn skirt the edges of the throng in search of a more prepared meal, but as you pass by, you notice the other purpose of the fish market: gossip. The appellation 'fishwife' — although in the Winter City, half or more are really 'fishhusbands', and many of the rest are half-sexed — has never seemed more appropriate as you watch elves idle in line yammering on about their neighbors, the prices, the druids, and the recent political upheaval. Between the raucous calls of the fishmongers and the animated discussions of their customers, nobody really notices the two of you. Ryn, however, definitely notices them; you can see her big ol' ears twitch every time she catches part of a political discussion. [etheryn.lowConfidence |The poor thing blushes furiously to hear her actions under such intense scrutiny, even if, as far as you can tell and given your limited understanding, there's little strident criticism of her reign so far. |She frowns in concentration as she tries to pick up what political intelligence she can from the snippets of conversation. ] But the market talk notwithstanding, you maintain a brisk pace, moving quickly to avoid the public eye. [party.has cait |In fact, the only person who does notice you is Cait, who waves excitedly from the other side of a wagon piled high with fresh-caught cod. You and Ryn round it for privacy, and as soon as you do, the kitty priestess gives you both a big hug. [flags.RYN_CAIT_FISH |"It's so good to see you guyyys!" she squeals. "Oh, you should never leave me alone in this fish market. It's just too much! I tried some of the herring... and some of that smoked stuff... and some of the fermented shark... oh, Mallach, if only it didn't take so long to prepare fish the elven way, I'd be able to have it on my own all the time!" Well, the boreal elven merchants are probably very happy to take her business. If she sticks around, they might even start giving her discounts. The kitty flutters her eyelashes coquettishly, placing her hand to her chest in mock outrage. "I'm sure I don't know what you mean. Th-that would be an... abuse of my priestly authority, [pc.name]!" You meant it as more of a repeat customer thing, but if that's where she wants to take it... "Oh! Right." Cait clears her throat. "Anyway, how's the big romantic date?" |"Oh, Mallach, I never knew you had so much fish here!" she titters. "I might just stay here and never go back to Hawkethorne. It's just like the markets back home in Jassira!" "I never knew that you liked it so much!" giggles Ryn. "We're really proud of all the ways we prepare fish. Did you try the little balls that we make out of mince, eggs, flour, and milk?" Cait nods. "Mmm, they came with some shrimp and tasted amazing." "Oh, if you liked them, you're going to love all of the other ways that we prepare fish! There's the one where we ferment it and then leave it to hang out to dry for months, there's the one where we bury it in the ground, there's salt-cure, pickling —" "Pickling!" Your catgirl friend grabs Ryn by both shoulders. "No. Way." "Yeah, we pickle a lot of fish, especially herring. It's one of my favorite things ever, especially when it's served with this wonderful marinade. You didn't smell it?" "Mrrr..." Cait bites her lip. "[var0|Okay, you sold me — not that that takes much doing! I've still got plenty of room, after all.|I really shouldn't, but I have such a weakness for fishy dishies... I'll see if I can find a place that sells it. Just for, umm, you know, future reference!] But enough about me. How's the big date going?" ] [etheryn.lnhConfidence |Ryn smiles shyly. "It's... it's the most fun I've had in a long time." "Awwww! That's sweet. |"It's nice! Very relaxing." Your elven companion beams. "We're making some wonderful memories." "Hee hee, you guys are so cute. I'm glad it's going well. |[etheryn.libidoRange 50 |Instead of responding, Ryn [pc.heightRange 70 |hops up into your arms and plants a big kiss directly on your [pc.lipsChaste], letting you hold her aloft for several decadent seconds before dropping back to the ground again. |leans over and kisses you deeply, dragging it out as long as either of you dare before turning back to Cait with a proud smile. ] |You and Ryn share a meaningful glance. "It's... it's magical," she says warmly. "I'm just so lucky to be able to spend time with a [pc.manWoman] like [pc.himHer]." She's made it magical for the both of you. You'll always treasure these moments with her. ] Cait claps gleefully. "You two are the most romantic dorks ever and I love it! ] Anyway, don't mind me!" The pretty kitty waves over her shoulder as she turns to leave. "You just keep enjoying yourselves, and I'll see you later!" |As you walk, the fish-smell becomes overpowering, and to take your mind off it, you turn to Ryn. So, where does all this fish come from? And what looks good? "There is an awful lot here, isn't there? Fish is the every-elf's meal: it's abundant and cheap. I know we're not right on the sea, but we're not that far away from it, either, and it's cold enough here to make sure that the fish keeps until it gets from boat to market. And as for varieties? Almost anything you can imagine! We get cod, haddock, herring, salmon, ling, pollock, all kinds of shellfish and crustaceans..." You understand. In a colder climate like this, fish would naturally make up a pretty big proportion of one's diet. It's not like there's much space for boreal elves to keep large herds of stock or grow vast fields of grain. "Right! We can grow a little cold-weather rye and barley on the edges of the Frostwood — that's where the bread comes from — but up here, it's mostly game and fish. And that means we have to get really creative with the way we prepare our food. We ferment it, we bury it in the ground, we hang it out to dry for months, we make dumplings out of it, we salt it... and my favorite: we pickle it!" Ryn half-closes her sapphire eyes. "Mmm... I could really, really have some pickled herring right now..." That's a pretty heartfelt recommendation. Who makes the best pickled herring, then? "I have no idea!" she laughs. "Let's find out." ] The isolated elves of the Winter City don't get enough visitors to make inns profitable. But they do have some things vaguely akin to them, namely: indoor public houses to provide the urban laborers around the market square with some cheap grub, along with shelter from the worst blizzards.[flags.RYN_FISH| You pick a different venue from last time, not so much from dissatisfaction as from your ongoing quest for the best herring joint in the city.] Subsiding snowfall has partially emptied the place of its customers, [etheryn.highConfidence |but when the two of you queue to order, it causes a stir all the same, with Ryn briefly mobbed by its multicolored clientele. With all the placating and thanking that the two of you have to do, it takes several minutes before you can finally buy your food and head for a quiet corner to try it out. All told, you've got a pair of ceramic cups with some kind of weird-smelling liquor in them, plus the herring, with bread, butter, and a hard cheese on the side. |but Ryn's still feeling a bit skittish. While she quietly keeps your table in an out-of-the-way corner, you brave the line, sandwiched between boisterous frost elves with a middling command of heavily-accented Belharan. At one point, you make the mistake of actually introducing yourself, and end up buried in a sea of backslapping amazons and elf-men, all calling out "Shampion!" and raving in boer'alvarin about... well, probably about whatever rumors have made it into the city since your battle in the Palace. It takes several minutes for you to finally reach the half-sexed vendor, who leans on her wooden counter with a faintly amused expression on her face, and negotiate for a meal of bread, butter, cheese, herring, and some very cheap liquor. ] Ryn perks up once you're safely ensconced in the corner with your food. "Okay! First comes the liquor. Now, you don't want to shoot this." Really? It's in the right kind of little cup and everything. "No, don't! We sip it slowly, over the course of the meal." She raises her cup to yours. "[silly |Skål! |Tal'asha! ]" The liquor's — oof, it's fucking hard, but not bad-tasting; weirdly, it reminds you of elven bread. Then, at Ryn's recommendation, you taste a fragment of the herring. It's firm, easy to bite through, with a sort of vinegary taste. As fish, it's pretty good, not too overwhelming, and extremely salty. Ryn beams to see your smile of approval as you chew, and pushes more ingredients at you, mixing and sequencing the bread, butter, liquor, and cheese to push your tongue into a whirlwind of new taste sensations. Your dinnermate keeps pace with you in both food and drink, but she starts developing a rosy blush before her liquor cup's halfway gone, and you can't help but bring it up. At first, Ryn's eyes widen, but then she lets out a delayed "Whaaaaaat? Noooooooo!" that she only barely finishes before collapsing into helpless giggles. When they subside, she continues, "[pc.name], I grew up in the palace. I don't drink much hard liquor." And when she does, she doesn't drink much. She leans forward. "Right." So all that stuff about sipping it slowly... "It's true! It tastes better this way. Well, it tastes... something." Okay. Well, if that's the case, she's going to need to have a little more bread. "Yes!" Some time later, you and Ryn lean against the back wall of the establishment, gazing idly at your empty plates. The highlights of a commoner's meal are that it must be cheap and filling, and this herring serviced both ambitions quite nicely. Happy with your choice, you sit back, rub your [pc.belly], and sip from your waterskin to wash out some of the taste of fish and liquor. Ryn, slightly less flushed than before, yawns and stretches in her seat. "I... I... aaahhhhmmm. I told you it was good, right?" she mumbles sleepily. She certainly did, and she was completely right. As far as [flags.RYN_FISH|boer'alvarin|new] foods go, this one hit the mark, and it made for a lovely capstone to your fun trip to the city. "I'm glad you think so. You're the one who makes it all special, you know. For me." What an astonishing coincidence. You were about to say the exact same thing. "Well," she says, "that makes me happy, too." [etheryn.highConfidence |With that, her lips meet yours in a tender, drawn-out kiss. |Shy though she normally is, Ryn's buzzed enough to lean over and give you a quick, unprompted peck on the cheek. ] When she pulls away, she notices your unfocused eyes and frowns. "Something wrong, [pc.name]?" No, nothing.[pc.isChamp | Nothing could ever be wrong. ] That was just the right way to end this little trip. It's just that... given her current semi-ebriated state, Her [etheryn.crowned|Majesty|Highness] is probably going to need a steadfast and doughty escort back to the palace. "Mmm, I will," she agrees. "I think that my Champion would be perfect for that role.[etheryn.libidoRange 25 | Maybe I should even reward [pc.himHer] for [pc.hisHer] help when we return..." [pc.isBimbo |Ooooh, does that mean cummies? You'll work extra-extra-hard for those! |You promise to take that under very serious consideration. ] [party.has quin |You and Ryn manage to keep to a more or less straight path as you make your way out of the fish market and back toward the palace, but you're still unsteady enough for others to notice — like Quin, relaxing with his book by the fountain. The bunny-boy chuckles and shakes his head, throwing you an approving thumbs-up before returning to his reading. |The walk back passes uneventfully, apart from the both of you getting your sea legs back; it hadn't really been that much alcohol, after all. You weren't drunk. You were just tipsy. Weren't you? ] As you walk arm in arm, you ponder whether to call it a day here or to abscond with your [etheryn.crowned|queen|princess] to her chambers, and by the time you reach the throne room, you have an answer. |" She rises, more or less steadily, and holds out her hand for you. Still feeling the effects of the booze, you shakily make your way out of the fish market.[party.has quin | Naturally, Quin happens to be relaxing with his book near the fountain and sees you and Ryn as you push through the plaza crowd on rubbery legs; he laughs knowingly and throws you a joking salute before returning to his reading. ] You both manage to regain your equilibrium on the walk back to the palace, and as you do, you consider whether your little date has to be quite over just yet. You're sure that Ryn wouldn't mind a more, ah, explosive ending to your little meet-cute. Should you bring it up when you return to the throne room? ] "

rows.original: With the white shroud lifting as the heavy snow abates, the whole of the Winter City marketplace is open to you. Crowds swell in front of the street food vendors and eating establishments as elves, hungry as you are, seek out their next meal. From here, you have a clear view of the elf-maiden fountain, the long thoroughfare down to the gated walls, the workmen busily expanding the fortified perimeter, the tips of the Frostwood's trees, and, far in the distance, the foothills rising to mountains. The normal hubbub of the plaza dies down as a small procession makes its way through the square. Elven pedestrians clear away as ten elves on wargs slowly pad in the direction of the gate. Four of them, the two in front and the two behind, are clad in the gear of the royal guard, but the other six wear much simpler, wilder outfits — outfits that draw silent stares as they pass the marketgoers. "The daily druid trade mission," Ryn whispers to you. "It's been, um, interesting trying to manage things so that they have access to what they need without antagonizing everybody." She surveys the scene. "I... well, I don't know that we've quite gotten there yet. Believe it or not, the guards are there to protect the druids, not the crowd." The silence is pretty eerie, true, but at least nobody's yelling, let alone fighting. From what you've learned about the grudges the boer'alvar can hold, that's quite the accomplishment. "I guess so. Hopefully this is just temporary... and hopefully it gets better, rather than getting worse. With Kasyrra and Alissa's depredations fresh in everyone's mind, a lot more people are thinking about unity than they normally would be. If that memory wears off, and we still haven't managed to come together more as a people..." She sighs. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |"I'm not the kind of person who can lead us through that. I don't know what to do." |"My nerves are shot just thinking about it." |"It's a pretty powerful incentive to keep working as hard as I can to make sure everything goes smoothly." ] At least she knows it's not just her: El, Hethia, and plenty of other elves want unity, too. The problems in their way are real, but the commitment to solve them is just as real. "I hope you're right." Ryn gives you a one-armed hug and pulls herself in close — close enough for you to hear her little tummy rumble. So, yeah, about the original reason you were wandering the market square. "Yes! Let's get some food." She pauses. "Hmm. I wonder if the druids' trading partners are selling any." Would they? "Sure. After all, that's one of the reasons they're buying from us: food supplies in the Frostwood and Old Forest are a bit less secure with all the chaos down south, and some of the druids are further away from their normal haunts anyway as the negotiations draw them closer to the city. Let's retrace their steps and see what we can find!" [party.has berwyn |As you follow the track of the druid delegation, you pass street vendors hawking fresh bread — and Berwyn, leaning against a building as he munches on something wrapped up in paper. You veer over to meet the little pup and exchange greetings, asking what he's found for himself. "This? Oh, it's just a cheesy bread. Rye, I think? It's still hot, and it's actually really good." It certainly looks it — his fluffy white tail won't stop wagging. "Yeah, okay," he snorts, but then his expression softens. "Anyway, it tastes good, and I'm enjoying myself. What about you two?" Ryn smiles. "Oh, we've just been doing this and that. It's been a pretty good day, all things considered. Did you happen to notice where that druid delegation came from?" "The people on the big wargs?" Berry frowns. "I think it was down that side street over there. Something smells a little weird in that direction." Bad weird? "No, just weird weird. It's kind of familiar, but I can't quite put my finger on it." Hmm. Well, you and Ryn will investigate, and let him know later. "Okay. Have fun, I guess. See you." A minute later, as you follow the side street, your nose confirms Berwyn's description. It is a pretty strong smell, but you're not quite sure what it is.[pc.bg barbarian | It dredges up old, raw memories — cookfires on brown, rocky plains, lighthearted meals with your [pc.ora wyldelf |troupe |tribe ] — but you can't quite remember why. ] |Following the druids' path, you notice an odd smell coming from a side street. It's strong, but not unpleasant, and interestingly, the warg tracks in the fresh snow seem to have come from that direction.[pc.bg barbarian | The smell's a good, not-quite-familiar one, one that forces old memories to the surface without you understanding why. You remember cookfires on the plains, rocky outcrops amid low brown grass, and boisterous [pc.ora wyldelf |meals with your troupe |tribal meals ], but can't quite put your finger on the thing that draws them all together. ] ] [flags.RYN_TURF |Of course, you eventually figure it out: it's the peat smell from the brewery, and as soon as it drifts across your nose, you and Ryn decide that you'll be going back for a return visit. Visions of roast duck and tasty whisky dance in your heads as the thick aroma fills your noses, and with your minds so occupied the journey there seems to take almost no time at all. As you walk, Ryn, ever the one to share, chats about more stories she remembers about the old pale elves and the peat bogs. Apparently there are weapons hidden in the bogs, placed there by the druids during the burial rituals for the Winter Queens and Kings of old, with strange, magical powers: fruits of the knowledge of the Old Wyld, of Belhar, or of something even more ancient. You wonder whether the bogs have preserved them in working order... or if they've crumbled to uselessness under the weight of peat and time. |Ryn's the first to connect the dots. "Is... is that peat?" Who the what now? "Peat!" She belatedly realizes that this isn't helping and tries to clarify. "You know, turf from bogs? It makes for good fuel, if you can cut it." [pc.bg barbarian |Of course! You and your people always called it bogearth, but it's clearly the same thing. When you were out on the moors, far from forests and easy wood fuel, you'd cut little turf bricks to keep the fires going instead. You remember how the meat you cooked over the, um, peat fires had a unique taste — one you wouldn't mind having again. So the boreal elves have access to the same stuff up here, do they? |Huh. You might've heard of this before, but not seen it in action. So certain kinds of mud are worth scooping up and burning? ] "Exactly. [var0|Remember the eastern Frostwood? There's a reason we call it the Icemire: it's a giant frozen peat bog.|We haven't been there before, but the whole of the eastern Frostwood is a huge peat bog called the Icemire.] Ancient pale elves would bury their dead in the bogs, and in return, the Wyld would give them peat for the fires. Here in the City, people used to say that the druids would even make sacrifices in the bogs — not just of animals, but of unwary travelers, too. I wonder how much of that is just a blood libel, and how much is a real memory of our most distant past." She purses her lips thoughtfully before moving on. "Anyway, I guess the druids still cut peat bricks out there in the woods, and they've been bringing them up to the city to trade for whatever they need." Well, in that case... you wonder what sort of things the boer'alvar can do over a peat fire. "Let's go find out!" ] The druids' trading partner is a multistory establishment, made more from stone than wood, with a proudly-swinging sign over the door. You enter to find a large common space around a bar area, with tables and wait staff and food much like the Frost Hound's... but this space is full of inebriated elves laughing, joking, eating, telling stories to each other, singing, and, of course, drinking. [silly |The main entertainment, though, is on a stage against the far wall, where a band of amazonian elves shreds through an uptempo metal song amid a jubilant crowd. Their lead singer, a musclebound, mohawked purple-skinned woman wearing a sleeveless top in imitation of armor (and, bizarrely, a pair of sunglasses), huskily roars a paean to war as the elves below her go nuts. They've even got a little half-sexed fan in the air, crowdsurfing the riotous multitude from end to end as she waves a flag blazoned with a yellow cross on a blue field. At their tables, the rest of the patrons cheer along, grunting, chanting, and throwing horns as appropriate — but you can barely hear them through the percussive blasts of the drums and the impossibly loud guitar. |In the middle of the floor, a large space has been cleared of tables and chairs to make room for a collection of clearly-drunk elven half-sexeds and men, singing something loudly, a cappella, and off-key as the rest of the clientele cheers along and bangs rhythmlessly on the tables. ][party.has arona | And, of course, who'd be more at home here than your big green [arona.isSub |beta |alpha ]? Arona's sitting at the bar, cackling at the elves' antics as she swigs from a big ceramic cup. Naturally, you gravitate right toward her. "Ha!" She slams her mug down on the counter. "If it isn't [arona.isSub |the big, bad [pc.mf |bastard him |bitch her ]self! |my favorite little beta! ] How the fuck are ya?" Great — better than great. You and Ryn have been having a wonderful day so far. "That right? You bein' nice to lil' Ryn?" Arona leans toward her unsteadily and raises a meaty finger. "[pc.name] treatin' you right, kiddo?" Your elven companion giggles. "[silly |Kiddo? You know I'm, like, more than twice your age, right? |You don't have anything to worry about, Arona. ] [pc.HeShe]'s been good to me — actually, I haven't had this much fun in a long time." "Damn straight," grunts the Mean Green approvingly as she downs another swallow of her drink. It seems like she's a little in her cups. What's got her drinking so heavily? "Pft, this? You think I'm getting pisseyed off this pansy elfshit whisky? It's way fuckin' smoother than the rotgut that old fucker Vaush [arona.isExiled |usedta make |makes ]. Seeeeee, look at —" She leans over ponderously to show you her mug, but overbalances and has to grab your shoulder to keep from spilling all over the floor. What was that again? Arona gives you a tusky grin from close enough for you to smell the whisky on her breath. "Aaah, maybe it's sneakin' up on me a liiiiiittle. But later, I'll be sober, and yooooou'll still... uh... how'd that go again?" Oh, Arona. Maybe you should let the bartender know that she's been overserved. "Hey, [arona.isSub |don't be an assass... ass... asshole. |know your place, 'kay? ] I got this. You have a try, see how much you like it. It's good shit." She claps your shoulder cheerfully, straightens up, and turns to the barkeep. "Gara! Take care of these two, yeah? Make sure they have a good date." ] [flags.RYN_TURF |As soon as she notices you, the motherly elf at the bar waves cheerfully and gestures for a server to come cover her place. All a-smile, Gara chatters happily with you about your adventures and how you're doing as she brings you to the usual private table, while you and Ryn reciprocate, asking after her and the baby. [rand |Apparently, the kiddo's not making it easy for her today, judging from the grimace she greets your question with, but the barkeep manages her best hospitality smile for her answer. |From the blissful, eyes-half-closed grin on her face, it's been a good day so far — whether through Lumia's blessing or natural pregnant euphoria. ] She takes your usual order and leaves you with a lit candle on the table and a wink as she waddles off to get your food prepared. |The bartender — Garadelle, by brief, stammering introduction — gawps at the sight of a monarch and a Champion in her establishment, but after recovering, she insistently summons some help. Soon a waitress is leading you into a well-furnished and empty side room for privacy. rows.translation: 随着大雪逐渐消退，白色的薄纱被掀开，整个冬城的市场都向你们敞开了大门。街头小吃摊前和餐馆前挤满了人群，因为像你们一样饥饿的精灵们都在这里寻找下一餐的食物。从这里，你们可以清楚地看到精灵少女喷泉、通往有门围墙的长街、正在忙碌地扩建防御工事的工人们、霜木树的树梢，以及远处连绵起伏的山丘。 广场上平时的喧闹声渐渐消失了，因为一支小队伍正缓缓穿过广场。精灵们纷纷让路，十名骑着狼人的精灵缓缓朝大门方向走去。其中四人——前面和后面的两人——穿着皇家卫队的制服，而另外六人则穿着简单得多的、更为野性的服装。当他们经过市场里的人群时，那些人都不由得默默地注视着他们。 每天的德鲁伊贸易任务啊，”小琳轻声对你说，“试图在确保他们能够得到所需物品的同时，又不惹恼任何人，还真是一件挺有意思的事。”她环顾四周，“嗯……说实话，我觉得我们目前还没有完全做到这一点。信不信由你，那些守卫其实是来保护德鲁伊们的，而不是来维护秩序的。 这种寂静确实让人感到有些诡异，但至少没有人在大喊大叫，更没有发生争执。考虑到那些布尔阿尔瓦人能够怀有的怨恨之多，能够保持这样的平静已经算是相当不错了。 “我想也是。希望这只是暂时的罢了。希望情况能有所好转，而不是继续恶化。在大家都还记得卡希拉和艾莉莎所犯下的暴行之后，比平时有更多的人开始思考团结的重要性。但如果这种记忆逐渐淡去，而我们仍然未能真正团结起来，那后果将不堪设想。……”她叹了口气。 [etheryn.lnhConfidence |我不是那种能够带领我们度过难关的人。我不知道该怎么做。 |光是想到这件事，我就觉得神经都要崩溃了。 |这是一个非常有力的激励因素，让我会更加努力地工作，以确保一切都能顺利进行。 ] 至少她知道，不只是她一个人有这样的想法：埃尔、赫希娅，还有许多其他精灵也都渴望团结。阻碍他们实现这一目标的困难确实存在，但人们为解决这些困难所表现出的决心也同样真实。 “希望你是对的。”小琳用一只手臂抱住了你，然后将自己拉得离你更近一些——近到你能听到她的小肚子在咕咕叫。 所以，嗯，关于你之前在市集广场闲逛的初衷…… “对！我们去找点吃的吧。”她停顿了一下，“嗯……不知道那些德鲁伊的贸易伙伴有没有在卖这类东西。” 他们会有吗？ “当然会有的。毕竟，这也是他们选择从我们这里购买的原因之一：由于南方地区的混乱局势，霜木林和古林地区的食物供应变得不太可靠了。而且，随着谈判的进行，一些德鲁伊们也不得不再远离他们平时常去的地方，从而不得不前往城市附近采购食物。让我们沿着他们的足迹重新走一遍，看看能发现些什么吧！ [party.has berwyn |当你沿着德鲁伊代表团走过的路线前行时，你会看到街头小贩们正在兜售新鲜面包——而贝尔温则靠在一栋建筑物上，啃着用纸包着的什么东西。你走过去与那只小狗打招呼，询问它自己找到了什么。 这个？哦，只不过是一种普通的面包而已。应该是黑麦面包吧？还是热的，其实真的很好吃。” 它看起来确实如此——它那蓬松的白尾巴不停地摇来摇去。 “嗯，好吧，”他哼了一声，但随后他的表情变得柔和起来。不管怎样，这东西味道不错，我玩得很开心。你们两个呢？” 小琳笑了笑：“哦，我们只是随便做做些事情而已。总的来说，今天过得还挺不错的。你们有没有注意到那个德鲁伊代表团是从哪里来的？那些在大瓦格上的人？”贝里皱了皱眉头，“我觉得应该在那条小街的那一侧。那个方向有点奇怪的味道。” “很奇怪的那种奇怪吗？” “不，就是普通的奇怪而已。这种感觉有点熟悉，但我就是想不起来具体是什么。” “嗯，你和小琳去调查一下，之后再告诉他结果吧。” “好的。祝你们顺利，回头见。” 一分钟后，当你沿着小路前行时，你的鼻子确实证实了贝尔温的描述。它是一种相当浓烈的气味，但你不太确定那是什么。[pc.bg barbarian | rows.raw: " With the white shroud lifting as the heavy snow abates, the whole of the Winter City marketplace is open to you. Crowds swell in front of the street food vendors and eating establishments as elves, hungry as you are, seek out their next meal. From here, you have a clear view of the elf-maiden fountain, the long thoroughfare down to the gated walls, the workmen busily expanding the fortified perimeter, the tips of the Frostwood's trees, and, far in the distance, the foothills rising to mountains. The normal hubbub of the plaza dies down as a small procession makes its way through the square. Elven pedestrians clear away as ten elves on wargs slowly pad in the direction of the gate. Four of them, the two in front and the two behind, are clad in the gear of the royal guard, but the other six wear much simpler, wilder outfits — outfits that draw silent stares as they pass the marketgoers. "The daily druid trade mission," Ryn whispers to you. "It's been, um, interesting trying to manage things so that they have access to what they need without antagonizing everybody." She surveys the scene. "I... well, I don't know that we've quite gotten there yet. Believe it or not, the guards are there to protect the druids, not the crowd." The silence is pretty eerie, true, but at least nobody's yelling, let alone fighting. From what you've learned about the grudges the boer'alvar can hold, that's quite the accomplishment. "I guess so. Hopefully this is just temporary... and hopefully it gets better, rather than getting worse. With Kasyrra and Alissa's depredations fresh in everyone's mind, a lot more people are thinking about unity than they normally would be. If that memory wears off, and we still haven't managed to come together more as a people..." She sighs. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |"I'm not the kind of person who can lead us through that. I don't know what to do." |"My nerves are shot just thinking about it." |"It's a pretty powerful incentive to keep working as hard as I can to make sure everything goes smoothly." ] At least she knows it's not just her: El, Hethia, and plenty of other elves want unity, too. The problems in their way are real, but the commitment to solve them is just as real. "I hope you're right." Ryn gives you a one-armed hug and pulls herself in close — close enough for you to hear her little tummy rumble. So, yeah, about the original reason you were wandering the market square. "Yes! Let's get some food." She pauses. "Hmm. I wonder if the druids' trading partners are selling any." Would they? "Sure. After all, that's one of the reasons they're buying from us: food supplies in the Frostwood and Old Forest are a bit less secure with all the chaos down south, and some of the druids are further away from their normal haunts anyway as the negotiations draw them closer to the city. Let's retrace their steps and see what we can find!" [party.has berwyn |As you follow the track of the druid delegation, you pass street vendors hawking fresh bread — and Berwyn, leaning against a building as he munches on something wrapped up in paper. It certainly looks it — his fluffy white tail won't stop wagging. "Yeah, okay," he snorts, but then his expression softens. "Anyway, it tastes good, and I'm enjoying myself. What about you two?" Ryn smiles. "Oh, we've just been doing this and that. It's been a pretty good day, all things considered. Did you happen to notice where that druid delegation came from?" A minute later, as you follow the side street, your nose confirms Berwyn's description. rows.original:
Contrary to the usual, Ryn's the first to speak, visibly perking up as you enter and giving you a [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |nervous smile. She appears tentative about something, looking every now and then to Elthara at her side for encouragement, and it's only when the priestess gives her a nod that she addresses you, waving you over.
        
        "[pc.name]! I-I was hoping you'd come, and here you are! It was almost too late... I was wondering how I'd g-get ahold of you, but then you decide to show up! S-silly me..." 
        |smile. She nods to Elthara, who returns the gesture, and waves you over eagerly.
        
        "[pc.name]! You're a pretty hard person to get ahold of — I sent someone down to check in at the Frost Hound, but you weren't there and hadn't been for a while. Thank Lumia you decided to show up, I was getting pretty antsy!"
    ]
    
    Whoa, whoa. While you're happy to see Ryn in one of her enthusiastic moods — something that's as rare as before, if for different reasons — what's the big occasion?
    
    "[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |T-the Midwinter Festivus ball, of course! I've t-taken the liberty of inviting everyone whom I've traveled with on our adventures, and that includes you!
        |The Midwinter Festivus ball, of course! I've invited as many of our adventuring companions as I could, but couldn't get my hands on you to give you yours!
    ]"
    
    "Ah. If I may, [etheryn.crowned
        |Your Majesty
        |Regent
    ]..." Sweeping forward a step, Elthara puts her hands together. "Shall I explain?
    
    "The Midwinter Festivus ball is a tradition that has been hosted by the Palace of Ice and the var Ridells since ancient times. Previously, it was held to commemorate the turning of the seasons and year in accordance with the animistic druidic beliefs of those who held fast to the Old Wyld, but since Atheldred's reign it's become an event to honor the glory of Lumia on the day when the north star is brightest in the sky.
    
    "Of course, for most of the city, it's just an excuse to feast and make merry. And there's much of that to be done — the ball is the one time every year that parts of the palace are made open to the public, mostly the grand ballroom and gardens. For one day, elves of all walks of life are free to enjoy the hospitality of the crown in food, drink and entertainments. There are, of course, other cultural and religious matters taking place on that day... but they're not part of the ball."
    
    She sounds quite familiar with it all. Not that you wouldn't have expected her to be, as high priestess, but... 
    
    "The organisation of each year's ball was mostly left to me; Alissa enjoyed partaking of the festivities and giving the yearly speech, but hated the idea of wrangling the provisioners, kitchens, maids and so forth necessary to host the event." Elthara smiles ruefully. "I may be a priestess in name, but many of my other unofficial duties were more that of a majordomo as more and more of my peers became interested in schmoozing with Alissa rather than doing their jobs. I suppose it was good practice for the unfortunate circumstances we find ourselves in now."
    
    Ryn clears her throat. "[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |A lot's h-happened this year, [pc.name]. We need to show the people that their trust in us isn't misplaced, and I agree with Elthara that e-everyone having a good Midwinter Festivus can only make things better. W-won't you at least join us for tomorrow's festivities? Everyone e-else's already said yes. It'll be a day out of your s-schedule... but I-I'm sure that just a day to remind everyone why they're fighting demons can't hurt.
        |A lot's happened this year, [pc.name] — I didn't just take the throne from my sister, but the entire governmental structure of the boer'alvar is undergoing a rehaul under Elthara's oversight, plus the whole healing of the schism... we need to show the people that their trust in us isn't misplaced, and I agree with Elthara that everyone having a good Midwinter Festivus can only make things better. The people need to be reassured that while the bad things are going to change, the good things they remember aren't going to disappear as well.
        
        "Won't you join us for the festivities tomorrow? Everyone else's already said yes. It'll be a day out of your schedule, but I'm sure that just a day to remind everyone why they're fighting demons can't hurt.
        
        Please.
    ]"
    
    It sounds like Ryn's asking you, and asking you pretty hard at that. If you do accept her invitation to the ball, it'll be a day of your time, so there's that. On the other hand, if you don't accept, she'll be pretty sad... 
    
    Ah, what's your answer?
rows.translation:
与往常不同，当你们走进来时，小琳是第一个开口说话的人。他明显显得非常兴奋，然后对你说道[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |她露出一种紧张的微笑，看起来对某件事有些犹豫不决，不时地向身旁的艾尔萨拉寻求鼓励。直到那位女祭司点了点头，她才终于开口叫你过去。[pc.name]我……我本来还盼着你能来呢，结果你真的来了！差点就太晚了……我还在想着该怎么联系你呢，结果你竟然自己出现了！真是个傻瓜…… 
        |她微笑着，向艾尔萨拉点了点头，艾尔萨拉也回了同样的礼节，然后急切地朝你招手。[pc.name]你真是个很难联系到的人——我派了人去“寒霜猎犬”那里找你，但你当时并不在那里，而且已经离开有一段时间了。还好你最终出现了，否则我真的会急得不行！
    ]
    
    哇，等等。虽然看到小琳处于这种热情高涨的状态确实让人很高兴——不过这种情况已经变得非常罕见了，只是原因有所不同而已——但究竟发生了什么大事呢？[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |当然是冬季节日舞会了！我擅自邀请了所有在我们一起冒险过程中结识的朋友，你也在其中哦！
        |当然是冬季节日舞会啦！我已经邀请了尽可能多的冒险伙伴来参加，可惜就是没能找到你，让你也来参加这个舞会呢！
    ]啊，如果可以的话， [etheryn.crowned
        |陛下
        |摄政王
    ]……艾尔萨拉向前迈了一步，双手合十说道：‘需要我解释一下吗？’

“‘仲冬庆典舞会’这一传统，自古以来就由冰宫和里德尔家族共同举办。最初，这个活动是为了纪念季节与年份的更替，这符合那些坚守古老信仰的德鲁伊们的观念；但自从阿瑟德雷德统治时期开始，这个庆典便变成了一个用来颂扬卢米娅荣耀的仪式——就在北极星在天空中最为明亮的那天。
    
    当然，对这座城市的大多数人来说，这只是一个借口，用来享用美食、尽情欢乐。而这样的活动确实很多——每年只有在这一天，宫殿的某些区域才会向公众开放，主要是那座宏伟的舞厅和花园。在这一天，各行各业的精灵们都可以免费享受王室提供的美食、饮品和娱乐活动。当然，那天还会有一些其他的文化和宗教活动……但它们并不属于舞会的一部分。
    
    她对这一切似乎都非常熟悉。作为大祭司，你本也应该预料到她会如此，但是……

“每年舞会的筹备工作大多都是由我来负责的；艾莉莎虽然喜欢参加这些庆祝活动，也喜欢每年发表演讲，但她却极其讨厌处理那些与活动筹备相关的事务——比如联系供应商、安排厨房工作、安排女仆等等。艾尔萨拉无奈地笑了笑。‘名义上我确实是一名女祭司，但实际上，我的许多非正式职责更像是一个管家——因为越来越多的同僚都喜欢去和艾莉莎闲聊，而忽略了他们自己的工作。我想，对于我们目前所处的这种不幸处境来说，这样做确实是一种不错的做法。
    
    小琳清了清嗓子，说道：[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |今年发生了很多事情[pc.name]我们必须让人们相信，他们对我们的信任是值得的。我同意艾尔萨拉的观点——如果每个人都能度过一个愉快的仲冬节，那么一切都会变得更好。你至少能参加明天的庆祝活动吧？其他人都已经答应参加了。虽然这会占用你一天时间……但我相信，花这么一天时间来让大家明白为什么要与恶魔作斗争，总不会有坏处吧。
        |今年发生了很多事情。[pc.name] — 我不仅从姐姐手中夺取了王位，而且在艾尔萨拉的监督下，整个布尔阿尔瓦尔的政府体系正在经历重组，同时那些分裂带来的矛盾也在逐步得到解决……我们必须向人民证明，他们对我们的信任是值得的。我也同意艾尔萨拉的看法：让每个人都能够度过一个愉快的仲冬节，只会让一切变得更好。人们需要得到保证：虽然那些不好的事情会发生变化，但他们所记得的美好时光并不会因此而消失。

“明天の庆祝活动，你不会一起来参加吗？其他人都已经答应要来了。这只会占用你一天时间而已，但我相信，用这一天来让大家明白自己为何要与恶魔战斗，绝对没有坏处。

拜托了。
    ]听起来小琳是在向你提出邀请，而且邀请得相当迫切。如果你接受了她参加舞会的邀请，那就会占用你一天的时间；而如果你拒绝，她肯定会很难过的……

啊，你打算怎么回答呢？

            “我、我明白。这不是你的错。”小琳抽泣着，尽管她在心里告诉自己，眼泪在政治场合是不应该出现的。“那、那么，祝你好运吧，[pc.name]。既然你来了，还有其他什么事情我可以帮你的吗？”

            这其实和她没有任何关系，但你真的没办法参加这次活动了，尤其是当这种事情突然发生在你面前时。舞会就在明天——不管怎么算，这个通知确实太仓促了。

rows.original: Sorry... you just can't make it.

As you step into the throne room, Elthara comes rushing up to Ryn and you, huffing and puffing. "Thank Lumia you're back home, [etheryn.crowned
        |Your Majesty
        |Regent
    ], and just in time!"
    
    Ryn takes one look at the priestess' flushed face and [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |quails. "D-did something happen, Elthara? Are we in d-danger?
        |takes her by the shoulders. "Calm yourself, Elthara. What happened? Is the city in danger?
    ]"
    
    "Danger? No. But the Midwinter Festivus ball is tomorrow, [etheryn.crowned
        |Your Majesty
        |Lady Regent
    ]! A var Ridell has to show her face, and — " she gasps. "We sent people to the village down south where you usually stay when out of the palace, and you weren't there! We were worried that we were going to have to break tradition on top of everything else that's happened — "
    
    Whoa, whoa. Midwinter Festivus ball? What's the big occasion? Could someone please explain?
    
    Now it's Ryn's turn to blush. "It's my fault. I completely forgot..." 
    
    "Ah. Ah. Of course." Leading Ryn to her throne, Elthara takes several deep breaths to steady herself. "I'll explain. The Midwinter Festivus ball is a tradition that has been hosted by the Palace of Ice and the var Ridells since ancient times. Previously, it was held to commemorate the turning of the seasons and year in accordance with the animistic druidic beliefs of those who held fast to the Old Wyld, but in recent centuries since Atheldred's reign it's an event to honor the glory of Lumia on the day when the north star is brightest in the sky.
    
    "Of course, most of the city just sees it as an excuse to feast and make merry. And there's much of that to be done — the ball is the one time every year that parts of the palace are made open to the public, mostly the grand ballroom and the gardens. For one day, elves of all walks of life are free to enjoy the hospitality of the crown in food, drink and entertainments. There are, of course, other cultural and religious matters taking place on that day... but they're not part of the ball."
    
    She sounds quite familiar with it all. Not that you wouldn't have expected her to be, as high priestess, but... 
    
    "The organisation of each year's ball was mostly left to me; Alissa enjoyed partaking of the festivities and giving the yearly speech, but hated the idea of wrangling the provisioners, kitchens, maids and so forth necessary to host the event." Elthara smiles ruefully. "I may be a priestess in name, but many of my other unofficial duties were more that of a majordomo as more and more of my peers became interested in schmoozing with Alissa rather than doing their jobs. I suppose it was good practice for the unfortunate circumstances we find ourselves in now.
    
    "The problem was that the ruling var Ridell is expected to be present and make a speech, and it's only on the very day before that she deigns to show herself back at her throne!"
    
    [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |Ryn wilts under Elthara's onslaught. "I-I said I was sorry!"
        |Ryn sets her teeth on edge. "I said I was sorry!"
    ]
    
    "Sorry isn't going to cut it, not when you're a [etheryn.crowned
        |queen
        |regent
    ]. The boer'alvar are depending on you to lead them, Etheryn var Ridell, and their faith in the crown has no doubt been shaken in the wake of your sister's betrayal. For you to be absent during one of the most customary royal appearances would have been..." The priestess finally deflates. "Never mind that, we're wasting time. I think we still have your grandmother's things around, they should fit you just fine. Then you need to memorize the speech."
    
    [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |Ryn flails. "Okay, o-okay! But what about [pc.name]?"
        |"Fine, I'll do it! But what about [pc.name] here?" Ryn points at you. "We can't just leave [pc.himHer] hanging, can we?"
    ]
    
    The harried Elthara considers you briefly, then nods. "Why don't you join the festivities, Champion of Frost? The palace will be open to anyone, after all. Maybe you being present will motivate Etheryn to do her best, push her beyond her perceived limits."
    
    Ryn clears her throat. "[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |Elthara's right. A lot's h-happened this year, [pc.name]. We need to show the people that their trust in us isn't misplaced, and I agree with Elthara that e-everyone having a good Midwinter Festivus can only make things better. I'm sorry to s-spring this on you so suddenly, but w-won't you at least join us for tomorrow's festivities? It'll be a day out of your s-schedule... but I-I'm sure that just a day to remind everyone why they're fighting demons can't hurt.
        |A lot's happened this year, [pc.name] — I didn't just take the throne from my sister, but the entire governmental structure of the boer'alvar is undergoing a rehaul under Elthara's oversight, plus the whole healing of the schism... we need to show the people that their trust in us isn't misplaced, and I agree with Elthara that everyone having a good Midwinter Festivus can only make things better. The people need to be reassured that while the bad things are going to change, the good things they remember aren't going to disappear as well.
        
        "I'm sorry to spring this on you so suddenly, but won't you join us for the festivities tomorrow? It'll be a day out of your schedule, but I'm sure that just a day to remind everyone why they're fighting demons can't hurt.
        
        Please.
    ]"
    
    It sounds like Ryn's asking you, and asking you pretty hard at that. If you do accept her invitation to the ball, it'll be a day of your time, so there's that. On the other hand, if you don't accept, she'll be pretty sad... and since she needs to be here anyway, you're going to be stuck for the day either way.
    
    Ah, what's your answer?
rows.translation:
当你走进王座厅时，艾尔萨拉气喘吁吁地跑到小琳和你面前。“谢谢卢米娅，你们终于回家了[etheryn.crowned
        |陛下
        |摄政王
    ]真是来得正是时候！”

小琳看了一眼女祭司那通红的脸，然后[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |鹌鹑们：“发生什么事了，艾尔萨拉？我们遇到危险了吗？
        |他抓住她的肩膀，说道：“冷静下来，艾尔萨拉。发生了什么事？这座城市陷入危险了吗？
    ]危险？不。不过明天的仲冬节庆典舞会可不能错过。 [etheryn.crowned
        |陛下
        |摄政王夫人
    ]里德尔小姐必须现身才行，”她喘着气说道，“我们派人去了你平时离开宫殿后会去的那个村子，可你根本不在那里！我们担心，除了已经发生的一切之外，我们可能还不得不打破惯例了……
    
    哇，哇。冬季节日舞会？有什么特别的原因吗？有人能解释一下吗？

现在轮到小琳脸红了。“都是我的错，我完全忘了……”

“啊，当然。”艾尔萨拉带着小琳走向她的王座，深吸了几口气让自己平静下来。我来解释一下。冬季节日舞会这一传统，自古以来就由冰宫和里德尔家族主办。最初，这个活动是为了纪念季节与年份的更替，这体现了那些坚守古老信仰的德鲁伊们的自然崇拜观念；但自阿瑟尔德雷德统治以来，在近几个世纪里，这个活动已经变成了在北极星最为明亮的那天，用来颂扬卢米娅的荣耀。
    
    当然，这座城市的大多数人只是把这一天当作一个尽情享乐、庆祝欢聚的借口。的确，有很多活动可以开展——每年只有在这一天，宫殿的某些区域才会向公众开放，主要是那座宏伟的舞厅和花园。在这一天，各行各业的精灵们都可以免费享受王室提供的美食、饮品和娱乐活动。当然，那天还会有一些其他的文化和宗教活动……但它们并不是舞会的主要部分。
    
    她对这一切似乎都非常熟悉。作为大祭司，你本也预料到她会如此，但……

“每年舞会的组织工作大多都是由我来负责的；艾莉莎虽然喜欢参加这些庆祝活动，也喜欢每年发表演讲，但她却极其讨厌处理那些与筹备活动相关的琐事，比如联系供应商、安排厨房工作、安排女仆等等。艾尔萨拉无奈地笑了笑。‘名义上我确实是一名女祭司，但实际上，我的许多非正式职责更像是一个管家——因为越来越多的同僚都喜欢去和艾莉莎闲聊，而忽略了他们自己的工作。我想，对于我们目前所处的这种不幸处境来说，这种做法也算是不错的应对方式吧。
    
    问题在于，那位名叫里德尔的统治者预计会出席并发表演讲，然而就在前一天，她才肯重新出现在她的王座上！
    
    [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |在艾尔萨拉的猛烈攻击下，小琳彻底崩溃了。“我、我说过我很抱歉！
        |小琳咬紧牙关：“我已经说过我很抱歉了！
    ]
    
    道歉是远远不够的，尤其是当你[etheryn.crowned
        |女王
        |摄政者
    ]布尔阿尔瓦族的人们正依赖着你来带领他们，伊瑟琳·瓦·里德尔。在你妹妹的背叛之后，他们对王室的信任无疑已经受到了动摇。而在这样一个极其重要的皇家场合你却缺席，这实在……”女祭司终于停下了话语。“算了，我们正在浪费时间。我想你祖母留下的那些衣物应该还留着，你应该能穿得合适。接下来，你必须要熟记那篇演讲稿。
    
    [etheryn.lowConfidence
        |小琳慌忙摆手：“好吧，好吧！但是……那该怎么办呢？[pc.name]？”
        |好吧，我来做吧！但是[pc.name]这里吗？”小琳指着你说道，“我们不能就这样离开啊。[pc.himHer]挂了，好吗？
    ]
    
    疲惫的艾尔萨拉短暂地打量了你一番，然后点了点头。“为什么不参加这场庆典呢，冰霜冠军？毕竟宫殿对所有人都是开放的。也许你的出席能激励伊瑟琳全力以赴，帮助她突破自己认为的极限。”

小琳清了清嗓子，说道：[etheryn.lowConfidence
        |艾尔萨拉说得对。今年发生了很多事情[pc.name]我们必须让人们相信，他们对我们的信任是值得的。我同意艾尔萨拉的观点——如果每个人都能度过一个愉快的仲冬节，那么一切都会变得更好。很抱歉突然这样要求你，但至少你能参加明天的庆祝活动吧？这只会占用你一天时间而已……但我相信，花这么一天时间让大家明白为什么要与恶魔作斗争，总不会有坏处吧。
        |今年发生了很多事情。[pc.name] — 我不仅从姐姐手中夺取了王位，而且在艾尔萨拉的监督下，整个布尔阿尔瓦尔的政府体系正在进行改革，同时那些分裂带来的矛盾也在逐步得到解决……我们必须向人民证明，他们对我们的信任是值得的。我也同意艾尔萨拉的观点：让每个人都度过一个愉快的仲冬节，只会让一切变得更好。人们需要得到保证：虽然那些不好的事情会发生变化，但他们所记得的美好时光并不会因此而消失。

“很抱歉突然这样告诉你，但明天你不会和我们一起参加庆祝活动吗？这只会占用你一天时间而已，但我相信，用这一天来让大家明白自己为何要与恶魔斗争，绝对没有坏处。

拜托了。
    ]听起来小琳是在向你提出邀请，而且邀请得相当迫切。如果你接受了她的邀请去参加舞会，那就会占用你一天的时间；而如果你拒绝，她也会很难过……不过既然她反正都要来这里，那么不管你做哪种选择，这一天你都得待在这里。

啊，你打算怎么回答呢？

    ]"
    
    It sounds like Ryn's asking you, and asking you pretty hard at that. If you do accept her invitation to the ball, it'll be a day of your time, so there's that. On the other hand, if you don't accept, she'll be pretty sad... and since she needs to be here anyway, you're going to be stuck for the day either way.

[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |No sooner are the words out of your mouth that Ryn looks like she's going to burst into tears. She struggles, looks at Elthara, then realizes that she's meant to look like a ruler and shakily attempts to comport herself. "I-I'm so sorry I asked. I didn't mean to spring this onto you, [pc.name]."
            
            It's got nothing to do with her, but you're not confident in yourself when something like this is sprung on you out of the blue. The ball being tomorrow — no matter how one cuts it, that's really short notice. You'll end up humiliating her or something, and this public appearance is going to be important for her and her people.
            
            "I-I understand. It's not my fault." Ryn sniffles, despite her internal assurances that tears have no place in politics. "W-well then, best of l-luck to you, [pc.name]. Y-you're welcome to stay in the palace while I'm about my d-duties tomorrow. Once I'm done, we'll b-be free to resume our travels." 
            |No sooner are the words out of your mouth that Ryn deflates, rubbing her forehead with the heel of her palm before remembering she's meant to have the airs of a monarch. It's still a moment or two before she comports herself, but at least she doesn't burst into tears at your gentle refusal of her invitation.
            
            "I'm sorry I asked, [pc.name]. I s-should've known... I didn't mean to spring this onto you. I really forgot all about it."
            
            It's got nothing to do with her, but you're not confident in yourself when something like this is sprung on you out of the blue. The ball being tomorrow — no matter how one cuts it, that's really short notice. You'll end up humiliating her or something, and this public appearance is going to be important for her and her people.
            
            "I know it's not my fault. And yet, somehow, I feel responsible for your refusal. No matter... it'll pass. Well then, you're welcome to stay in the palace while I'm about my duties tomorrow. Once I'm done, we'll be free to resume our travels."
        ]
        
        With nothing left, Ryn allows Elthara to drag her away into the depths of the palace, leaving you alone until one of the guards comes up to show you to the guest quarters. The rest of the day and the one that follows is mostly spent keeping to your chambers, but even so the sounds of revelry coming from the palace's lower floors are inescapable. Here and there you think you catch voices that sound familiar, but you can't make out what they're saying.
        
        Eventually, though, the day passes and Ryn appears at your door the next dawn, all ready to go. She looks a little exhausted, but satisfied; you surmise that she must have conducted herself well.
        
        [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |"A-all right. We can go now — Elthara w-will handle the rest from here. She's not happy about m-me leaving again, but..."
            |"All right, we can go now — Elthara will handle the rest from here. She's not happy about me leaving again, but she'll deal with it."
        ]
        
        Did she have fun?
        
        Ryn looks away. "I still wish you'd come."
        
        You give your elven companion a reassuring pat on the shoulder and gather your things. It'll be all right... there'll be next year, and she'd better not forget next time!

[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |话音刚落，小琳就仿佛要哭出来一样。她挣扎着，看了看艾尔萨拉，然后意识到自己应该表现出一个统治者的风范，于是颤抖着努力让自己镇定下来。“我、我很抱歉提出了这个请求。我并不是想突然把这件事强加给你[pc.name]这与她毫无关系，但当这种事情突然发生在你身上时，你确实会对自己缺乏信心。比赛就在明天——无论从哪个角度来看，这个通知都实在太仓促了。你最终可能会让她难堪，而这次公开露面对她和她的族人来说非常重要。

“我、我明白。这不是我的错。”小琳抽泣着说道，尽管她在内心告诉自己，泪水在政治场合是不应该出现的。那…那好吧，祝你好运吧。[pc.name]你…你可以在宫殿里留下来，明天我去做我的事情。等我忙完之后，我们就可以继续我们的旅程了。 
            |话音刚落，小琳就泄了气，用手掌背揉了揉额头，这才想起自己本应该摆出君主般的架子来。过了片刻，她才重新恢复了仪态，但至少在你婉拒她的邀请时，她并没有突然哭出来。

“很抱歉我提出了这个请求[pc.name]我…我本应该提前告诉你的……我并不是故意突然把这件事告诉你的，我真的完全忘了这件事。”

这件事和她没有任何关系，但当这种事情突然发生在你身上时，你确实会对自己缺乏信心。明天就要举行活动了——不管怎么算，这个通知时间确实太短了。你最终可能会让她难堪，而这次公开场合对她和她的人来说非常重要。

“我知道这不是我的错。然而，不知为何，我觉得自己应该为你的拒绝负责。不过……这一切都会过去的。那么，明天我忙于处理事务的时候，你可以留在宫殿里。等我忙完之后，我们就可以继续我们的旅程了。
        ]
        
        当一切都已消失无踪时，小琳允许艾尔萨拉将她带走，带入宫殿的深处，于是你独自一人待着，直到有卫兵前来带你前往客房。接下来的一天以及第二天，你大部分时间都待在自己的房间里，但即便如此，从宫殿底层传来的欢闹声依然无法避免地传入你的耳中。有时你会觉得听到一些听起来熟悉的声音，但却听不清他们在说什么。

不过，最终一天还是过去了，第二天黎明时分，小琳出现在你的门口，准备出发了。她看起来有些疲惫，但脸上带着满足的神情；你猜想，她一定完成得很好。
        
        [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |好吧，我们现在可以走了——从现在开始，剩下的事情就由艾尔萨拉来处理吧。她对我再次离开并不高兴，但是……
            |好了，我们现在可以出发了——从现在开始，剩下的事情就由艾尔萨拉来处理吧。她对我再次离开并不高兴，但她会想办法解决的。
        ]
        
        她玩得开心吗？

小琳移开了视线，说道：“我还是希望你能来。”

你轻轻拍了拍你的精灵伙伴的肩膀，安慰她一番，然后收拾好自己的东西。一切都会好起来的……明年还有机会，希望她下次一定不要忘记再来！
rows.raw:
"
        [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |No sooner are the words out of your mouth that Ryn looks like she's going to burst into tears. She struggles, looks at Elthara, then realizes that she's meant to look like a ruler and shakily attempts to comport herself. "I-I'm so sorry I asked. I didn't mean to spring this onto you, [pc.name]."
            
            It's got nothing to do with her, but you're not confident in yourself when something like this is sprung on you out of the blue. The ball being tomorrow — no matter how one cuts it, that's really short notice. You'll end up humiliating her or something, and this public appearance is going to be important for her and her people.
            
            "I-I understand. It's not my fault." Ryn sniffles, despite her internal assurances that tears have no place in politics. "W-well then, best of l-luck to you, [pc.name]. Y-you're welcome to stay in the palace while I'm about my d-duties tomorrow. Once I'm done, we'll b-be free to resume our travels." 
            |No sooner are the words out of your mouth that Ryn deflates, rubbing her forehead with the heel of her palm before remembering she's meant to have the airs of a monarch. It's still a moment or two before she comports herself, but at least she doesn't burst into tears at your gentle refusal of her invitation.
            
            "I'm sorry I asked, [pc.name]. I s-should've known... I didn't mean to spring this onto you. I really forgot all about it."
            
            It's got nothing to do with her, but you're not confident in yourself when something like this is sprung on you out of the blue. The ball being tomorrow — no matter how one cuts it, that's really short notice. You'll end up humiliating her or something, and this public appearance is going to be important for her and her people.
            
            "I know it's not my fault. And yet, somehow, I feel responsible for your refusal. No matter... it'll pass. Well then, you're welcome to stay in the palace while I'm about my duties tomorrow. Once I'm done, we'll be free to resume our travels."
        ]
        
        With nothing left, Ryn allows Elthara to drag her away into the depths of the palace, leaving you alone until one of the guards comes up to show you to the guest quarters. The rest of the day and the one that follows is mostly spent keeping to your chambers, but even so the sounds of revelry coming from the palace's lower floors are inescapable. Here and there you think you catch voices that sound familiar, but you can't make out what they're saying.
        
        Eventually, though, the day passes and Ryn appears at your door the next dawn, all ready to go. She looks a little exhausted, but satisfied; you surmise that she must have conducted herself well.
        
        [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |"A-all right. We can go now — Elthara w-will handle the rest from here. She's not happy about m-me leaving again, but..."
            |"All right, we can go now — Elthara will handle the rest from here. She's not happy about me leaving again, but she'll deal with it."
        ]
        
        Did she have fun?
        
        Ryn looks away. "I still wish you'd come."
        
        You give your elven companion a reassuring pat on the shoulder and gather your things. It'll be all right... there'll be next year, and she'd better not forget next time!
        "

rows.original: Sorry... you just can't make it.

You've only been asleep for a few minutes before you hear a knock[silly
        |: there's an imp at your door!
        
        Actually, it's just an elf. Oh, fine; if he insists. At least he's not on your shelf
    ].
    
    Telfir, the seamster who put together your formal outfit, stands grinning in the hallway. "Good evening, Champion. I'm sorry if I woke you. May I trouble you for a quick walk down the hall? Just a few last-minute things to look at with your outfit..."
    
    Certainly, certainly. It's a good thing you're still wearing that simple white shift. 
    
    The dapper elf whisks you down the mostly-empty corridor to a larger chamber, one absolutely jam-packed with dresses, cloaks, and other Winter City formal wear. A few tailors sit at long tables, hands flying over the fabric as they make other guests' last-minute changes. Telfir finds your [pc.mf
        |outfit
        |dress
    ] easily and draws your attention to all of the additions made since you picked out fabrics and design back in his premises on the marketplace. It's a gorgeous piece of work, one you can hardly believe is yours to wear tomorrow.
    
    Telfir waits discreetly and professionally while you drowsily slip into your duds, then immediately rushes into measurements, checking to see if any adjustments need to be made to account for any... ah... bodily changes.
    
    Idly, you ask him how extensive those changes could be. [pc.mf
        |Say, if you wanted to wear something dressier and more feminine than this.
        |What if you'd rather go with a more masculine outfit?
    ]
    
    "Those kinds of changes would be easy enough," he replies. "I've got enough extra material and magic to make it work, and rush jobs aren't exactly unknown when dealing with nobility. You should've seen some of the alterations I had to do for some of the, ah, former queen's entourage. Compared to them, this'd be pretty easy. 
    
    "In fact, I already have something in mind that I think you'll like; the [etheryn.crowned
        |Queen
        |Regent
    ]'s shared a few other ideas for outfits for you, and one of them wouldn't be too difficult to work up here with what we have. Just say the word, and I can make it happen."[silly
        |
        
        That does not sound even remotely possible.
        
        "You can't prove it, though! After all: spooky long-lived boreal elven magic. Anyway, who are you to look a gift mulligan in the mouth?"
        
        And now he's mixing metaphors.
        
        "Look, Your Worship, do you want to change your outfit or not?"
    ]
    
    Would you rather [pc.mf
        |stick with your fur cloak and light, airy silk shirt and pants... or see if he can put you in a formal dress instead
        |stick with your formal ballroom dress... or see if he can put you in a shirt and pants instead, maybe with a fur cloak to keep you warm
    ]?
rows.translation:
你才睡了几分钟，就听见一阵敲门声[silly
        |：有只小恶魔来敲你的门了！
        
        其实，那只是一名精灵。哦，好吧；既然他坚持的话。至少他没蹲在你的架子上
    ]。
    
    为你制作正式礼服的裁缝泰尔菲尔正站在走廊里，脸上挂着笑容。“晚上好，勇者。抱歉吵醒你了。能否劳烦你沿走廊走一小段路？关于你的礼服，还有几处最后关头需要检查的地方……”
    
    当然，当然。幸好你还穿着那件简朴的白色衬衣。
    
    衣着考究的精灵带着你快步穿过几乎空无一人的走廊，来到一间更宽敞的房间；里面塞满了礼裙、斗篷，以及冬城的其他正式服饰。几位裁缝坐在长桌旁，双手在布料上飞快穿梭，为其他客人赶做最后的修改。泰尔菲尔轻松找出你的[pc.mf
        |礼服
        |长裙
    ]，并让你留意，自从你在集市上的店里挑好面料和款式后，他们又加上了多少细节。成品华美绝伦，你几乎不敢相信明天自己就要穿上它。
    
    你睡眼惺忪地换上衣服时，泰尔菲尔既谨慎又专业地等在一旁；随后他立刻开始测量，检查是否需要进行调整，以适应任何……呃……身体上的变化。
    
    你随口问道，这种修改究竟能做到什么程度。[pc.mf
        |比如说，假如你想穿一套比这更加华丽、更具女性气质的服装。
        |要是你更想换一套偏男性化的服装呢？
    ]
    
    “那种程度的修改并不难，”他回答。“我有足够的备用材料和魔法来完成它；而且给贵族服务时，临时赶工也不是什么稀奇事。你真该看看我以前为那位……呃，前女王的某些随从做过怎样的改动。跟那些相比，这次相当简单。
    
    “事实上，我已经想到了一个你或许会喜欢的方案；[etheryn.crowned
        |女王
        |摄政王
    ]还跟我分享了几个为你设计服装的新点子，其中一个用我们现有的材料就不难赶制出来。只要你一句话，我就能把它变为现实。”[silly
        |
        
        那听起来完全不可能。
        
        “可你也没法证明不可能！毕竟，这是诡秘而长寿的极北精灵魔法。总之，别人白送你一次重新选择的机会，你还要挑三拣四吗？”
        
        现在他连比喻都混到一起了。
        
        “听着，尊贵的勇者，你到底想不想换套衣服？”
    ]
    
    你更愿意[pc.mf
        |继续穿着毛皮斗篷和轻盈透气的丝绸衬衫与长裤……还是让他试着给你换上一袭正式礼裙
        |继续穿着正式的舞会礼裙……还是让他试着给你换上衬衫和长裤，或许再添一件保暖的毛皮斗篷
    ]？
