rows.original: You awaken the next morning by sunlight streaming through the window and onto your face; the luxury of the room notwithstanding, you've slept better and dreamlessly, feeling rested and ready to face the day of festivities that lies ahead. The sun may be just about climbing up from the horizon, but the sounds of revelry rise to you from the palace's lower floors — looks like the party's in full swing. The guests — that is, all of Ryn's subjects — must have been arriving since well before dawn for things to have livened up by this time of day. It's still early, but by the standards of the day you must've slept in... [party.hasCompanions |You look around for [party.compNames], but [party.manyCompanions |their beds are |the bed next to yours is ] empty, a hastily scrawled note on one of the bedside stands. "You looked so peaceful sleeping like that, I didn't have the heart to wake you up. Take your time in washing up, [party.manyCompanions |we |I ]'ll be waiting for you down in the ballroom." ] Well, that settles that. [flags.RYN_MARKET |[var0 |Although your other gear's been carefully laundered and left outside the door, the real prize is your formal outfit, and you excitedly put it on[pc.mf |, anxious to really feel what it's like without sleep clouding your thoughts |, hoping that the rush job wasn't too much for the elven tailors ]. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |The chiffon shirt — made from drider silk, maybe? Who knows? — flatters your body extremely well, and feels just as light and airy as you remember from the fitting. It's the same story with the pants, which are made from the same material: they show off your figure well, but aren't so tight as to be uncomfortable. Telfir's work is much more daring than what you remember from down in the south, but fortunately for you, he's included a fur cape that ought to help keep you warm without the benefit of cold-running boreal elven blood. |Whatever material this is — something kind of silky, you'd guess? — it feels very comfortable against your skin. Telfir measured well, too; it fits perfectly and doesn't require much adjustment before you feel ready to go. The only downside is how open and light it is, but the elven seamster's thought of that, too, and included a fur cloak for you to protect you against the northern chill. ] You spend a few minutes at the mirror admiring the cut and cleaning yourself up, and soon enough, the dashing Champion of Frost is ready to make [pc.hisHer] entrance! |Outside your room, you find your other gear neatly cleaned and folded, but what you're most looking forward to is the dress that's hung up with it. [pc.mf |You hope it wasn't too much of a rush job for the elven tailors; you'll have to thank Telfir for his quick work next time you see him. |It was one thing to try it on with Ryn, but another entirely to put it on for a whole day's festivities. ] It takes you a few minutes to put it on, and you have to enlist the aid of a passing elven servant named Melita to help, but the finished product is absolutely worth it. It's a long, curve-flattering dress with wrist-length sleeves and just a bit of fur trimming for style, and despite its sheer appearance, it's surprisingly warm, whether through magic or clever layering. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |And on the dress itself, woven from a lovely, shimmery drider-silk satin, Telfir's added snowy embroidery in tulle. These long-lived elven seamsters really put southern dressmakers to shame; you can't remember having worn anything quite so lovely! |Whatever silky fabric this is made out of, it looks beautiful, with a practically magical shine accentuated by the snowy embroidery. You can't help thinking that this sort of outfit isn't one that someone like you belongs in, but some encouragement from Melita — "you and this dress go perfectly together, dear; you look even prettier than the fancy ladies who've been doing this their whole lives" — has you glowing in no time. ] You and the maid spend a few minutes making last-second adjustments, but there really isn't much left to do with the dress.[pc.bellyPregRange 5 | Telfir even managed to accommodate your growing belly remarkably well; you're not sure whether you should be grateful or embarrassed, but eventually settle on the former. ] Then Melita[pc.hasHair | helps you fix up your hair and ] works on your makeup, complimenting you on your appearance and how well the colors work for you. Soon, you're ready to face the rest of the gathering: time for the Champion of Winter to make her entrance! ] |Just outside your door, you find your clothes freshly laundered, dried, and pressed with elven precision and efficiency — after shrugging off the shift and throwing on your [pc.armor] and other things, you check yourself in the bedroom's full-length mirror and do a little gussying up. There, looking good! Now you're ready to face the party. ] It's but a short trip down the stairs to the ground floor, and from there all you have to do is follow the flow of people to what must be the grand ballroom. True to Elthara's words, it feels like the entire populace of the Winter City has converged upon the palace this day — young and old, rich and poor, Lumian and druid, all of them at least respect the traditions of Winter Festivus. The common folk of the Winter City may not be as finely dressed as the residents of the palace, but even so they've all put on their best and have an aura of quiet dignity about them on their visit to the palace grounds. The ballroom itself adjoins the gardens — the very gardens that you passed through with Ryn on your raid on the palace. Only this time you're approaching them from the other side, and the guards salute you as you approach. The amazonian women are all decked out in silvered ceremonial armor for the day. "[etheryn.crowned |Her Majesty |The regent ] told us to be expecting you, Champion of Frost[flags.RYN_MARKET |; you are certainly dressed for the occasion ]. Would you like to be announced?" No, that won't be necessary. Besides, you'd like to surprise a few people. "Very well. The kitchens will be busy all day, but the best of the feasting is customarily held in the morning before the royal speech; please help yourself to as much as you wish from the buffet on the western end of the ballroom. Entertainments have been engaged for the ball, and are mostly held in the eastern side of the ballroom and adjoining gardens. On behalf of Lady Elthara, allow us to bid you a fair Festivus, and may the light of Lumia shine upon you this day." Of course, of course. Now, if they don't mind... The guards step aside and usher you through the door into the cavernous ballroom, which is just as packed as the hallways, if not more. There must be thousands of elves in this vast chamber of dark-veined white marble, talking, eating, laughing, singing; as the guards mentioned, a spread's been set out on the western end of the ballroom, rich smells rising from the velvet-draped tables. From the eastern end, a twenty-elf band plays, producing a constant stream of music to fill the ballroom and gardens, their melody amplified by the acoustics of the ballroom and no doubt some kind of magical means in order to rise above the constant hubbub that results from thousands of elves all holding simultaneous conversations with each other. Crystal chandeliers, perhaps imported from Tychris, swing from the ceiling, casting a warm glow upon the revelry, and there are other marks of Belharan influence in the decorations that line the draped and tapestried walls of the ballroom. But the centerpiece of the whole affair is not in the ballroom proper, but rather the gardens — standing amidst the ice roses is a large evergreen tree that wasn't there the day before, live candles adorning its branches and a golden four-pointed sun atop its peak. And beside it, of course, is a statue of Lumia, goddess of sunlight... at least, that's the boer'alvar interpretation of her. It's an elven woman, tall and slender and regal-looking, holding aloft a beacon of flame in one hand, with a scythe couched under her other arm. The goddess' armor has been painted gold, and her hair is flaxen-blonde, but otherwise the rest of the marble statue is alabaster white and free from the barest hint of color. Until noon arrives and with it the time for Ryn to address her subjects, you're free to do as you wish — perhaps you might want to help yourself to the buffet, or perhaps partake in some of the entertainments. Ryn did mention that she invited all of your companions, so you might be able to find them in the throng of people, or if you want to find some elves you know to schmooze with that's perfectly fine, too. When you're done with the morning, you should just relax and let the hours pass amidst the revelry — it won't do to burn yourself out before noon, when there's still half the day to go!
rows.translation: 第二天清晨，阳光透过窗户洒在你的脸上，你由此醒来。尽管这个房间非常豪华，但你睡得非常香，也没有做任何梦，整个人感觉精力充沛，已经准备好迎接即将到来的欢乐时光。太阳才刚刚从地平线上升起，但从宫殿的底层传来了阵阵欢闹声——看来这场派对已经进入了高潮。那些宾客们，也就是小琳的所有子民，肯定是从黎明之前就开始陆续到达的，否则到了这个时候，场面还不可能如此热闹。现在还早，但按照现在的标准来看，你肯定睡过头了吧…… [party.hasCompanions |你环顾四周，寻找着[party.compNames]但是[party.manyCompanions |他们的床铺在……地方。 |你旁边的那张床是 ]空荡荡的房间里，床头柜上放着一张草草写下的便条。 “你睡得那么安详，我实在不忍心叫你醒来。你慢慢来，有时间再洗漱吧[party.manyCompanions |我们 |我 ]我会在舞厅等你的。 ] 好吧，这件事就这么定了。 [flags.RYN_MARKET |[var0 |虽然你的其他装备都已经被仔细清洗并放在门外了，但真正的珍宝还是你的正式服装——你兴奋地穿上了它。[pc.mf |我迫切地想要真正体验那种在没有睡眠干扰思绪时的感觉 |希望这些赶工的任务不会让那些精灵裁缝们负担过重 ]。 [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |这件雪纺衬衫——可能是用某种特殊的丝绸制成的吧？谁知道呢？——它将你的身形衬托得格外完美，触感也正如你在试穿时所记得的那样，轻盈而透气。这条裤子也是如此，它们也是用同样的材料制作的：它们能很好地展现你的身材，但并不会过于紧绷，从而造成不适。泰尔菲尔的设计确实比你在南方所见过的那些作品要大胆得多，不过对你来说幸运的是，他设计了一件毛皮披风，这应该能够帮助你保持温暖——即使你没有寒冷的北方精灵血液这种优势。 |无论这种材料是什么——你可能会猜到，它应该是一种质地柔软、类似丝绸的东西吧——它接触皮肤时都会带来非常舒适的感受。Telfir的尺寸也测量得非常精确，佩戴起来非常合身，几乎不需要进行任何调整就能立即使用。唯一的缺点就是它的材质过于轻薄透风，但这位精灵裁缝也考虑到了这一点，因此还为你准备了一件毛皮斗篷，可以帮助你抵御北方的严寒。 ] 你花了几分钟时间在镜子前欣赏自己的造型，整理好自己的仪容，不久之后，这位英俊潇洒的霜之冠军就准备出发了。[pc.hisHer]入口！ |在你的房间外面，你发现其他装备都被整齐地清洗并折叠好了，但让你最期待的是那件与之一起挂在那里的裙子。 [pc.mf |你希望精灵裁缝们并没有因为时间紧迫而草率完成工作；下次见到泰尔菲尔时，你真得感谢他的高效表现。 |在小琳身上试穿它是另一回事，但要在一整天的庆祝活动中一直穿着它，那就是另一回事了。 ]你只需要几分钟就能穿好它，而且还需要一位名叫梅利塔的精灵仆从来帮忙。不过，最终得到的结果绝对值得这个努力。这是一条长度适中、线条流畅的裙子，袖子长度刚好到手腕处，还点缀了一些毛皮装饰来增添时尚感。尽管这条裙子的材质看起来很透明，但出乎意料地保暖——这要归功于魔法效果或是巧妙的层次搭配吧。 [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |而这件连衣裙本身，就是用那种美丽而闪亮的德莱德丝绸缎子编织而成的，泰尔菲尔还在上面添加了用薄纱制成的雪花图案刺绣。这些技艺高超的精灵裁缝，确实让南方的服装匠人们相形见绌——你肯定想不起来自己曾经穿过过如此精美的衣物！ |无论这种面料是由什么丝质材料制成的，它看起来都美极了，那种近乎魔法的光泽在雪白的刺绣衬托下更加显眼。你不禁会想，这样的服装根本不适合像你这样的人穿着……但梅丽塔的一番鼓励——“亲爱的，你和这条裙子简直天作之合，你看起来甚至比那些一辈子都穿着这类衣服的贵族女士们还要漂亮”——立刻让你充满了自信，容光焕发起来。 ] 你和女仆花了几分钟时间进行最后的调整，但这条裙子其实已经没什么可以修改的地方了。[pc.bellyPregRange 5 | 泰尔菲尔甚至设法很好地适应了你逐渐隆起的腹部；你不确定自己是应该感到感激还是应该感到尴尬，但最终还是选择了前者。 ]然后是梅利塔。[pc.hasHair | 帮助你整理头发，同时…… ]这些装饰会提升你的整体形象，凸显你的外貌优势，也会让那些颜色更加适合你。很快，你就准备好迎接聚会中接下来的环节了——冬季冠军登场的时间到了！ ] |就在你家门外，你会发现自己的衣服已经被精灵们以精湛的技艺和高效的方式洗干净、晾干并熨平了——你只需稍作整理，然后穿上它们就行了。[pc.armor]还有其他一些事情，你可以站在卧室的全身镜前整理一下自己，稍微打扮一下。 看，这样看起来多好啊！现在你就可以去参加派对了。 ] 只需沿着楼梯走到一楼，然后跟着人群的方向走，就能找到那个宏伟的舞厅。正如艾尔萨拉所说，今天似乎整个冬城的人们都聚集到了这座宫殿里——无论老少、贫富，无论是卢米安人还是德鲁伊，他们至少都尊重冬日节日的传统。冬城里的普通百姓或许没有宫殿里居民那样穿着考究，但即便如此，在前往宫殿参观时，他们也都穿上了自己最好的衣服，身上散发着一种宁静而高贵的气质。 这个舞厅本身就与花园相邻——就是你们在袭击宫殿时与小琳一起穿过的那些花园。只不过这一次，你们是从另一侧接近它们的，而当你们靠近时，守卫们都会向你们敬礼。那些亚马逊女性在这一天都穿上了银色的仪式用盔甲。[etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ]他们告诉我们，要等着你——冰霜冠军的到来。[flags.RYN_MARKET |你的穿着确实很适合这个场合。 ]您是否希望有人宣布这一消息呢？” “不，没有必要。而且，您还是想给一些人一个惊喜吧。” “好的。整个白天厨房都会很忙，但通常来说，最丰盛的宴席会在皇家演讲之前的早晨举行；请随意享用宴会厅西端设置的自助餐吧。为了庆祝这场盛会，已经邀请了许多娱乐表演者，这些表演活动主要在舞厅的东侧以及相邻的花园里举行。我们代表艾尔萨拉女士，向各位致以诚挚的祝福，愿卢米亚的光芒在这一天照耀在你们身上，祝大家度过一个欢乐的节日！" 当然，当然。现在，如果他们不介意的话…… 守卫们让开道路，引领你穿过大门，进入那个宽敞的舞厅。那里的人挤得和走廊里一样多，甚至更密集。在这个由深色脉络纹路的白色大理石建造的巨大厅堂里，肯定有成千上万的精灵在交谈、进食、欢笑、歌唱；正如守卫们所说，舞厅的西端已经摆好了美食，那些铺着天鹅绒的桌子上散发着诱人的香气。从东端开始，一支由二十名精灵组成的乐队正在演奏，他们不断释放出美妙的音乐，让音乐厅和花园里充满了旋律。这些声音通过音乐厅的声学效果得到了放大，而某种魔法手段无疑也帮助这些音乐声盖过了成千上万的精灵们同时交谈时所产生的喧嚣声。水晶吊灯或许是从提克里斯进口而来的，它们悬挂在天花板上，为这场欢庆活动营造出温暖的光芒。在舞厅那些挂满帷幔和挂毯的墙壁上，也能看到其他体现贝尔哈兰风格的装饰元素。 但整个活动的核心并不在宴会厅本身，而是在花园里——那些冰玫瑰丛中矗立着一棵巨大的常绿树，这棵树在前一天还不存在；它的树枝上挂满了点燃的蜡烛，树顶则装饰着一个金色的四角太阳标志。而在它旁边，当然还有一座代表卢米娅的雕像——这位阳光女神……至少，布尔阿尔瓦尔人是这样解读她的。那是一座精灵女性的雕像，高挑纤细，气质高贵，一只手高举着火焰火炬，另一只手臂下则横放着一把镰刀。这位女神的铠甲被涂成了金色，她的头发也是亚麻金色的，但除此之外，这座大理石雕像的其他部分都保持着纯白色的色调，没有任何一丝色彩。 直到中午来临，也就是小琳该开始与她的子民们交谈的时间之前，你都可以随心所欲地做任何你想做的事情——或许你可以趁这个机会吃点东西。自助餐或者，或许也可以参与其中的一些活动。娱乐活动小琳确实提到过，她邀请了你们所有人。同伴所以，你或许能在人群中找到它们，或者如果你想寻找某些特定的东西的话精灵们你知道，和别人闲聊也是完全没问题的。 等你完成了早上的工作，就可以放松吧。让时光在欢乐中流逝吧——在中午之前就把自己累垮可不行，毕竟还有大半天的时间呢！
rows.raw: " You awaken the next morning by sunlight streaming through the window and onto your face; the luxury of the room notwithstanding, you've slept better and dreamlessly, feeling rested and ready to face the day of festivities that lies ahead. The sun may be just about climbing up from the horizon, but the sounds of revelry rise to you from the palace's lower floors — looks like the party's in full swing. The guests — that is, all of Ryn's subjects — must have been arriving since well before dawn for things to have livened up by this time of day. It's still early, but by the standards of the day you must've slept in... [party.hasCompanions |You look around for [party.compNames], but [party.manyCompanions |their beds are |the bed next to yours is ] empty, a hastily scrawled note on one of the bedside stands. "You looked so peaceful sleeping like that, I didn't have the heart to wake you up. Take your time in washing up, [party.manyCompanions |we |I ]'ll be waiting for you down in the ballroom." ] Well, that settles that. [flags.RYN_MARKET |[var0 |Although your other gear's been carefully laundered and left outside the door, the real prize is your formal outfit, and you excitedly put it on[pc.mf |, anxious to really feel what it's like without sleep clouding your thoughts |, hoping that the rush job wasn't too much for the elven tailors ]. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |The chiffon shirt — made from drider silk, maybe? Who knows? — flatters your body extremely well, and feels just as light and airy as you remember from the fitting. It's the same story with the pants, which are made from the same material: they show off your figure well, but aren't so tight as to be uncomfortable. Telfir's work is much more daring than what you remember from down in the south, but fortunately for you, he's included a fur cape that ought to help keep you warm without the benefit of cold-running boreal elven blood. |Whatever material this is — something kind of silky, you'd guess? — it feels very comfortable against your skin. Telfir measured well, too; it fits perfectly and doesn't require much adjustment before you feel ready to go. The only downside is how open and light it is, but the elven seamster's thought of that, too, and included a fur cloak for you to protect you against the northern chill. ] You spend a few minutes at the mirror admiring the cut and cleaning yourself up, and soon enough, the dashing Champion of Frost is ready to make [pc.hisHer] entrance! |Outside your room, you find your other gear neatly cleaned and folded, but what you're most looking forward to is the dress that's hung up with it. [pc.mf |You hope it wasn't too much of a rush job for the elven tailors; you'll have to thank Telfir for his quick work next time you see him. |It was one thing to try it on with Ryn, but another entirely to put it on for a whole day's festivities. ] It takes you a few minutes to put it on, and you have to enlist the aid of a passing elven servant named Melita to help, but the finished product is absolutely worth it. It's a long, curve-flattering dress with wrist-length sleeves and just a bit of fur trimming for style, and despite its sheer appearance, it's surprisingly warm, whether through magic or clever layering. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |And on the dress itself, woven from a lovely, shimmery drider-silk satin, Telfir's added snowy embroidery in tulle. These long-lived elven seamsters really put southern dressmakers to shame; you can't remember having worn anything quite so lovely! |Whatever silky fabric this is made out of, it looks beautiful, with a practically magical shine accentuated by the snowy embroidery. You can't help thinking that this sort of outfit isn't one that someone like you belongs in, but some encouragement from Melita — "you and this dress go perfectly together, dear; you look even prettier than the fancy ladies who've been doing this their whole lives" — has you glowing in no time. ] You and the maid spend a few minutes making last-second adjustments, but there really isn't much left to do with the dress.[pc.bellyPregRange 5 | Telfir even managed to accommodate your growing belly remarkably well; you're not sure whether you should be grateful or embarrassed, but eventually settle on the former. ] Then Melita[pc.hasHair | helps you fix up your hair and ] works on your makeup, complimenting you on your appearance and how well the colors work for you. Soon, you're ready to face the rest of the gathering: time for the Champion of Winter to make her entrance! ] |Just outside your door, you find your clothes freshly laundered, dried, and pressed with elven precision and efficiency — after shrugging off the shift and throwing on your [pc.armor] and other things, you check yourself in the bedroom's full-length mirror and do a little gussying up. There, looking good! Now you're ready to face the party. ] It's but a short trip down the stairs to the ground floor, and from there all you have to do is follow the flow of people to what must be the grand ballroom. True to Elthara's words, it feels like the entire populace of the Winter City has converged upon the palace this day — young and old, rich and poor, Lumian and druid, all of them at least respect the traditions of Winter Festivus. The common folk of the Winter City may not be as finely dressed as the residents of the palace, but even so they've all put on their best and have an aura of quiet dignity about them on their visit to the palace grounds. The ballroom itself adjoins the gardens — the very gardens that you passed through with Ryn on your raid on the palace. Only this time you're approaching them from the other side, and the guards salute you as you approach. The amazonian women are all decked out in silvered ceremonial armor for the day. "[etheryn.crowned |Her Majesty |The regent ] told us to be expecting you, Champion of Frost[flags.RYN_MARKET |; you are certainly dressed for the occasion ]. Would you like to be announced?" No, that won't be necessary. Besides, you'd like to surprise a few people. "Very well. The kitchens will be busy all day, but the best of the feasting is customarily held in the morning before the royal speech; please help yourself to as much as you wish from the buffet on the western end of the ballroom. Entertainments have been engaged for the ball, and are mostly held in the eastern side of the ballroom and adjoining gardens. On behalf of Lady Elthara, allow us to bid you a fair Festivus, and may the light of Lumia shine upon you this day." Of course, of course. Now, if they don't mind... The guards step aside and usher you through the door into the cavernous ballroom, which is just as packed as the hallways, if not more. There must be thousands of elves in this vast chamber of dark-veined white marble, talking, eating, laughing, singing; as the guards mentioned, a spread's been set out on the western end of the ballroom, rich smells rising from the velvet-draped tables. From the eastern end, a twenty-elf band plays, producing a constant stream of music to fill the ballroom and gardens, their melody amplified by the acoustics of the ballroom and no doubt some kind of magical means in order to rise above the constant hubbub that results from thousands of elves all holding simultaneous conversations with each other. Crystal chandeliers, perhaps imported from Tychris, swing from the ceiling, casting a warm glow upon the revelry, and there are other marks of Belharan influence in the decorations that line the draped and tapestried walls of the ballroom. But the centerpiece of the whole affair is not in the ballroom proper, but rather the gardens — standing amidst the ice roses is a large evergreen tree that wasn't there the day before, live candles adorning its branches and a golden four-pointed sun atop its peak. And beside it, of course, is a statue of Lumia, goddess of sunlight... at least, that's the boer'alvar interpretation of her. It's an elven woman, tall and slender and regal-looking, holding aloft a beacon of flame in one hand, with a scythe couched under her other arm. The goddess' armor has been painted gold, and her hair is flaxen-blonde, but otherwise the rest of the marble statue is alabaster white and free from the barest hint of color. Until noon arrives and with it the time for Ryn to address her subjects, you're free to do as you wish — perhaps you might want to help yourself to the buffet, or perhaps partake in some of the entertainments. Ryn did mention that she invited all of your companions, so you might be able to find them in the throng of people, or if you want to find some elves you know to schmooze with that's perfectly fine, too. When you're done with the morning, you should just relax and let the hours pass amidst the revelry — it won't do to burn yourself out before noon, when there's still half the day to go! "

rows.original: The grand ballroom is alight with the morning's festivities. Despite the thousands of elves packed within its walls and spilling out over to the hallways and garden, there's always space for you to move freely. Non-stop music flows through the air as elves mingle, schmooze and feast; on this day, the hospitality of the crown knows no bounds. Until noon arrives and with it the time for Ryn to address her subjects, you're free to do as you wish — perhaps you might want to help yourself to the buffet, or perhaps partake in some of the entertainments. Ryn did mention that she invited all of your companions, so you might be able to find them in the throng of people, or if you want to find some elves you know to schmooze with that's perfectly fine, too. When you're done with the morning, you should just relax and let the hours pass amidst the revelry — it won't do to burn yourself out before noon, when there's still half the day to go! The ball, as the saying goes, is in your court...
rows.translation: 宏伟的舞厅里洋溢着晨间的欢乐气氛。尽管有成千上万的精灵挤满了这里，他们的身影还延伸到了走廊和花园里，但你们仍然有足够的空间自由活动。音乐声不绝于耳，精灵们或相聚交谈，或享用美食；在这一天，王室的热情好客简直无边无际。 直到中午来临，小琳也该开始向她的子民们发表讲话了，那时你们就可以随心所欲地做自己想做的事情了——或许，你们会想要再享用一些美食吧自助餐或者，或许可以参与其中的一些活动。娱乐活动小琳确实提到过，她邀请了你们所有人。同伴因此，你或许能够在人群中找到它们，或者如果你想寻找某些特定的东西的话精灵们你知道，和别人闲聊也是完全没问题的。 等你完成了早上的工作，就可以放松吧。让时光在欢乐中流逝吧——毕竟在中午之前就把自己累垮可不行，毕竟这一天还有一半呢！ 俗话说，现在轮到你了……

Despite the thousands of elves packed within its walls and spilling out over to the hallways and garden, there's always space for you to move freely. Non-stop music flows through the air as elves mingle, schmooze and feast; on this day, the hospitality of the crown knows no bounds. Until noon arrives and with it the time for Ryn to address her subjects, you're free to do as you wish — perhaps you might want to help yourself to the buffet, or perhaps partake in some of the entertainments. Ryn did mention that she invited all of your companions, so you might be able to find them in the throng of people, or if you want to find some elves you know to schmooze with that's perfectly fine, too. When you're done with the morning, you should just relax and let the hours pass amidst the revelry — it won't do to burn yourself out before noon, when there's still half the day to go! The ball, as the saying goes, is in your court... "

rows.original: See if you can find any of the elves you know; there should be plenty at the party.
rows.translation: 看看能不能找到你认识的那些精灵们；派对上应该有很多这样的精灵。
rows.raw: "See if you can find any of the elves you know; there should be plenty at the party."

rows.original: Ryn said she invited everyone the two of you knew; maybe you'll be able to find some of your mutual companions at the party. It couldn't hurt...
rows.translation: 小琳说她邀请了你们俩认识的所有人；也许在聚会上你们能找到一些共同的伙伴。试试看也没坏处……
rows.raw: "Ryn said she invited everyone the two of you knew; maybe you'll be able to find some of your mutual companions at the party. It couldn't hurt... "

rows.original: Just while away the hours and let noon come along. This will progress the event to Ryn's speech.
rows.translation: 就这样消磨时间，等待正午的到来吧。这一环节将会引导事件发展至小琳的演讲阶段。
rows.raw: "Just while away the hours and let noon come along. This will progress the event to Ryn's speech."

rows.original: You cast your eye over the velvet-draped tables at the western end of the ballroom and consider your options. Elves mill about the tables, grabbing plates from one end and moving down in a line across the spread — it's a strange way of doing things, perhaps, but it does have the mark of Elthara's efficiency on it. The palace staff run to and fro from the kitchens, collecting empty serving dishes and returning with filled ones; others serve the many people eager to have their yearly taste of rich food at someone else's expense. [pc.ra elf |You receive several polite nods as you approach, the people of the Winter City acknowledging you despite the quiet profile you're keeping, and |Though you get several curious looks as you approach, the people of the Winter City being able to take their [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]'s champion up close for the first time, ] they part politely for you to approach the tables. The closest one holds [rand |a large, dark layer cake topped with cream and several specimens of light blue berries that you've never quite seen before. The elf serving you smiles broadly and places on your plate not one, but two thick slices, a faint scent of alcohol rising from the heavy dough. And it is heavy — you feel the weight of each slice as it's dumped upon your plate, as imposing and grandiose as cake can be. "For the [pc.mf |lord |lady ]'s constitution. Food at this time of year is meant to put meat on your bones and keep you warm; it's easy to get hungry when you're out in the cold." Unsurprisingly, it's very sweet, and as you draw away from the buffet to sample the cake, the sweetness begins to give way to the taste of the wine used in the baking. The cake itself is as thick as it looks, each bite requiring you to bite down heavily for the dough to part, contrasting with the light, fruit-flavored cream that parts easily under your teeth. And after you've swallowed... oh, dear. That's going to sit in your stomach and weigh it down like a ball and chain for the rest of the day. But what a taste, especially with the wine lingering on your tongue! You might regret it tomorrow... but for now, both slices of layer cake aren't long for this world, and you find yourself craving more like it. |a serving dish, on which are arrayed about two dozen smaller dishes with what looks like meatloaf on them. The outsides are browned and speckled with dried fruit, and the faint smell of a honey glaze reaches your nose. The server at the table places one of the dishes on your plate with both hands, then steps back and bows. "A fair Festivus to m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." And to her as well. Might you ask what this is? "It used to be that when we wished to journey from our homes, we'd take food to last, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. The druids of the Old Wyld perfected the art of pemmican making with meat, fat and fruit from the forest, and as it spread to the boer'alvar as a people, we'd add honey and herbs during the cooking to not just help it last longer, but also greatly improve the taste. It used to be that the druids would add nectar of the razorcup flower for the best effects, but that was out of the reach of the common folk. For Festivus, the recipe changes slightly with the addition of breadcrumbs to make it a proper meatloaf. "Since Lumia has turned our eyes to the glorious north, we no longer use meat and fat from forest creatures, but seal and whale meat and blubber instead. The druids offered some of their own for the ball made in their fashion... but I still have to say that our way of doing things is better." You chuckle, nod, and carry away your prize to partake. The richness of the rendered blubber complements the sweetness of the honey glaze perfectly, and the savouriness of the well-done mincemeat is something to be said. That's not to speak of the dried fruit... it's certainly not any type of berry, judging by the shrivelled fruit segments. Apricots? It's hard to tell, given the medley of flavors dancing on your tongue, but does it matter? The whole of this festive meatloaf is clearly more than the sum of its parts, and like all the other food being toted around this Midwinter Festivus, very, very rich. Ah... at this rate, you'll be putting on weight before long. But everything the palace kitchens have come up with looks and smells so appealing... |several large bottles of elven mirrorwine — or as it's more commonly known in the Marches, ice wine. There's even a separate section with watered-down drink for the children, and that's even more crowded than the table you're at. The server beams at you and fills your glass from a freshly opened bottle, artfully letting the foam subside before topping it off. "Good health and Lumia bless you this Festivus, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." And to him. But... he opened a fresh bottle just for you? "Not to worry, champion; both [etheryn.crowned |Her Majesty |the regent ] and Lady Elthara have opened the wine cellars for the occasion. Now that the druids are back, we can make more mirrorwine again — there's no need for the kitchens to ration it out any further. I know that many people aren't completely sure about them coming back to us, but if it means more mirrorwine, I'm sold!" Well, you can see that he's a man who knows what he wants. Good health, and Lumia bless him too! The server grins, and you wonder if he isn't sampling from the bottles while on the job. And who can blame him? It is Festivus, after all. Taking your glass, you head away from the buffet to sip it — cold within and cold without, just like the pale elves themselves. What was that Ryn said about it? That you could get drunk without even realizing it? Oh well... this is the day to be merry, after all. Maybe you should have gotten some food to go with the wine... but this is just fine on its own, with its cool clear taste dancing on your tongue and cleansing your palate for anything you might care to sample next. |a large tureen of cold soup, kept chilled by virtue of sitting in a basin of crushed ice. It's certainly a novel way to serve soup, if nothing else — seeing you approach, the server at the table grabs a bowl from a pyramid on the other side of the table and fills it for you. The soup visibly flows from the ladle to bowl, and you can appreciate the thickness with which it runs, yet the lack of any visible lumpiness in the creamy liquid. "We hope you're enjoying the ball, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Though if you're planning to dance later on, do be careful not to overindulge. This is a day in Lumia's honor, after all — don't do anything that would put the Lady of Light to shame." You chuckle. The soup, please. If you might ask... "Of course, of course. Lobster, crab and shrimp fresh from the sea ice of the glacier, sauteed, strained and thickened with their ground shells. Adapted from a Belharan recipe from before Queen Atheldred's reign, although as you can see, we've changed it to suit our tastes considerably. Please, enjoy, and don't drink it all too quickly, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." When you leave with the bowl and try a spoonful, you can see why the server said as much. Maybe it's the ground shells and the cream in the soup or perhaps they used barley or some other grain to thicken it, but consistency of the creamy soup is such that you could almost bite down on it and chew. It'd be ridiculously easy to choke on something like this... and given how it was sitting in a basin of crushed ice but moments ago, the smoothness with which each savory spoonful goes down is something in and of itself. The taste of seafood and seasoning herbs fills your mouth and throat, and though it doesn't warm your body like hot soup would do, it nevertheless leaves a sense of calm contentment inside of you with each spoonful. If there were another more iconic soup to suit the pale elves, you wouldn't know what it is. You quickly finish off the soup proper, then pick at the seafood that remains on the bottom of the bowl — lobster, crab and shrimp, was it? Ah, it's all good. |a large serving dish of finely shredded salad — unlike the other tables, one of the chefs is out front, preparing the vegetables and tossing them in front of a rapt audience, while another of the palace staff serves up the mixed result. As far as you can tell, it's mostly cold weather vegetables — cabbage, onions, turnips and several other root vegetables that while not immediately recognisable look extremely starchy. You present your plate, and the server gives you a generous helping with a serving fork, sprinkling it with sea salt as a finish. "May the year to come bless you with Lumia's firstfruits, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Amidst the richness and revelry, we serve this simple salad to remind ourselves of our humble beginnings as a people." Ah, even this salad has meaning? "It's comprised of many of our staple crops, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. A subtle but important reminder that once this day is done, there's still the rest of the year to be had. Sweets and wines are fine this day, but we'd get sick having them every meal. Onions, cabbages, potatoes and beans — these are what fill the belly day to day. Unobtrusive and plain, but no less important, like the common folk are to the crown; a reminder from the Lady of Light for us to be humble even in our revelry, as it were. Please, keep this in mind as you enjoy the ice salad." You will. And when you leave the buffet to partake, you understand what he means; if there were any way to tell a story of humble simplicity through taste, this is it. The earthy taste of the raw vegetables, the starchy consistency of the shredded roots mixed with sea salt and several dashes of vinegar — entirely mundane ingredients in and of themselves, yet you feel fortified after several mouthfuls. Unobtrusive and plain, yes, but no less a part of the Midwinter Festivus proceedings than the sweets, cakes and wines. ] If you're still able to eat more after that, maybe another trip to the buffet table couldn't hurt, or maybe you have something else in mind? Noon is still a while away...
rows.translation: 你目光扫过舞厅西端的那些铺着天鹅绒的桌子，思考着该怎么做。精灵们在这些桌子周围忙碌着，从一端拿起盘子，然后排成一列，沿着桌子移动——这种做事方式或许有些奇怪，但其中确实体现了艾尔萨拉族的高效作风。宫殿里的工作人员在厨房之间来回穿梭，他们将空盘子收走，然后又端着装满食物的盘子回来；还有其他人则在为那些渴望品尝别人花钱准备的丰盛菜肴的人们服务。 [pc.ra elf |当你靠近时，人们向你礼貌地点头致意——尽管你一直保持着低调，但冬城的人们依然认识你。 |当你靠近时，虽然会引来许多好奇的目光，但冬城的人们却能够坦然面对这一切。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]这是人们第一次如此近距离地观察这位冠军。 ]他们礼貌地让开，让你能够走向那些桌子。 其中离你最近的那一张桌子就是你要去的。 [rand |一款厚实、呈深色的层状蛋糕，上面覆盖着奶油，还有几颗你从未见过的浅蓝色浆果。为你服务的精灵露出了灿烂的笑容，将两片厚厚的蛋糕放在你的盘子里——从那厚实的面团中散发出一丝淡淡的酒精气息。是厚实——当你将每一片蛋糕放入盘中时，你能真切感受到它们的重量，那种厚重感，正是蛋糕所具备的独特魅力。 “为了[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]根据我们的体质，每年这个时候的食物应该是用来补充营养、保暖的；在寒冷的天气里，人们很容易感到饥饿。” 不出所料，这种蛋糕甜度很高。当你离开自助餐区去品尝这种蛋糕时，你会发现它的甜味逐渐被用来制作蛋糕的葡萄酒的味道所掩盖。这块蛋糕的质地确实如看上去那样紧密，每次咬下去都需要用力咀嚼才能让面团分开，这与那种质地轻盈、带有水果香味的奶油形成了鲜明对比——那种奶油在牙齿间就能轻易被咬碎。 而当你将其咽下之后……哦，天哪。那种味道会留在你的胃里，像一块重型的枷锁一样让你一整天都感到不适。不过，这种味道确实很棒，尤其是当葡萄酒的味道还在你的舌头上回荡的时候！明天你可能会后悔的……但此刻，这两片层状蛋糕已经让你欲罢不能了，你甚至开始渴望再吃一些。 |一个托盘上摆放着大约二十几个小盘子，每个盘子上都似乎放着肉饼。肉饼的表面已经煎至金黄，上面还点缀着干果；空气中弥漫着淡淡的蜂蜜糖浆香味。服务生用双手将其中一个盘子放到你的盘子里，然后退后一步鞠了一躬。 “祝您节日愉快。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]也是给她准备的。你能问问这是什么吗？ “过去，当我们想要离开家去远行时，会带上足够吃一段时间的食物。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]古老荒野中的德鲁伊们精通利用森林中的肉类、脂肪和水果制作肉干的技术。随着这种制作方法在布尔阿尔瓦尔地区传播开来，人们在烹饪过程中加入了蜂蜜和香草，这样不仅能延长肉干的保存时间，还能显著提升其口感。最初，德鲁伊们会使用剃刀草的花蜜来提升肉干的风味，但这种材料对普通人来说实在难以获得。而在节日庆典中，人们会稍微调整制作方法，加入面包屑，使其更符合传统肉饼的制作标准。 自从卢米娅让我们将目光投向了那片辉煌的北方，我们就不再使用森林生物的肉和脂肪了，而是改用海豹和鲸鱼的肉与油脂。德鲁伊们也贡献了一些他们自制的食材……用来制作那种他们特有的食物……但不得不说，我们的做法确实更胜一筹。 你轻声笑了笑，点了点头，然后拿走自己的奖品去享用吧。那浓郁的油脂与蜂蜜糖浆的甜味搭配得天衣无缝，而那些煮得恰到好处的肉末所带来的鲜美滋味更是不容忽视。更不用说那些干果了…………从那些干瘪的果肉来看，这肯定不是什么浆果。杏子吗？很难说，因为那些混合在舌尖上的各种味道让人难以分辨，但这真的重要吗？显然，这道充满节日气氛的“肉饼”整体的味道远远超过了其组成部分所带来的效果，就像在这个冬季节日里出现的所有食物一样。非常啊……照这样下去，你很快就会发胖的。不过宫廷厨房做出的那些食物，无论是外观还是味道，都实在太诱人了…… |几大瓶精灵镜酒——在边境地区，这种酒更常被称为冰酒。甚至还有专门为孩子们准备的低浓度饮品，那个区域比你们所在的桌子那里还要拥挤。服务员微笑着，从刚打开的酒瓶中为您倒酒，还巧妙地等泡沫消退后再将酒杯倒满。 “在这个节日里，愿健康与卢米娅保佑您。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]也是为了他……但他专门为你打开了一瓶新的酒？ “别担心，冠军；这两瓶酒都是[etheryn.crowned |女王陛下 |摄政王 ]艾尔莎拉女士也特意为这个场合打开了酒窖。现在德鲁伊们回来了，我们就可以再次酿造镜像酒了——再也不用让厨房们限量分发这种酒了。我知道很多人还不太确定他们是否真的会回到我们身边，但只要能因此得到更多的镜像酒，我就完全赞成这个决定！嗯，你可以看出，他是个清楚自己想要什么的人。希望他身体健康，也愿卢米娅保佑他！ 服务器那边发出了笑声，你不禁怀疑，他是不是在上班的时候偷偷品尝那些酒瓶里的酒呢。谁又能责怪他呢？毕竟是毕竟，今天是仲冬节。你拿起酒杯，离开自助餐区开始品尝——酒液内外都透着寒意，就像那些肤色苍白的精灵们一样。小琳不是说过吗？喝这种酒甚至会不知不觉就喝醉……不过算了，今天本来就是欢乐的日子。或许应该再吃点东西搭配葡萄酒才对……不过单喝这种酒也完全没问题，它那清冽爽口的味道会在你的舌头上跳跃，为接下来你要品尝的任何食物做好准备。 |一大碗冷汤，因为盛放在装满碎冰的盆中而保持低温。这种上汤的方式确实很新颖——当你走近时，桌边的服务员会从桌子另一边的金字塔形容器中取出一碗汤来为你盛好。这碗汤的颜色看起来流畅地进行从勺子到碗，你可以感受到这种酱料的浓稠度，但与此同时，你也能够看到这种奶油状的液体中完全没有任何颗粒感或块状物。 “希望你们喜欢这种酱料，先生。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]不过，如果你之后打算跳舞的话，一定要注意不要喝得太多。毕竟今天是纪念Luma的日子——千万不要做出任何会让这位轻型之女士蒙羞的事情。” 你轻笑了一声，然后说道：“请给我来碗汤。如果你不介意的话…… “当然可以。这些龙虾、螃蟹和虾都是从冰川上的海冰中捕获的新鲜食材，经过翻炒处理后，再过滤去壳屑并加入浓稠的酱汁调味。这个食谱源自贝尔哈兰地区，在阿瑟尔德雷德女王统治之前就已经存在了，不过你们可以看到，我们根据自己的口味对它做了一些调整。请慢慢享用，别喝得太快，好吗？[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]当你拿着碗尝了一口之后，就会明白为什么服务员会那么说了。也许是因为汤里加入了磨碎的贝壳和奶油，又或许他们用了大麦或其他谷物来增加汤的浓稠度，但这种奶油状的汤质地实在太过浓稠，以至于你几乎觉得可以把它咬下去咀嚼用这样的东西来进食，真的会很容易被噎到……不过考虑到它之前是放在一盆碎冰中的，而现在每一口食物都能如此顺滑地进入喉咙，这种体验本身就已经很棒了。海鲜与调味香草的味道充斥着你的口腔与喉咙，虽然它无法像热汤那样温暖你的身体，但每一口都会让你内心感受到一种宁静与满足。 如果要为这些肤色苍白的精灵再设计一款更具象征意义的汤品，你恐怕也猜不出来那会是什么。你迅速喝完了汤，然后开始挑食碗底剩下的海鲜——是龙虾、螃蟹和虾吧？啊，没关系的。 |一大盘切得细碎的沙拉——与其他餐桌不同，这里有位厨师站在前面，当着观众们的目光准备蔬菜并将其拌匀，而另一位宫廷工作人员则负责将拌好的沙拉端上桌。从外观上看，这些菜肴主要是寒冷季节常见的蔬菜——卷心菜、洋葱、芜菁以及一些其他根茎类蔬菜。虽然它们看起来并不那么容易辨认，但实际上含有大量的淀粉。当你把盘子端到服务员面前时，他会用一份量足的餐具为你盛菜，最后还会撒上一些海盐作为点缀。 愿来年能赐予你卢米娅带来的首批成果与喜悦，我的朋友。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]在这一切丰盛与欢乐之中，我们端上这道简单的沙拉，是为了提醒我们自己——作为一个民族，我们的起点是多么的朴素。” 啊，就连这道沙拉也蕴含着意义吗？ “它是由我们许多主要的农作物制成的。[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]这是一个微妙而重要的提醒：虽然今天是这个特殊的日子，但一年中还有许多其他的日子等着我们。今天吃甜食和喝葡萄酒固然不错，但如果每顿饭都吃这些，反而会对身体造成伤害。而洋葱、卷心菜、土豆和豆类，这些才是我们日常生活中真正能够填饱肚子的食物。朴素无华，但却同样重要——就如同普通百姓对王室而言一样；这可以说是光明女神给我们的提醒，告诫我们在欢庆之时也要保持谦逊。在享用这份冰沙拉的时候，请务必记住这一点。你一定会明白的。当你离开自助餐区去品尝这些食物时，你就会理解他的意思了；如果有什么方式能够通过味道来讲述关于朴素与简单的故事，那就是这种方式了。新鲜蔬菜的泥土气息，切成丝的根茎所带有的淀粉质口感，再加上海盐和几滴醋——这些食材本身都非常普通，但当你品尝了几口之后，你会感到浑身充满力量。低调而朴素，的确如此，但它同样是冬季节日庆典中不可或缺的一部分，就像那些甜点、蛋糕和葡萄酒一样。 ] 如果吃完之后你还能再吃点东西，或许再去自助餐台吃一会儿也没关系吧？或者，你还有其他打算？距离中午还有段时间呢……

Elves mill about the tables, grabbing plates from one end and moving down in a line across the spread — it's a strange way of doing things, perhaps, but it does have the mark of Elthara's efficiency on it. The palace staff run to and fro from the kitchens, collecting empty serving dishes and returning with filled ones; others serve the many people eager to have their yearly taste of rich food at someone else's expense. The server at the table places one of the dishes on your plate with both hands, then steps back and bows. "A fair Festivus to m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." And to her as well. Might you ask what this is? "It used to be that when we wished to journey from our homes, we'd take food to last, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. The druids of the Old Wyld perfected the art of pemmican making with meat, fat and fruit from the forest, and as it spread to the boer'alvar as a people, we'd add honey and herbs during the cooking to not just help it last longer, but also greatly improve the taste. It used to be that the druids would add nectar of the razorcup flower for the best effects, but that was out of the reach of the common folk. For Festivus, the recipe changes slightly with the addition of breadcrumbs to make it a proper meatloaf. "Since Lumia has turned our eyes to the glorious north, we no longer use meat and fat from forest creatures, but seal and whale meat and blubber instead. The druids offered some of their own for the ball made in their fashion... but I still have to say that our way of doing things is better." You chuckle, nod, and carry away your prize to partake. The richness of the rendered blubber complements the sweetness of the honey glaze perfectly, and the savouriness of the well-done mincemeat is something to be said. That's not to speak of the dried fruit... it's certainly not any type of berry, judging by the shrivelled fruit segments. Apricots? It's hard to tell, given the medley of flavors dancing on your tongue, but does it matter? The whole of this festive meatloaf is clearly more than the sum of its parts, and like all the other food being toted around this Midwinter Festivus, very, very rich. Ah... at this rate, you'll be putting on weight before long. But everything the palace kitchens have come up with looks and smells so appealing... |several large bottles of elven mirrorwine — or as it's more commonly known in the Marches, ice wine. There's even a separate section with watered-down drink for the children, and that's even more crowded than the table you're at. The server beams at you and fills your glass from a freshly opened bottle, artfully letting the foam subside before topping it off. "Good health and Lumia bless you this Festivus, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." And to him. But... he opened a fresh bottle just for you? "Not to worry, champion; both [etheryn.crowned |Her Majesty |the regent ] and Lady Elthara have opened the wine cellars for the occasion. Now that the druids are back, we can make more mirrorwine again — there's no need for the kitchens to ration it out any further. I know that many people aren't completely sure about them coming back to us, but if it means more mirrorwine, I'm sold!" Well, you can see that he's a man who knows what he wants. Good health, and Lumia bless him too! The server grins, and you wonder if he isn't sampling from the bottles while on the job. And who can blame him? It is Festivus, after all. Taking your glass, you head away from the buffet to sip it — cold within and cold without, just like the pale elves themselves. What was that Ryn said about it? That you could get drunk without even realizing it? Oh well... this is the day to be merry, after all. Maybe you should have gotten some food to go with the wine... but this is just fine on its own, with its cool clear taste dancing on your tongue and cleansing your palate for anything you might care to sample next. |a large tureen of cold soup, kept chilled by virtue of sitting in a basin of crushed ice. It's certainly a novel way to serve soup, if nothing else — seeing you approach, the server at the table grabs a bowl from a pyramid on the other side of the table and fills it for you. The soup visibly flows from the ladle to bowl, and you can appreciate the thickness with which it runs, yet the lack of any visible lumpiness in the creamy liquid. "We hope you're enjoying the ball, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Though if you're planning to dance later on, do be careful not to overindulge. This is a day in Lumia's honor, after all — don't do anything that would put the Lady of Light to shame." You chuckle. The soup, please. If you might ask... "Of course, of course. Lobster, crab and shrimp fresh from the sea ice of the glacier, sauteed, strained and thickened with their ground shells. Adapted from a Belharan recipe from before Queen Atheldred's reign, although as you can see, we've changed it to suit our tastes considerably. Please, enjoy, and don't drink it all too quickly, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]." When you leave with the bowl and try a spoonful, you can see why the server said as much. Maybe it's the ground shells and the cream in the soup or perhaps they used barley or some other grain to thicken it, but consistency of the creamy soup is such that you could almost bite down on it and chew. It'd be ridiculously easy to choke on something like this... and given how it was sitting in a basin of crushed ice but moments ago, the smoothness with which each savory spoonful goes down is something in and of itself. The taste of seafood and seasoning herbs fills your mouth and throat, and though it doesn't warm your body like hot soup would do, it nevertheless leaves a sense of calm contentment inside of you with each spoonful. If there were another more iconic soup to suit the pale elves, you wouldn't know what it is. You quickly finish off the soup proper, then pick at the seafood that remains on the bottom of the bowl — lobster, crab and shrimp, was it? Ah, it's all good. |a large serving dish of finely shredded salad — unlike the other tables, one of the chefs is out front, preparing the vegetables and tossing them in front of a rapt audience, while another of the palace staff serves up the mixed result. As far as you can tell, it's mostly cold weather vegetables — cabbage, onions, turnips and several other root vegetables that while not immediately recognisable look extremely starchy. You present your plate, and the server gives you a generous helping with a serving fork, sprinkling it with sea salt as a finish. "May the year to come bless you with Lumia's firstfruits, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. Amidst the richness and revelry, we serve this simple salad to remind ourselves of our humble beginnings as a people." Ah, even this salad has meaning? "It's comprised of many of our staple crops, m'[pc.mf |lord |lady ]. A subtle but important reminder that once this day is done, there's still the rest of the year to be had. Sweets and wines are fine this day, but we'd get sick having them every meal. Onions, cabbages, potatoes and beans — these are what fill the belly day to day. Unobtrusive and plain, but no less important, like the common folk are to the crown; a reminder from the Lady of Light for us to be humble even in our revelry, as it were. Please, keep this in mind as you enjoy the ice salad." You will. And when you leave the buffet to partake, you understand what he means; if there were any way to tell a story of humble simplicity through taste, this is it. The earthy taste of the raw vegetables, the starchy consistency of the shredded roots mixed with sea salt and several dashes of vinegar — entirely mundane ingredients in and of themselves, yet you feel fortified after several mouthfuls. Unobtrusive and plain, yes, but no less a part of the Midwinter Festivus proceedings than the sweets, cakes and wines. ] If you're still able to eat more after that, maybe another trip to the buffet table couldn't hurt, or maybe you have something else in mind? Noon is still a while away... "

rows.original: [rand |With a loud final flourish, the ballroom band completes another tune, holds up their bows and horns, and bows to the general approbation of the crowd. Clapping along with the rest, you take the opportunity of the musical pause to sidle closer and get a better look at the band and its instruments. The twenty band members are all ageless boreal elves, long hair tied back carefully to keep it out of the way, standing on a temporary platform erected in the corner of the ballroom. Most of them are men, with a few half-sexed and amazonian women mixed in, and their clothes vary somewhat as to cut and design. Some of them even wear druidic outfits — maybe even are druids, which would be particularly shocking. No wonder Elthara had to spend so much time getting things ready, if both sections of the elven people contributed musicians to the same band! What unifies the band members isn't sex or style or, apparently, religion, but the sky-blue color of their garments. [pc.bg minstrel |It reminds you of the guilds and bardic orders down south, and the dye jobs that helped them stand out and identify their own; |Whatever the reason for it, ] if both druids and Lumians are wearing the same color, it must have a very long history indeed. Three different instruments are in evidence: a very long, thin wooden horn; a little flute; and a sort of fiddle with keys along the neck[pc.bg minstrel |, kind of like a hurdy-gurdy without the crank ]. As the elves retrieve their tools and prepare for the next piece, you find a place near the open space in front of the platform and perk your ears. The horn players begin, starting off one by one, each elf raising their instrument with surprising ease for its size; they must be made of lighter wood than you'd expected. Then come the fiddlers, stroking rougher than you'd expect from people with such complex, delicate instruments. Bows bounce off strings as they play, each note separated from the next by the briefest of pauses. And then come the flutists, all four of them weaving in and out of each other's tunes on slightly distinct lines, sometimes joining for a single note before diverging again. For such an elegant group of elves in such a fancy setting, the whole effect is surprisingly primal, or at least rustic, the sort of sound that evokes a camp in the Frostwood rather than the refinement of the palace. Maybe that's the point: to reach back into the city's past to find tunes from the era before the schism. Or maybe it's not about consciously putting the druids at ease at all — maybe the long-lived Winter City elves really haven't changed their musical tastes all that much. For the boer'alvar, after all, two and a half centuries can pass... well, not quite in the blink of an eye, but quickly enough that they don't see it as the primordial, inaccessible past as much as humans or lupines or even wyld elves would. Even if you wouldn't call the elves' music refined, it's certainly not simple. The flutes weave into and out of difficult scales, up and down in rapid succession, dancing through different motifs and themes that still, somehow, manage to retain a little of the same music idea: a note frequently returned to, a progression. And when the flutists recede into the background and let the fiddlers take the lead, the different fiddlers compete in traditional festival style, with two players dueling in increasingly-complex patterns while their fellows maintain a thrumming tremolo baseline. You can just imagine fiddle competitions much like this one between elven players in the market square... or, y'know, around a Frostwood campfire. Once again, the horn players signal the end to the piece, and the nearby knots of ballroom guests clap appreciatively alongside you — some of the fur-clad druids loudest of all. Horn and flute players lower their instruments and recover their chops, and fiddlers give their fingers a rest. You, however, let the echoes of the melody linger in your head for a bit. It wasn't what you'd have expected from the Winter City elves, but it sounded pretty good, all in all. Whether the primal tunes were a conscious attempt to reach out to the druids or the natural expression of Lumian musical culture, they seem to have worked. Music can bring people together... but good music, like this, makes it much easier. |Through the crowd, you can see little points of light bobbing up and down at the adult elves' chest level. They're tiny flames — real ones — affixed to crowns worn by little berobed elven girls, all of about early teenage appearance and all smiling beatifically. Each girl looks like a little Lumia in her little getup of white robe and red sash, a princess of light bearing good tidings and goodwill to the rest of the gathering. And each has an entourage of other, younger children, some dressed up in the same robe sans sash and crown, others bearing little painted wooden suns on sticks, and still others (mostly boys) dressed as... you'd guess orcs, maybe, or hill trolls? [var0 |They're certainly not as massive as old Benny was, but their masks reproduce his grotesque looks — in fact, they're even more baroque and gruesome than you remember him being. ] One little procession led by a nervously-smiling adolescent Lumia comes right up to you; you can tell that some of the younger children behind her are egging her on quietly and jabbing her in the back. They clearly know who you are[flags.DELANEL_MET |, and you can see why: your marketplace friend Delanel is in the group, vibrating with excitement as he holds his little sun-stick ]. Anxiously, the young Lumia lookalike holds out a platter of buns to you. "Fair F-Festivus, y-your Worship! Um..." she stammers. "[silly |Allow me to offer you a lumenkatte in these trying times. |W-would you care for a lumenkatte? It's still fresh and warm... ]" Some of her fellows giggle into their mouths as she talks, but most of them keep their supportive smiles. Aww. Sure, you'd love to have one of these buns. They smell delightful. What'd she call them? "Lumenkatter!" she says excitedly, relieved that you're acting like a normal adult and not some eldritch meanie from beyond the walls. "Um, Lumia's cats. Because each one looks like [pc.ra leothran catfolk |a tail, just like y-yours |a leothran's tail ]!" They certainly do. Each bun twists in on itself in an S shape; you're not quite sure what cats have to do with Lumia rather than, say, Mallach, but then again the boer'alvar see Lumia as an elf rather than a human, so who knows? You hover over the buns for a few seconds, admiring their golden-brown coloration, and select one from the [pc.isChamp |edge |middle ] of the platter. Conscious of the kiddos' expectant stares, you try a bite of the warm, toasty bun. Mmm! It's very sweet, with a bit of... saffron? That must've been what you smelled earlier — and must be why it's got that wonderful golden color. The rest of the warm, airy bun goes down very easily after that, like nothing at all, leaving a lovely aftertaste on the middle of your tongue. The kiddos' expectant smiles turn into outright beams when you inform them that the lumenkatte was very tasty. By the way, what's the story behind their little outfits? You guess that the girl in the lead is Lumia, but who's everybody else? After some prodding, one of the other robed girls pipes up, "I'm, um, I'm one of Lumia's handmaidens!" "And I'm a sun bearer," says [flags.DELANEL_MET |little Del |a blonde boy ] as he proudly waves his stick. "I'm here so we can all see!" [flags.DELANEL_MET |You tousle your sun-bearing buddy's hair in appreciation. | ]That's cute! What about the boys in the troll outfits? One of them attempts a deep growl in the kind of high, little-boy's voice that wouldn't convince anybody and is all the more adorable for it. "I get to hide in the darkness an' act all mean to people! But it's okay," he continues pensively, "'cause they give me porridge to keep me happy an' stuff so I don't hurt anybody." "And later, at night," says the Lumia in the lead, "we get to bring each other gifts! L-like carved wargs and little bells and candy!" That might be the sweetest custom you've ever heard of[pc.bg acolyte |; you're quite familiar with the religious observances of the south, of course, but none of them are quite like this! |. ] It's a shame you can't spend more time chatting with the kiddos, but you don't want to let the little cakes get cold before other people have a chance to eat them. You thank them for the food and the explanation, and wish them well. "You too, [pc.mf |Lord |Lady ] Shampion! Th' blessings of the Dawn Maiden be on you, an' may the Wyld be good!" |You turn your attention to the magnificent evergreen tree, branches lit with a thousand points of light, and the mighty statue of elven Lumia beside it. Reeling around the base in a great circle is a huge gathering of elves, mostly in the garb of the Winter City rather than druidic furs, all holding hands as they dance around the tree. Out here in the gardens, it's hard to hear the ballroom musicians, so instead the elves frolic — for, as much as Hethia might sneer at the notion, that is what they're doing — to the light airs played by a few fiddlers set up near one of the garden hedges. The lighting of the candles against the multicolored array of boreal elves in their blues and purples and pinks combines with the upbeat music and the laughter to lend the whole scene a cheerful, festive air. What's most surprising, though, is that even though the revelers are mostly Lumians, a few druids are also joining hands and getting in on the action. And judging by the number of fur-clad kibitzers hovering around the edges of the gathering, they won't be alone for long. You pass by a knot of druids with glasses full (or, rather, somewhat-less-than-full) of mirrorwine humming along to the music and tapping out the beat; the druids know these songs just as well as the Lumians do, after all. One song ends, and the revelers unlink hands to clap and cheer. The crowd shifts in and out as new elves brush past you to take the place of those dropping out for the next song, while the fiddlers pause to rest their fingers and agree on the next song. One particularly inebriated — er, boisterous — group of Lumians approaches you and the druids, greets you cheerfully in boer'alvarin and accented Belharan, and holds out their hands to offer you a place by the tree. A few of the druids grin reluctantly, pass off their drink glasses, and allow themselves to be led into place. And you know what? You might as well, too. A female druid laughing in spite of herself and a big bearded Lumian with children in tow take you by either hand and add you to the ring, and the whole crowd of you waits for the band to start playing. The first few notes clue your fellow merrymakers into the next song; they all know these pieces by heart from many a Festivus past. For them, the songs are a common cultural touchstone, a place for them all to come back to and embrace the ties that bind them. Even if you don't have that cultural memory — even if you don't even know the songs — that's fine; keeping your eyes on the elf in front of you, you start to develop a sense for how to skip and dance, anticipate the changes in rhythm, and even reverse directions at the appropriate moments. [pc.bg minstrel |Your long musical experience makes it particularly easy, and soon you're frolicking with the best of them, adding flourishes and showing off for the onlookers as best you can |It's a bit of a trial to keep up with everybody, but the song's long enough and simple enough for you to manage ]. The important part about the revelry isn't nailing the dance steps perfectly, after all. Half the adult elves are a little tipsy, and half the children are giggling so much that they miss their steps. What's important is holding hands and dancing together, losing yourself in the camaraderie and the music and the holiday cheer. Eventually, the song ends, and you clap along with the others as the fiddlers take their customary pause. Your unknown dance partners give you a squeeze of the hand and a cheerful smile before disappearing into the throng, and with a goofy grin plastered on your face, you head back out yourself. As you pass the crew of druids you'd been next to earlier, you overhear a little of the conversation between the freshly-returned revelers and their spectating friends. "I don't know if I'll ever get used to that statue, and the tree isn't quite a juniper bush," murmurs one half-sexed woman as she takes her mirrorwine glass back. "But it's nice to hear the same old songs." Her partner chuckles. "And the kids love it, too." "Ha. I'll drink to that." ]
rows.translation: [rand |随着最后一个激昂的乐章的结束，乐队演奏完了另一首曲子，他们举起弓和号角，向观众鞠躬致意，赢得了大家的一致好评。你也跟着其他人一起鼓掌，趁着音乐暂停的时机，悄悄靠近一些，仔细观察这个乐队以及他们的乐器。 这二十名乐队成员都是永葆青春的北方精灵，他们将长发仔细地束在身后，以免妨碍演奏。他们站在舞厅角落搭建的临时舞台上。其中大部分是男性，也有少数半阴半阳或体格强壮的女性成员，他们的服装在款式和设计上各有不同。其中一些人甚至穿着德鲁伊风格的服装——也许甚至是德鲁伊们，这简直太令人震惊了。难怪艾尔萨拉要花费这么多时间来准备一切——如果精灵族的两个分支都派乐手加入同一个乐队的话！将这些乐队成员团结在一起的不是性别、风格，显然也不是宗教，而是他们服装上那天空般的蓝色。 [pc.bg minstrel |这让人联想到南方那些行会与吟游士组织，以及那些帮助他们脱颖而出、彰显自身特色的染色工艺。 |无论原因是什么， ]如果德鲁伊和卢米安人都穿着同一种颜色的服装，那么这种传统肯定有着非常悠久的历史。现场出现了三种不同的乐器：一种长而细的木制号角、一支小笛子，以及一种颈部装有按键的类似小提琴的乐器。[pc.bg minstrel |有点像一种没有曲柄的旋转装置。 ]当精灵们拿起工具，准备开始下一阶段的任务时，你在平台前的空地上找了个地方，竖起耳朵仔细聆听。 号手们开始演奏了，他们一个接一个地加入进来。每个精灵演奏乐器时都显得异常轻松，考虑到乐器的体积，这实在令人惊讶——这些乐器肯定是用比你想象中更轻质的木材制成的。接着是那些小提琴手，他们拉琴时的手法比你想象中要粗犷得多——毕竟这些乐器本应需要极其细腻、精准的操控。他们在演奏时，琴弓不断在琴弦上跳动，每个音符之间都只隔着极短的停顿。然后是那些长笛手，四个人各自演奏着略有不同的旋律，时而相互交织，时而共同演奏一个音符，随后又再次分道扬镳。 对于这样一群身着华丽服饰的精灵，身处如此精致的环境中，整体营造出的效果却出人意料地原始，或者说带有乡土气息——这种音乐更让人联想到霜木林中的营地，而非宫殿里的奢华氛围。或许这正是作者的意图：通过这些音乐，让人们回溯这座城市的历史，重温分裂之前的时代。或者，其实根本不是为了刻意让德鲁伊们感到放松——也许那些长寿的冬城精灵，他们的音乐品味其实并没有发生太大的变化。毕竟，对于那些“布尔阿尔瓦人”来说，两个半世纪的时间，其实也只不过是一瞬而已。嗯，虽然不能说是一眨眼就发生了，但速度确实快到让他们无法将这一过程视为与人类、狼族甚至野精灵所理解的那种原始的、无法触及的过去。 即使你不会称精灵们的音乐为精致，但它确实不简单。那些长笛声在复杂的音阶中穿梭往复，急速地上下跳跃，演绎出各种不同的旋律主题，然而这些变化却始终保持着某种统一的音乐脉络：某个反复出现的音符，以及某种特定的旋律进展方式。当长笛手们退到幕后，让小提琴手们担起主角角色时，这些不同乐器的小提琴手们会以传统节日风格的表演方式展开竞争。其中会有两位演奏者进行对决，他们演奏的乐谱会变得越来越复杂，而其他小提琴手则会持续保持着那种低沉而连绵的颤音背景音。你可以想象，在市场广场上，或者是在霜木营地的篝火旁，精灵玩家们会举行这样的小提琴比赛…… 再一次，号手们发出了表示乐曲结束的信号，周围的舞会宾客也纷纷鼓起掌来表示赞赏——其中那些穿着毛皮服饰的德鲁伊们更是拍得最为热烈。号手和长笛演奏者们放下了乐器，休息了一下；而小提琴手们也让手指得到了片刻的休息。然而，这段旋律的余音却在你的脑海中久久回荡。这并不是你对冬城精灵们的期待，但总体来说，听起来确实相当不错。无论这些原始的音乐旋律是精灵们有意尝试与德鲁伊们建立联系的结果，还是卢米安音乐文化的自然体现，它们显然都取得了成功。音乐能够将人们凝聚在一起……而像这样的优秀音乐，更是让这种凝聚变得更加容易。 |在人群中，你可以看到一些小小的光点在成年精灵们的胸前上下闪烁。那些其实是真正的火焰，它们被固定在一些穿着短袍的年轻精灵女孩们的皇冠上。这些女孩们都还处于青少年早期阶段，脸上都挂着幸福的笑容。每个女孩都穿着白色的长袍和红色的腰带，看起来就像一个个小小的卢米娅手机，就像是光明的公主，为在场的所有人带来美好的消息与祝福。而且，每个女孩身边都跟着一群年纪更小的孩子：有些孩子也穿着同样的长袍，但没有腰带和皇冠；有些孩子则拿着用木头做的小太阳玩具；还有些孩子（大多是男孩）也穿着类似的服装。…你可能会猜是兽人，或者说是山巨魔吧？ [var0 |虽然它们肯定没有老本尼那么庞大，但这些面具完美地再现了他那怪异的外貌——事实上，它们甚至比你记忆中的他还要夸张、恐怖。 ] 一支由一位面带紧张微笑的青少年卢米娅带领的小队伍走到了你面前；你可以看出，她身后的一些年幼的孩子正在小声地怂恿她，还不时地戳她的后背。他们显然知道你是谁。[flags.DELANEL_MET |你可以理解其中的原因：你的市场伙伴德拉内尔也在这个团队里，他兴奋地拿着他的小太阳棒，不停地振动着。 ]那个长相与年轻的卢米娅相似的女孩急切地递给你一盘小面包。“节日快乐，尊贵的……呃……”她结结巴巴地说道。[silly |在这艰难的时刻，容我为您献上一份慰藉。 |你想来点卢门卡特吗？它还是新鲜热乎的…… ]当她说话时，她的一些同伴忍不住暗自发笑，但大多数人都保持着支持她的微笑。 “哇，当然了，你肯定也想拥有这样一个面包吧？它们的香味真是太诱人了……她把它们叫什么来着？” “流明猫r！”她兴奋地回答道，心里暗自松了口气——因为你表现得像个正常的成年人，而不是那些来自墙外的邪恶怪物。“嗯，其实就是Luma的猫们……因为每一只看起来都[pc.ra leothran catfolk |一条尾巴，就像你……的尾巴一样。 |利奥斯兰的尾巴 ]确实如此。每一个小面包都呈S形弯曲着；你其实不太明白猫和卢米娅有什么关系，而不是比如说和马拉克有什么关联……不过，那些布尔阿尔瓦人把卢米娅看作是精灵而不是人类，所以谁又能知道呢？你在那些小面包上方悬停了几秒钟，欣赏它们那金棕色的外观，随后从盘子的[pc.isChamp |边缘 |中间 ]挑了一个。注意到孩子们充满期待的目光，你尝了一口那温热、香脆的小面包。嗯！它非常甜，还带有一丝……藏红花的味道？刚才闻到的香味肯定就是这个，也难怪它会呈现出那种美妙的金色。在尝过那美味的面包之后，剩下的部分也会非常容易地被吃掉，完全不会让人觉得有什么困难，而且会在你的舌头上留下美妙的余味。 当你告诉孩子们这种面包非常美味时，他们原本充满期待的笑容会立刻变成灿烂的笑脸。顺便问一下，他们那些奇特服装背后有什么故事呢？你们应该能猜到走在最前面的那个女孩是卢米娅，但其他的人分别是谁呢？ 在大家的追问下，其中一个穿着长袍的女孩终于开口了：“我，嗯，我是卢米娅的侍女之一！而我，就是那个肩负光明之人，”他说。 [flags.DELANEL_MET |小德尔 |一个金发男孩 ]他骄傲地挥舞着手杖，说道：“我在这里，就是为了让大家都能看到！ [flags.DELANEL_MET |你轻轻拨弄着那位拥有阳光般灿烂头发的伙伴的头发，以此表达你的赞赏之情。 | ]太可爱了！那些穿着滑稽服装的男孩们怎么样呢？ 其中一个人试图用那种高亢的、小孩子般的嗓音发出低沉的吼声，但这样的声音根本无法让人信服，反而更加惹人发笑。“我可以躲在黑暗中，对人们做出一些恶作剧呢！不过没关系，”他若有所思地继续说道，“因为他们会给我粥吃，让我保持开心，还会做些其他事情，这样我就不会伤害到任何人了。” “然后到了晚上，”领头的卢米娅说，“我们还可以互相送礼物呢！ L形的雕刻狼族模型，还有小铃铛和糖果！” 这或许是你听过的最有趣的习俗了。[pc.bg acolyte |你当然对南方的宗教习俗非常熟悉，但其中没有任何一种习俗是像这样的！ |。 ]真遗憾你不能多花些时间和小孩子们聊天，但你也不想让那些小蛋糕在别人有机会吃之前就凉掉。你感谢他们提供的食物和解释，同时也祝他们一切顺利。 “你也是。 [pc.mf |大人 |女士 ]冠军！愿黎明女神的祝福降临在你身上，也愿荒野永远与你同在，赐你平安与好运！ |你的目光被那棵巍峨的常绿树吸引住了——它的树枝上闪烁着数千点光芒，而树旁还矗立着那座雄伟的精灵卢米娅雕像。在树基周围，一大群精灵正围成一个大圈跳舞。他们大多穿着冬季城市的服饰，而不是德鲁伊风格的皮毛装束，大家手拉手，围绕着那棵树欢快地旋转着。在这片花园里，几乎听不到舞厅里的音乐声，因此精灵们便在几名小提琴手在花园树篱旁演奏的轻快旋律中嬉戏玩耍——尽管赫希娅可能会对此嗤之以鼻，但事实确实如此。蜡烛的光芒与那些身着蓝色、紫色和粉色服饰的极北精灵们共同营造出绚丽的视觉效果，再加上欢快的音乐和人们的笑声，使得整个场景充满了欢乐与节日的氛围。 然而，最令人惊讶的是——尽管参加庆祝活动的人大多数都是卢米安人，但其中也有几位德鲁伊。此外他们携手并肩，积极参与其中。从那些穿着毛皮衣服、在聚会边缘徘徊的人群数量来看，他们很快就不会孤单了。你路过一群德鲁伊，他们手中的酒杯里装着镜像酒——当然，酒杯里的酒已经不多了——他们跟着音乐哼唱，同时打着节拍；毕竟，这些歌曲德鲁伊们和卢米安人一样熟悉。 一首歌结束了，欢庆的人们松开手来，开始鼓掌欢呼。人群不断流动着：新的精灵们从你身边经过，取代了那些因为下一首歌而离开的人；而那些弹奏小提琴的人则暂停演奏，让手指得到休息，同时商量接下来要演奏哪首歌。有一个人醉得特别厉害——呃喧闹的一群卢米安人走到你和那些德鲁伊身边，用带有贝拉兰口音的博尔阿尔瓦林语热情地向你们打招呼，然后伸出手，请你们到树旁坐下。其中一些德鲁伊虽然不情愿，但还是笑了笑，将自己的酒杯递了出去，随后跟着他们坐到了指定的位置。你知道吗？你其实也可以加入他们。一位女性德鲁伊强忍笑意，还有那位留着大胡子的卢米安带着孩子们，会牵着你的手，让你也加入这个圈子，然后你们所有人一起等待乐队的演奏开始。 最初的几音符就为其他欢庆的人们指明了下一首歌的方向；他们所有人都因为过去参加过无数次这样的庆典活动而对这些曲目了如指掌。对他们来说，这些歌曲是一种共同的文化象征，是一个让他们能够回想起彼此、重温那些将他们紧密联系在一起的纽带的地方。即使你没有那种文化记忆——即使你甚至不认识那些歌曲——也没关系；只要注视着眼前的精灵，你就能逐渐掌握如何跳跃、如何跳舞，学会预判节奏的变化，甚至在适当的时机改变移动方向。 [pc.bg minstrel |由于你拥有丰富的音乐经验，因此这项任务对你来说格外轻松。很快，你就能够与最优秀的演奏者们一起尽情演奏，添加各种华丽的装饰性乐段，并尽自己最大的努力为在场的观众们展示自己的才华。 |要跟上所有人的节奏确实有点困难，但这首歌的长度和难度都适中，你应该能够跟上。 ]说到底，这场狂欢活动中最重要的并不是把舞步跳得完美无缺。毕竟，有一半的成年精灵都有点微醺，而有一半的孩子们笑得太过开心，甚至忘记了自己的舞步。真正重要的是手拉手一起跳舞。一起沉浸在那种友谊、音乐以及节日的欢乐氛围之中，你完全忘却了自我。 最终，歌曲结束了，当小提琴手们按照惯例暂停演奏时，你也和其他人一起鼓起了掌。那些你不认识的舞伴们与你握了握手，露出了愉快的笑容，然后又消失在人群中。而你，脸上带着傻乎乎的笑容，也继续回到了人群中。当你经过刚才还站在你身边的那些德鲁伊们时，你无意中听到了那些刚刚归来的狂欢者们与他们旁观的朋友们之间的对话。 “我不知道自己是否能够习惯那座雕像……而且那棵树也根本算不上是杜松灌木吧，”一位有着双性特征的妇女边说边把她的镜酒杯拿了回去。不过，听到那些老歌还是挺让人开心的。” 她的伴侣轻笑了一声：“孩子们也很喜欢这些歌呢。” “哈，那我就干杯。 ]
rows.raw: " [rand |With a loud final flourish, the ballroom band completes another tune, holds up their bows and horns, and bows to the general approbation of the crowd. Clapping along with the rest, you take the opportunity of the musical pause to sidle closer and get a better look at the band and its instruments. The twenty band members are all ageless boreal elves, long hair tied back carefully to keep it out of the way, standing on a temporary platform erected in the corner of the ballroom. Most of them are men, with a few half-sexed and amazonian women mixed in, and their clothes vary somewhat as to cut and design. Some of them even wear druidic outfits — maybe even are druids, which would be particularly shocking. No wonder Elthara had to spend so much time getting things ready, if both sections of the elven people contributed musicians to the same band! What unifies the band members isn't sex or style or, apparently, religion, but the sky-blue color of their garments. [pc.bg minstrel |It reminds you of the guilds and bardic orders down south, and the dye jobs that helped them stand out and identify their own; |Whatever the reason for it, ] if both druids and Lumians are wearing the same color, it must have a very long history indeed. Three different instruments are in evidence: a very long, thin wooden horn; a little flute; and a sort of fiddle with keys along the neck[pc.bg minstrel |, kind of like a hurdy-gurdy without the crank ]. As the elves retrieve their tools and prepare for the next piece, you find a place near the open space in front of the platform and perk your ears. The horn players begin, starting off one by one, each elf raising their instrument with surprising ease for its size; they must be made of lighter wood than you'd expected. Then come the fiddlers, stroking rougher than you'd expect from people with such complex, delicate instruments. Bows bounce off strings as they play, each note separated from the next by the briefest of pauses. And then come the flutists, all four of them weaving in and out of each other's tunes on slightly distinct lines, sometimes joining for a single note before diverging again. For such an elegant group of elves in such a fancy setting, the whole effect is surprisingly primal, or at least rustic, the sort of sound that evokes a camp in the Frostwood rather than the refinement of the palace. Maybe that's the point: to reach back into the city's past to find tunes from the era before the schism. Or maybe it's not about consciously putting the druids at ease at all — maybe the long-lived Winter City elves really haven't changed their musical tastes all that much. For the boer'alvar, after all, two and a half centuries can pass... well, not quite in the blink of an eye, but quickly enough that they don't see it as the primordial, inaccessible past as much as humans or lupines or even wyld elves would. Even if you wouldn't call the elves' music refined, it's certainly not simple. The flutes weave into and out of difficult scales, up and down in rapid succession, dancing through different motifs and themes that still, somehow, manage to retain a little of the same music idea: a note frequently returned to, a progression. And when the flutists recede into the background and let the fiddlers take the lead, the different fiddlers compete in traditional festival style, with two players dueling in increasingly-complex patterns while their fellows maintain a thrumming tremolo baseline. You can just imagine fiddle competitions much like this one between elven players in the market square... or, y'know, around a Frostwood campfire. Once again, the horn players signal the end to the piece, and the nearby knots of ballroom guests clap appreciatively alongside you — some of the fur-clad druids loudest of all. Horn and flute players lower their instruments and recover their chops, and fiddlers give their fingers a rest. You, however, let the echoes of the melody linger in your head for a bit. It wasn't what you'd have expected from the Winter City elves, but it sounded pretty good, all in all. Whether the primal tunes were a conscious attempt to reach out to the druids or the natural expression of Lumian musical culture, they seem to have worked. Music can bring people together... but good music, like this, makes it much easier. |Through the crowd, you can see little points of light bobbing up and down at the adult elves' chest level. They're tiny flames — real ones — affixed to crowns worn by little berobed elven girls, all of about early teenage appearance and all smiling beatifically. Each girl looks like a little Lumia in her little getup of white robe and red sash, a princess of light bearing good tidings and goodwill to the rest of the gathering. And each has an entourage of other, younger children, some dressed up in the same robe sans sash and crown, others bearing little painted wooden suns on sticks, and still others (mostly boys) dressed as... you'd guess orcs, maybe, or hill trolls? [var0 |They're certainly not as massive as old Benny was, but their masks reproduce his grotesque looks — in fact, they're even more baroque and gruesome than you remember him being. ] One little procession led by a nervously-smiling adolescent Lumia comes right up to you; you can tell that some of the younger children behind her are egging her on quietly and jabbing her in the back. They clearly know who you are[flags.DELANEL_MET |, and you can see why: your marketplace friend Delanel is in the group, vibrating with excitement as he holds his little sun-stick ]. Anxiously, the young Lumia lookalike holds out a platter of buns to you. "Fair F-Festivus, y-your Worship! Um..." she stammers. "[silly |Allow me to offer you a lumenkatte in these trying times. |W-would you care for a lumenkatte? It's still fresh and warm... ]" Some of her fellows giggle into their mouths as she talks, but most of them keep their supportive smiles. Aww. Sure, you'd love to have one of these buns. They smell delightful. What'd she call them? "Lumenkatter!" she says excitedly, relieved that you're acting like a normal adult and not some eldritch meanie from beyond the walls. "Um, Lumia's cats. Because each one looks like [pc.ra leothran catfolk |a tail, just like y-yours |a leothran's tail ]!" They certainly do. Each bun twists in on itself in an S shape; you're not quite sure what cats have to do with Lumia rather than, say, Mallach, but then again the boer'alvar see Lumia as an elf rather than a human, so who knows? You hover over the buns for a few seconds, admiring their golden-brown coloration, and select one from the [pc.isChamp |edge |middle ] of the platter. Conscious of the kiddos' expectant stares, you try a bite of the warm, toasty bun. Mmm! It's very sweet, with a bit of... saffron? That must've been what you smelled earlier — and must be why it's got that wonderful golden color. The rest of the warm, airy bun goes down very easily after that, like nothing at all, leaving a lovely aftertaste on the middle of your tongue. The kiddos' expectant smiles turn into outright beams when you inform them that the lumenkatte was very tasty. By the way, what's the story behind their little outfits? You guess that the girl in the lead is Lumia, but who's everybody else? After some prodding, one of the other robed girls pipes up, "I'm, um, I'm one of Lumia's handmaidens!" "And I'm a sun bearer," says [flags.DELANEL_MET |little Del |a blonde boy ] as he proudly waves his stick. "I'm here so we can all see!" [flags.DELANEL_MET |You tousle your sun-bearing buddy's hair in appreciation. | ]That's cute! What about the boys in the troll outfits? One of them attempts a deep growl in the kind of high, little-boy's voice that wouldn't convince anybody and is all the more adorable for it. "I get to hide in the darkness an' act all mean to people! But it's okay," he continues pensively, "'cause they give me porridge to keep me happy an' stuff so I don't hurt anybody." "And later, at night," says the Lumia in the lead, "we get to bring each other gifts! L-like carved wargs and little bells and candy!" That might be the sweetest custom you've ever heard of[pc.bg acolyte |; you're quite familiar with the religious observances of the south, of course, but none of them are quite like this! |. ] It's a shame you can't spend more time chatting with the kiddos, but you don't want to let the little cakes get cold before other people have a chance to eat them. You thank them for the food and the explanation, and wish them well. "You too, [pc.mf |Lord |Lady ] Shampion! Th' blessings of the Dawn Maiden be on you, an' may the Wyld be good!" |You turn your attention to the magnificent evergreen tree, branches lit with a thousand points of light, and the mighty statue of elven Lumia beside it. Reeling around the base in a great circle is a huge gathering of elves, mostly in the garb of the Winter City rather than druidic furs, all holding hands as they dance around the tree. Out here in the gardens, it's hard to hear the ballroom musicians, so instead the elves frolic — for, as much as Hethia might sneer at the notion, that is what they're doing — to the light airs played by a few fiddlers set up near one of the garden hedges. The lighting of the candles against the multicolored array of boreal elves in their blues and purples and pinks combines with the upbeat music and the laughter to lend the whole scene a cheerful, festive air. What's most surprising, though, is that even though the revelers are mostly Lumians, a few druids are also joining hands and getting in on the action. And judging by the number of fur-clad kibitzers hovering around the edges of the gathering, they won't be alone for long. You pass by a knot of druids with glasses full (or, rather, somewhat-less-than-full) of mirrorwine humming along to the music and tapping out the beat; the druids know these songs just as well as the Lumians do, after all. One song ends, and the revelers unlink hands to clap and cheer. The crowd shifts in and out as new elves brush past you to take the place of those dropping out for the next song, while the fiddlers pause to rest their fingers and agree on the next song. One particularly inebriated — er, boisterous — group of Lumians approaches you and the druids, greets you cheerfully in boer'alvarin and accented Belharan, and holds out their hands to offer you a place by the tree. A few of the druids grin reluctantly, pass off their drink glasses, and allow themselves to be led into place. And you know what? You might as well, too. A female druid laughing in spite of herself and a big bearded Lumian with children in tow take you by either hand and add you to the ring, and the whole crowd of you waits for the band to start playing. The first few notes clue your fellow merrymakers into the next song; they all know these pieces by heart from many a Festivus past. For them, the songs are a common cultural touchstone, a place for them all to come back to and embrace the ties that bind them. Even if you don't have that cultural memory — even if you don't even know the songs — that's fine; keeping your eyes on the elf in front of you, you start to develop a sense for how to skip and dance, anticipate the changes in rhythm, and even reverse directions at the appropriate moments. [pc.bg minstrel |Your long musical experience makes it particularly easy, and soon you're frolicking with the best of them, adding flourishes and showing off for the onlookers as best you can |It's a bit of a trial to keep up with everybody, but the song's long enough and simple enough for you to manage ]. The important part about the revelry isn't nailing the dance steps perfectly, after all. Half the adult elves are a little tipsy, and half the children are giggling so much that they miss their steps. What's important is holding hands and dancing together, losing yourself in the camaraderie and the music and the holiday cheer. Eventually, the song ends, and you clap along with the others as the fiddlers take their customary pause. Your unknown dance partners give you a squeeze of the hand and a cheerful smile before disappearing into the throng, and with a goofy grin plastered on your face, you head back out yourself. As you pass the crew of druids you'd been next to earlier, you overhear a little of the conversation between the freshly-returned revelers and their spectating friends. "I don't know if I'll ever get used to that statue, and the tree isn't quite a juniper bush," murmurs one half-sexed woman as she takes her mirrorwine glass back. "But it's nice to hear the same old songs." Her partner chuckles. "And the kids love it, too." "Ha. I'll drink to that." ] "

rows.original:
You sweep your gaze about the crowded ballroom — while the place is absolutely packed with pale elves of all kinds, you also note that the Winter City's populace has naturally separated itself into various cliques. Knowing this, it turns the job of finding someone from a needle in a haystack to a needle in a sewing kit — still not easy by far, but manageable.

    Is there anyone you were thinking of finding in particular?
rows.translation:
你环顾着这个拥挤的舞厅——虽然这里到处都是各种肤色苍白的精灵，但你也注意到，冬城的人们自然而然地分成了不同的派系。知道了这一点，要在这个“大海捞针”的环境中找到某个人，其实就相当于在“针线包里找针”——虽然仍然不容易，但至少还是可行的。

    那么，有没有某个人是你特别想找到的呢？

rows.original: Finding Ryn isn't hard in all of this. Your companion is [etheryn.lnhConfidence |doing her best to keep her composure |reasonably comfortable in her role |effortlessly projecting her royal presence ] as elven[etheryn.crowned |queen | regent ], mingling with the people of the Winter City as she works her rounds through the ballroom. Upon seeing you, Ryn waves you over with a smile; the people she's talking to at the moment bow and retreat to give you your space.[etheryn.lowConfidence | When the two of you are as alone as can be amidst the throng of elves, she sighs and sags, letting just a little of her stutter creep back into her words. This must be tough on her. "Are you h-having fun at the party? There's still some time before noon, so you should enjoy everything that Elthara's organised while the f-festivities are in full swing. If there's anything I can do... I'd feel p-personally responsible if you accepted my invitation and ended up not liking the ball | "A[silly |nother Festivus! What a time. A ]re you having fun at the party? There's still some time before noon, so you should enjoy everything that Elthara's organised while the festivities are in full swing. If there's anything I can do... I'd feel personally responsible if you accepted my invitation and ended up not liking the ball ]." Oh no, everything's been really great so far. She's been pretty great so far, inasmuch as you understand these things. But enough about you — how's she been holding up in her queenly duties? [etheryn.lowConfidence |[rand |"V-very well, actually." Ryn lowers her eyes and blushes. "Elthara's done all the heavy lifting when it comes to o-organising the festivities. A-all I have to do is to walk around and talk to people, show myself as the [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]. It's all A-Alissa had to do, and she was very good at it. Me, I just keep on w-worrying about what people think of me." Everyone seems polite and friendly enough to her, though. "T-that's the thing!
