rows.original:
[rand
            |As you mingle with the elves in the ballroom, you spy Elthara off by one corner of the crowd, giving directions to several of the palace staff before dismissing them. The priestess spies you watching her and approaches, giving you a nod as she draws close.
            
            "Enjoying the festivities, Champion?"
            
            They're not bad. The food, the music, the games and cultural displays... it's very folklorish, for lack of a better term to put it. Yeah, you're having fun.
            
            "Thank you. Everyone in the palace staff worked very hard to bring this year's Midwinter Festivus ball into being. Towards the end, all the palace staff who hadn't succumbed to the demoness' schemes had long since fled the grounds... it took a lot of convincing for them to return, even if Ryn's speech after our victory helped. Then there was the matter of the treasury and our budget... the druids helped with that, too, as a sign of goodwill. Like it or not, I owe it to Hethia for making at least half of all of this possible."
            
            That's a rare concession coming from her.
            
            "[etheryn.crowned
                |Her Majesty
                |The regent
            ] has asked me to be more reasonable in dealing with them, so there she was and here I am. Maybe it won't be this generation or even the next, but we'll need to live together someday. This, perhaps, is one of many first steps to bridging the schism; letting them see and feel the light of Lumia for themselves. Perhaps it would be too much to hope for them to be so inspired as to formally convert, but there's something to be said for stating our case."
            
            Yeah, she shouldn't think of running before she can walk.
            
            "Everyone's behaving themselves, which is good. I need to rotate out some of the servers and musicians so that they have an hour or two to enjoy themselves as well, and be refreshed for their next round of duties. Some of them have been at it since dawn.
            
            "Please, Champion, enjoy the food and entertainments. It'll be time for [etheryn.crowned
                |Her Majesty
                |the regent
            ]'s speech before you know it."
            |As you mingle with the elves in the ballroom, you spy Elthara speaking with several elven druids dressed in heavy furs and simple white shifts. The priestess is using what you've come to recognise as her diplomatic face, all unperturbed and calm neutrality, while the latter clearly aren't as used to this kind of byplay and negotiation by the looks of it. Eventually, they part ways, whereupon Elthara turns to you with a nod.
            
            "You saw that."
            
            Yes. What was that all about?
            
            "Mostly questions about their role in boer'alvar society going forward. There's no place for them, at least not in the same way that the Old Wyld had before the schism. Those were reasonable questions, but they belong to the negotiating table. Today isn't a day for that kind of talk, it's a day for experiencing emotions of he heart.
            
            "They didn't like that answer, of course."
            
            Does she think they can do it, though? Reintegrate the elves who left all those centuries ago?
            
            "Why not?" Elthara waves a hand at the entirety of the ball. "The murals on the ballroom walls... they used to honor the Old Wyld. Not a single chisel has been taken to them, and yet now they sing the praises of Lumia. The tree, the star, the candles, they're all old symbols that found new roles, new meaning. The foods, even the custom of celebrating the winter solstice... they all have roots long before Atheldred's reign. Many things don't change, but their meanings do.
            
            "That's why I'm confident that if our estranged cousins are making a genuine attempt to return to the Winter City as commanded by the few remaining wyld trees as they claim is the case, they'll be able to join the fold once more. We'll find them a place amongst the boer'alvar that they can be proud of. But! They must be genuine about it. That lot back there... they didn't sound very much so."
            
            There're bound to be holdouts on both sides; there's still a lot of bad blood.
            
            "Which is precisely why it wasn't a topic I cared to discuss here and now, Champion. This is Winter Festivus. It's something we both can agree to respect. Just for one day, if nothing else, we can stop arguing and negotiating, and just enjoy ourselves. Except for me." She sighs. "My work is never done."
            
            There, there... 
            |As you mingle with the elves in the ballroom, you spy Elthara speaking with several elves, dressed cleanly and simply. Seeing you approach, the priestess quickly excuses herself, using your arrival as an excuse to detach herself from the group.
            
            "Quickly," she murmurs. "Take me away before my mind melts."
            
            You do that, leading her over to the buffet where she grabs a glass of mirrorwine and downs it in one gulp.
            
            "Ah." She lets out the breath she's been holding. "I needed that. Thank you, [pc.name]."
            
            She's welcome, but who were those people?
            
            "Several local farmers from just outside the walls with petitions. Their usual liaison had, well... you know what happened with Alissa and the nobility, so we'll leave that out. The task of arranging their payment for the grains used in today's dishes — they thought to seize the moment to try and renegotiate terms on the spot. On Festivus!" Elthara spits. "If it were just them, I'd have been fine, but I'm supposed to rub elbows with everyone all at once. I just can't catch a break, even during the ball."
            
            What of Ryn?
            
            "Oh, everyone's too polite to bring such things up to [etheryn.crowned
                |Her Majesty
                |the regent
            ]. Wouldn't be right, so it falls to me. I should be used to this by now, it's not my first time wrangling the provisions, the musicians, the palace guards and staff. And now this year, the druids have joined the fray, too. Honestly, I get more rest on the day after Festivus than the day itself." Elthara sighs, reaches for a refill, and downs that, too. "I'm sorry to unload this on you, [pc.name]. I just... I just need to fortify myself; there're many more people I have to meet this morning before I go off to prepare the valkyries who came down all the way for the hymnals."
            
            As Elthara moves off into the crowd, you get the feeling this won't be the only time she'll need a shoulder to cry on this morning... 
        ]

[rand
            |当你在舞厅里与精灵们交谈时，你注意到艾尔萨拉站在人群的一角，她正在向几位宫殿工作人员指示方向，随后便让他们离开了。那位女祭司发现你在注视她，便走了过来，在靠近你的时候向你点了点头。
            
            正在享受这些庆祝活动吗，冠军？”

这些活动确实不错。食物、音乐、各种游戏以及文化表演……用一个恰当的词来形容的话，就是非常有民俗气息。没错，你肯定玩得很开心吧。
            
            谢谢大家。宫中的所有工作人员都付出了巨大的努力，才使得今年的冬季节日庆典得以顺利举办。到了最后阶段，所有没有落入女魔诡计中的宫员们早已逃离了这片场地。……我们费了很大劲才说服他们回来，尽管我们在获胜后小琳的演讲确实起到了一定的作用。此外，还有国库和预算的问题……德鲁伊们也出于善意帮忙解决了这些问题。不管我是否愿意承认，至少有一半的成功都要归功于赫希娅。这真是她难得的一次让步。[etheryn.crowned
                |女王陛下
                |摄政王
            ]她让我在与他们相处时更加理性一些，所以现在她提出了这个要求，而我也在努力按照她的建议去做。也许不是这一代人，甚至也不是下一代人，但我们总有一天会共同生活在一起。或许，这就是弥合分歧的众多第一步之一——让他们亲自体验并感受到卢米娅带来的好处。或许，期望他们能受到如此大的启发而正式改信我们的信仰，未免要求过高了，但至少我们应该把自己的观点表达出来。

是啊，她现在还不会走，就别想着跑了。
            
            大家都表现得很好，这很棒。我需要让一些服务器管理员和音乐师休息一两个小时，让他们也有机会放松一下，为下一轮工作做好准备。其中有些人已经连续工作到天亮了。
            
            拜托了，冠军，好好享受这些美食和娱乐活动吧。很快就该[etheryn.crowned
                |女王陛下
                |摄政王
            ]他的演讲在不知不觉中就结束了。
            |当你在舞厅里与精灵们交谈时，你看到艾尔萨拉正在与几位身着厚厚毛皮和简单白色长袍的精灵德鲁伊交谈。这位女祭司展现出了你早已熟悉的那种外交姿态——神情镇定自若，保持着冷静中立的态度；而那些德鲁伊们显然还不太习惯这种外交手段和谈判方式。最终，他们分开了，这时艾尔萨拉朝你点了点头。
            
            你看到了吧。”

“是的。那都是关于什么内容的呢？”

“主要是关于他们在未来的‘布尔阿尔瓦’社会中的角色问题。他们已经没有位置了，至少不再是以分裂之前的那种方式存在了。那些问题确实很有道理，但它们应该放在谈判桌上讨论。今天不是讨论这些事情的日子，今天应该是让人们感受到内心情感的日子。
            
            他们当然不喜欢那个答案。”

不过，她真的认为他们能够做到吗？让那些几百年前离开的精灵们重新回归？

“为什么不能呢？”艾尔萨拉朝整个宴会现场挥了挥手。舞厅墙壁上的壁画……它们原本是用来纪念古老荒野的。至今没有一个人动用过凿子去修改它们，然而现在，它们却在歌颂卢米娅。那棵树、那颗星星、那些蜡烛，它们都是古老的象征，如今却被赋予了新的含义和作用。这些食物，甚至庆祝冬至这一习俗……它们的根源都可以追溯到阿塞尔雷德统治之前很久。很多东西本身并没有改变，但它们的含义却已经发生了变化。
            
            正因如此，我才有信心：如果我们那些疏远的亲戚们真的是按照那些剩下的野生树木的命令，真心想要回到冬城的话，他们一定能够重新加入我们的行列。我们会为他们在博尔阿尔瓦族中找到一个让他们引以为豪的位置。但是！他们必须是真心的才行。那些人……听起来可不太像是真心的啊。
            
            双方肯定都会有人持反对意见；怨恨依然很深。

“正因为如此，我现在才不想讨论这个话题，冠军。这是冬季庆典，是我们都应该尊重的事情。至少在这一天里，我们可以停止争吵和谈判，好好享受节日。除了我……”她叹了口气，“我的工作永远都没有尽头。
            
            好了好了…… 
            |当你在舞厅里与精灵们交谈时，你看到艾尔萨拉正在和几位穿着整洁朴素的精灵交谈。当你走近时，这位女祭司迅速找了个借口，利用你的到来作为理由，从那群人中离开了。
            
            快一点，”她轻声说道，“在我脑子彻底乱掉之前带我离开吧。”

你照做了，带着她来到自助区。她在那里拿了一杯镜像酒，一饮而尽。

“啊……她终于松了一口气，说道：“我真的很需要这个。谢谢你。[pc.name]她当然可以来，但那些人都是谁呢？”

“是一些来自城墙外的当地农民，他们带来了请愿书。他们的常规联络人……嗯，你知道艾莉莎和那些贵族们发生了什么，所以我们就不提这个了。安排今天菜肴中所用谷物的付款事宜——他们觉得应该抓住这个机会，当场尝试重新协商条款。在节日庆典期间啊！艾尔萨拉愤怒地说道，“如果只是他们的话，我还能忍受，但我现在却不得不同时与所有人打交道。我真是运气太差了，就连在球赛的时候也是如此。

那小琳呢？

“哦，大家都太客气了，没人会提起这种事情。 [etheryn.crowned
                |女王陛下
                |摄政王
            ]那样做不太合适，所以这个任务就落到了我身上。其实我现在应该已经习惯了这种事情，毕竟协调乐师、宫廷卫兵以及各种工作人员已经不是第一次了。而今年，德鲁伊们也加入了这个行列。说实话，在仲冬节后的第二天，我反而能得到更多的休息。”艾尔萨拉叹了口气，拿起另一杯酒喝了起来，“很抱歉要把这些事情都告诉你。[pc.name]我只是……我需要先调整一下自己的状态；今天早上我还有很多人需要见，之后我还要去准备那些专程赶来参加这次仪式的女武神们所需的物品。”

当艾尔萨拉走进人群中时，你不禁觉得，今天早上她很可能还不止一次需要有人陪伴她倾诉…… 
        ]

"
        [rand
            |As you mingle with the elves in the ballroom, you spy Elthara off by one corner of the crowd, giving directions to several of the palace staff before dismissing them. The priestess spies you watching her and approaches, giving you a nod as she draws close.
            
            "Enjoying the festivities, Champion?"
            
            They're not bad. The food, the music, the games and cultural displays... it's very folklorish, for lack of a better term to put it. Yeah, you're having fun.
            
            "Thank you. Everyone in the palace staff worked very hard to bring this year's Midwinter Festivus ball into being. Towards the end, all the palace staff who hadn't succumbed to the demoness' schemes had long since fled the grounds... it took a lot of convincing for them to return, even if Ryn's speech after our victory helped. Then there was the matter of the treasury and our budget... the druids helped with that, too, as a sign of goodwill. Like it or not, I owe it to Hethia for making at least half of all of this possible."
            
            That's a rare concession coming from her.
            
            "[etheryn.crowned
                |Her Majesty
                |The regent
            ] has asked me to be more reasonable in dealing with them, so there she was and here I am. Maybe it won't be this generation or even the next, but we'll need to live together someday. This, perhaps, is one of many first steps to bridging the schism; letting them see and feel the light of Lumia for themselves. Perhaps it would be too much to hope for them to be so inspired as to formally convert, but there's something to be said for stating our case."
            
            Yeah, she shouldn't think of running before she can walk.
            
            "Everyone's behaving themselves, which is good. I need to rotate out some of the servers and musicians so that they have an hour or two to enjoy themselves as well, and be refreshed for their next round of duties. Some of them have been at it since dawn.
            
            "Please, Champion, enjoy the food and entertainments. It'll be time for [etheryn.crowned
                |Her Majesty
                |the regent
            ]'s speech before you know it."
            |As you mingle with the elves in the ballroom, you spy Elthara speaking with several elven druids dressed in heavy furs and simple white shifts. The priestess is using what you've come to recognise as her diplomatic face, all unperturbed and calm neutrality, while the latter clearly aren't as used to this kind of byplay and negotiation by the looks of it. Eventually, they part ways, whereupon Elthara turns to you with a nod.
            
            "You saw that."
            
            Yes. What was that all about?
            
            "Mostly questions about their role in boer'alvar society going forward. There's no place for them, at least not in the same way that the Old Wyld had before the schism. Those were reasonable questions, but they belong to the negotiating table. Today isn't a day for that kind of talk, it's a day for experiencing emotions of he heart.
            
            "They didn't like that answer, of course."
            
            Does she think they can do it, though? Reintegrate the elves who left all those centuries ago?
            
            "Why not?" Elthara waves a hand at the entirety of the ball. "The murals on the ballroom walls... they used to honor the Old Wyld. Not a single chisel has been taken to them, and yet now they sing the praises of Lumia. The tree, the star, the candles, they're all old symbols that found new roles, new meaning. The foods, even the custom of celebrating the winter solstice... they all have roots long before Atheldred's reign. Many things don't change, but their meanings do.
            
            "That's why I'm confident that if our estranged cousins are making a genuine attempt to return to the Winter City as commanded by the few remaining wyld trees as they claim is the case, they'll be able to join the fold once more. We'll find them a place amongst the boer'alvar that they can be proud of. But! They must be genuine about it. That lot back there... they didn't sound very much so."
            
            There're bound to be holdouts on both sides; there's still a lot of bad blood.
            
            "Which is precisely why it wasn't a topic I cared to discuss here and now, Champion. This is Winter Festivus. It's something we both can agree to respect. Just for one day, if nothing else, we can stop arguing and negotiating, and just enjoy ourselves. Except for me." She sighs. "My work is never done."
            
            There, there... 
            |As you mingle with the elves in the ballroom, you spy Elthara speaking with several elves, dressed cleanly and simply. Seeing you approach, the priestess quickly excuses herself, using your arrival as an excuse to detach herself from the group.
            
            "Quickly," she murmurs. "Take me away before my mind melts."
            
            You do that, leading her over to the buffet where she grabs a glass of mirrorwine and downs it in one gulp.
            
            "Ah." She lets out the breath she's been holding. "I needed that. Thank you, [pc.name]."
            
            She's welcome, but who were those people?
            
            "Several local farmers from just outside the walls with petitions. Their usual liaison had, well... you know what happened with Alissa and the nobility, so we'll leave that out. The task of arranging their payment for the grains used in today's dishes — they thought to seize the moment to try and renegotiate terms on the spot. On Festivus!" Elthara spits. "If it were just them, I'd have been fine, but I'm supposed to rub elbows with everyone all at once. I just can't catch a break, even during the ball."
            
            What of Ryn?
            
            "Oh, everyone's too polite to bring such things up to [etheryn.crowned
                |Her Majesty
                |the regent
            ]. Wouldn't be right, so it falls to me. I should be used to this by now, it's not my first time wrangling the provisions, the musicians, the palace guards and staff. And now this year, the druids have joined the fray, too. Honestly, I get more rest on the day after Festivus than the day itself." Elthara sighs, reaches for a refill, and downs that, too. "I'm sorry to unload this on you, [pc.name]. I just... I just need to fortify myself; there're many more people I have to meet this morning before I go off to prepare the valkyries who came down all the way for the hymnals."
            
            As Elthara moves off into the crowd, you get the feeling this won't be the only time she'll need a shoulder to cry on this morning... 
        ]

rows.original: [rand |"Enjoying yourself?" Hethia asks as you sees you approach, acknowledging you with a nod. "I certainly am." That's a surprising admission, coming from her usually dour self. Hethia chuckles. "For once... just for once, Elthara and I were able to just shut up and get working, for Ryn's sake. The high priestess is a very focused woman when she sets her mind on a task, I can recognize that; she was at her wits' end with regards to the ball, until I so graciously stepped in and offered some help. Out of the goodness of my heart, of course." The state of the treasury... "We don't have much, either. Our exile has left us rather deprived of much material comfort, but that means that we druids do have quite extensive knowledge of stretching thin what we have to make it look like a lot. We can't order fish into the nets or fruit from the trees like the legends say we can — although the Old Wyld of the day did nothing to disprove those claims, of course — but there's a lot you can make out of a little if you don't let anything go to waste." And knowing Alissa, a lot went to waste under her reign. "Elthara stopped it from getting too out of hand, but... yes, effectively. We gave some of our stores for the ball, too; nothing fancy, but seeing what the kitchens have done with it makes me proud. We've also done our best to work with the musicians Elthara's wrangled for the event — it looks like we still have a lot of shared pieces when it comes down to it." You're just glad that the two women are able to work together when need be; it bodes well for the future of the pale elves. "Only for today, Champion. Only for today. After that... we're going straight back to squabbling and fighting for every advantage we can get our own side." Hethia chuckles and takes a bite out of the cake she's holding. "Fair Festivus to you, Champion." |So, how's the party? Hethia eyes you as you approach, then greets you with a cautious nod. "It's foreign, yet familiar at the same time. The tree, the star, the candles... they all have different meanings now. New gods do old jobs... just two years ago, I was hanging lanterns from the boughs of one of the last wyld trees, and today I'm standing here looking at our ancient symbols turned into symbols of the Lumians' victory over us." It must be a bitter pill to swallow. "Oh, it is. But..." the druidess sighs and looks down at the sweet pemmican meatloaf on her plate, her ears drooping. "At least the food's good. Small consolation, and even so it's still another reminder of how things have changed. No more moose, caribou and reindeer in this dish, it's all whale and seal. The fruits of the forest replaced with those of the tundra and glacier. The soup they're serving used to be a vegetable and meat broth, and now it's all seafood. "I get it, really I do. I'll bet Elthara set all of this up on purpose to remind me and mine that we're supposed to integrate and be good subjects to the var Ridells from here on out, that we can still keep our form like all the symbols of the winter solstice and Festivus itself if we just give up our meaning... but at least she wasn't the one who asked up to give up the latter. That was the wyld trees themselves." Hethia just looks defeated. "And now it's just sweetmeats and songs all the way down. Fuck, I'm sorry. This is supposed to be a nice day, and a nice party; I'm just ruining it for you by getting all sentimental. I have to be here, and my people have to be here, but that doesn't mean I've got to be a wet blanket. At least our children are playing nicely with theirs... no, I should try to start thinking of it as the children, right? No more 'ours' and 'theirs.' A fair Festivus to you, Champion." |"Have you had one of the little buns that the children are giving out? They're... I don't really know how to feel about them." Hethia crosses her arms. "It's not entirely the same as the way that we would do them before, but you can see little bits of the druidic solstice practice peeking through. And... to be honest, not all of the new things are bad." You understand just how much it pains her to admit that. "Hmph. Yes, well. It's not as if the idea of bringing light around on the darkest day of the year is a tradition for Lumians only, although I admit it does fit pretty neatly with her sun motif. You see the processions, with the candle-crowned girls leading the way for motley collections of other children? Once upon a time, that was a whole parade of hundreds of young elves, all carrying candles out from the Temple of Terrestrial Fire and the lesser fire shrines. Some of them would carry light and love to parents still working as the sun fell, and others would bring the adults food — good solid brown bread, or cured fish that would keep properly. The light would let them keep working... and keep the terrors of the night away, on the date when they had the greatest power. "Now the whole thing is sweetness and light, from the Lumian songs that they sing to the flavor of the buns. The troll is just an adorable little child. It's nauseatingly cute and kitschy." Sounds like there's a 'but' in the offing, there. Hethia purses her lips for a long moment before sighing. "Quite. But... these Lumia cakes taste very good. And, well, maybe it's not entirely a bad thing that children see all this as more of a fun celebration than a necessary ritual to keep fear at bay. "Druid or Lumian, the point is still the same. The candles are both light and love, and you need both in a long boreal winter, especially on the blackest day of the year. A single candle, a single child's love, can hold back the darkness. And hundreds of them? Well." [pc.isChamp |That's... much more emotional than you'd have expected her to be about this. And inspiring. "Don't you dare tell me that it looks like I'm getting into the Festivus spirit."[silly | You don't know about that, but at the very least it seems like the Grinch's heart is growing three sizes this day. "I'm not going to touch that joke with a thirty-nine-and-a-half foot pole." ] |Kinda more maudlin than you'd have expected from her. That draws a derisive snort. "I'll be sure to do more to fulfill your expectations in the future, [pc.ra elf |southerner |[pc.race] ]." ] ]
rows.translation: [rand |玩得开心吗？”当你走近时，赫希娅问道，同时点了点头表示认出了你。“当然开心啦。” 这样的回答实在出人意料，因为她平时总是那么严肃。 赫希娅轻声笑了起来。就这一次……真的就这一次，为了小琳的缘故，艾尔萨拉和我终于能够安静下来，专心工作了。那位大祭司女士一旦下定决心去做某件事，就会全神贯注地投入其中，这一点我是看得出来的；在解决那个球的问题时，她确实陷入了困境，直到我慷慨地伸出援手，提供了帮助。当然是出于好意才这么做的。 国库的状况…… “我们也没什么钱。流亡的生活让我们失去了许多物质上的享受，但这也意味着我们德鲁伊们掌握了如何巧妙利用现有的资源，让它们看起来仿佛数量很多一样。我们并不能像传说中那样从鱼网里捕捉鱼，或从树上摘取水果——当然，当时的原始森林也没有任何证据来反驳这些说法——但是，只要不浪费任何资源，那么用少量的东西也能做出很多东西来。" 以艾莉莎的性格，她在掌权期间肯定让很多事情白白浪费掉了。 “艾尔萨拉阻止了事情变得太过失控，但……确实，她起到了关键作用。我们也为这场活动贡献了一些物资；虽然没有什么特别豪华的东西，但看到厨房团队把它们制作成了这么漂亮的东西，我真的感到很自豪。我们还尽力与艾尔萨拉联系来的音乐家们合作——说实话，我们确实有很多共同的作品可以用于这次活动。 你只是很高兴这两位女性在需要时能够携手合作；这对苍白精灵的未来来说是个好兆头。 “就今天而已，冠军。就今天而已。之后……我们又会开始争斗起来，为了争取对自己一方有利的一切而争斗。”赫希娅轻笑着，咬了一口手中的蛋糕。“祝你在节日里一切顺利，冠军。 |那么，聚会进行得怎么样了？ 当你靠近时，赫希娅注视着你，然后谨慎地点了点头向你打招呼：“感觉既陌生又有些熟悉。那棵树、那颗星星、那些蜡烛……它们现在都有了不同的含义。新的神明在承担着旧有的职责……就在两年前，我还在最后一棵野生树木的枝头上挂灯笼，而今天，我却站在这里，看着我们那些古老的象征，如今已经变成了象征卢米安人战胜我们的标志。 这肯定是一颗让人难以接受的苦药。 “哦，确实如此。但是……”女德鲁伊叹了口气，低头看着盘子里那美味的肉饼，耳朵都耷拉了下来。“至少食物还是不错的。这算是个小小的安慰吧，不过这也再次提醒了我，一切都已经变了。这道菜里再也没有驼鹿、驯鹿或麋鹿了，全部都是鲸肉和海豹肉。森林里的果实也被苔原和冰川上的植物所取代。他们之前提供的汤是蔬菜和肉类的汤，而现在则全是海鲜汤。 我明白了，真的明白。我敢打赌，艾尔萨拉一定是故意安排这一切的，目的是提醒我和我们所有人：从现在开始，我们必须融入其中，成为拉迪尔家族的顺从子民；只要我们放弃自己的原有意义，我们就依然可以像冬至节和节日庆典中的那些象征一样，保持自己的存在价值……不过至少，提出放弃这些意义的人并不是她，而是那些野生树木本身。 赫希娅看起来简直像被彻底打败了一样。“现在到处都是甜言蜜语和欢歌笑语，真是够了……该死，我对不起。今天本该是美好的一天，也是个愉快的聚会，可我却因为过于情绪化而把一切都搞砸了。我必须在这里，我的孩子们也必须在这里，但这并不意味着我就得当个扫兴的人。至少我们的孩子们还能和其他孩子一起开心地玩耍……不，我该试着把他们都当作一群孩子，对吧？不要再用“我们的”和“他们的”来区分了。祝你们度过一个公平、快乐的节日，冠军。 |你有没有拿到孩子们分发的那些小点心啊？那些点心……我真不知道该怎么评价它们才好。”赫希娅双臂交叉说道，“虽然这些小点心的制作方式与我们以前习惯的有所不同，但还是能隐约看到德鲁伊传统中关于夏至节庆的习俗痕迹。而且……说实话，这些新加入的元素并不全是坏事。 你应该明白，对她来说，承认这一点是多么痛苦的事。 “哼，好吧。虽然在这个一年中最黑暗的日子里带来光明这个习俗并不是只有卢米安人才有，但我必须承认，这个习俗与她所代表的太阳主题确实非常契合。你看到那些队伍了吗？那些头戴蜡烛花环的女孩们走在最前面，后面跟着各种各样其他孩子。其实，从前这里曾经是一支由数百名年轻精灵组成的庞大队伍，他们全都手持蜡烛，从大地之火神庙以及那些较小的火神祠堂中出发。有些会在太阳落山时为仍在工作的父母带来光明与关爱，而另一些则会为成年人准备食物——美味的棕色面包，或是能够妥善保存的腌鱼。这些光明与食物能让人们继续他们的辛勤工作。……并在那些它们拥有最强力量的夜晚，驱赶一切恐惧与邪恶。 现在整个场景都充满了温馨与美好，从他们唱的卢米安歌曲，到那些小面包的味道，都让人感到无比愉悦。那个巨魔简直就像一个可爱的小孩子，那种可爱的程度简直让人觉得有点反胃……” 听起来后面应该还有个“但是”吧…… 赫希娅抿着嘴唇好一会儿，最终叹了口气说道：“好吧。但是……这些卢米娅蛋糕确实很好吃。而且，嗯，也许孩子们把这些活动看作是一种有趣的庆祝活动，而不仅仅是一种用来驱散恐惧的必要仪式，这也并非完全是一件坏事。 “无论是德鲁伊还是卢米娅n，道理都是一样的。蜡烛代表着光明与爱，在漫长而寒冷的冬季，尤其是在一年中最黑暗的日子里，这两样东西都是必不可少的。一支蜡烛，一个孩子纯真的爱，就能驱散黑暗。而如果有上百支蜡烛，那么 [pc.isChamp |这……比你想象中她会对这件事表现出的情绪要强烈得多。而且真的很鼓舞人心。 “你敢说我看起来已经融入了仲冬节的氛围中了？[silly | 你可能不知道，但至少在今天，格林奇的心似乎变得柔软多了。 “我绝对不会去碰那个笑话。 ] |这有点太伤感了，完全超出了你对她的预期。 “我以后一定会加倍努力，以满足你的期望。”他冷笑着说道。 [pc.ra elf |南方人 |[pc.race] ]。" ] ]

And hundreds of them? Well." [pc.isChamp |That's... much more emotional than you'd have expected her to be about this. And inspiring. "Don't you dare tell me that it looks like I'm getting into the Festivus spirit."[silly | You don't know about that, but at the very least it seems like the Grinch's heart is growing three sizes this day. "I'm not going to touch that joke with a thirty-nine-and-a-half foot pole." ] |Kinda more maudlin than you'd have expected from her. That draws a derisive snort. "I'll be sure to do more to fulfill your expectations in the future, [pc.ra elf |southerner |[pc.race] ]." ] ] "

rows.original: As you're walking through the gardens looking for someone you know, a certain elf in the crowd catches your eye. You're sure that you haven't met her before — she's strikingly beautiful, so much so that you could never have forgotten her — but there's a definite sense of familiarity that strikes you when you draw close. She's standing by the decorated tree with its candles, head tilted upwards to take in the sight of the pine and statue alike with a satisfied smile on her face. A druidess, by the looks of the thick furs she's dressed in... but you haven't met any of them other than Hethia, have you? Stepping up to the elf, you give her a nod — she's [pc.heightRange 70 74 |about the same height as |just a little shorter than |just a little taller than ] you, and certainly smaller than the average boer'alvar amazon, and greet her. "Why, if it isn't the Champion of Frost [pc.himHer]self," the druidess purrs, fixing her golden gaze on you with a toss of her long, blonde hair. Or at least, it would've been long if it weren't done up in a braid close to her head; the whole act is rather abortive, as if she's forgotten her hair's up in the first place. "The entire Winter City is abuzz with how you and the [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ] defeated the demons who had corrupted her sister and secretly ruled the palace. Very impressive. That kind of act sticks in peoples' minds, you know." Ah, of course she would know you, so many people you've bumped into during the party saw you during Ryn's speech, when she named you her champion. You have to ask: do you know her from somewhere? No matter how you turn in over in your head, you can't shake the feeling that you do know this elf, against all sense... The druidess swirls her wineglass. "Tch. That's because you know me very, very well, my dear [pc.name]." Her voice... it changed! And... and you know that voice; the unmistakable dulcet tones of the woman that conquered this place before you! You whirl around to see if anyone else has noticed, but despite the milling throng about you, none of the elves have noticed anything out of the ordinary. Planting a hand on your cheek, Kasyrra guides your eyes back to hers, and gives you the sweetest smile. "Don't worry about it, no one's going to notice. Whatever we say, they'll think we're just talking about the weather — or some other such banality that makes folk feel safe and familiar. And even if it weren't part of the glamor... no one would care. So many things just get lost in the crowd." S-she's back?! "Well, this is a very nice palace, I must admit. The culprit always returns to the scene of the crime, as the saying goes... and when I heard there was going to be a grand ball in honor of this goddess — " she jerks a thumb at the statue of Lumia — "I'd to come and see for myself, especially since you were going to attend, too!" Oh. "It's been pretty fun so far. There's a game for the women and half-sexed on that side of the garden, where they try to drink mirrorwine from a glass through a straw while balancing the glass between their tits." Elf-Kas grins and squeezes her breasts, which despite her furs still show off an ample amount of cleavage. "Good thing I was thinking about what you'd fancy when I made this disguise. These girls won it handily; the other women got too tipsy too soon anyway." So, what's she really up to here? "Me?" Kas draws back, feigning shock. "Why, I'm just enjoying the party, same as you are. The palace's open to the public for today, isn't it? Even a wicked demoness like me needs a day off from my scheming. And more importantly, a day away from fawning cultists that won't leave me alone! "Truth be told, it would be rather droll, if not for you and your companions being around... and let's be frank, you make this whole affair that much more bearable. Here I was, wondering — no, hoping that you'd see through the disguise, and you did! You're really growing very well, [pc.name]. Mommy's proud of you," she says, giving you a little wink. "Besides, just as you know me, I know you... and I know that you won't expose me, will you?" [pc.isDK |Why would you? As long as she doesn't get up to mischief, then you're happy to have Kas around any time. |Of course not. Accusing her of being a demon right here would be like... like trying to expose a nobleman for really being a bear in disguise that couldn't even speak. It would be impossible to imagine a demoness in the middle of the Midwinter Festivus ball, just sipping wine, soaking in the atmosphere and enjoying herself. Patently absurd. Besides, it'd ruin the day for everyone else, and if she's not going to get up to any mischief... then well, you guess you can close one eye... ] Kas winks. "Oh, trust me, I'm going to get up to all kinds of mischief. But only the harmless kind, brought on by too much alcohol and being in reach of a [pc.mascFem |handsome |pretty ] [pc.boyGirl] you fancy." Would she like your company for the duration of the ball? "For more than just that. But first..." turning her gaze back to the statue and tree, Kas waves you off absent-mindedly, "I'd like to be alone with my thoughts for a while. Being here, looking at these, it brings back memories. I'm afraid I won't be much fun while I'm reminiscing on the old days, [pc.ora elf |back when you'd have been just a child. |before you were even born! ] Why don't you run along and stuff your face or talk to your friends, and we can meet up again later after the speech? I'm not going anywhere today, after all." That seems to be that. Her golden eyes fixed on the tree and the star perched atop it, Kas is clearly lost in thought, and you can only wonder what's going through her mind right now. Not too much that she can't give you a pinch on the ass as you turn to go, whatever it is.
rows.translation: 当你穿梭在花园中，寻找某个你认识的人时，人群中的一位精灵吸引了你的注意。你确信自己之前从未见过她——她美得如此惊人，以至于你绝对不可能忘记她——但当你靠近她时，却有一种莫名的熟悉感涌上心头。她站在那棵挂满蜡烛、装饰一新的树下，抬头凝视着松树和雕像，脸上洋溢着满足的微笑。 从她身上穿着的厚厚毛皮来看，她应该是一名德鲁伊女祭司。…但是除了赫希娅，你还没有见过他们中的任何一个，对吧？你走上前，向那位精灵点了点头——她[pc.heightRange 70 74 |大约有同样的高度 |只比……稍短一些 |只比……稍微高一点 ]是你，而且肯定比普通的博尔阿尔瓦亚马逊还要小，向她问好吧。 “哎呀，这不是霜之冠军吗[pc.himHer]自我，”女德鲁伊轻声说道，她那金色的目光紧紧地注视着你，同时甩了甩自己那长长的金发。不过，如果她的头发没有被扎成发辫紧贴在头部的话，那头发确实应该算是很长的；不过现在这个发型看起来有点失败，就好像她根本忘记了自己把头发扎成了发辫一样。“整个冬城都在热议你和[etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]她击败了那些腐蚀了她妹妹、暗中统治着宫殿的恶魔。真是了不起——这样的行为一定会留在人们的记忆中，你知道的。 啊，她当然会认识你。在派对上，有很多人看到你在小琳发表演讲时，被她称为自己的守护者。你肯定应该去问问她吧做你在哪里认识她的？无论你如何回想，都无法摆脱这种感觉——你确实认识这个精灵，尽管这完全不合常理…… 女德鲁伊旋转着她的酒杯，轻蔑地说道：“哼，那是因为你太了解我了，亲爱的。[pc.name]她的声音……变了！还有……你知道就是那个声音——那个曾经征服过这个地方的女人的那独特而悦耳的嗓音！你转过身去，想看看是否还有其他人注意到了，但尽管周围人群熙熙攘攘，却没有一个精灵察觉到任何异常。卡希拉将手放在你的脸颊上，引导你的目光重新看向她，然后露出了最甜美的微笑。 “别担心，没人会注意到的。无论我们说什么，他们都会以为我们只是在谈论天气——或者是一些能让人们感到安心、觉得熟悉的无聊话题罢了。就算它不属于那种光彩夺目的东西……也没人会在意。太多事情就这样在人群中被忽略了。” “她、她回来了？！” “嗯，这个是不得不承认，那确实是一座非常华丽的宫殿。俗话说，罪犯总是会回到犯罪现场……当我听说要为这位女神举办一场盛大的舞会时——她朝卢米娅的雕像挥了挥拇指——我就决定亲自来看看，尤其是你还打算参加这次活动的话！哦，到目前为止还挺有趣的。在花园的那一边，有专门为女性和半性人设计的游戏——他们需要用吸管通过玻璃杯喝镜像酒，同时还要保持玻璃杯在自己的胸前平衡。埃尔夫-卡希咧嘴一笑，捏了捏自己的胸部——尽管穿着毛皮服装，她的乳沟依然清晰可见。“幸好我在准备这个伪装时，就已经考虑到了你会喜欢什么。这些女孩真的赢得了胜利；反正其他女性也都太早喝醉了。那么，她到底是什么人呢？真的就到这儿了？” “我吗？”卡希故作惊讶地后退了一步，“哎呀，我只是在享受这场派对而已，和你一样啊。今天宫殿是向公众开放的，对吧？就连我这样的邪恶女魔头也需要休息一天，暂时停止那些阴谋诡计啊。更重要的是，再也不用忍受那些整天围着我、纠缠不休的狂热追随者了！ “说实话，要不是有你们和你的朋友们在身边，这一切反而会显得挺有趣的……坦白说，正是你们的存在让这一切变得可以忍受一些。我就在这里，心里想着——不，其实是希望你们能看穿这个伪装，而你们确实做到了！你们真的进步得非常快。[pc.name]妈妈为你感到骄傲，”她说道，同时向你眨了眨眼。 “而且，就像你了解我一样，我也了解你……我知道你不会揭发我的，对吧？ [pc.isDK |你为什么要这么做呢？只要她不惹麻烦，那你随时欢迎卡希留在你身边。 |当然不会。在这里指责她是个恶魔，简直就像……就像试图揭穿某个贵族其实是一只连话都不会说的熊一样。在仲冬节舞会上，怎么可能想象会有一个恶魔女郎只是坐在那里品酒，享受着节日的气氛呢？这显然太荒谬了。更何况，这样做还会破坏其他人的兴致；如果她并没有打算搞什么恶作剧的话……那么，嗯，我想大家也可以睁一只眼闭一只眼吧…… ] 卡希眨了眨眼，说道：“哦，相信我，我肯定会做出各种调皮的事情来。但都是些无害的举动，只是因为喝了太多酒，再加上手边有[pc.mascFem |英俊的 |漂亮 ] [pc.boyGirl]你愿意吗？” “在整个舞会期间，她都希望有你陪伴吗？” “不仅仅是为了这个……但首先……”卡丝将目光重新投向那座雕像和那棵树，心不在焉地对你摆了摆手，“我想独自静想一会儿。在这里，看着这些，会让我想起许多往事。恐怕在回忆过去的时候，我并不会显得很有趣吧[pc.ora elf |还是在你还是个孩子的时候。 |在你出生之前！ ]你为什么不跑去找你的朋友玩一会儿，或者跟他们聊聊天呢？等演讲结束后我们再见面吧。反正我今天也没什么地方要去。” 她似乎陷入了沉思，金色的眼睛紧紧盯着那棵树以及树顶上那只鸟儿，你不禁会好奇她此刻在想些什么。 不过，不管她在想什么，应该也不会影响到你转身离开这件事吧。

rows.original: There's something familiar about this elf that you can't quite put a finger on... who is she?
rows.translation: 这个精灵身上有种熟悉的感觉，可你一时说不上来……她到底是谁？
rows.raw: "There's something familiar about this elf that you can't quite put a finger on... who is she?"

rows.original:
You spy the expectant elven bartender resting on a bench in the gardens and veer over to say hello. Staring intently in another direction, she doesn't even notice you until you clear your throat and say hello.
        
        "Oh! Hey, ah, Your Worship. Fair Festivus to ya. Havin' a good time?"
        
        You're definitely enjoying yourself — but you were expecting to. As you've seen at the brewery, boreal elves know how to have a lot of fun.
        
        Gara chuckles. "Yeah, you're not kidding. Sometimes, we even know how to clean up afterwards, too. It's a fun event, look forward to it every year... but it's a bit different with the little one on the way. I'm takin' a break myself, giving my feet and ankles a rest while hubby grabs me some more berry juice. It's okay if I don't get up, right?"
        
        It's fine. Ah, the travails of pregnancy.
        
        "You know it.[pc.bellyPregRange 15
            | Wish I could manage as well as you are.
        ]"
        
        Was that what was distracting her earlier? The usual aches and pains of expecting?
        
        "Kinda. I've just been watchin' the dance 'round the tree. Kids, parents, grandparents, everybody all holdin' hands and havin' a good time. I remember lovin' it when Festivus came 'round and I could dance with my moms and my brother, singin' and laughin' and runnin' until our legs gave out." She rests a blue hand on her belly and smiles. "Still hard to imagine that I'm gonna be able to do that with this lil' stranger someday. My moms keep tellin' me that havin' a kid's the best thing in the world... and half the time I'm daydreamin' about that, and the other half the time I'm thinkin' about how scary the whole thing is, bein' responsible for this little kiddo.[silly
            | Y'know: th' undiscovered country, from whose bourn no traveler returns. It's not death, it's parenthood.
        ]"
        
        [pc.hasKids
            |Having
            |From what you hear, having
        ] children is indeed quite the adventure, but you're sure she's going to love it. She seems like the type. Besides, it sounds like her moms are looking forward to being grandmas; at the very least, she should have plenty of help with her little one.
        
        "Thank the Dawn Maiden for that, right?" she laughs. "Gonna have to make 'em draw lots with Valien's parents to see who gets what days. Hey, speak of the devil: meet my co-owner and better half. Val, this is the Champion of Winter."
        
        Her husband, a tall, broad-shouldered purple elf bearing a drink in each hand, executes a very impressive half-bow despite his encumbrance. He doesn't spill a drop... which would make sense if he and Gara run the brewery as a family business. His vest, which leaves his arms bare, is perfect for showing off flower-and-acanthus tattoo sleeves, both identical to Gara's. "It's an honor, my [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]. Fair Festivus to you. I hope you're getting on well."
        
        The festivities have been delightful, and the company even more so.
        
        Valien's face opens up in a genuine grin. "Gara's only ever told me good things about you and [etheryn.crowned
            |Her Majesty
            |the Regent
        ], and now I see why."
        
        So, what's in store for them for the rest of the day? Will they be there for the speech and the singing later on?
        
        "Speech, yes," says Gara. "It kinda feels like a particularly big deal this year, y'know? [etheryn.crowned
            |Queen Etheryn
            |The Regent
        ] seems like a decent one, just tryin' to do her best, and she's a great customer to boot. So we'll be there to hear her words and cheer her on."
        
        "That," adds Val, "and it'll be good to know what the future with the druids looks like. We've got a good thing going with this peat deal, and more of that would be pretty nice." He takes a sip of his drink; just like his wife's glass, it's full of juice, out of what you presume is solidarity. "But the afternoon and evening'll be packed with celebrations down at the brewery. We've been rotating staff to try to get ready while making sure each person gets to enjoy at least part of the ball, and as soon as the speech is over I'll have to get back to work myself."
        
        His wife grimaces. "Oof, yeah. That's the other reason I'm taking a bit of a break. We'll be up on our feet 'til the wee hours of the mornin' with [silly
            |folk metal
            |drunken fiddler duels
        ] resonatin' in our ears. And we'll be keepin' the druids and townsfolk from gettin' into fights, which'll be a fun new project this year. And worryin' about everythin' they're gonna drink..."
        
        "Even with all of that, though, it'll be good business, and with Festivus in the air there's a better than even chance of everybody just being, you know, deliriously happy with no fighting at all."
        
        "I hope so. Everythin' goes tits up, though, you throw 'em all out. You like doin' that."
        
        "There are worse ways to spend time, even if I miss the days when you were still up to throwing them out alongside me." Val smiles at her fondly. "At any rate, that means no dancing or hymns for us, but we're used to it."
        
        Well, either way, you hope that their evening works out well, with a minimum of violence and a maximum of good business.
        
        Gara raises her juice glass. "Cheers. You're a good egg, Your Worship! I'm glad there're folks like you helpin' [etheryn.crowned
            |Queen
            |Regent
        ] Etheryn out. Lumia bless you."
        
        You wish them both well and take your leave; they deserve some time alone as a couple before their long Festivus evening.
rows.translation:
你看到那位满怀期待的精灵酒保正坐在花园的长椅上，便走过去跟她打招呼。她正全神贯注地望着另一个方向，直到你清了清嗓子才注意到你的存在。

“哦！嘿，啊，尊贵的阁下。祝您节日快乐，玩得开心吗？”

您肯定玩得很开心——毕竟这也是您所期待的。正如您在酿酒厂看到的那样，极北精灵确实懂得如何享受乐趣。
        
        加拉轻笑道：“是啊，你没开玩笑。有时候，我们甚至还会知道事后该怎么清理现场呢。这确实是个有趣的活动，每年都让人期待……不过现在有那个小宝宝在肚子里，情况就有点不一样了。这次我打算休息一下，让我的足部和脚踝好好放松一下，等老公再给我拿些莓果汁来。如果我不起床也没关系吧？”

“没关系。啊，怀孕真是让人辛苦啊。”

“你懂的。[pc.bellyPregRange 15
            | 真希望我也能像你一样做得这么好。
        ]原来是这样，刚才让她分心的就是这个吗？就是那种怀孕期间常见的各种不适吧？”

“差不多吧。我一直在看大家围着树跳舞的场景——孩子们、家长们、祖父母们，所有人手拉手，一起享受着欢乐的时光。我记得每当节日来临，我就会和妈妈、弟弟一起跳舞、唱歌、欢笑，跑来跑去，直到腿脚发软。她把一只蓝色的手放在肚子上，微笑着说道：“现在还是很难想象，有朝一日我也能和这个小小的陌生人一起做这些事情。我妈妈总是跟我说，生孩子是世界上最美好的事情……有一半的时间，我会幻想那种美好的情景；而另外一半的时间，我则会思考，承担起照顾这个小生命的责任，其实是一件多么可怕的事情啊。[silly
            | 你知道的：那个未被探索过的国度，从那里出发的旅行者再也没有回来过。这并非死亡，而是成为父母。
        ]"
        
        [pc.hasKids
            |拥有
            |据你所说，拥有……是件不错的事情。
        ]对孩子们来说，这确实是一次充满冒险的体验，但你可以肯定，她会非常喜欢的。她看起来就是那种会喜欢这类活动的人。而且，她的妈妈们似乎也很期待能当上奶奶；至少，在照顾孩子方面，她应该会得到很多帮助。
        
        这可得感谢黎明少女呢，对吧？”她笑着说，“看来得让她们和瓦里恩的父母一起抽签，决定谁该在哪些日子工作。嘿，说起来正好：让我介绍一下我的合伙人兼另一半吧。瓦，这位就是冬季的冠军。她的丈夫是一位身材高大、肩膀宽阔的紫色精灵，他双手各拿着一杯饮料，尽管背着这些东西，他仍然做出了一个非常娴熟的半鞠躬动作。他一滴饮料都没有洒出来……如果他和加拉将这家酿酒厂当作家族企业来经营的话，这一点也就不足为奇了。他的背心将双臂完全露出来，这样就能完美地展示那些印有花卉与刺叶图案的纹身袖子了——这些纹身和加拉的一模一样。“我很荣幸，[pc.mf
            |大人
            |夫人
        ]。祝您节庆节快乐，希望你们一切都好。”

庆典令人愉快，身边人的陪伴更是如此。

瓦里恩露出了真诚的微笑：“加拉从来只跟我讲你的好话[etheryn.crowned
            |女王陛下
            |摄政王
        ]现在我明白为什么了。”

那么，他们在今天剩下的时间里还会遇到什么事情呢？他们会参加后面的演讲和歌唱活动吗？

“演讲，是的，”加拉说，“今年这场演讲似乎格外重要，你知道的吧？ [etheryn.crowned
            |伊瑟琳女王
            |摄政王
        ]看起来她是个不错的人，一直在尽力做好自己的工作，而且她还是个非常不错的顾客。所以我们会去听她的说法，为她加油鼓劲的。”

“没错，”瓦尔补充道，“而且了解德鲁伊一族的未来发展方向也会很有帮助。我们通过这笔泥炭交易取得了不错的成果，如果能再多一些这样的交易，那就再好不过了。”他喝了一口饮料；和他妻子的杯子一样，他的杯子里也装满了果汁——大概这是出于一种默契吧。“不过，下午和晚上，酿酒厂里将会举行一系列庆祝活动。我们一直在轮换工作人员，以便在确保每个人都能至少参与到活动中来的同时做好准备工作。等演讲一结束，我就得回去继续工作了。”

他的妻子露出了苦涩的表情。哎哟，没错。这也是我打算休息一段时间的另一个原因。我们得工作到凌晨才能停下来[silly
            |民谣金属
            |醉酒的小提琴手决斗
        ]这些话一直回荡在我们的耳边。今年，我们的任务就是防止德鲁伊和镇民们发生冲突，这将会是一个有趣的新项目。另外，我们还得担心他们喝什么酒的问题……

不过，尽管有这些麻烦，这仍然会是一笔不错的生意。而且，既然节日即将来临，大家很有可能会因为没有发生任何冲突而开心得发狂，这样我们的成功率就会更高了。希望如此。不过，要是一切都搞砸了，你就把它们全都扔掉吧。你本来就喜欢这么做。”

“就算是没有你陪我一起把它们扔掉的那些日子，也有比这更糟糕的消磨时间的方式啊。瓦尔深情地微笑着看着她。‘无论如何，这意味着我们今晚不用跳舞，也不用唱赞美诗了，不过我们已经习惯了。’”

嗯，不管怎样，大家都希望他们的晚宴能够顺利进行，尽量减少暴力事件，同时让各种事务都能顺利达成。
        
        加拉举起她的果汁杯：“干杯！您真是个好人，大人！能遇到像您这样的人帮忙，我真的很高兴。 [etheryn.crowned
            |女王
            |摄政王
        ]愿伊瑟琳一切顺利，愿卢米娅保佑你。”

你祝愿他们俩一切安好，然后便离开了；在他们漫长的费斯蒂夫斯之夜来临之前，他们作为一对情侣，确实需要一些独处的时间。
rows.raw:
"
        You spy the expectant elven bartender resting on a bench in the gardens and veer over to say hello. Staring intently in another direction, she doesn't even notice you until you clear your throat and say hello.
        
        "Oh! Hey, ah, Your Worship. Fair Festivus to ya. Havin' a good time?"
        
        You're definitely enjoying yourself — but you were expecting to. As you've seen at the brewery, boreal elves know how to have a lot of fun.
        
        Gara chuckles. "Yeah, you're not kidding. Sometimes, we even know how to clean up afterwards, too. It's a fun event, look forward to it every year... but it's a bit different with the little one on the way. I'm takin' a break myself, giving my feet and ankles a rest while hubby grabs me some more berry juice. It's okay if I don't get up, right?"
        
        It's fine. Ah, the travails of pregnancy.
        
        "You know it.[pc.bellyPregRange 15
            | Wish I could manage as well as you are.
        ]"
        
        Was that what was distracting her earlier? The usual aches and pains of expecting?
        
        "Kinda. I've just been watchin' the dance 'round the tree. Kids, parents, grandparents, everybody all holdin' hands and havin' a good time. I remember lovin' it when Festivus came 'round and I could dance with my moms and my brother, singin' and laughin' and runnin' until our legs gave out." She rests a blue hand on her belly and smiles. "Still hard to imagine that I'm gonna be able to do that with this lil' stranger someday. My moms keep tellin' me that havin' a kid's the best thing in the world... and half the time I'm daydreamin' about that, and the other half the time I'm thinkin' about how scary the whole thing is, bein' responsible for this little kiddo.[silly
            | Y'know: th' undiscovered country, from whose bourn no traveler returns. It's not death, it's parenthood.
        ]"
        
        [pc.hasKids
            |Having
            |From what you hear, having
        ] children is indeed quite the adventure, but you're sure she's going to love it. She seems like the type. Besides, it sounds like her moms are looking forward to being grandmas; at the very least, she should have plenty of help with her little one.
        
        "Thank the Dawn Maiden for that, right?" she laughs. "Gonna have to make 'em draw lots with Valien's parents to see who gets what days. Hey, speak of the devil: meet my co-owner and better half. Val, this is the Champion of Winter."
        
        Her husband, a tall, broad-shouldered purple elf bearing a drink in each hand, executes a very impressive half-bow despite his encumbrance. He doesn't spill a drop... which would make sense if he and Gara run the brewery as a family business. His vest, which leaves his arms bare, is perfect for showing off flower-and-acanthus tattoo sleeves, both identical to Gara's. "It's an honor, my [pc.mf
            |lord
            |lady
        ]. Fair Festivus to you. I hope you're getting on well."
        
        The festivities have been delightful, and the company even more so.
        
        Valien's face opens up in a genuine grin. "Gara's only ever told me good things about you and [etheryn.crowned
            |Her Majesty
            |the Regent
        ], and now I see why."
        
        So, what's in store for them for the rest of the day? Will they be there for the speech and the singing later on?
        
        "Speech, yes," says Gara. "It kinda feels like a particularly big deal this year, y'know? [etheryn.crowned
            |Queen Etheryn
            |The Regent
        ] seems like a decent one, just tryin' to do her best, and she's a great customer to boot. So we'll be there to hear her words and cheer her on."
        
        "That," adds Val, "and it'll be good to know what the future with the druids looks like. We've got a good thing going with this peat deal, and more of that would be pretty nice." He takes a sip of his drink; just like his wife's glass, it's full of juice, out of what you presume is solidarity. "But the afternoon and evening'll be packed with celebrations down at the brewery. We've been rotating staff to try to get ready while making sure each person gets to enjoy at least part of the ball, and as soon as the speech is over I'll have to get back to work myself."
        
        His wife grimaces. "Oof, yeah. That's the other reason I'm taking a bit of a break. We'll be up on our feet 'til the wee hours of the mornin' with [silly
            |folk metal
            |drunken fiddler duels
        ] resonatin' in our ears. And we'll be keepin' the druids and townsfolk from gettin' into fights, which'll be a fun new project this year. And worryin' about everythin' they're gonna drink..."
        
        "Even with all of that, though, it'll be good business, and with Festivus in the air there's a better than even chance of everybody just being, you know, deliriously happy with no fighting at all."
        
        "I hope so. Everythin' goes tits up, though, you throw 'em all out. You like doin' that."
        
        "There are worse ways to spend time, even if I miss the days when you were still up to throwing them out alongside me." Val smiles at her fondly. "At any rate, that means no dancing or hymns for us, but we're used to it."
        
        Well, either way, you hope that their evening works out well, with a minimum of violence and a maximum of good business.
        
        Gara raises her juice glass. "Cheers. You're a good egg, Your Worship! I'm glad there're folks like you helpin' [etheryn.crowned
            |Queen
            |Regent
        ] Etheryn out. Lumia bless you."
        
        You wish them both well and take your leave; they deserve some time alone as a couple before their long Festivus evening.
        "

rows.original: Check in on the friendly barkeep.
rows.translation: 去看看那位友善的酒保吧。

rows.original: Gara's spending time with her husband now. You should probably leave her be.
rows.translation: 加拉现在正在和她的丈夫一起度过时光，你或许应该让她安静地待着。
rows.raw: "Gara's spending time with her husband now. You should probably leave her be."

" Thinking about it, Ryn said she invited all of your traveling companions to the party, didn't she?[party.hasCompanions | It wasn't just [party.compNames], you're pretty sure she said everyone. ] Well, if that's the case, you should be good to find them in the ballroom — they should be somewhere in this posh party, assuming they didn't turn down the invitation. And let's face it, who would? You certainly didn't. "

rows.original: Cait's the first to spot you — barely have you begun searching for the bubbly catgirl that she comes running up to you with a plate heaped high with cake and several tarts and candies. It's not just her ears and attire; her dyed hair and tail make her stand out from the crowd and her approach is painfully obvious as she comes to a screeching halt before you. "Oh hey, you're finally here, [pc.name]! Ryn said you might turn up any time now — the morning's still young, but I was getting kind of worried!" It looks like she's been enjoying herself. Cat get into the cream? "Mmhm! I've been here since dawn — I wanted to watch them consecrate the statue with the rising sun, then I offered to help with the last-minute preparations. The palace staff didn't want to let me at first, but I proved that I could pull my weight! And yes — " she points down at her plate — "there's a lot of cream in everything! The cake, the puffs, the soup, I sure got into a lot of it!" Well, you're just glad that she's fit into this throng of elves with such ease. "This was the kind of thing Dad, Calla and I were traveling all over for; I learned a lot from helping out with the final preparations! You get to see a lot of things most people don't, you know." Cait winks at you conspiratorially. "Ah, if only [var0 |Dad wasn't... well, Dad. He's already wandered off to the crypts with some poor cleric, insisting on learning all the history of all the rulers. Haha, that's so like him... |Dad would finally turn up somewhere! He'd have loved to see this place... ]" Enough of that, though, this is supposed to be a festive day and people are supposed to be having fun! What's she going to be up to once she finishes this sweet spread? "Well, Elthara asked me if I'd be willing to show some traditional Jassiran dance for the benefit of the people, since I'm a visiting dignitary — her words! — and all. I'm not as good as some others I know are, but then again she also asked me to not be too racy about it." Cait laughs, giving you a playful wink. "Contrary to popular belief, there are some Jassiran dances that aren't all hip and titty. Just a few, though. I just need to finish all this... and then I'll get started." Judging by the spread on Cait's plate, it looks like that'll be some time yet...
rows.translation: 凯特第一个发现了你——你才刚开始寻找那个活泼的猫女，她便端着一个堆满蛋糕、馅饼和糖果的盘子朝你跑来。不只是她的耳朵和衣着；染过色的头发与尾巴也让她在人群中格外醒目。她一路冲到你面前骤然刹住，想不注意到她都难。 “哦，嘿，你终于来了，[pc.name]！小琳说你随时都可能出现——虽然现在还是大清早，但我已经有点担心了！” 看来她玩得很开心。馋猫偷吃奶油了？ “嗯哼！我天一亮就到了——我想看他们在朝阳下为雕像祝圣，之后又主动帮忙进行最后的准备。宫里的工作人员一开始不愿意让我插手，但我证明了自己干得来！而且没错——”她指了指自己的盘子，“每样东西里都有好多奶油！蛋糕、泡芙、汤，我确实吃了个够！” 好吧，你只是很高兴她能如此轻松地融入这群精灵之中。 “爸爸、卡拉和我四处旅行，为的就是参加这样的活动；帮忙完成最后的准备让我学到了不少东西！你知道的，这样能看到许多普通人看不到的幕后景象。”凯特心照不宣地冲你眨眨眼。“唉，要是[var0 |爸爸不是……呃，爸爸就好了。他已经带着某个可怜的牧师跑去墓穴，非要了解历代所有统治者的历史。哈哈，这可真像他…… |爸爸终于能在某个地方露面就好了！他一定会喜欢这里的…… ]” 不说这些了。今天本来就是欢庆的日子，大家都该尽情享乐！等她吃完这盘甜点后，打算做些什么？ “嗯，艾尔萨拉问我愿不愿意为大家表演传统的贾西拉舞蹈，因为我是来访的贵宾——这是她的原话！——之类的。我没某些认识的人跳得那么好，不过她也叫我别跳得太色情。”凯特笑着朝你俏皮地眨眨眼。“和人们普遍的看法不同，确实有一些贾西拉舞蹈不全是摇臀晃奶。只是没几种就是了。我只需要先吃完这些……然后就可以开始。” 看凯特盘子里那一大堆食物，恐怕还得等上好一会儿……

rows.original: Brint's not hard to pick out in the crowd. Despite most pale elves being tall and well-built, the minotaur still manages to tower over the crowd by a head; you pick him out from a distance and slide your way through the crowd. He's got some kind of fish dish on his plate or the other, kind of pale and unappetising in appearance but nevertheless digging into it with relish. Brint swallows hastily when he sees you approach, waving you over. "Ah, [pc.name]! Good to see you; I was wondering when you'd show up." You've been here for a while yourself, it's just that there're a lot of people packed into the palace. How's he enjoying the party? "Actually... it's not bad. There's a lot less open decadence than I thought there'd be, but I should've expected that other places wouldn't be like home. It's totally on me! Oh!" He swings the plate in your direction. "Do you want to try some of this?" The smell that hits you can only be described as alchemical, and you fight the instinct to make a face and recoil. Just... just what is it? Brint takes another large bite — large by minotaur standards, too. "Oh, it's something the valkyries make up in the rift and send down for Festivus. Some kind of fermented fish product — smells kind of funky, but the taste isn't bad. Here, why don't you have some?" Actually, you think you'll need to make space for more of that cake you saw just now. A shrug. "Suit yourself, more for me. I'm just going to stand around and eat until it's time for Ryn to make her speech — no one really seems to know how to approach me, and I don't blame them." [flags.ELF_KAS_MET |Out in the distance by the gardens, you could swear you hear someone choking in anguish, followed by a lamentation along the lines of: "Marae's tits, what is that hrhghgh — " Must've just been your imagination. ]
rows.translation: 在人群中，布林特并不难认。尽管大多数苍白精灵都身材高大、体格健壮，这名弥诺陶洛斯仍比周围众人高出整整一个头；你隔着老远就发现了他，于是从人群中穿行过去。他盘子里盛着某种鱼肉料理，看起来颜色苍白，令人提不起食欲，他却依然吃得津津有味。见你走近，布林特连忙咽下嘴里的食物，挥手招呼你过去。 “啊，[pc.name]！很高兴见到你；我还在想你什么时候会出现呢。” 其实你也已经来了好一会儿，只不过宫殿里挤满了人。他觉得这场聚会怎么样？ “其实……还不错。这里公开放纵的程度比我预想中低得多，不过我早该想到，别的地方不会和家乡一样。这完全是我自己的问题！哦！”他把盘子朝你递来。“你想尝尝吗？” 扑面而来的气味只能用炼金术般来形容；你拼命忍住皱起脸来、向后退缩的本能。这……这到底是什么？ 布林特又咬下一大口——即使按弥诺陶洛斯的标准来看也相当大。“哦，这是女武神们在裂隙里制作、送到山下庆祝冬至节的东西。好像是某种发酵鱼制品——闻起来有点怪，但味道还不错。来，你为什么不尝尝呢？” 其实，你觉得自己得给刚才看见的蛋糕多留一点肚子。 他耸了耸肩。“随你便，那我就能多吃点了。我打算站在这里一直吃，直到小琳发表演说——似乎没人真正知道该怎么接近我，我也不怪他们。” [flags.ELF_KAS_MET |远处的花园边，你发誓自己听见有人痛苦地噎住了，随后传来一句大致这样的哀叹：“玛蕾的奶子啊，那是什么，呃呃呃——” 肯定只是你的错觉。 ]

rows.original: Brienne's not hard to pick out in the crowd. Despite most pale elves being tall and well-built, the cowgirl still manages to tower over the crowd by a head; you pick her out from a distance and slide your way through the crowd. She's got some kind of fish dish on her plate or the other, kind of pale and unappetising in appearance but nevertheless digging into it with relish. Brienne swallows hastily when she sees you approach, waving you over. "Ah, [pc.name]! Good to see you; I was wondering when you'd show up." You've been here for a while yourself, it's just that there're a lot of people packed into the palace. How's she enjoying the party? "Actually... it's not bad. There's a lot less open decadence than I thought there'd be, but I should've expected that other places wouldn't be like home. It's totally on me! Oh!" She swings the plate in your direction. "Do you want to try some of this?" The smell that hits you can only be described as alchemical, and you fight the instinct to make a face and recoil. Just... just what is it? Brienne takes another large bite — large by cowgirl standards, too. "Oh, it's something the valkyries make up in the rift and send down for Festivus. Some kind of fermented fish product — smells kind of funky, but the taste isn't bad. Here, why don't you have some?" Actually, you think you'll need to make space for more of that cake you saw just now. A shrug. "Suit yourself, more for me. I'm just going to stand around and eat until it's time for Ryn to make her speech — no one really seems to know how to approach me, and I don't blame them." rows.translation: 在人群中，布蕾妮很容易被认出来。尽管大多数苍白精灵都身材高大、体格健壮，但这位牛仔女孩依然比周围的人高出半个头；从远处就能看到她，然后你可以直接穿过人群走向她。她盘子里端着某种鱼料理，看起来颜色苍白、没什么食欲，但她却吃得津津有味。当看到你走过来时，布蕾妮急忙咽下嘴里的食物，然后向你招手。 “啊，[pc.name]！很高兴见到你；我还在想你什么时候会出现呢。” 你其实也已经在这里待了一段时间了，只是宫殿里挤满了人。她觉得这次聚会怎么样？ “其实……还不错。这里的开放与放纵程度比我想象的要低得多，不过我本就应该预料到，其他地方不可能和家乡一样。这完全是我的错！哦！”她把盘子朝你的方向一挥，“你想尝尝这些吗？” 扑面而来的那股气味只能用炼金术般的来形容，你努力按捺住做鬼脸和往后退的本能。只是……这到底是什么东西？ 布蕾妮又大口咬了一口——按照牛仔女孩的标准来说，这也算是一大口了。“哦，这是女武神们在裂谷里做出来、再送下来供节日享用的东西。某种发酵鱼制品——闻起来有点怪，但味道还不坏。来，你尝尝看？” 其实，你觉得自己得给刚才看到的那种蛋糕腾点肚子。 她耸了耸肩。“随你便吧，我多吃点。我就站在这儿一直吃到小琳发表演讲为止——好像没人真的知道该怎么跟我搭话，我也不怪他们。” [flags.ELF_KAS_MET |在远处的花园旁，你发誓自己听到了有人在痛苦中窒息的声音，紧接着是一句大意如下的哀叹：“玛拉埃的奶子啊，那到底是什么鬼 hrhghgh——” 肯定只是你的幻觉。 ]

rows.original: When you find Arona, she's doing the former of the two things she loves best: feasting and fucking. The orcess has firmly planted herself on one end of the buffet, claiming a table all for herself and surrounded by plates piled high with the richest delicacies that the palace has to offer. About four or five dozen elven children surround her as she applies herself with gusto, watching in rapt fascination — you note that while Arona's definitely looking a bit pudgier about the middle than usual, she isn't slowing down in the least. As you look on, she washes down the last of a roast with mirrorwine straight from the bottle, then starts on a bowl of soup as one of the children clears away the empty dish and returns with a full one from the buffet. Maybe it's time to get some answers. Kneeling down, you find the nearest kid and ask her just what's up. The elven child gets a mischievous look on her face. "We're seeing how much the troll can eat!" Really? The troll — you point at Arona — over there? "Yeah! All the stories say that they eat people, like three to four at a time, so we're giving it enough food to amount to that many people and, uh, see if trolls really can eat that much!" Given that you've actually seen a troll when you confronted Argoth... but then again, you have no desire to disabuse this kid of the idea that Arona's some kind of ravenous troll. She's certainly acting like one, if anything. "We think she's eaten enough to make up one person, now. Do you think she'll make two?" You glance back at Arona, now polishing off a large slice of heavy cream cake, and shrug. Maybe not, but it won't be for lack of trying, and let's face it — despite the amount she's eating, it's a cheap price to pay for her proving that much entertainment for the kids, even if inadvertently.
rows.translation: 你找到阿罗娜时，她正在做自己最爱的两件事中排在前面的那件：大吃大喝和纵情交欢。女兽人稳稳占据了自助餐台的一端，独占一张桌子，周围摆满了堆得高高的盘子，盛着宫殿所能提供的最丰盛佳肴。大约四五十个精灵孩子围在她身边，看她兴致勃勃地埋头猛吃，一个个看得入迷——你注意到，阿罗娜的腰腹确实比平时圆润了几分，可她丝毫没有放慢速度。你看着她拿起酒瓶，用镜酒灌下最后一口烤肉，接着又开始对付一碗汤；一个孩子将空盘撤走，又从自助餐台端来满满一盘。 或许该问清楚这是怎么回事了。你跪下来，找到离自己最近的孩子，问她究竟在做什么。 精灵孩子脸上露出调皮的神情。“我们在看巨魔到底能吃多少东西！” 真的吗？你指着那边的阿罗娜——她就是巨魔？ “对呀！所有故事都说巨魔会吃人，而且一顿能吃三四个，所以我们要给它足够抵得上那么多人的食物，然后，呃，看看巨魔是不是真的能吃下那么多！” 你在面对阿戈斯时确实见过真正的巨魔……不过话说回来，你一点也不想打消这个孩子把阿罗娜当成某种饥不择食的巨魔的念头。不管怎么说，她现在的表现确实很像。 “我们觉得她现在吃的东西已经抵得上一个人了。你觉得她能吃到两个人的分量吗？” 你回头看了看阿罗娜；她正迅速吃完一大块厚奶油蛋糕。你耸耸肩。或许不能，但她肯定会尽力；而且说实话，不管她吃了多少，能在无意间给孩子们带来这么多乐趣，这点代价都算便宜。

rows.original:
At first you worry Atugia may be hard to pick out, being a great deal shorter than the average boer'alvar. You search around, looking for defining features till your gaze is stopped still. Tui stands atop a short stair, chatting with some of the attendees and sampling food and wine from the passing platters. Her shock of red hair is what caught your eye, but the dress she's wearing is what kept it.
        
        Scintillating fabric sparkles like stars reflected on a dark ocean, and as she moves, you swear you can see wispy spiders crawling along the length. Gossamer fabric that glistens like morning dew is draped over each shoulder, adding a macabre sense of beauty to the ensemble. Around her neck, a black velvet ribbon with frilled edges provides complete coverage. Her normally boyish hair is swept into a twirl and held in place by a lapis lazuli-studded diadem.
        
        As you approach, you see the flush of red on her freckled face, not from the drink but from the attention she's getting. Nervous hands clench the front of her dazzling dress, but you see her visibly brighten when she notices you. She says a polite goodbye to the guests she's speaking with, before veering toward you in the most courteous panicked run you've ever seen, her jaunt letting you see a stunning pair of sapphire heels that accent her dress; she doesn't fancy being beset by another elven couple. 
        
        "Oh, thank the gods! The guests keep asking what kingdom I hail from, the children keep asking what life in the heavens is like, and I have absolutely no idea what to say. How can I have received Lady Reverra's tutelage for so long and still have no idea what to say? Bel Carn itself has no monarch, let alone Teiglache having any kind of royalty," she says, the words accompanied by exasperated gestures. You're half tempted to ask the same questions yourself, to be honest. For one thing the dress is beyond marvelous, where did it even come from?
        
        "Her ladyship had it expressly ordered during her time in Bel Carn. It was what she was picking up when she found me in the city. She heard I was going to a royal party and brought it out of storage," she replies, lapsing into an obviously tired response she's been using all night. 
        
        You snap your fingers, trying to break her out of her funk. It's weird seeing her in full formal mode, attire notwithstanding. She doesn't need to maintain any airs with you.
        
        "O-oh, right. Sorry, I get used to talkin' like that and it just sticks. Lots of practice, you know?" she says, plucking something from a passing platter that looks like some kind of cheese. She pops it into her mouth, hardly biting for more than a second before she swallows, and immediately taking a long swig of ice wine.
        
        "Have you tried that stuff? They said it was some kind of shark. They make a soup out of sharks in Bel Carn, and it tastes absolutely nothin' like that. I made the mistake of chewing it the first time, and gods it tasted like the smell of my grandmam's house after the cats got out of hand. B-but it's a lot better with the wine. They do similar stuff with the guts of cuttlefish in Kitsuhon, and that's fantastic with rice," she says. 
        
        You'll... have to take her word for it; neither of those things sound particularly appetizing. Is she sure she'll be ok? You can stay for a bit if she doesn't want to chat with random nobles.
        
        "No, no. I can handle stuff like this. It's no different from the foreign parties Carmen took me to. It's just been a couple years since the last one," she says, taking a much better smelling square of fruity looking cake from another passing platter and taking a small bite. She curtsies, a motion that sends spidery forms skittering over her dress, and turns away to mingle with more of the guests.
rows.translation:
起初，你担心阿图吉娅可能很难被认出来，因为她的个子比普通的布尔阿尔瓦人要矮很多。你四处寻找，试图找到能够区分她的特征，直到你的目光被某样东西吸引住了。图伊站在一段短台阶上，正和一些与会者聊天，同时品尝着人们端过来的食物和葡萄酒。她那醒目的红色头发首先吸引了你的注意，而她所穿的裙子更是让你无法忽视她的存在。
        
        这种闪闪发光的织物仿佛是夜海中反射出的星辰，当她移动时，你甚至会以为有细小的“蜘蛛”在织物上爬行。每一侧肩部都披着如晨露般闪烁的轻纱，这种装扮增添了一种诡异的美丽感。她的脖子上系着一条边缘带有褶边的黑色天鹅绒丝带，将她的颈部完全包裹起来。她那原本略显男孩气的头发被梳成一条辫子，然后用镶嵌着青金石的冠冕固定住。
        
        当你靠近时，你看到她那布满雀斑的脸上泛着红晕——这并非因为喝了什么酒，而是因为她正在受到众人的关注。她紧张地双手紧握着自己那件耀眼的连衣裙，但当她注意到你时，她的脸上立刻露出了灿烂的笑容。她礼貌地向那些正在与她交谈的宾客道别，然后以一种你见过的最急切、最优雅的方式朝你奔来。她的步伐轻快，让你得以看到她那双漂亮的蓝宝石色高跟鞋，它们为她的连衣裙增色不少；显然，她可不想再被另一对精灵情侣缠上了。 
        
        哦，感谢诸神！客人们一直问我来自哪个王国，孩子们也不断询问天界的生活是怎样的，而我却完全不知道该说什么好。我都接受了雷薇拉夫人的指导这么久了，怎么还不知道该回答这些问题呢？贝尔·卡恩本身就没有君主，更别说泰格拉切有什么王室成员了，”她边说边做出无奈的手势。说实话，你也有点想问自己同样的问题。首先，那条裙子简直美得不可思议，它到底是从哪里来的呢？
        
        夫人在贝尔卡恩期间明确吩咐过要准备这个。当她在城里找到我的时候，正是带着这个来的。她听说我要参加一场皇家聚会，所以就把它从储藏处取了出来，”她回答道，语气中明显带着一整晚都在重复这个回答而产生的疲惫感。 
        
        你打了个响指，试图让她从这种沉闷的状态中摆脱出来。看着她穿着那么正式的衣服，却依然保持着那种严肃的神情，确实有点奇怪。其实她完全没有必要在你面前摆出这种架子。
        
        “哦，对，抱歉。我习惯了那样说话，所以就养成了这个习惯。需要多练习才行，你知道的吧？”她边说边从旁边一个盘子里拿了一块看起来像奶酪的东西放进嘴里。她几乎没怎么咀嚼，就立刻吞了下去，然后立刻喝了一大口冰酒。
        
        你试过那种东西吗？他们说那是一种鲨鱼……在贝尔卡恩，人们会用鲨鱼来熬汤，但那种汤的味道和这个完全不一样。我第一次尝试的时候不小心嚼到了，天啊，那味道简直就像我奶奶家里那些猫闹翻天后的味道一样……不过，如果搭配葡萄酒一起吃，味道会好很多。在基茨霍恩，人们也会用乌贼的内脏来制作类似的食物，搭配米饭吃的话，简直棒极了。”她说。 
        
        你得相信她的话……那些东西听起来确实没什么吸引力。她确定自己没问题吗？如果她不想和那些陌生的贵族聊天，你也可以留下来陪她一会儿。
        
        “不，不用。这种事情我完全可以应付得来。这和卡门带我去过的那些外国餐厅没什么两样，只是距离上次去已经过去几年了吧，”她说道，从另一个经过的盘子里拿了一块散发着诱人香气的果味蛋糕，轻轻咬了一口。她行了一个屈膝礼，这个动作使得一些细小的东西从她的裙子上滑落，然后她转身去与其他宾客交流了。

rows.original: You don't notice Quin, Quin notices you. Barely has the idea of looking for him entered your mind that the bunny-boy claps you on the shoulder from behind, giving you a firm hug. "Fair Festivus, [pc.name]! Or at least, I think that's how the elves say it." Right back at him, too. What's up? He doesn't look like he's having any of the food. "Oh no, I don't have any appetite — not for any of this rich elf food, leastways. Just look at all the tall women packed in this hall — now that's the kind of appetite I'd like to sate!" Well, presumably the half-sexed amongst the boer'alvar find love and live lives, so he has a chance at picking up one of their amazonian women, you'd say. "That's right, I — " Quin pauses a moment, raises a finger and scowls. "Heeey." Best hop to it. He's only got one day to make this work, and no cheating. Wouldn't want to ruin the party for everyone else, hmm? "Ah, don't worry about it." He sweeps his hand over at the packed ballroom and gardens, then winks at you, his good humor flowing back like nothing had ever happened. "Just you wait, I'll be bedding a tall, blond, strong woman by the time the day is out." Uh-huh.
rows.translation: 你没有注意到昆因，而昆因却注意到了你。就在你刚刚想到要去找他的时候，那个兔耳男孩从背后拍了拍你的肩膀，然后紧紧地拥抱了你。 “节日快乐，[pc.name]！至少，我想精灵们是这么说的。” 也回他一句节日快乐。怎么了？他看起来对那些食物一点兴趣都没有。 “哦不，我实在没什么胃口——至少对这种精灵们做的美味食物来说，确实没有。只是看看这大厅里挤满的高个女人——那才是我想满足的那种欲望啊！” 嗯，布尔阿尔瓦人里的双性者想必也能找到爱情、过上好日子，所以你说，他也有机会勾搭上她们当中某个亚马孙女战士吧。 “没错，我——”昆因停顿了一下，举起一根手指，皱起了眉头。“嘿。” 最好赶紧行动起来。他只有一天时间办成这件事，而且不许作弊。毕竟我们可不想毁了其他人的兴致，对吧？ “啊，别担心这个。”他朝那座挤满人的舞厅和周围的花园挥了挥手，然后冲你眨了眨眼，他的好心情仿佛什么都没发生过一样，又回来了。“你就等着看吧，等到今天结束的时候，我肯定会把一个高挑、金发、强壮的女人弄上床。” 嗯哼。
rows.raw: " You don't notice Quin, Quin notices you. Barely has the idea of looking for him entered your mind that the bunny-boy claps you on the shoulder from behind, giving you a firm hug. "Fair Festivus, [pc.name]! Or at least, I think that's how the elves say it." Right back at him, too. What's up? He doesn't look like he's having any of the food. "Oh no, I don't have any appetite — not for any of this rich elf food, leastways. Just look at all the tall women packed in this hall — now that's the kind of appetite I'd like to sate!" Well, presumably the half-sexed amongst the boer'alvar find love and live lives, so he has a chance at picking up one of their amazonian women, you'd say. "That's right, I — " Quin pauses a moment, raises a finger and scowls. "Heeey." Best hop to it. He's only got one day to make this work, and no cheating. Wouldn't want to ruin the party for everyone else, hmm? "Ah, don't worry about it." He sweeps his hand over at the packed ballroom and gardens, then winks at you, his good humor flowing back like nothing had ever happened. "Just you wait, I'll be bedding a tall, blond, strong woman by the time the day is out." Uh-huh. "

rows.original: As it turns out, finding your fox-wife take a little longer than expected. Foxes are good at hiding — if she doesn't want to be seen, she won't be, but even so, you should be an exception, right? You eventually find Kiyoko sitting in an alcove by a corner, having pulled up a chair and set as many of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails as she can on her lap. She looks utterly serene and calm, but that's how she always looks, isn't that the case? Ah, having retreated from the party for a bit? "I would not presume to lie to you, beloved." Hmm... not to her tastes? She sighs. "The people are very nice, and Etheryn herself has come around to ask if she can do anything for me, but I will be fine as I am. It is not in us to complain about the hospitality shown by others. I will not conduct myself in a manner that brings shame upon you, but that is as much as I will do." ...There's the stubbornly passive-aggressive politeness her people use when they don't want to discuss the matter further. You don't want to press her, but at the same time it's hard to look at her so deeply out of her element. Well, there's a bitter edge to this party...
rows.translation: 事实证明，找到你的狐族妻子比预想中多花了一些时间。狐狸很擅长躲藏——如果她不愿被人看见，别人就找不到她；但即便如此，你也该是个例外，对吧？ 最终，你在角落的一处凹室里找到了清子。她搬来一把椅子坐下，将[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]条尾巴中尽可能多的几条拢在膝上。她看起来无比平静安详，但她平时不总是这副模样吗？ 啊，是暂时离开宴会清静一会儿吗？ “亲爱的，我不会冒昧地对你撒谎。” 嗯……这里不合她的口味？ 她叹了口气。“这里的人都很友善，伊瑟琳本人也过来问我是否需要帮忙，但我维持现状就好。我们一族不会抱怨他人的款待。我不会做出令你蒙羞的举止，但我能做的也仅止于此。” ……这就是她的族人在不愿继续讨论某件事时，那种固执而含蓄地表达不满的礼貌方式。你不想逼问她，可看到她如此格格不入，又实在令人难受。好吧，这场宴会的苦涩之处原来在这里……

rows.original:
You catch Azyrran drawing away from the buffet, the hive knight's hands piled with multiple plates. It makes for a strange juxtaposition compared to the warm smiles and polite bows she shares with any passers-by.
        
        With a little shake of her head, the soft flaxen locks of her hair manage to get themselves out of her face after yet another deft bow to a large, passing elf. "Having fun?"
        
        As much as she is. Huh... all those plates she has with her — meats, seafood, all savory, no sweet. Is she sure she's really a hornet?
        
        Azzy tsks and moves to boop you on the nose, then thinks better of it given her burden. "[party.has azyrran
            |You know, I was just joking last night. 
        ]If I wanted something sweet, there's plenty of that at home in the hive. Here... I want to taste what these people consider fancy, and so far I've not been let down in the least."
        
        Ah... that's fair.
        
        "It's a good party, great atmosphere. I'm really looking forward to the dancing later on, too — I daresay I'm a pretty good dancer, might show those elves a thing or two."
        
        Well, you'll be waiting to see her in action later, then.
        
        "See? Why not join?"
        
        Ah, that's a pretty strong invitation there... you'll consider it deeply, you will.
        
        She grins and glances away. "Don't be a tease; it's not nice to get a girl's hopes up for nothing! One way or the other, I'll be seeing you later!"
rows.translation:
你看到阿兹兰从自助餐区走开，那位蜂群骑士的手里堆满了好几盘食物。这与她对路人们展现出的温暖笑容与礼貌鞠躬形成了鲜明的对比。
        
        她轻轻摇了摇头，那柔软的亚麻色长发又一次巧妙地从她脸上滑落，这时，一个体型高大的精灵从她身边经过。“玩得开心吗？”
        
        她确实玩得很开心。嗯……她手里拿着那些盘子，里面全是肉类和海鲜，都是美味的菜肴，没有一点甜食。她确定自己真的是一只大黄蜂吗？
        
        阿齐“啧”了一声，本来想用鼻子轻触你一下，但考虑到自己身上的负担，她还是放弃了这个想法。[party.has azyrran
            |你知道，我昨晚只是开个玩笑而已。 
        ]如果我想吃点甜的东西，家里有的是。不过……我想尝尝这些人认为高档的东西，到目前为止，我一点也没有失望过。
        
        啊……这也难怪。
        
        这个派对真的很棒，气氛也很热烈。我真的很期待晚上的舞蹈环节——我自认为自己的舞跳得还不错，说不定还能给那些精灵们展示一下我的本领呢。”
        
        嗯，那你可得等着看她晚上的表现了。
        
        看到了吧？为什么不加入呢？”
        
        啊，这邀请可真够直接的……你肯定会认真考虑的，肯定会的。
        
        她笑了笑，然后把目光移开了。“别开玩笑了；让一个女孩白白抱有希望，那可不太好！不管怎样，晚点见吧！

rows.original: It's not hard to find the little mecian — she's busy packing it away, stuffing her cheeks with the richest food she can find as if she were going to a desolate wasteland tomorrow. Knowing her history, you can't quite blame her, but at the same time it's kind of awkward to see the little mousegirl stuff her face like that. It's all right, she can slow down. Even though the feasting will be officially over at noon, the buffer will still be open throughout the day. Einin squeaks when she feels your hand on her shoulder, and sets down her fork, looking more than a little guilty. "I'm s-sorry. I just kind of got carried away..." Her stomach probably isn't used to this kind of rich food, so she should be careful about overindulging. "Y-yeah." Looking dejectedly down at her plate, Einin's silent for several moments while the buzz of the party surrounds the both of you. "I feel kinda guilty for stuffing myself while Dad and everyone else back home may not have enough to eat. On the other hand, I should stuff myself because I may never get another chance like this again." You're sure that Ryn will be more than happy to invite her to next year's ball. "I know, but... [pc.name], the kind of life I used to lead, you couldn't be sure — couldn't be sure — " The only acceptable answer here, really, is a pat on the head. Einin pipes down after a moment, still staring down at her plate. There's nothing wrong with indulging on this day — it is Midwinter Festivus, after all. She just needs to be careful that she doesn't overdo it and regret it later. Tomorrow will eventually come, after all. "Yeah. Tomorrow..."
rows.translation: 找到那个小梅西亚人并不难——她正忙着狼吞虎咽，把能找到的最丰盛的食物塞进脸颊，就好像明天就要被丢进一片荒凉的废土上一样。了解她的过去后，你也不好责怪她，但看着这个小老鼠女孩这样胡吃海塞的样子，还是有点让人觉得尴尬。 没关系，她可以放慢速度。虽然正式的宴席会在中午结束，但自助餐台还是会全天开放。 当艾宁感觉到你的手放在她的肩膀上时，她吱地叫了一声，放下了叉子，看起来非常内疚。“我、我很抱歉，我只是有点控制不住自己了……” 她的肠胃可能还不习惯这种油腻的食物，所以应该注意不要吃撑了。 “嗯，是啊。”艾宁沮丧地低头看着自己的盘子，沉默了好一会儿，而周围的派对依然热闹非凡。“我觉得有点内疚，因为我在家里吃得这么饱，而爸爸和其他人可能连足够的食物都没有。可另一方面，我又应该把自己塞饱，因为可能再也不会有这样的机会了。” 你确定小琳会很乐意邀请她参加明年的舞会。 “我知道，但是…… [pc.name]，我过去过的那种日子，你没法确定——没法确定——” 在这里，唯一合适的回应，真的就是拍拍她的头。过了一会儿，艾宁安静了下来，依然低头盯着自己的盘子。 在这一天放纵一下并没有什么坏处——毕竟这是仲冬节。她只要注意不要做得太过火、以免日后后悔就行。毕竟，明天总会到来的。 “是啊。明天……”
