rows.original: [viv.isDemon |You... well, you're not actually sure where Viviane is. It takes a while to push through the throng in search of the witch, without hide nor hair of her. No hat, no nothing. What you do notice, though, is that there's a certain spirit rolling around and barking in the royal gardens while a small horde of elven children giggle, pet, and chase him around. Viviane's ghost wolf is having as good a time as the kids are — what a good spectral dog[silly |go ] he is! The scene of mayhem and merriment, though, doesn't include a witch, so after amusedly watching the delighted elves and the spirit pet for a few minutes, you head off again in search of his mistress. You finally find her several hedges away, hiding in a little alcove and eating one of the elves' aromatic fish dishes — and she doesn't look particularly happy. "What? I... I'm surviving, I suppose." Viv houses one of the chunks of fish meat. "Mmmf. The herring is pretty good. I finished off all the alcohol that came with it, though." [flags.RYN_FISH | Yeah, she's supposed to sip it alongside the herring. The witch raises an eyebrow at you. "Really, [pc.name]? Whatever. I do want more. | Shame. Maybe she should go back for more. "Oh, I will. ] Just need to avoid all the elves in order to get another cup." Is that why her spirit wolf is out distracting a bunch of children? "Yes," she says shortly. Apparently the 'do better at social' idea didn't take. "Still: I've got my little hideaway, and the food is as good as promised. On balance, this has been a good time so far." Does the balance change if she starts to see people in person? "All bets are off — so don't you dare." |Your witchy companion's off by one of the walls, rather than in the middle of the action, which is about what you'd expect. What you're pleasantly surprised to see is that [party.has viviane |she's not |the somewhat socially awkward witch isn't ] just holding a plate and trying to avoid people, but that she's actively engaged in conversation with a friendly and well-dressed blonde elven gentleman[flags.RYN_MARKET | — none other than Telfir himself. He looks a little tired after last night, but he's still more than holding up his end of the discussion ]. It's animated and Viviane seems to be smiling and laughing a lot, so you avoid interrupting them. You don't have to wait long, though; less than a minute passes before an amazonian elven woman arrives, hands [flags.RYN_MARKET |Telfir |her... boyfriend? husband? ] a cup, amiably greets Viviane, and, after a few minutes' more friendly conversation, leaves arm-in-arm with her dapper beau. As soon as they leave, the delighted redheaded witch waves you over. "I should've expected it," she says excitedly, "but have you any idea how impressive some of these elven seamsters are? Even the commoners' outfits — and almost everyone here is a commoner — are amazing!" [flags.RYN_MARKET |Yeah, you've met Telfir before, and you were very impressed; in fact, he's the one who made your current outfit. Viv lets out a low whistle. "And it looks like it. What a treat! I'd love to drop by his premises sometime. |For sure. The Lumians around here are like a sea of pastels, and the druids in their simpler forest-y gear look pretty nice, too. "Indeed. No matter how much people have to their name or how hard their lives are, people like to wear nice colors.[silly | Ancient and medieval villages weren't a sea of drab brown, no matter what the movies show. ] But the style, too... I'd love to visit that seamster's shop sometime. ] The techniques he's mentioned sound spectacular. I need to pick his brain somewhere other than a party! From how he marveled over this dress, I think he's got a few questions for me, too." You take it that that means she's enjoying herself. "Despite my best efforts, yes," she chuckles. "The food is good; I'm really enjoying this herring. And the drink makes it go down nice and easy. Congratulations, [flags.VIV_DATE |darling |[pc.name] ]: you got me to have some fun, even though there's a ton of people around." That's what Festivus is all about, you gather. Viviane grins. "As good a reason for a holiday as any.[silly | I think I still prefer Halloween, though. It's my birthday, after all. ]" Wonderful. You don't suppose that means she's reconsidered her stance on dancing... [flags.VIV_DATE | "Tch. Now who's the cheeky one? I'm still not one for dance floors quite yet, love, but I'm warming up to the idea. Maybe next year — but it'd better be you taking me out there." | "Gods, no. Not even if I have a lot more to drink. Sorry, sweetheart, but this year, at least, I'll be standing on the side and just watching." ] ]
rows.translation: [viv.isDemon |你……嗯，其实你并不确定薇薇安到底在哪里。要在人群中搜寻那位女巫，确实需要花费一些时间，而且根本找不到她的踪迹，连她的帽子都没有。 不过，你确实注意到，在皇家花园里有一只灵兽在四处奔跑、吠叫，而一群小精灵孩子们则在一旁咯咯笑着，抚摸它、追逐它。薇薇安的幽灵狼过得和孩子们一样开心——真是一只可爱的幽灵狗狗啊。[silly |开始吧 ]他就在那里！然而，那片充满混乱与欢乐的场景里并没有女巫的身影。因此，在欣赏了那些欢欣鼓舞的精灵们以及他们的灵宠几分钟之后，你便继续踏上了寻找他女主人的旅程。 最终，你在几道树篱之外找到了她——她正躲在一个小角落里，吃着精灵们做的那些香气扑鼻的鱼料理，不过她的表情似乎并不高兴。 什么？我……我想我还活着吧。”薇芙吃着其中一块鱼肉说道，“嗯，这种鲱鱼味道还不错。不过，随鱼附带的酒我全都喝光了。 [flags.RYN_FISH | 是的，她应该把这种饮料和鲱鱼一起慢慢品尝。” 女巫挑了挑眉毛，看着你说道：“真的吗？[pc.name]？ 随你便吧。我做还想更多。 | 真遗憾。也许她应该再回去拿一些来。 “哦，我会的。 ]只需要避开所有的精灵，就能得到另一杯酒。” 那么，这就是为什么她的灵狼会出去吸引那些孩子们的注意吗？ “是的，”她简短地回答。显然，“提高社交能力”这个想法并没有奏效。不过，我有一个自己的小隐居处，食物也确实如承诺般美味。总的来说，到目前为止，这段时光过得还不错。” 那么，如果她开始与他人当面见面，这种平衡会发生变化吗？ 结果完全难以预料——所以你最好别冒险。 |你的那位女巫同伴并没有出现在战斗的中央，而是站在其中一面墙边。不过，当你看到这一幕时，你会感到十分意外和惊喜。 [party.has viviane |她不是。 |这个在社交方面有些笨拙的女巫并不是…… ]她只是拿着一个盘子，试图避开人群，但事实上，她正在与一位友善且穿着得体的金发精灵绅士积极地交谈着。[flags.RYN_MARKET | ——正是泰尔菲尔本人。经过昨夜的忙碌，他看起来有些疲惫，但仍然能够充分参与讨论。 ]这个动画效果非常生动，薇薇安看起来一直在微笑、大笑，因此你最好不要去打扰她们。不过，你也不用等待太久——不到一分钟，一位亚马逊精灵女性就出现了，她手里[flags.RYN_MARKET |泰尔菲尔 |她的……男朋友？丈夫？ ]一杯酒端上来，友好地招待着薇薇安，又聊了几分钟之后，她便挽着那位风度翩翩的男友一起离开了。 他们一走，那个高兴的红发女巫立刻招手叫你过去。“我早该料到会这样的，”她兴奋地说，“但你知道吗，这些精灵裁缝的手艺真是太厉害了！就连普通人的服装——而这里几乎所有人都是普通人吧——也都做得非常精致、漂亮！ [flags.RYN_MARKET |是啊，你之前已经见过泰尔菲尔了，而且对他印象深刻；事实上，正是他为你设计了现在的这套服装。 薇芙轻声赞叹道：“看起来确实很棒！真是个难得的惊喜！我以后一定有机会去他的工作室看看。 |当然。这里的卢米安人穿着各种淡雅的色彩，而那些穿着简单森林风格服装的德鲁伊们，看起来也相当漂亮。 “的确如此。无论一个人拥有多少荣誉，无论他们的生活有多艰难，人们总是喜欢穿着色彩鲜艳的衣服。[silly | 无论电影里是如何描绘的，古代和中世纪的村庄其实并不是一片单调的棕色世界。 ]不过那种风格……我真希望能有空去那家裁缝店看看。 ]他提到的那些技巧听起来确实很棒。我真得找个机会单独请教他才行！从他对着那条裙子赞叹不已的样子来看，我想他也有几句话想问我的。 你的意思是，她现在玩得很开心吧？ “尽管我付出了很多努力，但确实如此，”她笑着说，“食物很美味，尤其是这种鲱鱼，我真的很喜欢。再加上这些饮料，让用餐体验更加愉快。恭喜你啊[flags.VIV_DATE |亲爱的 |[pc.name] ]你让我也玩得开心起来了，尽管周围有很多人。” 这才是仲冬节的意义所在，就是让大家聚在一起。 薇薇安笑了：“这确实是庆祝节日的绝佳理由。[silly | 不过，我还是更喜欢万圣节。毕竟那天也是我的生日。 ]太棒了。你该不会认为这意味着她改变了对跳舞的态度吧…… [flags.VIV_DATE | 啧，现在谁才是那个厚脸皮的人呢？亲爱的，我其实还不太适合去舞池跳舞，不过我正在慢慢接受这个想法。也许明年吧——不过最好还是你带我去。 | 天啊，不行。就算我还有很多酒可以喝，也不行。对不起，亲爱的，但至少今年，我只会站在一旁看着而已。 ] ]
rows.raw: " [viv.isDemon |You... well, you're not actually sure where Viviane is. It takes a while to push through the throng in search of the witch, without hide nor hair of her. No hat, no nothing. What you do notice, though, is that there's a certain spirit rolling around and barking in the royal gardens while a small horde of elven children giggle, pet, and chase him around. Viviane's ghost wolf is having as good a time as the kids are — what a good spectral dog[silly |go ] he is! The scene of mayhem and merriment, though, doesn't include a witch, so after amusedly watching the delighted elves and the spirit pet for a few minutes, you head off again in search of his mistress. You finally find her several hedges away, hiding in a little alcove and eating one of the elves' aromatic fish dishes — and she doesn't look particularly happy. "What? I... I'm surviving, I suppose." Viv houses one of the chunks of fish meat. "Mmmf. The herring is pretty good. I finished off all the alcohol that came with it, though." [flags.RYN_FISH | Yeah, she's supposed to sip it alongside the herring. The witch raises an eyebrow at you. "Really, [pc.name]? Whatever. I do want more. | Shame. Maybe she should go back for more. "Oh, I will. ] Just need to avoid all the elves in order to get another cup." Is that why her spirit wolf is out distracting a bunch of children? "Yes," she says shortly. Apparently the 'do better at social' idea didn't take. "Still: I've got my little hideaway, and the food is as good as promised. On balance, this has been a good time so far." Does the balance change if she starts to see people in person? "All bets are off — so don't you dare." |Your witchy companion's off by one of the walls, rather than in the middle of the action, which is about what you'd expect. What you're pleasantly surprised to see is that [party.has viviane |she's not |the somewhat socially awkward witch isn't ] just holding a plate and trying to avoid people, but that she's actively engaged in conversation with a friendly and well-dressed blonde elven gentleman[flags.RYN_MARKET | — none other than Telfir himself. He looks a little tired after last night, but he's still more than holding up his end of the discussion ]. It's animated and Viviane seems to be smiling and laughing a lot, so you avoid interrupting them. You don't have to wait long, though; less than a minute passes before an amazonian elven woman arrives, hands [flags.RYN_MARKET |Telfir |her... boyfriend? husband? ] a cup, amiably greets Viviane, and, after a few minutes' more friendly conversation, leaves arm-in-arm with her dapper beau. As soon as they leave, the delighted redheaded witch waves you over. "I should've expected it," she says excitedly, "but have you any idea how impressive some of these elven seamsters are? Even the commoners' outfits — and almost everyone here is a commoner — are amazing!" [flags.RYN_MARKET |Yeah, you've met Telfir before, and you were very impressed; in fact, he's the one who made your current outfit. Viv lets out a low whistle. "And it looks like it. What a treat! I'd love to drop by his premises sometime. |For sure. The Lumians around here are like a sea of pastels, and the druids in their simpler forest-y gear look pretty nice, too. "Indeed. No matter how much people have to their name or how hard their lives are, people like to wear nice colors.[silly | Ancient and medieval villages weren't a sea of drab brown, no matter what the movies show. ] But the style, too... I'd love to visit that seamster's shop sometime. ] The techniques he's mentioned sound spectacular. I need to pick his brain somewhere other than a party! From how he marveled over this dress, I think he's got a few questions for me, too." You take it that that means she's enjoying herself. "Despite my best efforts, yes," she chuckles. "The food is good; I'm really enjoying this herring. And the drink makes it go down nice and easy. Congratulations, [flags.VIV_DATE |darling |[pc.name] ]: you got me to have some fun, even though there's a ton of people around." That's what Festivus is all about, you gather. Viviane grins. "As good a reason for a holiday as any.[silly | I think I still prefer Halloween, though. It's my birthday, after all. ]" Wonderful. You don't suppose that means she's reconsidered her stance on dancing... [flags.VIV_DATE | "Tch. Now who's the cheeky one? I'm still not one for dance floors quite yet, love, but I'm warming up to the idea. Maybe next year — but it'd better be you taking me out there." | "Gods, no. Not even if I have a lot more to drink. Sorry, sweetheart, but this year, at least, I'll be standing on the side and just watching." ] ]"

rows.original:
Mm, you've done all you wanted at the morning's festivities, so you just find a nice little nook in the ballroom and let the atmosphere of the people soak into you. The energy, the laughter, the voices... despite all that's happened to the Winter City, there's still hope in the pale elves, and perhaps that's what counts regardless of the symbology of the day. Even Hethia and her people look to be genuine in their revelry, despite the cloud that hangs over them, and you can respect them for that.
    
    As time ticks by, the sun climbs higher in the sky, until a large bell chimes from somewhere above the palace, high atop the glacier. It's noon — time to head out to the gardens and hear Ryn deliver her speech, then.
rows.translation:
嗯，在早上的庆祝活动中，你已经做了你想做的一切，现在只需在舞厅里找个安静的角落，让周围人们的氛围感染你吧。那种活力、笑声、人们的谈话声……尽管冬城发生了那么多事情，但苍白精灵们心中依然怀有希望，或许这才是最重要的，而不是那些象征意义。即使赫希娅和她的族人身上笼罩着阴云，但他们在欢庆时的神情却是如此真挚，因此你不得不对他们表示尊重。
    
    随着时间的流逝，太阳逐渐升高，直到宫殿上方、冰川之巅的某个地方，有一口巨大的钟声突然响起。现在是中午了——是时候去花园里听小琳发表她的演讲了。
rows.raw:
"
    Mm, you've done all you wanted at the morning's festivities, so you just find a nice little nook in the ballroom and let the atmosphere of the people soak into you. The energy, the laughter, the voices... despite all that's happened to the Winter City, there's still hope in the pale elves, and perhaps that's what counts regardless of the symbology of the day. Even Hethia and her people look to be genuine in their revelry, despite the cloud that hangs over them, and you can respect them for that.
    
    As time ticks by, the sun climbs higher in the sky, until a large bell chimes from somewhere above the palace, high atop the glacier. It's noon — time to head out to the gardens and hear Ryn deliver her speech, then.
    "

rows.original: The sun's high in the sky when you leave the shade of the ballroom and enter the rose garden, where preparations have been ongoing since dawn for Ryn's address to her subjects. Flanked by hedges of ice roses on either side, a platform rises above the garden back with a marble fountain behind as a backdrop, draped with thick azure woollen cloth to form a stage. Higher than most people who would be listening to the speech, of course... but not too high, either. This is supposed to be the one day each year the pale elves are expected to approach their rulers, and for that... well, Ryn has to be approachable, doesn't she? You notice that in addition to the palace guard, there're a handful of particularly tall, radiant elves in the garden — mostly about the stage, while the common guard take to the sides and wrangles the crowd that's gathered to come and hear Etheryn speak. Valkyries! And there are a lot of them. Given your position as Ryn's champion, you're ushered off to one side of the stage where you can get a good view of of the lectern where she's supposed to deliver her speech from. The rest of everyone else... well, while several rope barriers keep the rose gardens from devolving into complete chaos, it's still a close thing for the harried guards. Not that it's a bad kind of chaos; the feeling you're getting from the crowd is generally one of positivity and excitement, hushed not-quite-whispers and excited murmurings as the elves await the arrival of their [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]. As the last of the bell's peals echo into the distance, a horn sounds, and Ryn emerges from the ballroom, flanked by a quartet of valkyries as her honor guard. [etheryn.lowConfidence |It looks like Elthara's drilled her well — though you know how insecure your elven companion usually is, here and now she's at least comported herself in a manner befitting the royal presence. And that makes sense — like it or not, far more people than herself are relying on her, and she's got to put on a strong face and smile for them whether she's feeling it or not. |Striding forward confidently in step with her honor guard, she really looks different from the quailing, uncertain girl that you met all that time ago at the ruined wayfort. Well, it wasn't that long ago, was it? Yet so much's happened in that time that you'd be surprised if Ryn still hadn't changed from who she was. Seeing her make her entrance, there's no doubt that Ryn's comported herself in a manner befitting the royal presence, and [etheryn.highConfidence |without even needing to think about it to boot |without too much effort, too ]. And it makes sense. Here on this day, the people of the Winter City are looking to her for reassurance for their future, especially with all the great changes that've happened in so short a time. She's got to put on a strong face and smile for them, dispel their fears and doubts... and it helps a lot that her strength and smile alike are truly genuine. ] Ah, heavy is the head that wears the crown... But it is what it is. Dressed up in her grandmother's full regalia — the furs of blue, white and gold, the crown jewels, and[etheryn.crowned |[flags.ETHERYN_CROWNED |, of course, her sister's, no, grandmother's crown |, of course, her mother's crown ] |... ah, of course she's not wearing the crown yet ], Ryn sweeps down the carpeted garden path to the soft cheers of the assembled elves. She does look taller than usual, and you can't help but wonder if Elthara's provided some platform shoes for her to wear throughout all this. Ryn's honor guard of valkyries peels away to either side of the stage while she takes her place at the lectern, letting the sight of her assembled subjects sink in; her eyes linger on you for a moment, and you give her a smile and thumbs-up before she looks away, smiling. "A fair Midwinter Festivus to each and every one of you who has gathered here to partake of the Crown's hospitality this day. At this hour, when the glory of the sun and her light is at its greatest, I intend to unreservedly and unambiguously state with Lumia's blessings the hopes that I have for the future." Her voice rings out over the gardens, loud and clear; [etheryn.lowConfidence |her usual stutter nowhere to be heard — well, almost nowhere, but certainly still perceptible to someone who knows to listen for it. Nevertheless, it's an impressive achievement both on Elthara and Ryn's part to inspire this burst of confidence and courage |knowing how Ryn usually speaks, you can't help but wonder if her voice's being amplified somehow ]... "I will be forthright in my address to you — instead of my sister's honeyed words which were soothing but lacking all substance, I will give you the truth as I know it, however harsh as it may be. "It was not so long ago that you all witnessed the fruits of my sister's betrayal, and what happened to her; that you all have still accepted the var Ridell line after what we've done to you is a great vote of confidence in me for which I'm thankful. I could not dare to ask more from my subjects — your loyalty, your hope, and your faith in me has inspired me to make the decisions which I believe will be the best for the Winter City going forward. "All of us understand that we are in a time of darkness, and a time of change. The demonic corruption that transpired here in this very palace is happening elsewhere in the world as well; I have seen as much during my travels with my champion. Neither are we the only ones to be aware that this is happening; other peoples have discovered the presence of such corruption and are reacting in their own ways. For example, I learned that the great city of the minotaurs under their mountain has gone into quarantine, fearing this very same corruption which seduced my sister and the nobility. But that does not make sense — they cannot live forever like that, sequestered under the earth and refusing entry or exit. Assuming their plan succeeds, they might survive a while longer, be the last to be devoured by the beast, but at that point who will be left to stand with them? [var0 |"Another approach I encountered was that of an orcish chieftain. Reputedly, his seeress — also a blessed adherent of the Lady of Light — was granted a vision of this encroaching darkness, and promptly informed her brother of such. He gathered his entire tribe, sailed the seas to the continent, and awaited the commencement of his great battle. "But he didn't tell anyone about it, not even his tribe or the rest of his family. He wanted his people to take part in something that would reshape the world as we know it, but didn't want to share in any of the glory he thought he would win." Orc...? Ah, she must be talking about Argoth. "This chieftain did not try to make more out of his tribe; instead, he tried to use them to make himself into a living legend. A brute with delusions of grandeur, he thought he could defeat the darkness alone — not with allies, not even his tribe, he himself. His tribe was merely there to fight the underlings, and alone in knowing the truth of his sister's visions, the orc chieftain planned to defeat the encroaching darkness in glorious combat and claim all the renown for himself. "His entire so-called plan was not realistic. He did not try to form an army for a second Godswar, he did not create alliances with others to strengthen himself. He thought himself ready to become a legend and waited for fate to serve itself up at his feet. The moment he interpreted the vision so graciously sent by Lumia in so self-serving a fashion, his overthrow as chieftain was all but assured. ] "One of the first things I did upon escaping from my sister was to head south into the lands the other peoples call the Marches, beyond the old Wayfort we used to call our own. Surely the ancient agreements signed with my ancestors would be honored, and I would return with an army to retake the palace from my sister! "But it was not to be. We boer'alvar live longer than other peoples, and our perception of time is different. While we busied ourselves up north in the rift, keeping our business to our own, the world had passed us by. The Belhar Empire with which my great-great-great grandfather had signed treaties was no more. The local baroness was a powerless woman with neither army nor resources to spare, an echo of that empire. In our isolation, we had blinded ourselves to the state of affairs beyond our borders, and when I needed help there was none to be had where I expected it to be. As it turned out, I did not need an army to set things right, but one cannot continually depend on the goddess' providence to supply us with what we need. As our mother, Lumia wishes for us to grow and be able to stand on our own feet. "So this is the first direction which has, and will shape policies from my rule going forward: we will no longer isolate ourselves from the world, and reach out to other peoples and understand what is going on around us. Our remote location atop the crown of the land clearly is no shield from the corruption that approaches, and in order to defeat it we must join with other peoples. This is not to say to embrace them, to blindly trust them, or to necessarily even approve of their ways and customs. But even so, we must at least know what is going on beyond our city and the rift, and be on speaking terms with others; to this effect, you may have seen some of the guests I've invited to this year's ball. We may not be interested in the world, but the world is very definitely interested in us, and as such we must act accordingly. "But in order to reach out to others, we must first get our own house in order, and that brings me to the second half of my speech: the need for unity within our own people. This year marks the first in over two generations that our estranged brothers and sisters have joined the Winter Festivus ball, and indeed much of today's revelry would not be possible without their help in the preparations. The rift that my grandmother and Archdruid Vaeril Xadaron tore in the boer'alvar may have been deep, but at last, there is hope for healing. For those who see them walking the city, for those who pass by their lodges, I urge you to not shy away from them, but offer out your hand in reconciliation. Those who used to follow the Old Wyld have shown incredible bravery and forbearance in swallowing their pride and accepting the decisions of the spirits they once followed; in turn, we must be gracious and understanding of their situation. To break away from what you've known all your life and face the uncertainty of doing something new takes a strength of will that is hard to find these days. "And to those who have returned to the fold: thank you for coming, from the bottom of my heart. Your homecoming was likely bittersweet, as are the things you've seen today, but we all understand that we must move forward. Hethia Runasdottir has been vocal in arguing for you, but she has also been a reasonable negotiator; I'm sure that we'll be able to work out more details of the reunion in the coming days. I've been informed of some of the things you believed about us, and my only request is for you to be understanding and keep an open mind, to compare what you see in the Winter City now with what you were told. "We have to look forward; things can't go back to the way they were before. With the state of the world as it is now, few things are certain, but I will promise you this: the var Ridell line will find places for you within our people, professions that you can be proud of and dignity despite your origins. Already, Hethia and I have spoken of establishing new vineyards upon the tundra and glacier for the production of mirrorwine, and I'm sure more such efforts will follow as we hopefully rediscover more of what was lost more than two centuries ago. "Outreach and unity; these are the principles that will guide my rule for the foreseeable future. Now, to all my subjects: a fair Winter Festivus, and may the light of Lumia shine upon you for the year to come!" As Ryn finishes addressing her people, the crowd in the rose gardens erupts into cheers and clapping — the scattered groups of druids don't join in, alas, but at least they appear somewhat content at the content of Ryn's speech. It's a good start, you suppose... "And now..." Ryn raises her arms in the greatest, most grandiose fashion she can manage, "I declare the floor open! After so many heavy words, let us dance until the light ebbs from the sky!" The cheering reaches a crescendo as Ryn steps from the stage and back onto the carpeted garden path, her honor guard of valkyries closing in upon her once more as she struts back towards the ballroom. As she passes you by, your elven companion gives you a [etheryn.lowConfidence |timid ]nod and wink, to which you reply with another thumbs-up. Yes, that wasn't bad, that wasn't bad at all — the pale elves are going to be in good hands, if things keep on going the way they are. Sure, there's still the rest of the year, but starting it off on the right foot goes a long way, too.
rows.translation: 当你离开舞厅的阴凉处，走进玫瑰园时，太阳已经高悬在天空之中。从黎明开始，人们就在这里为小琳向子民们发表演讲做准备。花园的两侧种满了冰霜玫瑰，中间有一个高台，背后是大理石喷泉作为背景，台上铺着厚厚的天蓝色羊毛布，形成了一个演讲台。当然，这个台子比大多数前来聆听演讲的人都要高……但这也并不奇怪。太同样，这个日子也是每年苍白精灵们应该前来向他们的统治者请愿的日子。因此……嗯，小琳必须给人一种平易近人的印象，不是吗？ 你会注意到，在宫殿守卫之外，花园里还有几名特别高大、容光焕发的精灵——他们大多站在舞台周围，而普通的守卫们则分布在两侧，负责控制那些前来聆听伊瑟琳讲话的人群。女武神们！而且还有许多其他的很多在他们之中。鉴于你作为小琳的拥护者的身份，你被引导到了舞台的一侧，在那里你可以清楚地看到她应该进行演讲的讲台。至于其他所有人……嗯，虽然有几道绳索屏障防止玫瑰园陷入彻底的混乱，但对于那些忙得不可开交的守卫们来说，情况仍然相当紧张。毕竟糟糕一片混乱之中，人们从人群中感受到的，更多的是积极与兴奋的情绪。当精灵们等待着他们的到来时，空气中弥漫着轻声的低语和激动的窃窃私语。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]当最后的钟声渐渐远去，一阵号角声响起，小琳在四名女武神的护卫下从舞厅中走了出来。 [etheryn.lowConfidence |看来艾尔萨拉做得相当不错——虽然你知道她的精灵伙伴平时总是那么缺乏自信，但这一次，她至少表现得符合一位王室成员的身份。这也情有可原，因为不管她自己是否愿意，实际上有比她更多的人在依赖她，所以她必须强装笑容，为他们做出榜样。 |她自信地走在仪仗队的前面，与当初在那座废弃的路标处遇到的那个胆怯、缺乏自信的女孩相比，她确实已经变了。嗯，事实就是如此。那个很久以前的事了，对吧？但在那段时间里发生了太多事情，如果小琳还没有发生改变，那你一定会感到惊讶。看到她登场的样子，毫无疑问，小琳的表现完全符合一位王室成员应有的风范。 [etheryn.highConfidence |甚至都不需要思考一下就办成了。 |毫不费力地 ]这确实很有道理。在这个日子里，冬城的人们都在期待她能给他们带来对未来的信心，尤其是在如此短的时间内发生了这么多巨大的变化之后。她必须展现出坚定的态度，对他们微笑，消除他们的恐惧和疑虑……而她的坚强与笑容都是发自内心的，这一点无疑起到了很大的作用。 ] 啊，戴王冠的人责任重大…… 但事实就是如此。她穿着祖母那一整套华丽的礼服——蓝、白、金三色的毛皮服饰，还有那些珍贵的珠宝[etheryn.crowned |[flags.ETHERYN_CROWNED |当然，是她妹妹的，不，祖母的加冕 |当然，还有她母亲的王冠。 ] |…啊，当然了，她现在还没有戴上王冠。 ]小琳沿着铺着地毯的花园小径奔跑下去，周围聚集的精灵们发出轻柔的欢呼声。她确实看起来比平时更高了，人们不禁会想，是不是艾尔萨拉特意为她准备了一些高跟鞋，让她在这段时间里穿着。当小琳站在讲台前时，她的英灵卫队成员纷纷退到舞台的两侧，让她能够清楚地看到聚集在下面的子民们。她的目光在你身上停留了片刻，你向她微笑并竖起了大拇指，随后她也露出了微笑，将视线移开了。 对于今天聚集在这里，共同享受王室盛情款待的每一位人士，我衷心祝愿大家度过一个欢乐的仲冬节庆。在这个阳光最为灿烂的时刻，我愿在卢米娅的庇佑下，毫无保留、明确地表达我对未来的期望。她的声音在花园中回荡，清晰而响亮； [etheryn.lowConfidence |她惯常的口吃这一次完全消失了——嗯，几乎完全没有了，但对于那些善于留意这些细节的人来说，仍然能够察觉到。不过，无论是对艾尔萨拉还是对小琳来说，能够激发出这样的自信与勇气，确实是一项了不起的成就。 |考虑到小琳平时的说话方式，人们不禁会想，她的声音是不是通过某种方式被放大了。 ]我在对你们说话时将会直言不讳——而不是像我姐姐那样用甜言蜜语来安抚你们，那些话虽然听起来令人舒服，但却毫无实质内容。我会告诉你们我所知道的真相，无论这些真相有多么残酷。 “就在不久前，你们所有人都亲眼目睹了我姐姐背叛行为的后果，以及她所遭遇的一切；而尽管我们曾经对你们做过一些事情，你们仍然选择了支持拉里·里德尔家族，这无疑是对我的极大信任，对此我感到非常感激。我不敢再向我的子民们提出更多的要求——你们的忠诚、你们的期望以及你们对我的信任，激励我做出了那些我认为对未来冬城最为有利的决定。 我们所有人都明白，我们现在正处于一个黑暗的时代，一个充满变革的时代。就在这座宫殿里发生的那些恶魔般的腐败现象，其实在世界的其他地方也在发生；在我与我的勇士一起旅行的过程中，我亲眼目睹了太多这样的景象。我们也并非唯一意识到这一情况的人；其他人也发现了这种腐败现象的存在，并正在以他们自己的方式作出反应。例如，我得知那些居住在山下的弥诺陶洛斯人居住的伟大城市已经进入了隔离状态，他们害怕这种同样会诱惑我的妹妹和那些贵族的腐败现象会蔓延开来。但这根本说不通——他们不可能永远这样生活，被封印在地下，既不能进入也不能出来。假设他们的计划成功了，他们或许还能多活一段时间，成为最后被那头怪物吞噬的生物，但到那时，还会有人与他们站在一起吗？ [var0 |我遇到的另一种方法是某个兽人首领的做法。据说，他的女先知——同时也是光明女神的信徒——获得了关于这种正在逼近的黑暗的预知，于是立即将这一消息告诉了她的兄弟。这位首领召集了他的整个部落，跨越海洋前往那片大陆，然后等待着那场伟大战役的开始。 但他没有把这件事告诉任何人，甚至连他的部落成员和家人都没有。他希望自己的族人能够参与到一场将会改变我们所熟知的世界秩序的事件中，但他却不想分享那些他自认为会因此获得的荣耀。” 兽人……？啊，她一定是在说阿戈斯。 这位兽人首领并没有试图利用自己的部落来谋取更多利益，相反，他利用他们来让自己成为了一个活生生的传奇人物。这个充满妄想的自大之徒认为，自己能够独自战胜黑暗——不需要盟友，甚至不需要他的部落，只有他自己。他的部落存在的意义，仅仅是用来对抗那些低等生物而已。而只有他自己知道妹妹那些预言的真相，因此这个兽人首领打算独自在辉煌的战斗中击败逐渐逼近的黑暗，然后将所有的荣耀都据为己有。 他所谓的整个计划根本不切实际。他既没有努力组建一支军队以应对即将到来的第二次神战，也没有与其他势力结盟来增强自己的实力。 他自以为已经准备好成为传奇人物，只是等待命运将自己送上成功的宝座。而当他以如此自私的方式解读卢米娅赐予他的启示时，他被推翻作为首领的地位几乎已成定局。 ] 从我姐姐手中逃脱后，我做的第一件事就是向南前往那些被其他民族称为‘边境地区’的地方，越过我们曾经称之为自己领地的那片古老的荒废驿堡地区。我相信，与我祖先们签订的那些古老协议一定会得到遵守，而我也会带着一支军队回来，从我姐姐手中夺回那座宫殿！ 但事实并非如此。我们布尔阿尔瓦人的寿命比其他民族更长，我们对时间的感知方式也与他们不同。当我们在北方的裂谷中忙于自己的事务时，世界已经在我们身后继续前进了。我的高祖父曾经与之签订条约的贝尔哈尔帝国，也已经不复存在了。那位当地的男爵夫人只是一个毫无实权的女人，既没有军队也没有可以调用的资源，她只不过是那个帝国的一个象征罢了。在我们与世隔绝的状态下，我们忽视了边境之外发生的种种事情；而当我需要帮助时，却在那些我原本以为可以寻求帮助的地方一无所获。事实证明，我并不需要一支军队来纠正一切错误，但人们也不能总是依赖女神的恩赐来获得我们所需要的东西。作为我们的母亲，卢米娅希望我们能够成长，能够独立自主。 因此，这就是第一个在我今后的统治中将影响并指导各项政策的方向：我们不会再与世界隔绝，而是要主动与其他民族建立联系，了解周围正在发生的事情。我们地处这片土地的最高处，这种地理位置显然无法阻挡日益严重的腐败现象；要想战胜它，我们就必须与其他民族携手合作。这并不是说我们要接纳他们、盲目信任他们，甚至必须赞同他们的行事方式与习俗。但即便如此，我们至少也应该了解发生在我们城市之外、那片裂隙之外的情况，并且能够与他人进行交流；为此，你们可能已经看到了一些我邀请来参加今年舞会的客人。我们或许对这个世界并不感兴趣，但这个世界却无疑对我们很感兴趣，因此我们必须据此采取相应的行动。 但是，要想与他人建立联系，我们首先必须把自己的事情处理好。这就引出了我演讲的第二个部分：我们内部团结的重要性。今年，是我们两代人以来第一次有那些曾经与我们疏远的兄弟姐妹们一起来参加冬季庆典活动，事实上，如果没有他们在筹备工作中的帮助，今天的一切庆祝活动都是不可能顺利进行的。我的祖母与大德鲁伊瓦雷尔·扎达隆在博尔阿尔瓦地区造成的裂痕或许很深，但如今，治愈的希望终于出现了。对于那些看到他们在城市中行走的人，对于那些路过他们住所的人，我恳请大家不要回避他们，而是伸出援手，共同促进和解。那些曾经追随古老荒野的人们表现出了令人难以置信的勇气与宽容，他们放下了自己的骄傲，接受了曾经所追随的那些精灵们的决定；因此，我们也应当以宽容与理解的态度来看待他们的处境。要摆脱自己一生中所熟悉的一切，去面对尝试新事物的不确定性，这种意志力在如今这个时代已经变得十分难得。 而对于那些重新回到我们身边的人，我由衷地感谢你们的到来。你们的归乡之路或许充满了苦涩与甜蜜，今天所看到的一切也可能令你们感到复杂难懂，但我们都知道，我们必须继续前进。赫西亚·鲁纳斯多蒂尔一直在积极为你争取权益，同时她也是一个通情达理的谈判者；我相信，在接下来的几天里，我们一定能够详细商定重聚的相关事宜。我已经了解到你对我们的一些看法，我唯一的要求就是希望你能保持理解与开放的心态，将你现在在冬城所看到的一切，与之前听到的描述进行对比。 我们必须展望未来；事情已经无法恢复到从前的状态。鉴于当前的世界形势，几乎没有什么是可以确定的，但我可以向你们保证：瓦·里德尔组织会为你们在我们族群中找到合适的地位，让你们能够从事那些令你们引以为豪的职业，并让你们无论出身如何都能享有尊严。赫希娅和我已经讨论过在苔原和冰川上建立新的葡萄园，用来生产镜像酒。我相信，随着我们逐步找回那些在两个多世纪前遗失的珍宝，还会有更多的类似计划被提出来。 团结与包容，这些将是我在可预见的未来统治国家的原则。现在，向我的所有子民宣告：一个公正的冬季庆典即将到来，愿卢米娅的光芒照亮你们每一个人，陪伴你们度过新的一年！” 当小琳结束对子民的讲话时，玫瑰园里的群众爆发出欢呼声和掌声——那些分散在各处的德鲁伊们虽然没有加入他们的行列，但至少看起来对小琳的演讲内容还算满意。我想，这应该是一个良好的开端吧…… 现在……”小琳以她所能表现出的最夸张、最华丽的姿态举起了双臂，“我宣布现在开始跳舞吧！在说了这么多严肃的话之后，让我们尽情跳舞，直到天上的光芒消失为止！” 随着小琳走下舞台，重新回到铺着地毯的花园小道上，人们的欢呼声达到了高潮。她的那些女武神护卫们再次围了上来，和她一起阔步走向舞厅。当她从你身边经过时，你的精灵伙伴给了你一个[etheryn.lowConfidence |胆小 ]你点了点头，又眨了眨眼，而你则回以另一个竖起的大拇指。 没错，这样做得不错，真的很好——如果事情继续这样发展下去，那些苍白精灵一定会得到妥善的照顾。当然，这一年还有很长的时间，但良好的开端同样非常重要。
rows.raw: " The sun's high in the sky when you leave the shade of the ballroom and enter the rose garden, where preparations have been ongoing since dawn for Ryn's address to her subjects. Flanked by hedges of ice roses on either side, a platform rises above the garden back with a marble fountain behind as a backdrop, draped with thick azure woollen cloth to form a stage. Higher than most people who would be listening to the speech, of course... but not too high, either. This is supposed to be the one day each year the pale elves are expected to approach their rulers, and for that... well, Ryn has to be approachable, doesn't she? You notice that in addition to the palace guard, there're a handful of particularly tall, radiant elves in the garden — mostly about the stage, while the common guard take to the sides and wrangles the crowd that's gathered to come and hear Etheryn speak. Valkyries! And there are a lot of them. Given your position as Ryn's champion, you're ushered off to one side of the stage where you can get a good view of of the lectern where she's supposed to deliver her speech from. The rest of everyone else... well, while several rope barriers keep the rose gardens from devolving into complete chaos, it's still a close thing for the harried guards. Not that it's a bad kind of chaos; the feeling you're getting from the crowd is generally one of positivity and excitement, hushed not-quite-whispers and excited murmurings as the elves await the arrival of their [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]. As the last of the bell's peals echo into the distance, a horn sounds, and Ryn emerges from the ballroom, flanked by a quartet of valkyries as her honor guard. [etheryn.lowConfidence |It looks like Elthara's drilled her well — though you know how insecure your elven companion usually is, here and now she's at least comported herself in a manner befitting the royal presence. And that makes sense — like it or not, far more people than herself are relying on her, and she's got to put on a strong face and smile for them whether she's feeling it or not. |Striding forward confidently in step with her honor guard, she really looks different from the quailing, uncertain girl that you met all that time ago at the ruined wayfort. Well, it wasn't that long ago, was it? Yet so much's happened in that time that you'd be surprised if Ryn still hadn't changed from who she was. Seeing her make her entrance, there's no doubt that Ryn's comported herself in a manner befitting the royal presence, and [etheryn.highConfidence |without even needing to think about it to boot |without too much effort, too ]. And it makes sense. Here on this day, the people of the Winter City are looking to her for reassurance for their future, especially with all the great changes that've happened in so short a time. She's got to put on a strong face and smile for them, dispel their fears and doubts... and it helps a lot that her strength and smile alike are truly genuine. ] Ah, heavy is the head that wears the crown... But it is what it is. Dressed up in her grandmother's full regalia — the furs of blue, white and gold, the crown jewels, and[etheryn.crowned |[flags.ETHERYN_CROWNED |, of course, her sister's, no, grandmother's crown |, of course, her mother's crown ] |... ah, of course she's not wearing the crown yet ], Ryn sweeps down the carpeted garden path to the soft cheers of the assembled elves. She does look taller than usual, and you can't help but wonder if Elthara's provided some platform shoes for her to wear throughout all this. Ryn's honor guard of valkyries peels away to either side of the stage while she takes her place at the lectern, letting the sight of her assembled subjects sink in; her eyes linger on you for a moment, and you give her a smile and thumbs-up before she looks away, smiling. "A fair Midwinter Festivus to each and every one of you who has gathered here to partake of the Crown's hospitality this day. At this hour, when the glory of the sun and her light is at its greatest, I intend to unreservedly and unambiguously state with Lumia's blessings the hopes that I have for the future." Her voice rings out over the gardens, loud and clear; [etheryn.lowConfidence |her usual stutter nowhere to be heard — well, almost nowhere, but certainly still perceptible to someone who knows to listen for it. Nevertheless, it's an impressive achievement both on Elthara and Ryn's part to inspire this burst of confidence and courage |knowing how Ryn usually speaks, you can't help but wonder if her voice's being amplified somehow ]... "I will be forthright in my address to you — instead of my sister's honeyed words which were soothing but lacking all substance, I will give you the truth as I know it, however harsh as it may be. "It was not so long ago that you all witnessed the fruits of my sister's betrayal, and what happened to her; that you all have still accepted the var Ridell line after what we've done to you is a great vote of confidence in me for which I'm thankful. I could not dare to ask more from my subjects — your loyalty, your hope, and your faith in me has inspired me to make the decisions which I believe will be the best for the Winter City going forward. "All of us understand that we are in a time of darkness, and a time of change. The demonic corruption that transpired here in this very palace is happening elsewhere in the world as well; I have seen as much during my travels with my champion. Neither are we the only ones to be aware that this is happening; other peoples have discovered the presence of such corruption and are reacting in their own ways. For example, I learned that the great city of the minotaurs under their mountain has gone into quarantine, fearing this very same corruption which seduced my sister and the nobility. But that does not make sense — they cannot live forever like that, sequestered under the earth and refusing entry or exit. Assuming their plan succeeds, they might survive a while longer, be the last to be devoured by the beast, but at that point who will be left to stand with them? [var0 |"Another approach I encountered was that of an orcish chieftain. Reputedly, his seeress — also a blessed adherent of the Lady of Light — was granted a vision of this encroaching darkness, and promptly informed her brother of such. He gathered his entire tribe, sailed the seas to the continent, and awaited the commencement of his great battle. "But he didn't tell anyone about it, not even his tribe or the rest of his family. He wanted his people to take part in something that would reshape the world as we know it, but didn't want to share in any of the glory he thought he would win." Orc...? Ah, she must be talking about Argoth. "This chieftain did not try to make more out of his tribe; instead, he tried to use them to make himself into a living legend. A brute with delusions of grandeur, he thought he could defeat the darkness alone — not with allies, not even his tribe, he himself. His tribe was merely there to fight the underlings, and alone in knowing the truth of his sister's visions, the orc chieftain planned to defeat the encroaching darkness in glorious combat and claim all the renown for himself. "His entire so-called plan was not realistic. He did not try to form an army for a second Godswar, he did not create alliances with others to strengthen himself. He thought himself ready to become a legend and waited for fate to serve itself up at his feet. The moment he interpreted the vision so graciously sent by Lumia in so self-serving a fashion, his overthrow as chieftain was all but assured. ] "One of the first things I did upon escaping from my sister was to head south into the lands the other peoples call the Marches, beyond the old Wayfort we used to call our own. Surely the ancient agreements signed with my ancestors would be honored, and I would return with an army to retake the palace from my sister! "But it was not to be. We boer'alvar live longer than other peoples, and our perception of time is different. While we busied ourselves up north in the rift, keeping our business to our own, the world had passed us by. The Belhar Empire with which my great-great-great grandfather had signed treaties was no more. The local baroness was a powerless woman with neither army nor resources to spare, an echo of that empire. In our isolation, we had blinded ourselves to the state of affairs beyond our borders, and when I needed help there was none to be had where I expected it to be. As it turned out, I did not need an army to set things right, but one cannot continually depend on the goddess' providence to supply us with what we need. As our mother, Lumia wishes for us to grow and be able to stand on our own feet. "So this is the first direction which has, and will shape policies from my rule going forward: we will no longer isolate ourselves from the world, and reach out to other peoples and understand what is going on around us. Our remote location atop the crown of the land clearly is no shield from the corruption that approaches, and in order to defeat it we must join with other peoples. This is not to say to embrace them, to blindly trust them, or to necessarily even approve of their ways and customs. But even so, we must at least know what is going on beyond our city and the rift, and be on speaking terms with others; to this effect, you may have seen some of the guests I've invited to this year's ball. We may not be interested in the world, but the world is very definitely interested in us, and as such we must act accordingly. "But in order to reach out to others, we must first get our own house in order, and that brings me to the second half of my speech: the need for unity within our own people. This year marks the first in over two generations that our estranged brothers and sisters have joined the Winter Festivus ball, and indeed much of today's revelry would not be possible without their help in the preparations. The rift that my grandmother and Archdruid Vaeril Xadaron tore in the boer'alvar may have been deep, but at last, there is hope for healing. For those who see them walking the city, for those who pass by their lodges, I urge you to not shy away from them, but offer out your hand in reconciliation. Those who used to follow the Old Wyld have shown incredible bravery and forbearance in swallowing their pride and accepting the decisions of the spirits they once followed; in turn, we must be gracious and understanding of their situation. To break away from what you've known all your life and face the uncertainty of doing something new takes a strength of will that is hard to find these days. "And to those who have returned to the fold: thank you for coming, from the bottom of my heart. Your homecoming was likely bittersweet, as are the things you've seen today, but we all understand that we must move forward. Hethia Runasdottir has been vocal in arguing for you, but she has also been a reasonable negotiator; I'm sure that we'll be able to work out more details of the reunion in the coming days. I've been informed of some of the things you believed about us, and my only request is for you to be understanding and keep an open mind, to compare what you see in the Winter City now with what you were told. "We have to look forward; things can't go back to the way they were before. With the state of the world as it is now, few things are certain, but I will promise you this: the var Ridell line will find places for you within our people, professions that you can be proud of and dignity despite your origins. Already, Hethia and I have spoken of establishing new vineyards upon the tundra and glacier for the production of mirrorwine, and I'm sure more such efforts will follow as we hopefully rediscover more of what was lost more than two centuries ago. "Outreach and unity; these are the principles that will guide my rule for the foreseeable future. Now, to all my subjects: a fair Winter Festivus, and may the light of Lumia shine upon you for the year to come!" As Ryn finishes addressing her people, the crowd in the rose gardens erupts into cheers and clapping — the scattered groups of druids don't join in, alas, but at least they appear somewhat content at the content of Ryn's speech. It's a good start, you suppose... "And now..." Ryn raises her arms in the greatest, most grandiose fashion she can manage, "I declare the floor open! After so many heavy words, let us dance until the light ebbs from the sky!" The cheering reaches a crescendo as Ryn steps from the stage and back onto the carpeted garden path, her honor guard of valkyries closing in upon her once more as she struts back towards the ballroom. As she passes you by, your elven companion gives you a [etheryn.lowConfidence |timid ]nod and wink, to which you reply with another thumbs-up. Yes, that wasn't bad, that wasn't bad at all — the pale elves are going to be in good hands, if things keep on going the way they are. Sure, there's still the rest of the year, but starting it off on the right foot goes a long way, too. "

rows.original:
Fresh in from Ryn's speech, you return to the ballroom to find it considerably changed. While Ryn was busy addressing her subjects, the palace staff has been busy rearranging the entire place; while still present in a reduced capacity, the buffet has been withdrawn to a corner and the dance floor has been cleared of obstructions and dirt. That's not to mention the more central position that the musicians now hold in the ballroom — as you and the first elves enter, they greet you with a booming fanfare and start up the music as you filter in along the edges. Elves quickly start pairing off and heading down to the dance floor, while those spectating — or still hungry — keep to the sides of the ballroom, giving the dancers their space.
    
    Of course, not everyone's in the ballroom, you notice — it's mostly the people who would know ballroom dancing. Outside, the druids are leading children and the common folk in a traditional folk dance, an affair that's far more energetic, noisy, and chaotic than the genteel notes rising from the band in the ballroom.
    
    You take a look around; there should be several people you know whom you might ask to dance for the next number. Elthara is notably absent — the high priestess is no doubt off wrangling valkyries for the evening's hymnal — but there're still plenty of people for you to choose from.[pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan
        | Your mind flicks back to the dancing lessons you received in your younger days as a noble scion, and you wonder if you should've paid more attention to them. Ballroom dancing isn't a skill that you've had much cause to use in the course of this adventure... 
        | This brings back memories of your days as a courtesan, before all this madness began... you should be at home here on the dance floor, even if it's been a good while since you did any ballroom dancing. Surely you'll be getting it all back after a number or two.
        | While your personal history isn't one that would lend itself well to ballroom dancing, it can't hurt to give it a try. Certainly no one is going to yell at you for stepping on anyone's toes, you're the Champion of Frost, right?
    ]
    
    Nothing left for it, then...
rows.translation:
刚听完小琳的演讲，你回到舞厅，发现那里已经发生了很大的变化。在小琳忙于向她的子民发表讲话的时候，宫殿的工作人员一直在忙于重新布置整个场所：虽然规模有所缩小，但自助餐区已经被移到了角落里，舞池里的障碍物和杂物也都被清理干净了。更不用说，如今音乐家们在舞厅中占据了更加核心的位置——当你和第一批精灵们走进舞厅时，他们会用雄壮的乐曲来迎接你们，而你们则沿着边缘缓缓进入场地，与此同时，音乐也会随之开始播放。精灵们迅速成对结伴，走向舞池，而那些在旁观看或还未开始跳舞的人，则留在舞厅的边缘，为舞者们留出空间。
    
    当然，你也会注意到，并不是所有人都在舞厅里——主要是那些熟悉交谊舞的人才会在这里。在外面，德鲁伊们正带领着孩子们和平民们跳着传统的民间舞蹈，这场舞蹈比舞厅里乐队演奏的那些优雅音乐要热闹、喧闹得多，也混乱得多。
    
    你环顾四周，应该会看到几个你认识的人，你可以邀请他们下一支舞一起跳。艾尔萨拉显然没有出现——这位大祭司肯定正在去召集女武神们，以便为晚上的仪式准备颂歌——不过，仍然有很多人可供你选择。[pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan
        | 你的思绪不由自主地回想起年轻时作为贵族子弟接受的舞蹈课程，不禁思索：当时是否应该更加认真地学习这些技能。在这次冒险中，你其实并没有太多机会用到交谊舞这些技巧…… 
        | 这让人回想起你还是名交际花的那段日子，在这一切疯狂的事情发生之前……你现在应该就在这个舞池里，即使你已经很久没有跳过交谊舞了。相信跳上一两支舞后，你一定就能重新找回那种感觉。
        | 虽然你的个人经历并不适合参加交谊舞活动，但尝试一下也没什么坏处。反正没人会因为你踩到别人的脚而责骂你吧？你可是霜之冠军啊，对吧？
    ]
    
    那就没什么别的办法了……

rows.original: The ballroom has been cleared for the dance; couples pair off and take to the floor, while spectators keep to the edges and converse amongst themselves with refreshments. Music fills the hall, one number seamlessly melding into another; parts of the band rotate in and out in shifts so that the musicians can catch a break while keeping the music going at all times. It's a very refined affair, that's for sure, and you can feel it in the atmosphere. Until dusk falls and with it the time for the Lumian hymnals, the floor is yours. Surely there're people you'd like to dance with; the possibilities are manifold, aren't they? Of course, if you would rather not take to the floor yourself, you can just grab some mirrorwine and watch the dancers go at it. You estimate that there's enough time for you to get [var0] dance[var1|s] in, if you were so inclined.
rows.translation: 舞厅已经准备好供人们跳舞了；情侣们成对地走上舞池，而观众们则站在边缘，边品尝着点心边互相交谈。音乐充满了整个大厅，一首曲子流畅地过渡到另一首；乐队的成员们轮流上台演奏，这样他们就可以在保证音乐不断播放的同时休息一下。毫无疑问，这是一场非常高雅的聚会，你一定会觉得非常享受的。感受这种氛围弥漫在空气中。 直到黄昏降临，也就是卢米娅n 赞美诗开始演奏的时刻，整个场地都属于你。肯定有你想一起跳舞的人吧？选择其实很多，不是吗？当然，如果你不想亲自参与跳舞，也可以喝些镜酒，然后观看其他人的表演。 你估计还有足够的时间去做你想做的事情。 [var0]跳舞[var1|]如果你愿意的话，当然可以。

rows.translation: 一场与童话中的皇室成员共同进行的童话般的舞蹈？你怎么可能拒绝这样的邀请呢？
rows.raw: "A fairy-tale dance with fairy-tale royalty? How could you possibly turn this down?"

rows.original: It's kind of awkward, but... does Hethia want to dance?
rows.translation: 有点尴尬，但是……赫希娅想跳舞吗？
rows.raw: "It's kind of awkward, but... does Hethia want to dance?"

rows.original: Who better to ask than Kas herself?
rows.translation: 还有谁比卡希本人更合适来回答这个问题呢？
rows.raw: "Who better to ask than Kas herself?"

rows.original: Ask the pink kitty for the privilege of the next number.
rows.translation: 向粉色小猫请求获得与她共舞下一曲的荣幸吧。

rows.original: Join the knight for a little time on the dance floor.
rows.translation: 和这位骑士一起在舞池里跳一会儿舞吧。

rows.original: Ask your bunny-boy to head down to the floor for a romp.
rows.translation: 让你的小兔子男孩到舞池里去嬉闹一番吧。

rows.translation: 你需要再次与小琳和阿图吉娅一起跳舞才能完成这个任务。

rows.original: Ah, you don't feel like getting in on the action yourself. You'll just stand back and watch them go at it. This will progress the event to the hymnal.
rows.translation: 啊，你并不想亲自加入其中，只想退到一旁看着他们尽情舞动。这将会把活动推进到赞美诗环节。
rows.raw: "Ah, you don't feel like getting in on the action yourself. You'll just stand back and watch them go at it. This will progress the event to the hymnal."

rows.original: As soon as she notices you making your way toward her, Etheryn's eyes light up. The elven monarch has to fight to keep from rushing into your arms, instead settling for a stately approach that gently swishes the hem of her grandmother's dress around her ankles. Ryn's honor guard — now made up of regular royal guards, not valkyries — maintain their stony countenances, which couldn't contrast more sharply with the broad smile that spreads across her face all the way to her wobbling elven ears. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |You know exactly what to do here, all the etiquette and protocol coming back to you in a rush. When the two of you reach each other, you [pc.mf |bow |curtsey ] first, and she, aglow with joy, gestures for you to rise. |As you walk, a little voice thrums in the back of your head, urging you to [pc.mf |bow |curtsey ] — that's how you're supposed to greet royalty at dances, right? That's what all the stories say. And that's what you do, even if a little awkwardly, with Ryn happily accepting the gesture soon after. ] Elves spread apart and watch, the music dies down, and suddenly you can feel every eye in the ballroom on you. Most of Ryn's guards join the throng, spreading out in a loose box around the opening the crowd has left for you, their expressionless faces maintaining miens of impassive watchfulness. Only one remains at her side, the very picture of an imposing war maiden... save only for the faint smile that graces her lips. [pc.mf |You gently take Ryn's chilly hands in yours[flags.RYN_MARKET |. Her gaze shifts down to them, drawn by your touch, but then slowly travels up and over your formal [var0 |dress |suit ]. Now that she finally has the chance to see you in it here on the dance floor, she's too happy for words — but that's okay. She's not the one who's got to say the hard part here. |, nearly losing yourself in her eyes. She holds your gaze, excitedly anticipating what's to come — that part's up to you. ] [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |Despite your experience of southern courtly life, you've never encountered anything quite like this: having the eyes of a whole people on you as you ask their ruler to dance. So you hesitate for a few infinite seconds, deeply conscious of not wanting to say the wrong thing in front of what feels like every frost elf that has ever existed, before overlearned behaviors kick in, the words start, |Nothing you've done in your life would've prepared you for asking royalty to dance under the eyes of an entire people. You're not sure you even know how... but with Ryn's shining eyes putting you at ease, eventually the words come to mind, ] and you ask Etheryn var Ridell, [etheryn.crowned |Queen |Princess Regent ] of the Boer'alvar, to give you, her Champion, the honor of leading her in this dance. Ryn [etheryn.lowConfidence |exhales with relief |grins delightedly ] and nods. "Y[etheryn.lowConfidence |-y ]es," she murmurs. "Oh, [pc.name], [etheryn.lowConfidence |th- ]this is a dream come true." It is for you, too. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |In fact, you might even say that you've been preparing for it your whole life. |Of course, what you don't say is that it's both dream and nightmare; you're going to be leading her, but you don't, strictly speaking, know how... and while that wouldn't be a big deal in a crowd, it's something quite different when you and she are the only people on the dance floor. But you'll make it work. You have to. ] [var0 |Ryn slowly removes her ceremonial cloak and passes it |The pair of you slowly remove your cloaks and pass them ] to the guardswoman standing by; the imposing war-maiden's sly smile grows, but she stays quiet as she merges into the circle of onlookers. Ryn's lips part happily as you place your hand at her waist, and her wide sapphire eyes lock onto yours. And then the music starts up. Slow and steady to begin with, the piece gives you the opportunity to take the measure and settle into the rhythm. The piece is gentle and repetitive, gradually iterating on old themes to build new ones; the band's going easy on you, and for that you're thankful. Side to side, then box step, let Ryn twirl at the high note — this isn't too bad. [etheryn.lowConfidence |Your partner's eyes stay on you at every possible second, and as the dance continues without disaster they steadily brighten with joy. |Ryn's warm, reassuring gaze, which stays on you every instant it can, rids you of the nervousness shackling your feet. ] [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |Now it's time to really show her what you can do. You stay in the center of the cleared-away circle, but slowly stack flourish on flourish — guiding her with one hand only, leaving the other behind your back, letting her extend further and further with each spin. The key is to do more with less, to give Ryn the opportunity to shine, and she takes that opportunity with a gleeful laugh. Every time she extends, she goes out to the tips of your fingers; every time she twirls, her dress billows out further and further. Your daring builds in time with the music, rotating and spinning and eventually gliding across the floor. No longer do you feel the eyes of the elves around you; no longer do you see them as anything other than a multicolored blur. There is only the dance floor and Ryn, and the uncontained joy that turns both your smiles to laughs. You're not showing off for them — you're showing off for her, making her Festivus dance as special as you possibly can, and she's loving every second of it. You bring her in close once again and spin around the edges of the circle, getting as near to the watching elves as you dare. Every rotation lets Ryn lean back and show her gleeful smile to the onlookers; every time she returns her gaze to you, she looks like she's dancing on air. As the music starts to peak, you lean her against you and sweep her into a lift that billows her dress out for the crowd, then down again gently, spinning and spinning again. At the next peak, she gasps when you take her by the waist with both hands and lift her high, turning slowly in place to the delight of the onlookers. Then down again, and twirl and twirl, letting her enjoy the feeling of your touch, raising your hands high as you reach over her head to spin her around. Your heart thrums in time with the strings, resonating so closely that you can feel the approach of the final notes in your chest, and in a last, excited gesture, you lean her back and down, come close enough for her cool breath to brush your nose, then rise up again as the music stops. And, as is proper and courtly, you place your hand over your heart and bow deeply to Ryn as the crowd drowns you in an avalanche of claps. |[pc.agilityRange 80 |Now it's time to really test your skills. [etheryn.lowConfidence |Ryn's eyes go as wide as dinner plates as you pin her dress, the crowd gasps, and she nearly loses control, but the pair of you manage to recover from your accident without falling. Your mistake becomes a relic of the distant past as Ryn puts on a show for the crowd, laughing infectiously while she tests out her skills. And finally getting the chance to show it off for a crowd [etheryn.lowConfidence |washes away her crippling anxiety. It's quite the sight, seeing her genuinely happy to be in public: one you refuse to ruin for her despite your two left feet. |is the absolute peak of joy for her, a mark of her flowering into the beautiful, confident monarch she is now. rows.translation: 当她注意到你正朝她走来时，伊瑟琳的眼睛立刻亮了起来。这位精灵女王不得不努力克制自己，才没有冲进你的怀抱，而是保持着庄严的步伐，让祖母留下的裙摆轻轻拂过她的脚踝。如今由普通皇家卫兵而非女武神组成的小琳仪仗队，依然保持着面无表情的神情，这与她脸上洋溢着的灿烂笑容形成了鲜明的对比——那笑容一直延伸到她那微微颤动的精灵耳朵处。 [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |你非常清楚在这里该做什么，所有的礼仪和规矩立刻浮现在你的脑海中。当你们两人相遇时，你[pc.mf |鞠躬 |行屈膝礼 ]首先，她满脸喜悦地示意你站起来。 |当你行走时，脑海中会有一个微小的声音在不断催促你[pc.mf |鞠躬 |行屈膝礼 ] — 精灵们散开站着观看，音乐渐渐停息，突然间，你能感觉到舞厅里所有人的目光都集中在你身上。小琳的大部分护卫也加入了人群，他们散开站在人群为你留下的空地上，面无表情，只是保持着警惕的目光。只有一个人留在她身边，她那威严的形象简直就是一位战神少女……唯一不同的是，她唇边带着一丝淡淡的微笑。 [pc.mf |你轻轻地将小琳冰冷的手握在自己的手中。[flags.RYN_MARKET |她的目光被你的触碰吸引，缓缓向下移落，落在那些物件上，但随后又慢慢向上移，最终落在了你那正式的着装上。 [var0 |衣服 |适合 ]现在她终于有机会在舞池里见到你了，她高兴得简直无法用言语表达——不过没关系，毕竟该说那些难听的话的人并不是她。 |几乎完全沉浸在她的眼眸之中。她凝视着你，满怀期待地等待着接下来会发生什么——这一部分就取决于你了。 ] [pc.bg noblescion |你的舞伴每时每刻都在注视着你，而随着舞蹈的顺利进行，他们眼中的光芒也逐渐变得明亮起来，充满了喜悦。 |小琳那温暖而令人安心的目光，总是尽可能地停留在你身上，这种注视能够消除束缚在你身上的紧张情绪。 ] [pc.bg noblescion courtesan rows.original: Hethia [hethia.isHostile |stifles a wince |makes a show of considering your offer ] when you ask her to dance. Looking around, the druidess notices several expectant pairs of eyes on the two of you, which in retrospect isn't that off — you are Ryn's champion, after all, and she's leading the druidic end of the reunion negotiations. "Why, this comes as quite the surprise, Champion. I would've expected the opposite, given how reputedly antagonistic I am towards the var Ridell line." You meet Hethia's thin smile with a disarming chuckle and turn your palms upwards before proffering one of them to the druidess. Well then, this is the point where she says yes. Hethia huffs a bit, feigning reluctance, but eventually puts her hand forth to let it come to rest in yours. You close your fingers over her slender ones, and give them a reassuring squeeze before leading her away from the crowd and towards the dance floor. The elves about you fall silent as the both of you leave, moving out into the heart of the ballroom. "[flags.RYN_MARKET |Why, you're looking quite smart today," Hethia notes as the interlude begins to come to an end and the couples find their own space. "The [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ] spend some of the nearly-bare treasury on you?" That's not quite the case, but you suppose it's close enough. The druidess sighs and shakes her head. "Well, at least the both of you got your money's worth out of it, I can't deny as much." |And if you aren't looking your best this fair Festivus," Hethia notes as the interlude begins to come to an end and the couples find their own space. "Much cleaner than when we first met, even if your fashion sense hasn't improved since then." And did she imagine she'd be dancing with you when the first time you met in that logging camp? "Oh no, oh no. Wyld preserve me, not in my wildest dreams would I even have conceived of such a notion. But then, life has a way of throwing surprises at us, doesn't it? After all that's happened and all that's going to happen, I've stopped expecting anything and just take things as they come." ] So... can she dance? "Not in this style, but that isn't going to stop me from trying. For some strange reason, ballrooms are in short supply in druidic temples, even during our heyday when the vine-wreathed marble spires rose as high as the wyld trees they housed. Elthara keeps on telling me that I should be brave enough to try new things... so here I am!" And here you are, too. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |Not to worry, you've had some schooling in courtly dancing and would be more than glad to show Hethia the ropes — if she's willing to allow you to lead her, that is |Well, she should be glad to know that you're just as inexperienced and unschooled in the art of courtly dancing as she is, so that's another thing you have in common ]. When it comes down to it... the point of the Festivus ball is to have fun, isn't it? "For you, maybe." You would've had a witty reply for that, but the music starts up in earnest and you swing into motion. Smiling at Hethia, you tell the druidess to just follow your lead, and everything will be fine; [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |you know what you're doing and all eyes will be on you, anyway |you're just as blind as she is in this, so you might as well take responsibility for inviting her to dance ]. The druidess nods, firmly digging her fingers into your wrists in a death grip, as if worried you're going to get cold feet and leave her alone on the dance floor. Trying to follow your motions, she starts to move her feet — shuffle them, really — and you catch her not-surreptitiously glancing at the other dancing couples nearest to you, doing her best to figure out what she's supposed to be doing in this kind of situation. It's kind of cute, really. For all the furs and adornments she's wearing over her plain white shift, the fact that Hethia's acting like a hesitant schoolgirl in contrast to her usual tough woman schtick is adorably awkward — you're sure that she'd immediately snap the mask back were she more self-conscious and aware of your scrutiny of her, but if you don't tell her, who will? Hethia leans heavily on you — partly because that's what she saw another couple do, and partly because she clearly isn't used to this kind of dancing, needing to steady herself against you as the music picks up its pace, and so do the dancers. It's a brisk waltz, and you hold the druidess tightly against yourself, leading her feet with your own and guiding her through the simplest motions of the dance, [pc.bgMulti courtesan noblescion |thinking back to all the clueless dancers you've had to deal with as a courtesan and how to quietly correct their mistakes |trying to think back to your own lessons in courtly dancing and how your instructors handled you |because that's frankly the extent of what you're capable of yourself, too ]. As the first moments pass without major mishaps, Hethia becomes more confident, able to follow your lead a little better; you start to make your movements a little more complex as she learns, [pc.bgMulti | courtesan noblescion |working up from the gentle turn-and-sway of the rising music until you wind up |not knowing that much yourself but willing to improvise on the spot with what feels right, ] spinning the druidess under your arm and pulling her back, catching her by the waist. Hethia looks a little dazed from the suddenness of it all, then laughs and blushes, letting her hands settle on your [pc.hips] to steady herself while she gasps for breath. Is she fine? "I-I'm all right. Just a little surprised, that's all. Everything's just so... refined. I wasn't expecting that last move." Shall you continue, then? "Hmph, of course. I didn't say to stop in the least." The music swells louder, faster, urging all the couples on the floor to move with it, get caught up in the rising swell of the melody; even so, you don't drive Hethia to any truly complex footwork. She's more than willing to let your lead her through her paces, moving a bit faster as the tempo increases; the furs and shift she's wearing billow in an appropriately dramatic fashion, swaying with the movements of her shoulders and slight hips. She's growing more and more confident with every passing minute, more agile on her feet; Hethia may not know how to dance in a ballroom, but you suspect she knows how to do a merry jig about a tree or colorful pole. You can feel the eyes upon you — unsurprising, given who the two of you are — but at least you're conducting yourself well, you feel. And then, out of the blue, a sudden pressure upon your foot as Hethia's heel lands squarely upon it. The jab isn't so much painful as it is startling, but Hethia looks absolutely mortified until you laugh and spin her right around, catching her as her shoulders land directly on your [pc.chest]. Ah, it was but a small mistake — besides, she's far too lithe and light to actually hurt anyone by stepping on their toes. You hear Hethia mumble something or the other, but you don't really care, craning your neck forward to give the druidess a kiss on the cheek and a nibble at the ear. The both of you remain like that for just the blink of an eye, and then you spin her right back round face to face, moving on as if nothing had happened. But at last, the number ends, the music seguing over to an interlude so that musicians and dancers alike can be swapped out. Hethia's all but openly panting, her slight chest heaving in and out under her plain white shift as the dance draws to a close. Taking the druidess by the hand, you lead her away from the dance floor and towards the refreshments, pulling her in close and pressing her side to yours. You can feel Hethia tense for just a moment, and then she relaxes within the tight embrace, allowing you to take her away. See? Wasn't that fun? "Hmph." That's a good "hmph", you'll take it. "It wasn't bad. I'll have to show you some of my kind of dancing sometime... maybe at the summer solstice. For now, though... that took a bit out of me. I think I'll go find Elthara and argue with her, that always gets my energy back."
