rows.raw: " Hethia [hethia.isHostile |stifles a wince |makes a show of considering your offer ] when you ask her to dance. Looking around, the druidess notices several expectant pairs of eyes on the two of you, which in retrospect isn't that off — you are Ryn's champion, after all, and she's leading the druidic end of the reunion negotiations. "Why, this comes as quite the surprise, Champion. I would've expected the opposite, given how reputedly antagonistic I am towards the var Ridell line." You meet Hethia's thin smile with a disarming chuckle and turn your palms upwards before proffering one of them to the druidess. Well then, this is the point where she says yes. Hethia huffs a bit, feigning reluctance, but eventually puts her hand forth to let it come to rest in yours. You close your fingers over her slender ones, and give them a reassuring squeeze before leading her away from the crowd and towards the dance floor. The elves about you fall silent as the both of you leave, moving out into the heart of the ballroom. "[flags.RYN_MARKET |Why, you're looking quite smart today," Hethia notes as the interlude begins to come to an end and the couples find their own space. "The [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ] spend some of the nearly-bare treasury on you?" That's not quite the case, but you suppose it's close enough. The druidess sighs and shakes her head. "Well, at least the both of you got your money's worth out of it, I can't deny as much." |And if you aren't looking your best this fair Festivus," Hethia notes as the interlude begins to come to an end and the couples find their own space. "Much cleaner than when we first met, even if your fashion sense hasn't improved since then." And did she imagine she'd be dancing with you when the first time you met in that logging camp? "Oh no, oh no. Wyld preserve me, not in my wildest dreams would I even have conceived of such a notion. But then, life has a way of throwing surprises at us, doesn't it? After all that's happened and all that's going to happen, I've stopped expecting anything and just take things as they come." ] So... can she dance? "Not in this style, but that isn't going to stop me from trying. For some strange reason, ballrooms are in short supply in druidic temples, even during our heyday when the vine-wreathed marble spires rose as high as the wyld trees they housed. Elthara keeps on telling me that I should be brave enough to try new things... so here I am!" And here you are, too. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |Not to worry, you've had some schooling in courtly dancing and would be more than glad to show Hethia the ropes — if she's willing to allow you to lead her, that is |Well, she should be glad to know that you're just as inexperienced and unschooled in the art of courtly dancing as she is, so that's another thing you have in common ]. When it comes down to it... the point of the Festivus ball is to have fun, isn't it? "For you, maybe." You would've had a witty reply for that, but the music starts up in earnest and you swing into motion. Smiling at Hethia, you tell the druidess to just follow your lead, and everything will be fine; [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |you know what you're doing and all eyes will be on you, anyway |you're just as blind as she is in this, so you might as well take responsibility for inviting her to dance ]. The druidess nods, firmly digging her fingers into your wrists in a death grip, as if worried you're going to get cold feet and leave her alone on the dance floor. Trying to follow your motions, she starts to move her feet — shuffle them, really — and you catch her not-surreptitiously glancing at the other dancing couples nearest to you, doing her best to figure out what she's supposed to be doing in this kind of situation. It's kind of cute, really. For all the furs and adornments she's wearing over her plain white shift, the fact that Hethia's acting like a hesitant schoolgirl in contrast to her usual tough woman schtick is adorably awkward — you're sure that she'd immediately snap the mask back were she more self-conscious and aware of your scrutiny of her, but if you don't tell her, who will? Hethia leans heavily on you — partly because that's what she saw another couple do, and partly because she clearly isn't used to this kind of dancing, needing to steady herself against you as the music picks up its pace, and so do the dancers. It's a brisk waltz, and you hold the druidess tightly against yourself, leading her feet with your own and guiding her through the simplest motions of the dance, [pc.bgMulti courtesan noblescion |thinking back to all the clueless dancers you've had to deal with as a courtesan and how to quietly correct their mistakes |trying to think back to your own lessons in courtly dancing and how your instructors handled you |because that's frankly the extent of what you're capable of yourself, too ]. As the first moments pass without major mishaps, Hethia becomes more confident, able to follow your lead a little better; you start to make your movements a little more complex as she learns, [pc.bgMulti | courtesan noblescion |working up from the gentle turn-and-sway of the rising music until you wind up |not knowing that much yourself but willing to improvise on the spot with what feels right, ] spinning the druidess under your arm and pulling her back, catching her by the waist. Hethia looks a little dazed from the suddenness of it all, then laughs and blushes, letting her hands settle on your [pc.hips] to steady herself while she gasps for breath. Is she fine? "I-I'm all right. Just a little surprised, that's all. Everything's just so... refined. I wasn't expecting that last move." Shall you continue, then? "Hmph, of course. I didn't say to stop in the least." The music swells louder, faster, urging all the couples on the floor to move with it, get caught up in the rising swell of the melody; even so, you don't drive Hethia to any truly complex footwork. She's more than willing to let your lead her through her paces, moving a bit faster as the tempo increases; the furs and shift she's wearing billow in an appropriately dramatic fashion, swaying with the movements of her shoulders and slight hips. She's growing more and more confident with every passing minute, more agile on her feet; Hethia may not know how to dance in a ballroom, but you suspect she knows how to do a merry jig about a tree or colorful pole. You can feel the eyes upon you — unsurprising, given who the two of you are — but at least you're conducting yourself well, you feel. And then, out of the blue, a sudden pressure upon your foot as Hethia's heel lands squarely upon it. The jab isn't so much painful as it is startling, but Hethia looks absolutely mortified until you laugh and spin her right around, catching her as her shoulders land directly on your [pc.chest]. Ah, it was but a small mistake — besides, she's far too lithe and light to actually hurt anyone by stepping on their toes. You hear Hethia mumble something or the other, but you don't really care, craning your neck forward to give the druidess a kiss on the cheek and a nibble at the ear. The both of you remain like that for just the blink of an eye, and then you spin her right back round face to face, moving on as if nothing had happened. But at last, the number ends, the music seguing over to an interlude so that musicians and dancers alike can be swapped out. Hethia's all but openly panting, her slight chest heaving in and out under her plain white shift as the dance draws to a close. Taking the druidess by the hand, you lead her away from the dance floor and towards the refreshments, pulling her in close and pressing her side to yours. You can feel Hethia tense for just a moment, and then she relaxes within the tight embrace, allowing you to take her away. See? Wasn't that fun? "Hmph." That's a good "hmph", you'll take it. "It wasn't bad. I'll have to show you some of my kind of dancing sometime... maybe at the summer solstice. For now, though... that took a bit out of me. I think I'll go find Elthara and argue with her, that always gets my energy back." "

rows.original: It isn't hard to find Kasyrra in the crowd — despite being disguised as an elf, she has a certain gravitas to her that is plainly obvious to anyone looking for it — and at this point, it's a feeling that you're pretty intimate with in all senses of the word. She graces you with a warm smile as you present yourself before her and extend a hand. "[silly |Ara ara |Oh-ho ], [pc.name], are you asking me to dance?" But of course. Whyever else would you be here? Kasyrra's smile broadens. "I can imagine at least a half-dozen reasons, most of them bawdy... but yes. [flags.RYN_MARKET |Since you were so gracious to dress up and be all dapper |Since you asked me so nicely ], I suppose I have no choice but to oblige, don't I?" It's your turn to smile. No, the outcome was never in doubt. Kasyrra closes her fingers about yours — they're comfortingly strong and hot — and allows you to lead her out to the ballroom floor for the next dance number. You feel the eyes of several people upon the two of you — the Champion of Frost, dancing with a druid? — but that simply makes your heart swell as you bring her beneath the crystal chandeliers. Let them see, then; let them watch. The two of you will give them a show to remember. Seeing the growing crowd of people moving onto the floor, the band starts up a more folksy number than the previous handful of pieces before it — perhaps deciding to play something more appropriate now that the druids are joining in, too. Around you, the other elven couples start moving to the music, holding each other tight and matching the lively beat. It's certainly nothing grandiose or sweeping like what one might expect of stereotypical energetic ballroom numbers, but you're glad that the simple motions are more intimate, less formal. This is Kas you're dancing with, after all. Stepping in close, close enough to feel the burning heat radiating off Kasyrra's body, you plant a hand on her waist and the other on her shoulder; the bulky furs she's wearing in her druidic getup make getting a firm hold on her a little awkward, but [flags.RYN_MARKET |the contrast with the finery you've donned for the occasion is really something |it's worth it just to be with her for a little bit ]. Perhaps sensing the force of Kasyrra's personal presence, the other dancers are kind enough to give the both of you your space. Even so, Kas is far from sated, greedily pulling you close enough that the tips of her breasts so close to your [pc.chest] that it's a force of will not to close that last little bit of distance and [pc.hasBreasts |smush your boobs right up into hers |press them between you ], to grind your suddenly sensitive nipples against each other through all your clothes. Kasyrra moves again, a seemingly innocuous motion that runs the length of her thigh against your [pc.ass] as she flows across the ballroom floor, yet leaves aching heat lingering on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] long after she's parted from you. ...She's teasing you, isn't she? Her smile just widens, saccharine sweet, and [pc.heightRange 69 75 |she pulls you close to her |given that her elf form's shorter than usual, you're able to pull her up to you |even though her elf form's shorter than usual, she half-bends while pulling you upwards, face to face ] such that her cheek brushes against yours, sending shivers down your spine and making your knees go weak. "Yes." An appropriately dramatic pause to let that sink in. "Well then, I'll be taking the lead, hmm? That's how it goes — I run, and you chase, I lead, and you follow?" Kas doesn't wait for your reply, but instead moves with eager confidence to the musicians' lilting tune, spinning you right round and around without care for anyone or anything about the two of you. Yes, just for now it's just you and her, and she sets the mood, she sets the motions, and there's no other way that it could ever be. Kas sweeps you along with inhuman grace, moving fluidly to set even the other dancers in her wake even considering her bulky furs. Slowly but surely, the music builds up, swelling louder and ever so slightly faster, letting you and your demonic partner dance ever quicker in time with the pounding of your hearts; Kas is a whirlwind, picking you up and sending you spinning, twirling you right under her arm and sending you spiraling away, only to pull you back by your hand with a little flourish at the very last moment when you think you'll fall. One moment she's pressing your bodies together, the next she's pushing you away, and you don't know when one will end and the other begin. Still, that's the excitement inherent in it all, isn't it? [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |Sure, you don't know the exact moves she's using on you, but you understand their general form and try to react as best as you can, not so much holding out against the storm but harnessing its energy without being swept away. |Privately, you're glad that Kas is dominating the dance like this — it just means you can allow you to be swept away by the storm and don't have to worry so much about your own lack of skill at dancing. Letting her cover for you like this feels a little awkward, but it's better than making a fool out of both of yourselves in front of the entire Winter City, isn't it? ] One way or the other, the both of you are having fun, and that's what matters when it comes down to it. She's a pretty good dancer. Does she dance a lot? "I did, once," Kasyrra purrs, allowing you to lean your weight in her arms. "Would you be shocked to learn I was taught? Though that was before... before, anyway. After I lost my soul, there wasn't really much call for this kind of dancing, until now. When we demons dance, we prefer to be more vigorous than ballroom dancing. And much less clothed. Still, this is fun. Downright nostalgic. I'm all right with continuing as we are, if it's for you." Aw shucks, she's going to make you blush. "It's okay to blush, pet. It's the least you can do for me, and lots of it, too." [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |It just... you used to dance formally too, or at least was schooled in it, and now you really don't have the time or reason to do it very much. That's something the both of you share, at the very least — if only the both of you didn't keep each other that busy... Kas laughs. "Well, we've got today, so let's make the most of it, shan't we?" |Well, you're doing your best, just as you're doing your best to dance for her right now despite not actually having any real training in formal dancing. Sure, you might step on both your feet all at once, but for her? It's totally worth it. Kas laughs at that. "Oh, you're just so adorable. Seeing you so eager to please me... you really do know how to set a woman's heart aflutter, don't you?[pc.mf | | Of course you do, you're one yourself! ]" ] Indeed. Kas' laughter rings out over the hall, chuckling all the way while she pulls you tight against her, even as the dance number begins to wind down. With one final pull, your demonic lover comes to rest with her hands pressed against your chest, her body close enough that her breasts squeeze in against your [pc.chest]. It takes her a moment to realize where she's ended up, and then a grin comes over her features as she reaches in and gives you a firm, unmistakable squeeze before sliding her fingers back to your shoulders and [pc.hips]. Like it or not, you can feel plenty of eyes on the both of you at this point; Kas is blatantly stealing the show in a devil-may-care fashion, and she knows it. Breaking away from you for a moment to give several of the onlookers a smug smile, she turns back to you, laces her fingers behind your head, and pulls you in for a kiss. It's surprisingly chaste, all things considered; your tongues wrestle for a bit, but she doesn't get into any of the more risque things that you know her to be capable of. Less is more in this case; maybe she's not wanting to break her cover just yet, or she's simply holding back in hopes of getting some real action later. Either way, Kasyrra's taste lingers on your lips and tongue, merely traces of what you know could have been but content to lightly tease you with the tantalizing hope of might-bes. But at last, the number winds to a close, and the musicians pick up an interlude to let the couples leave the floor and new ones arrive. Head still spinning, thoughts still woozy, you step away as Kas gracefully allows you lead her away from the dance floor and to what's left of the buffet, the crowd parting smoothly to let the both of you pass. Purring, she grabs a tall glass of mirrorwine and leans against a pillar, sipping lightly as she settles in with a sigh. "Well! Thank you for the dance." No, no. You thank her for the dance. Kasyrra smiles and shakes her head. "If you're going to be so pushy about it, then have it your way. I think I'll take a little breather before heading down to the floor again myself... dancing with you really brings back some memories!"
rows.translation: 在人群中找到卡希拉并不难——尽管她伪装成了精灵，但她身上仍有一种独特的威严感，任何试图寻找她的人都能立刻注意到这一点。而此刻，这种感觉让你觉得，你在某种程度上与她非常亲近。当你站在她面前并伸出手时，她给了你一个温暖的微笑。[silly |啊哈 |哦嗬 ]， [pc.name]，你是想让我跳舞吗？” “当然啦。不然你为什么会在这里呢？” 卡希拉的笑容更加灿烂了：“我想至少有六种理由，其中大部分都挺……有点调情的……不过，没错，就是这个意思。 [flags.RYN_MARKET |既然你这么大方，还特意打扮得如此整洁漂亮…… |既然你这么客气地问了我…… ]我想，我别无选择，只能照做吧？” 现在轮到你笑了。不，结果从一开始就毫无疑问。 卡希拉握住了你的手——她的手握得很有力，也很温暖——然后让你带着她走向舞厅，开始下一支舞曲。你能感觉到有好几双眼睛正在注视着你们两个——那位冰霜冠军，正在与一位德鲁伊共舞？——但当你们将她带到水晶吊灯下时，这种感觉只会让你的内心充满喜悦。那就让他们看吧，让他们都看着吧。你们两个将会为他们献上一场令人难忘的表演。 看到越来越多的人涌向舞台，乐队开始演奏一些比之前那些曲目更富有民间气息的音乐——或许是因为现在德鲁伊们也加入了表演，他们决定演奏一些更合适的曲目。在你周围，其他精灵情侣们也开始随着音乐移动起来，他们紧紧相拥，动作与欢快的节奏完美契合。虽然这一切并不像人们通常想象中的那种盛大而华丽的舞会场景，但你却觉得这种简单的动作更加亲密、更加自然，也不那么正式。这个是毕竟，你是在和她跳舞啊。 你靠近她，靠近到能够感受到卡希拉身上散发出的灼热气息，一只手放在她的腰上，另一只手放在她的肩上；她穿着德鲁伊装束时所穿的厚重毛皮，让你要牢牢抓住她显得有些困难，但[flags.RYN_MARKET |与你为这个场合特意准备的华丽装扮相比，这种反差实在令人印象深刻。 |哪怕只是和她在一起片刻，这也值得。 ]或许感受到了卡希拉强大的个人魅力，其他舞者们也出于礼貌，给了你们两人一些空间。即便如此，卡希拉仍然意犹未尽，她贪婪地将你拉得如此靠近，以至于她的胸部几乎贴到了你的身上[pc.chest]这其实是一种意志力的体现——就是不愿意放弃最后那一点点距离，坚持到底。 [pc.hasBreasts |把你的胸部紧紧贴在她身上。 |把它们夹在中间 ]这样，你的乳头就会在层层衣物包裹之下相互摩擦、产生刺激。卡希拉再次动了动，这个看似无害的动作，实际上让她的大腿与你身体发生了接触[pc.ass]当她穿梭在舞厅的地板上时，却会在你身上留下令人难以忘怀的热感[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]在她与你分别很久之后…… ……她是在逗你玩吧？ 她的笑容变得更加灿烂，甜得发腻，然后[pc.heightRange 69 75 |她把你拉到她身边。 |鉴于她现在的精灵形态比平常要短，你可以把她拉到自己身边。 |尽管她以精灵形态出现时身高比平时要矮一些，但她还是半弯着身子将你拉向自己，让我们面对面站立。 ]她的脸颊轻轻触碰到你的脸颊，这一触瞬间让你的脊背发凉，双腿也变得软弱无力。 是的。故意制造一段戏剧性的停顿，让对方有时间仔细思考这句话的含义。“那么，这次就由我来带头吧，嗯？就是这样的——我跑在前头，你们跟着我；我负责引导方向，你们负责跟随。” 卡希并没有等待你的回答，而是满怀信心地随着音乐节奏开始行动，一边旋转着你的身体，一边完全不顾及你们两个人之外的任何事物。是的，目前只有你和她在一起，是她营造了这种氛围，是她决定了行动的节奏，除此之外，也不可能有其他的安排。卡丝以一种超凡脱俗的优雅将你带入其中，她动作流畅自如，甚至让那些跟在她后面的舞者们也受到她的影响——尽管她身披厚重的毛皮。渐渐地，音乐声逐渐增强，旋律变得越来越激烈，节奏也稍微加快了一些，让你和你的“恶魔伙伴”随着心跳的节奏越来越快地舞动起来；卡希就像一阵旋风，她将你抓起，让你旋转、翻腾，然后又在最后一刻突然拉住你的手，将你重新拉回她的怀抱——就在你以为自己要跌落下去的那一刻。有时候她会将你们的身体紧紧拉在一起，而有时候又会将你们推开，你根本无法预知哪种行为何时会结束，另一种行为何时会开始。然而，正是这种不确定性才为这一切增添了令人兴奋的元素，不是吗？ [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |当然，你可能还不知道精确的她对你使出了这些手段，但你了解它们的大致套路，因此会尽力做出相应的反应——不是硬要抵挡这场“风暴”，而是设法利用它的能量，以免被卷走。 |私下里，你其实很高兴卡希能如此出色地掌控整个舞蹈场面——这样你就不用再为自己的舞技不佳而烦恼了，可以尽情享受这场表演带来的乐趣。虽然让她来为你遮掩缺点会让人觉得有些尴尬，但总比在整个冬城面前一起出丑要好吧？ ]不管怎样，你们俩现在正处于这样的关系中。有趣归根结底，这才是最重要的。 她的舞跳得相当不错。她经常跳舞吗？ “有一次，我跳过。”卡希拉轻声说道，让你可以依靠在她的怀里。“如果你知道我是有人教我跳舞的，你会感到惊讶吗？不过那是在……在之前的事了。在我失去了灵魂之后，其实并没有太多机会去跳这种舞，直到现在。当我们恶魔跳舞的时候，我们更喜欢充满活力的比跳交谊舞还要有趣。而且穿着也更加随意。不过，这确实很有趣，让人充满怀旧之情。如果这对你来说也是可以的，那我完全赞成继续这样下去。 哎呀，她这么说肯定会让你脸红的。 “脸红也没关系，亲爱的。这是你至少可以为我做的，而且这样做也真的很有意义。 [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |就是……你以前也经常跳正式的舞蹈，或者至少接受过相关的训练，而现在你真的没有时间也没有理由再去跳了。至少这一点你们是相同的——要是你们俩不要总是让对方那么忙的话…… 卡丝笑了：“好吧，今天我们有时间，那就好好利用它吧，不是吗？ |嗯，你已经在尽力了，就像你现在虽然没有接受过正规的舞蹈训练，但仍在努力为她跳舞一样。当然，你可能会不小心同时踩到两只脚，但对她来说，这一切都值得。 卡丝听到这里笑了起来：“哦，你真是太可爱了。看到你这么渴望取悦我……你确实知道如何让一个女人的心跳加速，对吧？[pc.mf | | 你当然懂，你自己就是这样的嘛！ ]" ] 确实如此。 卡斯的笑声在大厅中回荡，她一边笑着，一边将你紧紧拉到自己身边。即使舞蹈即将结束，她依然没有松开手。最后，她将你拉到自己面前，双手按在你的胸口，她的身体紧贴着你，以至于她的胸部几乎贴在了你的身上[pc.chest]她花了一点时间才弄清楚自己现在身处何处，随后脸上露出了笑容。她伸出手，紧紧地握了握你的手，那是一个坚定而明确的握手，之后她的手指又滑回到你的肩膀上[pc.hips]不管你愿不愿意，此刻你肯定能感觉到有很多人在注视着你们俩；卡丝正以一种无所顾忌的方式抢尽所有人的目光，而她自己也清楚这一点。她暂时离开你，朝周围的一些旁观者露出得意的笑容，然后又回到你身边，把手指绕到你的脑后，将你拉过来吻你。 考虑到所有因素，这种表现其实相当克制了；你们的舌头确实会有些互动，但她并没有做出那些你明知她有能力做的更大胆的事情。在这种情况下，少即是多；也许她还不想暴露自己的真实意图，或者她只是在克制自己，期待之后能有一些更激烈的举动。无论如何，卡希拉留下的味道会萦绕在你的唇齿间，那些本可能发生的情景只是留下了淡淡的痕迹，却足以让你怀着对美好可能的期待而心生向往。 但最终，音乐声渐渐停止，乐手们演奏起了过渡曲目，让那些舞伴们离开舞池，新的舞伴们则走上舞台。头晕目眩，思绪仍有些混乱，你在卡丝的优雅邀请下，带着她离开了舞池，走向还剩下的自助餐区。人群自觉地让开道路，让你们俩通过。她轻声哼着小曲，拿起一杯高脚杯里的镜像酒，靠在柱子上，轻轻啜饮着，然后长叹一声，仿佛终于找回了平静。 嗯！谢谢你的舞蹈。” 不，不，应该你来说谢谢。她为了跳舞。” 卡希拉微笑着摇了摇头：“既然你这么坚持，那就随你的便吧。我想在再次跳起舞来之前，先休息一会儿……和你一起跳舞真的让我回忆起了一些往事！
rows.raw: " It isn't hard to find Kasyrra in the crowd — despite being disguised as an elf, she has a certain gravitas to her that is plainly obvious to anyone looking for it — and at this point, it's a feeling that you're pretty intimate with in all senses of the word. She graces you with a warm smile as you present yourself before her and extend a hand. "[silly |Ara ara |Oh-ho ], [pc.name], are you asking me to dance?" But of course. Whyever else would you be here? Kasyrra's smile broadens. "I can imagine at least a half-dozen reasons, most of them bawdy... but yes. [flags.RYN_MARKET |Since you were so gracious to dress up and be all dapper |Since you asked me so nicely ], I suppose I have no choice but to oblige, don't I?" It's your turn to smile. No, the outcome was never in doubt. Kasyrra closes her fingers about yours — they're comfortingly strong and hot — and allows you to lead her out to the ballroom floor for the next dance number. You feel the eyes of several people upon the two of you — the Champion of Frost, dancing with a druid? — but that simply makes your heart swell as you bring her beneath the crystal chandeliers. Let them see, then; let them watch. The two of you will give them a show to remember. Seeing the growing crowd of people moving onto the floor, the band starts up a more folksy number than the previous handful of pieces before it — perhaps deciding to play something more appropriate now that the druids are joining in, too. Around you, the other elven couples start moving to the music, holding each other tight and matching the lively beat. It's certainly nothing grandiose or sweeping like what one might expect of stereotypical energetic ballroom numbers, but you're glad that the simple motions are more intimate, less formal. This is Kas you're dancing with, after all. Stepping in close, close enough to feel the burning heat radiating off Kasyrra's body, you plant a hand on her waist and the other on her shoulder; the bulky furs she's wearing in her druidic getup make getting a firm hold on her a little awkward, but [flags.RYN_MARKET |the contrast with the finery you've donned for the occasion is really something |it's worth it just to be with her for a little bit ]. Perhaps sensing the force of Kasyrra's personal presence, the other dancers are kind enough to give the both of you your space. Even so, Kas is far from sated, greedily pulling you close enough that the tips of her breasts so close to your [pc.chest] that it's a force of will not to close that last little bit of distance and [pc.hasBreasts |smush your boobs right up into hers |press them between you ], to grind your suddenly sensitive nipples against each other through all your clothes. Kasyrra moves again, a seemingly innocuous motion that runs the length of her thigh against your [pc.ass] as she flows across the ballroom floor, yet leaves aching heat lingering on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] long after she's parted from you. ...She's teasing you, isn't she? Her smile just widens, saccharine sweet, and [pc.heightRange 69 75 |she pulls you close to her |given that her elf form's shorter than usual, you're able to pull her up to you |even though her elf form's shorter than usual, she half-bends while pulling you upwards, face to face ] such that her cheek brushes against yours, sending shivers down your spine and making your knees go weak. "Yes." An appropriately dramatic pause to let that sink in. "Well then, I'll be taking the lead, hmm? That's how it goes — I run, and you chase, I lead, and you follow?" Kas doesn't wait for your reply, but instead moves with eager confidence to the musicians' lilting tune, spinning you right round and around without care for anyone or anything about the two of you. Yes, just for now it's just you and her, and she sets the mood, she sets the motions, and there's no other way that it could ever be. Kas sweeps you along with inhuman grace, moving fluidly to set even the other dancers in her wake even considering her bulky furs. Slowly but surely, the music builds up, swelling louder and ever so slightly faster, letting you and your demonic partner dance ever quicker in time with the pounding of your hearts; Kas is a whirlwind, picking you up and sending you spinning, twirling you right under her arm and sending you spiraling away, only to pull you back by your hand with a little flourish at the very last moment when you think you'll fall. One moment she's pressing your bodies together, the next she's pushing you away, and you don't know when one will end and the other begin. Still, that's the excitement inherent in it all, isn't it? [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |Sure, you don't know the exact moves she's using on you, but you understand their general form and try to react as best as you can, not so much holding out against the storm but harnessing its energy without being swept away. |Privately, you're glad that Kas is dominating the dance like this — it just means you can allow you to be swept away by the storm and don't have to worry so much about your own lack of skill at dancing. Letting her cover for you like this feels a little awkward, but it's better than making a fool out of both of yourselves in front of the entire Winter City, isn't it? ] One way or the other, the both of you are having fun, and that's what matters when it comes down to it. She's a pretty good dancer. Does she dance a lot? "I did, once," Kasyrra purrs, allowing you to lean your weight in her arms. "Would you be shocked to learn I was taught? Though that was before... before, anyway. After I lost my soul, there wasn't really much call for this kind of dancing, until now. When we demons dance, we prefer to be more vigorous than ballroom dancing. And much less clothed. Still, this is fun. Downright nostalgic. I'm all right with continuing as we are, if it's for you." Aw shucks, she's going to make you blush. "It's okay to blush, pet. It's the least you can do for me, and lots of it, too." [pc.bg noblescion courtesan |It just... you used to dance formally too, or at least was schooled in it, and now you really don't have the time or reason to do it very much. That's something the both of you share, at the very least — if only the both of you didn't keep each other that busy... Kas laughs. "Well, we've got today, so let's make the most of it, shan't we?" |Well, you're doing your best, just as you're doing your best to dance for her right now despite not actually having any real training in formal dancing. Sure, you might step on both your feet all at once, but for her? It's totally worth it. Kas laughs at that. "Oh, you're just so adorable. Seeing you so eager to please me... you really do know how to set a woman's heart aflutter, don't you?[pc.mf | | Of course you do, you're one yourself! ]" ] Indeed. Kas' laughter rings out over the hall, chuckling all the way while she pulls you tight against her, even as the dance number begins to wind down. With one final pull, your demonic lover comes to rest with her hands pressed against your chest, her body close enough that her breasts squeeze in against your [pc.chest]. It takes her a moment to realize where she's ended up, and then a grin comes over her features as she reaches in and gives you a firm, unmistakable squeeze before sliding her fingers back to your shoulders and [pc.hips]. Like it or not, you can feel plenty of eyes on the both of you at this point; Kas is blatantly stealing the show in a devil-may-care fashion, and she knows it. Breaking away from you for a moment to give several of the onlookers a smug smile, she turns back to you, laces her fingers behind your head, and pulls you in for a kiss. It's surprisingly chaste, all things considered; your tongues wrestle for a bit, but she doesn't get into any of the more risque things that you know her to be capable of. Less is more in this case; maybe she's not wanting to break her cover just yet, or she's simply holding back in hopes of getting some real action later. Either way, Kasyrra's taste lingers on your lips and tongue, merely traces of what you know could have been but content to lightly tease you with the tantalizing hope of might-bes. But at last, the number winds to a close, and the musicians pick up an interlude to let the couples leave the floor and new ones arrive. Head still spinning, thoughts still woozy, you step away as Kas gracefully allows you lead her away from the dance floor and to what's left of the buffet, the crowd parting smoothly to let the both of you pass. Purring, she grabs a tall glass of mirrorwine and leans against a pillar, sipping lightly as she settles in with a sigh. "Well! Thank you for the dance." No, no. You thank her for the dance. Kasyrra smiles and shakes her head. "If you're going to be so pushy about it, then have it your way. I think I'll take a little breather before heading down to the floor again myself... dancing with you really brings back some memories!" "

rows.original: Sauntering over to Cait, you ask her if she'd be so kind as to let you have the honor of dancing with her. Giggling, she does a little pretend swoon, raising the back of one hand to her forehead, then guides your hands over her own and allows you to lead her out onto the dance floor. "Ah, dancing in a stately ballroom, just you and me! I'm sure Dad and Calla would kill to see me right now!" Others might say her clothes make her look out of place on the ballroom floor... but you're going to say that they make her stand out. Coupled with the fact that she's a catfolk in a room full of elves, all eyes are going to be on her while she dances, so she should take the chance to enjoy it. Cait chuckles at that. "Remember, [pc.name], I was trained to be a high-class companion. I can sing, recite poetry, do a little magic, hold a decent conversation... and yes, I can dance with the nobility's best. Jassiran dance may be a little strange to Ryn's people, but that's the point, isn't it? And you, [pc.name]? Can you dance?" [pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan |You learned some under your tutors, yes. Not that you got to use it that much, so you're probably out of practice, but with someone like Cait as your dance partner? You'll be remembering everything in no time at all. |Of course you can dance. You wouldn't be much of a courtesan if you didn't know at least a little formal dance, hmm? |Not very well to not at all. You didn't have the chance to learn how, let alone put it into practice, but you're willing to give it a go for Cait's sake. ] Cait tsks and does a little twirl, still holding onto your hand. "Don't worry about it, [pc.name] — it'll be fun, and I'll let you lead! And let's face it, if either of us makes any silly mistakes, it's just an excuse for a laugh, isn't it?" Your reply is on the tip of your tongue, but then the music picks up and your bodies are moving in earnest. Cait's certainly a lot more energetic and willing to move her body than the elves are, and while she said she'd let you lead the dance, her energy is infectious. Frankly, you're glad for it — even the musicians in the band have picked up on the change in mood on the dance floor, slowly shifting the tempo of their tune to something more lively. "Don't worry about me!" your pink kitten says with a laugh as you twirl her about, her tail trailing about behind her like a streamer. Cait's [cait.chest] presses against yours as your bodies close and part, and you could swear she's doing all of these little touches on purpose. "[pc.bg noblescion courtesan |You're not half-bad, really! Maybe we should dance more often when we can get the chance... this is too fun to only do once a year, don't you think? |you really shouldn't be so worried, either — you haven't stepped on my feet or tail yet, so I'd say you're pretty good for a beginner! ]" The music picks up again, and you focus on your feet, pulling the swirling and bubbling Cait after you across the ground. And step-and-two-and-three, and step-and-two-and-three... like it or not, your heart's pounding hard in your chest, and the way Cait's smiling as you lead her about the dance floor makes your heart skip a beat. You can feel the eyes of numerous elves upon you, but Cait gives your fingers a squeeze, and her bright blue gaze draws your attention back to her. And before you know it, the music's slowed and so has your footwork, your lungs slightly out of breath as a still-spry Cait bounces free of you and slaps your [pc.ass] with the side of her butt. She gives you a big, bubbly smile, and then bows just a bit too deeply for what's appropriate before heading off the dance floor after you, making space for the dancers moving in for the next number. "I really wish Dad and Calla could've been here to see me dance with you, [pc.name]. You were great." Were you? It didn't feel like you were. "Trust me when I compliment you, okay? You really do need to work on that." Cait laughs, then taps you on the [pc.ass] with the tip of her tail and blows you a kiss before sauntering off back into the crowd. You can still feel her bubbly energy coursing through your veins from that dance... could Cait always do that, or did you just never notice?
rows.translation: 你走到凯特身边，询问她是否愿意允许你和她共舞。她咯咯笑着，假装晕倒了一下，将一只手放在额头上，然后让你握住她的手，带你走向舞池。 “啊，在这个庄严的舞厅里跳舞，只有我们两个人！我敢肯定，爸爸和卡拉现在看到我一定会非常高兴的！” 其他人可能会说，她的穿着在舞厅里显得格格不入……但你是得说，这些特点确实让她显得格外突出。再加上她是一个猫族，而周围都是精灵，所以当她跳舞的时候，所有人的目光都会集中在她身上——她应该好好把握这个机会，享受这一切。 凯特听到这里轻笑了一声：“记住，”她接着说道，[pc.name]，我被训练成为一名高贵的同伴。我会唱歌、朗诵诗歌、表演一些简单的魔术，也能进行得体的交谈……当然，我还能与贵族中的精英们一起跳舞。对于小琳的人民来说，贾西兰舞蹈或许有些奇怪，但这就是它的魅力所在，不是吗？至于你[pc.name]你会跳舞吗？ [pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan |你确实跟导师们学过一些技巧，不过因为没有经常练习，所以可能已经生疏了。不过如果有像凯特这样的舞伴，你很快就能重新掌握所有这些技巧的。 |你当然可以跳舞。如果连最基本的正式舞蹈都不会，那你也就算不上是个真正的舞者了，对吧？ |差得远，甚至可以说完全不行。你根本没有机会去学习如何做，更不用说实际去实践了，但为了凯特，你还是愿意试一试的。 ] 凯特轻笑了一声，转了个小圈，手依然紧握着你的手。“别担心，没事的。[pc.name]一定会很有趣，而且我会让你来主导这次活动！说实话，如果我们当中有谁犯了些愚蠢的错误，那不正好是个开玩笑的好理由吗？” 你的回答已经脱口而出，但就在这时，音乐声骤然响起，你们的身体也开始认真地跟随节奏移动起来。与那些精灵们相比，凯特确实要活跃得多，也更愿意动起来。虽然她说会让你来带领舞蹈，但她的热情确实具有感染力。说实话，你对此感到很庆幸——就连乐队里的音乐家们也注意到了舞池里气氛的变化，他们逐渐调整了曲子的节奏，使之变得更加活泼起来。 别担心我！”当你轻轻旋转着你的粉色小猫时，它笑着说道，它的尾巴像一条彩带一样在身后飘动。凯特真是太可爱了[cait.chest]当你们的身体靠近又分开时，她的身体会轻轻触碰到你的身体，你甚至敢发誓，她这些小动作都是故意的。[pc.bg noblescion courtesan |你其实还挺不错的嘛！要是有机会的话，我们应该多跳跳舞……这样的活动一年只搞一次未免太浪费了，你不觉得吗？ |你其实也没必要这么担心——你既没有踩到我的脚，也没有碰到我的尾巴，所以对于一个初学者来说，你已经做得相当不错了！ ]音乐再次响起，你全神贯注地控制着自己的脚步，牵着那个旋转着、跳跃着的凯特在舞池中移动。一步、两步、三步……无论你愿不愿意，你的心都在胸口剧烈地跳动，而当你在舞池中引领着她跳舞时，她那幸福的笑容更是让你的心跳得更加快了。你能感觉到无数精灵的目光都在注视着你，但凯特轻轻捏了捏你的手指，她那湛蓝色的目光立刻吸引了你的注意力，让你再次将目光转向她。 不知不觉间，音乐的速度变慢了，你的脚步也变得迟缓起来，呼吸变得有些急促。而凯特依然灵活敏捷，她突然从你身边跳开，还轻轻拍了一下你的[pc.ass]她用臀部的一侧轻轻触碰着你，然后露出一个灿烂、充满活力的笑容，接着鞠了一个略显过分的深躬，之后便跟在你身后离开了舞池，为下一组舞者让出了空间。 “我真希望爸爸和卡拉能在场，看到我和你一起跳舞[pc.name]你做得真的很棒。” 是吗？可我感觉你并没有那么出色。 “当我夸你时，相信我，好吗？你确实还需要再努力一些。”凯特笑着说，然后轻拍了一下你的肩膀。[pc.ass]它轻轻摆动尾巴，向你飞了一个吻，然后便悠然地走回人群中去了。直到现在，你仍然能感受到那段舞蹈带来的活力正在你的体内流淌……是凯特一直都有这样的能力，还是说你之前只是从未注意到而已呢？
rows.raw: " Sauntering over to Cait, you ask her if she'd be so kind as to let you have the honor of dancing with her. Giggling, she does a little pretend swoon, raising the back of one hand to her forehead, then guides your hands over her own and allows you to lead her out onto the dance floor. "Ah, dancing in a stately ballroom, just you and me! I'm sure Dad and Calla would kill to see me right now!" Others might say her clothes make her look out of place on the ballroom floor... but you're going to say that they make her stand out. Coupled with the fact that she's a catfolk in a room full of elves, all eyes are going to be on her while she dances, so she should take the chance to enjoy it. Cait chuckles at that. "Remember, [pc.name], I was trained to be a high-class companion. I can sing, recite poetry, do a little magic, hold a decent conversation... and yes, I can dance with the nobility's best. Jassiran dance may be a little strange to Ryn's people, but that's the point, isn't it? And you, [pc.name]? Can you dance?" [pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan |You learned some under your tutors, yes. Not that you got to use it that much, so you're probably out of practice, but with someone like Cait as your dance partner? You'll be remembering everything in no time at all. |Of course you can dance. You wouldn't be much of a courtesan if you didn't know at least a little formal dance, hmm? |Not very well to not at all. You didn't have the chance to learn how, let alone put it into practice, but you're willing to give it a go for Cait's sake. ] Cait tsks and does a little twirl, still holding onto your hand. "Don't worry about it, [pc.name] — it'll be fun, and I'll let you lead! And let's face it, if either of us makes any silly mistakes, it's just an excuse for a laugh, isn't it?" Your reply is on the tip of your tongue, but then the music picks up and your bodies are moving in earnest. Cait's certainly a lot more energetic and willing to move her body than the elves are, and while she said she'd let you lead the dance, her energy is infectious. Frankly, you're glad for it — even the musicians in the band have picked up on the change in mood on the dance floor, slowly shifting the tempo of their tune to something more lively. "Don't worry about me!" your pink kitten says with a laugh as you twirl her about, her tail trailing about behind her like a streamer. Cait's [cait.chest] presses against yours as your bodies close and part, and you could swear she's doing all of these little touches on purpose. "[pc.bg noblescion courtesan |You're not half-bad, really! Maybe we should dance more often when we can get the chance... this is too fun to only do once a year, don't you think? |you really shouldn't be so worried, either — you haven't stepped on my feet or tail yet, so I'd say you're pretty good for a beginner! ]" The music picks up again, and you focus on your feet, pulling the swirling and bubbling Cait after you across the ground. And step-and-two-and-three, and step-and-two-and-three... like it or not, your heart's pounding hard in your chest, and the way Cait's smiling as you lead her about the dance floor makes your heart skip a beat. You can feel the eyes of numerous elves upon you, but Cait gives your fingers a squeeze, and her bright blue gaze draws your attention back to her. And before you know it, the music's slowed and so has your footwork, your lungs slightly out of breath as a still-spry Cait bounces free of you and slaps your [pc.ass] with the side of her butt. She gives you a big, bubbly smile, and then bows just a bit too deeply for what's appropriate before heading off the dance floor after you, making space for the dancers moving in for the next number. "I really wish Dad and Calla could've been here to see me dance with you, [pc.name]. You were great." Were you? It didn't feel like you were. "Trust me when I compliment you, okay? You really do need to work on that." Cait laughs, then taps you on the [pc.ass] with the tip of her tail and blows you a kiss before sauntering off back into the crowd. You can still feel her bubbly energy coursing through your veins from that dance... could Cait always do that, or did you just never notice? "

rows.original: You [pc.mascFem |saunter up to |prowl your way across the floor to ] Azyrran, who looks to be comfortably sipping wine and looking around. When those pure black orbs alight on you, they brighten up and she gestures you closer with a crook of her finger. She giggles when you take her hand. "[pc.dcb |You and me; dance. |Might I have this dance? |Wanna get your dance on, cutie? ]" Her giggling melts into a smug smile, changing the grip on your hand until she's holding you firmly. "Of course, I would love to... but surely I should be asking you?" [pc.mascFem |Wait, what? There's a glitter in her eyes at your surprise, and the knight gives you a little squeeze. |But of course! She's the big strong knight, after all. ] Azzy guides you, holding you like a dainty girl and taking leading steps until you're near the center of the dance floor. "Do you know how to dance, [pc.name]?" [pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan |You were educated in the dance back in the day... but you're more than a little out of practice. "Perhaps you could get me back up to speed again?" |Dance? You practically lived for it! Such is the life of a courtesan. |You nervously shift on the spot as her feet nudge yours into place. "Not a clue, help." ] She begins with simple steps, holding you close; it's hard to hear it over the music that floods the hall, but it sounds a lot like Azzy's humming beneath her breath. Undoubtedly this knight was made to lead a dance, stepping in and guiding your step out, a hand planted firmly on your ass while the other has a masculine grip on your [pc.mascFem |calloused |soft ] fingers. The scent of honey and flowers clings to her body — and very quickly to you — as the humming knight escorts you step-by-step through the simple dance. Eventually there's a lull in the tune, allowing the two of you to share a few words. Azzy looks to be utterly glowing and vibrant with Lumian light... you'd swear she's even getting a few jealous looks at this unspoken favor. "We're getting a lot of looks, you're quite the dancer, [pc.name]." You snort and tuck in for a kiss, allowing her to control the pace and have fun taking the lead. "The eyes are mostly on you here, are you sure you're not secretly elven nobility?" A ladylike giggle slips out of her, just in time for the music to change and the ball to erupt into motion. Thankfully you're all warmed up as the energetic pace is kicked off by a few of the more adventurous dancers — it's possible to snatch a glimpse of pink kitty ears — and you manage to keep up with Azzy's directions. It's a whirl of motion, and the knight has you spinning and twirling in her strong hands... there's even a cheeky grope or two on her part as the slower dancers are left behind and more eyes are on the two of you. Your heart thumps hard enough to feel in the back of your throat, turned entirely over to the hornet's control as a few tired dancer clap and sing for you and those few couples that remain. And then all at once, a drop— a catch. One of your legs are thrown up into the air, one hand holding yours, an arm couched behind your shoulders, and a flaxen waterfall of beautiful hair covers your face. When her lips find yours, the taste of honey and spice is sweet on her tongue, warm and soft and melting into you as you're pulled into a kiss and embrace entirely at odds with the knight's usual shyness. With even more eyes on the two of you than when you began, Azzy walks you off of the dance floor beaming with joy. "That was so fun, I feel like a little girl again!" "I'm amazed you know to dance so well..." Azzy blushes and clears her throat, accepting a glass of wine as it passes her by. "My sisters and I love to dance, and some of the shorter ones would always have me be the man... which I prefer, taking the lead, getting to see that look in your eeeyes..." her bug-bum does a little wiggle and she kisses you on the cheek. "It was delightful! Thank you for the dance, [pc.mf |m'lord |m'lady ]." After a last little — gentlemanly — bow Azzy returns to the sidelines for a moment's rest, leaving you alone with your choices.
rows.translation: 你[pc.mascFem |慢悠悠地走过去 |悄悄地移动着穿过地面，前往…… ]阿兹兰看起来正悠闲地品着葡萄酒，环顾四周。当那些纯黑色的光球照在你的身上时，它们会亮起来，她便用手指一勾，示意你靠近一些。 当你握住她的手时，她咯咯地笑了起来。[pc.dcb |你和我；一起跳舞吧。 |这个舞步，能让我来跳吗？ |想跳支舞吗，小可爱？ ]她的咯咯笑声渐渐变成了得意的笑容，同时她握着你手部的力度也发生了变化，直到她紧紧地抓住了你的手。“当然，我非常愿意……但肯定我难道不应该先来问你吗？ [pc.mascFem |等等，什么？看到你的惊讶，她的眼中闪烁着光芒，而那位骑士也轻轻捏了捏你的手。 |当然啦！毕竟她可是那位强大勇敢的骑士啊。 ] 阿齐牵着你的手，像抱着一个娇嫩的女孩一样，带着你一步步走向舞池的中心。“你会跳舞吗？[pc.name]？” [pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan |你以前接受过舞蹈训练……不过现在确实已经有点生疏了。“或许你可以帮我重新恢复状态吧？ |跳舞？你简直就是为跳舞而生的！这就是舞妓的生活啊。 |当她的脚轻轻碰了碰你的脚，让你站好位置时，你紧张地在原地挪动着。“完全不知道，帮帮我吧。 ] 她从简单的动作开始，紧紧地将你拉在身边；在充斥着整个大厅的音乐声中，几乎听不清她在说什么，但那声音听起来很像阿齐在低声哼唱。毫无疑问，这位骑士生来就是为了带领大家跳舞——他会适时介入，引导你的步伐，一只手稳稳地放在你的臀部上，而另一只手则以充满男子气概的方式握住你的[pc.mascFem |粗糙的、老化的 |柔软的 ]她的手指上带着蜂蜜与花香的气息——当那位哼着小曲的骑士一步步引导你跳这支简单的舞蹈时，这种香味很快也会传到你身上。 渐渐地，音乐节奏变得缓慢下来，你们有了机会互相交谈几句。阿齐看起来仿佛被卢米安的光芒照得容光焕发、活力四射……你甚至会觉得，那些旁观者中，有些人似乎因为这种无声的“恩惠”而感到嫉妒。“有很多人在看着我们呢，你跳舞真是跳得太棒了[pc.name]你轻哼一声，然后主动吻了她，让她来掌控节奏，享受主导的乐趣。“在这里，所有人的目光都在你身上呢，你确定自己不是暗地里什么精灵贵族吗？” 她发出一阵淑女般的轻笑，正好在音乐发生变化、舞会重新热闹起来的时候。 幸好大家都已经热身好了，因为一些更具冒险精神的舞者们率先开始了充满活力的舞蹈——你甚至有机会瞥见那些粉红色的猫耳装饰……你也成功地跟上了阿齐的指令。 随着舞蹈的进行，你感觉自己仿佛在她的强有力手中不断旋转、翻腾……有时候，她还会调皮地触碰你的脸颊。当其他舞者逐渐被甩在后面，越来越多的目光集中在你们两个人身上时，这种感觉更加明显了。 你的心跳得如此剧烈，甚至能感觉到它在喉咙后部跳动；此时，你的整个身心都已经完全被那个“黄蜂”控制住了——只有那几个疲惫的舞者还在为你，以及为那为数不多的情侣们鼓掌、唱歌。 然后，突然间，一切都发生了变化：你的一条腿被猛地抬向空中，有一只手握住了你的手，另一只手臂搭在你的肩上，而一缕金色的长发则像瀑布般覆盖住了你的脸庞。 当她的嘴唇触碰到你的嘴唇时，那种蜂蜜与香料的芬芳在她的舌头上弥漫开来，温暖而柔和，仿佛正在慢慢融化你。你们之间的这个吻、这个拥抱，与那位骑士平日里的羞涩截然不同。 此时，注视着你们的目光比刚开始时还要多。阿齐满脸喜悦地牵着你走下舞池，说道：“太有趣了，我感觉自己又变回了一个小女孩！ 你跳舞跳得这么好，真让我感到惊讶……” 阿齐的脸颊微微发红，清了清嗓子，接过递过来的一杯葡萄酒。“我和我的姐妹们都很喜欢跳舞，那些年纪较小的姐妹们总是让我来当‘男主角’……而我其实更喜欢这样的角色，能够带头跳舞，还能看到你眼中的那种表情……”她扭动了一下身体，然后在你的脸颊上轻轻一吻。“真是太开心了！谢谢你陪我跳舞。 [pc.mf |大人 |女士 ]在做了最后一个礼貌的鞠躬之后，阿齐便回到场边稍作休息，让你独自面对自己的选择。

rows.original: No sooner has the thought entered your mind that Quin's at your side, eyeing you intently with a smug smile on his face and a raised eyebrow. His eyes meet yours for a split second, and then he bows with a sweeping flourish, one that perhaps is a little too at odds with his outfit. "[flags.RYN_MARKET |Looking good today, aren't you? I guess since you dressed up so nicely, I've got no choice but to ask you out onto the floor |So, what're you going all by your lonesome with everything so lively around you? Guess I've no choice but to fix that all by myself ]." Is... is he asking you to dance? What happened to finding a nice tall amazonian woman and picking her up? "Ah, there'll be time enough for that — without you, I wouldn't even be here at this party, so there's that. Gotta pay my dues, you know, and with you sitting here looking all glum I've got to fix that. Besides, you were just thinking of asking me to dance, weren't you? "Come on, don't look at me like that. The way you were standing there, you were screaming it out for anyone who cared to listen. Enough moping, let's get us onto the floor, eh?" Dance? "Dance!" You look at Quin's outstretched hand, then smile. Barely has your hand entered his that Quin grabs you by the wrist and hoists you to your feet, sliding an arm around your waist even as he guides you forward under the chandeliers. "Guess we're stuck with each other for this number, so let's make the most of it!" Seeing the growing crowd of people moving onto the floor, the band starts up a slow melody, allowing the dancers to get their bearings. Around you, the other elven couples start moving to the music, moving in graceful steps in time to the music. This one's looking like it's pretty formal, and [flags.RYN_MARKET |despite your fancy elven clothes, you just can't make up for Quin sticking out like a sore thumb here |you can't help but feel that the two of you are sticking out like sore thumbs here, especially Quin ]. Your bunny companion just smiles, gently swaying his body — and yours — to the tune, and before you know it he's easily usurped the masculine role in the pairing. Privately, you're a little glad that the band's chosen a slow number for this dance[pc.bg noblescion courtesan | |, and not just because you're not that good at dancing ]; the atmosphere in the ballroom is a little less formal and a lot more intimate than what all the elven finery about you might otherwise imply. Despite Quin's cocky impulsiveness and rashness at times, he's forced to move in time with the beat, although that doesn't stop him from sneakily sliding a hand down below your waist when you're not expecting it, making you suck in a startled breath. You shoot the bunny-boy an accusatory glare, and he just blows you off with a chuckle and faux-innocent shrug of his shoulders. He's getting off on the cheeky thrill of being so very naughty on this important occasion in full view of the entire Winter City, and getting off scot-free under the noses of so many snooty — or at least, they're snooty in his mind — elves. "Even though I learned it, I don't really do this kind of dancing much," Quin says with a laugh. Sweeping you across the marble floor with a grand flourish, he takes a moment to surreptitiously slide a hand over your [pc.hips] and [pc.butt], his crotch grinding into your thigh. "Slow isn't really my style... frankly, it isn't really taleer style at all. But for someone as special as you, I guess I'll make do. Last thing I want people saying about me is that I'm inflexible." Where did he learn ballroom dancing, anyway? Certainly it wasn't with the cult. "Gods forbid, no! That lot couldn't dance formally if their lives depended on it. No, I learned ballroom dancing while I was trying out for Taelia's Talons." You can only imagine what kind of outfit the Talons were that would have required Quin to pick up formal dance as a part of his training, but those thoughts are scattered from your mind as Quin sweeps you up into a quick swirl and carry before planting you on your feet again. That was certainly more lively than the music warranted and you feel the eyes of numerous elves upon you, some longing, others judgemental, but you don't care. Against all odds, this is fun, and that's the point of why you're here all the ball in the first place. Sure, the pale elves might be adding politicking and all kinds of byplay to this event, but screw them. Here and now, with Quin holding your hands, his devil-may-care attitude, perfectly exemplified by his dress amongst all the elven finery, is really getting to you. "Can you feel it?" He leans his face close to yours, close enough that your noses barely touch. "Are you aware?" You're aware of the fact that he's yet to sweep up a tall elven lady for a tryst, but given how he's holding himself you really can't imagine why he hasn't already done so. "Can't commit too early," comes the cheeky answer. "Like the buffet, you've got to scope out everything on display before making a decision. And before you ask the question... you're not bad, I guess." Not bad? That's all you warrant? A laugh. Now that he's gotten away with breaking the mold, Quin grows bolder, forcing you to keep up with his burgeoning movements. Now that he's getting into a dance that's more in his stride, his feet move with deft confidence, neatly avoiding yours as the two of you turn round and around to the music. Feeling the air coming off the both of you as you begin to truly dominate the floor and seeing that they've no choice, the band acquiesces and picks up the pace, going louder and faster to match your footwork. Quin's hips pump to the now more lively beat, his little poofy bunny tail wagging hard enough to betray his excitement despite the calm, confident face he's presenting to you. The Talons must've been demanding if he had to learn ballroom dancing as part of, or in preparation for his tryouts. Quin chuckles[pc.bgMulti noblescion courtesan | | as he nimbly dodges one of your stumbling feet, turning it into a catch and pulling you back close to him. Nice catch there ]. "You have no idea. Even I don't, myself." You're about to ask him what he means by that when Quin spins you right round again in his arms, catching you and pulling you in with your back right to him, hands lacing about your [pc.belly]. It's your turn to be cheeky, now — you shimmy in Quin's grip, grinding back against his tight embrace until you can feel a lump forming in his pants, hard and insistent against your [pc.butt]. Quin smiles at that, spinning you right round so that you're face to face once again. At last, he finally deigns to ignore the pace of the music altogether, throwing the music's tempo to the winds and erupting in a flurry of energetic yet fancy footwork that's truly in his element and leaves you struggling to keep up[pc.bg nobleScion courtesan | despite this being far from your first spin upon the dance floor ]. Dragging you along with him, Quin moves with lively yet immutable grace, reminiscent of how fleet-footed he was being the first time you met him; all impeccable poise and posture despite the urgency and energy with which he carries himself, your bunny-boy companion keeps you steady but keeps you moving, so quickly that you don't really have the time to think about what you're doing and just let your feet make the decisions for you. At this point, you're so far out of line from the other dancers that most of the ballroom is openly staring at the two of you, and the extra attention just makes your heart pound in your chest. Quin? He's luxuriating in having stolen the spotlight, squeezing your shoulder reassuringly as he holds you tight. "We make a pretty good pair, don't we?" He doesn't wait for your reply, but instead pulls you along with him again; while you've noticed how quickly the two of you are moving, it's only now that you truly realize that Quin and you are flying across the dance floor compared to the other couples. When the music finally ends, you find that your bunny-boy companion's just as out of breath as you are despite not having so much as broken a sweat, his heart hammering against yours as he pulls you in close and presses your [pc.chest] close to his. The aura of smugness at getting away with everything he's just pulled on the dance floor could choke out a minotaur, but to you, it's admittedly quite intoxicating. "That wasn't so bad," Quin says, releasing you and guiding you off to the sides of the ballroom. "This kind of formal jig really depends on the kind of partner you have, and you were pretty fun[pc.bg noblescion courtesan | | despite your two left feet ]." With that, Quin gives you a flirtatious wink and slips away into the crowd, leaving you still a little out of it.

[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_TUI
        |You find Atugia nervously staring into a glass of mirrorwine that looks to be mostly full. She sets the drink down, then picks it up again, but the glass never makes it to her lips. You wander up and ask if she, perhaps, [silly
            |has a drinking problem
            |would like a less liquid confidence boost
        ]. She starts at your voice, but gives a thankful half-smile at the suggestion.
        
        "M-maybe. I'm just not even sure how to ask royalty to dance. Most of the foreign parties were just aristocrats or friends of Carmen's. 'A guy who knows the sultana' is a whole lot different from the [etheryn.crowned
            |a real queen
            |true royalty
        ]. I don't even..." Her features turn downcast as she trails off, looking past your shoulder. You turn to see Etheryn, catching her breath after the last song and drinking from a glass of water on the long end of the banquet table. Welp, no sense keeping this door closed when fate is knocking so loudly.
        
        Atugia makes a muffled 'eep' as you put an arm around her back, sweeping her handily toward the royal boer'alvar. Ryn notices you coming, smiling at you and raising an eyebrow at the beet red dullahan standing beside you. 
        
        "[pc.name]! [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |A-are you still having fun? Who's your f-frie-
            |Are you still enjoying the ball? Who's this you've go-
        ]" she begins, eyes going wide as she gets a closer look. She does another glance-over, top to bottom, and her face brightens. She rushes forward, brushing the fabric of Tui's dress between her fingers, and twirling her this way and that in short increments to watch the spiders dance. [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |Worries banished for the moment
            |Formality forgotten
        ], she grins wide and hugs the shorter girl tight.
        
        "Atugia! I didn't even recognize you at first. I'm so glad you could make it, and your dress is so beautiful! Have you been having fun? A-are you ok? You look a little hot," Ryn asks, putting the back of her hand to Tui's forehead, where her blush is threatening to boil over. She nods, a wobbly smile on her lips, and tries to answer one or both questions. All that comes out is a wordless string of quiet noises you can barely hear above the chatter. With a sigh, you make an effort to translate.
        
        "[pc.dcb
            |She wants a dance, got time for one more?
            |We were just about to head back to the dance floor. Would you care to join us?
            |we want to daaaaance. C'monnn Ryn! It'll be super mega awesome. Pretty please?
        ]" you ask, taking each girl by the hand. Atugia nods, exhaling for the first time since you approached the [etheryn.crowned
            |queen
            |royal regent
        ].
        
        "[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |Oh! Y-yes! I'd love to, but I don't know any three person dances,
            |Oh definitely! I'd love to dance with you both, but I don't know any three person dances to go with this song,
        ]" Ryn replies as you gently tug her in the direction of the crowd. Who cares? [pc.bg noblescion courtesan
            |You don't know any either, but that's beside the point
            |What does knowing have to do with it?
        ] The three of you can come up with something on the fly, how hard can it be? It's a bit awkward at first, 
        getting your partners into a position that's even remotely workable. You somehow manage, with Atugia positioned just between you and Etheryn and the three of you close enough to kiss the other.
        
        "I-I think people are looking. What do we do now?" Tui asks, gripping your hand a little too tightly. Ryn puts her hand over the shorter woman's, smiling [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |despite the fact that her own hands show a slight tremble
            |confidently as her fingers mesh between yours
        ]. 
        
        "We dance, [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |I guess
            |silly
        ]," Ryn says, pushing the ensemble to start as the music begins anew. At first it's much smoother than you would have imagined, with the three of you gliding serenely through the crowd. The longer you dance, the more [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |Atugia and Etheryn both relax and get more into the dance.
            |Atugia relaxes and gets into the dance.
        ] You find your footing, twirling both girls out to either side of you and pulling them back together. The nervous dullahan giggles as she eases into place on the way back, and the tension breaks in an instant. The throng of dancers part around you as best they can, but as your pace picks up a couple missteps are unavoidable.
        
        Etheryn breaks into laughter as you bump into a couple who look briefly irritated until they recognize you and the [etheryn.crowned
            |queen
            |princess
        ]. The two of you twirl Atugia out through the middle, and she spins on her heels, staying out and turning your closed waltz into a circle. You spin and spin, somehow managing not to step on each others' feet as you haphazardly swing to the tune of the music. If the throng of elves weren't spread out around you before, they certainly are now. Each of them, the royal guard included, watch with quiet curiosity as the three of you sway in delighted ignorance. 
        
        Without a hint of warning, Etheryn breaks away from the two of you. [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |Her smile falters once she's alone, and you see all too common thoughts cloud her expression, 'why did I do this?', and 'what do I do now?' chief among them. Before panic can truly set in, you put the first two fingers of both hands together and give her the loudest whistle of encouragement you can manage. Ryn's ears flutter, and you see her nod to herself before pirouetting thrice and coming to a stop facing you. Tears shine in the corner of her eyes, relics of a moment that passed before it began. 
            |She spins flawlessly, pirouetting thrice before returning to face you. The raw confidence in her screams to you, a display that shows everyone just how far she's come. She doesn't stop there, twirling left, right, and shimmying her hips till she's right in front of the two of you. Or just you... where's-
        ]
        
        While you're distracted by dance, Atugia jumps on your back, laughing loud as you barrel forward into a [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |terrified, but 
        ]fully expectant Ryn. The two girls struggle to hold back snickers as they take each others' hands, waiting for you to be Tui's feet while you hold her in place. You teeter and turn to the point of near falling as your awkward pairing shambles around the parted crowd. The uninhibited monarch spins three circles, dress twirling out as your rider simply holds an outstretched hand above her head. 
        
        "Hold on, let me just..." the crimson haired hellion grunts, stretching out her legs till her calves reach just around Etheryn's back. With a victorious cry, she pulls her legs together till you're pressed face to face. Tangled as you are, the dance and music fade into the rhythm of heartbeats pressed together. The closeness also makes moving that much easier. You hug ryn around the middle, just above Tui's thighs, and [pc.heightRange 0 69
            |do your best to guide the dance from below.
            |hoist her into the air.
        ] The two of them point their held hands in the direction you want to move, and you do your best to steer.
        
        Growing tired of being squashed, you tickle the underside of Tui's thighs. She holds out at first, bopping the top of your head with her chin before her grip weakens enough that you can pull her over your shoulder. Atugia cries out as you flip her right over and into a full-on princess carry, looking around bewildered for a moment and clutching at your shoulder before gaining her bearings. Turning her gaze between Ryn and you, she throws her head back and spreads her arms, lounging between your outstretched arms.
        
        "[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |H-hey! D-don't go limp on us
            |Hey, no slacking off
        ]," Etheryn murmurs, bouncing the supine recliner a little and trying her best to sound serious. She stands when you set her down, pouting a little but unable to keep the corners of her mouth from curling up when she looks either of you in the face. By now you can hear the music winding down, and the three of you transition into one last form. Standing in a circle and holding one hand for each partner, you twirl left, right, and back. Even as the music dies, you have eyes for none but each other.
        
        At least, that is, until the clapping and a few timely whistles bring you blinking back into reality. As soon as you're alone, Ryn throws her arms around you and gives you a deep kiss. She breathes deep, steadying herself before tackling Atugia in a similar fashion.
        
        "Thank you, thank you, thank you! If you guys could just keep distracting me like this all night it'll be much easier to- Tui? What's wrong? [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |D-did I touch a wound when I hugged you?
            |Did you pull something during the dance?
        ]" she asks, full of sudden concern. Atugia stands there trembling, with tears streaming down her face and a wobbly grin. It takes her a few tries to speak, with each attempt coming out as nothing more than a slightly more successful cough.
        
        "I... You all are so c-cool, and I'm just some country b-bumpkin dressin' up fancy and, and-'' she begins, unable to continue as Ryn puts two fingers to her lips. The boreal beauty [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |is breaking up herself, tears streaming down her cheeks as she hugs Atugia again.
            
            "No! You a-aren't a bumpkin! You're super pretty and smart, and anyone would be happy to have you around. If I found out anyone called you a bumpkin I-I'd.. p-put them on cleaning duty or something!"
            |shows remarkable restraint, wiping the corners of her eyes before she can fall into sympathy tears.
            
            "Stop that! You aren't a bumpkin, and if I hear anyone saying you are they'd get a one-way ticket to cleaning duty,"
        ] she says, patting the redhead on the back till she calms down. You [pc.isBimbo
            |nod, lasting all of ten seconds before you break down into a sympathetic cry-fest of your own.[etheryn.lowConfidence
                | Both of the other girls start crying again with you, continuing until your eyes are dry.
            ]
            |join the hug, patting both girls on the back and waiting until everyone decides to naturally untangle.
        ]
        
        "Now I'm going to go back and mingle, but I better not see you crying in the dance hall. Find some sweet cake to eat. It really helps make you feel better sometimes," Ryn instructs, wiping her face on a towel that one of the guards provides before waving and heading back into the fray of the dance floor. Tui holds your sleeve as you start to head back, looking much better than she did mere seconds ago.
        
        "Thanks. I needed this," she says before following Ryn through the door.
        
        You don't know if you'll ever get used to having so many warm butterflies in your stomach, but it's not a bad feeling to need to get used to.
        |Slipping through the throng of coupled dancers as the music begins to pick up, you find yourself face to face with Atugia. The redhead is unapologetically out of place among the elves, even with a dress that looks like it wholly belongs. Each of her fists is clenched around a handful of the dress's fabric, and she looks to be on the verge of being utterly overwhelmed. Seeing you, the tension bleeds out of her all at once, and she graces you with a big wholesome grin.
        
        "I was hoping you'd find me. Do you want to dance?" she asks, releasing her skirt and holding both hands out to you. 
        
        Ha! Why does she think you came all the way over here? Of course you want to dance. You take both her hands, [pc.bg noblescion courtesan
            |seamlessly matching the movements of the dance going around you.
            |surprised to find yourself seamlessly matching the movements on the dance floor as she subtly adjusts to your lead.
        ] Tui follows you with near-perfect accuracy, occasionally glancing at nearby couples and returning her gaze to you with more confidence each time. Even knowing she received training from the baroness, you'd never have expected her to be so at home at a function like this.
        
        "Hey! [pc.bg noblescion
            |don't get snobby with me, [pc.mascFem
                |mister
                |missy
            ]
            |I could say the same about you
        ]!" she shoots back, flush with pride despite her response. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan
            |Your partner follows you step for step, not missing a single beat as you twirl her out and pull her back in.
            |Even when you don't know the steps, you still find yourself matching the crowd step for step.
        ] [pc.agilityRange 50
            |Despite your lack of formal training, you find yourself having no trouble following Tui's steps, managing as graceful a dance as you can.
            |Even when you inevitably trip up, Tui straightens in an instant, avoiding your footfalls and making it look almost intentional.
        ] This is incredible! When did she learn to waltz in classical boer'alvar form so well? Was that something the baroness taught her?
        
        "Um, err. Is it really that good? I've kind of been watching people all night; it's easy to pick up once you've seen it a couple times, right?" she asks, a flush growing in her cheeks as she gives you a nervous laugh. For a half-second you wonder if she's trying to sound humble, but no, you can hear it in the sincerity of her question. With complete seriousness, [pc.bg noblescion courtesan
            |the girl believes it's just that simple to pick up a dance form that developed over ages and make it look completely natural.
            |she thinks there's nothing odd about how well she's dancing a dance she's never formally learned.
        ]
        
        "I-I can slow down if I'm going too fast. I don't want to-," she begins, glancing nervously at the crowd and tripping up for the first time of the night.
        
        No! You didn't mean to make her uncomfortable. The music comes to a convenient lull, and you hug her around the waist. There's no need for her to falter now. You're very much enjoying dancing with her, and equally sure that anyone else would think the same. She melts at that, and when the next movement has you lifting and twirling with her held in the air, she beams like a bright star. Once she's back on the ground, she moves with the same intense passion you saw at the start of the dance, following your lead with exquisite grace.
        
        She's perfectly willing to show off now, and you spy more than one onlooker raise their brows at the short foreigner faultlessly executing the elvish dance. In full movement, the glittering spiderforms on her dress look more like a sky of stars, not unlike the sidereal collar on her neck. Speaking of, why is she even bothering with the dark velvet ribbon? It would probably be cooler if she removed it, and the people here would likely assume her neck was an enchanted part of the ensemble. Would it be so bad if she removed it?
        
        "Hmm. [silly
            |You'll be sorry if I do, so I won't,
            |I don't have the paint on, and I'd rather leave that for later,
        ]" she says with a curious smile. The lithe dullahan makes for a startling assortment of color, now that you're close enough to get a good look. The light from the chandeliers above shines on her hair and reflects in the bright green pools of her eyes. Twirling gently, you let the beat of the music set the pace. Atugia leans against you and rocks, eyes closed, as the musicians reach a pattern she's already heard. She hums along with the tune, folding out into a pirouette with relaxed grace.
        
        "I like what you're wearing," she says, a hand shifting from back, to butt, to hip, and back again. [flags.RYN_MARKET
            |Oh please. Even now it's not like anyone whose eye you're catching even sees you
            |Yeah... and she's probably the only one. Anyone else has got to be looking at her
        ]. She knees you in the shin as soon as the dance allows her to hide it, laughing at your wince.
        
        "Oh shut up, you're shining like Lumia herself, and [flags.RYN_MARKET
            |the spider silk has nothing to do with it
            |no one cares what you're wearing. At least not anyone who matters
        ]," she promises, and makes you believe at that. You hardly even notice as the current song dies, staying in your tomboyish partner's arms till she decides it's time to let go.
        
        "Ok. I'm gonna go get something more to drink. I've been trying to work up the courage to ask Ryn to dance too, but I already feel super out of place. I don't know if I could handle all those eyes on me..." she says as she rushes off toward the banquet bar. Hmm.
    ]

[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_TUI
        |你看到阿图吉娅紧张地盯着那杯看起来几乎满了的镜像酒。她把酒放下，又重新拿起它，但杯子始终没有送到她的嘴唇边。你走过去，问道：“她是不是[silly

        "[pc.name]！ [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |你还在玩得开心吗？你的朋友是谁啊……

突然间，伊瑟琳毫无预兆地从你们中间脱离了出来。 [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |当她独自一人时，她的笑容立刻消失了，你能够清楚地看到那些常见的思绪笼罩在了她的脸上：“我为什么要这么做？”以及“现在我该怎么办？”这些念头最为突出。就在恐慌真正开始之前，你把双手的食指和中指并拢，用尽全力吹出了最响亮的鼓励声。小琳的耳朵微微一颤，她点了点头，然后连续转了三个圈，最终停在了你的面前。她的眼角噙着泪水，那些泪水，其实是发生在这一切开始之前的那个瞬间的痕迹。

            |害怕极了，但是…… 
        ]满怀期待的小琳。两个女孩强忍住笑意，手拉着手，等着你站在翠伊的脚边，帮她保持平衡。你们笨手笨脚地穿梭在分开的人群中，差点摔倒。这位毫无拘束的君主旋转了三圈，她的裙摆随之飞舞，而她的骑手只是将一只手伸到她的头顶上方。

“等一下，让我先……”这位红发叛逆的女孩哼了一声，她伸长了双腿，使得自己的小腿几乎触到了伊瑟琳的背部。随着一声胜利的欢呼，她将双腿收拢，使得你们面贴着面。在这种紧密相贴的姿势下，舞蹈和音乐渐渐融入了彼此心跳的节奏之中。这种亲密的距离也让动作变得更加流畅自如。你从腰部抱住小琳，正好在崔的大腿上方，然后[pc.heightRange 0 69
            |尽你所能从下方引导这场舞蹈。
            |将她举到空中。
        ]他们两人将牵着的手朝你想要移动的方向伸去，而你则尽力引导他们的方向。

        由于被挤压得有些难受，你开始挠弄崔大腿内侧。起初她还会反抗，用下巴轻敲你的头顶，但过了一会儿，她的力气逐渐减弱，你终于可以将她拉到自己的肩上。当你将阿图吉娅翻过来，用公主抱的方式抱起她时，她发出了惊叫声。她茫然地环顾四周，紧紧抓住你的肩膀，过了一会儿才找回方向。她的目光在小琳和你之间来回移动，然后她仰起头，张开双臂，就这样躺在你伸开的怀里。
        
        "[etheryn.lowConfidence

Once she's back on the ground, she moves with the same intense passion you saw at the start of the dance, following your lead with exquisite grace.
        
        She's perfectly willing to show off now, and you spy more than one onlooker raise their brows at the short foreigner faultlessly executing the elvish dance. In full movement, the glittering spiderforms on her dress look more like a sky of stars, not unlike the sidereal collar on her neck. Speaking of, why is she even bothering with the dark velvet ribbon? It would probably be cooler if she removed it, and the people here would likely assume her neck was an enchanted part of the ensemble. Would it be so bad if she removed it?
        
        "Hmm. [silly
            |You'll be sorry if I do, so I won't,
            |I don't have the paint on, and I'd rather leave that for later,
        ]" she says with a curious smile. The lithe dullahan makes for a startling assortment of color, now that you're close enough to get a good look. The light from the chandeliers above shines on her hair and reflects in the bright green pools of her eyes. Twirling gently, you let the beat of the music set the pace. Atugia leans against you and rocks, eyes closed, as the musicians reach a pattern she's already heard. She hums along with the tune, folding out into a pirouette with relaxed grace.
        
        "I like what you're wearing," she says, a hand shifting from back, to butt, to hip, and back again. [flags.RYN_MARKET
            |Oh please. Even now it's not like anyone whose eye you're catching even sees you
            |Yeah... and she's probably the only one. Anyone else has got to be looking at her
        ]. She knees you in the shin as soon as the dance allows her to hide it, laughing at your wince.
        
        "Oh shut up, you're shining like Lumia herself, and [flags.RYN_MARKET
            |the spider silk has nothing to do with it
            |no one cares what you're wearing. At least not anyone who matters
        ]," she promises, and makes you believe at that. You hardly even notice as the current song dies, staying in your tomboyish partner's arms till she decides it's time to let go.
        
        "Ok. I'm gonna go get something more to drink. I've been trying to work up the courage to ask Ryn to dance too, but I already feel super out of place. I don't know if I could handle all those eyes on me..." she says as she rushes off toward the banquet bar. Hmm.
    ]
    "

rows.original:
While there's a lot of energy being bandied about on the dance floor, you don't feel up for it — maybe it isn't so bad to just kick back and let others have some fun. There's still a little while left to go before dusk, so you head on back, get yourself a glass of mirrorwine and take the opportunity to soak in the music and watch the couples go at it.
    
    [var0
        |Speaking of couples, for the briefest of moments you catch a flash of red on the dance floor. Following the movement, you have to stifle a snort at the sight of Azyrran dancing the male part, guiding a tomato-bright Liaden through simple steps and taking a surprisingly dominant stance; there's a little squeal of surprise from Liaden when she dips the paladin low to sneak a kiss at her collarbone, before another whirl and turn takes the duo out of sight once more.
    ]
    
    In a way, it's relaxing — if you weren't standing, you'd have dozed off long ago. The band has been going for smooth, flowing tunes this whole while, and it shows. You steadily lose track of the hours until the music's sudden absence jerks you back to wakefulness; you snap back to attention just in time to see the musicians finish with a flourish, bow, and take their leave of the ballroom with the last of the dancers.
    
    Outside in the gardens, the last of the folk dances is winding down with the setting sun, with the common folk slowly departing — some for their homes, others to continue the revelry in private. The hymnal appears to be one for the more devout, given how few of the Winter City's citizenry actually remain once the merriment's starting to wind down. With the ballroom being cleaned up, there's little for you but to follow the remaining elves out to the gardens for the last event of the day.
rows.translation:
虽然舞池里充满了热闹的气氛，但你却提不起兴致——或许，放松下来，让别人尽情享受欢乐，也不是坏事。距离黄昏还有些时间，于是你回到座位上，拿了一杯镜像酒，趁这个机会聆听音乐，欣赏那些情侣们的舞姿。
    
    [var0
        |说到情侣们，有那么一瞬间，你在舞池里瞥见了红色的身影。随着他们的动作，你不禁暗自发笑——阿兹兰竟然在扮演男方的角色，引导着皮肤白皙如番茄的莉娅登完成那些简单的舞步，而且表现得异常主动；当阿兹兰将莉娅登轻轻拉低，趁机在她锁骨处亲了一下时，莉娅登甚至发出了轻微的惊呼，随后两人又随着旋转的步伐消失在了视线之外。
    ]
    
    从某种角度来看，这种状态其实挺放松的——如果你没有站着的话，早就睡着了。整个过程中，乐队一直在演奏流畅、连贯的音乐，这一点显而易见。你会逐渐忘记时间流逝，直到音乐突然停止，才猛然惊醒；你刚好在音乐家们以华丽的演奏结束演出、鞠躬致意，然后与最后一批舞者一起离开舞厅的时候，才回过神来。
    
    在花园里，最后的民间舞蹈在夕阳的映照下渐渐落下帷幕，人们也陆续离去——有些人回家了，有些人则继续在私密场合享受欢乐。从留下来的人数量来看，这首赞美诗似乎是为那些更为虔诚的人们准备的，因为当庆祝活动开始接近尾声时，冬城的居民中实际上只剩下很少一部分人还在场。随着舞厅被清理干净，你只需跟随剩下的精灵们前往花园，参加当天最后的活动即可。

rows.original:
As you finish that last dance, the band slowly winds down the music and finishes with a flourish, the musicians standing, bowing, and taking their leave from the ballroom. Yeah, that last number had fewer takers than the others... but is it dusk already? Well, it is Winter Festivus and that means the days are short, but even so it feels too soon for the music to be over, far too soon. Still, as the last couples leave the dance floor, you find yourself drawn away with them, the palace staff hurrying over to pack away the last of the refreshments and furniture. Their job isn't done yet, far from it.
    
    Ah, it feels so melancholy when the festivities are slowly winding down... the day after a good party is always a bit of a wet blanket, but sorrow's the price one pays for joy.
    
    Outside in the gardens, the last of the folk dances is winding down with the setting sun, with the common folk slowly departing — some for their homes, others to continue the revelry in private. rows.translation:
当你完成最后一个舞蹈动作时，乐队缓缓减弱了音乐力度，以一段华丽的结尾结束了演出。乐手们站起身来，鞠了一躬，然后离开了舞厅。没错，最后一个舞蹈的参与者确实比其他舞蹈要少一些。…但现在已经黄昏了吗？嗯，现在是冬季庆典期间，这意味着白昼变得很短，不过即便如此，音乐就这样结束了，还是觉得太早了，实在太早了。不过，当最后一对情侣离开舞池时，你也不由自主地跟在他们后面离开了。宫殿的工作人员们则匆忙地收拾起剩下的点心和家具。他们的工作远未完成，还差得远呢。
    
    啊，当庆祝活动渐渐结束的时候，总会感到一阵忧郁……热闹的聚会过后第二天，总会有些让人心情低落，但悲伤，其实就是快乐所要付出的代价吧。
    
    在花园里，最后的民间舞蹈在夕阳的映照下渐渐落下帷幕，人们也陆续离去——有些人回家了，有些人则继续在私密场合享受欢乐。从留下来的人数量来看，这首赞美诗似乎是为那些更为虔诚的人们准备的，因为当庆祝活动开始减弱时，冬城的居民中其实只剩下很少一部分人留了下来。随着舞厅被清理干净，你只需跟随剩下的精灵们前往花园，参加当天最后的活动即可。
