rows.original: Just like the ballroom when you entered it for the dance, the gardens have changed considerably when you arrive once more, following the stream of people out onto the grass. The tree and statue of Lumia that were previously in the ballroom have been moved out by the fountain, all of the children's candles ablaze, and the golden four-pointed star that adorns the tree's top is ablaze with a fury that brightens the entirety of the rose gardens, doing away with the need for any other lighting. The stage that Ryn delivered her speech on now has several wooden stands laid out upon it, and taking the centerpiece are a sextet of elven valkyries, winged and resplendent in gold and white. They burst into song as the few — or at least, compared to the buffet and dance — partygoers who still remain take up seats upon the many benches in the gardens, quiet and composed compared to the day's earliest revelry. Out of the corner of your eye, you spy several palace staff and attendants gently but firmly refuse entry to a handful of inebriated revelers; that's probably for the best. The valkyries' voices... does being one do something to them, or are they just that well-trained for their singing to be so scintillating, so resonant, especially in these open gardens? Maybe both? You can't really tell, given that it's all in the pale elf native tongue, but even without being able to understand the lyrics the feeling you're getting from it all is nothing short of... well, divine. As the last of the elves take their seats for the hymnal, elves start to enter the stage from the hedges to the sides; ten, twenty, thirty, until there're no less than fifty elves raising their voices in praise of the Lady of Light, seamlessly joining the vocals the valkyries have set and swelling the singing to reach a crescendo. Yeah, you get the effect they were going for, and it's very pretty. As the choir finishes one hymn and starts on the next, the elves around you start joining in without any prompting — presumably this is one of those unspoken cultural things that you can only really learn by having been there. Maybe it's the atmosphere, maybe it's the sight of the valkyries, or maybe it's just the sound of so many elven voices joined in perfect unison — whatever the case, there's that sense of rapt wonderment there that's quite effective. The light glistening off the blossoms of the ice roses only makes the scene all the more poignant and dare you say it, mystical... "Ah, there you are, champion." Elthara's voice is barely above a whisper so as to not interrupt the singing, yet you hear it crystal-clear. "You appear to have arrived at the hymnal without any mishaps." Well, when in the Winter City, do as the pale elves do. It wasn't hard. "Nevertheless, I was worried. This year's arrangements were considerably more finicky than all the others I've dealt with so far, and wrangling valkyries is more tiring than one would think." Ah, so that's where she was during the dance. A pity, you'd have liked to see Elthara dance, or even invite her out to the floor yourself. "Ah, but my work is never done. Maybe next year, maybe next year. Well, a fair Festivus to you, [pc.name]. Let this day end peacefully under the light of the stars, slivers of light that they are to reflect the sun's tears." And with that, Elthara gives you a nod and moves off to address some other personage amidst the benches, leaving you with your thoughts. What are you going to do now? You could just lose yourself in the enchanting wonderment of the valkyrie-led choir and sing along with them even if you don't know the words. Then again, despite the blazing star by the statue's side, the hedges and bushes of the rose gardens do cast long, deep shadows, and the clear night sky so close to the crown of the world is rather romantic. If you wanted to sneak off and perhaps invite someone along with you... well, it'd be a little sacreligious to do that during the hymnal, but doesn't the forbidden nature of it all just make it all the more titillating? Well, what will you do? To note, though: if you do want to invite someone to sneak out into the gardens with you, the night is only long enough that you can do so once.
rows.translation: 就如同你走进舞厅准备跳舞时，当再次来到这里时，花园已经发生了巨大的变化——人们沿着小路走到了草地上。原本位于舞厅里的那棵树和卢米娅的雕像已经被移到了喷泉旁边，所有孩子们点燃的蜡烛都在闪烁着光芒，而装饰在树顶上的那颗金色四角星更是燃烧得格外旺盛，它的光芒照亮了整个玫瑰园，使得其他任何照明设施都变得多余了。 现在，小琳发表演讲的舞台上摆放着几张木制讲台，其中最显眼的是六位身披金白羽衣的精灵女武神。当她们开始歌唱时，那些还留在现场的宾客——与早些时候的狂欢场面相比，他们的数量已经少了很多——便在花园里的长椅上安静地坐了下来。你眼角余光瞥见，几名宫廷工作人员和侍从正温和而坚决地阻止一些喝得醉醺醺的狂欢者进入；这样或许反而是件好事。 这些女武神的声音……成为女武神这一身份真的对她们产生了什么影响，还是说她们只是因为接受了极其精湛的训练，才能让歌声如此动听、如此富有共鸣，尤其是在这些开阔的花园里？或许两者都有吧？其实很难说清楚，因为这些歌声都是用淡精灵的母语演唱的；不过，即使听不懂歌词，从这些声音中感受到的那种震撼，也确实可以说是……神圣的。 当最后一位精灵坐到位置上开始唱赞美诗时，其他精灵们也从树篱两侧陆续走上舞台；十个、二十个、三十个……最终，不少于五十位精灵一起高声赞美光明女神，他们的歌声与女武神们早已开始演唱的部分完美融合，共同将这首颂歌推向了高潮。 是的，他们想要达到的效果确实实现了，而且看起来非常漂亮。 当合唱团唱完一首赞美诗开始下一首时，你周围的精灵们也会不约而同地加入进来——想必这就是那种只有亲身经历过才能真正理解的文化现象吧。也许是因为那种氛围，也许是因为那些女武神的形象，又或许只是因为众多精灵的声音完美地融合在了一起——无论原因是什么，那种令人惊叹的感觉确实非常强烈。冰之玫瑰的花朵上闪烁着光芒，这使得整个场景显得更加令人动容，甚至可以说，充满了神秘感…… 啊，你来了，冠军。”艾尔萨拉的声音轻得几乎像耳语，这样就不会打扰到歌声的播放，但你的耳朵却能清晰地听到她的声音。“看来你顺利地到达了那首圣歌所在的地点。” 嗯，在冬城，就按照苍白精灵们的方式来做吧。其实并不难。 不过，我还是感到有些担心。今年的安排比我以往处理过的任何事情都要复杂得多，而与这些女武神打交道其实比想象中要耗费更多的精力。” 啊，原来她在跳舞的时候是在忙这些事情。真遗憾，你本来应该有机会看到艾尔萨拉跳舞的，甚至还可以亲自邀请她一起跳舞呢。 啊，不过我的工作永远做不完。也许明年吧，也许明年才能完成。嗯，祝你们节日快乐！[pc.name]让这一天在星星的光芒中平静地结束吧，那些星星的光芒，其实是在反射太阳的泪水。” 说完，艾尔萨拉向你点了点头，然后走开了，去与其他坐在长椅上的角色交谈，留下你独自沉浸在思绪之中。你现在打算做什么呢？即使你不认识那些歌词，也可以沉浸在由女武神领唱的合唱团所营造出的迷人氛围中，跟着他们一起歌唱。不过，尽管雕像旁边有一颗闪耀的星星，玫瑰园里的灌木丛确实会投下长长的阴影，而如此接近“世界之巅”的清澈夜空，也确实显得十分浪漫。如果你想偷偷溜走，然后邀请某个人一起……嗯，在唱赞美诗的时候这么做未免有点不敬神明，但这种被禁止的行为，不正是让这一切变得更加刺激吗？ 那么，你打算怎么做呢？不过需要注意的是：如果你确实想邀请某人和你一起偷偷溜到花园里去，那么这个夜晚的时间只够你们做这一次而已。

rows.original: While it might be fun to have a romp in the bushes, you really aren't into breaking the spirit of the whole event. Sing along with the valkyries and the rest of the choir, and that should bring the day's festivities to a close.
rows.translation: 虽然在灌木丛里嬉闹或许挺有趣，但你实在不想破坏整个活动的气氛。跟着女武神们和合唱团的其他成员一起唱吧，这样就能为当天的庆祝活动画上句号了。
rows.raw: "While it might be fun to have a romp in the bushes, you really aren't into breaking the spirit of the whole event. Sing along with the valkyries and the rest of the choir, and that should bring the day's festivities to a close."

rows.original: The poor girl's been under a lot of pressure today in her capacity as the face of the var Ridells. Why don't you help her relieve some of that stress and anxiety?
rows.translation: 这个可怜的女孩今天作为里德尔家族的代表人物，承受了巨大的压力。你为什么不帮她缓解一下这些压力和焦虑呢？
rows.raw: "The poor girl's been under a lot of pressure today in her capacity as the face of the var Ridells. Why don't you help her relieve some of that stress and anxiety?"

rows.original: As far as you're concerned, the Midwinter Festivus ball was a great success. While there's still the clean-up for her to do, this is the time to congratulate Elthara for a job well done in the most direct fashion.
rows.translation: 对你来说，冬季节日庆典确实取得了巨大的成功。虽然之后还有一系列清理工作需要她去完成，但现在正是以最直接的方式祝贺艾尔萨拉工作做得出色的时候。
rows.raw: "As far as you're concerned, the Midwinter Festivus ball was a great success. While there's still the clean-up for her to do, this is the time to congratulate Elthara for a job well done in the most direct fashion."

rows.original: Hethia's people have done a great job in both working to make the Winter Festivus ball a success, and conducting themselves gracefully for the day. You're sure that this is in no small part due to Hethia's perspective on the matter, and you ought to thank her directly.
rows.translation: 赫希娅的团队在确保冬季庆典活动圆满成功方面做得非常出色，同时他们在整个活动期间的表现也十分得体。你肯定知道，这在很大程度上要归功于赫希娅对这类事务的独到见解，因此你真的应该直接感谢她。
rows.raw: "Hethia's people have done a great job in both working to make the Winter Festivus ball a success, and conducting themselves gracefully for the day. You're sure that this is in no small part due to Hethia's perspective on the matter, and you ought to thank her directly."

rows.original: Tomorrow you'll have to go back to pretending to be enemies, but just for tonight... it wouldn't be bad to at least try and get her to change her perspective on things in the most personal and intimate fashion.
rows.translation: 明天你们又得装作是敌人了，但就今晚而已……至少试着以最亲密、最私人的方式让她改变对某些事情的看法，也没什么坏处吧。
rows.raw: "Tomorrow you'll have to go back to pretending to be enemies, but just for tonight... it wouldn't be bad to at least try and get her to change her perspective on things in the most personal and intimate fashion."

rows.original: You look around you at all the elves enraptured by the sight of divine glory arrayed before them, and smile. The Festivus spirit sure is strong, and let's face it, you don't have the heart to ruin it for everyone by sneaking off and getting up to some hanky-panky in the bushes, even if it's in a very small capacity. Raising your voice to join that of the elves', you follow along as best as you can — that the lyrics are foreign to you doesn't make a lick of difference when it's the emotions inspired that are the point of this whole affair. The light blazing down upon each and every person in the gardens — the valkyries, the choir, the people, you — it's intense and searing, yet warm and comforting all at once, a paradox unto itself, an impossibility made real through the sensation surging in your breast and perhaps just a little bit of divine providence. As the voices rise to their highest point in praise of the goddess of the sun, one of the valkyries steps out of the choir and lifts up her arms to either side of her. Wings spread, head raised to gaze upon the statue's beatific features, she stares unflinchingly right into the glorious, blinding light cast down upon all of the gardens and raises her voice in a single phrase. "Prisad vare solen!" The cry is quickly taken up by the rest of the elves on the benches, all of them rising to their feet to echo the words with fervent intensity as the choir continues to sing their hearts out — once, twice, thrice, the valkyrie cries out the same phrase in boer'alvarin, and you find yourself swept up and following along too, knowing exactly what the meaning is from the sheer strength of the sensation it inspires deep within you. Such wonderment, such strength, compressed in the space of a few moments — and when it passes, leaving you gloriously relieved. While you don't know how long the hymnal is intended to last, you'll keep on going for as long as your voice will hold out, such is the fascination the spectacle's able to evoke... you can see why Elthara had to spend the entire afternoon just getting the final touches for this in place. The food, the dancing... all that was just working towards this moment at the heart of Festivus; all the revelry was just window dressing for glorious praise of the Lady of Light. And yes, it indeed is glorious. You'll sleep well tonight...
rows.translation: 你环顾四周，看到所有精灵们都被眼前这神圣而壮观的景象所吸引，不禁露出了微笑。节日的气氛确实非常浓厚，而且说实话，你也没有心情为了自己偷偷躲到灌木丛里做些私事而破坏大家的兴致，哪怕只是些小事而已。你提高音量，试图跟上精灵们的歌声，尽你所能地跟着唱——对于你来说，这些歌词确实很陌生，但真正重要的是那些被歌声激发出来的情感。那光芒照耀着花园中的每一个人——那些女武神、合唱团成员，以及所有在场的人们。你 — 这种感觉既强烈而炽热，同时又温暖而令人舒适，仿佛是一种自相矛盾的现象，一种看似不可能却通过你胸中的那种澎湃感受而变得真实的存在，或许也有一点是神的安排。 当人们用最高的声音赞美太阳女神时，一位女武神走出了合唱队，将双臂向身体两侧伸展开来。她展开双翼，仰起头凝视着那座雕像那神圣而庄严的面容，坚定不移地注视着那道洒满整个花园的灿烂光芒，然后用一个短语高声说道。 全体士兵，准备行动！ 其他坐在长凳上的精灵们也迅速加入了这一呼喊，他们全都站了起来，满怀热情地重复着这些话语。当合唱团继续用他们全部的热情歌唱时——一次、两次、三次——这位女武神又一次用博尔阿尔瓦林语喊出了同样的句子，你也会不由自主地被这股力量所感染，跟着一起呼喊起来，因为这种力量在你内心深处激起的共鸣，让你清楚地理解了这些话语的含义。 如此令人惊叹的场景，如此强大的力量，都在短短的几分钟内被凝聚在一起——而当这一切过去后，你会感到无比的解脱与愉悦。虽然你不知道这场表演究竟会持续多久，但只要你的声音还能继续发出声音，你就会一直坚持下去，因为这种场面确实具有令人着迷的力量…… 你们现在应该明白，为什么艾尔萨拉要花整个下午的时间来完善这些细节了。那些食物、那些舞蹈……所有这些安排都是为了迎接仲冬节的这一刻；所有的庆祝活动其实都只是为了赞美那位光之女神而已。 的确，这一切都无比辉煌。今晚你一定会睡个好觉……

rows.original: For once today, Etheryn isn't the center of attention; all eyes — all open eyes, anyway — are locked on the valkyrie-led chorus at the center of the gardens. Instead, she stands off to the side of the stage, still dressed in her grandmother's finery [etheryn.crowned |and crown — it is still a ceremonial occasion, after all |and striking quite a regal figure despite not wearing a crown ]. Ryn's as enraptured by the valkyries as everyone else; she doesn't notice you until you sidle up next to her[etheryn.lowConfidence |, sparking a brief — and blessedly quiet — little squeak of surprise when she finally does sense your presence. Fortunately, though, it doesn't take much to calm her down, put a smile back on her face, and turn her back to the choir | and take her hand. She lets her eyes drift closed, dips her head slightly, and smiles before squeezing your hand back and turning to you in silent acknowledgment ]. For a long moment, the pair of you stand there in the light of Lumia's blazing glory and let her angels' song carry you away. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |Finally, you clear your throat and gesture toward the dark bushes. This is very pretty, but you'd like to spend some time with her, if that's all right. "O-oh." Ryn's gaze flicks nervously between the choir and the otherwise-occupied crowd before finally settling on you. "Umm... of c-course, [pc.name]. Th-this way." |Eventually, though, you come back to earth: there was a more specific reason you came over here. A gentle squeeze of Ryn's hand gets her attention, and quietly, you suggest spending time together somewhere else. She briefly scans the crowd to make sure nobody's looking at you, but nobody is; this is one of the few times today that the [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |princess regent ] will go unnoticed. "Okay, sure. I know a place. Follow me." |Another hand-squeeze brings your attention back to Ryn. "Hey," she whispers, barely loud enough for you to hear over a rising coloratura solo. Hey herself. She can't help but smile fondly at that. "Do... you maybe want to talk in private? Just the two of us?" There's nothing you'd like better. That turns her expression positively beatific — rather appropriately, under the circumstances. "Thank you. C'mon, this way." ] Blazing artificial daylight turns slowly to long twilit shadows as she leads you into the unoccupied parts of the garden. The pair of you sneak as unobtrusively as you can, rounding hedges and passing shrubberies to place more distance between you and the holy chorus. It's strange to see these places so empty after holding the thronging thousands of the morning and afternoon, but you don't blame the boreal elves: between the Lumian chorus and the undoubted revels continuing in the city itself, there's plenty else for them to do. The choir's angelic chimes slowly fade into the sound of the wind off the glacial plateau as the pair of you keep walking into the hedge maze, past intricately-trimmed designs and under arched trellises. Through one of those trellises, you spy a cozy little clearing in the maze, butting up against the walls of the palace near the edge of the plateau — it's not too far away from the place where you infiltrated the castle, as a matter of fact. The roses look particularly pretty in the clearing, growing and swirling around a little bench in the middle. You start toward the bench, but Ryn stops you short underneath one of the trellises. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"U-um, [pc.name] ... d-do you, um, do you n-notice anything on the... um... on the arch?" |"Notice anything up there, [pc.name]?" ] Hmm? White-painted wood, carved in a flowing arch — typical elegant boreal elf stuff, kind of reminiscent of the Frostwood — and little sprigs of some kind of white-berried plant all over it... A[etheryn.lowConfidence |n anxious ] tug on your arm, a cough at your ear, and you look back [pc.heightRange 70 |down |over ] at Ryn. "D[etheryn.lowConfidence |-d ]o you know what [etheryn.lowConfidence |p- ]plant that is?" she asks[etheryn.lowConfidence | hopefully ]. [pc.bgMulti hunter acolyte |Yeah, it's mistletoe — you know it's poisonous, at least a little bit, but it's not much use other than that. Why, is there something else...? [etheryn.lowConfidence |"W-well," she stammers, "i-in the W-Winter City, w-we... th-there's a th-thing p-people do... if you w-walk underneath m-mistletoe, you're suh-supposed to... to..." To what? Kiss? Ryn nods furiously. |"Well," she giggles, "for us, there's a romantic tradition during Festivus that dates back to the druids. If you find someone underneath mistletoe, you're supposed to kiss." ] |Hey, that's mistletoe! You don't know about northern Lumians, but southern Lumians sometimes see it as a symbol of fertility — white berries and all that. Wh... waaaaiiiitttt a second... [etheryn.lowConfidence |"Y-yes," she agrees, "b-but not... just fertility." You lean closer to her. Oh? Is there something else that people do with mistletoe in the Winter City? Maybe something... romantic? Ryn nods shyly. "Y-you're suh... supposed to kiss..." |"Fertility, yes," she agrees, eyes fairly glowing, "but there's an older tradition from the druids. Mistletoe sprigs are a symbol of romantic love, and if you find a boreal elf underneath mistletoe, you're supposed to kiss." ] |You're not sure. You might've seen a few of them before in the Frostwood, but you don't know much about them... [etheryn.lowConfidence |"They, um. They're m-mistletoe," she mumbles. "During F-Festivus... if you see s-someone underneath it... you're suh... you're supposed to..." Do what? You lean in. Maybe something romantic? Ryn nods shyly. "You're s-supposed to k-kiss..." |"Those little white berries mean it's mistletoe," she explains, grinning from ear to ear. "And ever since the time of the druids, if you find someone underneath mistletoe during Festivus, you're supposed to kiss..." ] ] [etheryn.lowConfidence |Well, that you can do. With both hands, you take hold of the nervous, quivering elf and gently pull her into a long kiss, long enough for her to relax and melt into your arms from sheer joy. When you separate, her hand flies to her chest. "[pc.name]... I..." You liked that boreal elven tradition quite a lot. Poor Ryn's face has gone from a soft lavender to furious beet red; she can't even form proper words anymore. "I — I —" There, there. How about the two of you take a seat on that bench over there? She looks like she needs a rest. "Th-thank you..." |She doesn't wait for you to answer, instead pulling you[pc.heightRange 70 | down ] into a long, heartfelt smooch, a moment of impossible closeness that the pair of you extend for as long as you possibly can. You reopen your eyes to starlight blue, reflected off the glittering ice-roses on the hedges surrounding you, and, even more enticingly, off of Ryn's wet, adoring sapphire orbs. W-wow. [silly |"I'm so glad my Festivus wish came true," she murmurs. "Lumia really heard me... because underneath the mistletoe I found you." |"Yeah," she murmurs. "Wow." ] [etheryn.highConfidence |So, when she said she wanted to talk in private... "It's the traditional lover's corner in the gardens," Ryn giggles. "Surrounded by beautiful, glittering ice roses, with mistletoe on the trellises... couples have been ducking in here all day, but now that the hymns have started and everybody else has gone home, we — my lover and I — we have it all to ourselves." Her eyes twinkle. "Do you want to see what the bench is for? There's more mistletoe over there..." |She knew a spot, huh? Seems pretty romantic, what with the mistletoe and the seclusion and all. Your elven companion giggles shyly. "Mmaayyybe." Her suddenly-furtive eyes dart away, then return to you. "Let's... let's go over to the bench." ] ] [etheryn.lowConfidence |Ryn sighs as you guide her over to the bench, still overwhelmed by the kiss. It takes her a long time to finally speak, time you use effectively to hold the sweet thing close and calm her nerves beneath the starlight. Far above you, milky, colorful lights hang in the sky like an enormous tapestry. Finally, your companion stirs. "Oh, [pc.name]," she says tiredly, "th-that was... goddess, th-that was one of the h-hardest days of m-my whole l-life." You lean into her, humming gently as you give her ears a nice little rub. It's almost over. Soon she'll be able to go back inside and not have to deal with so many people again. She can just be someplace where she can relax. Relaxation is the furthest thing from the elven monarch's mind as she anxiously pulls herself into a side-hug with you. "I — I j-just... I..." Hey, it's okay. Being in charge of lots of people is overwhelming, no matter who you are. But she did it. She did great. Everybody here enjoyed themselves, you most of all. [flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN |And you distinctly remember her having an awful lot of fun on the dance floor with you, too... |People have been praising her all day, as you recall, but the thing is: the ball was good enough to earn that praise. ] At this, Ryn gloms onto you with both arms, burying her head in your shoulder. "It... it w-was," she admits. "It w-was one of the b-best thi-things to ever h-happen to me..." There, there. You keep rubbing her ears. She's just had a day leaning awfully far toward eventful. What she needs is a way to relieve all that tension knotted up inside her. How would she like you to give her a nice backrub? Get all those kinks worked out of her system so she can sleep soundly tonight? It so happens that you managed to secrete an ampoule of rubbing oil on your person... |Ryn's grinning from ear to elven ear as the pair of you settle onto the bench, letting go of your hand only to grab the other side of your waist to pull you in close. You do the same, then lean back together against the chilly bench, eyes roving around the expanse of glittering northern stars. Long, wispy lines, like chasms in the sky, trace a streaming path through the heavens from left to right, as if emanating from the recently-set sun. Chasms, perhaps, or maybe curtains: a beautiful, glowing tapestry in the sky knit by the gods themselves. "Our aurora," Ryn murmurs. "It's the perfect time of year and the perfect place to see it, [pc.name].[silly | Although one time it showed up in the palace kitchens. Elthara never believed me, but it's true! ] I want to think... I think it's Lumia's blessing on our celebrations. Maybe this is a sign that everything's turning around. That even if we still have a lot of work to do, at least we're on the right track..." You think that that's exactly where the elves are, and they owe so much of it to her. She projects confidence like a proper queen. Her mingling, her speech[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN|, even her dance moves] — she's just the presence that her people need to lead them right now. [etheryn.highConfidence |She giggles. "You're very sweet.[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN| And a[pc.bg noblescion courtesan | really ] good dancer yourself! ] And... well." Her words carry enough warmth on their own to make the chill winter air feel like nothing at all. "You know how I feel about you." |She looks [pc.heightRange 70 |up |over ] at you and smiles. "Thank you. Whenever I felt like I was flagging today, I thought about you. You're the example that helps me be better... and I'm glad I was able to live up to you today." ] Wordlessly, the two of you cuddle under the stars, gazing into the infinite firmament as the aurora slowly dances across the sky. It's cloudless here and cold, with just a hint of winter breeze, but each point of light twinkles with a warmth that you see rather than feel. Ryn hums a few notes of elfsong, bars of one of the hymns you overheard before leaving, and the two of you gently rock back and forth in time to her music. You sway from side to side, just enjoying each other's presence, until your idyll is abruptly broken by a grunt of pain. Ryn grimaces, shifting her hand to her back. "Ugh... that hurt." She probably feels pretty tense after that long day, huh? You can only imagine how much pressure the star of the show was under. Stress relief will be the name of the game here, and fortunately, you snuck an ampoule of oil along for just such an eventuality. How does a backrub sound to her? ] Convincing Ryn to assent [etheryn.highLibido |doesn't take much; she's more than accustomed to your touch, after all, and almost totally unconcerned about being discovered by a phantom passerby |takes a little effort, but eventually you do manage to persuade her that no, no one will wander through her and catch her getting a massage ]. What's more troublesome is removing her ceremonial cloak, getting her into your lap, and undoing enough of her dress to allow you to work. After fumbling with laces and ties and clasps, though, the pair of you eventually get it open enough to reveal the whole of her back. Nobody would ever have accused the elven waif of having the muscles of an orc or minotaur, but that isn't to say that long decades of archery had no effect at all. Ryn's upper body is lean but strong under her lavender skin, fit for running one's hands through the dimples and crevices just to feel. Of course, just feeling isn't enough, and you duly retrieve the oil to begin your task. Your hands find knot after knot in Ryn's back, and you work assiduously to excise them. A firm press inside each little bundle of nerves makes your elven lover gasp; each gasp slowly draws itself out into a long, sustained exhalation when you switch to rubbing all around the tense spots to loosen her up. [var0 |You and she are old hands at these sorts of monarchical massages, after all, and while the knots don't always show up in the same places, you're quite familiar with relieving Ryn's tension no matter where it pops up. |You've never quite done anything like this with her before, but it's easy to see how much she likes it. [etheryn.lowConfidence |The poor thing could definitely use a lot of helpful, nonthreatening intimate touching in her life. |Ryn's long past the point where she'd be too shy to easily accept intimate touching, but that burden's been replaced by the no-less-stressful one of leadership. Either way, you're happy to relieve her of it, at least for an evening. ] ] Rubbing and kneading, you work gradually from neck down, easily gliding across Ryn's skin thanks to your oil. Each little bundle of nerves gets its own special treatment before you move on to the next. Her lower back is the toughest, necessitating a bit of a position change, but eventually, you make it work, rubbing lower and lower until you're right up against Ryn's [etheryn.butt]. One set of frustrating back kinks eradicated! Although, come to think of it, there's no reason to stop there, and [etheryn.isCaged |after a whole day without you, Ryn's probably dying for a different kind of relief... |[pc.hasVag |besides, you're sure Lumia, most divine of mothers, would heartily approve of some breeding on this holy night. |even without the cage, you know Ryn's happy to relieve her urges with you. ] ] [etheryn.libidoRange 50 |"Mmmf," she moans, "I... I really do need it, [pc.name]... and I don't care who sees me.[etheryn.highLibido | F-fuck, it'd be even hotter if we were closer to everybody else... ]" Her lust-clouded sapphire eyes meet yours over her shoulder. "Help me the rest of the way out of this dress so I'm all ready for you." |[etheryn.lowConfidence |"S-sex? Y-you w-want me... n-naked? Out h-here?" She swallows hard, looking around at the impassive hedges like a cornered animal. "If th-that's what y-you want, [pc.name]." |"Well," she says, ears wobbling, "I [etheryn.highConfidence |want you so badly |do want it ], but with this dress on, I'd need to take all my clothes off... out here in the open..." There's nobody around, though. Everybody's all very distracted. What are the chances that somebody will tear themselves away from the hymns long enough to wander the hedge maze and find the [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |regent of the Winter City ] in flagrante delicto with her own Champion? "Nnnn," she groans, biting her lip. "Okay. You're right — but now you have to finish helping me out of this dress." ] ]

rows.raw: ' For once today, Etheryn isn't the center of attention; all eyes — all open eyes, anyway — are locked on the valkyrie-led chorus at the center of the gardens. Instead, she stands off to the side of the stage, still dressed in her grandmother's finery [etheryn.crowned |and crown — it is still a ceremonial occasion, after all |and striking quite a regal figure despite not wearing a crown ]. Ryn's as enraptured by the valkyries as everyone else; she doesn't notice you until you sidle up next to her[etheryn.lowConfidence |, sparking a brief — and blessedly quiet — little squeak of surprise when she finally does sense your presence. Fortunately, though, it doesn't take much to calm her down, put a smile back on her face, and turn her back to the choir | and take her hand. She lets her eyes drift closed, dips her head slightly, and smiles before squeezing your hand back and turning to you in silent acknowledgment ]. For a long moment, the pair of you stand there in the light of Lumia's blazing glory and let her angels' song carry you away. [etheryn.lnhConfidence |Finally, you clear your throat and gesture toward the dark bushes. This is very pretty, but you'd like to spend some time with her, if that's all right. "O-oh." Ryn's gaze flicks nervously between the choir and the otherwise-occupied crowd before finally settling on you. "Umm... of c-course, [pc.name]. Th-this way." |Eventually, though, you come back to earth: there was a more specific reason you came over here. A gentle squeeze of Ryn's hand gets her attention, and quietly, you suggest spending time together somewhere else. She briefly scans the crowd to make sure nobody's looking at you, but nobody is; this is one of the few times today that the [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |princess regent ] will go unnoticed. "Okay, sure. I know a place. Follow me." |Another hand-squeeze brings your attention back to Ryn. "Hey," she whispers, barely loud enough for you to hear over a rising coloratura solo. Hey herself. She can't help but smile fondly at that. "Do... you maybe want to talk in private? Just the two of us?" There's nothing you'd like better. That turns her expression positively beatific — rather appropriately, under the circumstances. "Thank you. C'mon, this way." ] Blazing artificial daylight turns slowly to long twilit shadows as she leads you into the unoccupied parts of the garden. The pair of you sneak as unobtrusively as you can, rounding hedges and passing shrubberies to place more distance between you and the holy chorus. It's strange to see these places so empty after holding the thronging thousands of the morning and afternoon, but you don't blame the boreal elves: between the Lumian chorus and the undoubted revels continuing in the city itself, there's plenty else for them to do. The choir's angelic chimes slowly fade into the sound of the wind off the glacial plateau as the pair of you keep walking into the hedge maze, past intricately-trimmed designs and under arched trellises. Through one of those trellises, you spy a cozy little clearing in the maze, butting up against the walls of the palace near the edge of the plateau — it's not too far away from the place where you infiltrated the castle, as a matter of fact. The roses look particularly pretty in the clearing, growing and swirling around a little bench in the middle. You start toward the bench, but Ryn stops you short underneath one of the trellises. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"U-um, [pc.name] ... d-do you, um, do you n-notice anything on the... um... on the arch?" |"Notice anything up there, [pc.name]?" ] Hmm? White-painted wood, carved in a flowing arch — typical elegant boreal elf stuff, kind of reminiscent of the Frostwood — and little sprigs of some kind of white-berried plant all over it... A[etheryn.lowConfidence |n anxious ] tug on your arm, a cough at your ear, and you look back [pc.heightRange 70 |down |over ] at Ryn. "D[etheryn.lowConfidence |-d ]o you know what [etheryn.lowConfidence |p- ]plant that is?" she asks[etheryn.lowConfidence | hopefully ]. [pc.bgMulti hunter acolyte |Yeah, it's mistletoe — you know it's poisonous, at least a little bit, but it's not much use other than that. Why, is there something else...? [etheryn.lowConfidence |"W-well," she stammers, "i-in the W-Winter City, w-we... th-there's a th-thing p-people do... if you w-walk underneath m-mistletoe, you're suh-supposed to... to..." To what? Kiss? Ryn nods furiously. |"Well," she giggles, "for us, there's a romantic tradition during Festivus that dates back to the druids. If you find someone underneath mistletoe, you're supposed to kiss." ] |Hey, that's mistletoe! You don't know about northern Lumians, but southern Lumians sometimes see it as a symbol of fertility — white berries and all that. Wh... waaaaiiiitttt a second... [etheryn.lowConfidence |"Y-yes," she agrees, "b-but not... just fertility." You lean closer to her. Oh? Is there something else that people do with mistletoe in the Winter City? Maybe something... romantic? Ryn nods shyly. "Y-you're suh... supposed to kiss..." |"Fertility, yes," she agrees, eyes fairly glowing, "but there's an older tradition from the druids. Mistletoe sprigs are a symbol of romantic love, and if you find a boreal elf underneath mistletoe, you're supposed to kiss." ] |You're not sure. You might've seen a few of them before in the Frostwood, but you don't know much about them... [etheryn.lowConfidence |"They, um. They're m-mistletoe," she mumbles. "During F-Festivus... if you see s-someone underneath it... you're suh... you're supposed to..." Do what? You lean in. Maybe something romantic? Ryn nods shyly. "You're s-supposed to k-kiss..." |"Those little white berries mean it's mistletoe," she explains, grinning from ear to ear. "And ever since the time of the druids, if you find someone underneath mistletoe during Festivus, you're supposed to kiss..." ] ] [etheryn.lowConfidence |Well, that you can do. With both hands, you take hold of the nervous, quivering elf and gently pull her into a long kiss, long enough for her to relax and melt into your arms from sheer joy. When you separate, her hand flies to her chest. "[pc.name]... I..." You liked that boreal elven tradition quite a lot. Poor Ryn's face has gone from a soft lavender to furious beet red; she can't even form proper words anymore. "I — I —" There, there. How about the two of you take a seat on that bench over there? She looks like she needs a rest. "Th-thank you..." |She doesn't wait for you to answer, instead pulling you[pc.heightRange 70 | down ] into a long, heartfelt smooch, a moment of impossible closeness that the pair of you extend for as long as you possibly can. You reopen your eyes to starlight blue, reflected off the glittering ice-roses on the hedges surrounding you, and, even more enticingly, off of Ryn's wet, adoring sapphire orbs. W-wow. [silly |"I'm so glad my Festivus wish came true," she murmurs. "Lumia really heard me... because underneath the mistletoe I found you." |"Yeah," she murmurs. "Wow." ] [etheryn.highConfidence |So, when she said she wanted to talk in private... "It's the traditional lover's corner in the gardens," Ryn giggles. "Surrounded by beautiful, glittering ice roses, with mistletoe on the trellises... couples have been ducking in here all day, but now that the hymns have started and everybody else has gone home, we — my lover and I — we have it all to ourselves." Her eyes twinkle. "Do you want to see what the bench is for? There's more mistletoe over there..." |She knew a spot, huh? Seems pretty romantic, what with the mistletoe and the seclusion and all. Your elven companion giggles shyly. "Mmaayyybe." Her suddenly-furtive eyes dart away, then return to you. "Let's... let's go over to the bench." ] ] [etheryn.lowConfidence |Ryn sighs as you guide her over to the bench, still overwhelmed by the kiss. It takes her a long time to finally speak, time you use effectively to hold the sweet thing close and calm her nerves beneath the starlight. Far above you, milky, colorful lights hang in the sky like an enormous tapestry. Finally, your companion stirs. "Oh, [pc.name]," she says tiredly, "th-that was... goddess, th-that was one of the h-hardest days of m-my whole l-life." You lean into her, humming gently as you give her ears a nice little rub. It's almost over. Soon she'll be able to go back inside and not have to deal with so many people again. She can just be someplace where she can relax. Relaxation is the furthest thing from the elven monarch's mind as she anxiously pulls herself into a side-hug with you. "I — I j-just... I..." Hey, it's okay. Being in charge of lots of people is overwhelming, no matter who you are. But she did it. She did great. Everybody here enjoyed themselves, you most of all. [flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN |And you distinctly remember her having an awful lot of fun on the dance floor with you, too... |People have been praising her all day, as you recall, but the thing is: the ball was good enough to earn that praise. ] At this, Ryn gloms onto you with both arms, burying her head in your shoulder. "It... it w-was," she admits. "It w-was one of the b-best thi-things to ever h-happen to me..." There, there. You keep rubbing her ears. She's just had a day leaning awfully far toward eventful. What she needs is a way to relieve all that tension knotted up inside her. How would she like you to give her a nice backrub? Get all those kinks worked out of her system so she can sleep soundly tonight? It so happens that you managed to secrete an ampoule of rubbing oil on your person... |Ryn's grinning from ear to elven ear as the pair of you settle onto the bench, letting go of your hand only to grab the other side of your waist to pull you in close. You do the same, then lean back together against the chilly bench, eyes roving around the expanse of glittering northern stars. Long, wispy lines, like chasms in the sky, trace a streaming path through the heavens from left to right, as if emanating from the recently-set sun. Chasms, perhaps, or maybe curtains: a beautiful, glowing tapestry in the sky knit by the gods themselves. "Our aurora," Ryn murmurs. "It's the perfect time of year and the perfect place to see it, [pc.name].[silly | Although one time it showed up in the palace kitchens. Elthara never believed me, but it's true! ] I want to think... I think it's Lumia's blessing on our celebrations. Maybe this is a sign that everything's turning around. That even if we still have a lot of work to do, at least we're on the right track..." You think that that's exactly where the elves are, and they owe so much of it to her. She projects confidence like a proper queen. Her mingling, her speech[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN|, even her dance moves] — she's just the presence that her people need to lead them right now. [etheryn.highConfidence |She giggles. "You're very sweet.[flags.WC_BALL_DANCE_RYN| And a[pc.bg noblescion courtesan | really ] good dancer yourself! ] And... well." Her words carry enough warmth on their own to make the chill winter air feel like nothing at all. "You know how I feel about you." |She looks [pc.heightRange 70 |up |over ] at you and smiles. "Thank you. Whenever I felt like I was flagging today, I thought about you. You're the example that helps me be better... and I'm glad I was able to live up to you today." ] Wordlessly, the two of you cuddle under the stars, gazing into the infinite firmament as the aurora slowly dances across the sky. It's cloudless here and cold, with just a hint of winter breeze, but each point of light twinkles with a warmth that you see rather than feel. Ryn hums a few notes of elfsong, bars of one of the hymns you overheard before leaving, and the two of you gently rock back and forth in time to her music. You sway from side to side, just enjoying each other's presence, until your idyll is abruptly broken by a grunt of pain. Ryn grimaces, shifting her hand to her back. "Ugh... that hurt." She probably feels pretty tense after that long day, huh? You can only imagine how much pressure the star of the show was under. Stress relief will be the name of the game here, and fortunately, you snuck an ampoule of oil along for just such an eventuality. How does a backrub sound to her? ] Convincing Ryn to assent [etheryn.highLibido |doesn't take much; she's more than accustomed to your touch, after all, and almost totally unconcerned about being discovered by a phantom passerby |takes a little effort, but eventually you do manage to persuade her that no, no one will wander through her and catch her getting a massage ]. What's more troublesome is removing her ceremonial cloak, getting her into your lap, and undoing enough of her dress to allow you to work. After fumbling with laces and ties and clasps, though, the pair of you eventually get it open enough to reveal the whole of her back. Nobody would ever have accused the elven waif of having the muscles of an orc or minotaur, but that isn't to say that long decades of archery had no effect at all. Ryn's upper body is lean but strong under her lavender skin, fit for running one's hands through the dimples and crevices just to feel. Of course, just feeling isn't enough, and you duly retrieve the oil to begin your task. Your hands find knot after knot in Ryn's back, and you work assiduously to excise them. A firm press inside each little bundle of nerves makes your elven lover gasp; each gasp slowly draws itself out into a long, sustained exhalation when you switch to rubbing all around the tense spots to loosen her up. [var0 |You and she are old hands at these sorts of monarchical massages, after all, and while the knots don't always show up in the same places, you're quite familiar with relieving Ryn's tension no matter where it pops up. |You've never quite done anything like this with her before, but it's easy to see how much she likes it. [etheryn.lowConfidence |The poor thing could definitely use a lot of helpful, nonthreatening intimate touching in her life. |Ryn's long past the point where she'd be too shy to easily accept intimate touching, but that burden's been replaced by the no-less-stressful one of leadership. Each little bundle of nerves gets its own special treatment before you move on to the next. Her lower back is the toughest, necessitating a bit of a position change, but eventually, you make it work, rubbing lower and lower until you're right up against Ryn's [etheryn.butt]. One set of frustrating back kinks eradicated! Although, come to think of it, there's no reason to stop there, and [etheryn.isCaged |after a whole day without you, Ryn's probably dying for a different kind of relief... |[pc.hasVag |besides, you're sure Lumia, most divine of mothers, would heartily approve of some breeding on this holy night. |even without the cage, you know Ryn's happy to relieve her urges with you. ] ] [etheryn.libidoRange 50 |"Mmmf," she moans, "I... I really do need it, [pc.name]... and I don't care who sees me.[etheryn.highLibido | F-fuck, it'd be even hotter if we were closer to everybody else... ]" Her lust-clouded sapphire eyes meet yours over her shoulder. "Help me the rest of the way out of this dress so I'm all ready for you." |[etheryn.lowConfidence |"S-sex? Y-you w-want me... n-naked? Out h-here?" She swallows hard, looking around at the impassive hedges like a cornered animal. "If th-that's what y-you want, [pc.name]." |"Well," she says, ears wobbling, "I [etheryn.highConfidence |want you so badly |do want it ], but with this dress on, I'd need to take all my clothes off... out here in the open..." There's nobody around, though. Everybody's all very distracted. What are the chances that somebody will tear themselves away from the hymns long enough to wander the hedge maze and find the [etheryn.crowned |elvenqueen |regent of the Winter City ] in flagrante delicto with her own Champion? rows.original: When the pair of you finally recover, you reluctantly set to work cleaning, your task thankfully illuminated by starlight and auroral glow. Fortunately, the wealthier partygoers were somewhat unconcerned with their personal belongings and other detritus, and it doesn't take long for the pair of you to locate a discarded cloak to use as a cumrag — although you hesitate to use it until Ryn [etheryn.lowConfidence | abashedly ] assures you that it'll be well laundered and hopefully returned to its owner after the festivities. You wipe away the sweat first of all, still concerned about the frigid night air, then set to work on the seed splattered around your little hideaway. After that, more to keep warm than out of a sense of propriety, the pair of you dress yourselves properly again, thankful that your[flags.RYN_MARKET | formal ] outfit and Ryn's grandmother's dress made it through without damage. At the end, you relax on the bench, here beneath the stars at the top of the world, cuddling together for warmth underneath the royal ceremonial cape. Ryn [etheryn.lnhConfidence |quietly snuggles into your side, wordlessly staring up into endless glittering space, free of panic and worry for a moment, at least. You don't mind. A silent Festivus night, broken only by faint notes of angelsong on the wind, with [etheryn.crowned |the elvenqueen |a princess ] at your side... it's a fine way for the both of you to take it easy after your long night and day. |keeps up a quiet conversation with you, pointing out the shining northern constellations and the gentle curves of the boreal aurora. As always, she's anxious to share what she knows about her people with a friend, and spins tales of how the druidic star-signs were changed into Lumian ones, of how much has changed and how much stayed the same. It's interesting to compare them to the ones further south... but also increasingly abstract, and as much as you try to stay awake, you and Ryn both find yourselves slowly drifting off. |happily snuggles into your side, exchanging kisses and giggles with you under the mistletoe like a teenager. Underneath Queen Atheldred's heavy cloak, you can, if not ignore the cold, at least stay out in the garden for much longer than you otherwise would. [var0|And much like Ryn's star-crossed grandmothers must've done so long ago,|With its warmth to keep away the wintry breeze,] you and she repose in sensual idleness together, [pc.raMulti elf kitsune lupine |gently stroking each other's ears |trading ear-rubs for headpats |trading ear-rubs for pets |trading ear-rubs for hugs ] and whiling the time away under the endless dance of the Northern Lights. ] Eventually, though, the cold starts to creep in, forcing your teeth together in a full-on chatter. Anxiously, Ryn rubs you a few times for warmth, then sighs. "It's... it's probably best if we get you indoors, [pc.name]. There's still a lot of night to go, and [etheryn.lowConfidence |p-people w-will notice if I m-miss it |I need to put in an appearance for at least some of it ]." That's too bad, but you understand. You'll just see if you can find your way to your room in the palace. Hopefully you make it there in one piece. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"Y-yeah," she says nervously. "I h-hope so." It was a joke, Ryn. You'll be fine. This was all very sweet — you enjoyed your Festivus gift from her quite a lot. "W-well, th-there's also s-something else," the shy elf mumbles. "Y-you'll see tomorrow. But also... th-thank you, [pc.name]. This was... this was the b-best Festivus I've ever h-had." You bid Ryn a tired goodnight and a fair Festivus and struggle to your feet. Now, which way were the palace doors again? |"I would commit to sending out a search party," she says wryly, "but instead I'll just walk you to the doors. The guards can help you get where you need to go." Well, that's very sweet of her — as was your gift. It made your Festivus very fair indeed.[silly | You might say it was a miracle — a Festivus miracle. "It is the season for wishing," Ryn laughs. And this year you found somebody special and you're... "Thaaaanking you! For all the joy! And makin' this, whooooooaaaaaa..." Ryn trails off, stifles her laughter, and coughs, shaking her head in mock seriousness. "Okay, let's stop milking that for now." Fine, fine. If you must. This was still the bestest present you could get without a bow. ] Ryn smiles. "Well, there's something else — you'll see tomorrow, after you get some rest. But also..." She comes in to squeeze you with one last hug[etheryn.highConfidence | and kiss ]. "That was [silly |the best Festivus ever — 'cause I found you. |the best Festivus I've ever had. Out of anyone in the whole world... I'm glad I got to spend it with you. ]" ]
rows.translation: 当你们俩终于缓过劲来，才不情不愿地开始收拾起来。幸好有星光和极光的微光照着，这活儿才不至于看不清。那些比较有钱的宾客似乎不太在意自己的随身物品和杂物，所以你们没花多久就找到一件被丢弃的斗篷，可以用来当擦精液的抹布——不过你还是有点犹豫，直到小琳[etheryn.lowConfidence | 羞愧地 ]向你保证，它会被好好洗干净，活动结束后多半还能还给它的主人。你首先把汗水擦掉，虽然还是担心夜里的寒气，然后才开始清理溅在你们那小藏身处周围的精液。之后，与其说是讲究体面，不如说更多是为了保暖，你们俩又重新穿戴整齐，庆幸你的[flags.RYN_MARKET | 正式的 ]那身正装和小琳祖母的裙子都完好无损。 最后，你们放松地靠在长椅上，就在这世界之巅的星空之下，裹着那件皇家礼袍依偎着取暖。小琳[etheryn.lnhConfidence |静静地依偎在你身侧，一言不发地凝望着无尽的闪烁星空，至少在这一刻，她不再惊慌，也不再担忧。你并不介意。一个寂静的仲冬节之夜，只有风中隐约的天使歌声打破宁静，而[etheryn.crowned |精灵女王 |一位公主 ]就在你身边……对你们俩来说，这是在这一天一夜的漫长奔波之后放松身心的好办法。 |她和你轻声交谈，指点着北方那些闪亮的星座和北极光柔和的弧线。她一如既往地渴望与朋友分享自己族群的知识，讲述德鲁伊的星象如何被改成了卢米亚人的星象，讲述有多少东西变了、又有多少依旧如故。把它们和更南方的星象作比较确实很有意思……但也越来越抽象，无论你怎样努力保持清醒，你和小琳都发现自己渐渐迷糊起来。 |开心地依偎在你身侧，像个少女一样在槲寄生下和你亲吻、嬉笑。在阿塞尔德雷德女王厚重的斗篷下，就算你无法完全无视寒冷，至少也能在花园里待得比平时久得多。 [var0|就像小琳那对命运多舛的祖母们很久以前一定做过的那样，|借着它的温暖挡住冬日的寒风，]你和她一起沉浸在慵懒的缠绵中， [pc.raMulti elf kitsune lupine |轻轻揉着彼此的耳朵 |用揉耳朵换摸头 |用揉耳朵换抚摸 |用揉耳朵换拥抱 ]在北极光无尽的舞动之下消磨着时光。 ] 然而，寒冷最终还是悄悄钻了进来，让你的牙齿不由自主地打颤。小琳焦急地替你揉了几下取暖，然后叹了口气。“我们……最好还是把你送回室内去，[pc.name]。夜还长着呢，而且[etheryn.lowConfidence |要-要是我不露面，别-别人肯定会注意到的 |至少也得露个面才行 ]。” 那就太可惜了，不过你能理解。你只能自己想办法找到回宫殿房间的路。希望你一路平安。 [etheryn.lowConfidence |“嗯，是的，”她紧张地说，“希-希望如此。” 这只是个玩笑，小琳。你会没事的。刚才那一切真的很温馨——她送你的仲冬节礼物你相当喜欢。 “嗯，其-其实还有别的……”害羞的精灵咕哝道，“明天你就知道了。不过……也谢谢你，[pc.name]。这真是……这是我过得最棒的仲冬节了。” 你向小琳道了声疲惫的晚安，祝她仲冬节快乐，然后挣扎着站了起来。话说回来，宫殿大门在哪个方向来着？ |“我本来可以派人出去搜救的，”她揶揄地说，“不过还是算了，我干脆送你们到门口吧。守卫会帮你们找到该去的地方。” 嗯，她人真好——你的礼物也是。它让你的仲冬节过得格外美好。[silly | 你或许可以说这是个奇迹——一个仲冬节奇迹。 “这确实是许愿的时节，”小琳笑着说。 “而今年，你找到了一个特别的人，你……” “太——感谢你了！感谢你带来的所有欢乐！还有让这一切成真，哇哦哦哦哦……”小琳声音渐弱，憋住笑，咳了几声，假装严肃地摇摇头。“好吧，这个话题就先到这儿吧。” 好吧，好吧。既然你非要这样。这依然是你收到的最棒的礼物，连蝴蝶结都不用拆。 ] 小琳笑了。“嗯，还有一件事——等你休息好了，明天就知道了。不过……”她上前来，最后紧紧抱了你一下[etheryn.highConfidence | 还亲了你一口 ]。“那真是[silly |有史以来最棒的仲冬节——因为我找到了你。 |这是我过得最棒的仲冬节。全世界那么多人里……我很高兴能和你一起度过。 ]” ]

rows.original: Leaving your seat inconspicuously isn't hard — the elves present at the hymnal are completely enraptured by all the singing and the soft glowing light from statue and tree alike. A couple of the guards by the entrance to the rose gardens give you funny looks, but don't question you when you act in the most casual tone you can muster just where the druidic delegation is at the moment. As it turns out, they're not too far away, helping the palace staff with packing up the remnants of the day's festivities in the rest of the gardens. Hethia isn't that hard to spot — she's a lot more simply dressed than her peers — and raises a questioning eyebrow as she sees you approach. "Why, [pc.name]. I thought I saw you head in with the others on their way to the hymnal." You did... but you couldn't keep your mind on the whole religious aspect of it. Like it or not, your thoughts kept wandering... Hethia rolls her eyes and gives you a thin smile. "To me?" Why, how did she guess? "I've heard better flattery in my time, but the fact does still stand that you're here, so there must be some truth to it." It's been a long day, and one that you know has been grating on her sensibilities and beliefs for a while now. Why doesn't she just take the rest of the night off and come with you? You're not going to lie, there's a certain thrill in getting up to funny business in the shadow of the goddess of light... "And as I understand it, she's the goddess of breeding, too, so that isn't even as sacreligious as one might imagine. Even so..." Hethia's smile widens. "I suppose thumbing my nose at her, even in so small a fashion, can't hurt." Or is it just an excuse to blow off some steam? "Can't it be both?" Seeing some of the other druids staring at the both of you, Hethia says something to them in her native tongue, and they quickly turn away, suddenly seeming very interested in putting away the tables and wrapping up the ribbons. Turning back to you, the druidess gives you an easy shrug and extends a hand palm-up to you, tilting her head. "Well then, Champion, I'll play along and see what you have in mind. Take me away..." And so you do. The hedges that surround the rose garden aren't that far away — with how thick they are, even the chorus of voices raised in praise of Lumia are a little muffled, but the shadows cast by the foliage are deep and long. It is, after all, the brightest light that casts the deepest shadows, isn't it? "Well, aren't we feeling poetic," Hethia murmurs. In this one moment, she does look very tired, indeed, and unsurprisingly so. Wrangling Elthara's people, wrangling her people, and all against the backdrop of the defeat of everything she believed in as a girl and has come to grudgingly accept — ah, but that's what you're here for, aren't you? Leaning in, you grace the druidess with a quick peck on the tip of her nose; her skin is cool to the touch, and she blinks in surprise, perhaps expecting more. Still, it's nice to see an expression on her face other than her usual standoffish self, and you quickly follow up with two smooches, one to each cheek. rows.original: [atFH |Entering the Frost Hound and leaving behind the cold and the wind always evokes a palpable sense of relief, and, if you dare say, a bit of strange, pleasant nostalgia. Not too long ago you were a stranger here, and now you're surrounded by friends. It's a warmth better than the glow of the hearthfire. |The winter city's throne room opens to you again, baring its grandeur and decor. At the center of the room is the seat of the boer'alvar ruler... curious. Like a jewel absent from its crown, its rightful occupant is missing. ] [pc.heightRange 0 60 70 |Two dainty blue hands appear in your periphery; a person's arms cross around your shoulders like the clasp of a protective cloak. In any other circumstance this would be alarming, but as you touch the girl's cool-hued arms feelingly, eyes fluttering shut, you melt into the close intimacy of her heartfelt embrace. |Gently, two arms thread beneath yours, fingers kitting at your middle. A fleeting sensation of concern quickly melts away as the familiar girl rests her chin on your shoulder, nuzzles into the crook of your neck. With a quiet sigh, you touch her fingers, enjoy this rare affection. |Two small arms loop around your waist from out of the blue, a gentle, feminine figure pressing herself into your flank. That action alone isn't enough to make you start, but it's the insistent nuzzle of her head into the space beneath your [pc.arm] that does. You rest that same arm around her shoulders to hold her close, letting her bask in the comfort of your closeness. ] "[pc.name]..." Etheryn murmurs into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], just standing there, enjoying the moment. What a journey it's been. From long days on lonesome roads, to meeting Cait, to encountering Kasyrra... to meeting Etheryn. It's been difficult, excruciating even. You've been through more than the average [pc.manWoman] could ever imagine, experiencing things that'd drive less capable individuals to madness. But being right here with Ryn... you know it's the path you're meant to be on. You squeeze her against your body, feel out her heart amid the ambience. The whole world could disappear around you, your lifetime could pass by in an instant, and you wouldn't notice. Everything you've been through was worth this moment. Saying 'it's nice' would be the understatement of the era. "Hey, [pc.name]..." Ryn whispers, shifting herself around to your front, cupping your chin. [pc.heightRange 0 60 70 |She bends down to your level, lapis lips pursed. |She tightens the hug and purses her lapis lips. |She stands on her tiptoes (and you pull her up a little bit to help), pursing her lapis lips. ] "Mm..." Etheryn kisses you right there in front of everyone, as if to say, "Let there be no doubt of my relationship with [pc.name]." That she's showing such confidence and initiative... you flush with passion and excitement, body temperature rising steadily. A few seconds of making out feels like a whole hour, and you spend that toying with the idea of slipping into her mouth. Ryn's the one who acts, tilting her head. Soft, supple tongues dance between your cheeks in an exhausting dance that she's leading. [pc.hasTail |When the future of House Ridell stumbles slightly, you firmly grasp her delicate waist with your [pc.tails], enhancing the romanticism. ] There's a little girlish squeal when the liplock breaks; she sneaks a few smooches down the length of your neck... then surprises you with round two. In that brief moment, you see her cheeks colored a deep, rich purple. At the end of your pashing, Ryn is panting, laughing softly. "I love you, [pc.name]." The fragile-looking [etheryn.crowned |queen |queen-to-be ] strokes your cheek. "I don't think I'll ever deserve you... but I wanted you to know that, okay?" As you grasp her hand, you wonder how to respond...
rows.translation: [atFH |走进寒霜猎犬，远离寒冷与风雪，总会让人感到一种切实的解脱，甚至可以说，还会引发一种奇妙而愉悦的怀旧之情。不久前，你还是这里的陌生人，而如今，你已经被朋友们环绕在身边。这种温暖，比炉火的光芒还要令人感到舒适。 |这座冬季城市的王座厅再次向您敞开，展现出它那宏伟的气势与精美的装饰。厅室的中央是布尔阿尔瓦统治者的宝座……奇怪的是，它的合法主人却不见了，就像一颗从王冠上脱落的宝石一样。 ] [pc.heightRange 0 60 70 |两只纤细的蓝色手臂出现在你的视野中；一个人的双臂环绕着你的肩膀，就像一件保护性的斗篷一样。在任何其他情况下，这种举动都会让人感到不安，但当你深情地触摸着那个女孩那冰冷色调的手臂，缓缓闭上眼睛时，你便沉浸在她那充满温情的拥抱之中，感受到了那种亲密无间的感觉。 |轻轻地，两只手臂从你的手臂下方穿过，手指在中间轻轻相触。那种短暂的担忧瞬间消散了，因为那个熟悉的女孩把下巴靠在你的肩膀上，依偎在你的颈间。你轻轻叹了口气，触了触她的手指，享受着这份难得的关爱。 |突然，两把小武器被别在你的腰间，一个温柔而女性化的身影紧紧贴在你的身侧。仅仅这个动作本身还不足以让你警觉起来，但当她的头不断在你的腰间蹭来蹭去时，你就不能再忽视了[pc.arm]确实如此。你依然用那只手臂搂住她的肩膀，让她紧紧依偎在你身边，让她感受到你给予的温暖与安慰。 ] "[pc.name]……伊瑟琳轻声对你说，[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]就那么站在那里，享受着这一刻。 真是一段漫长的旅程啊。从在孤独的路上度过漫长的日子，到遇见凯特，再到遇到卡希拉……最后遇见伊瑟琳。这一路上充满了艰辛，甚至可以说是痛苦不堪。你所经历的一切，都远远超出了常人的承受范围。[pc.manWoman]我简直无法想象，经历那些连能力较弱的人都会被逼疯的事情。 但能够置身其中，体验这一切，也是一种难得的缘分吧。就在这里和小琳在一起……你知道，这就是你注定要走的道路。你将她紧紧搂在怀里，在这种氛围中感受着她的心跳。即使整个世界都在你身边消失，你的整个人生在瞬间流逝，你也不会察觉。你所经历的一切，都值得这一刻。用“感觉很好”来形容，简直是对这种感受的轻描淡写。 “嘿，[pc.name]……”小琳轻声说道，然后调整姿势来到你的面前，托起你的下巴。 [pc.heightRange 0 60 70 |她弯下腰，与你平视，那双青色的嘴唇紧闭着。 |她收紧了怀抱，紧抿着那双淡蓝色的嘴唇。 |她踮起脚尖（你稍微拉了她一下帮她），紧闭着那双淡蓝色的嘴唇。 ]嗯……” 伊瑟琳当着所有人的面吻了你，仿佛在说：“我与[pc.name]的关系不容置疑。”她竟表现得如此自信，如此主动……你满心激情与兴奋，体温也在不断上升。短短几秒钟的亲吻仿佛持续了整整一小时，在这段时间里，你不断想象着将舌头伸进她的口中。是小琳主动采取了行动，她微微倾斜着头，柔软而灵活的舌头在你的脸颊间跳着舞，这场充满诱惑的舞蹈完全由她主导着。 [pc.hasTail |当里德尔家族的未来遇到些许挫折时，你会紧紧握住她那纤细的腰肢[pc.tails]，进一步增添了浪漫气息。 ] 当那个唇吻结束时，她发出了一阵少女般的轻声尖叫；然后她悄悄地在你的脖子上留下了一连串轻吻……接着，她又突然再次行动起来，让你措手不及。在那一瞬间，你看到她的脸颊变成了深沉的紫色。 在你们的亲热结束后，小琳喘着气，轻声笑着说道：“我爱你。[pc.name]那个看起来如此脆弱的东西[etheryn.crowned |女王 |准王后 ]轻抚着她的脸颊，你说：“我觉得自己永远都不配拥有你……但我还是想让你知道这一点，好吗？” 当你握住她的手时，你却在思考该如何回应……

[pc.heightRange 70
            |Etheryn detects the mischievous glint in your eyes but is wholly unprepared for being literally swept off her feet into a bridal carry — destination: bedroom. "Wa-aah!"
            |Ryn watches the little smirk spreading across your face, but could never predict you'd grab her by the hand and elope with her to the bedroom.
        ] You pass by numerous smiles and leave the laughter in your dust.
        
        [atFH
            |In the huddled space of one of the Frost Hound's many coveted rooms, you lay Ryn out on the sheets and pick up where you left off,
            |In the romantic getaway that is Ryn's personal bedchambers, you lay her across her own sheets and pick up where you left off,
        ] resolving to reciprocate the cute elf's advances in the best way possible...
        
        "Ahh... [pc.name]..." Ryn is all smiles when you pull away, a thin strand of saliva connecting your lower lips. Instead of lying splayed out, she's massaging you, being romantic in all those ways once horribly repressed. "[etheryn.isCaged
            |The chill of this cage is nothing compared to the warmth you fill my heart with. Someday, we're going to melt it. I know it!
            |How can I ever thank you for all these wonderful things you've done for me? You were the light in my darkest hour... you're my liberator, my savior... just tell me however you'd like it, and I'll make it happen!
        ]"
        
        Aw, you're getting a little misty...

rows.original: The two hours pass in the blink of an eye in the comfort the palace baths and some refreshments — if nothing else, the chill water has you awake and alert for the upcoming ceremony. One of the palace servants comes by with a summons, and you have plenty of time to get dressed and make yourself as decent as possible before heading to the throne room. Everyone's already there by the time the guards step aside to admit you — Ryn on her throne, Elthara a little ways by her side, and the young archdruid with half a dozen of her colleagues approaching the throne. Ryn waves you over as you enter, discreetly gesturing to where you should situate yourself, and you oblige to take up the other side Notably, though, Hethia's not here. You thought she'd have been, given that the whole trip to Xadaron Temple was her idea to begin with, but you also remember that she's not very high up on the druidic pecking order. Maybe you can go and see her later and congratulate her privately... ...That being said, the little ceremony's beginning. The archdruid starts speaking in boer'alvarin, until Ryn bids her pause with an outstretched hand. "Pardon, Archdruid Xadaron. If you wouldn't mind speaking Belharan for the benefit of my champion? It's only fair, since [pc.heShe] was instrumental to our success." "Of course, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]." Mie clears her throat. "To commemorate the finalization of the reunification, we would like to present you with a gesture of our future fealty — arms and apparel befitting you." The archdruid beckons one of her fellows forward, retrieving a case and slowly opening it before the court. Within is a finely made bow and quiver, as well as clothes colored in irregular shades of green, brown and black. "[etheryn.crowned |My queen |Lady regent ], you are most certainly at the age where a var Ridell pursues the building of a fine martial reputation, and even we have heard of your exploits alongside your champion — Grower Hethia has made sure of that. To further your endeavors, we have labored to infuse these fine artifacts with enchantments that will aid you in your future adventures." Ryn receives the gift and then clears her throat, perhaps the first hint of uncertainty she shown since the ceremony began. "I won't have to, um —" "We do not ask you to hold a faith that we ourselves admit is dying, Etheryn var Ridell. The wyld trees once drank deep and directly from the ley-lines which nourished them, the lifeblood of the world, and in sharing their power with us served as a conduit for that lifeblood, allowing us to tap power to a degree which would kill others. You've seen for yourself what an uncontrolled surfeit of life is capable of... "But I digress. Although our powers will fully wane when our patron finally passes, they will not vanish, but simply be limited to what we're capable of on our own. The reason we're here to begin with is that our patron has accepted her passing, but that we should not pass with her — a complete opposite to how the corrupted wyld tree in Xadaron Temple behaved. As agreed, you will not force us to convert as your grandmother attempted, but at the same time we will not tie down our own who wish to bury the dying and move on. The show of strength by your goddess' valkyries has been very inspiring, I'll admit. "But if you are to rule two peoples as one — and I won't lie in that saying in effect we are still two peoples for several generations more — then you should understand something of our power, and this is the purpose of our gift." "You're most gracious, Archdruid. In that case, I'll certainly wear them in place of my usual regalia during my next public appearance to explain our situation to the people and call for those who wish to be part of the resettlement effort." "[etheryn.crowned |My queen |The lady regent ] is most wise. The var Ridells have always been... charismatic. No doubt your public acceptance of our gift will send a strong message to your current and future subjects." Oh great, courtly byplay. [pc.bgMulti noblescion slumrat |One of the reasons you left home was to get away from this kind of nonsense, but it's caught up with you yet again. Perhaps this is the burden the gods have set upon you... |If you were to tell a younger you that you'd be standing in a royal court listening to this drivel, you'd never have believed yourself — not just for being there in the first place, but not sneaking off to the palace pantry to stuff your face in the bargain. |If you'd told yourself several months ago that you'd be moping around in halls of power listening to polite bickering, you'd never have believed yourself. Then again, considering the scope of the perils that you've faced thus far, this is a good problem to have. ] The rest of the ceremony is pretty muted — there's a smattering of applause from Ryn's court, so you follow suit, and Ryn passes off her new clothes and weapon to Elthara before thanking the druids again. The little ceremony complete, the archdruid and her people file out of Ryn's throne room, leaving the three of you to depart through the back with Ryn's new duds. Etheryn has acquired the wyldkin set. "These look amazing!" Ryn exclaims as you pace through the hallways, unfolding the leathers. "And they have a nice smell to them too — not that you'd notice were we out in the wilds. [party.has etheryn |Take me somewhere so I can put these to good use, okay?" Elthara looks just a tiny bit exasperated at that. "Planning to leave so soon again, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]?" A smile. "Hey, you heard the druids. I've got a martial legacy to fulfill, passed down from my grandmother no less. Mom, Dad, and even Alissa did well by it — there's something to be said for having that kind of reputation. As for palace matters... that's why you're here, aren't you?" Elthara sighs, then stoops down to kiss Ryn on the brow, and gives you [elthara.fucked |one that's considerably more intimate |one as well ]. "Well, you heard her, [pc.name]. Not that it needs to be said, but please take care of Ryn while the both of you are out there." [pc.isDK |Heh. You'll take care of her, all right. |That goes without saying. ] "All right, I'll leave the both of you to it, then." Winking at the both of you, Elthara sashays off. "Enjoy your new clothes, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ] — you know where to find me if you need me." |If you have need of me, I'll always be ready to head out with you." Elthara looks just a tiny bit exasperated at that, although she can't hold back a smile. "Planning to leave so soon again, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]? You could always hold a hunt if you wished to demonstrate your skills — I've a shortlist of several prospective members of your new court you could get to know better." But it wouldn't be with you, would it? Ryn blushes, and you know that you've hit the mark here. "H-hey, you heard the druids. I've got a martial legacy to fulfill, passed down from my grandmother no less. Mom, Dad, and even Alissa did well by it — there's something to be said for having that kind of reputation. As for palace matters... that's why you're here, aren't you?" Elthara sighs, then stoops down to kiss Ryn on the brow, and gives you [elthara.fucked |one that's considerably more intimate |one as well ]. "Oh, whatever am I to do with you. Delegation is fine, but you don't want to end up like your sister who wound up letting others handle everything. At least I've you to myself for a little while before [pc.name] snatches you off to go on another adventure, hmm?" Mm-hm. Good thing you've Elthara to mind Ryn while you're off elsewhere doing champion things, saving the Marches and all. Even if you're not going to be around, maybe she should hold that hunt Elthara suggests if she wants to try on her new clothes. She can do it for you, yes? "Y-yes!" All right, you've to be off now. It's been fun, but it's nice to be able to close a chapter on all of this. There are other things you've to handle for now... ]
rows.translation: 在宫殿里的沐浴与一些点心带来的舒适环境中，这两个小时转瞬即逝——至少，清凉的水让人保持清醒，为即将到来的仪式做好充分准备。这时，一位宫仆前来传召你，你有足够的时间整理衣装，让自己看起来尽可能得体，然后再前往王座厅。当守卫们退开让你进入时，所有人都已经在那里了——小琳坐在王座上，艾尔萨拉站在她身旁不远处，而那位年轻的首席德鲁伊以及她的六位同事正朝着王座走来。当你走进去时，小琳向你招手，同时悄悄地示意你应该坐在哪里，你便遵从她的指示，在另一侧坐了下来。 不过值得注意的是，赫希娅并不在这里。你本来以为她会来的，因为这次前往萨达隆神庙的旅行本来就是她的主意，但你也知道，在德鲁伊的等级体系中，她的地位并不高。也许你可以晚些时候去看看她，私下里向她表示祝贺。…话虽如此，这个小仪式终于开始了。大德鲁伊开始用布尔阿尔瓦林语讲话，直到小琳伸出手示意她暂停。 “抱歉，大德鲁伊萨达伦。如果您不介意的话，能用贝尔哈兰语来说话吧？这样对我的冠军来说会更容易理解。这样才公平，因为[pc.heShe]对我们的成功起到了至关重要的作用。” “当然， [etheryn.crowned |我的女王 |摄政王夫人 ]米埃清了清嗓子，说道：‘为了庆祝统一事业的最终完成，我们想向您表达我们未来的忠诚——献上适合您的武器与服饰。’” 大德鲁伊示意其中一位同伴上前，拿出了一个匣子，在众人面前缓缓打开。匣子里装着一把制作精良的弓和一支箭袋，还有几件颜色为绿色、棕色和黑色的衣物。[etheryn.crowned |我的女王 |摄政女王 ]你确实已经到了那种应该努力树立自己卓越武艺声誉的年纪。就连我们也都听说过你与你的冠军伙伴一起所取得的成就——Grower 赫希娅确实为你的名声做出了贡献。为了帮助你继续前进，我们特意为这些珍贵的神器施加了特殊的魔法，这些魔法必定会在你未来的冒险中为你提供帮助。 小琳接过礼物，然后清了清嗓子，这或许是她自仪式开始以来第一次流露出犹豫不决的神情。“我应该不需要这样做吧，嗯——” “我们并没有要求你去坚守一种连我们自己都承认已经濒临消亡的信念，伊瑟琳·瓦·里德尔。那些野生树木曾经直接从那些滋养它们的能量脉络中汲取养分——那些能量脉络堪称世界的生命线。通过与我们共享这些力量，它们成为了连接这些生命线的通道，使我们能够获取如此巨大的能量，以至于这种能量对其他生物来说可能是致命的。你们已经亲眼看到了，当生命失去控制、变得过度繁盛时，会带来什么后果…… 不过，我有点跑题了。虽然当我们的庇护者最终离世时，我们的力量会彻底减弱，但它们并不会完全消失，而只是会局限于我们独自所能做的事情。我们之所以会来到这里，正是因为我们的庇护者已经接受了自己的死亡，但她并不希望我们也随之消亡——这与扎达伦神殿中那颗被腐蚀的野生树木的行为截然相反。按照约定，你们不会像你们的祖母那样强迫我们进行转换；但同时，我们也不会阻碍那些希望为逝者送行然后继续前行的人。我必须承认，你们的女神的女武神们所展现出的那种力量确实令人振奋。 但是，如果你想要将两个民族统一起来治理——我毫不隐瞒，事实上在接下来的几代人里，我们仍然会是两个不同的民族——那么你就必须了解我们的力量，而这份礼物正是为了这个目的而准备的。” “您真是太慷慨了，大德鲁伊。既然如此，在我下一次公开露面时，我一定会穿上这些服饰，代替我平时的礼服，向人们解释我们的处境，并号召那些愿意参与重新安置计划的人前来。 "[etheryn.crowned |我的女王 |女摄政王 ]这是最明智的做法。里德尔家族一向都……具有非凡的魅力。毫无疑问，您公开接受我们的礼物，必将向您现在的臣民以及未来的子民传递出一个强有力的信号。 哦，真是太妙了——这些优雅的客套话真是恰到好处。 [pc.bgMulti noblescion slumrat |你离开家的原因之一就是想要摆脱这种无聊的事情，但它们又一次找上了你。也许这就是上天赋予你的负担吧…… |如果你告诉年少的自己，有一天你会站在皇家宫廷里听这种废话，自己绝对会不相信的——不仅是因为自己竟然会出现在那里，更是因为你还会偷偷溜进宫殿的食品储藏室，大吃特吃。 |如果几个月前你告诉自己，将来会整天在权力机构的大厅里听着那些客气的争吵，你肯定不会相信自己的话。不过，考虑到你迄今为止所面临的各种危险，这种情况也算是在意料之中吧不错真是个麻烦事。 ] 仪式的其余部分相当沉闷——只有小琳的宫廷里传来零星的掌声，你也跟着鼓起了掌。随后，小琳将她的新衣服和武器交给了艾尔萨拉，再次向德鲁伊们表示感谢。这个小小的仪式结束后，大德鲁伊和她的族人们纷纷离开了小琳的宝座厅，而你们三个人则带着小琳的新衣物从后门离开了那里。 伊瑟琳已经获得了野人套装。 这些看起来太棒了！”当你们沿着走廊走着，一边展开那些皮革制品时，小琳惊叹道，“而且它们还散发着不错的香味——不过在野外的话，你可能根本注意不到这些气味。 [party.has etheryn |带我去某个地方吧，这样我就能把这些东西派上用场了，好吗？” 听到这个请求，艾尔萨拉显得有些无奈：“又打算这么快就离开吗[etheryn.crowned |我的女王 |摄政女王 ]一个微笑。“嘿，你听到德鲁伊们说的话了吧？我有一项武学使命要完成，这份使命还是从我祖母那里继承下来的。妈妈、爸爸，甚至艾莉莎都在这方面做得很好——拥有这样的名声确实很有好处。至于宫廷里的事情……你们来这里不就是为了这个吗？” 艾尔萨拉叹了口气，然后俯下身在小琳的额头上吻了一下，接着对你说[elthara.fucked |一种亲密程度要高得多的关系/方式 |我也一样 ]嗯，你们都听到了她的话[pc.name]。 其实也并不是说需求虽然这么说有点多余，但你们俩出去的时候请一定要照顾好小琳。 [pc.isDK |呵呵，你来照顾她吧，没问题。 |这是理所当然的。 ] 好吧，那我就把你们俩留下来处理这件事了。”艾尔萨拉朝你们俩眨了眨眼，然后蹦蹦跳跳地走开了。“好好享受你们的新衣服吧！ [etheryn.crowned |我的女王 |摄政女王 ]如果你需要我的帮助，你知道该去哪里找我。 |如果你需要我，我随时准备与你一同出发。” 听到这话，艾尔萨拉脸上露出了一丝无奈的表情，但终究还是忍不住笑了起来：“又打算这么快就离开吗？ [etheryn.crowned |我的女王 |摄政女王 ]如果你想展示自己的能力，随时都可以组织一场狩猎活动——我列出了几位有望成为你新宫廷成员的人选，你可以去进一步了解他们。” One of the palace servants comes by with a summons, and you have plenty of time to get dressed and make yourself as decent as possible before heading to the throne room. Everyone's already there by the time the guards step aside to admit you — Ryn on her throne, Elthara a little ways by her side, and the young archdruid with half a dozen of her colleagues approaching the throne. Ryn waves you over as you enter, discreetly gesturing to where you should situate yourself, and you oblige to take up the other side Notably, though, Hethia's not here. You thought she'd have been, given that the whole trip to Xadaron Temple was her idea to begin with, but you also remember that she's not very high up on the druidic pecking order. Maybe you can go and see her later and congratulate her privately... ...That being said, the little ceremony's beginning. The archdruid starts speaking in boer'alvarin, until Ryn bids her pause with an outstretched hand. "Pardon, Archdruid Xadaron. If you wouldn't mind speaking Belharan for the benefit of my champion? It's only fair, since [pc.heShe] was instrumental to our success." "Of course, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]." Mie clears her throat. "To commemorate the finalization of the reunification, we would like to present you with a gesture of our future fealty — arms and apparel befitting you." The archdruid beckons one of her fellows forward, retrieving a case and slowly opening it before the court. Within is a finely made bow and quiver, as well as clothes colored in irregular shades of green, brown and black. "[etheryn.crowned |My queen |Lady regent ], you are most certainly at the age where a var Ridell pursues the building of a fine martial reputation, and even we have heard of your exploits alongside your champion — Grower Hethia has made sure of that. To further your endeavors, we have labored to infuse these fine artifacts with enchantments that will aid you in your future adventures." Ryn receives the gift and then clears her throat, perhaps the first hint of uncertainty she shown since the ceremony began. "I won't have to, um —" "We do not ask you to hold a faith that we ourselves admit is dying, Etheryn var Ridell. The wyld trees once drank deep and directly from the ley-lines which nourished them, the lifeblood of the world, and in sharing their power with us served as a conduit for that lifeblood, allowing us to tap power to a degree which would kill others. You've seen for yourself what an uncontrolled surfeit of life is capable of... "But I digress. Although our powers will fully wane when our patron finally passes, they will not vanish, but simply be limited to what we're capable of on our own. The reason we're here to begin with is that our patron has accepted her passing, but that we should not pass with her — a complete opposite to how the corrupted wyld tree in Xadaron Temple behaved. As agreed, you will not force us to convert as your grandmother attempted, but at the same time we will not tie down our own who wish to bury the dying and move on. The show of strength by your goddess' valkyries has been very inspiring, I'll admit. "But if you are to rule two peoples as one — and I won't lie in that saying in effect we are still two peoples for several generations more — then you should understand something of our power, and this is the purpose of our gift." "You're most gracious, Archdruid. In that case, I'll certainly wear them in place of my usual regalia during my next public appearance to explain our situation to the people and call for those who wish to be part of the resettlement effort." "[etheryn.crowned |My queen |The lady regent ] is most wise. The var Ridells have always been... charismatic. No doubt your public acceptance of our gift will send a strong message to your current and future subjects." Oh great, courtly byplay. [pc.bgMulti noblescion slumrat |One of the reasons you left home was to get away from this kind of nonsense, but it's caught up with you yet again. Perhaps this is the burden the gods have set upon you... |If you were to tell a younger you that you'd be standing in a royal court listening to this drivel, you'd never have believed yourself — not just for being there in the first place, but not sneaking off to the palace pantry to stuff your face in the bargain. |If you'd told yourself several months ago that you'd be moping around in halls of power listening to polite bickering, you'd never have believed yourself. Then again, considering the scope of the perils that you've faced thus far, this is a good problem to have. ] The rest of the ceremony is pretty muted — there's a smattering of applause from Ryn's court, so you follow suit, and Ryn passes off her new clothes and weapon to Elthara before thanking the druids again. The little ceremony complete, the archdruid and her people file out of Ryn's throne room, leaving the three of you to depart through the back with Ryn's new duds. Etheryn has acquired the wyldkin set. "These look amazing!" Ryn exclaims as you pace through the hallways, unfolding the leathers. "And they have a nice smell to them too — not that you'd notice were we out in the wilds. [party.has etheryn |Take me somewhere so I can put these to good use, okay?" Elthara looks just a tiny bit exasperated at that. "Planning to leave so soon again, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]?" A smile. "Hey, you heard the druids. I've got a martial legacy to fulfill, passed down from my grandmother no less. Mom, Dad, and even Alissa did well by it — there's something to be said for having that kind of reputation. As for palace matters... that's why you're here, aren't you?" Elthara sighs, then stoops down to kiss Ryn on the brow, and gives you [elthara.fucked |one that's considerably more intimate |one as well ]. "Well, you heard her, [pc.name]. Not that it needs to be said, but please take care of Ryn while the both of you are out there." [pc.isDK |Heh. You'll take care of her, all right. |That goes without saying. ] "All right, I'll leave the both of you to it, then." Winking at the both of you, Elthara sashays off. "Enjoy your new clothes, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ] — you know where to find me if you need me." |If you have need of me, I'll always be ready to head out with you." Elthara looks just a tiny bit exasperated at that, although she can't hold back a smile. "Planning to leave so soon again, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]? You could always hold a hunt if you wished to demonstrate your skills — I've a shortlist of several prospective members of your new court you could get to know better." But it wouldn't be with you, would it? Ryn blushes, and you know that you've hit the mark here. "H-hey, you heard the druids. I've got a martial legacy to fulfill, passed down from my grandmother no less. Mom, Dad, and even Alissa did well by it — there's something to be said for having that kind of reputation. As for palace matters... that's why you're here, aren't you?" Elthara sighs, then stoops down to kiss Ryn on the brow, and gives you [elthara.fucked |one that's considerably more intimate |one as well ]. "Oh, whatever am I to do with you. Delegation is fine, but you don't want to end up like your sister who wound up letting others handle everything. At least I've you to myself for a little while before [pc.name] snatches you off to go on another adventure, hmm?" Mm-hm. Good thing you've Elthara to mind Ryn while you're off elsewhere doing champion things, saving the Marches and all. Even if you're not going to be around, maybe she should hold that hunt Elthara suggests if she wants to try on her new clothes. She can do it for you, yes? "Y-yes!" All right, you've to be off now. It's been fun, but it's nice to be able to close a chapter on all of this. There are other things you've to handle for now... ] "
