"I think so!" [etheryn.lnhConfidence |She bites her lip. "I — I mean, I hope so..." |She smiles the smile of someone who's trying to cover a little nervousness. "It should be fun!" |She doesn't seem too nervous. Excited, though — definitely. "We're going to try something new this time, and I hope it goes well!" ] ] [party.Yall] wend your way through the crowds in the same direction as they're going: first, toward the palace, and from there through side-streets toward the enormous cathedral of Lumia. But while the building is glowing and gorgeous, it's clearly not the main objective. Instead, despite the gently-falling snow, this is an outdoor event. The plaza around the cathedral is lit up with what must be hundreds of torches. Many of the elves filtering into the plaza, young and old, bear torches of their own, making the broad thoroughfares into a river of light swelling to a flood. [pc.swornGod lumia |Since you're a valkyrie yourself, you can probably see about participating in the ceremony instead of just watching. rows.original: Ryn would probably love it if you helped your fellow valkyries present her with her royal gift.
rows.translation: 如果你能帮助你的其他女武神们将这份皇家礼物送给小琳，她肯定会非常高兴的。
rows.raw: "Ryn would probably love it if you helped your fellow valkyries present her with her royal gift."

rows.original: You aren't a valkyrie, so you'll have to watch instead.
rows.translation: 你又不是女武神，所以只能眼睁睁看着了。

rows.original: Watch the ceremony and be there for Etheryn.
rows.translation: 观看这场仪式，陪伴伊瑟琳一起度过这个时刻吧。
rows.raw: "Watch the ceremony and be there for Etheryn."

rows.original: The other valkyries are near one of the side-streets approaching the cathedral, Thrud obviously most prominent among them, but Anni and Eira and Yolihuali and Halima and dozens of others are there as well. [party.has etheryn |As soon as you catch sight of them, you [pc.isBimbo |ask |murmur to ] Ryn: "[pc.isBimbo |Hey, cutie! Is it okay if I check in with the other sun mommies? |Do you mind if I check in with my sisters? ]" She glances back and forth, but then light dawns. "I — oh! [etheryn.lowConfidence |Th-that's fine. |[pc.isBimbo |Yeah, that's okay |I don't mind at all ] ]." The bottom of her lip disappears behind her teeth for half a second before she continues, with slightly darker cheeks than before. "Actually, I'd like that. I... wait, before I go, could I ask you something?" "[pc.dcb |Mhm. |Sure. |Of course! ]" "During the ceremony, I'm going to, um, swear an oath. Some of the other people, like Annika, are going to be witnesses. Since you're going to be there too, would you mind if I named you as a witness, too? You don't have to say much." [pc.isBimbo |"That's good! Is it okay if I get the lines, um, moooostly right instead of all the way right?" She nods, struggling to hold in a giggle. "Then sure!" |You smile reassuringly. "I'd be happy to." ] "Okay," [etheryn.highConfidence |she chirps |she says, shoulders sagging with relief ]. "Okay! Thank you. I[etheryn.lowConfidence |... I ] guess I'll see you inside, then!" "[pc.dcb |I guess you will! |I'm looking forward to it. |Mhm! Seeya innabit! ]" [etheryn.confessed |You give her a quick smooch and a hand-squeeze before she |You give her a friendly wave before she ] makes for the plaza[party.hasCompanions | with [comp2.name] ]. From there, it's only a few moments of pushing your way through the crowd to reach your shield-sisters. |[party.som |This looks to be your stop. While the rest of the crowd heads toward the plaza and its innumerable lights, you push your way over to meet your shield-sisters. |You take your leave of [party.compNames], who continues on into the plaza, then peel off to meet your shield-sisters. |You take your leave of [party.compNames], who continue on into the plaza, then peel off to meet your shield-sisters. ] ] "Hail and well met, [annika.kissed |darling |sister ]," Anni says, smiling. Her full armor's on again, and nicely polished, too — like that of the other valkyries.[pc.bg soldier | You remember comrades-in-arms from your time at war in the south who would've shit themselves to see gear like that on the opposite side of a battlefield. ] "Here to join us?" [pc.dcb |"If this is where the cool kids are sitting," you chuckle. |You spread your hands, smiling gently. "If you'll have me." |"Thaaaaat's right!" you confirm. "Am I allowed?" ] "[pc.isDK |Compliment received on this end. |Of course. ] It's a simple ceremony, all things considered. Our ceremonial entry into the city was more complicated." She turns to Thrud. "Perhaps the two of you could divvy up the armor?" Your enormous half-jotun [thrud.fucked |lover |shield-sister ] kneels, allowing you to see the bronze gear in her arms: breastplate, greaves, and suchlike things. "I'd appreciate it. The pieces aren't heavy, just awkward to carry for one person.[thrud.pregStage 2 | Especially when," she continues, blushing and nodding down at her belly, "this one gets in the way. ]" "Sure[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" You heft the breastplate, with its Lumian icon gleaming, and [thrud.pregStage 1 |[pc.isBimbo |flutter your eyelashes at your expectant lover. "I've got lots and lots of reasons to wanna help you out with that!" |give your expectant lover a teasing wink. "It's only fair that I shoulder some of the burden, right?" ] She turns her head a little to the side and grins delightedly. "You're so [pc.isBimbo |sweet |gallant ]..." You do something like a bow with an exaggerated flourish with the hand that isn't full of breastplate, then turn back to Anni. "[pc.isBimbo |Okie! So, next thing? |All right. ] |[pc.isDK |sketch a salute |grin ]. "I can do that. ] [pc.isBimbo |Could you tell me, like, the actual, um, steps and things? Is there a way we're supposed to do the thing and give Ryn-Ryn the armor? |You'll have to give me the script, though. Simple or not, I haven't exactly done this before. We're presenting Ryn with the armor? ]" "And arms," Anni says, raising a beautifully polished shield and a magnificent spear. "But yes, there are steps. It's a ceremony with a bit of a tradition — long in southern years, I imagine, even if it's shorter in ours. After Queen Atheldred passed, we wanted to maintain similar ties to her daughter without her needing to join our ranks. At the beginning of Queen Alraince's reign, we gifted her armor of proof and arms of light, consecrating them to show the bond between the elvenqueens and the Order. We did the same with her first daughter... though as I understand it, neither arms nor armor saw much use after she and the Order grew apart." Yeah, that sounds like Alissa.[pc.isBimbo | Super super stinky, that is! ] "Oh, okay. [pc.isBimbo |Um... are we gonna be speaking Elf a Ryn? [etheryn.confessed |'Cause Ryn only taught me a couple of words so far. |I don't actually know any elfy words. ] |The ceremony's not all in Alvarin, is it? [etheryn.confessed |Other than a few words, Ryn and I... |I don't actually know any words. ] ]" "[pc.isBimbo |Alvarin, dear," she says gently. "And none of it is. |None of it is," she assures you. " ]Remember, you're far from the first southerner to join the Order." At that, Halima and Yolihuali, both grinning, wave at you, as do a few other of your sisters further back. Thrud laughs. "Yeah, it's in your language. A lot of Lumian prayers are. Not all, or even most, but a lot are." "But that doesn't mean we shouldn't tell you about your role beforehand," Anni adds. "First of all: was Her Majesty able to ask you about witnessing the oath?" [party.has etheryn |"[pc.isBimbo |Yiiiiipyup! Are there special words for that too?" Gosh! There are lots of special words today! |She was, and I said yes." ] "Wonderful!" She claps. "All you'll really have to do is say, when prompted, that you witness the oath — loudly enough for at least some of the people in the crowd to hear it." "[pc.isBimbo |Okie-doke! That's simple. |Simple enough. ]" "The rest of it isn't quite as simple, but nearly so. |[pc.isBimbo |"Uuuuum, I don't think so! But I didn't get to see her before we got here. |"Witnessing?" You frown. "No. But I haven't had a chance to talk to her. ]" "That's fine," she assures you. "Normally, the ceremony doesn't include any sort of oath on the part of the queen; it's a gift given, and that's all. Etheryn asked if we could change that this time, though. She wants to reaffirm her family's connection to the Order in the wake of everything Alissa did, and will be making a promise. It's a very lovely gesture. She'll ask Elthara and myself, as well as the people of the city generally, to act as witnesses, and she did say that she wanted to ask you, as well. All you'll have to do is say, when prompted, that you witness the oath in Lumia's name, or in her light." "Hmm." You think it over for a few moments, then [pc.isDK |nod |smile ]. "[pc.isBimbo |Sounds good! I can say that. |I think I can do that, sure. ]" Anni inclines her head respectfully. "Thank you. I'm sure she'll be very grateful. Ready for the rest of the ceremony?" [pc.dcb |"Let's hear it." |"Whenever you are." |"Ready!" ] "All right. ] Once the horn blows, we'll form up in a double column..." The explanation's short and sweet and easy to remember, so it's not long before you and your shield-sisters return to idle conversation in anticipation of the start of the ceremony. While you wait, as ever in Njorhaalt, snow continues to fall lightly on you — and on the crowd, which bustles around. Many of the frost elves go straight into the well-lit square, while others slow up a little to say hello to the valkyries. Sometimes your elven shield-sisters say hi back, peeling off from the group for a few minutes in ones and twos to embrace family or greet old friends. It's remarkably convivial; [silly |even the valkyries who get asked to take selfies are in a good mood |the good sort of attention, not cloying, just happy-to-be-here smiles and handshakes ]. "Goddess," Anni sighs. She surveys the blue, pink, purple pastel river streaming into the plaza. "I've missed this." Next to her, Halima chuckles. "The adulation?" "Just being in the city and seeing friendly faces again. Feels like old times. But," the older valkyrie allows, "the adulation's not bad either." [pc.dcb |As for you, you take the opportunity to do a little basking before you respond. "Feels nice when the crowd loves you." "Feels nice when we can give them a reason to," Anni says. |You smile at the crowd, wave at a few friendly elves, and turn a reassuring smile on Annika. "Old times can be new times now, too." She smiles fondly. "I like the sound of that." |Of course, while Anni and Halima are just talking about the crowd, you're saying hi to them! You wave excitedly at every elf who looks at you, give them your biggest and most radiant sun-mommy smile, bounce up and down a few times, and whenever a little elf kiddo catches sight of you, you do your absolute bestest to glow for them! Next to you, Anni gives you a li'l shoulder-hug[annika.kissed | and a smooch on the cheek ] at the first time you pause. "You're amazing. I'm glad we get to keep you, angel." "I'm glad, too!" you giggle, just before [annika.kissed |smooch |hugg ]ing her right back. ] But something interrupts you. From within, there's a deep, loud horn-blast, a BAAAA-WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA that thrums into your teeth. Time to go!

rows.original: With folded wings you and your sisters proceed through the crowd. Annika is in the lead, taking a measured pace[annika.kissed | — goddess, her wings are illuminating her muscular shoulders, and they look spectacular — |, ] while you and Thrud follow behind her one after the other and the rest of the valkyries form a double column to the rear. In your arms you bear a white linen-wrapped package, and inside is your share of the armor, just as light and easy to handle as Anni said it would be. Behind you, Thrud bears her own portion of the armor, barely visible within her immense arms. Near the cathedral, a temporary altar to Lumia has been erected, with an immense icon of the Sun in the middle and the statues of duality to either side: the Mother to the right and the Warrior to the left. A smaller icon of the Sun, easily able to fit in one's hand, sits on the altar itself, just below the larger one. On the lowest step stands Etheryn, no longer clad in her [etheryn.armor], instead opting for a white robe, along with [flags.ETHERYN_CROWNED|her grandmother's crown|what looks like her mother's crown]. Maybe it's the simplicity of the outfit, or the way she's standing, but she seems regally calm. Comfortable. Downright queenly, even, especially with the cohort of clergy and neo-nobility assembled with Elthara off to the side, and Harrick perched on a stand of his own right next to them. Annika halts several feet in front of Etheryn, and the rest of you follow suit. As one, you incline your heads to the queen. Then, the seneschal speaks, in words that boom across the square: "As sisters and comrades of Queen Atheldred Sunbringer, we, the Order of the Argent Wing, offer our friendship to all descendants of hers who walk in the Radiant Mother's light. What she did for us, and what you and your people continue to do for us, we can never fully repay. Beyond our oaths and vows of service to the Goddess, allow us to bestow upon you tokens of our enduring gratitude. "First," she continues, "the arms of light. A valkyrie's bulwark, to protect not merely herself, but all the innocent of the world." She raises the large round shield, decorated with a sunburst, faced with bronze, and glimmering in the torchlight. "And a valkyrie's spear, to vanquish the wicked so that they may never bring harm to those who cannot defend themselves." In her other hand, she hefts a long [silly |barge-pole of a |eight- or ten-foot ] polearm, expertly weighted with a Lumian sun-wing on the butt. Here's your turn. Silently but irrepressibly [pc.isBimbo |grinning |smiling ] up at Ryn, you step forward and hold up your burden, and you hear the rustle of Thrud doing the same behind you. Anni speaks for you both. "Then, the armor of light. Of finest bronze, in the style of Atheldred Sunbringer and all of us who have taken up arms alongside her. "Each of these items," she intones, "has been consecrated by our goddess herself to resist evil and corruption, just as all other arms and armor of the warriors of light. They will well serve any elvenqueen who does battle with the wicked." And, of course, they won't do much at all for someone who consorts with the wicked, but Anni leaves that particular bit unsaid. After Alissa, everybody's thinking it. Ryn pauses before she responds. Then: "These gifts are humbling, and I accept them wholeheartedly. You do me great honor by offering them — and you honor my mother and grandmother, too. Although your Order does not request anything in return, I wish to honor my ancestors in the same way you do, and so I offer this promise." She clears her throat. "I, Etheryn, First of the House of Ridell and Queen of the Boer'alvar, before the Sisters of the Argent Wing, [etheryn.married |my beloved [pc.mf |King |Queen ] Consort, [pc.name] |[pc.isValk |[pc.name], Champion of Lumia |[pc.isBaron |Baron[pc.mf | |ess ] [pc.name] of the March |[pc.name], Champion of Frost ] ] ], High Priestess Elthara, and all Njorhaalt, swear in the name of Lumia and all the Seven to defend the people of the north from the darkness in the same way that my mother and my mother's mother did. And if I swear well, may the gods continue to bless myself, my family, and my people; if I forswear, may they bring destruction upon me." From her side, Elthara pipes up: "I witness this in Lumia's light." [pc.isBimbo |"Oooh! I also witness in Lumia's light!" you say proudly. |"I, too," you add, "witness this in Lumia's light." ] A murmur of approval runs through the crowd. Next to you, Anni smiles. "So witnessed, and so agreed. Let Her Majesty be clad as a Lumian warrior." You and Thrud now step forward, unwrapping the linen around Ryn's armor. There's definitely a little blush around both her cheeks and her ears as the elvenqueen disrobes, leaving only a modest top and bottom. The blush gets all the deeper as you help buckle the chestplate on, leaning in close from behind to [etheryn.confessed |brush her cheek with your lips |give her a reassuring shoulder-squeeze ]. Thrud works slowly, and you match her pace, giving reverential weight to every strap you tighten. Armlets, leggings, gorget; you give special attention to the little Lumian winged-sun icon that sits right between Ryn's breasts. Then, with a respectful nod[etheryn.confessed | and a [pc.isBimbo |blown kiss |romantic wink ] ], you back away and make space for Anni to bestow the shield and spear on her. [etheryn.highConfidence |Now that it's just her and Harrick on the altar, Ryn raises an open hand and the crowd murmurs die down. She takes hold of the spear, then examines it closely, taking a good look at the point, the inlay, the Lumia-enchanted decoration. rows.translation: 你们姐妹俩收起翅膀，穿梭在人群之中。安妮卡走在最前面，步伐从容而稳重。[annika.kissed | — 女神啊，她的双翼照亮了她那结实的肩膀，看起来真是美极了壮观极了 — |， ]你和斯露德一个接一个地跟在她后面，其余的瓦尔基里则排成两列走在后面。你怀里抱着一个用白色亚麻布包裹着的包裹，里面装着你的那份盔甲——正如安妮所说，它确实轻便易携带。在你身后，瑟拉德肩负着自己那部分护甲，那厚重的护甲在她的巨臂中几乎看不出来。 在大教堂附近，人们搭建了一个临时祭坛来供奉卢米娅，祭坛中央摆放着一幅巨大的太阳象征图案，两侧则立着代表二元性的雕像：右边是母亲的形象，左边则是战士的形象。在祭坛上，放置着一个较小的太阳图标，它的大小正好适合放在手中，位于那个较大的太阳图标下方。在最下装的台阶上，站着伊瑟琳，她已经不再穿着之前的衣服了。[etheryn.armor]相反，他选择穿了一件白色长袍。 [flags.ETHERYN_CROWNED|她祖母的王冠|看起来像她母亲的王冠]也许是因为这套服装的简洁设计，或是她的站立姿势，让她显得格外镇定自若、充满自信。甚至有一种女王般的威严感，尤其是当那些神职人员和新贵族们聚集在艾尔萨拉身旁时，而哈里克也独自站在他们旁边时，这种感觉更加明显了。 安妮卡在伊瑟琳面前几英尺的地方停了下来，其他人也纷纷跟在她的后面。你们一起向女王低头致意。随后，那位管家开口说道，他的声音在广场上回荡：“作为阿瑟尔雷德·桑布林格女王的姐妹和战友，我们‘银翼骑士团’向所有追随光明之母的她的女儿们表示我们的友谊。她为我们所做的一切，以及你和你的团队至今仍在为我们所做的这些，我们永远都无法完全报答。除了我们对女神立下的誓言和效忠的承诺之外，让我们以这些象征来表达我们永恒的感激之情吧。 首先，”她继续说道，“那就是轻型之臂。作为女武神的盾牌，它不仅保护着她自己，也守护着世界上所有无辜的人。”她举起了那面巨大的圆形盾牌——上面饰有太阳放射状的图案，盾面为青铜材质，在火把的光芒下闪烁着微光。还有一支女武神的长矛，用来击败那些邪恶之徒，让他们再也无法伤害那些无法自卫的人。”她另一只手握着那支长长的长矛。 [silly |笨重的支柱 |八到十英尺长 ]这把长柄武器在柄部巧妙地加装了卢米安太阳翼，使其重量得到完美平衡。 现在轮到你了。行动要悄无声息，但必须果断有力。 [pc.isBimbo |咧着嘴笑 |微笑 ]在小琳高地，你向前迈出一步，举起了自己的负担，同时听到身后瑟鲁德也在做着同样的事。安妮代表你们两人说道：“那么，就是那件轻型之铠甲吧。它由最上等的青铜制成，其设计风格继承了阿瑟德雷德·阳光使者以及所有与她并肩作战的勇士们的传统。 每一件这样的物品，”她缓缓说道，“都是由我们的女神亲自赐予的，它们被用来抵御邪恶与腐败，就像所有光之战士使用的武器与铠甲一样。任何与邪恶势力作战的精灵女王，都会这些物品发挥出巨大的作用。当然，对于那些与恶人勾结的人，他们也不会采取任何行动，但安妮并没有明确提到这一点。在艾莉莎的事情之后，大家都在这么想。 小琳在回答之前停顿了一下。然后她说：“这些礼物让我感到十分荣幸，我衷心接受它们。你们赠送这些礼物，既给了我莫大的尊重，也让我母亲和祖母感到无比光荣。虽然你们的组织并没有要求任何回报，但我希望也能以同样的方式来纪念我的祖先，因此我做出这个承诺。她清了清嗓子，说道：“我，伊瑟琳，里德尔家族的长女，也是博尔阿尔瓦的女王，在银翼姐妹面前宣布[etheryn.married |我亲爱的[pc.mf |国王 |女王 ]配偶，[pc.name] |[pc.isValk |[pc.name]，卢米亚的冠军 |[pc.isBaron |男爵[pc.mf | |ess ] [pc.name]三月的事情 |[pc.name]，寒冰勇士 ] ] ]大祭司艾尔萨拉以及所有的恩乔哈尔特人们，都以卢米娅以及七神的名义宣誓：要像我的母亲和她的母亲那样，保护北方人民免受黑暗的侵害。如果我遵守了这个誓言，愿诸神继续保佑我、我的家人以及我的族人；如果我违背了这个誓言，愿诸神降下毁灭降临在我身上。 站在她一旁的艾尔萨拉轻声说道：“我在卢米娅的光芒之下见证这一誓言。 [pc.isBimbo |哦哦！我也能在卢米娅的光芒中见证这一切！”你自豪地说道。 |我也一样，”你接着说道，“在卢米娅的光芒下，我亲眼见证了这一幕。 ] 人群中传来一阵赞同的低语。 站在你身边的安妮微笑着说道：“大家都同意了，那就让女王穿上卢米安战士的服装吧。” 你和瑟拉德一起走上前，解开了包裹在小琳盔甲上的亚麻布。当这位精灵女王脱下衣服，只剩下简单的上衣和下装时，她的脸颊和耳朵确实泛起了红晕。当你帮她扣上胸甲时，你从背后靠近她，她的红晕变得更加明显了[etheryn.confessed |用你的嘴唇轻触她的脸颊 |轻轻拍拍她的肩膀，给她一种安慰的感觉 ]斯露德的动作很缓慢，你也跟着她的节奏来，每收紧一根带子时，都带着一种虔诚的态度。护臂、护腿、项圈……你特别留意了那个位于小琳胸前、象征着Lumian族的小翅膀太阳图案。然后，你恭敬地点了点头。[etheryn.confessed | 还有[pc.isBimbo |飞吻 |浪漫的眨眼 ] ]你退后一步，为安妮留出空间，让她将盾牌和长矛授予你。 伊瑟琳确实看起来就像一位战士精灵女王的翻版——当然，她的个子没有那么高，也没有那么健壮，但战斗服装穿在她身上确实非常合适。[var0| 尤其是考虑到她现在那迷人的曲线。[silly | 哎哟。 ]][var1| 她真的做它们与安置在荒废驿堡一带的那位战士精灵雕像非常相似。]当然，让这一画面更加完整的是哈里克——它威风凛凛地飞过来，落在了小琳的肩上。 [etheryn.highConfidence |现在只剩下她和哈里克站在祭坛前，小琳举起手掌，人群中的嘈杂声渐渐消失了。她握住那支长矛，仔细端详着它的矛头、镶嵌的纹饰，以及那些被卢米娅施加了魔法的装饰。一阵漫长的、充满期待的时刻悄然流逝，就连你也能感受到那种令人兴奋的紧张感。然后，她胜利地将其高高举向空中，那些镶嵌在上面的魔法饰品仿佛都被太阳的光芒点燃了一般，闪烁着耀眼的光芒。 人群中那震耳欲聋的呐喊声淹没了所有其他声音。 |她站在那里，身披崭新的闪亮铠甲，环视着周围的人群。她露出的笑容并非平静自若，也并非毫不动摇，但却充满了真挚的情感。人群的反应也随之而来——起初只是零星的掌声和欢呼声，但随着越来越多的精灵加入到这种表达喜悦的情绪中，欢呼声逐渐变得响亮起来，最终震耳欲聋，长时间地持续着。 ]
rows.raw: ' With folded wings you and your sisters proceed through the crowd. Annika is in the lead, taking a measured pace[annika.kissed | — goddess, her wings are illuminating her muscular shoulders, and they look spectacular — |, ] while you and Thrud follow behind her one after the other and the rest of the valkyries form a double column to the rear. In your arms you bear a white linen-wrapped package, and inside is your share of the armor, just as light and easy to handle as Anni said it would be. Behind you, Thrud bears her own portion of the armor, barely visible within her immense arms. Near the cathedral, a temporary altar to Lumia has been erected, with an immense icon of the Sun in the middle and the statues of duality to either side: the Mother to the right and the Warrior to the left. A smaller icon of the Sun, easily able to fit in one's hand, sits on the altar itself, just below the larger one. On the lowest step stands Etheryn, no longer clad in her [etheryn.armor], instead opting for a white robe, along with [flags.ETHERYN_CROWNED|her grandmother's crown|what looks like her mother's crown]. Maybe it's the simplicity of the outfit, or the way she's standing, but she seems regally calm. Comfortable. Downright queenly, even, especially with the cohort of clergy and neo-nobility assembled with Elthara off to the side, and Harrick perched on a stand of his own right next to them. Annika halts several feet in front of Etheryn, and the rest of you follow suit. As one, you incline your heads to the queen. Then, the seneschal speaks, in words that boom across the square: "As sisters and comrades of Queen Atheldred Sunbringer, we, the Order of the Argent Wing, offer our friendship to all descendants of hers who walk in the Radiant Mother's light. What she did for us, and what you and your people continue to do for us, we can never fully repay. Beyond our oaths and vows of service to the Goddess, allow us to bestow upon you tokens of our enduring gratitude. "First," she continues, "the arms of light. A valkyrie's bulwark, to protect not merely herself, but all the innocent of the world." She raises the large round shield, decorated with a sunburst, faced with bronze, and glimmering in the torchlight. "And a valkyrie's spear, to vanquish the wicked so that they may never bring harm to those who cannot defend themselves." In her other hand, she hefts a long [silly |barge-pole of a |eight- or ten-foot ] polearm, expertly weighted with a Lumian sun-wing on the butt. Here's your turn. Silently but irrepressibly [pc.isBimbo |grinning |smiling ] up at Ryn, you step forward and hold up your burden, and you hear the rustle of Thrud doing the same behind you. Anni speaks for you both. "Then, the armor of light. Of finest bronze, in the style of Atheldred Sunbringer and all of us who have taken up arms alongside her. "Each of these items," she intones, "has been consecrated by our goddess herself to resist evil and corruption, just as all other arms and armor of the warriors of light. They will well serve any elvenqueen who does battle with the wicked." And, of course, they won't do much at all for someone who consorts with the wicked, but Anni leaves that particular bit unsaid. After Alissa, everybody's thinking it. Ryn pauses before she responds. Then: "These gifts are humbling, and I accept them wholeheartedly. You do me great honor by offering them — and you honor my mother and grandmother, too. Although your Order does not request anything in return, I wish to honor my ancestors in the same way you do, and so I offer this promise." She clears her throat. "I, Etheryn, First of the House of Ridell and Queen of the Boer'alvar, before the Sisters of the Argent Wing, [etheryn.married |my beloved [pc.mf |King |Queen ] Consort, [pc.name] |[pc.isValk |[pc.name], Champion of Lumia |[pc.isBaron |Baron[pc.mf | |ess ] [pc.name] of the March |[pc.name], Champion of Frost ] ] ], High Priestess Elthara, and all Njorhaalt, swear in the name of Lumia and all the Seven to defend the people of the north from the darkness in the same way that my mother and my mother's mother did. And if I swear well, may the gods continue to bless myself, my family, and my people; if I forswear, may they bring destruction upon me." From her side, Elthara pipes up: "I witness this in Lumia's light." [pc.isBimbo |"Oooh! I also witness in Lumia's light!" you say proudly. |"I, too," you add, "witness this in Lumia's light." ] A murmur of approval runs through the crowd. Next to you, Anni smiles. "So witnessed, and so agreed. Let Her Majesty be clad as a Lumian warrior." You and Thrud now step forward, unwrapping the linen around Ryn's armor. There's definitely a little blush around both her cheeks and her ears as the elvenqueen disrobes, leaving only a modest top and bottom. The blush gets all the deeper as you help buckle the chestplate on, leaning in close from behind to [etheryn.confessed |brush her cheek with your lips |give her a reassuring shoulder-squeeze ]. Thrud works slowly, and you match her pace, giving reverential weight to every strap you tighten. Armlets, leggings, gorget; you give special attention to the little Lumian winged-sun icon that sits right between Ryn's breasts. Then, with a respectful nod[etheryn.confessed | and a [pc.isBimbo |blown kiss |romantic wink ] ], you back away and make space for Anni to bestow the shield and spear on her. Etheryn truly does look like the spitting image of a warrior elvenqueen — not quite as tall, of course, or as amazonian, but the garb of battle sits well on her.[var0| Especially given her new curves.[silly | Yowza. ]][var1| She really does resemble the warrior elf statue placed in the Wayfort.] What completes the image, of course, is Harrick, who majestically flaps his way over to perch on Ryn's shoulder. [etheryn.highConfidence |Now that it's just her and Harrick on the altar, Ryn raises an open hand and the crowd murmurs die down. She takes hold of the spear, then examines it closely, taking a good look at the point, the inlay, the Lumia-enchanted decoration. There is a long, pregnant pause, and even you can feel the prickle of anticipation on your skin. Then, triumphantly, she thrusts it high into the air, and all the enchantments on it glow with the fire of the sun herself. The deafening roar of the crowd drowns everything else out. |She stands there, resplendent in her new shining armor, and surveys the crowd. The smile she manages isn't a serene or unflappable one, but it is completely genuine. And the crowd responds, first with a trickle of clapping and cheering, then with a torrent, as more and more of the elves join in the outpouring of a feeling of relief. Within seconds the cheering is loud enough to keep you from hearing anything else, and it stays that way for a long time. ] '

rows.original: Much later, when everything's died down, Annika tells the crowd that she and the other valkyries brought food and drink and that it's in the cathedral. Many elves start migrating over there, although dozens who pass the altar where you, Ryn, and the valkyries still stand let loose with more spontaneous (if somewhat hoarse) cheers before following the others in. Each valkyrie also stands in line to greet and congratulate the queen; all are taller than Ryn, but when they bow only Thrud is still large enough to best her height. [etheryn.highConfidence |As you watch Ryn meet with the valkyries, there's a sudden weight on your shoulder and — oh, it's Harrick. One murderbird eye looks at you sidelong from his new perch. "Hey, there, big guy," you chuckle. "Did I do a good job helping your mama get all fancy-looking?" He does let out the usual "SCREEEEEEEEE!" He also nuzzles up to the side of your head and trills out something a little lower and softer. "I," you murmur, "will take that as a yes." "SCREEEEE-EEEEEEEEEE!" Affection duly bestowed, Harrick hops off of you and returns to his old perch. ] Annika is last in line, and when she reaches the two of you, she grins. "[etheryn.highConfidence |That was a nice touch |You did pretty well ], Your Majesty." "Thank you." Ryn's still wearing a delighted smile of her own. "[etheryn.highConfidence |It just seemed like the right thing to do |I'm just... trying to do my best ], you know?" "I do," she says warmly. "And it was. You're better at this than you think you are." "And thank you, too," the armored queen giggles, rushing over to give you a hug. "I'm so glad you were here!" You hug her right back. "[etheryn.confessed |[pc.dcb |I could spare the time. |Wouldn't have missed it. |Me too! ] I got to see you be queenly, help you with your oath and your armor, and smooch you in front of the whole city." [etheryn.highConfidence |"I liked every part of that," she tells you. "Especially the last part." You make a little check sign in the air. "[pc.isBimbo |Okie-dokie! |Okay, then. ] More public smooches." "Just be careful," Ryn warns playfully. "Elvenqueens smooch back." "[pc.isBimbo |I betcha can't prove it! |Oh, do they? Prove it. ]" She does. |"And make me blush!" She tries and fails to manage a look of stern disapproval; it just dissolves into smiles. "So is that a yes or no on more public smooches?" Ryn smiles shyly. "Yes, please." ] |Me, too. [pc.dcb |The change of plans was fine with you? |You don't mind that I was part of the ceremony, do you? |It's okay that I went off with the other sun mommies, right? ]" "I loved it! You put on my armor and everything." The hug gets a little tighter[pc.heightRange 60 72 |, enough for the gentle chill of her ear to brush against the side of your head | as she presses the side of her head into your chest | as she presses the side of your head into her chest ]. "I'm lucky to have such a wonderful friend." ] Anni smiles and stands patiently by while the two of you hug it out. Once you and Ryn separate, the older valkyrie clears her throat. "There's also a more practical side to all this, too. Now you'll be able to fight alongside [pc.himHer] as a more traditional sort of infantry." "Protected by the shield of an elven warrior queen," you muse. "[etheryn.confessed |Hot. |[pc.isBimbo |That's pretty sexy. |Some of the other valkyries might get jealous of me. ] ]" The only thing that staves off Ryn's blush now is her excitement. "I've already been training! Anytime you need me, I'll be there." The seneschal inclines her head respectfully. "And we'll be happy to support you as well, Your Majesty. Good luck out there." She pauses, then: "Before you go... we did bring an awful lot of food. You should swing by and pick some up for the road before you leave." Acquired Etheryn's Set: Lumian Battle Dress! You can change Etheryn's equipped set in the Character Sheet tab of the Journal while she is in your party!
rows.translation: 很久以后，当一切都平息下来时，安妮卡告诉众人，她和其他女武神们带来了食物和饮料，那些物资被放在了大教堂里。许多精灵开始向那里迁移，不过还是有几十只精灵在经过你们——小琳和那些女武神们站立的祭坛时，自发地发出了欢呼声，然后才跟随着其他人一起走了进去。每一位女武神也都排好队列，前来迎接并祝贺女王；她们的个子都比小琳高，但当她们鞠躬时，只有瑟鲁德的身高仍然足以超过她。 [etheryn.highConfidence |当你看着小琳与女武神们会面时，突然感到肩膀上多了什么重物——哦，是哈里克。它从新找到的位置上，用那只独眼斜睨着你。 “嘿，大块头，”你笑着说道。我帮你妈妈弄得这么漂亮，做得还不错吧？” 然后它果然发出了那声惯常的“吱吱吱！”同时还会把头凑到你的耳边，用更低更轻的声音发出一些声音。 我，”你低声说道，“就把这当作同意吧。” “吱——呀——！”哈里克收到了你表达的关爱，从你身上跳下来，回到了它原来的位置。 ] 安妮卡站在队伍的末尾，当她走到你们俩跟前时，她露出了微笑。[etheryn.highConfidence |这个点子真是太妙了。 |你做得相当不错。 ]陛下。” “谢谢。”小琳脸上依然挂着愉悦的笑容。[etheryn.highConfidence |这样做似乎就是正确的选择。 |我只是……在尽我最大的努力而已。 ]你知道吗？” “我知道，”她温暖地回答，“确实如此。你在这方面做得比自己想象的要好。” “谢谢你我也是，”那位身着铠甲的女王咯咯笑着，跑过来拥抱了你。“真高兴你在这里！” 你也回抱了她。[etheryn.confessed |[pc.dcb |我有时间去做这件事。 |我肯定不会错过它的。 |我也一样！ ]我真想看到你展现出女王般的风范，帮你完成宣誓仪式，帮你穿上铠甲，还要在整座城市的人面前亲吻你。 [etheryn.highConfidence |我真的很喜欢其中的每一个环节，”她对你说，“尤其是最后那部分。” 你在空中做了一个小小的确认手势。[pc.isBimbo |好的，没问题！ |好的，那就这样吧。 ]更多的公开亲热行为吧。” “不过要小心点，”小琳开玩笑地提醒道，“精灵女王们可是会回吻的哦。”[pc.isBimbo |我打赌你根本无法证明这一点！ |哦，是吗？那就证明给我看吧。 ]她确实这么做了。 |害得我都脸红了！”她努力表现出严厉的不赞同，但那表情很快就变成了笑容。 “那么，这是同意再公开接吻吗？” 小琳害羞地笑了：“是的，请吧。 ] |我也是。 [pc.dcb |你同意这个计划的变更吗？ |你不会介意我参与了那个仪式吧？ |我和其他那些“太阳妈妈”们一起走了，这样也没关系吧？ ]我太喜欢了！你甚至为我穿上了盔甲，一切都准备得那么周到。”这个拥抱变得更加紧了一些。[pc.heightRange 60 72 |这种轻柔的触感，足以让她的耳朵轻轻触碰到你的头部。 | 当她将头部靠在你的胸前时 | 当她将你的头部轻轻按在她的胸前时 ]能拥有这样一位出色的朋友，我真是太幸运了。 ] 安妮微笑着，耐心地站在一旁，等待你们俩解决矛盾。等你们和小琳分开后，那位年长的女武神清了清嗓子，说道：“其实这一切还有更实际的意义——现在你们可以并肩作战了。[pc.himHer]作为一种更为传统的步兵形式。” “受到一位精灵战士女王的保护，”你不禁思索道。[etheryn.confessed |热。 |[pc.isBimbo |那可真是太性感了。 |其他一些女武神可能会因此嫉妒我。 ] ]现在，唯一能阻止小琳脸红的原因就是她的兴奋之情。“我已经开始训练了！无论您什么时候需要我，我都会立刻赶到。” 女管家恭敬地点了点头：“陛下，我们也很乐意为您提供支持。祝您一切顺利。”她稍作停顿，然后继续说道：“在您离开之前……我们做了带了很多食物呢。你在出发前应该顺便来拿一些路上吃吧。 获得了伊瑟琳的套装：卢米安战斗服！ 当伊瑟琳在你的队伍中时，你可以在日志的“角色信息”标签页中更改她所装备的物品组合！
rows.raw: ' Much later, when everything's died down, Annika tells the crowd that she and the other valkyries brought food and drink and that it's in the cathedral. Many elves start migrating over there, although dozens who pass the altar where you, Ryn, and the valkyries still stand let loose with more spontaneous (if somewhat hoarse) cheers before following the others in. Each valkyrie also stands in line to greet and congratulate the queen; all are taller than Ryn, but when they bow only Thrud is still large enough to best her height. [etheryn.highConfidence |As you watch Ryn meet with the valkyries, there's a sudden weight on your shoulder and — oh, it's Harrick. One murderbird eye looks at you sidelong from his new perch. "Hey, there, big guy," you chuckle. "Did I do a good job helping your mama get all fancy-looking?" He does let out the usual "SCREEEEEEEEE!" He also nuzzles up to the side of your head and trills out something a little lower and softer. "I," you murmur, "will take that as a yes." "SCREEEEE-EEEEEEEEEE!" Affection duly bestowed, Harrick hops off of you and returns to his old perch. ] Annika is last in line, and when she reaches the two of you, she grins. "[etheryn.highConfidence |That was a nice touch |You did pretty well ], Your Majesty." "Thank you." Ryn's still wearing a delighted smile of her own. "[etheryn.highConfidence |It just seemed like the right thing to do |I'm just... trying to do my best ], you know?" "I do," she says warmly. "And it was. You're better at this than you think you are." "And thank you, too," the armored queen giggles, rushing over to give you a hug. "I'm so glad you were here!" You hug her right back. "[etheryn.confessed |[pc.dcb |I could spare the time. |Wouldn't have missed it. |Me too! ] I got to see you be queenly, help you with your oath and your armor, and smooch you in front of the whole city." [etheryn.highConfidence |"I liked every part of that," she tells you. "Especially the last part." You make a little check sign in the air. "[pc.isBimbo |Okie-dokie! |Okay, then. ] More public smooches." "Just be careful," Ryn warns playfully. "Elvenqueens smooch back." "[pc.isBimbo |I betcha can't prove it! |Oh, do they? Prove it. ]" She does. |"And make me blush!" She tries and fails to manage a look of stern disapproval; it just dissolves into smiles. "So is that a yes or no on more public smooches?" Ryn smiles shyly. "Yes, please." ] |Me, too. [pc.dcb |The change of plans was fine with you? |You don't mind that I was part of the ceremony, do you? |It's okay that I went off with the other sun mommies, right? ]" "I loved it! You put on my armor and everything." The hug gets a little tighter[pc.heightRange 60 72 |, enough for the gentle chill of her ear to brush against the side of your head | as she presses the side of her head into your chest | as she presses the side of your head into her chest ]. "I'm lucky to have such a wonderful friend." ] Anni smiles and stands patiently by while the two of you hug it out. Once you and Ryn separate, the older valkyrie clears her throat. "There's also a more practical side to all this, too. Now you'll be able to fight alongside [pc.himHer] as a more traditional sort of infantry." "Protected by the shield of an elven warrior queen," you muse. "[etheryn.confessed |Hot. |[pc.isBimbo |That's pretty sexy. |Some of the other valkyries might get jealous of me. ] ]" The only thing that staves off Ryn's blush now is her excitement. "I've already been training! Anytime you need me, I'll be there." The seneschal inclines her head respectfully. "And we'll be happy to support you as well, Your Majesty. Good luck out there." She pauses, then: "Before you go... we did bring an awful lot of food. You should swing by and pick some up for the road before you leave." Acquired Etheryn's Set: Lumian Battle Dress! You can change Etheryn's equipped set in the Character Sheet tab of the Journal while she is in your party! '

rows.original: [party.Yall] join the pastel river of elves flowing into the plaza. Many of them recognize you with waves and appreciative claps, but fortunately, no one makes it too awkward. The valkyries, too, recognize you; Annika, Thrud, and dozens of other warriors of light are down a side street not far away, and they give you a respectful nod[var1| and a few blown kisses] as you pass through the portal. There are easily hundreds of elves already in the square, and more streaming in from the various side streets that wind through the Winter City. Only one open space is left: a cleared zone in front of a temporary altar that's been erected not far from the entrance to the cathedral. The altar, a raised platform with three large statues of Lumia — the Sun in the middle, the Mother to the right, and the Warrior to the left — is surrounded by a gaggle of priestesses and acolytes, including Elthara[party.has etheryn |. "That's where we should be," Ryn says. "[etheryn.highConfidence |Is that all right with you? |I[etheryn.lowConfidence |-I ]f you're comfortable with it, anyway... ]" "Sure[pc.isBimbo |! |. ] Lead the way." You're sure you could've pressed through the crowd without too much difficulty, but when a queen is holding one's hand, there's no difficulty at all. Elves somehow manage to make space for [party.yall], clapping, cheering, and bowing as you pass. It's enough to darken the tips of Ryn's ears[etheryn.highConfidence | — but only just. She's gotten better at the whole composure thing in a fairly short time. | and set her to smiling. It's a[etheryn.lowConfidence | | slightly ] nervous smile, but it's a genuine one. ] In no time at all, you've reached Elthara and the priestesses. Again, Ryn takes the lead. "We made it!" The taller elf's eyes twinkle gold. "With minutes to spare. I think you've got just enough time to change; there's a room in the cathedral with everything you need." "Before I do —" Ryn turns back to you. "Since you were able to make it, I wanted to ask... it's not normally part of the ceremony, but we thought it would be a good idea to include me swearing an oath. Would it be all right if I called on you as one of the witnesses with Elthara and Annika?" "You wouldn't have to say much," the high priestess adds. "Annika and I will simply be saying that we witness her oath, and you could chime in as well." "[pc.isBimbo |If it's thaaaaat easy," you tell Ryn, "then I can do that, sure!" |That sounds [pc.isDK |easy |simple ] enough." You shrug amiably. "Sure, Ryn. I can do that." ] She sighs with relief. "Thank you." "Indeed. Thank you, [pc.name]." Elthara gives you a nod, then briskly turns to one of the acolytes. "Anthea, would you show Her Majesty where her robes are?" |, as well as Etheryn herself. Her Majesty looks [etheryn.lnhConfidence |pretty nervous |a little nervous |quite composed ] up there, but that vanishes in favor of a delighted smile as soon as she sees you in the crowd. As soon as she sees you, she waves you up to the dais with the kind of excitement that might perhaps not be completely compatible with the sort of composure a queen is supposed to maintain. Not that you mind, of course. In fact, there's one benefit to everyone being able to see how excited Ryn is to see you: the crowd makes space pretty readily. You wouldn't have had that much trouble pushing through without it, but you have to admit: a more-or-less clear shot to the altar and the cheers and claps of hundreds of elves aren't half bad. Plus, as soon as you arrive at the altar, you greet Ryn with [etheryn.confessed |a hug and a kiss |a friendly hug ]. "Hey there. [pc.dcb |Right on time. |I'm glad I made it. |I'm heee-eeere! ]" "[pc.dcb |You are |I am, too |Hey yourself ]!" She fairly beams at you. "I wanted to make sure I had time to see you before I had to change." "Which you... technically do," Elthara points out, smiling, "if only barely. Shall I ask someone to help you find your robes?" Ryn [etheryn.lnhConfidence |blushes deeply |lets a shy blush creep onto her cheeks |giggles sheepishly ]. "Y[etheryn.lowConfidence |-y ]es, please. Just one second!" She turns back to you. "I... I wanted to add a little something to the ceremony. An oath. It's... well, one of the reasons I wanted you to be here is so you could witness it for me, along with Elthara and Annika. Is that — are you okay with that?" [pc.dcb |You shrug. "Sure, I don't mind." |"Of course I am," you say reassuringly. "I'm glad I didn't miss it." |You don't miss a beat: "Sure, sweetie! That sounds nice and easy." ] "Thank you!" Her shoulders sag with relief. "Okay, I'll see you in a little bit." With Ryn's request made, Elthara turns to one of her acolytes, who steps forward gracefully. "Anthea, would you show Her Majesty where the changing room is?" ] Ryn beckons Harrick down and directs him to a perch set up near the altar just for him. "Hey, buddy. Could you wait here for me until I'm back?" [etheryn.highConfidence |He lands on it for a few moments, then cocks his head — and flaps over to your arm instead. "Oh!" You smile. "Uh, that's fine, too." Ryn giggles. "So long as you're okay with it! I'll see you in a bit." |He dutifully takes up position there with not so much as a skree. "Thanks! I'll see you in a bit!" ] You[etheryn.highConfidence | and Harrick — who's nuzzling up against you, because he is a very good bird — ] and El watch Ryn and the acolyte disappear into the cathedral, then turn back to the bustling crowd. The sheer number of elves is enough to coax a low whistle from you. "[pc.isBimbo |Wow! This is kind of a big dealio. |This is a big deal, huh? ]" "[pc.isBimbo |A very big dealio |Very ]," the high priestess confirms. "We've only ever had this ceremony twice before: once shortly after Etheryn's mother's coronation, and once again after Alissa's. Neither was a valkyrie, so the Order visited to offer the tools of a warrior of Lumia, fit for a queen: armor of proof and arms of light." You raise an eyebrow. "[pc.isBimbo |Waitwaitwait — ]Alissa got this too?" "She rarely used it. After her father passed away, she mostly dressed and armed herself for the hunt, the close ties with the valkyries faded into abeyance, and even I ended up more a nuisance at court than a partner of the crown. You know the story from there." The priestess sighs. "It'll be nice to get back to the way things were from here on out." [pc.dcb |"Seems like a lot of[pc.ra elf | frost ] elves feel that way," you observe. |"That makes sense." You survey the pastel rivers of excited elves still streaming into the great square. "The rest of the city seems to feel the same way." |"Oooh! I understand," you say sagely. "And all the other chilly elves think the same way too, right?" ] Elthara smiles warmly. "It'll feel much safer to renew the protection of the goddess. Besides," she continues, winking, "it's a nice show[var0| — one that I don't have to manage for the most part, thank Lumia]." "[pc.isBimbo |Oh! By the way! Um... what do I do in the ceremony? |Speaking of which, what do I do for all this? ]" "If you[etheryn.highConfidence | and Harrick ] stand with me and the clergy, you'll have the best view," she says. "It's a short ceremony, and relatively simple. And all the words are in Belharan, not Alvarin; many of our Lumian prayers are actually in your language anyway, and besides, not every [pc.swornGod lumia |one of your sisters |valkyrie ] grew up in our lands." "Okay..." "The valkyries will present the war-gear to Etheryn and then she'll put it on. There usually isn't much of a speech on either side, but there are a few words, in addition to the oath she'll be making. For that, all you have to do is say that you'll witness when prompted[silly |; there's no need to be certified as a notary public or anything beforehand ]. At the end, traditionally, as guests of the city, the valkyries usually bring food and drink for after — some of the other clergy are setting it up in the cathedral." "[pc.isBimbo |Okie-dokie! |Sounds cool. ] And when do we know it's starting?" "When Her Majesty is ready, we'll blow the horn." She points at the cathedral steps, which Ryn is taking at a brisk pace, wearing her crown but otherwise dressed only in a simple white robe. "And there she is now." As soon as the queen makes her way to the altar, she turns to face the crowd, breathes deeply, and pauses for a few seconds. Then she nods to a tall, well-muscled elven guardsman on the opposite end of the altar from you and Elthara. He lifts the mouthpiece of a long birchbark horn[pc.bg scholar | — a lur, you're pretty sure — ] and the crowd noise dies down. Only then does he play an immense, loud BAAAA-WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA that vibrates into you and through you. Time for the ceremony to begin.

|他在上面停留了片刻，然后歪了歪头，反而飞到了你的手臂上。 “哦！”你笑着说，“嗯，这样也挺好的。” 小琳咯咯笑了起来：“只要你没意见就行！一会儿见吧。 |他尽职尽责地站在那里，甚至连一句怨言都没有说过。尖叫谢谢！过一会儿见！ ] 你[etheryn.highConfidence | 还有哈里克——它正依偎在你身边，因为它确实是一只非常可爱的小鸟…… ]确实如此，”大祭司确认道，“这种仪式在我们历史上只举行过两次：一次是在伊瑟琳的母亲加冕之后不久，另一次则是在阿丽莎加冕之后。那两次的主持者都不是女武神，因此圣殿组织特意送来了属于卢米亚战士的武器与盔甲——这些装备正是适合一位女王使用的。” 你挑了挑眉毛，问道：“啊？[pc.isBimbo |等等等等—— ]阿丽莎也得到了这个吗？” “她很少使用它。在她父亲去世后，她主要是自己准备服装、配备武器去参加狩猎活动；与女武神的紧密联系也逐渐淡化了，甚至在我看来，她在宫廷里更像是个麻烦人物，而不是王室的得力助手。从那以后的事情，你应该也知道吧。”女祭司叹了口气，“从现在开始，如果能恢复到以前的状态，该多好啊。 [pc.dcb |看起来数量挺多的[pc.ra elf | 霜冻 ]精灵们就是这么觉得的，”你观察到。 |有道理。”你观察着那些兴奋的精灵们，他们依然源源不断地涌向那个巨大的广场。“这座城市的其他地方似乎也有同样的感受。 |哦哦，我明白了，”你睿智地说道，“其他那些冷漠的精灵们也是这么想的，对吧？ ] 艾尔萨拉温暖地笑了起来。“重新获得女神的保护，会让人感到安全许多。而且，”她眨了眨眼继续说道，“这也是一件挺有趣的事情呢。[var0| ——一个基本上我完全不需要去管理的系统，多亏了卢米娅]。” "[pc.isBimbo |哦！对了！嗯……在仪式上我应该做什么呢？ |说起来，我究竟要为这一切做些什么呢？ ]如果你[etheryn.highConfidence | 还有哈里克 ]和我还有神职人员们站在一起，你们就能看到最好的景象了，”她说。“这个仪式很简短，也比较简单。所有的祷文都是用贝尔哈兰语写的，而不是阿尔瓦林语；其实我们卢米安人的很多祷文本来就是用你们的语言表达的。而且，也不是所有人[pc.swornGod lumia |你的一个姐妹 |女武神 ]在我们这片土地上长大的。” “好的……” “女武神们会将战具交给伊瑟琳，然后她就会穿上它。通常双方都不会说太多话，但除了她会宣誓之外，还会有一些简短的致辞。至于这部分，你只需要在需要时表示会见证这一过程就可以了。[silly |没有必要事先取得公证员资格或其他类似的认证。 ]最后，按照传统，作为这座城市的宾客，女武神们通常会准备食物和饮料供大家享用——其他一些神职人员正在大教堂里准备这些食物和饮料。[pc.isBimbo |好的，没问题！ |听起来很酷。 ]那我们什么时候能知道它开始了呢？” “等到女王陛下准备好了，我们就会吹响号角。”她指向那座大教堂的台阶，而小琳正快步走上那些台阶，她戴着皇冠，其他地方只穿着一件简单的白色长袍。她现在就在那里。” 当女王走向祭坛时，她转过身面对人群，深吸一口气，停顿了几秒钟。然后，她向祭坛另一端、站在你和艾尔萨拉对面的那位高大、肌肉结实的精灵卫兵点了点头。他举起了那支由长桦树皮制成的号角的吹口。[pc.bg scholar | — 一个潜伏。你应该是相当确定的吧—— ]人群的喧闹声渐渐消失了。 直到那时，他才开始播放那段庞大而响亮的音乐。BAAAA-WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA那种能够触动你内心、贯穿你整个身体的感觉……现在，仪式即将开始了。
rows.raw: ' [party.Yall] join the pastel river of elves flowing into the plaza. Many of them recognize you with waves and appreciative claps, but fortunately, no one makes it too awkward. The valkyries, too, recognize you; Annika, Thrud, and dozens of other warriors of light are down a side street not far away, and they give you a respectful nod[var1| and a few blown kisses] as you pass through the portal. There are easily hundreds of elves already in the square, and more streaming in from the various side streets that wind through the Winter City. Only one open space is left: a cleared zone in front of a temporary altar that's been erected not far from the entrance to the cathedral. The altar, a raised platform with three large statues of Lumia — the Sun in the middle, the Mother to the right, and the Warrior to the left — is surrounded by a gaggle of priestesses and acolytes, including Elthara[party.has etheryn |. "That's where we should be," Ryn says. "[etheryn.highConfidence |Is that all right with you? |I[etheryn.lowConfidence |-I ]f you're comfortable with it, anyway... ]" "Sure[pc.isBimbo |! |. ] Lead the way." You're sure you could've pressed through the crowd without too much difficulty, but when a queen is holding one's hand, there's no difficulty at all. Elves somehow manage to make space for [party.yall], clapping, cheering, and bowing as you pass. It's enough to darken the tips of Ryn's ears[etheryn.highConfidence | — but only just. She's gotten better at the whole composure thing in a fairly short time. | and set her to smiling. It's a[etheryn.lowConfidence | | slightly ] nervous smile, but it's a genuine one. ] In no time at all, you've reached Elthara and the priestesses. Again, Ryn takes the lead. "We made it!" The taller elf's eyes twinkle gold. "With minutes to spare. I think you've got just enough time to change; there's a room in the cathedral with everything you need." "Before I do —" Ryn turns back to you. "Since you were able to make it, I wanted to ask... it's not normally part of the ceremony, but we thought it would be a good idea to include me swearing an oath. Would it be all right if I called on you as one of the witnesses with Elthara and Annika?" "You wouldn't have to say much," the high priestess adds. "Annika and I will simply be saying that we witness her oath, and you could chime in as well." "[pc.isBimbo |If it's thaaaaat easy," you tell Ryn, "then I can do that, sure!" |That sounds [pc.isDK |easy |simple ] enough." You shrug amiably. "Sure, Ryn. I can do that." ] She sighs with relief. "Thank you." "Indeed. Thank you, [pc.name]." Elthara gives you a nod, then briskly turns to one of the acolytes. "Anthea, would you show Her Majesty where her robes are?" |, as well as Etheryn herself. Her Majesty looks [etheryn.lnhConfidence |pretty nervous |a little nervous |quite composed ] up there, but that vanishes in favor of a delighted smile as soon as she sees you in the crowd. As soon as she sees you, she waves you up to the dais with the kind of excitement that might perhaps not be completely compatible with the sort of composure a queen is supposed to maintain. Not that you mind, of course. In fact, there's one benefit to everyone being able to see how excited Ryn is to see you: the crowd makes space pretty readily. You wouldn't have had that much trouble pushing through without it, but you have to admit: a more-or-less clear shot to the altar and the cheers and claps of hundreds of elves aren't half bad. Plus, as soon as you arrive at the altar, you greet Ryn with [etheryn.confessed |a hug and a kiss |a friendly hug ]. "Hey there. [pc.dcb |Right on time. |I'm glad I made it. |I'm heee-eeere! ]" "[pc.dcb |You are |I am, too |Hey yourself ]!" She fairly beams at you. "I wanted to make sure I had time to see you before I had to change." "Which you... technically do," Elthara points out, smiling, "if only barely. Shall I ask someone to help you find your robes?" Ryn [etheryn.lnhConfidence |blushes deeply |lets a shy blush creep onto her cheeks |giggles sheepishly ]. "Y[etheryn.lowConfidence |-y ]es, please. Just one second!" She turns back to you. "I... I wanted to add a little something to the ceremony. An oath. It's... well, one of the reasons I wanted you to be here is so you could witness it for me, along with Elthara and Annika. Is that — are you okay with that?" [pc.dcb |You shrug. "Sure, I don't mind." |"Of course I am," you say reassuringly. "I'm glad I didn't miss it." |You don't miss a beat: "Sure, sweetie! That sounds nice and easy." ] "Thank you!" Her shoulders sag with relief. "Okay, I'll see you in a little bit." With Ryn's request made, Elthara turns to one of her acolytes, who steps forward gracefully. "Anthea, would you show Her Majesty where the changing room is?" ] Ryn beckons Harrick down and directs him to a perch set up near the altar just for him. "Hey, buddy. Could you wait here for me until I'm back?" [etheryn.highConfidence |He lands on it for a few moments, then cocks his head — and flaps over to your arm instead. "Oh!" You smile. "Uh, that's fine, too." Ryn giggles. "So long as you're okay with it! I'll see you in a bit." |He dutifully takes up position there with not so much as a skree. "Thanks! I'll see you in a bit!" ] You[etheryn.highConfidence | and Harrick — who's nuzzling up against you, because he is a very good bird — ] and El watch Ryn and the acolyte disappear into the cathedral, then turn back to the bustling crowd. The sheer number of elves is enough to coax a low whistle from you. "[pc.isBimbo |Wow! This is kind of a big dealio. |This is a big deal, huh? ]" "[pc.isBimbo |A very big dealio |Very ]," the high priestess confirms. "We've only ever had this ceremony twice before: once shortly after Etheryn's mother's coronation, and once again after Alissa's. Neither was a valkyrie, so the Order visited to offer the tools of a warrior of Lumia, fit for a queen: armor of proof and arms of light." You raise an eyebrow. "[pc.isBimbo |Waitwaitwait — ]Alissa got this too?" "She rarely used it. After her father passed away, she mostly dressed and armed herself for the hunt, the close ties with the valkyries faded into abeyance, and even I ended up more a nuisance at court than a partner of the crown. You know the story from there." The priestess sighs. "It'll be nice to get back to the way things were from here on out." [pc.dcb |"Seems like a lot of[pc.ra elf | frost ] elves feel that way," you observe. |"That makes sense." You survey the pastel rivers of excited elves still streaming into the great square. "The rest of the city seems to feel the same way." |"Oooh! I understand," you say sagely. "And all the other chilly elves think the same way too, right?" ] Elthara smiles warmly. "It'll feel much safer to renew the protection of the goddess. Besides," she continues, winking, "it's a nice show[var0| — one that I don't have to manage for the most part, thank Lumia]." "[pc.isBimbo |Oh! By the way! Um... what do I do in the ceremony? |Speaking of which, what do I do for all this? ]" "If you[etheryn.highConfidence | and Harrick ] stand with me and the clergy, you'll have the best view," she says. "It's a short ceremony, and relatively simple. And all the words are in Belharan, not Alvarin; many of our Lumian prayers are actually in your language anyway, and besides, not every [pc.swornGod lumia |one of your sisters |valkyrie ] grew up in our lands." "Okay..." "The valkyries will present the war-gear to Etheryn and then she'll put it on. There usually isn't much of a speech on either side, but there are a few words, in addition to the oath she'll be making. For that, all you have to do is say that you'll witness when prompted[silly |; there's no need to be certified as a notary public or anything beforehand ]. At the end, traditionally, as guests of the city, the valkyries usually bring food and drink for after — some of the other clergy are setting it up in the cathedral." "[pc.isBimbo |Okie-dokie! |Sounds cool. ] And when do we know it's starting?" "When Her Majesty is ready, we'll blow the horn." She points at the cathedral steps, which Ryn is taking at a brisk pace, wearing her crown but otherwise dressed only in a simple white robe. "And there she is now." As soon as the queen makes her way to the altar, she turns to face the crowd, breathes deeply, and pauses for a few seconds. Then she nods to a tall, well-muscled elven guardsman on the opposite end of the altar from you and Elthara. He lifts the mouthpiece of a long birchbark horn[pc.bg scholar | — a lur, you're pretty sure — ] and the crowd noise dies down. Only then does he play an immense, loud BAAAA-WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA that vibrates into you and through you. Time for the ceremony to begin. '

rows.original: Golden-winged and magnificent, the valkyries set a deliberate pace as they walk through the middle of the crowd. Annika is in the lead, [annika.kissed |looking spectacular and inspiring and muscular |in her element as the picture of an inspiring Lumian warrior-maiden ], bearing a very well-made shield and spear. Behind her is Thrud, who towers over the crowd with two linen-wrapped packages in her immense arms. After them there's a long double line of dozens of [pc.swornGod lumia |your valkyrie sisters |valkyries ], mostly elves with a few humans, minotaurs, and siorcanna with wings folded respectfully behind them, plus [eira.met |the harpy Yolihuali |one harpy ]. They all seem at ease, all quite calm. They're not playing things up to the crowd like Minoan gladiators or Sartannian musicians, but nor are they eyes-front with the kind of absolute discipline of elite hieroloch infantry. Instead, they smile at Etheryn, at you, at the crowd — they're there to spread good feelings, and given the crowd's energy it's working pretty well. Annika halts several feet in front of Etheryn, and the rest of her sisters follow suit. As one, they incline their heads to the queen. Then, the seneschal speaks, in words that boom across the square: "As sisters and comrades of Queen Atheldred Sunbringer, we, the Order of the Argent Wing, offer our friendship to all descendants of hers who walk in the Radiant Mother's light. What she did for us, and what you and your people continue to do for us, we can never fully repay. Beyond our oaths and vows of service to the Goddess, allow us to bestow upon you tokens of our enduring gratitude. "First," she continues, "the arms of light. A valkyrie's bulwark, to protect not merely herself, but all the innocent of the world." She raises the large round [pc.bg soldier |aspis |shield ], decorated with a sunburst, faced with bronze, and glimmering in the torchlight. "And a valkyrie's spear, to vanquish the wicked so that they may never bring harm to those who cannot defend themselves." In her other hand, she hefts a long [silly |barge-pole of a |eight- or ten-foot ] polearm, expertly weighted with a Lumian sun-wing on the butt. Then Thrud moves to take a place beside Annika, kneeling to display the linen wrappings. Beside her, Annika continues: "Then, the armor of light. Of finest bronze, in the style of Atheldred Sunbringer and all of us who have taken up arms alongside her. "Each of these items," she intones, "has been consecrated by our goddess herself to resist evil and corruption, just as all other arms and armor of the warriors of light. They will well serve any elvenqueen who does battle with the wicked." And, of course, they won't do much at all for someone who consorts with them, but Anni[annika.kissed | |ka ] leaves that particular bit unsaid. After Alissa, everybody's thinking it. Ryn pauses before she responds. Then: "These gifts are humbling, and I accept them wholeheartedly. You do me great honor by offering them — and you honor my mother and grandmother, too. Although your Order does not request anything in return, I wish to honor my ancestors in the same way you do, and so I offer this promise." She clears her throat. "I, Etheryn, First of the House of Ridell and Queen of the Boer'alvar, before the Sisters of the Argent Wing, [etheryn.married |my beloved [pc.mf |King |Queen ] Consort, [pc.name] |[pc.isValk |[pc.name], Champion of Lumia |[pc.isBaron |Baron[pc.mf | |ess ] [pc.name] of the March |[pc.name], Champion of Frost ] ] ], High Priestess Elthara, and all Njorhaalt, swear in the name of Lumia and all the Seven to defend the people of the north from the darkness in the same way that my mother and my mother's mother did. And if I swear well, may the gods continue to bless myself, my family, and my people; if I forswear, may they bring destruction upon me." From her side, Elthara pipes up: "I witness this in Lumia's light." [pc.isBimbo |"Oooh! I also witness[pc.swornGod lumia | in Lumia's light ]!" you say proudly. |"I also," you add, "witness this oath[pc.swornGod lumia | in Lumia's light ]." ] A murmur of approval runs through the crowd[etheryn.highConfidence | — and your avian passenger, who awards you a nuzzle and trill of approval ]. Anni[annika.kissed | |ka ] smiles. "So witnessed, and so agreed. Let Her Majesty be clad as a Lumian warrior." She and Thrud now step forward, unwrapping the linen around Ryn's armor. There's definitely a little blush around both cheeks and ears as the queen disrobes, leaving only a modest top and bottom. And when the two valkyries start fastening the gear on, Ryn's gaze flicks over to you more than once — showing off the excited little smile that peeks through her still-fairly-regal demeanor. Annika and Thrud work slowly, investing all their movements with reverence, but when every strap, greave, plate, and fastener is in place, they withdraw, leaving Etheryn armed and armored just like they are. She truly does look like the spitting image of a warrior elvenqueen — not quite as tall, of course, or as amazonian, but the garb of battle sits well on her.[var1 | Especially given her new curves.[silly | Yowza. ] ][var0 | She really does resemble the warrior elf statue placed in the Wayfort. ] What completes the image, of course, is Harrick, who majestically flaps his way[etheryn.highConfidence | over from your arm ] to perch on Ryn's shoulder. [etheryn.highConfidence |Now that it's just her and Harrick on the altar, Ryn raises an open hand and the crowd murmurs die down. She takes hold of the spear, then examines it closely, taking a good look at the point, the inlay, the Lumia-enchanted decoration. There is a long, pregnant pause, and even you can feel the prickle of anticipation on your skin. Then, triumphantly, she thrusts it high into the air, and all the enchantments on it glow with the fire of the sun herself. The deafening roar of the crowd drowns everything else out. |She stands there, resplendent in her new shining armor, and surveys the crowd. The smile she manages isn't a serene or unflappable one, but it is completely genuine. And the crowd responds, first with a trickle of clapping and cheering, then with a torrent, as more and more of the elves join in the outpouring of a feeling of relief. Within seconds the cheering is loud enough to keep you from hearing anything else, and it stays that way for a long time. ]

rows.raw: ' "I h-have. My High Priestess, my friend, and one of the few people who gave me hope during my time in the palace, Lady Elthara." "It's a pleasure to meet you, my goddess." Elthara says, curtsying deeply. "There's no need for that kind of formality here, please," Lumia laughs, striding forward and taking El's hands in hers. "You've done such wonderful service to my faith, and I'm glad you can be here to help a servant in need. I trust you've been warned of the side effects of this particular method?" "Yes, my go- err, lady Lumia. I'm ready to help Ryn no matter what. Nothing could stop me from making sure her first time is comfortable and safe." Ryn looks like she's ready to burst into flames, flushed the deep purple of an overripe plum. "Splendid. I shall begin, then. Are you ready, sweet princess?" "A-as I'll e-ever be!" Ryn says, standing straight. "Then brace yourself," The goddess says, reaching a hand between Ryn's legs and grasping the metal cage that covers her sex. Ryn scrunches up her face in tensed concentration, but there's no accompanying surge of energy. Instead, after maybe a second or two of silence, the cage simply clinks and falls free. The elven princess relaxes, staring down with a bewildered look. "H-huh? It's that simple? But... what about the... nnnh," she says. As she speaks, you see the effects of the flood of fertile magic needed to break the seal taking hold over her body. Her pupils dilate, and her mouth hangs open slightly as her breath turns husky. Her hips unconsciously buck the air, and each one adds an inch to the tiny tent in her skirt. The growth stops at a solid seven inches, but she looks painfully hard for it. A thin sheen of sweat covers her body, and she turns toward Elthara in a daze. "E-El... Elll," she says, burying her face in the taller woman's cleavage as her hands explore her body. "I-I'm here, Etheryn. I'll always be here. Let's get you somewhere comfortable." "You can use my private chambers," Lumia offers, indicating the stairs at the side of the throne room. "Luv you. The two of them disappear, with Elthara giving you a final [elthara.fucked |blown smooch and a nod |nod ] before they disappear into the room at the top. You stay with Lumia for a few hours, chatting about your current adventures. When the pair don't return after those few hours, you wander the palace halls and speak with valkyries for a while. Every so often, you check in to see whether Ryn and Elthara have come down, and every time there's no sign of them. Firstly, though, let's get you both home safe." "Safe is good," Ryn adds, still woozy and leaning on Elthara's arm. "Right," you laugh. "There will always be time for more nights like this after you're done saving the world," El says, affectionately ruffling her hair. "Really? We can do this again?" Ryn says as you begin to break the tangle, and you see her exhausted endowment give a half-hearted twitch. "You'd be ok with that?" "After this time? How could you live with anything less?" you say, tracing your fingers down her shoulders with a teasing smirk. "I'll always be there to help you, and I'm sure [pc.name] will be close behind or ahead of me," El laughs, pulling her dress back on and stepping into her heels. "I will. For now, though, let's get you both home." You finish dressing, and help Ryn into her clothes. She's still a little wobbly once you get her on her feet, and needs both your arms for support as you walk down the stairs and into the throne room. Lumia awaits you with her chin in her palms and a wide smile. "Feeling better?" she asks, standing to place a hand on your and Elthara's shoulders. "Mhmm. All thanks to them," Ryn replies, smiling sheepishly. "Then good job, both of you. You've done so well," Lumia says, giving each of you a big kiss on the forehead. El beams, blushing and proud. You're sure you're just as flushed, and give one of Ryn's hands a squeeze that she returns with fervor. "Now then, back to saving the world with you. I look forward to the fruits of your efforts. And, perhaps, to the fruits of your labors in the future." She winks, and pats all three of you on the butt as she ushers you through the throne room doors. You lead the pair out and back to the waystone, where Ryn gets some congratulatory whistles from several valkyries and El turns a ruddy red shade of pink. By the time you've stepped into the ways and made it back through to the winter city, the afterglow has dimmed a little bit. El gives Ryn a final smooch before heading back to the chapel, and Ryn slumps into her throne with a contented sigh as you're left alone together. "I will... always stand ready to assist you, [pc.name]. You've done so much for me. If you continue to need my bow, or even just my companionship, you shall have it. Always." '

rows.original:
"Y-yes! My friend Atugia is willing to go through it with me."
    
    "Wonderful," the goddess says, turning to Atugia. "And you've been warned of the potency of the expected side effects?"
    
    "Y-yes ma'am. I'll help her no matter what!"
    
    "Splendid. You'll do just fine. I shall begin, then. Are you ready, sweet princess?"
    
    "A-as I'll e-ever be!" Ryn says, standing straight.
    
    "Then brace yourself," The goddess says, reaching a hand between Ryn's legs and grasping the metal cage that covers her sex.
    
    Ryn scrunches up her face in tensed concentration, but there's no accompanying surge of energy. Instead, after maybe a second or two of silence, the cage simply clinks and falls free. The elven princess relaxes, staring down with a bewildered look.
    
    "H-huh? It's that simple? But... what about the... nnnh," she says.
    
    As she speaks, you see the effects of the flood of fertile magic needed to break the seal taking hold over her body. Her pupils dilate, and her mouth hangs open slightly as her breath turns husky. Her hips unconsciously buck the air, and each one adds an inch to the tiny tent in her skirt. The growth stops at a solid seven inches, but she looks painfully hard for it. A thin sheen of sweat covers her body, and she turns toward Atugia in a daze.
    
    "T-Tui, ngh, Tui," she moans, burying her face in the starscape of Tui's neck. "P-pretty"
    
    "Eep, H-hang on, Ryn. Let's get somewhere private."
    
    "You can use my private chambers, sweetie. Good luck," Lumia says, directing the pair to an adjacent stair.
    
    Ryn clings to Tui the whole way up the stairs, but there's a happy determination in Tui's eyes when she glances back at you over her shoulder. Then, the two of them disappear through the door at the top of the stairs.
    
    You stay with Lumia for a few hours, chatting about your current adventures. When the pair don't return after those few hours, you wander the palace halls and speak with valkyries for a while. Every so often, you check in to see whether Ryn and Tui have come down, and every time there's no sign of them. Lumia affords you a room to nap or sleep in when it gets late enough, and you crash for a while till a valkyrie attendant comes to retrieve you. The goddess wasn't kidding about her magic's potency, as it's been just over twelve hours since you left. 
    
    You arrive just in time to hear the telltale click-clack of heels on marble, and watch Tui and Ryn wobble down the stairs. Ryn cradles Tui's head in her crossed arms, and holds it up for a final kiss before placing it gently back atop her neck. The pair look in equal amounts of lustful stupor, and neither are very vocal for a good few minutes. Eventually Lumia herself breaks the silence.
    
    "You two look resplendent," she says, beaming happily.
    
    "I'm feelin' pretty resplendent," Tui giggles, prompting a matching hoarse giggle from Ryn.
    
    "Yeah," the queen-regent agrees. "Thanks, Tui."
    
    "Any time. I trust [pc.name] to know when I'm needed."
    
    "For now, though, let's get the two of you back home."
    
    The pair follow you out and back through the ways between, till you've reached the Frost Hound. Tui leaves you at her room, giving each of you a final chaste smooch. 
    
    Ryn collapses on her bed when you get back to her room. She heaves out a contented sigh, and looks up at you from the bed.
    
    "I will... always stand ready to assist you, [pc.name]. You've done so much for me. If you continue to need my bow, or even just my companionship, you shall have it. Always."
rows.translation:
是的是的！我的朋友阿图吉娅愿意和我一起经历这个过程。”
    
    “太好了，”女神说道，然后转向阿图吉娅，“你之前也被告知过这些副作用可能会很严重吧？”
    
    “是的是的，女士。无论发生什么，我都会帮助她的！”
    
    “太好了。你一定能够胜任的。那么，我现在就开始吧。你准备好了吗，亲爱的公主？
    
    我永远都会是这样的！”小琳挺直身体说道。
    
    “那么，做好心理准备吧。”女神说道，她伸出手穿过小琳的双腿，抓住了覆盖在她私处的金属笼子。
    
    小琳紧张地皱起眉头，全神贯注地等待着什么，但却没有感受到任何能量的涌动。过了大概一两秒钟的寂静之后，那个金属笼子只是发出一声轻响，然后掉了下来。这位精灵公主放松了下来，困惑地低头看着掉在地上的笼子。
    
    哈？真的这么简单吗？但是……那个……嗯……”她说道。
    
    随着她说话，你可以看到那些用于打破封印的丰富魔力正在她体内产生作用。她的瞳孔放大，嘴巴微微张开，呼吸也变得急促起来。她的臀部不自觉地微微摆动，每一次摆动都会让她裙摆下那小小的“帐篷”再膨胀一英寸。最终，这个“帐篷”终于达到了整整七英寸的尺寸，但看她那吃力的样子，显然这个过程让她感到非常痛苦。她的全身都覆盖着一层细薄的汗珠，然后她恍恍惚惚地转向了阿图吉娅。
    
    呼……崔，呼……崔，”她轻声说道，将脸埋进崔的脖颈间，“真……真漂亮。”
    
    “哎呀，等一下，小琳。我们找个私密的地方吧。”
    
    “你可以使用我的私人房间，亲爱的。祝你好运，”卢米娅说着，指引他们走向旁边的楼梯。
    
    小琳在整个上楼梯的过程中都紧紧抓住涂伊的手，而当涂伊回头瞥了你一眼时，她的眼中闪烁着一种幸福的坚定神情。随后，她们俩一起消失在了楼梯尽头的那扇门后面。
    
    你和卢米娅一起待了几个小时，聊着你们目前正在经历的冒险。几个小时过去后，他们仍然没有回来，于是你便在宫殿的走廊里闲逛，偶尔还会和那些女武神聊上几句。每隔一段时间，你就会去看看小琳和图伊是否已经回来了，但每次都不见他们的踪影。当夜晚降临之际，卢米娅会为你提供一个地方让你小憩或入睡。你可以在那里休息一段时间，直到有一位女武神侍者前来将你唤醒。这位女神所说的她的魔法威力确实不假——自从你离开后，已经过去了十二个多小时了。 
    
    你刚好赶到，听到了那熟悉的脚步声——高跟鞋在大理石地面上发出的“咔嗒”声，同时也看到Tui和小琳摇摇晃晃地走下楼梯。小琳用双臂环住Tui的头部，将她的头抬起来亲吻了一下，然后轻轻地将她的头放回Tui的脖子上。两人都沉浸在充满欲望的恍惚之中，有好几分钟都没有发出任何声音。最终，是卢米娅打破了这份沉默。
    
    你们两个看起来真是光彩照人啊，”她开心地笑着说。
    
    “我也觉得自己挺光彩照人的呢，”崔咯咯地笑了起来，小琳也跟着发出了沙哑的笑声。
    
    “是啊，”摄政女王同意道，“谢谢你，崔。”
    
    “不客气。我愿意帮忙的。[pc.name]这样我就能知道什么时候需要我的帮助。”
    
    “不过，现在我们还是先把你们俩送回家吧。”
    
    两人跟着你穿过一条条小路，最终来到了寒霜猎犬那里。崔在她的房间里把你俩分别送走，还给了你们每个人一个温柔的吻。
    
    当你回到小琳的房间时，她已经躺在了床上。她满意地叹了口气，然后从床上抬起头看着你。
    
    “我……会永远准备好帮助你的。[pc.name]你为我做了这么多。如果你还需要我的帮助，或者只是需要我的陪伴，我都会一直在你身边。永远都会。

rows.original:
"A-actually, if it's not t-too selfish, I was w-wondering if you would be able to h-help me yourself, my g-goddess," Ryn asks, flushing purple when Lumia puts a hand on her shoulder.

    "I was wondering if you'd ask. The answer will always be yes. If you want me, if you need me, I am yours, Etheryn var Ridell. We can use my private chambers, if you'd be more comfortable there."
    
    "S-sure!" Ryn says, following as the goddess takes her hand and guides her toward a short set of stairs. She gives you a final look for reassurance, and smiles at the goddess.
    
    Lumia looks back at you as well, and arcs her eyebrow in a silent question. She doesn't need to speak for the intent of it to be clear. Would you like to be there with her when Ryn is freed from her cage?

其实，如果不太自私的话，我在想你能不能亲自帮帮我，我的女神……”当卢米娅把手放在她的肩上时，小琳的脸瞬间涨成了紫色，结结巴巴地说道。

    “我就等着你问呢。答案永远都是肯定的。如果你需要我，如果你想要我，我属于你，伊瑟琳·瓦·里德尔。我们可以去我的私人房间，那里你会感觉更自在。”
    
    “当、当然！”小琳说道，跟着这位女神的手，一起走向那段短楼梯。她最后看了你一眼，似乎是在确认你的态度，然后对着那位女神露出了微笑。

rows.original:
You shake your head with a smile. This is Ryn's moment, and she's already got to contend with the goddess of fertility herself. You want her first time to be memorable, but you want her to remember it. Any more stimulation and she'll probably black out. 

        Lumia takes your meaning from just the head-shake, winking and continuing to guide Etheryn up and through the door at the top of the stairs. You wait around the throne for a few hours, and when the pair don't return after those few hours, you wander the palace halls and speak with the valkyries for a while. Every so often, you check in to see whether Ryn and the goddess have come down, and every time there's no sign of them. Annika pops in to guide you to a room to nap or sleep in when it gets late enough, and you crash for a while till a valkyrie attendant comes to retrieve you. The goddess wasn't kidding about her magic's potency, as it's been just over twelve hours since you left. 
        
        You arrive just in time to see a very wobbly Etheryn walking down the stairs with Lumia in tow. The beauteous elf is like a resplendent painting, coated from neck to ankle in streaks of shining gold lipstick. Some of them show an attempt at cleaning, but the majority have been left where they lie. She's all smiles and sunshine herself, and the goddess wears a similar smile.
        
        "You look like you had fun," you say, opening your arms as Ryn approaches to throw herself into them for a hug.
        
        "It was! It was... goddess, it was indescribable! Thank you, my lady. Thank you, [pc.name]!" she says. Her voice is a little hoarse, but she otherwise seems no worse the wear for the length of their union.
        
        "Our halls are always open for you, future queen. I wish you both my grandest blessings, in all your future endeavors."
        
        You stay and chat till Ryn regains her full strength in her legs, and then head back through the ways between to the winter palace. Once you've arrived, the elvenqueen slumps down into her throne with a contented sigh. "I will... always stand ready to assist you, [pc.name]. You've done so much for me. If you continue to need my bow, or even just my companionship, you shall have it. Always."

你微笑着摇摇头。这是小琳的重要时刻，而她已经得应付生育女神本人了。你希望她的第一次刻骨铭心，但也希望她事后还记得。再多一点刺激，她恐怕就会昏过去。

        卢米娅仅凭你摇头便明白了意思；她眨眨眼，继续领着伊瑟琳登上楼梯，穿过顶端的门。你在王座旁等了几个小时；数小时后两人仍未回来，你便在宫殿走廊里闲逛，与女武神们聊了一阵。你不时去看看小琳和女神是否下来了，每次都不见她们的踪影。天色够晚后，安妮卡过来领你去一间可供打盹或睡觉的房间；你在那里倒头睡了一阵，直到一名女武神侍从前来叫你。女神并没有夸大自己魔法的效力：你离开至今已经过了十二个多小时。
        
        你抵达得正是时候，恰好看见双腿发软的伊瑟琳走下楼梯，卢米娅跟在后面。美丽的精灵仿佛一幅绚烂夺目的画作，从脖颈到脚踝都留着一道道闪亮的金色唇印。有些地方显然试着擦拭过，但绝大多数仍留在原处。她自己也是满面笑容、神采飞扬，而女神脸上也挂着相似的微笑。
        
        “看来你玩得很开心，”你说着张开双臂；小琳走近后，一头扑进你的怀里拥抱你。
        
        “是啊！那真是……女神在上，简直无法形容！谢谢您，女神大人。也谢谢你，[pc.name]！”她说道。她的嗓音略显沙哑，但除了这场欢爱持续太久之外，身体似乎并无不适。
        
        “我们的殿堂永远为你敞开，未来的女王。愿我最崇高的祝福伴随你们二人，庇佑你们今后的一切事业。”
        
        你留下来和她们交谈，直到小琳的双腿完全恢复力气，随后穿过界间之路，返回冬城宫殿。抵达之后，精灵女王满足地叹了口气，瘫坐在自己的王座上。“我会……永远准备好帮助你，[pc.name]。你为我做了那么多。只要你仍需要我的弓，甚至仅仅需要我的陪伴，我都会答应。永远。”

rows.original: Lumia nods before you even have the chance to voice your assent, stopping Ryn in her tracks before they make it to the top of the stairs. "Perhaps, my dear, you would like for [pc.name] to join us as well?" she asks, pointing the smaller woman back in your direction. "T-two!?" Ryn squeaks, taking a moment to clear her throat. "I-is that ok? Can I do that?" "That's for you to decide, dear," Lumia says with a hearty chuckle. "I believe in you, but it's more about what you want rather than what you can do." "T-then yes! Please. I-if you want to," she says, looking from you to the goddess and then back. "Of course I do," you say, finally putting words to the desire as you join them on the stairs. Lumia leads you both to her chambers like a trio of giddy honeymooners. When you make it inside, the goddess makes a beeline for one of the bedside tables, fishing through till she comes out with a stoppered glass. Inside, scintillating gold stars twinkle in a transparent fluid. She returns with the bottle, smirking proudly as she fiddles with the stopper. "It may be somewhat... unfair of me to bring this out now, when I likely wouldn't offer it to anyone else you could have chosen. No offense, [pc.isValk |my little hero. |brave little hero ]." "None taken, but what is it?" you ask, voicing Ryn's obvious curiosity alongside your own. "A little something to take the edge off what I'm about to do.
