rows.original: Headpats are always best for showing affection!
rows.translation: 轻拍头部总是表达爱意的最美好方式！
rows.raw: "Headpats are always best for showing affection!"

rows.original: Looking at the mess of tails sprawled out behind Kiyoko, a mischievous thought come to mind. They're so graceful, yet appear so full-bodied — entranced by the glossy sight, you can't help but stand up and cross over to Kiyoko's side of the table. "Hm?" Your fox-wife remains seated, eyes following you as she sips at her tea. Ever the picture of polite calm, isn't she? "Was there something you wanted, beloved?" From the glint in her eye, it's clear that she already knows the answer and that she's just asking for propriety's sake. It's not as if you were hiding it, after all — in which case, it'd be far simpler and better to just admit to your desires. "[pc.ra lupine |Heehee, so the hound wants a piece of the fox? That can be arranged, |Oh, so you want some tail? All you had to do was to ask! ]" comes the reply. "A kitsune's tails are very important to him or her, after all. I'm very glad you think so highly of my fluffy tails to want to get at them, hmhm?" They do look very soft and fluffy... "You do have a good eye, and I don't say that lightly," Kiyoko replies cheerfully. "Well, then! Here! One fluffy tail, just for you!" As if on cue, one of Kiyoko's [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails snakes its way around from her back, pushing its way to the fore. Your kitsune wife leans forward ever so slightly, her smile broadening. "[kiyoko.numKits 4 |It's thanks to you than I've so many lovely fluffy tails. Since you shared so much of your chi with me, I think it's only a just repayment that you get to touch and enjoy my fluffy tails any time you like! |Please, enjoy! I think it's only fair repayment for all you've done for me, beloved. And if you like it, I expect to be praised lots! ]" Now that's an invitation if you ever saw one. There's no need to hold back now — reaching out, you grasp hold of the offered tail and stroke its soft amber-orange fur. It feels simply wonderful. As you continue to stroke and pet Kiyoko's tail, you can feel a soft core inside, twitching with a life of its own much like her ears, brimming with pent-up energy. It's the warmest of blankets, the fluffiest of covers, the softest of mattresses, and Kiyoko herself appears to be taking great pleasure from your reveling in the sheer feel of her tail. After all, you're probably feeding her ego to no end just by indulging yourself in the simple comfort of touching her. "Well? Isn't it amazing? My tails weren't originally like that, you know — the fluffiness comes from a lot of dedicated grooming, herb oil, and plenty of loving care. But in the end, it's worth it." You have to agree. Amazing... so fluffy... Unable to suppress your desire any further — and besides, you do have an invitation — you bury your face into Kiyoko's tail fur. Your kitsune wife giggles as you do so, but it feels so good that you don't care about embarrassing yourself. What does it matter, anyway? There's no one in here save the both of you. "You really like it that much, don't you? I don't blame you — our fur is simply the best thing in the world. Hee hee. Do you want a special? I learned how to do it from my mother."
rows.translation: 看着清子身后那一排杂乱无章的尾巴，我突然产生了一个调皮的想法：这些尾巴看起来如此优雅，却又显得如此结实有力……被这闪亮的景象吸引，我忍不住站起身，走到了清子那一侧的桌子旁。 嗯？你的狐妖妻子依然坐在那里，一边喝茶一边注视着你。她总是那么文静有礼，不是吗？亲爱的，有什么你想要的东西吗？ 从她眼中的光芒来看，她显然已经知道了答案，只是出于礼貌才在追问而已。毕竟你并没有刻意隐瞒什么——如果真是这样，直接承认自己的想法反而会简单得多，也会更好。 "[pc.ra lupine |嘿嘿，原来这只猎犬也想分一杯狐狸的羹？这个要求倒是可以满足的。 |哦，原来你是想要点“额外奖励”啊？你当初只要开口问不就得了吗！ ]"回复到来了。对一只狐妖来说，尾巴可是非常重要的。我很高兴你如此看重我的这些蓬松尾巴，甚至想要得到它们，嗯哼？ 它们看起来确实非常柔软、蓬松…… 你的眼力确实不错，我这么说可是认真的。清子愉快地回答道。那么好吧！给！这一条毛茸茸的尾巴，就是专为你准备的！ 仿佛是事先约定好的那样，清子的其中一个[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]它的尾巴像蛇一样从她的背后蜿蜒延伸，逐渐向前移动。你的九尾狐妻子微微前倾身体，笑容也变得更加灿烂了。 "[kiyoko.numKits 4 |正是因为有了你，我才能拥有这么多可爱的、毛茸茸的尾巴。因为你分享了这么多东西气在我看来，你能随时抚摸和享受我柔软的尾巴，这才是对我的最好回报！ |请尽情享受吧！我觉得，这对于你为我所做的一切来说，才是最公平的回报，亲爱的。如果你喜欢的话，我肯定能得到很多赞美呢！ ]" 这可真是个再好不过的邀请了。现在完全没有必要再犹豫了——只要伸出手去，就能抓住那条柔软的、琥珀橙色的尾巴，轻轻抚摸它。 这种感觉简直美妙极了。 当你继续轻轻抚摸着清子的尾巴时，你能感觉到里面有一团柔软的组织在微微颤动，这种颤动仿佛拥有自己的生命，就像她的耳朵一样，充满了积蓄的能量。这尾巴简直就像是最温暖的毯子、最柔软的被子、最舒适的床垫；而清子本人似乎也非常享受你尽情享受她尾巴带来的这种触感。毕竟，只要你愿意享受与她肌肤相触带来的简单愉悦，你就一直在不断地满足她的虚荣心。 怎么样？难道不神奇吗？你知道，我的尾巴本来并不是这样的——这种柔软蓬松的状态可是经过大量的细心照料、使用草本精油，以及充满爱意的呵护才换来的。不过，这一切都是值得的。 你不得不承认，真是太神奇了……这么柔软，这么舒服…… 再也无法抑制自己的欲望了——而且你确实有邀请函——于是你把脸埋进了清子的尾巴毛里。你的九尾妻子看到你这样，会咯咯地笑，但这种感觉实在太美妙了，以至于你完全不在乎是否会显得尴尬。反正这里除了你们两个人，也没有其他人。 你真的这么喜欢它，对吧？我完全理解——我们的毛皮确实是世界上最棒的东西。嘻嘻，想要特别制作的吗？这个技巧是我从我妈妈那里学来的。

rows.original:
[dayNight
        |It's a nice day out, with warm sun
        |It's a cool evening out, with wan moonlight
    ]and a calm breeze. Perfect timing for a visit, too... which is why you're here, isn't it? Stepping up onto the raised porch, you approach the little shrine's door and rap on it with your knuckles. However, there's no response, and you're about to give it another go when a soft snore from around the corner draws your attention.
    
    Crossing over to investigate the source of the snoring, you don't have long to go before you find Kiyoko slumped in a rocking chair, [dayNight|smack in the middle of a large pool of sunlight|the night breeze blowing her hair astray]. The kitsune mother is sound asleep, nestled securely in the chair's soft cushioning and her own many tails; the [dayNight|sun|moon]light illuminates her soft features and the faint smile on her lips. The poor thing clearly hasn't brushed her hair or fur in a bit, and snuggling up in the rocking chair has only mussed up the lot even more.
    
    Come to think of it, it must be nice to nap in the [dayNight|warm sun on a cool day|peace of evening, surrounded by nature]...
    
    Back and forth, back and forth, the gentle creaking of the rocking chair on the floorboards as Kiyoko dozes away, her hands [kiyoko.pregStage 0 2 4
        |folded across her chest, her head bent to one side.
        |in front of her, cradling the growing swell of her pregnant tummy, hugging it to herself as if to make the fox kit — and herself — a little more secure while she snoozes.
        |resting atop the massive mound of her pregnancy. The front of Kiyoko's yukata is undone, allowing her bare belly to spill out of her clothes and onto her lap where it [dayNight|soaks up the warm sunshine|looks practically pearlescent in the moonlight]; the open halves are loosely draped over the kitsune mother's milk-swollen breasts, barely covering her nipples — the outline of which are clearly still visible against the sinfully thin fabric. 
    ] Every now and then, Kiyoko murmurs something in her sleep, and her large, fluffy ears twitch ever so slightly. There's a book lying on the floor beside her — she must have read herself to sleep, dropping the book to the ground when she finally nodded off.
    
    She seems so content to nap like this... but you wanted to visit, didn't you? How do you want to wake up this fluffy mommy?
rows.translation:
[dayNight
        |今天阳光温暖，是个宜人的好天气
        |今晚月色朦胧，是个凉爽的夜晚
    ]，还吹着宁静的微风。来探访也正是时候……这不就是你来这里的原因吗？你登上架高的门廊，走到小神社门前，用指节敲了敲门。然而里面没有回应；就在你准备再敲一次时，拐角处传来的轻柔鼾声吸引了你的注意。
    
    你循着鼾声前去查看，没走多远便发现清子瘫坐在摇椅里，[dayNight|恰好置身于一大片阳光中央|夜风吹乱了她的头发]。狐妖母亲睡得正熟，安稳地窝在椅子的柔软坐垫和自己众多的尾巴之间；[dayNight|日|月]光照亮了她柔和的面容，以及唇边那抹淡淡的微笑。这个可怜的女人显然有一阵没梳理头发和毛皮了，蜷在摇椅里只让它们变得更加蓬乱。
    
    仔细想来，能够在[dayNight|凉爽天气里的温暖阳光下|自然环抱的宁静夜色中]打个盹，想必十分惬意……
    
    前后摇晃，前后摇晃；清子酣睡时，摇椅在地板上发出轻柔的吱呀声，她的双手[kiyoko.pregStage 0 2 4
        |交叠在胸前，脑袋歪向一侧。
        |放在身前，托着怀孕后逐渐隆起的腹部，将它抱向自己，仿佛想让腹中的小狐狸——还有她自己——在睡梦中更安心一些。
        |搭在怀孕后高高隆起的巨腹顶端。清子的浴衣前襟敞开，让她裸露的腹部从衣裳里露出，落在大腿上；它在那里[dayNight|沐浴着温暖的阳光|在月光下泛着近似珍珠的光泽]。敞开的两半衣襟松松搭在狐妖母亲因乳汁而胀大的乳房上，几乎遮不住乳头——透过薄得诱人的布料，依然能清楚看见它们的轮廓。
    ]清子不时在睡梦中呢喃几句，一双毛茸茸的大耳朵极其轻微地颤动。她身旁的地板上躺着一本书——她想必读着读着睡着了，最终打起瞌睡时，书也落到了地上。
    
    她这样睡着似乎十分满足……可你是来探望她的，不是吗？你想怎样叫醒这位毛茸茸的妈妈？

rows.original: With a sharp intake of breath, Kiyoko levers herself out of the rocking chair, planting both hands on the armrests and shaking away the last vestiges of sleep. [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |Despite her baby bump, the kitsune mother has no problems getting to her feet. That slight frame of hers is deceptive — she has so much energy, it's practically pouring off her. |The sheer size and weight of her full, rounded belly makes the process a little awkward, but you lend a helping hand, and she's up and about in no time at all. ] She takes a few moments to smooth out her hair and fix the worst of her bedhead, then turns and gives you a small, formal bow. "Forgive my appearance, beloved. I wouldn't have let myself go like this if I'd known you were coming to visit today." That's just fine. This slightly wild look suits her just as well as the carefully groomed one does, either way. She is a fox, one way or the other. Kiyoko tilts her head, as if not quite fully believing your words, then dismisses her worries with a nonchalant shrug and resuming her usual cheerful demeanor. "Well, let's not keep standing around here all day. [dayNight|The sun is nice, but I'd like to get inside — especially if you want to play|After all, it is quite late now, and we ought to cherish our time together]." [kiyoko.pregStage 4 |Oh? Does she want to play? "Oh yes." You don't think Kiyoko's aware of it, but the kitsune mother-to-be is biting her lower lip as her eyes dart around. I wasn't feeling it that badly when I dozed off, but since you were so kind to wake me up, I'm feeling positively frisky. I wouldn't mind it if we could have a little fun... maybe enjoy a game together... " You'll think about it. "Be careful, now." Kiyoko's lips part to show just the barest hint of pearly white, slightly pointed teeth. "Work me up too much, and I just might not be able to control myself. Who knows what I might do, then? rows.original: Smiling, you reach for Kiyoko's shoulder and take a firm grip before gently nudging her a few times. She really is a deep sleeper — your first few attempts only get you soft murmurs and ear twitches, but you work at it. She must be used to being prodded from both inside and out by now, after all, and the [dayNight|pool of sunlight|calm of evening and rustle of leaves] is starting to make even you slightly drowsy... rows.original: Stepping up to the little shrine-cum-home, you knock on Kiyoko's door, but there's no response. Odd. Well, maybe she's out at Komari's... she does have a life and purpose of her own now, after all. You wait a minute or two and are rewarded with silence — yeah, she's not in at the moment, but it wouldn't hurt to check around the den before leaving for good.[party.hasCompanions | You leave [party.compNames] over by the shrine and go take a quick look-see. ] She wouldn't have any reason to personally enter the fields, and quick look-over by the well and remainder of the living quarters turns up nothing. You're about to give up and go when you hear the sound of soft singing by the waterfall spring. Well, soft is a technicality — it's what you might get if someone with a usually demure voice was trying to be loud and boisterous, and largely failing at it. Of course, you recognize who it is immediately — even while slightly slurred, Kiyoko's sonorous voice is still captivating as she sings to herself in her mother tongue. Slurred? Oh, no — it's when you get close enough to the water's edge that you see the full ensemble Kiyoko's dragged to the hot springs with her. A large flask on a circular tray, accompanied by small cups like the ones she serves tea in and a smell of — — Oh dear, she's been drinking. Well, that explains the slurring — although there's a hint of sweetness to it, the unmistakable scent of alcohol rises from the flask and cups. Her clothes lie discarded in a rumpled pile at the water's edge, instead of being neatly folded and stacked like you'd expect from her. "Hello, dear." One of Kiyoko's large fluffy ears perks up as your slutsune wife notices you, the other remaining stubbornly lopsided. "I was just thinking — ehe — I mean, I was just wanting your company, and you finally get around to showing up around here! What took you so long? It's not nice to keep a vixen waiting!" Were you gone that long? "Oh. Ehehe. Long enough. Too long." Kiyoko turns her gaze up towards you, her lips parting in a predatory smile, her cheeks flushed. Even at this distance, the scent of alcohol is heavy on her breath, and your kitsune slut-wife giggles as you pick up the nearly empty porcelain flask. "Why? Do you want some too, love?" She's drunk. "Oh yes, I'm drunk," Kiyoko admits without the slightest bit of shame or hesitation, slurring her words as if to drive home the point. Behind her, all [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] of her tails churn the steaming water to a froth. "Told... told Kinu to mind the other children, bring them over to Komari's... then nipped off to get the sake. And it's all your fault. If you would come and visit more often, I wouldn't need to drink... ehehe... because it's the only thing that'll take my mind off the empty ache in my tummy, and it's driving me to my wits' end..." "Everything tastes considerably better when I'm with you, beloved." Ah, such flattery. Well, to begin with, would she mind letting you up? "Ah, of course, of course. How uncouth of me — I merely got carried away in my excitement at seeing you again..." You can't stay mad at her, not when she's like this, and she knows it. She knows it, and she's going to milk that fact for all it's worth. Kiyoko slinks forward, her heavy maternal body pressing down on you with all of its warm weight while her tails brush against you from the sides, and your kitsune slut-wife graces you with a full kiss upon the lips. She's so small and light, you could probably throw her off without any problems, but the crushing gravitas her persona possesses is another matter altogether. Ouch... "All right, all right, I'll stop playing," she purrs, but her tone of voice makes it clear that she'll do anything but that. "Come now, beloved — I foresaw your coming, and have made the necessary arrangements..."

rows.original: And that's how you end up walking hand-in-hand with your fox-wife, a bona fide married couple pacing down the path that leads out of the crater. [dayNight |It feels a little silly to be prancing amongst the trees in the warm sunlight, but isn't that part of the reason why you married her in the first place, to be able to do silly, loving things like this without restraint? Of course it is. And now that you can do this, share in the same things that your fox-wife does with a physical body and metaphysical nature that allows you to connect yourself to her to the fullest of your abilities... it makes you feel closer to her than what you could have ever imagined before, and it feels very, very nice |Ghostly blue flames flicker in the lanterns that ply the path, foxfire lighting your way in addition to the will-o'-wisps the both of you have conjured up. It feels... gratifying to be able to do this at last, to share in the same things that Kiyoko does to the greatest extent that your physical body will allow you. It makes you feel closer to her in a way that's more than mere distance... and it feels really nice ]. Is your soul not hers now, and hers yours? At least, that's how Keros explained it when he removed yours... Oh, such weighty thoughts for a light-hearted romp in the woods. You carry the meal boxes under one arm, Kiyoko's fingers wrapped about yours in the other; her free hand is happily cradling her huge, kit-stuffed tummy while her gloriously maternal body presses against yours. Every now and then, you swear that one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails nips over to yours and teases their tips, darting back before you can catch her in the act. The knowing smile, the feigned innocence — she knows full well that she's being a cheeky vixen, but this is why you married her, isn't it? Eventually, though, the two of you arrive at the orchard by the den's edge, the rush of flowing water and high walls of the crater's lip looming over the trees. You set out the cloth mat while Kiyoko sets out the short table and boxed food, finding a suitable area and clearing it of fallen leaves while a floral, fruity scent hangs in the air, surrounding the both of you. [dayNight |Once everything's been set out, you take a moment to admire the scene you've set up. It's all very natural and tranquil, sunlight filtering through the leaves to provide just the perfect balance of light and shade, but without the centerpiece of Kiyoko in the thick of it all, it just wouldn't be the same. A quiet picnic in the midst of warm, untarnished nature — it certainly sets quite the romantic mood for a woman like Kiyoko, doesn't it? |Your fox-wife hangs a paper lantern on one of the lower boughs, then lights it with a snap of her fingers, soft blue light flaring into existence and flickering gently as it glows upon the both of you. A late supper under the stars, by the light of mystical foxfire... ah, if you were looking for romance, this isn't too bad ]. Kiyoko leans against you, nuzzling her face into your neck while her big pregnant belly and milky breasts lie warm and heavy against you. Your fox-wife's nose and lips brush against your skin, pressing insistently, while her breath washes against your pulse; you catch the foxy scent of her hair as she rolls around and snuggles up against you. The back of her head catches in your [pc.chest], her ears tickling your chin; the small of her back finds its place snug in your lap while her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails cushion her [kiyoko.numKits 1 8 16 32 |pert |full |warm and squishy |gloriously ripe ] butt. One fox against another... ah, you know what you must do now. Popping open one of the bento boxes laid out on the picnic mat, you pick up some delectable rice morsel — you have no idea what its name is, although it smells of vinegar and salt — with the chopsticks and start feeding and pampering your lovely fox-wife. She chews and swallows, then rolls her eyes up at you. "Ehehe. I remember when you first ate with me, beloved. You didn't even know what chopsticks were." Well, you do now. You've gone to all the trouble to sell your soul for the privilege of being a kitsune; learning how to use chopsticks is a small matter by comparison, isn't it? "You would be surprised. So many people native to this land simply cannot comprehend the idea, or at least they couldn't two and a half centuries ago. But I digress — if you want good eating, beloved, do open that bento box over there. I've prepared something for the both of us, to commemorate you taking this step in joining the fold." Oh? "Open it and see." Very well, then. You set down the chopsticks, reach over, and uncover the packaged meal Kiyoko pointed out. Oh... ah. Of course it had to be... inarizushi, her favorite. Kiyoko wiggles her ears, tickling your chin. "Well, beloved?" Is this for her, or for you? "As I said, it's for the both of us. It's true that I love inarizushi a lot... but since you've become one of us, I also want you to come to love the things we do. This first step you've taken has been a big one... but there's still much you have to do. And even though everyone will show you respect as the champion of a grand kami and my consort, there will always be those who begrudge you that status in their hearts, simply because you were not born one of us." You've done all you could, and to be frank, the only opinion of any kitsune that actually matters deep down is that of your fox-wife and the family you made together with her. "Ah, such flattery. But come... I'm hungry, and the kit you put inside of me is absolutely ravenous. Let's eat together as a family, shan't we?" Indeed you shall. It's simply sticky rice and grated vegetables wrapped in tofu pockets and seasoned with vinegar; it shouldn't taste as good as it does, but what should happen isn't what does happen, and in a good way. Maybe it's because you're a kitsune now and your senses have changed, maybe it's because you're eating with your fox-wife, maybe it's because she made this for you, and you're together out in nature listening to the wind whisper through the leaves in the [dayNight |muted light of day through the branches and boughs |calm of night ]. Kiyoko wiggles softly as she reclines atop you, her tails caressing your legs and thighs even as you pet her ears and silky head of hair as if she were some kind of animal. Her hands are splayed over the full, ripe dome of her overstuffed womb, stroking and caressing away even as you feed the both of you with the morsels she's prepared... it's a very quiet time, the both of you just basking in each other's presence, enjoying the delicious meal she's prepared for the both of you. When she's making herself look vulnerable like this, it's hard to not think of how delicate your beloved fox-wife is, how easily she would break, and thus how much you want to pet and coddle her and make her feel safe after everything the two of you've been through to get to this point. You know it's a blatant play on your emotions, and you don't care one bit. Ah... what if [kiyoko.numKits 4 |one of the kits |Kinu ] [dayNight |passes by |is out and about at night ], and sees the both of you like this? Fooling around like a young couple? "Hmm... I wouldn't really mind, beloved. It's not as we're getting frisky... yet. And who's to say that one of your fluffy children snooping in on us wouldn't be a good thing as long as we're just having a picnic out here [dayNight |in the middle of the day |and savouring the evening breeze ]? After all, a child seeing how well a good married relationship works will be educated in its merits, will they not? Where better to start off that lesson than at home?" As Kiyoko says that, you catch sight of the ring on her finger, and can't help but smile at the memory of that day as you continue to pamper and pet your fox-wife. The food and air may be cold, but your bodies and hearts are warm, and that more than makes up for it. That, and the fluff — all of it, so much of it, both hers and yours. "This is all your fault, you know," your kitsune wife says with a small giggle. "We'd never have ended up like this if not for you."
rows.translation: 就这样，你与你的狐妖妻子手牵手地走在通往火山口外部的小路上，真正成为了一对夫妻。 [dayNight |在温暖的阳光下，在树林间欢快地奔跑，虽然看起来有点傻傻的，但当初你娶她，不正是因为想要能够毫无顾忌地做这样一些傻傻的、充满爱意的事情吗？当然，正是这个原因。现在你能够做到这一点，与你那位拥有物质形态与超自然特性的狐狸妻子共同分享那些美好的事物，这种能力让你能够以自己全部的力量与她建立联系……这种感觉让你觉得与她的距离比你以前想象中的还要近，真的非常奇妙。非常不错 |幽蓝色的火焰在沿着小路排列的灯笼中闪烁着，这些灯笼与你们两人共同召唤出的狐火一起，为你们照亮前行的道路。终于能够做到这一点，能够尽自己身体所能去体验那些与清子相同的事情，这种感觉真是……令人满足。这种体验让你们与她的距离感消失了，让你们之间的联系变得更为紧密……这种感觉真的非常美好。 ]你的灵魂现在不就是她的了，而她的灵魂也不就是你的吗？至少，当凯罗斯取走你的灵魂时，他是这么解释的…… 哦，为了这次在森林里轻松愉快的郊游，你竟然会思考这么深刻的问题。你一只手臂托着饭盒，另一只手臂上缠着清子的手指；她空出来的手正开心地抚摸着自己那圆滚滚、装满了东西的肚子，而她那充满母性魅力的身体则紧紧贴着你。偶尔，你会忍不住想：她的这些动作，是不是[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]它的尾巴轻轻触碰你的尾巴，然后迅速缩回去，让你根本抓不住它。那意味深长的笑容，那假装的纯真——它心里很清楚自己正在耍赖，但这就是你娶它的原因，对吧？ 最终，你们俩还是来到了洞穴边缘的果园那里。湍急的流水声回荡在空气中，火山口边缘的高墙耸立在树木之上。你铺开了布垫，而清子则摆好了小桌子和盒装食物。你们找了一个合适的地方，清理掉了落下的树叶，此时空气中弥漫着花香与果香，将你们包围在其中。 [dayNight |当一切都布置妥当后，你会花一点时间欣赏自己创造出的这个场景。一切看起来都如此自然、宁静，阳光透过树叶洒下来，营造出了恰到好处的明暗效果。但如果没有纪代子作为这个场景的焦点，这一切就显得不够完整了。 在这样温暖、纯净的大自然中享受一场宁静的野餐，对于纪代子这样的女性来说，无疑会营造出一种非常浪漫的氛围，不是吗？ |你的狐狸妻子将一只纸灯笼挂在一根较低的树枝上，然后打了个响指将其点燃，柔和的蓝光瞬间亮起，在夜空中轻轻闪烁，照亮了你们俩。 在星空下，借着神秘的狐火光享用晚餐……啊，如果你在寻找浪漫，这样的场景倒也不坏。 ]清子靠在你身上，将脸贴在你的脖子上，她那圆滚滚的孕妇肚子和充满乳汁的胸部紧紧地压在你身上，温暖而重型。你那位狐妖般的妻子，用她的鼻子和嘴唇轻轻触碰着你的皮肤，不断地挤压着你；她的呼吸轻拂着你的脉搏，而当你她蜷缩过来依偎在你身边时，你也闻到了她头发上那特有的狐妖气息。她的后脑勺轻轻抵在你的[pc.chest]她的耳朵轻轻触碰着你的下巴；她的后腰则舒适地依偎在你的腿上[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]她的尾巴为她提供了支撑。 [kiyoko.numKits 1 8 16 32 |有趣 |完整 |温暖而柔软 |已经成熟到可以采摘的程度了 ]一只狐妖与另一只狐妖……啊，你现在该知道该做什么了。你打开铺在野餐垫上的便当盒，拿出一小块美味的食物——你不知道它叫什么名字，不过它闻起来有醋和盐的味道——然后用筷子开始喂你那可爱的狐妖妻子。她嚼着、吞着，然后冲你翻了个白眼。 呵呵，我还记得你第一次和我一起吃饭的时候，亲爱的。你当时甚至都不知道筷子是什么。 嗯，现在你确实做到了。你费了那么大劲，甚至不惜“出卖灵魂”才能获得成为狐妖的资格；相比之下，学习使用筷子简直就是小菜一碟，不是吗？ 你会感到惊讶的。这个地方有太多土生土长的人根本无法理解这个概念，至少在两个半世纪前他们是无法理解的。不过，言归正传——亲爱的，如果你想吃些好吃的，就快打开那边的便当盒吧。我为大家准备了一些食物，以此庆祝你决定加入我们。 哦？ 打开它看看吧。 好吧，那就这样吧。你放下筷子，伸手去拿KYOKO指出的那份包装好的食物。哦……啊，果然会是这样…… 稻荷寿司那是她最喜欢的。 清子摇动着耳朵，轻轻挠了挠你的下巴。那么，亲爱的？ 这是给她的，还是给你的？ 就像我说的，这是为了我们两个人。事实上，我真的很爱稻荷寿司很多……但既然你已经成为我们的一员，我也希望你能逐渐喜欢上我们所做的事情。你迈出的这第一步已经非常重要了……不过你还有很多事情需要去做。而且，尽管作为这位伟大的冠军，每个人都会尊重你神明以及我的伴侣，总会有一些人在心中嫉妒你拥有的那种地位，仅仅因为你并非通过那些途径获得的。出生我们中的一员。 你已经尽了全力，说实话，对于任何一只狐妖来说，真正重要的意见，只有你的狐妻以及你们共同建立的这个家庭的意见才算数。 啊，真是会说话啊。不过来吧……我饿了，你装在我体内的那些‘东西’也饿坏了。我们一家人一起吃饭吧，好吗？ 确实如此。这只不过是用豆腐皮包裹着粘米和切碎的蔬菜，再淋上醋调味而已；按理说味道不应该这么好，但事实却恰恰相反，而且这种反常的情况还挺不错的。也许是因为你现在是一只狐妖，所以你的感官发生了变化；也许是因为你和你的狐妖妻子一起吃饭；又或许是因为这是她专门为你做的，而你们此刻正身处大自然中，聆听风儿在树叶间低语[dayNight |透过树枝的缝隙，微弱的光线透了进来 |夜的宁静 ]清子轻轻扭动着身体，仰面躺在你身上，她的尾巴轻触着你的双腿和大腿，而你则抚摸着她的耳朵和那柔软的毛发，仿佛她在你面前是一只动物。她的双手摊开，覆盖着她那圆润、饱满的腹部，一边轻轻抚摸着，一边等你用她准备好的食物喂饱她们母女俩。…此刻真是非常宁静的时刻，你们俩只是静静地享受着彼此的陪伴，品味着她为你们准备的美味佳肴。当她以这样的方式展现出自己的脆弱时，人们很难不想到，你心爱的这位狐妖妻子是多么的纤细脆弱，她是如此容易受到伤害；因此，在经历了这一切之后，你更是想要好好地呵护她、安抚她，让她感受到安全与温暖。你知道这分明是在利用你的感情，但你却毫不在意。 rows.original: A curious sight awaits you as you enter the small crossroads in the middle of the kitsune den. [party.has kiyoko |Kinu's waiting for Kiyoko and you, all dressed up formally |Both your fox-wife and daughter are waiting for you, dressed up formally ]. Your fox-daughter steps up, bows, and [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |grins playfully. "Hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. You're right on time." On time, eh? "I got a divination from Miko as to when you'd be getting back, and made preparations. It's almost the turning of the year, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. Nice of you to drop by at this auspicious hour!" |gives you a small smile. "Welcome back, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. You have arrives just as predicted." Just as predicted, eh? "Mikoto was kind enough to make a divination as to when you would arrive, and so I made preparations to celebrate the turning of the year with you and Mother. It is, after all, an auspicious hour." ] [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko cocks her head at you. "Well, beloved. It looks like our daughter's been mindful enough to give us a proper welcome while we were on the road. It would be remiss of us to not avail ourselves of it, don't you think?" |You give Kiyoko a glance, and she returns it with a smile and shake of her head. "Now that she's grown, Kinu was quite insistent on doing everything by herself, and that I should just sit back and relax. It's not in my nature to do that kind of thing, but if our daughter insists..." ] After all you've been through together and fought so hard to get to this day where you can be together as a family... Of course you'll join in the festivities with her[kiyoko.numKits 1 2| and Kinu| and the children]. You take Kiyoko's hand in yours, and let your daughter guide the both of you through the den, down the paths and to [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 |the dining hall. As you enter, Kinu hurries ahead of the both of you and comes back lugging a large pot of steaming soup noodles. "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Good thing it's still hot, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I was worried the embers wouldn't be able to keep so much warm at once. |Ah... it is still warm. [pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, please partake before it gets cold. ]" |the dining hall, Kinu hurrying ahead of you. There, your children are patiently waiting at their tables; they rise and give you a bow as you enter. Up atop a low stove, a large cauldron of steaming noodle soup simmers over a muted fire, spreading a wondrous smell over the entire room. Kinu's tending to the cauldron and adding to the finishing touches, stirring the enormous batch of noodle broth with a long ladle and looking very pleased with herself. "That'll do," Kinu says, setting aside the ladle clapping her hands. As one, your fox-children — with the exception of Kinu, of course — take their seats and await to be served. "Now that everyone's here, I think we can begin." ] With that said, Kiyoko steps up and takes a whiff of the aroma rising from the broth. "Ah, hot soba. It truly brings back memories...[party.has kiyoko|what a pleasant surprise to come home to.]" Memories she'd care to share with you? Despite all this time you've been together, she hasn't really gone into her childhood in that much detail. A wan smile. "Maybe in the future. Not today, at least." As enigmatic as always, isn't she? [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 |While your daughter prepares a garnish of sliced spring onions and dried shrimp, Kiyoko takes the steaming pot and upends its steaming contents into three bowls, humming a merry tune all the while. The way mother and daughter work together like this... it's just like the dish they're preparing, elegant and simple. "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|All done!|That should do it.]" With a little flourish, Kinu sprinkles the garnishes atop the thick noodles in their light brown broth, then sets the bowls one by one on a tray. "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, you guys go out and enjoy yourselves, okay? I'll clean up back here and be with you guys in a bit. |Please, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, enjoy the sight outside while I clean up here. I will join you posthaste for the turning of the year. ]" Your fox-wife gives you a smile. "She's right. There's a lovely view outside; shall we depart?" | Once everyone is ready, Kinu says something in her mother tongue, then picks up the ladle. One by one, your kitsune children come up to their mother and are served large bowls of soba noodles, to which Kinu adds a garnish of spring onions and dried shrimp from large bins off to the side. It's an elegant, orderly affair — no doubt the fluffy kits have been warned to be on their best behavior for the day. When the last of the kits have been served and are seated, they look expectantly to Kiyoko. "Thank you for the food, Mama." "Of course. Please, begin." As your fox-children pick up their chopsticks and get to work, Kinu snuffs out the cooking fire with a snap of her fingers and portions out the last of the soba noodles onto a tray — just enough for you, Kiyoko, and herself. "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, you guys go out and enjoy yourselves, okay? I'll clean up back here and be with you guys in a bit. |Please, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, enjoy the sight outside while I clean up here. I will join you posthaste for the turning of the year. ]" Your fox-wife gives you a smile. "She's right. There's a lovely view outside; shall we depart?" ] Together, you pick up your trays and head outside down the path to the crater's edge where the fruit groves are. [dayNight|The warm sun beats down upon the both of you as you make the journey, caressing your skin and making you feel good inside|It's a little dark, but the gentle light of foxfire stone lanterns illuminates the path and lends a vaguely romantic air to the whole affair]. "Just enough time for the noodles to cool just right," Kiyoko remarks as she sets down the tray on a nearby box. It's not as luxurious as the hilltop parasols and benches back in the Astral Plane, but neither of you would ever give this up for that. "And just enough time for us to have a pleasant dalliance [dayNight|as the year comes to a close|under the moonlight]. I'm curious, [pc.name] — how did you observe the passing of the new year yourself?" [pc.bg noblescion courtesan minstrel| Ah, well... surely it couldn't have been that long since you came to the Marches, but you do remember the festivals in the heartland cities to the south. Big affairs, often funded by the local lord or lady with stalls lining the streets and establishments staying open till the crack of dawn. People bustling in the streets and brightly colored lanterns festooned all over the place. They were good times.[pc.bg minstrel| Of course, since you were a minstrel, it was just another workday, more haranguing than most. Festivals are never festivals for those doing the entertaining.][pc.bg noblescion| As one of the local nobility, you never lacked for anything during the festival... but here and now, sitting here with Kiyoko, you're feeling the moment far more keenly than any amount of carousal could have brought you.] ] [pc.bg soldier| Mostly being thankful for living out another year. Casualties were high in the life you led, and every year you'd see more and more of your fellow soldiers succumb to either injury or the sheer stresses of bloodshed day in, day out. The lucky ones were able to return home with perhaps a missing limb or couple of fingers; the less fortunate ended up burning in a mass grave. With Tira staring one in the face every day, simply being alive to usher in the new year was cause for celebration on what meager pay you had. ] [pc.bg hunter barbarian| Plenty of revelry and singing with the clan, that's for sure. You remember that the clan elders would break out the moonshine they'd been putting away for the entirety of the year, and everyone would gather by the bonfire's light to prepare the next year's batch while getting roaringly drunk. Even the children would be given some of the stuff after it'd been appropriately watered down — the new years' moonshine was strong, if nothing else. There'd be stories told, of course — after all these years, the tale of the moon-eating bear's one that's inexplicably stuck in your memory. The clan didn't have much in the way of material comforts those in the cities could afford, but it more than made up for it with the sheer intensity of the people participating in the celebrations. ] [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte| An evening of quiet repose and meditation, usually[pc.bg acolyte| followed by prayer to one or more of the Seven]. Your studies set you apart from society at large, and the revelries of new years' celebrations were often either too distant or simply didn't hold that much appeal to you. Going out into the streets of town and getting smashed with strangers just didn't seem meaningful at the time; you'd rather have spent the occasion with people you actually had meaningful relationships with. ] [pc.bg slumrat| Festivities? They were an opportunity to make a quick coin or two, whether it be from begging or less wholesome activities. Life was hard, and happiness and revelry was for other people; those were days you're glad to have left behind and never want to look back on again. ] Kiyoko listens to your recollections in silence, then heaves a little sigh when you're done. Your fox-wife sits herself down beside you on the crate, then leans her head against her shoulder, vulpine ears tickling your cheek. "We've been through so much together, beloved. It stirs a certain longing in one's heart." Um — Before you can reply, though, Kiyoko raises a finger to her lips and smiles. "It's okay. I'm just happy you're here with me to[dayNight|day|night]. Come on, let's have the toshikoshi soba before it gets too cold." Of course, of course... no matter how many times you try to use these sticks for eating, you can never quite get used to them. Broth and noodles alike are lukewarm by this point, and the two of you savour them in silence under the thin [dayNight||moon]light, a gentle breeze blowing in from the forest. Like Kiyoko herself, the food is simple and homely, evoking a strange sentiment of longing in your heart. Speaking of longing... hey, these noodles are really long... "They're made that way to symbolise long life," Kiyoko says with a small laugh, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails curling about herself. "Seven gods, I've lived long enough, or at least it feels that way. Who am I to complain, though? Komari must get sick at the sight of these." Well, your fox-wife looks pretty good for someone who's broken her second century. Why, she doesn't look a day over fifty. Kiyoko just giggles and shakes her head. Hmm... you still feel a little clumsy with these foreign utensils, but you manage to pick up a small portion of dried shrimp and hold it out in front of Kiyoko's face. Her ears wiggle and twitch as she realizes what you're doing, and your kitsune wife's cheeks color faintly. "Ehehe, I don't know, beloved... I'll feel kinda embarrassed if you feed me..." Nonsense. You've known her in the most intimate, carnal fashion now. There's absolutely no reason for her to get all bashful over something as simple as you feeding her. Kiyoko looks askance, a small grin set in her face. "All right, all right." There's a good fluffy girl. Say aaaah. "Aaaah." Leaning forward, Kiyoko bites the shrimp off your chopsticks, then settles back, chewing. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"Well, if that isn't adorable. Mom and Dad feeding each other like a newlywed couple." The two of you turn to see Kinu coming down the path with her own tray, relaxed as ever. Your fox-daughter plops herself down on the box with the two of you, then wastes no time slurping away her soba noodles at a prodigious pace. "I'm soooo hungry." Kiyoko sighs softly. "Your appetite is as good as that boy whom you're seeing..." Wait, did Kinu see you — Kiyoko just shrugs and smiles sadly. "It's best our daughter have a good model to follow in her own relationship. That's as much as we can do at this point. "It's not so often that we get to do things together, [pc.name]. Let's set this aside and enjoy the moment, shall we? "I'll go get these back to the kitchens. [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, don't wait on me, okay?" Wait, you — "There's no point doing that, beloved. She won't listen to anyone, least of all. At least it's something benign here. Come now, let's not ruin the mood of what's supposed to be an auspicious day, shall we?" |"What a poetic expression of affection — [pc.mf|Father|Mother] and Mother feeding each other like a newlywed couple." The two of you turn to see Kinu coming down the path with her own tray, taking small, careful steps as she approaches. Your fox-daughter gracefully seats herself down on the box with the two of you, then begins alongside the both of you. "I suppose I should have had more, but I will be doing this again for Nakano later on, too..." Kiyoko sighs softly. "Put in some extra effort for that boy, daughter. He's worth it." People bustling in the streets and brightly colored lanterns festooned all over the place. They were good times.[pc.bg minstrel| Of course, since you were a minstrel, it was just another workday, more haranguing than most. Festivals are never festivals for those doing the entertaining.][pc.bg noblescion| As one of the local nobility, you never lacked for anything during the festival... but here and now, sitting here with Kiyoko, you're feeling the moment far more keenly than any amount of carousal could have brought you.] ] [pc.bg soldier| Mostly being thankful for living out another year. Casualties were high in the life you led, and every year you'd see more and more of your fellow soldiers succumb to either injury or the sheer stresses of bloodshed day in, day out. The lucky ones were able to return home with perhaps a missing limb or couple of fingers; the less fortunate ended up burning in a mass grave. With Tira staring one in the face every day, simply being alive to usher in the new year was cause for celebration on what meager pay you had. ] [pc.bg hunter barbarian| Plenty of revelry and singing with the clan, that's for sure. You remember that the clan elders would break out the moonshine they'd been putting away for the entirety of the year, and everyone would gather by the bonfire's light to prepare the next year's batch while getting roaringly drunk. Even the children would be given some of the stuff after it'd been appropriately watered down — the new years' moonshine was strong, if nothing else. There'd be stories told, of course — after all these years, the tale of the moon-eating bear's one that's inexplicably stuck in your memory. The clan didn't have much in the way of material comforts those in the cities could afford, but it more than made up for it with the sheer intensity of the people participating in the celebrations. ] [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte| An evening of quiet repose and meditation, usually[pc.bg acolyte| followed by prayer to one or more of the Seven]. Your studies set you apart from society at large, and the revelries of new years' celebrations were often either too distant or simply didn't hold that much appeal to you. Going out into the streets of town and getting smashed with strangers just didn't seem meaningful at the time; you'd rather have spent the occasion with people you actually had meaningful relationships with. ] [pc.bg slumrat| Festivities? They were an opportunity to make a quick coin or two, whether it be from begging or less wholesome activities. Life was hard, and happiness and revelry was for other people; those were days you're glad to have left behind and never want to look back on again. ] Kiyoko listens to your recollections in silence, then heaves a little sigh when you're done. Your fox-wife sits herself down beside you on the crate, then leans her head against her shoulder, vulpine ears tickling your cheek. "We've been through so much together, beloved. It stirs a certain longing in one's heart." Um — Before you can reply, though, Kiyoko raises a finger to her lips and smiles. "It's okay. I'm just happy you're here with me to[dayNight|day|night]. Come on, let's have the toshikoshi soba before it gets too cold." Of course, of course... no matter how many times you try to use these sticks for eating, you can never quite get used to them. Broth and noodles alike are lukewarm by this point, and the two of you savour them in silence under the thin [dayNight||moon]light, a gentle breeze blowing in from the forest. Like Kiyoko herself, the food is simple and homely, evoking a strange sentiment of longing in your heart. Speaking of longing... hey, these noodles are really long... "They're made that way to symbolise long life," Kiyoko says with a small laugh, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails curling about herself. "Seven gods, I've lived long enough, or at least it feels that way. Who am I to complain, though? Komari must get sick at the sight of these." Well, your fox-wife looks pretty good for someone who's broken her second century. Why, she doesn't look a day over fifty. Kiyoko just giggles and shakes her head. Hmm... you still feel a little clumsy with these foreign utensils, but you manage to pick up a small portion of dried shrimp and hold it out in front of Kiyoko's face. Her ears wiggle and twitch as she realizes what you're doing, and your kitsune wife's cheeks color faintly. "Ehehe, I don't know, beloved... I'll feel kinda embarrassed if you feed me..." Nonsense. You've known her in the most intimate, carnal fashion now. There's absolutely no reason for her to get all bashful over something as simple as you feeding her. Kiyoko looks askance, a small grin set in her face. "All right, all right." There's a good fluffy girl. Say aaaah. "Aaaah." Leaning forward, Kiyoko bites the shrimp off your chopsticks, then settles back, chewing. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"Well, if that isn't adorable. Mom and Dad feeding each other like a newlywed couple." The two of you turn to see Kinu coming down the path with her own tray, relaxed as ever. Your fox-daughter plops herself down on the box with the two of you, then wastes no time slurping away her soba noodles at a prodigious pace. "I'm soooo hungry." Kiyoko sighs softly. "Your appetite is as good as that boy whom you're seeing..." Wait, did Kinu see you — Kiyoko just shrugs and smiles sadly. "It's best our daughter have a good model to follow in her own relationship. That's as much as we can do at this point. "It's not so often that we get to do things together, [pc.name]. Let's set this aside and enjoy the moment, shall we? It is, after all, the beginning of a new year." Yeah... you pat Kinu between her ears, and your daughter wiggles in place while she continues emptying the bowl. Bit by bit, the food gradually disappears, and eventually there're three empty bowls on the tray. "I'm full!" With that, Kinu jolts up on her feet and gathers all the utensils onto her own tray. "I'll go get these back to the kitchens. [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, don't wait on me, okay?" Wait, you — "There's no point doing that, beloved. She won't listen to anyone, least of all. At least it's something benign here. Come now, let's not ruin the mood of what's supposed to be an auspicious day, shall we?" |"What a poetic expression of affection — [pc.mf|Father|Mother] and Mother feeding each other like a newlywed couple." The two of you turn to see Kinu coming down the path with her own tray, taking small, careful steps as she approaches. Your fox-daughter gracefully seats herself down on the box with the two of you, then begins alongside the both of you. "I suppose I should have had more, but I will be doing this again for Nakano later on, too..." Kiyoko sighs softly. "Put in some extra effort for that boy, daughter. He's worth it." Wait, did Kinu see you — Kiyoko just shrugs and smiles sadly. "It's best our daughter have a good model to follow in her own relationship. That's as much as we can do at this point. "It's not so often that we get to do things together, [pc.name]. Let's set this aside and enjoy the moment, shall we? It is, after all, the beginning of a new year." Yeah... you pat Kinu between her ears, and your daughter holds herself with perfect grace while she continues emptying the bowl. Bit by bit, the food gradually disappears, and eventually there're three empty bowls on the tray. "I am sated." With that, Kinu rises to her feet and gathers all the utensils onto her own tray. "Please, allow me to bring these back, and enjoy yourselves. This is but a small service from me as your daughter to my parents." Wait, you — "Shush, beloved. She went to all the trouble of setting this up for us, after all. Come now, let's not ruin the mood of what's supposed to be an auspicious day, shall we?" ] "

rows.original: "Well, there's a little ritual I'd like to introduce you to," Kiyoko says, a twinkle in her eye. "If you wouldn't mind?" A ritual, eh? Oh, you know she's up to something when she's got that mischievous air about her. Guess you don't mind playing along; you know that your kitsune wife here would never mean you any actual harm. "Right. Follow me, please." The two of you eventually come to another section of crater's edge, not too far away from the cavern shrine where you first found the amulet that started all this. You'd never noticed it before — and unsurprisingly so, considering how well hidden it is — but there's a little gazebo-like structure planted squarely on the border between civilization and wilderness. Hanging from rust-flecked chains are a huge bell and a clapper the size and length of a tree trunk; the bell itself is huge, ancient, and covered with all sorts of carvings and patches of greenish patina. "It's very inspiring that it's stood after two and a half centuries. Originally, it was meant to be an alarm, but I think we've progressed past simple bells at this point. Even so, one of the first things I had Kinu do when we emerged was to have the clapper replaced. At this point, there's more to this than just practicality, after all." You look bell and clapper alike and give the former a rap with your knuckles. Solid bronze, indeed. So, you take it that you're supposed to ring the bell? Kiyoko nods and smiles. "A hundred and eight times, to be precise. One for each of the proscribed mental states which Lord Keros warns leads to unwholesome actions." Unwholesome actions... that's one way of putting it. A hundred and eight times... that's quite a few. [pc.toughnessRange 70|Not that you aren't going to welcome the challenge — if nothing else, it'll be a good exercise in pacing yourself.] "I'll help you, of course. No one said you were doing this alone." [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't think you need the help, this'll be a lot more meaningful with two people instead of one. |Ah, right. It'll be a lot easier with two people instead of one. ] Did she use to do this a lot in the past? "During my captivity? Not so much; there wasn't a reason to observe the new year when time simply blended into a blur, one day flowing into the next like the one that came before it. Before that, though, when I was a girl in the Old Country... haha, three or four of us would be clamouring to have a go at the clapper under my mother's watchful eye." Sniffling a little, Kiyoko wipes a stray tear from her cheek. "It was a small wonder we ever managed to finish ringing it before the sun came up." ... "Come, now. Shall we get started?" Of course. Stepping over to the large wooden clapper, you take it under an arm and test its weight. This sure is some solid wood, and the chains, though flecked with a patina of green, look sturdy enough. Kiyoko steps back and observes you closely as you take a deep breath to steel yourself, draw back the clapper, and send it crashing into the large bronze bell with all your might. Bong... The sound rings out through the air, loud and clear despite the bell's age. It resonates in your bones, bounces about in your head, and eventually leaves you, but not without leaving you feeling thoroughly rattled — but oddly enough, in a good way. By the time the last echo finally fades, you're tingling from head to toe as if you'd just been zapped with a burst of static. A small smattering of applause. "Not bad, [pc.name]. One hundred and seven more times to go, then." Phew... It's hard at first, especially when you need to stop and recover from the tremendous, clarion ringing each time, but eventually both your muscles and skull get used to it and it's not so bad by the twentieth or so strike of the bell. [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't feel that out of sorts, Kiyoko insists that she take over the job after the forty-second strike and let you rest for a bit before coming back to it. The set of her face and her folded arms strongly suggest that she's not taking no for an answer. |By the forty-second strike, you're starting to feel it in your joints, and Kiyoko offers to take over for a while and let you rest a bit. It's a small mercy you eagerly accept, and you let her have it all to herself while you shake out your shoulders and waist. ] There's a nice mossy stone to one side where you can get a good view of the proceedings, and it's this you lean against while watching Kiyoko go at it. Despite being small and slight, your foxy lover's clearly no stranger to this; where she lacks in strength, she makes up for in technique, moving her body with the natural flow of the clapper as she strikes the bell over and over again. Kiyoko's natural wiggliness and flexibility as a kitsune comes in handy as she leverages her body weight into the equation. "Sixty-three, sixty-four, sixty-five. Phew. It's your turn once more, beloved." Oh, already? She looked like she was having so much fun there. "Oh, I was, no doubt about that. However, as you're the guest to[dayNight|day|night], it's important for you to get the best experience you can out of the ceremonies." Ha, since she put it so nicely, you guess you don't have a choice... Just as you're about to get up and reclaim your old spot, though, you spy a familiar figure approaching the both of you. It's not hard to recognize your firstborn daughter at a distance, not when her silvery-white hair and fur glimmer like that when the [dayNight|sunlight strikes|moonbeams strike] them. Coming to a stop before the two of you, Kinu announces her presence by way of coughing gently, and [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |plants her hands on her hips |gives both Kiyoko and you a small bow ]. Now, what is she doing here? "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Here to ring the bell with you, of course! I'm done with the dishes, so why not? It's not as if I'm not old enough to [dayNight|do it|wait for the sunrise with the both of you!] |[pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, I would like to ring the bell with you. The dishes are cleaned and put away, so if you do not mind my presence... ]" You look between the bell clapper, practically the size of a tree trunk, then back at Kinu. Is she sure about that? "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Sheesh! I may be small, but I've got a pretty robust body, you know! Just let me at the bell! |Ah... I would like to think that Mother's exercise regimen has done me some good. If you do not mind... I may have a slight stature, but appearances can be deceiving... ]" Kiyoko taps her chin. "Hmm. What do you say, love?" She's a grown woman now, and no longer a child. There're only about forty more strikes of the bell to go, and you get the feeling that things would be a lot more fun if you did this as a family. So yes, you'd love to have her go at it with you. So it comes to pass that the three of you arrange yourselves about the clapper as a family, with you in front, Kiyoko behind, and Kinu sandwiched between you two. Once more, you draw back the clapper by its chains and strike the bell with all your might. Bong... [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Kinu's a strong little thing, carrying her own weight when it comes to drawing back the clapper. She's right — despite her small size even by kitsune standards, she's the body and strength of a working girl. |Kinu keeps a tight hold on the clapper, drawing it back with the rest of you. She doesn't have that much strength by herself, but with the three of you working together, everything seems to go forward so much more smoothly. ] Bong... Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but who wouldn't, surrounded by family like this? Bong. Has it been a hundred and eight tolls of the bell already? It doesn't feel like it — [pc.toughnessRange|you're still plenty energetic as it is|all that activity was far less tiring than you thought it would be]. But neither your foxy wife nor your fluffy daughter are revving up the clapper for another strike, so it must be over. You wipe the sweat from your brow, take a few deep breaths, and contemplate the matter in silence. Sure, it was a lot of hard work, and this isn't part of your own culture... but by being here with Kiyoko and Kinu, there's no doubt it's been worth your while. Your fox-wife gives you a smile. "Happy new year, beloved." [dayNight |Kinu [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |smiles and wipes the sweat off her brow. "Well, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, while it's not quite time for the new year yet, I guess we adhered to all the customs." |smiles and daintily wipes the sweat from her brow. "[pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, thank you for being here for me throughout all the traditions. May this new year be an auspicious one." ] The sun's setting now, slowly dipping on the other side of the crater rim and draggin the veil of night along with it. As you watch, transfixed, Kiyoko comes up to your side and melts against your shoulder, draping herself on you with a smile. |Kinu [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |smiles and wipes the sweat off her brow. "Well, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, guess we made it into the new year. Look, the sun's coming up now." |smiles and daintily wipes the sweat from her brow. "[pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, look. The first sunrise of the year." ] She's not wrong. From where you stand, you can see a dull orange glow cresting the lip of the crater, slowly pushing away the inky darkness of the starry night sky. As you watch, transfixed, Kiyoko comes up to your side and melts against your shoulder, draping herself on you with a smile. ] "Happy new year, [pc.name]. May it be a successful and prosperous one for you." The same for her — and of course, Kinu as well. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"Happy new year, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." |"Happy new year, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." ] Yep, [dayNight|it's been a good day, and the next promises to be even better|it's been only a few minutes into the new year, and things are looking up already]. Well then, it's probably time for you to head to bed... this time with your fox-wife. To be able to go to bed with Kiyoko... ah, this is what you fought so hard for. Small blessings for the new year. Scooping your kitsune wife and hearing Kinu squeal behind you at the sight, you head straight for the kitsune shrine and bed.
rows.translation: 嗯，有一个小仪式，我想向你们介绍一下。清子说道，她的眼中闪烁着光芒。如果你不介意的话…… 一种仪式，是吧？哦，当你看到她那调皮的神情时，你就知道她肯定在策划什么。看来你也不介意陪她一起玩这个游戏；你知道，你这位九尾狐妻子绝对不会对你造成任何真正的伤害。 好的，请跟我来。 你们俩最终来到了陨石坑边缘的另一个区域，这个地方距离你们最初发现那个引发这一切事件的护身符的洞穴神龛并不远。之前你们根本没有注意到它——考虑到它隐藏得如此之好，这也并不奇怪——但在人类文明与荒野的交界处，确实有一个类似凉亭的小建筑矗立在那里。那些布满锈斑的链条上悬挂着一口巨大的钟和一块形状与长度都像树干一样的钟槌；这口钟本身非常庞大，历史悠久，上面刻满了各种图案，还覆盖着一层绿色的铜锈。 它能历经两个半世纪依然屹立不倒，实在是一件非常鼓舞人心的事情。最初，它被设计成一种警报装置，但我想，如今我们已经超越了单纯使用铃声的阶段。即便如此，当我们从那个地方出来后，我做的第一件事就是让小娟把那个钟舌换掉。毕竟，现在这件事已经超越了实用性的范畴。 你们俩长得一模一样，你用指关节轻轻敲了敲那个铃铛。确实是纯青铜制成的。那么，你是觉得应该去敲这个铃铛吗？ 清子点了点头，微笑着回答。确切地说是一百零八次。每次都是针对克罗斯大人所警告的那些会导致不良行为的心理状态。 不健康的行为……这么说吧。一百零八次……这个数字确实相当大了。 [pc.toughnessRange 70|其实你并不会拒绝这个挑战——至少，这会是一个锻炼自己控制节奏的好机会。] 我当然会帮你。没人说过你必须独自完成这件事。 [pc.toughnessRange 70 |虽然你可能觉得不需要别人的帮助，但两个人一起做这件事，效果肯定会比一个人好得多。 |啊，对。两个人一起做的话，肯定会比一个人容易很多。 ]她以前经常这样做吗？ 在我被囚禁的那段时间里？倒不是特别会庆祝新年；因为时间根本分不清日夜，一天就这样缓缓过渡到下一天，与前一天毫无区别。不过在那之前，当我还是老家的那个小女孩的时候……哈哈，会有三四个小伙伴在妈妈的注视下争着去玩那个拍手游戏。基约科轻轻抽泣着，用纸巾擦去了脸颊上的一滴泪水。能在太阳升起之前完成敲钟的任务，已经算是小小的奇迹了。 …… 来吧，现在就开始吧。 当然可以。你走到那块巨大的木制拍子旁，把它夹在手臂下，试了试它的重量。这确实是块质地非常结实的木头，而那些链条虽然表面覆盖着一层绿色的锈迹，但看起来也足够坚固。清子站在一旁，密切观察着你。你深吸一口气，鼓起勇气，然后将拍子用力甩向那面巨大的青铜钟。 砰…… 这种声音在空气中回荡，尽管铃已经有了很长的历史，但它依然清晰响亮。这种震动会传达到你的骨子里，在你的脑海中不断回响，最终才会消失，但在此之前，它一定会让你感到一阵恍惚——不过奇怪的是，这种感觉却是令人愉悦的。当最后的回声终于消失时，你会从头到脚感到一阵刺痛，就好像刚刚被一阵静电击中了一样。 接着，是一阵轻微的掌声。不错，[pc.name]那么，还剩下107次了。 呼…… 一开始确实很困难，尤其是每次当那震耳欲聋的铃声响起时，你都需要停下来休息一会儿，但渐渐地，你的肌肉和头部都会适应这种节奏，到了敲钟二十次左右的时候，这种感觉就已经没那么难受了。 [pc.toughnessRange 70 |虽然你并不觉得有什么不妥，但清子坚持要在第42次攻击之后由她来接手这项工作，让你先休息一会儿再继续。她那副表情以及双臂交叉的姿势，清楚地表明她不会接受拒绝。 |到了第四十二次攻击时，你的关节已经开始感到疼痛了。这时，清子主动提出暂时接手攻击，让你休息一会儿。你欣然接受了这个帮助，让她独自继续攻击，而你则活动活动肩膀和腰部，缓解疼痛。 ]在一边有一块长满苔藓的石头，站在那里你可以清楚地看到整个过程。观看清子进行这项活动时，就可以靠在这块石头上。 虽然你的这位娇小玲珑的爱人身材瘦小，但她显然对这项活动非常熟悉；在力量上有所欠缺的地方，她就用技巧来弥补——她随着拍板的自然节奏移动身体，一遍又一遍地敲击铃铛。作为一只狐妖，清子的天生的灵活与柔韧性在这里发挥了重要作用——她巧妙地利用了自己的体重来达到目的。 六十三、六十四、六十五。呼，又到你的回合了，亲爱的。 哦，已经结束了？她看起来在那里玩得非常开心啊。 哦，我确实是这么做的，这一点毫无疑问。不过，既然你是我们的客人[dayNight|天|夜晚]因此，对于你来说，尽可能地享受这些仪式带来的体验是非常重要的。 哈，既然她说得这么委婉，那你也没办法选择了吧…… 就在你准备起身回到原来的位置时，你突然看到一个熟悉的身影正向你们走来。远远认出长女并不难，尤其是她那银白色的头发和毛皮在[dayNight|阳光|月光]下如此闪耀的时候。她在你们面前停下脚步。小娟轻轻咳嗽了一声，以此来表明自己的存在。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |双手叉腰 |向清子和你都微微鞠了一躬。 ]那么，她在这里做什么呢？ "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |当然，我很乐意和你一起敲响这个钟声！我已经洗完盘子了，所以为什么不呢？我又不是年纪太小，不能做这件事[dayNight|去做吧。|你们俩一起等待日出吧！] |[pc.mf|父亲|母亲]妈妈，我想和您一起敲钟。盘子都已经洗好收好了，所以如果您不介意我的陪伴的话…… ]" 你将目光转向那个几乎有树干那么大的钟槌，然后又看向小娟。她真的确定吗？ "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |哎呀！虽然我个子不高，但我的身体可挺结实的，你知道的！只要让我有机会出手，肯定不会让你失望的！ |啊……我愿意相信，母亲的锻炼方式确实对我有些好处。如果你不介意的话……虽然我的身材可能不算高挑，但外表有时候会骗人啊…… ]" 清子托着下巴思考着。嗯，亲爱的，你怎么看？ 她现在已经是个成年女性了，不再是小孩子了。距离敲钟结束只剩下大约四十次了，你会觉得，如果全家一起来做这件事的话，一定会更加有趣。所以，你当然很希望她能和你一起参与其中。 于是，你们三个人一家人一样地围在钟架旁，你站在前面，清子站在后面，而小娟则被你们两人夹在中间。你们再次拉紧钟链，然后用尽全力去敲钟。 砰…… rows.raw: " "Well, there's a little ritual I'd like to introduce you to," Kiyoko says, a twinkle in her eye. "If you wouldn't mind?" A ritual, eh? Oh, you know she's up to something when she's got that mischievous air about her. Guess you don't mind playing along; you know that your kitsune wife here would never mean you any actual harm. "Right. Follow me, please." The two of you eventually come to another section of crater's edge, not too far away from the cavern shrine where you first found the amulet that started all this. You'd never noticed it before — and unsurprisingly so, considering how well hidden it is — but there's a little gazebo-like structure planted squarely on the border between civilization and wilderness. Hanging from rust-flecked chains are a huge bell and a clapper the size and length of a tree trunk; the bell itself is huge, ancient, and covered with all sorts of carvings and patches of greenish patina. "It's very inspiring that it's stood after two and a half centuries. Originally, it was meant to be an alarm, but I think we've progressed past simple bells at this point. Even so, one of the first things I had Kinu do when we emerged was to have the clapper replaced. At this point, there's more to this than just practicality, after all." You look bell and clapper alike and give the former a rap with your knuckles. Solid bronze, indeed. So, you take it that you're supposed to ring the bell? Kiyoko nods and smiles. "A hundred and eight times, to be precise. One for each of the proscribed mental states which Lord Keros warns leads to unwholesome actions." Unwholesome actions... that's one way of putting it. A hundred and eight times... that's quite a few. [pc.toughnessRange 70|Not that you aren't going to welcome the challenge — if nothing else, it'll be a good exercise in pacing yourself.] "I'll help you, of course. No one said you were doing this alone." [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't think you need the help, this'll be a lot more meaningful with two people instead of one. |Ah, right. It'll be a lot easier with two people instead of one. ] Did she use to do this a lot in the past? "During my captivity? Not so much; there wasn't a reason to observe the new year when time simply blended into a blur, one day flowing into the next like the one that came before it. Before that, though, when I was a girl in the Old Country... haha, three or four of us would be clamouring to have a go at the clapper under my mother's watchful eye." Sniffling a little, Kiyoko wipes a stray tear from her cheek. "It was a small wonder we ever managed to finish ringing it before the sun came up." ... "Come, now. Shall we get started?" Of course. Stepping over to the large wooden clapper, you take it under an arm and test its weight. This sure is some solid wood, and the chains, though flecked with a patina of green, look sturdy enough. Kiyoko steps back and observes you closely as you take a deep breath to steel yourself, draw back the clapper, and send it crashing into the large bronze bell with all your might. Bong... The sound rings out through the air, loud and clear despite the bell's age. It resonates in your bones, bounces about in your head, and eventually leaves you, but not without leaving you feeling thoroughly rattled — but oddly enough, in a good way. By the time the last echo finally fades, you're tingling from head to toe as if you'd just been zapped with a burst of static. A small smattering of applause. "Not bad, [pc.name]. One hundred and seven more times to go, then." Phew... It's hard at first, especially when you need to stop and recover from the tremendous, clarion ringing each time, but eventually both your muscles and skull get used to it and it's not so bad by the twentieth or so strike of the bell. [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't feel that out of sorts, Kiyoko insists that she take over the job after the forty-second strike and let you rest for a bit before coming back to it. The set of her face and her folded arms strongly suggest that she's not taking no for an answer. |By the forty-second strike, you're starting to feel it in your joints, and Kiyoko offers to take over for a while and let you rest a bit. It's a small mercy you eagerly accept, and you let her have it all to herself while you shake out your shoulders and waist. ] There's a nice mossy stone to one side where you can get a good view of the proceedings, and it's this you lean against while watching Kiyoko go at it. Despite being small and slight, your foxy lover's clearly no stranger to this; where she lacks in strength, she makes up for in technique, moving her body with the natural flow of the clapper as she strikes the bell over and over again. Kiyoko's natural wiggliness and flexibility as a kitsune comes in handy as she leverages her body weight into the equation. "Sixty-three, sixty-four, sixty-five. Phew. It's your turn once more, beloved." Oh, already? She looked like she was having so much fun there. "Oh, I was, no doubt about that. However, as you're the guest to[dayNight|day|night], it's important for you to get the best experience you can out of the ceremonies." Ha, since she put it so nicely, you guess you don't have a choice... Just as you're about to get up and reclaim your old spot, though, you spy a familiar figure approaching the both of you. It's not hard to recognize your firstborn daughter at a distance, not when her silvery-white hair and fur glimmer like that when the [dayNight|sunlight strikes|moonbeams strike] them. Coming to a stop before the two of you, Kinu announces her presence by way of coughing gently, and [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |plants her hands on her hips |gives both Kiyoko and you a small bow ]. Now, what is she doing here? "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Here to ring the bell with you, of course! I'm done with the dishes, so why not? It's not as if I'm not old enough to [dayNight|do it|wait for the sunrise with the both of you!] |[pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, I would like to ring the bell with you. The dishes are cleaned and put away, so if you do not mind my presence... ]" You look between the bell clapper, practically the size of a tree trunk, then back at Kinu. Is she sure about that? "[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Sheesh! I may be small, but I've got a pretty robust body, you know! Just let me at the bell! |Ah... I would like to think that Mother's exercise regimen has done me some good. If you do not mind... I may have a slight stature, but appearances can be deceiving... ]" Kiyoko taps her chin. "Hmm. What do you say, love?" She's a grown woman now, and no longer a child. There're only about forty more strikes of the bell to go, and you get the feeling that things would be a lot more fun if you did this as a family. So yes, you'd love to have her go at it with you. So it comes to pass that the three of you arrange yourselves about the clapper as a family, with you in front, Kiyoko behind, and Kinu sandwiched between you two. Once more, you draw back the clapper by its chains and strike the bell with all your might. Bong... [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Kinu's a strong little thing, carrying her own weight when it comes to drawing back the clapper. She's right — despite her small size even by kitsune standards, she's the body and strength of a working girl. |Kinu keeps a tight hold on the clapper, drawing it back with the rest of you. She doesn't have that much strength by herself, but with the three of you working together, everything seems to go forward so much more smoothly. ] Bong... Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but who wouldn't, surrounded by family like this? Bong. Has it been a hundred and eight tolls of the bell already? It doesn't feel like it — [pc.toughnessRange|you're still plenty energetic as it is|all that activity was far less tiring than you thought it would be]. But neither your foxy wife nor your fluffy daughter are revving up the clapper for another strike, so it must be over. You wipe the sweat from your brow, take a few deep breaths, and contemplate the matter in silence. Sure, it was a lot of hard work, and this isn't part of your own culture... but by being here with Kiyoko and Kinu, there's no doubt it's been worth your while. Your fox-wife gives you a smile. "Happy new year, beloved." [dayNight |Kinu [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |smiles and wipes the sweat off her brow. "Well, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, while it's not quite time for the new year yet, I guess we adhered to all the customs." |smiles and daintily wipes the sweat from her brow. "[pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, thank you for being here for me throughout all the traditions. May this new year be an auspicious one." ] The sun's setting now, slowly dipping on the other side of the crater rim and draggin the veil of night along with it. As you watch, transfixed, Kiyoko comes up to your side and melts against your shoulder, draping herself on you with a smile. |Kinu [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |smiles and wipes the sweat off her brow. "Well, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Mom, guess we made it into the new year. Look, the sun's coming up now." |smiles and daintily wipes the sweat from her brow. "[pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother, look. The first sunrise of the year." ] She's not wrong. From where you stand, you can see a dull orange glow cresting the lip of the crater, slowly pushing away the inky darkness of the starry night sky. As you watch, transfixed, Kiyoko comes up to your side and melts against your shoulder, draping herself on you with a smile. ] "Happy new year, [pc.name]. May it be a successful and prosperous one for you." The same for her — and of course, Kinu as well. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |"Happy new year, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." |"Happy new year, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." ] Yep, [dayNight|it's been a good day, and the next promises to be even better|it's been only a few minutes into the new year, and things are looking up already]. Well then, it's probably time for you to head to bed... this time with your fox-wife. To be able to go to bed with Kiyoko... ah, this is what you fought so hard for. Small blessings for the new year. Scooping your kitsune wife and hearing Kinu squeal behind you at the sight, you head straight for the kitsune shrine and bed. "

rows.original: To your mild surprise, Kiyoko leans forward and plants her hands on your shoulders. Making little purring noises in the back of her throat, your foxy wife bows her head just so that her folded ears tickle your chin with the lightest of touches. "Mmm... do you know what I want right now?" Of course. "Right." Kiyoko's arms wrap about your sides, her tiny hands clasping about your back even as she lays her cheek on your [pc.chest]. "Let's make a kit." By the Seven, that's quite forward of her. "Why? You don't want another one?" No, it's not necessarily that, but — Kiyoko makes a needy, pouty little noise in the back of her throat and nuzzles her face ever deeper into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "Then why not? It's a nice, cool [dayNight|day|night], the grass is soft, there's no one around to bother us — isn't it so romantic? Making a kit [dayNight||under the moonlight, ]on the eve of the new year?" Eh... hah. You ought've known that conversations with her tend to take such turns. Really, you shouldn't have been surprised at all. [kiyoko.numKits 1 8 16 32 |Ever since your foxy wife's had Kinu, she's been wanting more and more fluffy fox kits to add to her growing family. It's as if you've woken something quite insatiable in her womb... "Aww, I'm not that needy and demanding, am I? It just feels so nice to be with child like that... not to mention when I receive your chi into myself." It's not so much being demanding as it is being assertive and sometimes a little overwhelming. The way how her usually meek demeanour can turn intense and forceful when certain topics — like breeding — are brought up can throw off the unwary. |She's already had more children than most women will ever have in their lifetimes, and she keeps on wanting more. "Eh, you say it like it's a bad thing." Were Kiyoko any other woman, she might've given you pause. However, she's no one else but herself — there's no denying that she's handled so many fluffy fox kits so excellently. That, and instead of wearing out her body, the repeated pregnancies and births have done the exact opposite. A thin smile. "So there's nothing to worry about, right? Just take it easy and let what happens naturally take its course..." She sure has a one-track mind when it comes to these things. |After all the kits you've fathered on Kiyoko, after all the seed you've planted in her insatiable womb, a question like this is but par for the course. Your foxy slut-wife simply purrs again, two of her tails curling about your feet. "Well then, you should simply succumb to your fate as my beloved cum-pump, should you not? Make another kit for the den?" Looking over Kiyoko with her increasingly ripe tits and her kit-pushing hips blatantly visible from under her yukata, it's sorely tempting. Her flat tummy — well, almost flat, given how her waistline's expanded slightly to accommodate her increasingly efficient kit factory — speaking of her empty womb, just begging for a pregging at this point. Kiyoko nuzzles deeper against your [pc.chest], and the faint floral aroma she wears rises up to you, tinged with the edge of her personal scent. "Come on, [pc.name] Don't you think it would be so romantic to conceive a child for the new year?" Sheesh, she really can't think of anything else once she gets babies on her brain... |With the practically obscene number of kits you've planted in her womb and she's nurtured to fruition, what's another one at this point? Kiyoko nuzzles deeper against your [pc.chest], pushing her face insistently against your warm body. "So that's a yes?" Hey, hey, you didn't say that. But with such a plush, fluffy fox mother snuggling up to you like this, it's rather hard to say no. "Hmm... with us having known each other for so long both inside and out, I'd be remiss if you didn't find it hard to deny me at this point. Come on, [pc.name] — don't you think it would be just so meaningful to make another kit for the new year? Rather symbolic, don't you agree?" Hmm... ] "So? Shall we?"

Time to put an end to this day... Kiyoko whimpers and murmurs as you bring her back to her chambers and get out a futon for the both of you, but doesn't complain. You finally finish, and bring your kitsune wife close to bed. "

It's the new year — you ought to observe the proper celebrations instead of doing your own thing. You can put a kit into her womb any time; new years' only comes once a year. "I guess you're right." For now, though, what does she have up her proverbial sleeve?

There, [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |Kinu stands at the fore of the table facing the door, bowing deeply as the two of you enter. Fur ranging in color from white to black to gold to red and gray and even more turns the dining hall into a sea of color, and even though they fidget uncomfortably all of the kits are reasonably well-behaved for the occasion. Kiyoko stands over her daughter, her expression carefully neutral, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails gathered about herself. Reaching down, Kiyoko plucks the bouquet of carnations from Kinu's hands, then takes a step back to study the gift. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |It feels like forever before Kiyoko responds, but she eventually dips her head in her daughter's direction. "You have my thanks." Without you and your delectable chi to make kits with, I wouldn't be sitting here today with the people I love... [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |our kits, and you, of course. This short time has been far better to me than the eternity that I spent alone; how could I not be grateful to you for making all this possible? |our big family. Isn't this just amazing? Come on, it's best to tuck into the food before it gets cold.[kiyoko.numKits 2| See, even the children are eating already.] There'll be time for talk later. "Yes, you're right. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |"Yes." Her smile turns upwards at the corners, becoming downright playful — or at least, it's best interpreted as playful.
