While I'm sure they can guess that they're going to have another sibling soon, they're not quite sure what's involved and can get quite... excitable. ]" All right. You'll be back soon. "Take your time. I'm not going anywhere." That's one way of putting it. Kiyoko is too dignified to scream, but the kitsune is definitely exhausted and under considerable pressure, to put it mildly. Still, if she doesn't want you to see her during the process, and you're okay with helping her in another way... best not to linger on it. Pushing aside the screen door, you step out into the hallway and break into a run. It doesn't take you long to find Kinu — she's at the well drawing water, and sets down the bucket with [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |an exasperated sigh as you tell her what's going on. "All right, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I'll go see to Mom, if that's what she wants." That'd be appreciated. Kinu breaks into a run, disappearing in the direction of the shrine and leaving you to your other tasks |a twitch of her ears as you explain to her what's going on. "Of course. It is my duty to see to Mother in her time of need." Please. Your fox-daughter gives you a dip of her head and sets off a brisk pace, leaving you to your other tasks ]. It takes a little time for you to assemble the two things that Kiyoko asked for — they are on opposite ends of the den, and you can't help but wonder if your fox-wife specifically asked for them because she knew you'd be out for as long as possible. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |It doesn't help that you bump into a few of your children out in the den; they look at you, saying nothing, but clearly look torn between tension and excitement at what's going on in their mother's abode. ] By the time you've retrieved both a basin of warm water and the incense, Kiyoko is already done; as you enter, she greets you with a weak, exhausted smile and a mewling fox kit swaddled in a towel. "Come and meet your new [var0|son|daughter], [pc.name]." Handing the basin of water and jar of incense to Kinu, you take a moment to hold and fuss over the newborn with Kiyoko while Kinu lights the incense with a flicker of foxfire. A sharp yet soothing aroma fills the chamber, vaguely reminiscent of citrus, and the kitsune looks better for it. She's all right, isn't she? "I told you that I was perfectly capable of handling things on my own, beloved. It's really sweet that you're concerned for me, but there's really no reason to doubt my abilities. My own mother would drop a kit in the morning and be out working the fields in the afternoon." All right, if she's sure she's fine. You hand your new [var0|son|daughter] back to Kiyoko, grab a towel off the rack, then proceed to clean up the worst of the birth fluids and afterbirth from the floor with the towel and warm water while Kinu fusses over her new sibling. "You know, Mother would say how she used to get this gloriously relieved feeling every time she made an addition to the family. I never quite understood it before, but I do now." "

rows.original: If she's asking you to leave and help in another way, you could take the graceful retreat and avoid the mess.
rows.translation: 如果她其实是希望你离开，然后以另一种方式提供帮助，那你大可以体面地退出，从而避免惹上麻烦。
rows.raw: "If she's asking you to leave and help in another way, you could take the graceful retreat and avoid the mess."

rows.original: Stepping up to the door of the little shrine, you give it a good knock, expecting Kiyoko to arrive any moment. When she does appear, though, it's with another little fox-kit in tow, looking a little shy and clinging to [flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|his|her] mother's skirts. "Ah, beloved. While you were away, I had the fortune to safely deliver our [flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|son|daughter], and I think the two of you deserve an introduction. Please, greet your father, child." The little fox-kit looks up at you with wide eyes. "H-hi...?" You give the latest addition to your kitsune family a pat on the head, feeling the tiny ball of fluff squirm happily under your touch. Kiyoko smiles and ushers your [flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|son|daughter] out of the house, giving the little fellow a small push. "All right, that's all. Go and find your big sister, okay? I hear she's in need of help today." As your [flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|son|daughter] scampers off, Kiyoko gives you a small dip of her head and invites you into her home with all due pomp and circumstance, leading you to the sitting room and bringing out the candies and tea. "Ah... seeing another kit always makes my heart melt. Well then, beloved, what can I do for you today?"
rows.translation: 你走到那座小神龛的门前，用力敲了敲门，心想基约子应该马上就会过来。然而，当她真的出现时，却带着另一只小狐妖幼崽一起来了，那只小狐妖看起来有些害羞，紧紧地依偎在基约子的身边。 [flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|他的|她]母亲的裙摆。 啊，亲爱的。在你离开的这段时间里，我有幸平安生下了我们的[flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|儿子|女儿]。我觉得你们俩应该互相认识一下。来，孩子，向你的父亲问好吧。 那只小狐妖用大大的眼睛望着你。嗨……？ 你轻轻拍了拍你家九尾狐家族中最新加入的一员的脑袋，感受到那团柔软的毛茸茸的毛发在你触碰下快乐地扭动着。清子微笑着，然后带你[flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|儿子|女儿]走出家门，轻轻推了那小家伙一下。 好了，就这样。去帮你姐姐吧，好吗？我听说她今天需要帮助。 作为你的[flags.KIYOKO_NEW_KIT_GENDER|儿子|女儿]基约科快步跑开了，然后轻轻点了点头，以极其隆重的方式邀请你进入她的家。她带你来到客厅，拿出了糖果和茶。 啊……每次看到新的角色套装，我的心里都会感到无比激动。那么，亲爱的，今天我能为你做些什么呢？

rows.original: You step up onto the raised wooden porch, pause to knock out of old habit, then remember that you're married and this is your home now. There's no need for such things... you reach for the handle, turn, and push; there's a brief moment as the door resists, then swings open easily to reveal the entrance hallway, shoes neatly left by the ingress. [party.som |Is it possible to feel nostalgic for a place that you've never known to begin with? |"Well, don't mind me," [companion1.name] says, jerking a thumb over [companion1.hisHer] shoulder. "You just go in there and have some quality time with your family. Hawkethorne's not too far away — I'll take a little time off while you get yourself sorted out. I'll be back tomorrow at the latest, okay?" Before you know it, [companion1.heShe]'s off, pacing down the road that leads out of the den. |"Well, don't mind us," [companion1.name] says, jerking a thumb over [companion1.hisHer] shoulder. "You just go in there and have some quality time with your family; I'll take [companion2.name] out for a little fun on the town. Hawkethorne's not too far away — we'll have a little time off while you get yourself sorted out. The two of us will be back tomorrow at the latest, okay?" Before you know it, they're off, pacing down the road that leads out of the den. ] No point dithering now; you remove your footwear and head into the little shrine that you and your fox-wife call home. It doesn't take you long to find Kiyoko; she's [rand |out in the back courtyard with a wooden tub full of laundry. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |The way the big wooden tub squishes against her firm, swollen tummy is adorable and serves to make your kitsune wife look even more domestic and motherly than she ordinarily would. That's an achievement in and of itself... |Your fox-wife waddles around with that hefty load in front of her, partially supporting the weight of the tub with her overstuffed roundness of her baby bump. While you're not sure if that's healthy, she's already lugging around so much with a petite body to begin with, so she presumably knows what she's doing. |Guess it's laundry day around this house; it's always a little disconcerting to see your fox-wife with her ten or so sets of the exact same outfit, but then again you're not exactly one to be consulted on fashion and sharp dressing, are you? ] [kiyoko.numKits 1 4 8 16 |With both Kiyoko and Kinu's clothes being hung out, you can't help but smile at the opposing color schemes mother and daughter have chosen for themselves. The more they grow apart as the latter enters womanhood, the more they're the same whether your daughter likes it or not. |Most of the clothes are Kiyoko and Kinu's, but you spy a piece here and there that aren't theirs. The other kits must do their own laundry elsewhere, but no doubt your fox-wife's getting some done while handling her own. That's how things work in a kitsune family, you suppose — all the more that you should try and make yourself a part of this. |The clothesline is a panoply of color, an array of traditional Old Country clothing of all shapes and sizes out on display as it flutters on the breeze. Kiyoko's are the best, of course, followed by Kinu's, but it looks like your fox-wife's decided that just washing for one or two people at one go really isn't worth the trouble and decided to do as much as she can. It's not all, of course, but the fact that this is but a portion of your fox-family's laundry serves as a reminder of just how big it is... and hopefully how much bigger it'll be getting. |With multiple clotheslines out and fabric of all sizes and colors fluttering in the breeze, Kiyoko truly has been hard at work here[kiyoko.pregStage 3| despite being so heavily with child]. The clothesline is a panoply of color, an array of traditional Old Country fashion; Kiyoko's garments are the best, of course, followed by Kinu's, but it looks like your fox-wife's decided that just washing for one or two people at one go really isn't worth the trouble and decided to do as much as she can. This can't be all of your fox-family's laundry, but it certainly has to be a good chunk of it. ] At length, Kiyoko sets down her empty tub by the door, turns to see you, then bows. "Beloved. I did not see you; you could have said something." But you wanted to watch her being domestic. Calling out to her would have spoiled that moment. Your fox-wife raises a finger to her lips in a small smile. "Hmmmn... all right, then. Since you flattered me, I'll let it pass this time. Come now; you do not return home as often as I would like, and I would like to spend some time as a married couple." |up on the [dayNight|sun|moon]lit balcony, tending to her bonsai and other plants[dayNight|| by the light of several foxfire lanterns]. The work is slow and delicate, and by all appearances she's completely absorbed in the task until her ears perk up, swivel, and then she turns to you with a smile, bowing [kiyoko.pregStage 3|as deeply as her big pregnant belly will allow|deeply]. "Ah, hello, beloved. I had thought you might turn up today, but I did not know the exact hour. Still, it is nice to have you home, if for a while. Do make some noise when you make an appearance next time, if you please." It's fine, it's fine. You just wanted to watch her for a while, be reminded of exactly why you married her. "Well, I hope that I've done just that." Setting down her gardening tools, Kiyoko sashays over and [pc.heightRange 65|stands on tiptoe to give|gives] you a kiss on the cheek. "Welcome home, beloved." Ah, it's good to be back. |out by the back, sharing [kiyoko.pregStage 1|amazake|strong rice liquor] with Komari alongside a jelly dish packed full of red beans. The two of them are chatting in their mother tongue, their tone sounding vaguely wistful, until Kiyoko's ears perk up and as one they stand and turn to you and bow. "Beloved." [pc.ra kitsune |"Divine champion." |"[pc.name]." ] And a very good [dayNight|day|evening] to them, too. You're not interrupting anything, are you? "Oh no, [pc.ra kitsune|your Eminence,]" Komari replies. "Just two old women reminiscing old times, that's all. In fact, I am the one interrupting the two of you. With your permission, my liege, I will take the rest of the youkan and depart so that the two of you may spend some time together.[dayNight|| It is getting rather late, after all.]" "Hmm..." "After all, you do not know when [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.hisHer] Eminence|[pc.name]] will next be able to visit, am I not wrong?" "Ah, it's hard to argue with this. Take care." Komari bows, clears the table, then disappears off around the back. The two of you watch her depart until she's gone, and then Kiyoko turns to you and [pc.heightRange 65|stands on tiptoe to give|gives] you a kiss on the cheek. "Welcome home, beloved." Ah, it's good to be back. |[kiyoko.numKits 8 |holding some sort of lesson for your younger kits, reading to them [dayNight||by the light of a foxfire lantern ]while they cling to her and listen attentively. Sure, you don't understand a word of what she's saying, but just being able to hear her voice employed like this is enough to make your stomach tie itself into knots. At length, though, Kiyoko finishes up, and the kits slink off as their mother dismisses them. Your fox-wife looks pensive a moment, then her ears swivel towards the doorway where you've been watching her from. |speaking with Kinu, although given that the conversation's being held in their mother tongue you can't make head or tail of it. Kinu [kinu.isInari|doesn't look too happy about whatever's being discussed, but nods anyway even if she looks sullen about it and leaves the other way|listens quietly to her mother speak, then acknowledges Kiyoko's words with a respectful nod before bowing and walking away in the opposite direction]. Kiyoko gazes after your daughter for a moment, tapping her chin with a finger, then sighs and makes to leave when her ears swivel in your direction. ] "Why, I wasn't expecting you to be home so soon, beloved." Neither were you, but it looks like you're here. "Well, I just got finished dealing with the children, so I could use some comfort." Without waiting, Kiyoko sashays over and gives you as big a hug as she can, wrapping her arms about you and nuzzling her cheeks against your body. "There, much better now. I'd like more, but this will suffice until we can be in private." Ah. Well, there's nothing stopping the two of you from arranging that, is there? "No, indeed there is not." |in her study, penning a letter with brush and paper. Kiyoko moves with gentle yet precise movements, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|especially given her huge belly's wedged between her and the desk|ever refined and graceful]; she makes every stroke count, with just enough ink for just enough paper. At length, she sets down her writing materials and leans back in her chair to allow the letter to dry out, and it's then that your fox-wife's ears perk up and she stands from her seat. "Welcome home, beloved. Are you tired? Is there anything I can get you?" Yes, you're tired, but there's nothing she needs to provide for you. All that you require is standing right here in front of you. Kiyoko smiles, raises a finger to her lips and then wiggles her ears. "Ah. Well, I am more than happy to provide such. But still, it is not always that you are home, and I feel like I should provide more. Do come." ] With that, your fox-wife leads you away and to the familiar sitting room, all set up for your comfort; she bids you rest your legs while she fetches a tea set from a cabinet and begins brewing a fresh pot. Before long, the air is filled with the bitter aroma of plain, hot tea, [kiyoko.numKits 2| and one of your fox-eared children comes into the room with a small plate of sweets, setting it on the table with delicate care. "Thank you," Kiyoko says, fondly petting the little one's large, fluffy ears. "Your parents need to talk for a bit; there'll be plenty of time to play later on, okay?" The fox kit smiles, bows wordlessly, and scurries off. Like mother, like child, one supposes. | washing away what remaining fatigue you might have had. ] "Now," Kiyoko begins as she sits down and pours herself a cup of tea, [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |then moves her hands to rest on her increasingly pregnant tummy, having trouble fitting the fertile bump between her and the table. |your fox-wife's immensely gravid tummy resting on her knees and bumping against the underside of the table. |then turns and gives you a warm smile. ] "Shall we begin? It feels like forever since your last visit, and there's so much to catch up on. We are now married, after all... there need be no secrets between us."
rows.translation: 你走上那扇凸出的木制门廊，出于习惯停了一下才去敲门，但随即想起自己已经结婚了，这里现在也是你的家。这种礼节已经没有必要了……你伸手抓住门把手，转动它，然后推门。门刚开始有些阻力，但很快就被推开了，门内是通往走廊的地方，鞋子也被整齐地放在入口处。 [party.som |对于一个你从来都不了解的地方，是否也可能产生怀旧之情呢？ |嗯，别管我。 [companion1.name]说着，用拇指朝某个方向一指。[companion1.hisHer]肩膀。你就进去陪陪家人，享受一些美好的时光吧。鹰棘镇离这里并不远，我会在你安排好一切的时候休息一会儿。最迟明天我就会回来，好吗？ 不知不觉间，[companion1.heShe]走了，沿着那条通向洞穴外部的道路慢悠悠地走去。 |嗯，别管我们了。 [companion1.name]说着，用拇指朝某个方向一指。[companion1.hisHer]肩膀。你进去陪陪家人，享受一些美好的时光吧；我来负责[companion2.name]我们去城里玩一会儿吧。鹰棘镇离这里不太远，等你处理好自己的事情后，我们可以休息一会儿。我们俩最迟明天就会回来，好吗？ 不知不觉间，它们已经出发了，沿着那条通向洞穴外部的道路开始前进。 ] 现在没时间犹豫了，脱掉鞋子，走进你和你的狐妖妻子共同称之为家的那个小神龛吧。你很快就能找到清子，她就在那里。 [rand |在后面的院子里，有一个装满待洗衣物的木盆。 [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |那个大木盆紧贴着她那结实而隆起的腹部，样子实在可爱极了，这让你的狐妻看起来比平时更加具有家庭妇女和母亲的形象。这本身就已经是一种了不起的成就了…… |你的狐狸妻子拖着那个沉重的负担四处走动，她那圆滚滚的孕肚在一定程度上也在分担着浴缸的重量。虽然你不确定这样是否对她的健康有益，但考虑到她本来就身材娇小，却要背负这么多的东西，想必她是知道自己在做什么的。 |看来今天这家里该洗衣服了……看到你的“狐狸妻子”总是穿着十几套一模一样的衣服，确实会让人有点不舒服。不过，说实话，你在时尚和穿着打扮方面也确实不是个可以征求意见的对象，对吧？ ] [kiyoko.numKits 1 4 8 16 |看到清子和小雪穿的衣服颜色截然不同，你不禁会会心一笑——这对母女选择的服装风格实在太有反差了。随着小雪逐渐长大成人，她们的穿着风格反而变得越来越相似，不管你女儿是否喜欢这一点。 |这些衣服大多数都是清子和小雪的，但偶尔也会看到一些不属于她们的衣物。其他狐狸家族成员肯定会在其他地方自己洗衣服，不过毫无疑问，你的狐狸妻子在照顾自己的同时也会帮忙洗一些别人的衣服。我想，在狐狸家族里就是这样的——因此你更应该努力让自己成为这个家庭的一员。 |晾衣绳上挂满了五颜六色的衣物，那些各式各样、大小不一的传统乡村服装在微风中轻轻摆动。当然，清子的衣物是最漂亮的，其次是小娟的，不过看起来你那位狐狸妻子觉得，一次只为了一两个人洗衣服实在不值得费这个劲，所以她决定尽可能多地洗衣服。 真是的所有当然，但事实上，这仅仅是你们的狐狸家族需要处理的一部分事务，这一事实恰恰提醒我们，他们的任务其实有多繁重……而我们也期待着，他们的任务会变得愈发艰巨。 |当多条晾衣绳伸展开来，各种尺寸和颜色的布料在微风中飘动时，清子确实在这里付出了很多努力。[kiyoko.pregStage 3| 尽管已经怀孕到了如此晚期的阶段]晾衣绳上挂满了五颜六色的衣物，这些都是传统的乡村风格服装；当然，清子的衣服最为漂亮，其次是小娟的，不过看起来你那位狐妖妻子觉得，一次只为了一两个人洗衣服实在不值得费这个劲，所以她决定尽可能多地洗衣服。 这可不行啊所有虽然这只是你们狐妖家族的一小部分事务，但肯定也是其中相当重要的一部分。 ] 最终，清子将那个空浴缸放在门边，转过身来看着你，然后鞠了一躬。亲爱的，我没看到你；你本可以告诉我的。 但你却想看她忙于家务的情景。如果叫她的话，就会破坏那一刻了。 你的狐妖妻子微微一笑，用手指轻轻按住嘴唇。嗯……好吧，既然你这么说了，这次我就不追究了。来吧，你回家的次数实在太少了，我想我们作为夫妻，应该多花些时间在一起。 |在[dayNight|阳光|月光]照亮的阳台上，照料着她的盆景和其他植物。[dayNight|| 在几盏狐火灯的光芒下]这项工作既繁琐又需要细心操作，从她的全神贯注的样子来看，她似乎完全沉浸在任务中。直到这时，她的耳朵突然动了动，然后她转过身来，面带微笑地向你鞠了一躬。 [kiyoko.pregStage 3|在她的巨大孕妇腹部允许的范围内，尽可能深地……|深深地]。 啊，你好，亲爱的。我本来以为你今天会来，不过并不知道具体时间。不过，你能回家来，哪怕只是短暂停留，也让我感到很高兴。下次来的时候，请一定要大声招呼我，好吗？ 没关系，没关系。你只是想多看她一会儿，想再次确认自己当初为什么会娶她而已。 嗯，我希望我确实做到了这一点。放下她的园艺工具，清子蹦蹦跳跳地走了过去。 [pc.heightRange rows.raw: " You step up onto the raised wooden porch, pause to knock out of old habit, then remember that you're married and this is your home now. There's no need for such things... you reach for the handle, turn, and push; there's a brief moment as the door resists, then swings open easily to reveal the entrance hallway, shoes neatly left by the ingress. [party.som |Is it possible to feel nostalgic for a place that you've never known to begin with? |"Well, don't mind me," [companion1.name] says, jerking a thumb over [companion1.hisHer] shoulder. "You just go in there and have some quality time with your family. Hawkethorne's not too far away — I'll take a little time off while you get yourself sorted out. I'll be back tomorrow at the latest, okay?" Before you know it, [companion1.heShe]'s off, pacing down the road that leads out of the den. |"Well, don't mind us," [companion1.name] says, jerking a thumb over [companion1.hisHer] shoulder. "You just go in there and have some quality time with your family; I'll take [companion2.name] out for a little fun on the town. Hawkethorne's not too far away — we'll have a little time off while you get yourself sorted out. The two of us will be back tomorrow at the latest, okay?" Before you know it, they're off, pacing down the road that leads out of the den. ] No point dithering now; you remove your footwear and head into the little shrine that you and your fox-wife call home. It doesn't take you long to find Kiyoko; she's [rand |out in the back courtyard with a wooden tub full of laundry. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |The way the big wooden tub squishes against her firm, swollen tummy is adorable and serves to make your kitsune wife look even more domestic and motherly than she ordinarily would. That's an achievement in and of itself... |Your fox-wife waddles around with that hefty load in front of her, partially supporting the weight of the tub with her overstuffed roundness of her baby bump. While you're not sure if that's healthy, she's already lugging around so much with a petite body to begin with, so she presumably knows what she's doing. |Guess it's laundry day around this house; it's always a little disconcerting to see your fox-wife with her ten or so sets of the exact same outfit, but then again you're not exactly one to be consulted on fashion and sharp dressing, are you? ] [kiyoko.numKits 1 4 8 16 |With both Kiyoko and Kinu's clothes being hung out, you can't help but smile at the opposing color schemes mother and daughter have chosen for themselves. The more they grow apart as the latter enters womanhood, the more they're the same whether your daughter likes it or not. |Most of the clothes are Kiyoko and Kinu's, but you spy a piece here and there that aren't theirs. The other kits must do their own laundry elsewhere, but no doubt your fox-wife's getting some done while handling her own. That's how things work in a kitsune family, you suppose — all the more that you should try and make yourself a part of this. |The clothesline is a panoply of color, an array of traditional Old Country clothing of all shapes and sizes out on display as it flutters on the breeze. Kiyoko's are the best, of course, followed by Kinu's, but it looks like your fox-wife's decided that just washing for one or two people at one go really isn't worth the trouble and decided to do as much as she can. It's not all, of course, but the fact that this is but a portion of your fox-family's laundry serves as a reminder of just how big it is... and hopefully how much bigger it'll be getting. |With multiple clotheslines out and fabric of all sizes and colors fluttering in the breeze, Kiyoko truly has been hard at work here[kiyoko.pregStage 3| despite being so heavily with child]. The clothesline is a panoply of color, an array of traditional Old Country fashion; Kiyoko's garments are the best, of course, followed by Kinu's, but it looks like your fox-wife's decided that just washing for one or two people at one go really isn't worth the trouble and decided to do as much as she can. This can't be all of your fox-family's laundry, but it certainly has to be a good chunk of it. ] At length, Kiyoko sets down her empty tub by the door, turns to see you, then bows. "Beloved. I did not see you; you could have said something." But you wanted to watch her being domestic. Calling out to her would have spoiled that moment. Your fox-wife raises a finger to her lips in a small smile. "Hmmmn... all right, then. Since you flattered me, I'll let it pass this time. Come now; you do not return home as often as I would like, and I would like to spend some time as a married couple." |up on the [dayNight|sun|moon]lit balcony, tending to her bonsai and other plants[dayNight|| by the light of several foxfire lanterns]. The work is slow and delicate, and by all appearances she's completely absorbed in the task until her ears perk up, swivel, and then she turns to you with a smile, bowing [kiyoko.pregStage 3|as deeply as her big pregnant belly will allow|deeply]. "Ah, hello, beloved. I had thought you might turn up today, but I did not know the exact hour. Still, it is nice to have you home, if for a while. Do make some noise when you make an appearance next time, if you please." It's fine, it's fine. You just wanted to watch her for a while, be reminded of exactly why you married her. "Well, I hope that I've done just that." Setting down her gardening tools, Kiyoko sashays over and [pc.heightRange 65|stands on tiptoe to give|gives] you a kiss on the cheek. "Welcome home, beloved." Ah, it's good to be back. |out by the back, sharing [kiyoko.pregStage 1|amazake|strong rice liquor] with Komari alongside a jelly dish packed full of red beans. The two of them are chatting in their mother tongue, their tone sounding vaguely wistful, until Kiyoko's ears perk up and as one they stand and turn to you and bow. "Beloved." [pc.ra kitsune |"Divine champion." |"[pc.name]." ] And a very good [dayNight|day|evening] to them, too. You're not interrupting anything, are you? "Oh no, [pc.ra kitsune|your Eminence,]" Komari replies. "Just two old women reminiscing old times, that's all. In fact, I am the one interrupting the two of you. With your permission, my liege, I will take the rest of the youkan and depart so that the two of you may spend some time together.[dayNight|| It is getting rather late, after all.]" "Hmm..." "After all, you do not know when [pc.ra kitsune|[pc.hisHer] Eminence|[pc.name]] will next be able to visit, am I not wrong?" "Ah, it's hard to argue with this. Take care." Komari bows, clears the table, then disappears off around the back. The two of you watch her depart until she's gone, and then Kiyoko turns to you and [pc.heightRange 65|stands on tiptoe to give|gives] you a kiss on the cheek. "Welcome home, beloved." Ah, it's good to be back. |[kiyoko.numKits 8 |holding some sort of lesson for your younger kits, reading to them [dayNight||by the light of a foxfire lantern ]while they cling to her and listen attentively. Sure, you don't understand a word of what she's saying, but just being able to hear her voice employed like this is enough to make your stomach tie itself into knots. At length, though, Kiyoko finishes up, and the kits slink off as their mother dismisses them. Your fox-wife looks pensive a moment, then her ears swivel towards the doorway where you've been watching her from. |speaking with Kinu, although given that the conversation's being held in their mother tongue you can't make head or tail of it. Kinu [kinu.isInari|doesn't look too happy about whatever's being discussed, but nods anyway even if she looks sullen about it and leaves the other way|listens quietly to her mother speak, then acknowledges Kiyoko's words with a respectful nod before bowing and walking away in the opposite direction]. Kiyoko gazes after your daughter for a moment, tapping her chin with a finger, then sighs and makes to leave when her ears swivel in your direction. ] "Why, I wasn't expecting you to be home so soon, beloved." Neither were you, but it looks like you're here. "Well, I just got finished dealing with the children, so I could use some comfort." Without waiting, Kiyoko sashays over and gives you as big a hug as she can, wrapping her arms about you and nuzzling her cheeks against your body. "There, much better now. I'd like more, but this will suffice until we can be in private." Ah. Well, there's nothing stopping the two of you from arranging that, is there? "No, indeed there is not." |in her study, penning a letter with brush and paper. Kiyoko moves with gentle yet precise movements, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|especially given her huge belly's wedged between her and the desk|ever refined and graceful]; she makes every stroke count, with just enough ink for just enough paper. At length, she sets down her writing materials and leans back in her chair to allow the letter to dry out, and it's then that your fox-wife's ears perk up and she stands from her seat. "Welcome home, beloved. Are you tired? Is there anything I can get you?" Yes, you're tired, but there's nothing she needs to provide for you. All that you require is standing right here in front of you. Kiyoko smiles, raises a finger to her lips and then wiggles her ears. "Ah. Well, I am more than happy to provide such. But still, it is not always that you are home, and I feel like I should provide more. Do come." ] With that, your fox-wife leads you away and to the familiar sitting room, all set up for your comfort; she bids you rest your legs while she fetches a tea set from a cabinet and begins brewing a fresh pot. Before long, the air is filled with the bitter aroma of plain, hot tea, [kiyoko.numKits 2| and one of your fox-eared children comes into the room with a small plate of sweets, setting it on the table with delicate care. "Thank you," Kiyoko says, fondly petting the little one's large, fluffy ears. "Your parents need to talk for a bit; there'll be plenty of time to play later on, okay?" The fox kit smiles, bows wordlessly, and scurries off. Like mother, like child, one supposes. | washing away what remaining fatigue you might have had. ] "Now," Kiyoko begins as she sits down and pours herself a cup of tea, [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |then moves her hands to rest on her increasingly pregnant tummy, having trouble fitting the fertile bump between her and the table. |your fox-wife's immensely gravid tummy resting on her knees and bumping against the underside of the table. |then turns and gives you a warm smile. ] "Shall we begin? It feels like forever since your last visit, and there's so much to catch up on. We are now married, after all... there need be no secrets between us.""

rows.original: You tell Kiyoko that you'd like to change things up, try some different tactics. If she could stay at home and take care of herself[kiyoko.pregStage 1| and the kit growing inside of her], hold down the fort, that would be appreciated. "Of course. I'm confident that there any many tasks to fill my attention with that have gathered in my absence. [kinu.isHime|Our daughter is an excellent manager and administrator, but she still lacks practical experience|I must confess that I do not have utmost confidence that our daughter has been running things satisfactorily while we were away]. It will be good to take a step back and get a slower pace of life." So long as she understands that you're not asking her to leave because of any untowardness on either of your parts. "Oh, perish the thought. If it will give you a greater chance of success on your endeavors, do not hesitate to do as you see fit. Now then, shall we not dwell on this issue? There are other much more pleasant things we could do."
rows.translation: 你告诉清子，你想改变一下做法，尝试一些不同的策略。如果她能待在家里照顾自己[kiyoko.pregStage 1| 以及她腹中正在成长的幼崽]，守好这个家，你会非常感激。 “当然。我有信心，在我不在的时候，一定有很多任务需要我去处理。 [kinu.isHime|我们的女儿是一位非常出色的管理者和行政人员，但她仍然缺乏实际工作经验。|我必须承认，在我们不在家的这段时间里，我并不完全相信我们的女儿能够把事情处理得妥当无误。]退一步，放慢生活节奏，会是一件好事。” 只要她明白，你要求她离开并不是因为你们当中有任何一方出了什么问题。 “哦，千万别这么想。如果这样做能增加你成功的机会，那就毫不犹豫地按照你认为最好的方式去做吧。现在，我们是不是应该停止讨论这个话题呢？还有许多其他更有趣的事情我们可以去做。”

rows.original: "If you need my skills and strength at your side, beloved, then I am glad to offer them to be used as you see fit. Please, give me a little while to make arrangements and I will be with you posthaste." With that, Kiyoko stands, bows, and takes her leave. You wait for perhaps half an hour before she returns and seats herself across the low table from you again. That was quick. "I have gathered my necessary possessions for travel and made arrangements for the smooth running of our home while I am away. As my heir, Kinu will run the place in my absence and all duties and obligations are laid at her feet in the interim. I am ready to leave whenever you are. "Now then, is there anything you would like to settle here before we depart?"
rows.translation: 如果亲爱的，你需要我的技能和力量来帮助你，那么我很乐意将它们奉献出来，让你按照你的意愿来使用。请给我一些时间来安排一切，我会立刻赶去陪在你身边。 说完，清子站起身来，鞠了一躬，然后离开了。你等了大概半个小时，她才回来，再次坐在你对面的那张矮桌旁。 真快啊。 我已经收拾好了旅行所需的所有物品，也安排好了我不在期间家里的一切事务，以确保一切能够顺利进行。作为我的继承人，小娟将在我不在的时候负责管理家里的一切事务，因此所有的责任和义务都落在了她的身上。只要你准备好了，我就可以随时出发。 那么，在我们离开之前，还有什么事是你想要解决或处理的吗？

The sound of your footsteps causes her to rise, and she gives you a small bow, hands clasped in front of her[kiyoko.pregStage 1 3|, her pregnant belly notwithstanding|, her heavily swollen tummy notwithstanding]. "As well as can be expected, beloved," your fox-wife purrs, gathering up one of her tails in her hands and openly toying with the exquisite fur, rubbing it back and forth between her fingers. rows.original: Ask her how being on the road is treating her.
rows.translation: 问问她，一路奔波下来过得怎么样。
rows.raw: "Ask her how being on the road is treating her."

rows.original: Being out on the road and in the wilderness doesn't mean one can let appearances slip. Help your fox-wife look her best always.
rows.translation: 即使在旅途之中或身处荒野，也并不意味着可以忽视自己的外表。一定要让你的狐狸妻子始终保持最佳状态。
rows.raw: "Being out on the road and in the wilderness doesn't mean one can let appearances slip. Help your fox-wife look her best always."

rows.original: [rand |"Ah, very well. I performed a minor divination in the morning to see how we would fare during the day, and I am content with the results." Oh? What did she see? "Hmm..." A small smile plays on her lips. "Well, I was licking a penis, and was mating quite vigorously while shaking my big, pregnant belly. I think that's a decently good future to have, isn't it?" It's an oddly specific one. "I know. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |It might be a little while off yet, but I'm looking forward to it in every aspect and detail." Your fox-wife purrs. "I'm sure you can't wait, too." |Given the level of detail and what they were —" she runs a hand over the huge, fecund bulge of her belly — "It can't be too far off, can it?" |Perhaps we should work towards seeing that future becoming a reality, don't you think?" A mischievous glint enters her slitted, jade-green eyes. "It would certainly be fun to see through." ] |Is she fine? You are doing a lot of walking, after all[kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |, and she is with child. She's not overly heavy yet and her body is made for this, and yet you still worry |, and she is with child. You know her body is made for this, and yet you can't help but worry when you her belly, big, low and heavy on such a petite frame as hers ]. "I did a lot of walking around with Komari when I was young," Kiyoko replies. "As my mother's heir apparent, I was impressed from a young age the importance of the duties that lay ahead of me in the years to come, and that often involved touring the lands that I was eventually to be responsible for. The roads are not always smooth, especially in the rural provinces and prefectures, and a palanquin would draw more attention than Mother or I cared for. Suffice to say... I am no stranger to walking long distances. Do not overly concern yourself on my behalf, beloved." Hmm. You know that many kitsune would rather suffer discomfort in silence than be seen as complaining, but then again if you didn't trust your fox-wife to be straight with you why is she even here to begin with? Yeah, if she says she's fine, you'll take her word for it. "Both your concern for and trust in me are appreciated." |"This part of the world has changed much since I was last able to survey it. Being able to travel with you has allowed me to see the state of the region and assess threats and opportunities alive where we pass. With you at my side, beloved, there are things which I can do that would otherwise be extremely dangerous to me — entering native settlements and dealing with them, for example. The simple matter of your presence changes their disposition quite considerably, and I am able to have meaningful interactions with them that are beyond what I could achieve otherwise. That is appreciated." Huh. You didn't see it that way, but... yeah. You're glad to have been of help in that regard, then. "They know you, [pc.ra kitsune|even if you have made the decision to be one of us|and that counts for a lot]. In much of the world, who you know and can count on is a valuable resource." Good thing she knows you, then. "Mm." |How does she manage to stay so prim and proper all the time even though you're traipsing through dusty streets, leafy forests and more? Dirt simply doesn't seem to stick to her. "Well, I cheat a little with a spot of predigistation. That, and sufficient brushing with my family's particular mix of herb oil when I wake up, and at the end of the day. Smooth the tangles out, and brush away the dirt of the road. After all, I am no stranger to travel since I was quite young; my duties required it of me. My duties also required me to appear presentable an hour or less after my arrival, so making myself clean and inoffensive — and preventing myself from needing such treatment in the first place — are skills that were ingrained into me. Now, I do not need to think about it; the whole affair is something that comes to me very naturally." |Does she worry about the den when the both of you are away? "[kinu.isInari |I sometimes do, but that is less about any incompetence on our daughter's part and more uncertainty that she will run the place to my satisfaction and standards when I am not around to supervise," Kiyoko replies with a sigh. "I do not fear things falling into any kind of disrepair; it is just that the way things grow and develop under our daughter is different from the way things would under me. A den should not be divided like that, should not have two sets of rules. It is problematic. Still, nothing can be done about it until she is married and off." |Not very much. Our daughter is diligent and perfectly capable; I'm sure she will be able to run the place to my satisfaction and standards when I'm not around to supervise," Kiyoko replies with a small smile. "She and I are in agreement with many things, and I am sure that the den will grow and develop in a way that's pleasing to me under her care. There's nothing to worry about." ] Hmm... "Kinu has the resources, wisdom and support of Komari in my absence. My dear, faithful retainer knows well that should her penance still not have come to an end upon my death, our daughter will be her liege in my stead. I am sure that she will seek to cultivate a good relationship with Kinu where she can." Her death, huh. Adventure is dangerous... "Our laws and customs are stringent to the point where it is clear what will happen in the case of our untimely demise," your fox-wife states matter-of-factly. "Kinu will inherit everything I own, good or bad. Property, allegiances, fealties, responsibilities and standing. We do not think of these so much in terms of individuals, but more as families and clans; I understand things are done differently in this part of the world. Yet our way gives a sense of continuity that appeals to our sensibilities, and is a constant reminder that what you might purport to own is not yours, but merely help in trust and stewardship from those who came before to those who will come after you. "But do not worry, I do not intend to die so soon after having being given a new lease at life. If I should perish again, at least it will be at your side, and with someone to handle affairs once I am gone." |"I am perfectly fine," Kiyoko replies. "The wonder of being able to see the world again after so long and note how it has changed, both for good and ill, outweighs any mere physical fatigue that I might suffer in the process. For all that the forest is endless, the Astral Plane is not very big... I wonder if it loops upon itself after a point. It's good to know that the joy of discovering something new is not lost upon me, even after all this." That's a really positive way to think about it. "It is what it is. Nothing more, nothing less. Being able to do something about the things you see is another matter, and one that is no less enjoyable, too. Either way, I am perfectly content with the chance to be out doing the original commission his divine lordship gave me, so do not worry overmuch about it." |"I must confess that I am craving something sweet at the moment. The exertions of travel have produced a certain hunger that while I understand not much can be done about here and now, is nevertheless troublesome. Do not concern yourself with it overmuch; I'm sure it will pass in time and with adequate rest." Oh, she wants something sweet, huh? [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Is she sure it's her and not the growing kit inside of her tummy who desires the treats? |Is she sure it's her and not the growing kit inside of her big tummy who desires the treats? Actually, why not both? At this point, the both of them must be sporting a pretty big hankering for anything at all. |Maybe you should keep some in your pocket whenever you travel with her. ] Kiyoko ignores your teasing and swishes her tails. "You asked. I answered honestly. That's about as much as can be expected." |"Well, since you are so kind to ask, my feet hurt a little. It is not a problem, and I am sure that everything will be fine once I've had a little rest." She'd better be. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |While she isn't that big yet, she's still pregnant. Well, it's probably not so much her weight, as opposed to her feet swelling; one way or the other, you're going to make sure she's comfortable before you go to bed tonight. "Ah, it's much better to have my feet ache than have my womb ache. The former I can at least remedy fairly easily, and ignore if I have to. The other can only be sated by one thing, and I would be hard-pressed to put it out of mind... sometimes, you have to choose the lesser of two evils." |You'd expect some level of discomfort after walking around all day with all that extra weight on her. One way or the other, you're getting her off her feet before you go to bed tonight... "Ah, it's much better to have my feet ache than have my womb ache. The former I can at least remedy fairly easily, and ignore if I have to. The other can only be sated by one thing, and I would be hard-pressed to put it out of mind... sometimes, you have to choose the lesser of two evils." |At least she doesn't go around everywhere barefoot like Kinu does. How your firstborn daughter manages to get around [kinu.isInari|in the fields ]without so much as hardening the soles of her feet, let alone stepping on something jagged or sharp, is completely beyond you. "Ah... I must confess it evades me, too," Kiyoko replies. "She does not cheat in any way, that much I am sure of. Perhaps it is simply divine providence." Is it? "It may as well be. Our firstborn does not appear to be aware of it, and it is not something that happened to be inherited from you or me. I know this keenly because, alas, my feet do ache quite badly..." ] ]

|虽然可能还需要一段时间，但我已经从各个方面、每一个细节开始期待这一天的到来了。你的狐狸妻子正在发出呼噜声。我敢肯定，你也同样迫不及待了吧。 |考虑到这些细节的丰富程度以及它们的本质……她将手轻轻放在自己隆起的腹部上—— 应该不会太远吧？ |或许我们应该努力让那个未来成为现实，你不觉得吗？她那双狭长的翡翠绿眼睛中闪过一丝调皮的光芒。如果能看穿这一切，肯定会很有意思。 ] |她没事吧？毕竟你走了这么远的路[kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |她现在怀孕了。她的体重还没有明显增加，她的身体也确实适合孕育孩子，但你们还是感到很担心 |她现在怀孕了。你知道她的身体本来就非常适合生育，但每当看到她那在如此娇小的身躯上显得格外突出的大肚子时，你还是忍不住会担心起来 ]。 我小时候经常和麻里一起到处走。清子回答道。作为我母亲的法定继承人，从小我就深刻意识到了未来几年我将肩负的重任，而这些职责往往意味着需要巡视那些最终将由我负责管理的地区。道路状况并不总是良好的，尤其是在那些偏远的乡村地区，而乘坐轿子只会吸引过多的注意力，这显然不是我母亲或我所需要的。总之……我对于长途跋涉已经习以为常了。亲爱的，你不必为我过于担心。 嗯，你知道，很多狐妖宁愿默默忍受不适，也不愿被人认为是在抱怨。但话说回来，如果你不信任你的狐妻会对你坦诚相待，那她当初为什么会出现在你身边呢？没错，如果她说自己没事，你自然会相信她的话。 你对我所表现出的关心与信任，我真心感到感激。 "C'mon, what are you waiting for?" Now, now, you're not going to leave a job half-done. However, you don't want to spoil her, either. "But foxes are made to be petted and praised and spoiled rotten! That's what we're made for!" Patience, patience... taking Kiyoko's other foot in hand, you run through the steps once more, perhaps a little — well, a lot more playful this time. Kiyoko squeals and wriggles in your grasp as you tickle her left foot, all pretense at composure gone as limbs and fluffy tails alike flail around wildly in her giggling fit. "Eee! No, stop it! Stop it! Haha!" [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |No, you won't, and she's too full of fox kit to try and get away from your evil tickling. She'll just have to sit and bear it! |No, you're not, and what's she going to do about it? ] Kiyoko whines and squeals, and it's only when she's clearly out of breath that you stop the tickling and leave her to pant, your fox-wife's chest heaving in and out as she tries to recompose herself. After a handful of minutes, she gives her feet a little flex, then sinks back onto your bedroll, still rather breathless. "That was very naughty... but my feet do feel much better now, so I'll let you off!" Mm. You finish up and give your fox-wife a pat between the ears. Does she feel better now? [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3 |"Yes! Thank you, that was very relaxing! I don't suppose you've heard of reflexology?" No, you've never come across the term. "You should learn, I think you'd be a natural. But since you don't know, maybe next time I'll treat you to a session! Consider it repayment for this!" |Your fox-wife has to steady herself a little in the process, pushing herself off the table with a grunt of effort, but her pregnancy hasn't yet gotten so large that it seriously hampers her movement.. "Yes. That was very nice, thank you." Hey, she's enjoying the great honor of growing your seed in her womb. The least you can do is to take good care of a foxy little mother like her. "Mm-hm. If I do well, I expect to be pampered and petted lots again!" |It's a little awkward and Kiyoko sways as she readjusts to the weight of her womb, but by and large she manages — with some help from you, of course. "Yes, but you shouldn't have tickled me like that," she protests halfheartedly. "Now the kit is going to be doing the same to me all day — and from the inside, too, which just makes it worse." What can you say? They're a playful one, just like their mother. Kiyoko says nothing, but stretches and sighs, shifting her weight from foot to foot as she pushes her gravid tummy forward. "Ah, this feels so much better..." And her sandals and stockings? "Aw, boo. I'm not going to deal with that now and ruin my good mood. Having to get at my feet once a day is enough of a struggle." ] That was fun. "Fun, yes, but now you've gotten me all tired now and I don't really feel like getting back on my feet," Kiyoko says with a sly smile, thwapping you on the side with one of her tails. "I guess this means I'll be staying here tonight. Now, now, don't complain — you brought this upon yourself." With that, your fox-wife surges forward and wraps you in a warm embrace, arms and tails alike pressing against your body. She doesn't have the weight to bowl you over, but the heat of her form and fluff is certainly enough to make you feel melty inside and out. All right, all right. She's such a good blanket, if nothing else...

|清子无声地抽泣着，那对蓬松的大狐狸耳朵紧紧贴在她的头发上，她将怀孕的腹部紧紧抱在怀里。可怜的她肯定真的很需要这样的安慰；对于一只整天拖着沉重身躯行走的母狐狸来说，这种拥抱肯定能缓解她的痛苦。 我看不清楚你在下面做什么，但感觉确实很棒。请继续吧…… |清子尽情享受着你给予她的所有关注，当你继续埋头工作时，她幸福地叹息着。你的狐狸妻子倾身靠近，叹息着抓住你的肩膀，努力保持身体平衡，而你则轻轻抚摸着她那纤细的小脚趾。 ] 你又继续努力了一会儿，用力按压着她那双灵巧足部的足弓和脚跟，但最终不得不承认，对于这个任务来说，你已经竭尽了全力。是时候转向下一个目标了；清子几乎掩饰不住自己的急切，迅速将脚伸到你面前，坐在那里急不可待地等待着下一步行动。 快点，还在等什么？ 现在，现在，你总不能把工作做到一半就放弃吧。不过，你也不想让她失望吧。 “可狐妖就是该被抚摸、被夸奖、被宠上天的！这就是我们存在的意义！” 那确实有点调皮……不过现在我的脚确实感觉好多了，所以我就原谅你吧！ 嗯，你忙完之后去轻轻拍拍你那只狐妖老婆的耳朵吧。她现在感觉好些了吗？ [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3 |是的！谢谢您，那真是太放松了！我想您应该没听说过反射疗法吧？ 不，你从未听说过这个术语。 你应该学一学，我觉得你天生就适合这个。不过既然你还不了解，也许下次我可以请你去体验一次吧！就当是偿还这次我的‘恩惠’吧！ rows.raw: " Kiyoko cocks her head and looks a little curious as you beckon her over, but follows back to your tent and ducks inside after you. The confusion turns into a bright smile as you tell her to sit on the bedroll, remove her sandals and stockings and present her feet to you for loving attention. Seems like she's figured out what you intend, eh? [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3 |Kiyoko's smile widens into a head-splitting, open-mouthed grin as your fox-wife takes her place atop your bedroll, gathering up skirts and tails alike as she makes herself comfortable. "Thank you, beloved." Her kind really loves being petted no matter where it might be, don't they? "You could say that. Although where I come from, there's a whole art called reflexology — but I digress. I won't say no to being pampered, especially after a day of walking!" It's a small matter for Kiyoko to shake off her sandals and pull off her stockings; once done, your fox-wife sets the lot neatly to the side and stretches out her feet expectantly, purring as she awaits your tender care. |"Now then, I don't think I'm so heavy already that my feet —" A kitsune refusing pampering and petting? Say it isn't so! Kiyoko flushes a little. "I didn't say I was refusing it, I —" Then she should sit down right here, yes? There's nothing improper about it — after all, it's just the two of you here in the tent. She huffs a little. "Okay, I'll sit, I'll sit. But only because I want to be petted, okay? Not because you say so or anything like that, but only because I want to be petted. Are we clear on this?" You grin. Oh, of course. Absolutely. "Hmp." Kiyoko gathers up her skirts and plops down on your bedroll. It's a little stretch — literally so — to get at her feet, but she pulls off her sandals and stockings, laying them on the ground by her side. |"Oof." Kiyoko rises just long enough to waddle over to your side, then plops down atop your bedroll with a small sigh of relief. The kitsune mother-to-be hugs her enormous kit-filled belly close to herself, then gives you a small, pleading look. "I don't suppose you could tend to my feet, please? Getting my stockings on in the morning is struggle enough for one day." But of course. Your fox-wife extends her feet, and you remove Kiyoko's sandals followed shortly by her white stockings. They go up almost all the way to her calves, and like everything else she wears, are fashioned of a fine silken material. But off they go, and you fold the stockings up neatly before setting them aside. She wipes her brow, then heaves a sigh of relief. "Phew. I can't even see my feet these days..." ] All right, then — time to get started. Kiyoko's feet are finely formed and dainty — what vulpine paws might have been, were they transformed into human feet. You feel her muscles tense reflexively as you take hold of her right foot in both hands, but she calms soon enough and you're better able to appreciate what you have here in your grasp. It seems almost unreal how Kiyoko's feet don't have a single callus or patch of rough skin between the two of them, but no doubt there's some kind of foxy trick behind it all. "Well? What are you waiting for?" Kiyoko says with a giggle, wiggling her little toes. "I want to be petted and pampered!" What an impatient little vixen she is. Making sure you have a firm grip on Kiyoko's foot, you start to knead her ankle, slowly rotating it as you work the ligaments with your fingers. "Harder!" Kiyoko cries. "I'm not made of glass, you know." All right, as she wishes. You apply a bit more pressure, make your movements that much more forceful, and Kiyoko sighs happily. [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |You catch her trying to peer at you around the swell of her enormously pregnant tummy, without much luck; eventually, the poor vixen gives up and settles back with a murmur. Is she looking forward to being able to see, let alone reach her feet again? "Maybe," she replies, all [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] of her tails twitching behind her. "Knowing you, though, you'll make me nice and round again before long. I suppose it's one of those small prices one has to pay in order to be a mother." |Your fox-wife wiggles in place, unable to keep still as she luxuriates in having her dainty feet massaged. It makes keeping ahold of them a little harder than it ought to be, but hey — she wouldn't be Kiyoko if she weren't playful. "Not there! That's ticklish!" Strange for a kitsune to admit weakness so easily. Unless she actually wants you to press there? Kiyoko squeals in delight, her wiggling increasing threefold — at least — and sending the table to rocking. "I told you that tickles!" Exactly. "Mrrrrhhhh..." ] Time to move on, then. Smiling proudly at Kiyoko's pleasure, you adjust your hands and begin to work your way up along her foot until you're up against her toes. Taking the delicate little joints between thumb and forefinger, you work each one of them in turn, kneading the tension straight out of them. Kiyoko's toenails are slightly hooked at their tips, an uncanny resemblance to fox claws, but each and every one of them is clipped and groomed with the utmost care. [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |Kiyoko yips and croons wordlessly, her large fluffy fox ears flattening against her hair as she hugs her pregnant tummy close to her. Poor thing must have really needed this; the weight of a fox mother waddling about all day after you must be killing those feet. "I can't see what you're doing down there, but it does feel really good. Please, do continue..." |Kiyoko luxuriates in all the attention that you're lavishing upon her, sighing blissfully while you continue to work away. Your fox-wife leans in and grips your shoulders with a sigh, trying to keep herself upright as you caress her dainty little toes. ] You work away a little longer, pushing against the arch and heel of her foxy feet, then have to admit that you've done all you can for that one. Time to move onto the next; Kiyoko is quick to push her foot into your grasp with barely concealed impatience, practically bouncing in her seat from all the anticipation. "C'mon, what are you waiting for?" Now, now, you're not going to leave a job half-done. However, you don't want to spoil her, either. "But foxes are made to be petted and praised and spoiled rotten! That's what we're made for!" Patience, patience... taking Kiyoko's other foot in hand, you run through the steps once more, perhaps a little — well, a lot more playful this time. Kiyoko squeals and wriggles in your grasp as you tickle her left foot, all pretense at composure gone as limbs and fluffy tails alike flail around wildly in her giggling fit. "Eee! No, stop it! Stop it! Haha!" [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |No, you won't, and she's too full of fox kit to try and get away from your evil tickling. She'll just have to sit and bear it! |No, you're not, and what's she going to do about it? ] Kiyoko whines and squeals, and it's only when she's clearly out of breath that you stop the tickling and leave her to pant, your fox-wife's chest heaving in and out as she tries to recompose herself. After a handful of minutes, she gives her feet a little flex, then sinks back onto your bedroll, still rather breathless. "That was very naughty... but my feet do feel much better now, so I'll let you off!" Mm. You finish up and give your fox-wife a pat between the ears. Does she feel better now? [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3 |"Yes! Thank you, that was very relaxing! I don't suppose you've heard of reflexology?" No, you've never come across the term. "You should learn, I think you'd be a natural. But since you don't know, maybe next time I'll treat you to a session! Consider it repayment for this!" |Your fox-wife has to steady herself a little in the process, pushing herself off the table with a grunt of effort, but her pregnancy hasn't yet gotten so large that it seriously hampers her movement.. "Yes. That was very nice, thank you." Hey, she's enjoying the great honor of growing your seed in her womb. The least you can do is to take good care of a foxy little mother like her. "Mm-hm. If I do well, I expect to be pampered and petted lots again!" |It's a little awkward and Kiyoko sways as she readjusts to the weight of her womb, but by and large she manages — with some help from you, of course. "Yes, but you shouldn't have tickled me like that," she protests halfheartedly. "Now the kit is going to be doing the same to me all day — and from the inside, too, which just makes it worse." What can you say? They're a playful one, just like their mother. Kiyoko says nothing, but stretches and sighs, shifting her weight from foot to foot as she pushes her gravid tummy forward. "Ah, this feels so much better..." And her sandals and stockings? "Aw, boo. I'm not going to deal with that now and ruin my good mood. Having to get at my feet once a day is enough of a struggle." ] That was fun. "Fun, yes, but now you've gotten me all tired now and I don't really feel like getting back on my feet," Kiyoko says with a sly smile, thwapping you on the side with one of her tails. Taking Kiyoko by the shoulder, you pull your fox-wife close and grace her with a quick peck upon the lips. That does the trick — she stirs, shifts, and then opens her jade-green eyes to regard you. "Well, that's quite the way to rouse someone. Not that I am complaining, of course... good morning, beloved." Good morning. Shall you be up and make ready to be on your way? "Of course." ]
rows.translation: [rand |终于，你准备好起床了。清子已经从床上起来，穿戴整齐，正以她那日本人特有的细致认真开始一天的活动——仿佛她从一开始就没有脱衣服上床睡觉，而是一直保持着端庄的姿势，直到你准备好继续你的生活为止。 早上好，亲爱的。你终于起床了。 你坐起来，揉了揉惺忪的双眼。难怪来到这里后会感到如此空虚——这个世界冰冷而残酷，但狐妻们却是温柔而温暖的。 啊，唉，这个世界确实需要我们的关注，而对此我们也无能为力。清子微微低下头，似乎在表示歉意。我们走吧吗？ [party.manyCompanions|收集[comp2.name]以及 ]走了吗？ |你醒来时，闻到了一阵怡人的香味——当你睁开眼睛，眼前的景象让你惊喜不已：清子正在为这一天整理自己的毛发。草本精油散发出的芬芳气息，她那熟练的手法在光亮的毛发上轻轻滑动……仅仅是看着这一幕，对你来说，就如同对她来说一样，是一种令人感到舒缓的体验。清子身上没有穿任何衣物，但她那自然而然的举止完全传达出一个信息：这一切与性无关。 然而，最终她注意到了你在注视她，于是露出了微笑。啊，亲爱的。你醒啦。希望我没有让你等待太久——魔法确实可以清除旅途中的尘埃和污垢，但有些东西，还是需要用心去清理和呵护的。 哦不，不行。她可以花她需要的任何时间。 嗯，再等几分钟就好。 你的狐狸妻子可是个守信用的人。没过多久，你们俩就都穿戴整齐，准备出发了。是时候去面对这个世界了…… |你缓缓睁开双眼，与清子那双翡翠般碧绿的瞳孔对视着。你们就这样静静地躺着一两分钟，或许都在思考谁会先移开视线，直到你微笑着伸出手，轻轻挠了挠你那位狐狸妻子的大耳朵。早上到了，该起床了。 清子轻轻叹了口气，将自己和你的四肢、尾巴分开了。你清楚地感受到了她的温暖从自己身上消失，那种空虚感仿佛渗入了你的灵魂深处，就在她离开、准备离去的时候。嗯，至少这也是一种鼓励，激励你尽自己最大的努力，这样今晚你就能重新回到你那位温柔的狐狸妻子的怀抱中……不过现在，是时候起床、穿好衣服，面对这个世界了。 |早上好，亲爱的。清子的低语不仅触动了你的听觉，更深入了你的心灵深处。那种话语有一种魔力，让你即使已经完全休息好了，也想要躺下来什么都不做。想要洗个晨浴来帮助自己清醒过来吗？ 嗯？ 或者来点早餐怎么样？ 嗯…… 或者，你更希望得到我？ 嗯！ 你的狐狸妻子笑了。哦，我只是在开玩笑。不过，是时候我们起床穿好衣服出发了。世界正在等待我们呢。 全世界都可以等待，但只有当你摆脱了那些困扰你的烦心事之后，才能享受到这样的奢侈。这难道不是一个值得我们忍受所有这些艰难险阻的理由吗？为了能够拥有在早晨安心躺下的权利，我们确实应该为之奋斗。[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]柔软的尾巴依偎在你的身旁……还有紧随其后的那位女性。 |你慢慢清醒过来，翻了个身——却撞到了一堆柔软的绒毛。往另一个方向移动，结果也是一样的；无论朝哪个方向走，都会遇到越来越多的绒毛。你在这些柔软、让人感到痒痒的绒毛中摸索着，终于找到了那些绒毛的主人。她依然紧贴着你，沉沉地睡着。你轻轻抓住清子的肩膀，轻轻摇了摇她。 没有回应，只有她嘴唇发出的轻柔、像狐狸般的声响。 好吧，也许你需要一些更有力的鼓励。你抓住清子的肩膀，将这位狐狸般的妻子拉到身边，然后在她的嘴唇上快速地吻了一下。这样就行了——她翻了个身，动了动身子，然后睁开了那双翡翠般绿色的眼睛，注视着你。 嗯，这可真是叫人一下子就清醒过来了。当然，我并不是在抱怨……早上好，亲爱的。 早上好。你该起床准备出发了吧？ 当然。 ]
rows.raw: ' [rand |At last, you're ready to wake up. Kiyoko is already out of bed, fully dressed and about her morning business with all the fastidiousness of her people — why, it's as if she never undressed to go to bed in the first place and simply froze in place, all prim and proper until you were ready to continue with your life. "Good morning, beloved. You're finally up." You sit up and rub the sleep away from your eyes. No wonder you felt so empty when you came to — the world is cold and hard, but fox-wives are soft and warm. "Ah. Alas, the world demands our attention, and nothing can be done about it." Kiyoko dips her head at you in a vaguely apologetic gesture. "Shall we [party.manyCompanions|gather [comp2.name] and ]be off?" |You wake up to a pleasant scent — and lo and behold, when you open your eyes you're greeted by the sight of Kiyoko doing her hair and tails for the day. The sweet smell of herb oil, the smooth movements of her brush through glossy fur — just watching it is as soothing to you as it must be for her. There's not a single scrap of clothing on Kiyoko, yet the simple poise with which she carries herself fully conveys the fact that this is not sexual in the slightest. Eventually, though, she notices you watching her and smiles. "Ah, beloved. You're awake. I hope I have not kept you waiting long — magic can clean up some of the dirt and dust of travel, but there is cleaning up, and there is care." Oh no, no. She can take as long as she needs. "Mm. A few more minutes, then." Your fox-wife is good to her word. Before too long, the both of you are dressed and ready to go. Time to face the world... |Slowly, you open your eyes — and meet Kiyoko's, the slitted jade-green orbs meeting your own. The two of you lie like that for a minute or two, perhaps wondering who will be the first to look away, until you smile and reach out to ruffle your fox-wife between her large ears. It's morning. Time to rise. Kiyoko sighs softly as she disentangles her limbs and tails from you, and you keenly feel the departure of her warmth from your person, an emptiness that sinks into the bottom of your soul as she pulls away and makes ready to be off. Well, if nothing else it's encouragement to do your best so that you can find yourself back in the welcoming arms of your fox-wife this night... but for now, it's time for you to get up, get dressed and face the world. |"Good morning, beloved." Kiyoko's whispered words touch not just the edge of your hearing, but the fringes of your spirit as well. There's something about them that makes you want to lie back and do nothing despite the fact that you're already fully rested. "Would you like a morning bath to help you wake up?" Hmm? "Or perhaps some breakfast?" Hmm... "Or perhaps you'd rather have me?" Hm! Your fox-wife laughs. "Oh, I jest. But it is time that we roused ourselves and got dressed. We should be on our way; the world is waiting for us." The world should wait, but such luxuries can only come to you once you've dealt with all the nonsense plaguing you. That would be a suitable reason to endure all these perils, wouldn't it? Fighting for the right to lie in during the morning with [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] fluffy tails by your side... and the woman attached to them. |You slowly come to, roll over — and bump into a huge pile of fluff. Moving the other way only yields the same result; ever single direction only yields ever-increasing levels of fluffy tail. Digging through the soft, tickling warmth, your hands close about the tails' owner, still pressed against you as she slumbers; you take Kiyoko by the shoulder and shake her gently. No response, save for a soft, vulpine noise from her lips. Well, perhaps you need something a little stronger in the way of encouragement. Taking Kiyoko by the shoulder, you pull your fox-wife close and grace her with a quick peck upon the lips. That does the trick — she stirs, shifts, and then opens her jade-green eyes to regard you. "Well, that's quite the way to rouse someone. Not that I am complaining, of course... good morning, beloved." Good morning. Shall you be up and make ready to be on your way? "Of course." ]'

rows.original: There's a twinkle in Kiyoko's eye as you beckon her over — no matter how discreet you might want to be about the whole thing, she always seems to know just exactly what you're thinking and what you want. Guess it takes one to know one, doesn't it? Getting up quietly, your fox-wife follows you back to your tent and slips inside after you. Once the two of you are alone, Kiyoko curls one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails about you, [pc.ra kitsune|twining it about one of yours|wrapping it about your side], and cosies up to your body. "Why, beloved. Are the burdens of travel wearing on you? Or perhaps you're worried that you may sleep less than soundly out in the wild? Maybe, just maybe, I'm so alluring that you cannot wait for us to be under a roof and within walls, and must absolutely have me now out [dayNight|in the open|under the stars]? Ah, whatever your reason is... I am here to offer what I have." In exchange for something that you have, of course. The first divine law of equivalent exchange always holds. "So that is the case. What I can do for you... what you can do for me. And is that not the best part of it all?" [kiyoko.pregStage 1 |Your fox-wife runs a hand over the curve of her rounded tummy. "You've been making me travel roads and cross mountains while I'm with child, beloved. How fortuitous that you just decided to make it up to me, yes?" And you're lucky she just happened to be in the mood, eh? "Just so. The hunger has not passed; if anything, it has intensified. Even the prospect of copulation does excite me so, ehe..." |Your fox-wife smiles and cocks her head at you. "So come now... we have known each other carnally; although it can be fun, there's no need for coy gestures." Yes, yes. You already know what she wants. "Ehe. In that case, beloved, let's get dirty and breed. Copulate like animals in the wilderness until I catch a kit in my womb." You look Kiyoko up and down and smile. Some things don't change. [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 4 8 16 32| |"Ah, well." Kiyoko feigns thoughtfulness, a smile playing on her lips. "I would love to see the look on our daughter's face when we come home from our travels with a little sibling for her to take care of. That would be quite funny." Mm. A fox kit is a responsibility, and Kinu will need to learn how to care for the young in preparation for her future. "Well, as my mother used to say, once you've had one, another isn't that much more in the way of work. I'm sure Kinu would enjoy a sibling or two, and I'm equally certain that we'll enjoy the making thereof." |"Ah, well. Child-making is a den mother's calling, and after having tasted it, I do relish it so. It's something I could get used to, so if you don't mind..." If you minded, you'd never have gotten started in the first place. Kiyoko makes a sultry little purring noise in the back of her throat. "Of course, of course. We are together now, and there is a certain allure to wild places to set the mood, is there not?" |"No, beloved, they do not. My womb still hungers for your essence. It feels so empty and desires to be filled..." Several of her tails wiggle at you to emphasise her point. "So please do oblige your fox-wife and let her have all the chi you're willing to give — that, and everything that comes with it, hmm?" Like your love? "That, amongst other things. There are so many things of yours I desire, beloved, and an equal number of things you would like to have from me, too. Here in the wilderness, it's just us, and what happens here is our little secret..." |Kiyoko sighs and rolls her eyes with a smile. "After all we've done together, beloved, do you really imagine that it would?" No, no, she's right. She's completely addicted to being reduced to a moaning, whimpering, breeding slut, hopelessly in love with the sensation of being bred and filled with kits. That part of her will never change. Laughter. "Well then, since you understand my motivations so thoroughly and I'm so predictable, it behooves you to sate my desires then, does it not?" |"No, they don't. Some things are just fine the way they are; they don't need to change, they will never change, and if someone tries to change them I'll fight it with everything I have." Kiyoko leans in and gives you a quick kiss on the cheek. "I wouldn't have done it so many times if I didn't like it... and I prefer things I enjoy to be with me." Ah, that explains why she can come off as clingy at times. "If that's what you want to call clingy? Well, so be it, ehehe. I certainly don't mind it..." |At that, Kiyoko tilts her head, wiggle her ears, and very pointedly holds your gaze with hers as she runs her tongue over her lips. "I think that if there were any chance of me ever tiring of it, beloved, I would have done so long before this point. Now... I think I feel my womb begging for me to have yet another child, so if we should take care of that posthaste?" You laugh. That's what you get for asking a stupid question. Kiyoko joins in with that high, flute-like voice of hers, then rubs her hands against her sides, spreading them outwards as they pass over her kit-bearing hips. "Come on then, beloved. Let's go make yet another baby." ] ] But of course. Time to begin, then...
rows.translation: 当你召唤纪代子过来时，她的眼中闪烁着光芒——无论你多么试图掩饰自己的意图，她似乎总能准确地理解你在想什么、想要什么。大概只有自己才有这样的能力吧？纪代子悄悄地站起来，跟随你回到了帐篷，然后跟在你身后走了进去。当你们两个人单独在一起时，纪代子蜷缩着身子[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]总有人跟在你后面[pc.ra kitsune|将其缠绕在你的某根手指上|把它紧紧抱在怀里]并紧贴着你的身体。 哎呀，亲爱的。难道是旅途的劳累让你感到疲惫了吗？又或者，你是担心在野外睡觉会不够安稳？也许……只是也许，我实在太迷人了，让你迫不及待地想要我们回到有屋檐有围墙的地方，现在就想要拥有我[dayNight|公开地|在星空之下]？ 哦，无论你出于什么原因……我在这里，愿意献出我所拥有的一切。 当然是用你拥有的东西作为交换。等价交换这一基本原则永远都是有效的。 原来如此。那我能为你们做些什么……你们又能为我做些什么呢。而这，不正是整个事情最美好的部分吗？ [kiyoko.pregStage 1 |你的狐狸妻子轻轻抚摸着自己圆润的腹部。亲爱的，我在怀孕期间，你却让我一路颠簸、翻山越岭。你现在终于决定补偿我，真是太及时了，不是吗？ 你真幸运，她正好有心情陪你，对吧？ 就是这么回事。饥饿感并没有消失，反而更加强烈了。就连交配这样的念头也能让我感到兴奋，嘿嘿…… |你的狐狸妻子微笑着，歪着头看着你。那么，现在就来吧……我们毕竟已经有过亲密接触了；虽然这样也很有趣，但没必要再故作矜持了。 是的，是的。你们已经知道她想要什么了。 呵呵，既然这样，亲爱的，那我们就来点亲密的接触吧繁殖就像野兽在荒野中交配一样，直到我的子宫里怀上一个孩子。 你上下打量着清子，然后笑了。有些东西确实是永远不会改变的。 [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 4 8 16 32| |啊，好吧。清子假装若有所思，嘴角挂着微笑。我真的很想看看，当我们带着一个需要女儿照顾的小弟弟或小妹妹回家时，她脸上会露出什么样的表情。那一定非常有趣。 嗯，照顾狐狸幼崽是一项责任，小娟需要学会如何照料这些幼崽，这样才能为她的未来做好准备。 嗯，就像我妈妈常说的，一旦有了一个孩子，再要一个也不会增加太多麻烦。我相信小娟也会很高兴有兄弟姐妹的，而且我也很有信心，我们一定会享受这个过程。 |啊，嗯。生孩子确实是母亲的天职，而且一旦体验过这种感觉，我确实会很喜欢。这是我可以习惯的事情，所以如果你不介意的话…… 如果你在意的话，根本就不会开始这件事。 清子从喉咙深处发出了一声娇媚的“呼噜”声。当然，当然。我们现在在一起了，而那些荒野之地确实有一种独特的魅力，能够营造出相应的氛围，不是吗？ |不，亲爱的，它们并没有。我的子宫依然渴望着你的存在。它感到如此空虚，渴望被填满……她的几条尾巴不停地摆动着，以此来强调她的意思。所以，请务必成全你的狐狸妻子，让她得到一切吧。气你愿意付出这些，以及随之而来的一切，是吗？ 就像你的爱情一样吗？ 除此之外，还有许多你想要的东西，亲爱的，而我也有一样样你希望从我这里得到的东西。在这片荒野里，只有我们两个人，发生在这里的事情，就是我们的小秘密…… |清子微笑着叹了口气，然后翻了个白眼。在我们一起经历了这么多之后，亲爱的，你真的你能想象会这样吗？ 不，不，她说得对。她彻底沉迷于那种被贬低为只会呻吟、呜咽、满足他人欲望的荡妇的角色中，她无可救药地沉溺于那种被利用、被填充的感觉之中。她的这一面永远都不会改变。 笑声。那么，既然你如此透彻地理解我的动机，而我也是一个如此容易预测的人，那么满足我的欲望应该是你义不容辞的责任吧？ |不，它们不需要改变。有些事情本来就很好，没有必要改动，也永远不可能改变。如果有人试图改变它们，我会用一切力量来抵抗。 清子凑过来，在你的脸颊上快速吻了一下。如果我不喜欢某件事，我就不会反复去做它……而且我更喜欢把那些让我开心的事物留在身边。 啊，原来如此，这就解释了为什么她有时会显得黏人。 如果你想把这种行为叫做黏人，那好吧，就这么叫吧，嘿嘿。我当然不介意…… |听到这话，清子歪了歪头，摇了摇耳朵，然后紧紧地注视着你的眼睛，同时用舌头舔了舔嘴唇。亲爱的，我想如果我真的会有厌倦这种感觉的话，肯定早就发生了。现在……我觉得我的身体仿佛在迫切地呼唤我再要一个孩子，所以我们应该尽快考虑这件事吧？ 你笑了，这就是你问了一个愚蠢问题所应得到的结果。 清子也用她那高亢、如同长笛般的嗓音加入了笑声，然后双手在身侧摩擦着，当双手经过她那装着装备的臀部时，将双手逐渐展开。那我们走吧，亲爱的。让我们再孕育一个新生命吧。 ] ] 当然。那么，是时候开始了……

rows.original: You look at your beloved fox-wife, and swallow hard. Kiyoko tilts her head, bends her ears forward, and leans on the table, elbows forward. "You appear discomfited, beloved. Is something the matter?" Gods, if she keeps on staring at you like that she's going to bore a hole straight through you, and you're already feeling butterflies in your stomach. You clench your fists, reach onto your things, and tell Kiyoko that you've something to give her. Gods, Komari didn't tip her off beforehand, did she? No, that's can't be the case; the little old lady really does want what's best for her liege; she wouldn't have done that. Would she? "Oh? And that thing would be?" If you don't do it now, you'll lose your nerve and never get to it. You cross over to Kiyoko's side of the table, take one of the rings out of your pocket, and slip it onto Kiyoko's finger. She blinks, then her slitted eyes widen as she realizes just what this is and by that extent, what you've just done. "Ah... ah! Beloved..." Will she marry you? "We already are, as far as I'm concerned." She's trying to sound nonchalant about it, but her voice chokes with a sob. "There's... there's really no need for this." But there is. You want to make it formal, to put things down on paper and get it all sorted out as it all ought to be according to kitsune custom. This state of affairs, these half-measures are hardly befitting of [pc.ra kitsune |both a den mother and the god's chosen champion |someone of her stature ]. You want to do things properly. So, once more... will she marry you, then? To be your fox-wife in name as well as in fact? "...This is quite the ambush; you truly do not play fair when it comes down to it.[pc.ra kitsune| Not that I would expect any less from the hand-picked champion of his divine lordship...]" You can't help but smile at this. No, you're quite used to seizing advantages when they happen to make themselves available. Kiyoko takes a deep breath and calms herself, folding her ears forward and curling her tails about herself. Quietly, she rolls her wrist back and forth, studying the ring on her finger, seeing how it fits her. Then, finally, your kitsune wife lowers her gaze, not quite looking you in the eye, but turns towards you anyway. "Of course I will marry you, beloved. I hope that you never doubted for a moment that I would." It is a strange union, perhaps; strange circumstances of meeting, a strange way in which the relationship developed, in a strange land to the likes of Kiyoko. Whether by sheer coincidence or by fate, you met, fell in love, and now spend your days in something approaching marital bliss even when everything hasn't been formalised yet. While it may seem to be nothing short of a fairy tale, it is everything but; the woman sitting in front of you is living proof of that. "It was not fated, that much I can tell you," Kiyoko replies quietly. "I did not manage to divine your first coming in any way, shape or form." [pc.ra kitsune |And you'd expect no less from the one who eventually became Keros' chosen champion — fully unexpected and unforeseen, yet undeniable in one's status as a mover and shaker |And to be honest, perhaps it was better that way ]. Kiyoko says nothing, her eyes darting from side to side, her ears swivelling this way and that. You're wondering what's going on inside of her mind, then decide to throw what little caution remains to the wind and sweep up your fox-wife in a full yet chaste kiss. She returns it with equal hunger and ardor, stopping just shy of escalating further before pulling away with a sigh of contentment. "If we continue like this, you'll light a fire in me and I won't be able to hold back," Kiyoko purrs. "Come on. Let's go tell both Komari and our daughter the good news."
rows.translation: 你看着你心爱的狐妖妻子，艰难地咽了口唾沫。清子歪着头，把耳朵向前凑，然后倚在桌子上，双肘向前撑着。 你看起来似乎有些不安，亲爱的。是不是发生了什么事情？ 天啊，如果她继续那样盯着你看，非得把你的身体看穿不可，而你现在就已经感到胃里一阵阵翻腾了。你握紧拳头，拿起自己的东西，然后告诉清子你有东西要给她。天啊，麻里之前应该没有提前告诉她吧？不，不可能是这样；那位老妇人确实是真心为她的主公着想，她不会做出那种事的。 真的会吗？ 哦？那到底是什么东西呢？ 如果你现在不去做，就会失去勇气，永远也提不起这个勇气来。你走到纪代子的那一侧桌子旁，从口袋里拿出一枚戒指，然后把它戴在纪代子的手指上。她眨了眨眼，随后当她意识到这究竟是什么，以及你刚刚做了什么时，她那细长的眼睛突然睁得大大的。 啊……啊！亲爱的…… 她会嫁给你吗？ 在我看来，我们已经做到了。她试图装作若无其事的样子，但她的声音里却带着哽咽。其实……真的没有必要这样做。 但是，确实存在这样的需求。你希望把这一切正式化，把相关事项都写在纸上，按照狐族的习俗把一切都安排得井井有条。目前的这种状况，这些敷衍了事的措施，实在不符合[pc.ra kitsune |既是群体的领袖，也是上天选中的勇士 |像她这样地位崇高的人 ]你想有所作为。正确地那么，再问一次……她最终会嫁给你吗？会真正成为你的妻子，名副其实地与你在一起吗？ ……这简直就是一场埋伏；说到底，你们确实不太讲公平啊。[pc.ra kitsune| 我本来也不指望这位被神明亲自挑选出来的勇士会做出什么差劲的事……]" 看到这一幕，你不禁会露出微笑。其实，你早就习惯了在机会出现时立刻抓住它。 清子深吸一口气，让自己平静下来，然后将耳朵向前折叠，尾巴也盘绕在身体周围。她轻轻转动手腕，仔细端详着自己手指上的戒指，看看它是否合手。终于，你的狐妻低下了头，虽然并没有直视你的眼睛，但还是转向了你。 我当然会嫁给你，亲爱的。我希望你从未有过一丝怀疑。 这或许是一种奇妙的缘分吧——相遇的情境如此奇妙，感情的发展过程也充满了蹊跷，而这一切都发生在一个对纪代子来说完全陌生的地方。无论是纯粹的巧合，还是命运的安排，你们相遇了、相爱了，如今虽然还没有正式结婚，但生活却已经充满了近乎婚姻般的幸福。虽然这一切看起来就像童话故事一般美好，但实际上却远非如此；坐在你面前的这位女性，就是最好的证明。 这并非命中注定，这一点我可以肯定地告诉你。清子轻声回答道。我完全无法预见到你的首次降临。 [pc.ra kitsune |对于最终成为凯罗斯选中的人类冠军来说，这样的结局也在意料之中——完全出乎意料，也难以预见，但毫无疑问，他确实具备改变局势的能力。 |说实话，或许那样反而更好。 ]清子一言不发，目光在四处游移，耳朵也不停地转动着。你不禁想知道她的内心正在想着什么，于是决定抛开最后的顾虑，紧紧地吻住了这位狐妖般的女子。她也以同样的热情回应着这个吻，只是在即将进一步发展之前停了下来，然后满足地叹了口气，退开了。 如果我们继续这样下去，你一定会点燃我内心的火焰，让我再也无法控制自己。清子发出呼噜声。来吧，我们一起去告诉麻里和我们的女儿这个好消息吧。
