rows.original: "...And that's that," Kiyoko finishes. "Given how [pc.name] could only have gotten those rings from you, I figured you had a hand in all this." "Well, you know how I am," Komari replies with a smile. "At my age, there's nothing really more satisfying for me to do than to pair off all the young people each generation. When you don't need to eat or sleep, you've got to find ways to fill in the hours of your existence — and what better way than to play meddlesome matchmaker?" Once more, you find yourself in Komari's chambers, this time with Kiyoko at your side. The colonial governor looks eminently pleased with herself, practically preening as she looks between the two of you; Kiyoko, on the other hand, is more than a little flustered — and equal parts overjoyed to boot. [kinu.isInari |Kinu's been summoned in from the fields, barely having had enough time to clean herself up perfunctorily before arriving on the scene. Your daughter shuffles awkwardly in place at the table, clearly discomfited by seeing her mother gush over like a giddy schoolgirl. Sure, Kinu should be past that difficult age by now, especially with the responsibilities of her station, but everything about this must be a little embarrassing for her, even if it is a joyous occasion and she's doing her best to be happy for her mother. Well, to her credit, she's trying her best to be nice about it all. |Kinu was here when you arrived with her mother, doing her afternoon job of being Komari's understudy; your daughter instantly fell into action the moment you showed yourselves in the doorway, ever perfectly prim and proper. She's been hovering around the edges of the conversation ever since, there-but-not-there, stepping in every now and then to serve the three of you tea and take care of your little needs. In short, she's being an absolute princess. ] "Don't worry about it, Lady Ōtomo; I'll handle everything for the two of you. [pc.ra kitsune|People of station such as the divine champion and yourself|Someone of your station] should have a grand wedding on your clan holdings, if not the capital, but as circumstances are —" "It can't be helped. Nothing can be done about it." "Of course, Lady Ōtomo. The entirety of the western colonies will bend their weight to the occasion, and give as much as they can." Komari sips her tea and sighs. "When we were girls, I was expected to officiate your wedding someday, as was the custom between our clans. It seems that it has not changed, even if I am late by two and a half centuries. "I can have everything thrown together in a week. The attire, the resources, the venue... not to mention the people, at least of this den. Everyone loves an excuse to have a bit of fun, and morale has been flagging of late. Giving them an impromptu day off for festivities should do much to revive the peoples' spirits." A week. That's impressive, just as much as Garth throwing people together for building projects. Kitsune efficiency, one can only assume. "I hope neither of you have any prior engagements," Komari continues, "because I'll be keeping the both of you pretty busy." Kiyoko laughs at that. "I fully expect you will." You cast a glance at Kinu, [kinu.isInari |still trying to smile and look cheery as she sits awkwardly at the table. Your daughter's been quiet all this while, fiddling with her fingers under the table where she thinks no one's noticing what she's doing. The poor thing is so tense, especially sitting next to her mother, but she's doing her best not to spoil the mood. "Mom, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], congrats. For everything you've done together, for all the time you've been with each other, this was inevitable. It's good that you've made it formal and proper." "Mm-hm." |sliding in from the side so as to interject herself without being overly obtrusive. Ever the picture of refined perfection, your fox-daughter clasps her hands before her and bows. "Mother, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], my heartfelt congratulations on the formalisation of your marriage. It is a joy to be able to witness such an occasion, and I am sure our family will be much more harmonious for it." Kiyoko smiles. "You have my thanks, daughter." ] "Watch and learn from this, child," Komari adds with a chuckle. "Today, it's your mother before the gods at the shrine; give it a year or two, and it'll be your turn up there!" [kinu.isInari |That gets Kinu all flustered, your daughter dropping her attempts at etiquette as she raises her hands to her cheeks, the beginnings of her mother's weapons-grade blush creeping onto her face. She's fidgeting so hard, the poor little fox is practically vibrating in place as she curls her tails about herself. "Um, uh, ah..." "There's no point in further delaying a foregone conclusion, is there? Best to start when you're young and your bodies are still plenty vigorous. Or maybe you're getting started already? Your mother gets a pass, but it might be awkward if you showed up at your wedding with a big belly." |"Ah." Kinu's cheeks color a little, and her usually calm and polite demeanour is graced with a smile. "I... I would like to have quite the romantic wedding. Mother, Matron, it is something that I have indeed thought about when I was younger... but I would not impose upon an occasion about someone else with talk about me." "There's no point in further delaying a foregone conclusion, is there? Best to start when you're young and your bodies are still plenty vigorous. I... what I feel about the whole matter is irrelevant; your mother is more than approving of your choice of consort and her word is what counts." ] Kiyoko narrows her eyes a little at her retainer, and Komari pipes down. "Sorry. Got a little ahead of myself there; back to the point. Like I said, I'll have things ready in a week, then a couple days before the event I'll send for the both of you and get you prepared. Lady Ōtomo knows what to expect, so it'll be easier for her, but [pc.ra kitsune |I understand that you may still have some catching up to do on our customs, your Eminence. In that case, my great-great-granddaughters and I will be more than willing to see you through this to the end, so there's nothing to worry about |someone like you who would naturally find our customs a little alien may have difficulties. Not to worry, my great-great-granddaughters and I will be more than willing to guide you through the ceremony ]; no one will think any less of you if you don't do things perfectly, I'm sure." A week, then? "A week. We'll need you for various preparations before the event, though, so it would be appreciated if the both of you could keep your schedules free. Take a little break — gods know what you've been doing out there to deserve it." That sounds marvelous, yes. Is there anything else? "Oh, yes." Komari gives Kiyoko a sidelong glance. "My apologies, Lady Ōtomo, but I'll need to reclaim that ring for now. You want [pc.name] to be able to present it to you at the ceremony, and yours to [pc.himHer], don't you?" "That... of course. As much as I expected." Kiyoko winces, but pulls the ring off her finger and hands it to Komari; you do the same with its twin. The old Kerosite priestess nods, and stows them away in her clothes. "A week hence, then." Indeed, a week...
rows.translation: 就这样，没什么别的了。清子完成了。考虑到[pc.name]那些戒指肯定是你给的，我想你肯定跟这件事有关。 嗯，你也知道我的性格。麻里微笑着回答道。在我这个年纪，没有什么比为每一代年轻人牵线搭桥更让我感到满足的事情了。当你不再需要吃饭或睡觉时，你就必须想办法填补自己存在的这些时间——而有什么比扮演一个爱管闲事的媒人更好的方式呢？ 这一次，你再次来到了麻里的房间，而清子也陪在你身边。这位殖民地总督看起来对自己非常满意，她一边看着你们两个，一边得意地炫耀着自己的成就；而清子，则显得既有些慌乱，同时又充满了欣喜。 [kinu.isInari |小娟从田地里被召回来，甚至连稍微整理一下自己都来不及，就匆忙赶到了现场。你的女儿坐在桌子旁，显得很不自在，显然看到自己的母亲像一个兴奋的小女孩一样对她赞不绝口，让她感到非常尴尬。当然，如今小娟应该已经过了那个尴尬的年纪了，尤其是考虑到她现在肩负着工作上的责任。不过，这件事对她来说肯定还是会有些尴尬的，尽管这是一个欢乐的场合，她也一直在尽力让自己为母亲的幸福感到高兴。 嗯，值得称赞的是，她确实在尽力以友善的态度来处理这一切。 |当你和她的母亲一起来到这里时，小娟正在这里，负责下午的工作，担任麻里的助手；你们一出现在门口，你的女儿立刻就开始忙碌起来，始终保持着得体、端庄的形象。从那以后，她就一直待在谈话的边缘，看似在参与，却又似乎并不真正参与其中，偶尔会进来为你们三人端茶水，满足你们的各种小需求。 总之，她的表现简直就像一位真正的公主一样。 ] 别担心，大友夫人，我会为你们俩处理好一切事情的。 [pc.ra kitsune|像神圣冠军这样的强者，还有你……|你们站里的某位同事]就算不在首都，也应该在你的家族领地上举办一场盛大的婚礼才对，不过考虑到目前的形势—— 这也没办法，根本无能为力。 当然，大友夫人。整个西部殖民地都会全力以赴，尽他们所能做出贡献。麻里喝着茶，叹了口气。在我们还是女孩的时候，按照我们家族的传统，人们就期望有那么一天我能为你主持婚礼。看来这个传统并没有改变，即使我已经迟来了两个半世纪。 我可以在一周内把所有东西都准备妥当。服装、物资、场地……更不用说这些人了，至少这个团队里的成员们。每个人都很喜欢找借口来玩一玩，而且最近大家的士气确实有些低落。给他们一个临时放假的机会来庆祝一下，应该能大大提振大家的情绪。 一周时间。真是了不起，这和加斯把人们召集起来一起完成项目的方式一样高效。只能说这是狐族的办事效率吧。 希望你们俩都没有其他的安排。麻里继续说道，因为我会让你们俩都忙得不可开交。 清子听了之后笑了起来。我完全相信你会的。 你瞥了小娟一眼， [kinu.isInari |她坐在桌旁，努力保持着微笑，显得很开心，但实际上却坐得有些局促不安。你的女儿一直都很安静，她在桌子下面用手指摆弄着什么，以为没人注意到她在做什么。那个可怜的孩子其实非常紧张，尤其是坐在她母亲旁边时，但她还是在尽力不破坏这个氛围。 妈妈， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]恭喜你们。对于你们一起经历的一切，对于你们共同度过的这段时光，这样的结果其实是不可避免的。很高兴你们能够正式地、妥善地处理这件事。 嗯。 |她从侧面悄悄靠近，以便在不显得过于突兀的情况下插话。这位举止优雅、完美无瑕的狐妖女儿将双手交叠在胸前，然后行礼。 妈妈， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]我衷心祝贺你们的婚姻正式确定了下来。能够见证这样一个时刻，我感到非常高兴，而且我相信，我们的家庭会因此变得更加和谐。 清子笑了。女儿，我真的很感激你。 ] 孩子，好好看看，从中学习吧。麻里轻笑着补充道。 今天，在神庙里，受敬拜的是你的母亲；再过一两年，轮到你在那里受敬拜了！ [kinu.isInari |那个这让小娟彻底慌了神，你的女儿完全忘记了礼仪，双手捂住脸颊，脸上渐渐浮现出那种让人尴尬的红晕。她坐立不安，那只可怜的小狐妖也因为紧张而不停地扭动着自己的尾巴。 嗯，呃，啊…… 再拖延下去也没什么意义了，对吧？最好在年轻的时候就开始，那时候身体还充满活力。或者你现在已经开始了吗？你妈妈可以例外，但如果你在婚礼当天出现一个大肚子，那就有点尴尬了。 |啊。小娟的脸颊微微泛红，她平时那平静而礼貌的神情此刻也浮现出了一丝微笑。我……我真的很想举办一场充满浪漫色彩的婚礼。妈妈、嬷嬷，其实我小时候就一直有过这个想法……但我也不想在别人的重要场合上谈论自己的事情，以免打扰到他们。 再拖延下去也没有意义了，对吧？趁你还年轻，身体也还充满活力，最好现在就开始行动。至于我个人的感受……其实并不重要；你母亲非常赞同你选择的配偶，她的意见才是最重要的。 ] 清子微微眯起眼睛看着她的随从，麻里立刻安静了下来。 抱歉，我有点超前讲了；还是回到正题上。就像我之前说的，一周后我会把所有准备好的东西准备好，然后在活动开始前的几天再把你们俩叫过去，让你们做好相应的准备。大友女士已经知道该做些什么，所以对她来说会更容易一些，但是[pc.ra kitsune |我明白，阁下可能还需要一些时间来了解我们的风俗习惯。在这种情况下，我的曾曾孙女们和我非常愿意帮助您度过这个阶段，因此您不必担心任何事情。 |像你这样的人，可能会觉得我们的习俗有些陌生，因此会遇到一些困难。不过不用担心，我的曾孙女们和我非常乐意帮助你了解这些仪式流程。 ]我相信，即使你没有把事情做到完美，也没有人会因此看轻你。 一周时间，这样吧？ 一周的时间。不过在活动之前，我们需要你参与各种准备工作，因此如果你们俩能腾出时间的话，我们将不胜感激。好好休息一下吧——天知道你们这些日子都在忙些什么，确实需要休息一下了。 那听起来真是太棒了，没错。还有其他事情吗？ 哦，是的。麻里瞥了清子一眼。非常抱歉，大友夫人，但我现在必须取回那枚戒指。您想要[pc.name]以便能够在仪式上向您展示它，同时也希望您的也能[pc.himHer]不是吗？ 那……当然。正如我所预料的那样。清子微微皱了皱眉，但还是将戒指从手指上取下来递给了麻里；你也用同样的方式处理了那枚双生戒指。那位年迈的煤油灯祭司点了点头，然后将它们收进了自己的衣服里。 那就一周后吧。 确实，整整一周……
rows.raw: ' "...And that's that," Kiyoko finishes. "Given how [pc.name] could only have gotten those rings from you, I figured you had a hand in all this." "Well, you know how I am," Komari replies with a smile. "At my age, there's nothing really more satisfying for me to do than to pair off all the young people each generation. When you don't need to eat or sleep, you've got to find ways to fill in the hours of your existence — and what better way than to play meddlesome matchmaker?" Once more, you find yourself in Komari's chambers, this time with Kiyoko at your side. The colonial governor looks eminently pleased with herself, practically preening as she looks between the two of you; Kiyoko, on the other hand, is more than a little flustered — and equal parts overjoyed to boot. [kinu.isInari |Kinu's been summoned in from the fields, barely having had enough time to clean herself up perfunctorily before arriving on the scene. Your daughter shuffles awkwardly in place at the table, clearly discomfited by seeing her mother gush over like a giddy schoolgirl. Sure, Kinu should be past that difficult age by now, especially with the responsibilities of her station, but everything about this must be a little embarrassing for her, even if it is a joyous occasion and she's doing her best to be happy for her mother. Well, to her credit, she's trying her best to be nice about it all. |Kinu was here when you arrived with her mother, doing her afternoon job of being Komari's understudy; your daughter instantly fell into action the moment you showed yourselves in the doorway, ever perfectly prim and proper. She's been hovering around the edges of the conversation ever since, there-but-not-there, stepping in every now and then to serve the three of you tea and take care of your little needs. In short, she's being an absolute princess. ] "Don't worry about it, Lady Ōtomo; I'll handle everything for the two of you. [pc.ra kitsune|People of station such as the divine champion and yourself|Someone of your station] should have a grand wedding on your clan holdings, if not the capital, but as circumstances are —" "It can't be helped. Nothing can be done about it." "Of course, Lady Ōtomo. The entirety of the western colonies will bend their weight to the occasion, and give as much as they can." Komari sips her tea and sighs. "When we were girls, I was expected to officiate your wedding someday, as was the custom between our clans. It seems that it has not changed, even if I am late by two and a half centuries. "I can have everything thrown together in a week. The attire, the resources, the venue... not to mention the people, at least of this den. Everyone loves an excuse to have a bit of fun, and morale has been flagging of late. Giving them an impromptu day off for festivities should do much to revive the peoples' spirits." A week. That's impressive, just as much as Garth throwing people together for building projects. Kitsune efficiency, one can only assume. "I hope neither of you have any prior engagements," Komari continues, "because I'll be keeping the both of you pretty busy." Kiyoko laughs at that. "I fully expect you will." You cast a glance at Kinu, [kinu.isInari |still trying to smile and look cheery as she sits awkwardly at the table. Your daughter's been quiet all this while, fiddling with her fingers under the table where she thinks no one's noticing what she's doing. The poor thing is so tense, especially sitting next to her mother, but she's doing her best not to spoil the mood. "Mom, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], congrats. For everything you've done together, for all the time you've been with each other, this was inevitable. It's good that you've made it formal and proper." "Mm-hm." |sliding in from the side so as to interject herself without being overly obtrusive. Ever the picture of refined perfection, your fox-daughter clasps her hands before her and bows. "Mother, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], my heartfelt congratulations on the formalisation of your marriage. It is a joy to be able to witness such an occasion, and I am sure our family will be much more harmonious for it." Kiyoko smiles. "You have my thanks, daughter." ] "Watch and learn from this, child," Komari adds with a chuckle. "Today, it's your mother before the gods at the shrine; give it a year or two, and it'll be your turn up there!" [kinu.isInari |That gets Kinu all flustered, your daughter dropping her attempts at etiquette as she raises her hands to her cheeks, the beginnings of her mother's weapons-grade blush creeping onto her face. She's fidgeting so hard, the poor little fox is practically vibrating in place as she curls her tails about herself. "Um, uh, ah..." "There's no point in further delaying a foregone conclusion, is there? Best to start when you're young and your bodies are still plenty vigorous. Or maybe you're getting started already? Your mother gets a pass, but it might be awkward if you showed up at your wedding with a big belly." |"Ah." Kinu's cheeks color a little, and her usually calm and polite demeanour is graced with a smile. "I... I would like to have quite the romantic wedding. Mother, Matron, it is something that I have indeed thought about when I was younger... but I would not impose upon an occasion about someone else with talk about me." "There's no point in further delaying a foregone conclusion, is there? Best to start when you're young and your bodies are still plenty vigorous. I... what I feel about the whole matter is irrelevant; your mother is more than approving of your choice of consort and her word is what counts." ] Kiyoko narrows her eyes a little at her retainer, and Komari pipes down. "Sorry. Got a little ahead of myself there; back to the point. Like I said, I'll have things ready in a week, then a couple days before the event I'll send for the both of you and get you prepared. Lady Ōtomo knows what to expect, so it'll be easier for her, but [pc.ra kitsune |I understand that you may still have some catching up to do on our customs, your Eminence. In that case, my great-great-granddaughters and I will be more than willing to see you through this to the end, so there's nothing to worry about |someone like you who would naturally find our customs a little alien may have difficulties. Not to worry, my great-great-granddaughters and I will be more than willing to guide you through the ceremony ]; no one will think any less of you if you don't do things perfectly, I'm sure." A week, then? "A week. We'll need you for various preparations before the event, though, so it would be appreciated if the both of you could keep your schedules free. Take a little break — gods know what you've been doing out there to deserve it." That sounds marvelous, yes. Is there anything else? "Oh, yes." Komari gives Kiyoko a sidelong glance. "My apologies, Lady Ōtomo, but I'll need to reclaim that ring for now. You want [pc.name] to be able to present it to you at the ceremony, and yours to [pc.himHer], don't you?" "That... of course. As much as I expected." Kiyoko winces, but pulls the ring off her finger and hands it to Komari; you do the same with its twin. The old Kerosite priestess nods, and stows them away in her clothes. "A week hence, then." Indeed, a week...'

rows.original: The next handful of days pass with you staying over at Kiyoko's place — your place — and helping with getting everything ready.[party.has kiyoko |[party.manyCompanions | You have to ask [comp2.name] to take some extra time off in Hawkethorne while this is going on — [comp2.heShe]'s a little miffed at first at the sudden delay, but soon relents when you explain you're getting married, and wishes you well. ] |[party.som| | You have to ask [comp1.name] to take some extra time off in Hawkethorne while this is going on — [comp1.heShe]'s a little miffed at first at the sudden delay, but soon relents when you explain you're getting married, and wishes you well. | You have to ask [party.compNames] to take some extra time off in Hawkethorne while this is going on — they're a little miffed at first at the sudden delay, but soon relent when you explain you're getting married, and wish you well. ] ] Miko and Mai come in to take your measurements for the garb you'll be wearing, and they do the same for Kiyoko, too — even Kinu gets herself sized up for some new clothes, even though all you've ever seen her wear is [kinu.isInari |that work outfit of hers with the headcloth. "Gotta dress up, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]," she says when you catch Mai taking her measurements for the den seamstress. "It's your big day, and Mom's as well, long overdue as it is. I'm a pretty relaxed fox, but I know enough to not show up to [pc.ra kitsune|the divine champion and a den mother's|a den mother's] wedding wearing what other people think of as rags. Mom would kill me if I wore this to the ceremony." |that gorgeous yet elegant outfits of hers she uses in her daily life. "New clothes for the occasion are part and parcel of the proceedings, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]," she says when you catch Mai taking her measurements for the den seamstress. "A representation of the new lease of life you and Mother will be having. That, and I would not dare to show up at to [pc.ra kitsune|the divine champion and a den mother's|a den mother's] wedding wearing my daily outfit. If nothing else, it would signal a lack of effort on my part." ] "Ain't costin' ya nothin'," Mai drawls as she finishes measuring up Kinu. "Everyone'll be wearin' their brightest and best, so ya want yer lil' girl to be shinin' amongst them like a princess oughta do. She done got a heritage to consider, ya know." Is there a guest list? Maybe there is, maybe there isn't; if there is, Kiyoko's the one handling it anyways. When you visit the den, the place is abuzz with low-key excitement; it does feel that with a figure as public as Kiyoko, everyone in the colonies is invited to some degree, or at least, your marriage is their business. Your kitsune wife rises every morning in your arms, leaves to tend to the impending wedding for much of the day, and returns in the evening to snuggle into bed with you; while you're keenly aware that you're not in any kind of position to help her, it still makes you wish you could do more to help. [pc.ra kitsune |It really drives home the distance between you and them; even if you are physically a kitsune, acting like one is really much, much harder. While you know Keros warned you about this when you made the decision, but it's never hit so close to your heart up till now. Kiyoko is marrying you, but even so... |No matter how welcoming the foxen are or the smiles they wear on their faces, it really drives home the distance between you and them. Kiyoko is marrying you and you're doing this, yes, but even so... ] Three days before the wedding, Miko shows up on your doorstep, has you try on the wedding garb — a blue undershirt, followed by what looks like a black outer jacket and black-and-white pleated skirts-cum-pants. "Well, don't ya look a treat," she says with a giggle when she's done folding all the cloth and tying all the knots. "The haori and hakama look great on ya[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]. Wouldn't be expectin' none less from [pc.ra kitsune|the divine champion|High Lady Ōtomo's choice] an' all. How d'ya feel?" You look at yourself in the mirror and blink. Sharp, that's for sure. "Now, don't go 'round undersellin' yerself[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]," Miko continues as she ties the front of the jacket together with white string and adds a little ball of white fox-fur in the middle. Grinning, she hands you a mask of a stylised fox's face with white fur and red markings. "Ya look fabulous. Here, try this on f'r size." You're supposed to wear this? "For the procession an' ceremony, yeah. Show deference to his divine lordship an' all, since we're dedicatin' the ceremony to him. Other peoples of the Old Country sometimes dedicate a wedding to one o' th' other six grand kami, but for us kitsune it's always the Trickster, no questions asked. Ya put it on like this, right over yer face but tilted back a lil' so it's leavin' yer mouth exposed..." Miko spends the next hour or two going over the details of the ceremony with you, making sure that you at least know what's expected of you and how to behave. When she's finally satisfied, the sultry shrine maiden has you undress and folds up the wedding garb neatly in her hands, to be put away for the big day. "Don't ya worry none, Mai an' I will be right beside th' two o' ya. Jus' don't do anything dumb an' we'll smooth over th' rest o' th stuff all nice-like. There obviously ain't no way to do a full dress rehearsal, but leastways ya got some idea o' what's gonna go down an' all, eh?" You feel a little nervous. Everything feels so foreign to you, and you don't want to make Kiyoko lose face. "Ah, that can't be helped none in th' least. Event like this, folks' eyes woulda be on th' two o' ya even if ya weren't... well who ya are[pc.ra kitsune|, yer Eminence]. Even people in th' capital mightn't get to see a den mother's weddin' in their lifetimes from th' streets... we're done in podunk nowhere smack in th' colonies an' this kinda grand event comes along? Folks'll be talkin' 'bout it f'r years to come, if'n not decades." Her words aren't making you feel any more relaxed about the whole event. "They ain't, and allow me to be blunt, but ya shouldn't be. Yer declarin' yer love f'r the High Lady Ōtomo an' bindin' yer clans an' families together. If that there don't make ya think a bit, then ya ain't takin' this here future with yer wife seriously enough. Well, that's all I gotta say — see ya in a couple days." A bow, and then Miko is gone with a swish of her tails.
rows.translation: 接下来的几天，你一直住在清子的家里。你的确定地点，并协助做好所有准备工作。[party.has kiyoko |[party.manyCompanions | 你得先问问看。[comp2.name]在这段时间里，可以在鹰棘镇多休息一些时间。[comp2.heShe]一开始，对于这种突如其来的延误，他确实感到有些恼火，但当你解释说你们要结婚了，他很快就理解了，并且祝你们好运。 ] |[party.som| | 你得先问一下。[comp1.name]在这段时间里，可以在鹰棘镇多休息一些时间。[comp1.heShe]一开始，对于这种突如其来的延误，他确实感到有些恼火，但当你解释说你们要结婚了，他很快就理解了，并祝你们好运。 | 你得先问一下。[party.compNames]在这段时间里，你可以趁机在鹰棘镇多休息一段时间——起初他们会对这种突然的延误感到有些不满，但当你向他们解释你要结婚了，他们很快就会理解并祝福你的。 ] ]米可与舞过来为你测量尺寸，以便为你准备合适的服装；她们也为清子做了同样的事情。就连小娟也去量了尺寸，想买些新衣服——尽管你以前从来没见过她穿过其他衣服。 [kinu.isInari |她那套工作装，还有头巾。 得打扮打扮了， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]，”她说，当你看到舞去为那位缝纫师量尺寸的时候，就会明白我的意思了。今天是你的重要日子，对妈妈来说也同样重要——虽然这个时刻已经迟来了很久。我是个性格比较随和的人，但我也明白，在这种场合，绝对不能出现任何差错。 [pc.ra kitsune|神圣冠军与母兽般的守护者|像母兽一样保护自己的幼崽]在婚礼上穿别人眼中的破衣服？如果我穿这种衣服去参加仪式，妈妈肯定会杀了我的。 |她日常生活中所穿的那些既华丽又优雅的服装。 为了庆祝这个特殊场合，穿上新衣服是必不可少的一部分。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]，"她说，当你看到舞去为那位缝纫师量尺寸的时候，就会明白我的意思了。这象征着你和母亲将获得新的生机与活力。没错，我确实是这么认为的。绝不敢穿着平日的衣服参加[pc.ra kitsune|神选冠军与巢母的|巢母的]婚礼，那至少说明我并没有花心思去准备。 ] 根本不花你一分钱。舞一边测量着小娟的尺寸，一边慢条斯理地说话。每个人都会穿上自己最漂亮、最华丽的衣服，所以你肯定希望自己的小女儿也能在人群中闪闪发光，就像一位公主应该做的那样。她可是有着属于自己的传统和身份，你明白的。 有宾客名单吗？也许有，也许没有；就算有，负责这件事的也是清子。当你来到那个聚会场所时，那里会弥漫着一种低调的兴奋气氛——毕竟，像清子这样知名度极高的人物，几乎让殖民地的所有人都感觉自己被邀请参加了这场婚礼，或者说，你的婚礼确实与他们所有人息息相关。你的九尾狐妻子每天早上都会依偎在你怀里醒来，然后一整天都去准备即将到来的婚礼，到了晚上才会回到你身边，与你一起躺在床上；虽然你很清楚自己根本无能为力，帮助她，但这仍然让你希望能为她做更多的事情。 [pc.ra kitsune |这确实让人深刻地意识到你与他们之间的差距；即使你在外表上是一只狐妖，但要真正表现出那种特质，其实要困难得多。当你做出这个决定时，就知道凯罗斯曾经警告过你这一点，但直到现在，这种差距才真正触碰到你的心弦。清子是要嫁给你的，但即便如此…… |无论那些狐狸们表现得多么热情，他们的笑容多么亲切，这些都清楚地表明了你与他们之间的距离。清子是要嫁给你的，你也在做这些事，没错，但即便如此…… ] 在婚礼前三天，米可出现在你的家门口，让你试穿婚礼服装——一件蓝色的内衣，然后是一件看起来像黑色外套的衣服，以及一条黑白相间的百褶裙套装。 哇，你看起来真漂亮啊。当她把所有的布料都折好、所有的结都系好后，她笑着说道。那个羽织以及和服下摆你穿这个看起来很棒。[pc.ra kitsune|，嗯[pc.mf|领主|女士]]这正是我所能预料到的。 [pc.ra kitsune|神圣冠军|大友高贵的选择]就这样。你感觉怎么样？ 你站在镜子前，眨了眨眼。没错，确实很锐利。 现在，可别再自己压低自己的价格了。[pc.ra kitsune|，嗯[pc.mf|领主|女士]]，”米可继续将夹克的前襟用白色绳子系好，然后在中间放了一小团白色狐妖毛。她笑着递给你一个装饰着白色毛皮和红色图案的狐妖面具。你看太棒了在这里，试试这个L号的吧。 你就应该穿这个吗？ 对于这场游行和仪式来说，确实有必要。既然我们要为他举行这场仪式，那就应该表达对他的尊崇之情。在旧国，人们有时也会为其他六位大神中的某一位举行婚礼仪式。神明但对我们这些狐妖来说，它永远都是“戏弄者”，没有任何疑问。你要这样戴上它，直接盖在脸上，但要稍微向后倾斜一点，这样你的嘴巴就能露出来…… 米可接下来的一两个小时都在与你详细讨论仪式的各个细节，确保你至少明白自己应该做什么以及该如何表现。当她终于满意时，这位风情万种的神社少女会让你脱掉婚礼服装，然后将其仔细地叠好收好，留到重要的日子再使用。 别担心，我和舞会一直陪在你们身边。只要你们别做出什么愚蠢的事情，剩下的问题我们肯定能顺利解决。虽然没办法进行一次全面的彩排，但至少你们应该对接下来会发生什么有所了解了吧？ 你感到有些紧张。这一切对你来说都显得如此陌生，而且你也不想让清子难堪。 啊，这确实无可避免。在这种情况下，就算你们不是……嗯，不管你们是谁，人们的目光也会集中在你们两个人身上。[pc.ra kitsune|，阁下]就连首都里的人们，可能一辈子也看不到这样的盛婚典礼在街头举行……我们这些生活在偏远殖民地的小人物，却能赶上这样的盛事？人们会谈论这件事很多年，甚至几十年吧。 她的话并没有让你对整个事件感到任何放松。 他们不是这样的，而且让我直说吧，你们也不应该这样想。你们正在公开表达对高等女祭司大友的爱意，还将自己的氏族和家族紧密联系在一起。如果这些都不能让你们认真思考一下的话，那就说明你们并没有真正把与妻子的未来当回事。好了，我该说的就这些了——几天后见。 弓一拉，米科便摇着尾巴消失不见了。

"New clothes for the occasion are part and parcel of the proceedings, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]," she says when you catch Mai taking her measurements for the den seamstress. "A representation of the new lease of life you and Mother will be having. That, and I would not dare to show up at to [pc.ra kitsune|the divine champion and a den mother's|a den mother's] wedding wearing my daily outfit. If nothing else, it would signal a lack of effort on my part." ] "Ain't costin' ya nothin'," Mai drawls as she finishes measuring up Kinu. "Everyone'll be wearin' their brightest and best, so ya want yer lil' girl to be shinin' amongst them like a princess oughta do. She done got a heritage to consider, ya know." Is there a guest list? Maybe there is, maybe there isn't; if there is, Kiyoko's the one handling it anyways. When you visit the den, the place is abuzz with low-key excitement; it does feel that with a figure as public as Kiyoko, everyone in the colonies is invited to some degree, or at least, your marriage is their business. Your kitsune wife rises every morning in your arms, leaves to tend to the impending wedding for much of the day, and returns in the evening to snuggle into bed with you; while you're keenly aware that you're not in any kind of position to help her, it still makes you wish you could do more to help. [pc.ra kitsune |It really drives home the distance between you and them; even if you are physically a kitsune, acting like one is really much, much harder. While you know Keros warned you about this when you made the decision, but it's never hit so close to your heart up till now. Kiyoko is marrying you, but even so... |No matter how welcoming the foxen are or the smiles they wear on their faces, it really drives home the distance between you and them. Kiyoko is marrying you and you're doing this, yes, but even so... ] Three days before the wedding, Miko shows up on your doorstep, has you try on the wedding garb — a blue undershirt, followed by what looks like a black outer jacket and black-and-white pleated skirts-cum-pants. "Well, don't ya look a treat," she says with a giggle when she's done folding all the cloth and tying all the knots. "The haori and hakama look great on ya[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]. Wouldn't be expectin' none less from [pc.ra kitsune|the divine champion|High Lady Ōtomo's choice] an' all. How d'ya feel?" You look at yourself in the mirror and blink. Sharp, that's for sure. "Now, don't go 'round undersellin' yerself[pc.ra kitsune|, m'[pc.mf|lord|lady]]," Miko continues as she ties the front of the jacket together with white string and adds a little ball of white fox-fur in the middle. Grinning, she hands you a mask of a stylised fox's face with white fur and red markings. "Ya look fabulous. Here, try this on f'r size." You're supposed to wear this? "For the procession an' ceremony, yeah. Show deference to his divine lordship an' all, since we're dedicatin' the ceremony to him. Other peoples of the Old Country sometimes dedicate a wedding to one o' th' other six grand kami, but for us kitsune it's always the Trickster, no questions asked. Ya put it on like this, right over yer face but tilted back a lil' so it's leavin' yer mouth exposed..." Miko spends the next hour or two going over the details of the ceremony with you, making sure that you at least know what's expected of you and how to behave. When she's finally satisfied, the sultry shrine maiden has you undress and folds up the wedding garb neatly in her hands, to be put away for the big day. "Don't ya worry none, Mai an' I will be right beside th' two o' ya. Jus' don't do anything dumb an' we'll smooth over th' rest o' th stuff all nice-like. There obviously ain't no way to do a full dress rehearsal, but leastways ya got some idea o' what's gonna go down an' all, eh?" You feel a little nervous. Everything feels so foreign to you, and you don't want to make Kiyoko lose face. "Ah, that can't be helped none in th' least. Event like this, folks' eyes woulda be on th' two o' ya even if ya weren't... well who ya are[pc.ra kitsune|, yer Eminence]. Even people in th' capital mightn't get to see a den mother's weddin' in their lifetimes from th' streets... we're done in podunk nowhere smack in th' colonies an' this kinda grand event comes along? Folks'll be talkin' 'bout it f'r years to come, if'n not decades." Her words aren't making you feel any more relaxed about the whole event. "They ain't, and allow me to be blunt, but ya shouldn't be. Yer declarin' yer love f'r the High Lady Ōtomo an' bindin' yer clans an' families together. If that there don't make ya think a bit, then ya ain't takin' this here future with yer wife seriously enough. Well, that's all I gotta say — see ya in a couple days." A bow, and then Miko is gone with a swish of her tails."

rows.original: Eventually, the day arrives, and dawn with it; Kiyoko greets you at breakfast with Kinu[kiyoko.numKits 2| and the rest of the family], but that's about as much as you see of her. Miko, Mai and Komari arrive through the torii gate just after the sun's up and the girls usher off your foxy wife-to-be. On the other hand, Komari stays and personally gives you a good scrub-down from head to toe with freshly drawn water from the well; it's a little odd [pc.isChamp|and perhaps embarrassing ]to have this short dumpy priestess scour your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] until you're all raw. "We've to make sure you're clean inside and out; while we'll still do the ritual purification at the shrine entrance, there's no harm in being doubly clean before you step into his divine lordship's home. Now, Miko went over with you what you're supposed to be about, yes?" Repeatedly. "Then I hope you'll conduct yourself accordingly. Do it for Kiyoko, all right? You don't want to make her lose face in front of everyone." No... of course not. "Good." She sighs. "She deserves so much more from me, but there is only so much a low-status backwater can bring to bear. Nothing can be done about it." Komari helps you get dressed in the wedding garb — for real this time — and hurries you through the gate just as morning is in full swing. Kinu's there to greet you on the other side; your daughter's dolled herself up for the occasion, and [kinu.isInari |to see her translate that wild, energetic and lively attractiveness into... well, this — she's even undone her braid and planted a couple of flowers in her silvery-white hair. It's certainly a different side of your daughter that you don't see when she's working in the fields. "Hey, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom], Matron. You don't look half-bad today, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]." |while it's hard to imagine your daughter being ever more elegant and refined from her usual self, she's managed it. You don't actually know what Old Country princesses look like, but you'd have no trouble believing Kinu was one. "[pc.mf|Father|Mother], Matron." She bows. "You look positively glamorous today, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]." ] "Hmph." Komari looks up at the sky — the sun's still shining strongly through the tree roots, but there's a slight drizzle coming down over this part of the Frostwood, raindrops so fine that they may as well have been a mist, lending an additional chill to the air to counter the heat of the warm sunshine. The old priestess' serious scowl melts into a little smile, then she hands you the fox mask, the last piece of your wedding garb. "Well, if this isn't auspicious weather for a fox's wedding. Here, the mask — put it on just as the procession starts, all right?" Yes, you remember. "I'll be off to handle the rest of the arrangements. Kinu, help your [pc.mf|father|mother]." Kinu bows as Komari turns to leave, then gestures for you to follow her. "[kinu.isInari |Come on, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. I'll take you to where Mom's waiting |Please follow me, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Mother awaits your arrival ]." Walking through the sacred gardens, to the head of the path, you're aware of numerous eyes on you from all directions. Given the milling throng on the edge of the gardens and by the fields, it looks like the entire den's come out to see the show; while you were indeed expecting this, to actually experience an entire arcology's worth of foxes out in force to view the proceedings is another matter altogether. They stay at quite the distance, far enough to give the illusion of tranquility to the gardens, yet definitely close enough to see what's going on clearly. A hundred families, perhaps more, huh? They must really love Kiyoko... At length, Kinu stops, then gestures for you to go on ahead down the path. You nod, then head on down to the little junction. Miko and Mai are there, as are four finely dressed kitsune; they've carried Kiyoko in on a palanquin. The shrine maidens have also dressed up for the occasion, wearing full white robes like their granny with cranes and branches embossed on them; despite the formality of their garb, their demeanour hasn't changed in the slightest as they sashay up to you. "Congratulations an' all[pc.ra kitsune|, yer Eminence]." "Congratulations on this here fine day." "Ain't no finer weather for a fox's weddin' than a sunshine shower..." "... So let's present ya yer bride an' get this show goin' already." With a small flourish, Miko and Mai draw back the curtain on the palanquin, and Kiyoko smiles as your eyes meet. Her wedding kimono is completely white save for red lining here and there, and her ears are folded under the hood that accompanies it. White and red — not bad of a color mix, especially given who she is...
rows.translation: 终于，那一天到来了，黎明也随之降临；在早餐时，清子和小娟一起迎接你的到来。[kiyoko.numKits 2| 还有家里的其他成员]但这就是你所能看到的关于她的全部信息了。米可、舞和麻里是从另一边出现的。鸟居太阳刚升起时，门就会被关上，那些女孩们也会把你那位迷人的未婚妻送走。而麻里则会留下来，用从井里打来的新鲜水，亲自为你从头到脚仔细清洗干净；这种做法有点奇怪[pc.isChamp|甚至可能还会让人感到尴尬。 ]让这个矮小粗壮的女祭司来搜查你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]直到你完全精疲力竭为止。 我们必须确保你从里到外都干净整洁；虽然我们仍然会在神社入口进行仪式性的净化，但在进入这位神圣君主的居所之前，再多做一次清洁也没什么坏处。现在，米可应该已经告诉你该做些什么了吧？ 一次又一次。 那么我希望你也能相应地表现自己。为了清子，好吗？你总不会想让她在所有人面前丢脸吧。 不……当然不会。 好的。她叹了口气。她值得我给予更多，但一个地位低下、环境闭塞的地方所能提供的实在有限。对此，我也无能为力。 麻里帮你穿上婚礼礼服——这次可是真的——然后在清晨时分催你快些通过大门。在另一边，小娟会来迎接你；你的女儿也为这个特殊场合精心打扮了一番[kinu.isInari |看着她将那种狂野、充满活力且活泼的魅力展现出来……嗯，就是这样的——她甚至解开了辫子，在自己银白色的头发中插了几朵花。这绝对是你女儿的另一面，是你在她田间劳作时根本看不到的。 嘿， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]女管家，您今天看起来气色不错呢。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]。" |虽然很难想象你的女儿会变得比平时更加优雅、更加精致，但她确实做到了。其实，你并不觉得这有什么不可思议的。知道那些古老乡村公主该是什么样子的，但你完全会相信小娟就是其中之一。 “[pc.mf|父亲|母亲]女管家。她鞠了一躬。你今天看起来真是光彩照人， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]。” ] 哼。麻里抬头望向天空——阳光依然透过树根照射下来，但弗罗斯特伍德的这一片地区却开始下起细雨来，那些雨滴细得几乎像雾气一样，为空气增添了一丝寒意，从而抵消了温暖阳光带来的热意。那位年迈的女祭司原本严肃的表情渐渐融化了，露出了一丝微笑，然后将那只狐妖面具递给了你——这是你婚礼礼服上最后的一件饰品了。嗯，这样的天气对狐妖的婚礼来说真是再吉利不过了。来，把这个面具戴上，等游行队伍开始的时候再戴上，好吗？ 是的，你记得的。 我去处理剩下的安排了。小娟，你去帮忙吧。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]。" 当麻里转身离开时，纪久鞠了一躬，然后示意你跟随她。"[kinu.isInari |来吧， [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]我会带你去妈妈等待的地方 |请跟我来。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]母亲正在等待你的到来 ]。" 当你漫步在这些神圣的花园中，走到小路的尽头时，你会感觉到周围有无数双眼睛正在注视着你。考虑到花园边缘以及田野旁聚集的那些人群，看来整个族群的人都出来看这一幕了；虽然你本来也预料到会这样，但真正看到整个聚居地里的狐妖们都聚集过来观看这一场面，还是让人感到有些出乎意料。他们保持着相当的距离，这个距离足以让花园看起来宁静安详，同时又足够近，能够清楚地看到发生的一切。 大概有一百户家庭，甚至更多吧？他们一定非常喜欢清子吧…… 最终，纪久停下了脚步，然后示意你继续沿着小路前进。你点了点头，便朝着那个小岔路口走去。米可与舞已经在那里了，还有四只穿着考究的狐妖；他们用轿子把清子抬了过来。这些神社少女也为这个场合精心打扮，她们穿着与她们的祖母一样的纯白色长袍，袍子上还绣着鹤和树枝的图案；尽管她们的装束十分正式，但当她们款款走向你时，她们的举止却丝毫没有改变。 恭喜大家！[pc.ra kitsune|阁下]。" 在这美好的一天里，向您表示祝贺。 对于狐妖的婚礼来说，没有比阳光倾泻的天气更完美的了…… ……那么，让我们把你的新娘介绍给大家，让这场仪式赶紧开始吧。 米可与舞轻轻一拉，拉开了轿子的帘幕，当你与清子的目光相遇时，她露出了微笑。她的结婚和服完全是白色的，只有偶尔点缀着红色的边纹，而她的耳朵也被和服的帽兜遮住了。白色与红色——这种色彩搭配确实不错，尤其是考虑到她的身份……

rows.original: "Our seamstress did a bang-up job on her shiromuku even though it were a rush job, so ya oughta be grateful. C'mon, then. Everyone's waitin'." Still keeping that little smile on her face, Kiyoko rises from her seat and steps out of the palanquin, her tails flowing behind her. She takes your hand in hers, gives it a brief squeeze, then draws away to give Miko and Mai a nod. "We're ready." The palanquin and its bearers pull away, and Mai takes the fore with a wooden flute in her hands, while Miko brings up the rear, shading you from sun and rain alike with a big red umbrella. Soft music rises into the air as Kiyoko and you put on your fox masks and formally start down the path through the shrine. You're not entirely sure when they arrive, but at some point Kinu and Komari join the procession, too, the former from behind and the latter ahead of you. Paper lanterns hang from poles and the branches of the small trees along the path, flickering with foxfire despite the light of morning; your steps are slow, measured and ceremonial, all of you putting on a show for populace you know are just beyond your vision and nevertheless watching your progress... When the procession finally arrives at the shrine, though, you hear a small gasp from Mai behind you. Your attention's drawn forward beyond the screen doors to the shrine's interior — it's been prettied up very nicely in Old Country aesthetic and extra furniture's been moved inside to provide seating, but all that pales to the fact that Keros himself is lounging about on the altar's middle with his legs dangling off the edge, leaning back into the mass of his own tails and looking absolutely and perfectly at ease despite the grandeur around him. The trickster god hasn't even bothered to wear anything different for the occasion, still clad in his robes of white and swirling color, although to be fair, he does have an excuse for his fashion sense... Still, this is clearly something that not even Komari was expecting; the tension rising from the matron and her great-great-granddaughters is palpable in the air. Yet there is no stopping now, not with the eyes of more than a hundred families of foxes on the procession through the sacred gardens. The Trickster waits in his own shrine, spies the wedding procession arriving, and sits up amongst the offerings of fruit, salt and vegetables to give you a cheery wave, beckoning you in. The procession stops several steps from the shrine's entrance, and Komari gives her patron deity a deep bow from the waist; all of you feel obliged to follow suit. It seems like the appropriate thing to do. "August Master At the Center of Heaven," Komari begins, not daring to raise her eyes. "I had not expected your personal presence here today." "Oh, Komari. It's always so awkward when you deign to use my full title. Then again, what better occasion for formalities than this?" He turns to the two of you. "I would be terribly remiss if I didn't show up for the wedding of [pc.ra kitsune|my faithful champion and ]my distant descendant, wouldn't I? One beautiful unbroken matrilineal line from my dear Chizuru, through countless generations to this. Such a happy occasion — congratulations, the both of you. "Come! Come into my domain wearing my guise, and ask for my blessings upon your union! This will be a great day!" The great, foppish smile upon Keros' face practically oozes honest sincerity as he paces past the threshold and waves you in once more. He stops, frowning a bit as no one makes a move, then bursts out into hearty laughter. "Oh, right, you needed a ritual cleansing before entering. Don't worry about that; I've already provided one." He points up at the sky, soft, misty rain still falling onto all of you between the roots of the cherry blossom tree. "If I say you're purified, you are. Now don't be shy." That breaks the ice. The wedding procession moves forward once more, entering the shrine, and Kinu and Komari take up seats on high stools to either side of the altar while Miko and Mai lead you to seats before it. Keros himself swings himself back up onto his seat atop the altar, regarding you with all the demeanour of an excited child who's had too many sweet things. Even Miko and Mai with their straight faces look positively somber next to the trickster god; careful and measured in their movements as they set out a small, shallow dish-like cup before you and Kiyoko, the sisters hand it to you, then fill it with strong-smelling clear rice liquor from a gilded scoop with a long handle. Right, you've gone through this with Miko during your coaching. Sip the liquor, finish it in three sips, then pass it back to the sisters. Kiyoko's turn, three sips as well; then once more, with her to be served the second time around. Finally, the third time, with you getting the first serving before Kiyoko... three times three, as it were. Keros himself is playfully coy as he takes in the two of you, clearly restraining his mischievous nature in an effort to be polite. When the rite is over, Miko and Mai remove cup and scoop alike, handing Kiyoko a small amber comb wrapped in white silk cloth. Ah, it's the color of her hair... such a nice touch. Closing her eyes, Kiyoko presses her hands together as if to pray to her patron deity right in front of her, comb and cloth alike sandwiched between her palms. She presses her hands to her heart, then smiles and offers the comb to you. Clasping them in your own, you're reminded of how delicate your fox-wife's fingers are, and yet how warm... when she mentioned so long ago back in the Astral Plane that she'd forgotten how warm peoples' hands could be, and now... Those slitted green eyes, that small smile... the thoughts that must be running through her head... ...If you stand here forever, you'll never get done. Not that you personally have anything against standing here in this moment forever, but still... taking the amber comb in your hands, you step forward. Miko said it ought to be presented to Keros at the altar, but given that the god's right here and waiting, it feels right to hand it directly to him instead. "Well, you've accepted the comb," he tells you with a grin as he tucks it away inside his robes of shifting colors. "You'd better make this marriage work, especially given that your wife's descended from divinity and you've publicly declared your dedication to your union." You will. "I'm sure.[pc.ra kitsune| You'd reflect poorly on me as my handpicked champion if you didn't treat your wife right, aha.]"
rows.translation: 我们的裁缝把这项工作完成得非常出色。白木虽然这是赶工完成的，但你还是应该感到庆幸的。快点吧，大家都在等着呢。 基代子依然面带微笑，从座位上站起身来，走出了轿子，她的长发在身后飘动。她握住你的手，轻轻捏了捏，然后转身向米可与舞点了点头。我们准备好了。 轿子和抬轿的人渐渐远去，舞手持木笛走在最前面，而米可则走在最后，用一把大红伞为你遮挡风雨。当清子和你戴上狐妖面具后，轻柔的音乐便在空气中回荡，你们正式开始沿着小路穿过神社。你并不完全确定他们何时会到达，但就在某个时刻，小娟和麻里也加入了这支队伍：前者从后面跟上，后者则走在你前面。路边的杆子上以及小树的枝头挂满了纸灯笼，尽管已是清晨，这些灯笼仍在闪烁着微弱的光芒；你们的脚步缓慢而庄严，仿佛在为那些虽然看不见，但却在注视着你们前进的民众表演一场戏…… 然而，当队伍终于抵达神社时，你听到身后的舞发出一声轻叹。你的注意力被吸引到屏风门之后，看向神社的内部——那里被装饰得非常漂亮，采用了传统的乡村风格，还添置了一些家具供人们休息。但这一切都比不上凯罗斯本人：他正懒洋洋地躺在祭坛中央，双腿悬在边缘之外，背部靠在自己的尾巴上，尽管周围环境如此庄严宏伟，他却显得无比自在、毫不拘束。这个狡猾的神明甚至都没有费心为这个场合更换任何不同的装扮，依然穿着他那白色与彩色交织的长袍。不过，公平地说，他的这种穿着风格确实也有其“原因”…… 然而，这显然也是连麻里都没有预料到的事情；女管家和她的高曾孙女们之间逐渐加剧的紧张气氛在空气中清晰地弥漫着。但现在，已经没有人能够阻止这一进程了——毕竟有上百户狐妖家族的目光正在注视着这一支穿过神圣花园的队伍。那个调皮的神明在自己的神龛中等待着，注视着婚礼队伍的到来。当他看到人们将水果、盐和蔬菜作为祭品献给他时，便从祭品中坐起来，向你们欢快地挥手，邀请你们进去。婚礼队伍在距离神龛入口还有几步的地方停了下来，麻里从腰间开始向她的守护神深深鞠了一躬；在场的所有人都觉得应该跟着她这样做。这样做似乎是正确的选择。 位于天中心的八月大师麻里开始说话了，她不敢抬起眼睛。我完全没有预料到你今天会亲自来到这里。 哦，麻里。每当你特意使用我的全名时，总会让人觉得有些尴尬。不过，既然现在正是这种需要正式场合的时刻，还有什么比这更合适的呢？他转向你们两个人。如果我不参加这场婚礼，那未免太失礼了[pc.ra kitsune|我忠实的伙伴，还有…… ]我的远古后裔，不是吗？从我亲爱的千鹤开始，这一条美丽而连续的母系血脉，历经无数代人，最终传到了你这里。真是件值得庆祝的事情——恭喜你们俩。 来吧！穿上我的化身，来到我的领域，祈求我为你们的结合赐予祝福吧！这将是一个伟大的日子！ 当凯罗斯大步跨过门槛，再次向你招手时，他脸上那灿烂而略带浮夸的笑容仿佛在流露着无比真诚的态度。他停了下来，见没有人反应，微微皱了皱眉头，然后突然爆发出一阵爽朗的笑声。 哦，对了，进入之前需要进行仪式性的净化。别担心，这个我已经准备好了。他抬头望向天空，柔和的雾雨仍在樱花树的枝叶间洒落，落在你们每个人的身上。如果我说你已经被净化了，那么你就真的被净化了。现在，别再害羞了。 这样打破了僵局。婚礼队伍再次向前行进，进入了神社。小娟和麻里在祭坛两侧的高脚凳上就座，而米可和舞则引领你们在祭坛前坐下。凯洛斯自己也重新坐回了祭坛上的位置，他用一个得到了太多甜食、兴奋不已的孩子的神情注视着你们。就连面无表情的米可与舞，在这个狡黠的神明面前也显得格外肃穆；她们动作谨慎而得体，先在你和清子面前摆放了一个小巧而浅的碗状容器，然后用手持长柄的镀金勺子，将香气浓烈的清酒倒入其中。 没错，你在指导米科的时候已经教过她这个动作了。先小口喝下这杯酒，三口喝完之后再把它递给其他姐妹。现在该轮到清子了，她也需要三口喝完；之后再由她来为其他人第二次倒酒。终于，在第三次尝试中，你在清子之前先得到了第一份食物……可以说是三乘以三吧。凯洛斯本人也表现得十分俏皮，当他看着你们两个人时，明显在努力克制自己调皮的天性，以表现出礼貌。仪式结束后，米可与舞一起取下了杯子和勺子，然后将一把用白色丝绸包裹着的琥珀色小梳子递给了清子。 啊，这是她头发的颜色……真是太贴切了。京子闭上眼睛，双手合十，仿佛正在向眼前的守护神祈祷一般；梳子和布料都被她紧紧地夹在手掌之间。她将双手放在心上，然后微笑着把梳子递给你。当你握住那些梳子时，你会想起自己的狐妖妻子那双手指是多么纤细，却又如此温暖……早在星界的时候，她就说过自己已经忘记了人类的手掌能够如此温暖，而如今…… 那双带着缝隙的绿色眼睛，那抹淡淡的微笑……她脑海中一定在想着些什么…… ……如果你永远站在这里，永远也完成不了这件事。并不是说你个人不愿意永远站在这里，但毕竟……握着那把琥珀色的梳子，你还是向前迈出了一步。米可说过应该把这份礼物送到祭坛前交给凯罗斯，但既然神明就在眼前等待着，直接将礼物交给他似乎也是理所应当的。 嗯，你已经接受了那把梳子。他微笑着把那东西收进他那颜色不断变化的长袍里，然后对你说出了这句话。你最好让这段婚姻继续下去，尤其是考虑到你的妻子出身于神族，而你也公开表示过对这段婚姻的承诺。 你一定可以的。 我当然相信。[pc.ra kitsune| 如果你不能好好对待你的妻子，那么作为我精心挑选的英雄，你也会让我蒙羞的，哈哈。]"
rows.raw: " "Our seamstress did a bang-up job on her shiromuku even though it were a rush job, so ya oughta be grateful. C'mon, then. Everyone's waitin'." Still keeping that little smile on her face, Kiyoko rises from her seat and steps out of the palanquin, her tails flowing behind her. She takes your hand in hers, gives it a brief squeeze, then draws away to give Miko and Mai a nod. "We're ready." The palanquin and its bearers pull away, and Mai takes the fore with a wooden flute in her hands, while Miko brings up the rear, shading you from sun and rain alike with a big red umbrella. Soft music rises into the air as Kiyoko and you put on your fox masks and formally start down the path through the shrine. You're not entirely sure when they arrive, but at some point Kinu and Komari join the procession, too, the former from behind and the latter ahead of you. Paper lanterns hang from poles and the branches of the small trees along the path, flickering with foxfire despite the light of morning; your steps are slow, measured and ceremonial, all of you putting on a show for populace you know are just beyond your vision and nevertheless watching your progress... When the procession finally arrives at the shrine, though, you hear a small gasp from Mai behind you. Your attention's drawn forward beyond the screen doors to the shrine's interior — it's been prettied up very nicely in Old Country aesthetic and extra furniture's been moved inside to provide seating, but all that pales to the fact that Keros himself is lounging about on the altar's middle with his legs dangling off the edge, leaning back into the mass of his own tails and looking absolutely and perfectly at ease despite the grandeur around him. The trickster god hasn't even bothered to wear anything different for the occasion, still clad in his robes of white and swirling color, although to be fair, he does have an excuse for his fashion sense... Still, this is clearly something that not even Komari was expecting; the tension rising from the matron and her great-great-granddaughters is palpable in the air. Yet there is no stopping now, not with the eyes of more than a hundred families of foxes on the procession through the sacred gardens. The Trickster waits in his own shrine, spies the wedding procession arriving, and sits up amongst the offerings of fruit, salt and vegetables to give you a cheery wave, beckoning you in. The procession stops several steps from the shrine's entrance, and Komari gives her patron deity a deep bow from the waist; all of you feel obliged to follow suit. It seems like the appropriate thing to do. "August Master At the Center of Heaven," Komari begins, not daring to raise her eyes. "I had not expected your personal presence here today." "Oh, Komari. It's always so awkward when you deign to use my full title. Then again, what better occasion for formalities than this?" He turns to the two of you. "I would be terribly remiss if I didn't show up for the wedding of [pc.ra kitsune|my faithful champion and ]my distant descendant, wouldn't I? One beautiful unbroken matrilineal line from my dear Chizuru, through countless generations to this. Such a happy occasion — congratulations, the both of you. "Come! Come into my domain wearing my guise, and ask for my blessings upon your union! This will be a great day!" The great, foppish smile upon Keros' face practically oozes honest sincerity as he paces past the threshold and waves you in once more. He stops, frowning a bit as no one makes a move, then bursts out into hearty laughter. "Oh, right, you needed a ritual cleansing before entering. Don't worry about that; I've already provided one." He points up at the sky, soft, misty rain still falling onto all of you between the roots of the cherry blossom tree. "If I say you're purified, you are. Now don't be shy." That breaks the ice. The wedding procession moves forward once more, entering the shrine, and Kinu and Komari take up seats on high stools to either side of the altar while Miko and Mai lead you to seats before it. Keros himself swings himself back up onto his seat atop the altar, regarding you with all the demeanour of an excited child who's had too many sweet things. Even Miko and Mai with their straight faces look positively somber next to the trickster god; careful and measured in their movements as they set out a small, shallow dish-like cup before you and Kiyoko, the sisters hand it to you, then fill it with strong-smelling clear rice liquor from a gilded scoop with a long handle. Right, you've gone through this with Miko during your coaching. Sip the liquor, finish it in three sips, then pass it back to the sisters. Kiyoko's turn, three sips as well; then once more, with her to be served the second time around. Finally, the third time, with you getting the first serving before Kiyoko... three times three, as it were. Keros himself is playfully coy as he takes in the two of you, clearly restraining his mischievous nature in an effort to be polite. When the rite is over, Miko and Mai remove cup and scoop alike, handing Kiyoko a small amber comb wrapped in white silk cloth. Ah, it's the color of her hair... such a nice touch. Closing her eyes, Kiyoko presses her hands together as if to pray to her patron deity right in front of her, comb and cloth alike sandwiched between her palms. She presses her hands to her heart, then smiles and offers the comb to you. Clasping them in your own, you're reminded of how delicate your fox-wife's fingers are, and yet how warm... when she mentioned so long ago back in the Astral Plane that she'd forgotten how warm peoples' hands could be, and now... Those slitted green eyes, that small smile... the thoughts that must be running through her head... ...If you stand here forever, you'll never get done. Not that you personally have anything against standing here in this moment forever, but still... taking the amber comb in your hands, you step forward. Miko said it ought to be presented to Keros at the altar, but given that the god's right here and waiting, it feels right to hand it directly to him instead. "Well, you've accepted the comb," he tells you with a grin as he tucks it away inside his robes of shifting colors. "You'd better make this marriage work, especially given that your wife's descended from divinity and you've publicly declared your dedication to your union." You will. "I'm sure.[pc.ra kitsune| You'd reflect poorly on me as my handpicked champion if you didn't treat your wife right, aha.]""

rows.original: Next comes the reading of the vows. Komari herself comes up to the both of you and presents forth a folded slip of paper, all gilded and ceremonial; on it are letters and characters — mostly the latter — of the kitsune tongue in the most impeccable brushwork. Though the two of you hold it between yourselves, it falls to you to recite the majority of the vows... The language itself is foreign to you, but Miko's drilled every syllable into your head three days prior and even helpfully provided a translation. Keros himself doesn't seem very motivated to help you overcome the language barrier this time, so you have to go ahead and hope you don't stumble over or mispronounce anything. Even through the fox mask she's wearing, Kiyoko's smile is encouraging, so you must be doing things right, yes? Happily, Kiyoko closes the last word for you, and the sisters take the paper away to have it replaced with a sprig of leaves and blooms from the cherry blossom tree itself, a single paper charm tied to the branch. Once more, like Miko coached you, Kiyoko and you hold the still-green sprigs out in front of you, bow your heads before Keros, then then present them branch-end first to the vulpine deity. Receiving them each in one hand, he quickly makes them disappear into his robes, then settles back as the two of you bow, clap twice, then bow again before his presence. The sound of your clapping should have quickly faded, but somehow it rings about the shrine like a bell, lingering with a strange sense of clarity to it that shouldn't be there. "Aha, I see. Yes, yes, you couldn't get the traditional flowering evergreens, so you used these instead. Very innovative... yes, I think I'll accept these and bestow my blessings upon the two of you, then." With a small flourish, Keros twirls his fingers and produces your wedding rings from thin air, toying with the pair of silver and ruby rings between thumb and forefinger. "Komari was hiding these on her, but I think it'll be a lot more impactful if I'm the one to give them to you, hmm?" Kiyoko says several words in her mother tongue to the vulpine deity and bows once more, which just makes him look even more cheery and full of himself. Taking one ring in each hand, Keros presses them into yours and Kiyoko's palms. "Go on, then, you two. Don't wait on an old-timer like me." The feeling when you slip the ring back on Kiyoko's finger is indescribable; even beneath the white-and-red fox mask, you're able to see... joy would be insufficient to do it justice. No, it's the essence of what makes her her, that loving yet alternately lustful and maternal warmth that you've gotten to know so well[kiyoko.numKits 8|, over and over again as your bodies joined in union, in copulation, in raw mating]. To say that she's a fox-wife would be so inadequate, but yet at the same time so simple, evocative and true. And when she puts her Trickster-blessed ring on yours, you can only wonder what she sees behind the fox-mask over your face. Your eyes meet hers, and she instinctively lowers her gaze. That won't do — gently, you reach out with a finger and catch her chin, force her to meet your eyes. You'll make her the happiest woman alive, you promise. "You already have."
rows.translation: 接下来是宣读誓约的环节。麻里亲自走上前，将一张装饰华丽、充满仪式感的折纸交给你们两人。纸上用最为精湛的笔触书写着一些文字和符号——其中大部分都是用狐语写成的。尽管你们两人共同拿着这张纸，但宣读誓约的任务最终还是落在了你要背诵其中的大部分誓词…… 这种语言对你来说确实很陌生，但三天前，米可已经把每一个音节都反复灌输给你，甚至还提供了相应的翻译。不过，凯罗斯这次似乎并没有什么兴趣帮助你克服语言障碍，所以你只能自己努力，希望不会在背诵过程中出现任何错误或发音失误。即使戴着狐妖面具，清子的笑容依然充满鼓励，这说明你一定做得很好，对吧？ 幸运的是，清子帮你完成了最后一句话，然后姐妹们把那张纸拿走，换上了来自樱树本身的树叶和花朵，一根纸制的饰品被系在树枝上。再一次，就像米可教你们的那样，清子和你将那些还带着绿叶的嫩枝举在面前，在凯罗斯面前鞠躬，然后先将枝条的末端呈递给那位狐妖神明。他双手各接住一根枝条，迅速将它们收进自己的长袍里，然后你们两人再次鞠躬、拍手两次，最后再次向他鞠躬表示敬意。你的掌声本应很快消失，但不知为何，它却在神龛周围回荡，如同钟声一般，带着一种本不该存在的清晰回响。 啊哈，我明白了。没错，你们无法获得那些传统的开花常绿植物，所以就用了这些代替。真是很有创新精神……好吧，我想我应该接受这些，并为你们俩赐予祝福。凯罗斯轻轻一捻手指，便从空气中变出了你的结婚戒指，他用拇指和食指轻轻摆弄着那枚银色与红宝石制成的戒指。麻里一直把这些藏在身上，但我觉得如果……的话，效果会好很多。我是就是那个要把它们交给你的人，嗯？ 清子用她的母语对那位狐妖神明说了几句话，然后再次鞠躬，这使得他看起来更加欢快、更加自信了。凯罗斯双手各拿着一枚戒指，将它们放在了你和清子的手掌中。 那你们两个继续吧，别等我这个老家伙了。 当你将戒指重新戴在清子的手指上时，那种感觉简直难以用语言形容；即使戴着那副红白相间的狐妖面具，你依然能够看到……“喜悦”这个词远远不足以形容那种感受。不，这是让她成为她的本质，那种充满爱意，同时又带有欲望与母性关怀的温度，正是你早已熟悉并深有体会的。[kiyoko.numKits 8|一次又一次，当你们的身体紧密相拥、交合在一起时，那种原始而强烈的感觉便会反复出现交配]说她是个“狐妖精”未免太过轻描淡写，但同时又如此贴切、生动且真实。当她将那枚被“戏弄者”庇佑的戒指戴在你的手指上时，你不禁会好奇——她究竟看到了你脸上那副狐妖面具之后的什么。 你们的目光相遇了，她本能地低下了头。这样不行……你轻轻伸出手，用手指托起她的下巴，迫使她再次与你的目光对视。你承诺，一定要让她成为这个世界上最幸福的女人。 你已经拥有了。

rows.original: The festivities stretch long into the night — Komari wasn't wrong in that foxes love an excuse to goof off and have fun as much as any other peoples do, and the marriage of someone as prominent as Kiyoko fits the bill. There're presents to be received by those close to you, presents to be given away on your part, and there're any number of unfamiliar faces who show up to congratulate you. Kiyoko handles most of these, speaking her mother tongue with unrivalled eloquence, but eventually even her energy starts to flag towards evening and you leave Kinu in charge of all this while the two of you duck out of the den for a little while to recharge. The rain's stopped at this point, and the both of you wander amongst the titanic roots and in the shade of the branches, enjoying the last light of the day before true nightfall. "Your first few hours of married life together have been pretty good, eh?" Kiyoko and you turn. Where there was but empty space before, Keros stands, lounging against one of the roots, swilling something from a gourd. Your fox wife makes to bow and say something, but he cuts her off with a wave of his hand. "I know this is your time to be alone together, so I'll make it quick. Don't suppose I could tempt you with the offer of a wedding present? It's customary to give money, but given that we're in the colonies there are other things I could do for you newlyweds instead." Him gracing the event with his presence will be good enough. You've heard enough stories about people getting exactly what they want. The vulpine deity laughs, moves as if to embrace you, then thinks better of it. "You're a smart one; [pc.ra kitsune|no wonder you signed up to be my divine champion|I like you]. Oh well, maybe your daughter will take me up on the offer when it's her turn to be wed. Shouldn't be too long, really, although the way I reckon 'long' is probably a little different from how you might think it." That's her decision to make when the time comes. "Ha, so it is. Don't mind me, then — enjoy each other, if you please." With a chuckle, the Trickster pulls his robes and nine tails about himself in what by all sense should be an impossible move, simply folding the space of his person upon itself until he's gone, disapparated into thin air. Kiyoko and you share a look for a moment, then you notice she's all quiet and nervous as you stand under the cherry blossom tree. With Keros' departure, a gentle wind's kicked up ruffling your wedding garb, petals being carried in the breeze; Kiyoko's trembling and fidgeting, biting her lip as she looks down at her feet. What's wrong? Her tails wrap loosely around her and her ears fold down, tears forming in the corners of her eyes. "It's rather silly..." Silly of her to be feeling silly on this day of all days. Out with it. "Can I hold your hand?" Of course. Kiyoko's hand is small compared to yours, but still a delight to hold, and your heart skips a beat as your fingers meet the warm metal of the ring on her finger. Tonight will pass, the festivities will cease, and people will settle back into normalcy... but tomorrow will be the first day of the rest of your lives together.
rows.translation: 庆祝活动一直持续到深夜——麻里说得没错，狐妖和其他人类一样，总是喜欢找机会放松玩乐，而像清子这样地位显赫的人的婚礼，正是这样的好机会。亲近的人会收到礼物，你也会送给别人礼物，还有许多素未谋面的人会前来向你表示祝贺。清子负责处理这些事务，她以无与伦比的口才使用着自己的母语进行沟通，但到了傍晚，就连她的精力也开始衰退。于是你会让小娟来负责所有这些工作，而你们俩则会暂时离开那个“巢穴”，休息一会儿，重新补充精力。此时雨已经停了，你们俩在那些巨大的树根间漫步，穿梭在树枝的荫蔽之下，享受着黄昏时分最后的阳光，等待着夜幕的降临。 你们结婚后的最初几个小时过得还挺不错的，对吧？ 清子和你一起转过身去。原本只有空荡荡的空间的地方，现在凯罗斯站在那里，靠在一根树根上，正从葫芦里喝着什么。你的狐妖妻子想要鞠躬说什么，但他只是挥了挥手让她停止了动作。 我知道现在正是你们俩独处的时候，所以我长话短说。我想，送一份结婚礼物应该能吸引你吧？按照惯例，人们通常会送钱，但考虑到我们现在是在殖民地，其实还有其他方式可以帮到你们这些新婚夫妇。 他的出席本身就已经足以为这场活动增色不少了。你们已经听过太多关于人们如愿以偿的故事了。 那位狡黠的神明笑了起来，似乎想要拥抱你，但最终又改变了主意。你真是个聪明人； [pc.ra kitsune|难怪你报名要成为我的守护者呢。|我喜欢你。]哦，好吧，也许等你女儿轮到结婚的时候，她会接受我的邀请的。其实应该不会等太久，不过我觉得“太久”这个概念，可能和你想象的有点不同吧。 到时候，这是她需要自己做出的决定。 哈，原来如此。那我就不打扰你们了——希望你们能互相享受彼此的陪伴。 Trickster轻笑着，将自己的长袍和九条尾巴围在身上，做出了一个看似不可能完成的动作——他只是将自己的身体空间折叠起来，就这样消失在了空气中。你与清子对视了片刻，然后你注意到她显得非常安静且紧张。当你们站在樱花树下时，随着凯罗斯的离开，一阵轻风拂起了，让你的婚礼礼服随风飘动，花瓣也随着风飞舞起来；清子则不停地颤抖着，坐立不安，还咬着嘴唇，低头盯着自己的足部。 怎么了？这有点傻吧…… 她真傻，在这种日子里还觉得自己很傻。干脆说出来吧。 我能牵你的手吗？ 当然。与你的手相比，清子的手确实较小，但握在手里依然感觉很舒适。当你的手指触碰到她手指上那枚戒指的温暖金属时，你的心会不由自主地跳动起来。今晚将会过去，庆祝活动也会结束，人们会重新回到日常生活中……但明天，将是你们共同度过的余生的第一天。

The rain's stopped at this point, and the both of you wander amongst the titanic roots and in the shade of the branches, enjoying the last light of the day before true nightfall. "Your first few hours of married life together have been pretty good, eh?" Kiyoko and you turn. Where there was but empty space before, Keros stands, lounging against one of the roots, swilling something from a gourd. Your fox wife makes to bow and say something, but he cuts her off with a wave of his hand. "I know this is your time to be alone together, so I'll make it quick. Don't suppose I could tempt you with the offer of a wedding present? It's customary to give money, but given that we're in the colonies there are other things I could do for you newlyweds instead." Him gracing the event with his presence will be good enough. You've heard enough stories about people getting exactly what they want. 这已经不是第一次让她来完成了鸟居前往麻里的家吧。清子带着一丝娇羞的微笑解释道。如果她想和自己的心上人共度一天，那就必须付出努力才行。 [kinu.isInari |听到这话，小娟的耳朵和脸都耷拉了下来。嗯，我明白了，妈妈。反正你从来就不喜欢仁司这个家伙。 我从来没有说过那个男孩的坏话，当然，我的任何家仆的后代们，我也同样从未说过他们的坏话。 随便吧。他已经够让人头疼的了——我甚至得把他从田里拉出来，尽管他自己也明白社交义务的重要性。说真的，我不知道他到底是真是个笨蛋，还是只是在装傻。每次我认定他是笨蛋时，他就会做出一些举动来让我改变想法。 那么，你们两个确实非常般配。 |小娟的身体僵硬了起来。妈妈，我已经清楚地解释过了，这并不是什么恋情或浪漫的插曲。我只是想通过这些活动来塑造自己想要展现的形象，所以才请求中野作为我的陪同而已。 甚至不惜向麻里提出正式请求，还利用我的名字来施加压力，让她无法拒绝。这一切确实表明，你非常渴望他在整个过程中都能陪伴在你身边。否则，你为什么要费尽心思去获得这样的保证呢？尤其是你明明知道，我的忠实下属对于你鼓励她的后代这件事，其实并不赞同。 妈妈！ ] 你在情况进一步恶化之前介入了。赏花吗？ 清子笑了。啊，当然。这是为了庆祝春天的到来，欣赏大自然的美景，表达对神灵的敬畏之情，当然也是为了尊崇我们帝国的象征以及那位神圣君主的宠儿。此外，这也是一个放松身心、享受欢乐的好机会。在过去，我个人觉得乡村地区的节日总是充满了魅力……而这个地方，可以说是最典型的乡村之地了。 正如我所说，小娟和我有义务参加，但是……也许你也应该一起来。 [pc.ra kitsune|在庆典期间，让他的神圣主人的冠军现身肯定是一件非常值得庆祝的事情。|这对于像你这样的人来说，无疑会帮助你更好地理解我们狐狸一族的行事方式。]另外，等那些社交活动结束后，我们还可以一起花些时间。[kiyoko.numKits 2 3 8 | 我也把绫送到了那里 | 我也把那些装备都送去了 |在活动期间，朝雾会负责照顾其他的角色，这样我们就可以有一些独处的时间了 ]。 |[pc.mf|父亲|母亲]妈妈，如果您不介意的话，我或许应该继续去完成这些配送工作了——在今天结束之前，还有不少任务需要完成呢。 清子摆了摆手，示意他不用再说了。尽管去吧， [kiyoko.numKits 4|让绫来帮你吧。那个女孩反正很可能在某个地方闲荡着；让她干点体力活，很快就能让她安静下来|下次经过门口时，一定要更加小心]。" 小娟再次鞠躬，然后拿起她的负担，走出了门去，她的尾巴随着步伐的移动而摇摆着。[dayNight|| 直到深夜]清子和你一起看着她朝那个方向消失了。鸟居门开了，你的狐妖妻子微笑着转向你。 ] 那么，亲爱的，你还是想参加吗？ ] 看来这次该由你来决定了。你可以去参加那些庆祝活动，也可以选择不去，留在家里照看你的狐妖妻子和女儿。不管怎样，这一天总会被消耗掉的——如果你要去拜访清子，应该也不会介意花这一天的时间吧？

rows.original: Flower viewing? Sure, why not — it sounds like a bunch of fun. Trappings aside, no matter where you go or what culture you find yourself in, people always love to eat, drink and make merry. If your fox-wife and daughter are inviting you over for a good time, then who are you to say no, really? "Ehehe. I knew you'd say yes." Beaming, Kiyoko leans in and graces you with a little kiss, then settles back with a happy sigh. "Come on then, beloved, let's rest well. We're going to need all our energy tomorrow." She isn't joking, either. You're awakened before dawn by Kiyoko tugging on your shoulder, rousing you from your sleep; the two of you share a bath before getting dressed and ready to go. With Kiyoko all dressed up in the traditional clothing of her people, you can't help but feel a little out of place, but then again, [pc.ra kitsune|no one's going to question you, are they? Even with you as you are, it'll still take some time to adjust to the culture you adopted|it's kind of expected of you at this point, isn't it? You're the foxes' favorite outsider, after all]. By the time you arrive at the Torii gate, Kinu is there waiting for you, [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 8 16 |[kinu.isInari |all dressed up in finery for the occasion. You wouldn't know her to be a working girl by this appearance alone, that's for sure. |elegant and refined as always. She's even used some floral scent on her tails, strong enough that you can smell it at this distance. Really, is she trying to impress some boy at the festivities? ] |her excitable teenaged sister by her side. Those two really have quite the dynamic when it gets down to it... |her siblings gathered behind her. Guess the kids are going to have a day out, too... |her many siblings gathered behind her. Seeing this many fox kits gathered in one place, you can't help but shake your head and smile. Family outings must be quite a struggle... |Her many, many siblings gathered around her. Oh boy — with this many children around, the festival's sure going to be lively... good thing that you're going to wash your hands of this and let Kinu and the eldest of her siblings sort it out, right? ] "[kinu.isInari |Morning, Mom, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. You all ready to go? |Good morning, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother. Are we prepared to depart? ]" But of course. Kiyoko's first through the portal, then you; the brief chill and disorientation of passing through The Ways Between is rapidly replaced by warmth and the scent of sweet incense in the air. Your fox-wife gently squeezes your hand and urges you on out of the gate — and not a moment too soon, because Kinu emerges next, [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 8 |neatly filling the space you occupied a moment ago |followed by her sister |follower by her siblings |followed by a whole passel of her siblings ]. "Our daughter can handle herself, beloved. Why don't we make this day about us?" Smiling, Kiyoko urges you down the path to the shrine — for once, neither Miko nor Mai are on duty and the shrine entrance is shuttered tight, but you do find Komari off in the gazebo pouring herself strong-smelling rice liquor from a small porcelain flask, while gazing out over the empty fields. The den matron rises to her feet and acknowledges the both of you with a nod as you approach, but doesn't bow. "My liege.[pc.ra kitsune| Divine champion.] [party.has kiyoko|It's good that you're able to come despite being busy doing his divine lordship's work out in the world|Your presence at the event is more than welcome]." "And yet you're all out here alone sipping sake." "Someone has to keep an eye out just in case his divine lordship decides to make an entrance upon the festivities, my liege; he gravitates to the chaos like flies to vinegar. That, and at more than two hundred and fifty it's hard for an old woman like me to get excited for things like hanami and summer bon festivals. Those are for young people." She regards the both of you with a coy smile. "These days, it brings me more joy to organize them for the young folk rather than participate myself... that, and I'm more than suited to enjoy the beauty of cherry blossoms from here." The only parts of the tree visible from here are its roots... "Just so." ...All right, you understand. Where do you get started? "Head on down to the lower plaza; Kohaku will get you all sorted out. From there, if you'd rather head for the plaza in the branches, or take a more distant view from outside of the den, that's up to you. Eat. Drink. Get drunk. Sing badly. Miko and Mai have a few things going. Have fun. Wake up with a hangover tomorrow. Write terrible poems about the beauty of sakura petals and the coming of spring, if you're my great-great-grandson. What a glorious time of year." At a nod from Kiyoko, Komari settles back down in her seat and picks up her cup again, looking all serene and grandmotherly. She was around when this cherry blossom tree was but a seed, a sapling... one can only wonder what's going on behind those blank eyes.
rows.translation: 赏花？当然可以，听起来肯定很有趣。抛开那些繁琐的仪式不谈，无论你走到哪里，无论身处哪种文化环境中，人们总是喜欢吃喝玩乐。如果你的狐妖妻子和女儿邀请你一起去享受美好时光，那你还有什么理由拒绝呢？ 呵呵，我就知道你会答应的。基约科满脸笑容地凑过来，轻轻地吻了你一下，然后满意地叹了口气，重新坐回原位。那么，亲爱的，我们好好休息吧。明天我们需要用到所有的精力。 她也不是在开玩笑。天还没亮，清子就会拉你的肩膀，将你从睡梦中唤醒；然后你们会一起洗澡，之后再穿好衣服准备出发。当看到清子穿着她族人的传统服装时，你难免会感到有些格格不入，但转念一想[pc.ra kitsune|没人会质疑你，对吧？即使你是现在的你，也需要一些时间来适应你所接纳的这种文化。|在这个时候，这种事情其实也在意料之中吧？毕竟，你可是狐狸们最喜欢的“外来者”啊。]当你到达那里的时候鸟居大门已经打开，小娟正在那里等着你。 [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 8 16 |[kinu.isInari |所有人都穿着盛装参加这个活动。单从这身打扮来看，你绝对想不到她其实是个上班族女孩。 |一如既往，她总是那么优雅精致。她甚至在尾巴上喷了些花香，香味浓烈，从这个距离就能闻到。说真的，她是不是想在庆典上吸引某个男孩的注意呢？ ] |她那容易激动的十几岁妹妹始终陪在她身边。说实在的，这两个人之间的关系确实挺特别的…… |她的兄弟姐妹们都聚集在她身后。看来这些孩子们也要出去玩一天了…… |她的许多兄弟姐妹都聚集在她身后。看到这么多小狐妖聚集在了一起，你不禁会摇头微笑——家庭聚会对于它们来说，肯定是一件相当麻烦的事情吧…… |她的许多兄弟姐妹都围在了她身边。天哪——有这么多孩子在场，这个节日肯定会热闹非凡的……幸好你可以把这件事交给小娟以及她那些哥哥姐姐们去处理，对吧？ ] "[kinu.isInari |早上好，妈妈。 [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]你们都准备好了吗？ |早上好， [pc.mf|父亲|母亲]妈妈，我们准备好出发了吗？ ]" 当然可以。 首先是清子的第一个通过传送门，然后轮到你；当穿过那些神秘通道时，那种短暂的寒冷与迷失感很快就被温暖的气息以及空气中弥漫的甜香所取代。你的狐妖妻子轻轻握住你的手，催促你继续前进——而这一刻来得正是时候，因为紧接着，小娟也出现了。 [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 8 |巧妙地填补了你刚才所占用的空间 |接着是她的妹妹 |被她的兄弟姐妹们追随 |接着是一大群她的兄弟姐妹们 ]。 亲爱的，我们的女儿已经能够照顾自己了。为什么不让这一天属于我们自己呢？ 基代子微笑着，带你沿着小路走向神社——这一次，无论是米可还是舞都没有值班，神社的入口也被紧紧关上了。不过你在凉亭里看到了麻里，她正从一个小瓷瓶中倒出浓烈的米酒，凝视着空荡荡的田野。当你走近时，这位“帮派头目”站了起来，点了点头向你们表示问候，但没有鞠躬。 我的君主。[pc.ra kitsune| 神圣冠军。] [party.has kiyoko|尽管你忙于处理那位神圣君主的世间事务，还是能够抽时间前来，真是太好了|我们非常欢迎您参加这次活动]。" 然而，你们现在却独自一人在这里喝酒清酒。” 总得有人留神观察，以防他的神圣陛下突然出现在庆典现场，我的主公；他总是会被混乱吸引，就像苍蝇会被醋吸引一样。更何况，我已经两百五十多岁了，像我这样的老妇人，实在很难对这类事情感到兴奋花见还有夏天bon节日活动啊，那些都是为年轻人准备的。她带着一丝娇羞的微笑看着你们俩。这些天，为年轻人组织赏樱活动反而让我感到更加开心，而不是亲自去参与其中……而且，从这里欣赏樱花的美丽，对我来说再合适不过了。 从这里只能看到这棵树的根部…… 只是这样而已。 …好吧，你明白我的意思了。那么，你应该从哪里开始呢？ 直接前往下层广场吧，琥珀会帮你们安排好一切。从那里开始，如果你们想去分岔处的广场，或者想从巢穴外面欣赏更远处的景色，那完全由你们自己决定。吃吧、喝吧、喝得酩酊大醉吧、唱得难听点也没关系。米可和舞有些事情要处理，你们尽情享受吧……明天醒来时可能会宿醉，如果你们是我的玄孙辈，那就写一些关于樱花花瓣之美以及春天到来的糟糕诗篇吧。这真是一年中最美好的时光啊。 在清子的示意下，麻里重新坐回座位，拿起了她的杯子，看上去显得十分平静，就像一位老奶奶一样。当这棵樱花树还只是一颗种子、一棵小树苗的时候，她就已经在那里了……人们不禁会想知道，那双空洞的眼睛背后，究竟在想着什么。
rows.raw: " Flower viewing? Sure, why not — it sounds like a bunch of fun. Trappings aside, no matter where you go or what culture you find yourself in, people always love to eat, drink and make merry. If your fox-wife and daughter are inviting you over for a good time, then who are you to say no, really? "Ehehe. I knew you'd say yes." Beaming, Kiyoko leans in and graces you with a little kiss, then settles back with a happy sigh. "Come on then, beloved, let's rest well. We're going to need all our energy tomorrow." She isn't joking, either. You're awakened before dawn by Kiyoko tugging on your shoulder, rousing you from your sleep; the two of you share a bath before getting dressed and ready to go. With Kiyoko all dressed up in the traditional clothing of her people, you can't help but feel a little out of place, but then again, [pc.ra kitsune|no one's going to question you, are they? Even with you as you are, it'll still take some time to adjust to the culture you adopted|it's kind of expected of you at this point, isn't it? You're the foxes' favorite outsider, after all]. By the time you arrive at the Torii gate, Kinu is there waiting for you, [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 8 16 |[kinu.isInari |all dressed up in finery for the occasion. You wouldn't know her to be a working girl by this appearance alone, that's for sure. |elegant and refined as always. She's even used some floral scent on her tails, strong enough that you can smell it at this distance. Really, is she trying to impress some boy at the festivities? ] |her excitable teenaged sister by her side. Those two really have quite the dynamic when it gets down to it... |her siblings gathered behind her. Guess the kids are going to have a day out, too... |her many siblings gathered behind her. Seeing this many fox kits gathered in one place, you can't help but shake your head and smile. Family outings must be quite a struggle... |Her many, many siblings gathered around her. Oh boy — with this many children around, the festival's sure going to be lively... good thing that you're going to wash your hands of this and let Kinu and the eldest of her siblings sort it out, right? ] "[kinu.isInari |Morning, Mom, [pc.mf|Dad|Mom]. You all ready to go? |Good morning, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], Mother. Are we prepared to depart? ]" But of course. Kiyoko's first through the portal, then you; the brief chill and disorientation of passing through The Ways Between is rapidly replaced by warmth and the scent of sweet incense in the air. Your fox-wife gently squeezes your hand and urges you on out of the gate — and not a moment too soon, because Kinu emerges next, [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 8 |neatly filling the space you occupied a moment ago |followed by her sister |follower by her siblings |followed by a whole passel of her siblings ]. "Our daughter can handle herself, beloved. Why don't we make this day about us?" Smiling, Kiyoko urges you down the path to the shrine — for once, neither Miko nor Mai are on duty and the shrine entrance is shuttered tight, but you do find Komari off in the gazebo pouring herself strong-smelling rice liquor from a small porcelain flask, while gazing out over the empty fields. The den matron rises to her feet and acknowledges the both of you with a nod as you approach, but doesn't bow. "My liege.[pc.ra kitsune| Divine champion.] [party.has kiyoko|It's good that you're able to come despite being busy doing his divine lordship's work out in the world|Your presence at the event is more than welcome]." "And yet you're all out here alone sipping sake." "Someone has to keep an eye out just in case his divine lordship decides to make an entrance upon the festivities, my liege; he gravitates to the chaos like flies to vinegar. That, and at more than two hundred and fifty it's hard for an old woman like me to get excited for things like hanami and summer bon festivals. Those are for young people." She regards the both of you with a coy smile. "These days, it brings me more joy to organize them for the young folk rather than participate myself... that, and I'm more than suited to enjoy the beauty of cherry blossoms from here." The only parts of the tree visible from here are its roots... "Just so." ...All right, you understand. Where do you get started? "Head on down to the lower plaza; Kohaku will get you all sorted out. From there, if you'd rather head for the plaza in the branches, or take a more distant view from outside of the den, that's up to you. Eat. Drink. Get drunk. Sing badly. Miko and Mai have a few things going. Have fun. Wake up with a hangover tomorrow. Write terrible poems about the beauty of sakura petals and the coming of spring, if you're my great-great-grandson. What a glorious time of year." At a nod from Kiyoko, Komari settles back down in her seat and picks up her cup again, looking all serene and grandmotherly. She was around when this cherry blossom tree was but a seed, a sapling... one can only wonder what's going on behind those blank eyes."

rows.original: When you arrive in the lower plaza, a good quarter of the entire place is filled with cloth bundles — and this is after the festivities have begun. There aren't that many foxes in line ahead of you, but everyone is more than eager to give way for Kiyoko, if not you... even Kohaku's warehouse staff aren't around as you might have expected, and it's the automatons — wooden puppets — that are carrying bundles in from the storehouse to Kohaku's makeshift stall where she's distributing them. The little golden fox herself has gone to the lengths of wearing traditional clothing for the occasion, and done up her usually loose hair in an appropriate style — but is still adorable in the extreme as you come up to her. "Welcome, High Lady Ōtomo, [pc.ra kitsune|divine champion|consort]!" Kohaku struggles to pick up a huge bundle half her size from the stack behind her. "It is a glorious day for flower viewing, is it not? Such fine weather, nojya!" The sight of Kohaku handling the package reminds you of an ant carrying something many times its size. Is she sure she doesn't need — "Here you go, nojya!" Kohaku hefts the big cloth bundle up over her head in order to present it to you. "Please enjoy this year's cherry blossom viewing[pc.ra kitsune|, my [pc.mf|lord|lady]]! Allow the beauty of spring to enter your hearts and invigorate you for the year to come!" You test the bundle in your arms and gods, is it heavy. Getting this much feels kind of embarrassing... "You have our thanks," Kiyoko adds. "That the High Lady Ōtomo and [pc.ra kitsune|the divine champion|her consort] have graced us with their presence is already amazing, but to have contributed to the proceedings in the way they have...! Please, do not hold back — the previous year has been very good to us, and the storehouse is overflowing with goods! To this extent, the matron has not only ordered its doors opened to all in the den, but also traded some of the surplus for luxuries across the ocean, nojya! Should this be insufficient for your purposes, [pc.ra kitsune|my [pc.mf|lord|lady], ]you have but to come back to me for more — I will be here until sundown!" Doesn't she want to partake of the cherry blossom viewing herself? "There is no greater joy than enabling it in others, nojya! Besides, I am perfectly placed to appreciate them, am I not?" That is true... "Your daughter has provided so much from your holdings, so what we are giving back is but only a small token of appreciation, nojya! Please enjoy yourselves, High Lady Ōtomo, [pc.ra kitsune|divine champion|consort]!" Kiyoko smiles. "Even so, don't forget to take some time off for yourself before the day is out. This is a direct order from a den mother." "I will, nojya!"
rows.translation: 当你来到下层广场时，会发现整个广场的四分之一区域都被布包占据着——就是这样的情景。之后庆祝活动已经开始了。排在你前面的狐妖并不多，但每个人都非常乐意给清子让路，即使不是给你……就连小白的仓库工作人员也不在，与你的预期不同。实际上，是那些自动机械——木制傀儡——在把包裹从仓库运到小白临时搭建的摊位，然后由她进行分发。 那只小金狐妖为了这个场合，甚至特意穿上了传统的服装，还将她平时松散的头发整理成了合适的发型——不过，当你走近她的时候，还是会发现她依然可爱极了。 欢迎来到这里，大友姬。 [pc.ra kitsune|神圣冠军|配偶]！"琥珀费了九牛二虎之力，才从身后的那一堆东西中搬起那个比她体型还要大一半的巨重包裹。今天真是观赏花朵的绝佳日子，不是吗？这样的好天气，真是太棒了！ 看到小红处理那个包裹，你会觉得她就像一只搬运着比自己大很多倍物品的蚂蚁。她真的确定自己不需要帮助吗？ 给你，诺雅！琥珀将那大包布料举过头顶，准备把它交给你。希望大家能尽情享受今年的樱花观赏活动。[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]]让春天的美好融入您的心中，为即将到来的一年带来活力吧！ 你把这一大包东西抱在怀里试了试，天啊，真够重的。拿到这么多东西，感觉有点尴尬…… 我们对此表示感谢。清子补充道。 高阶女士大友以及[pc.ra kitsune|神圣冠军|她的配偶]他们能够光临我们的聚会，就已经让我们感到非常荣幸了，而他们还能以这样的方式为聚会做出贡献……！请务必继续支持我们吧——过去这一年对我们来说真是非常顺利，我们的仓库里堆满了各种商品！因此，女主人不仅决定向所有参与者开放仓库的大门，还用多余的货物换来了远洋带来的各种奢侈品，真是太棒了！如果这些还是不够满足你们的需求的话[pc.ra kitsune|我的[pc.mf|领主|女士]， ]只要你需要更多帮助，随时回来找我吧——我会一直在这里，直到日落！ 她难道不想自己也去观赏樱花吗？ 没有什么比帮助他人获得快乐更令人欣慰的了，诺雅！而且，我完全有条件去体会这种快乐，不是吗？ 那个是真是如此…… 您的女儿从您的财产中贡献了如此多的东西，因此我们所给予的这些，只不过是一点表示感谢的小礼物而已，nojya！请各位尽情享受吧，大友家的高贵女士。 [pc.ra kitsune|神圣冠军|配偶]！" 清子笑了。即便如此，也别忘了在今天结束之前为自己留出一些时间。这是来自‘母狼’的直接命令。 我一定会的，诺雅！
