rows.original: So as it turns out, Kinu meets you by the gate linking your home and the tree. Your daughter [kinu.isInari |has certainly primped up her rustic, charming persona well past eleven — she hasn't changed her clothes any, but has cleaned up very well and at least doesn't smell of the fields. Guess she's chosen to obey her mother without actually obeying her, which is as good as you suppose things will ever get. Kinu gives the both of you a small bow. "Mom, [kinu.Dad]. They're just about waiting for us on the other side — you're just about ready, right?" |looks stunning as always, just as beautiful as her mother, if not more. She hasn't actually changed her clothes from her usual outfit, but certainly carries herself with much more poise and refinement than what she does in a casual setting — something which you might have thought wasn't possible given how she usually is, but she manages it nevertheless. Kinu gives the both of you a small bow. "Good morning, Mother, [kinu.Dad]. Everyone is ready to receive you on the other side, should you desire it." ] Kiyoko leans over and rubs her cheek on your shoulder affectionately. "Are you prepared, beloved?" You should be the one asking the question, not her. The way she's saying it, she's making it out to be your big day, not hers. Your fox-wife just laughs at that and takes your hand, dragging you after her through the torii gate. There's a faint sense of pressure on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], a sudden wrenching sensation that you really should've gotten used to by now, and then you're standing on the other side in the sacred gardens, Kinu following you soon after with a faint rush of displaced air by your side. Komari is waiting to receive you with Miko and Mai flanking her, and as Kiyoko steps forward the den matron removes her golden headpiece and bows deeply to her liege, receiving a brief nod in return. "We've been waiting for you, [silly |High Lady Ōtomo |Myōbu-Sama ]. Please, follow us. How gracious of you to be with us as well this day, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]; I hope you participate as much as you are able in the proceedings." Your fox-wife tsks. "No need to stand on ceremony to simply greet us, Komari — save that for later. The last time I was at one of these, it was more than two centuries ago and an ocean away; I can only hope that you haven't changed the forms of the ceremony too much in the intervening time." "These traditions hardly ever change for there is no reason for them to, [silly |High Lady |Myōbu-Sama ]. If there's one thing you can safely rely on, it's them," Komari explains as she and her great-great-granddaughters form a triangle about the three of you, escorting you through the roots, upwards into the trunk and out onto one of the sacred tree's branches. Your little party stops at one of the side rooms, whereupon Miko pulls open the sliding door and gestures for you to enter with a bow. Kiyoko is first in, followed by you and Kinu, and then Komari and her great-great-granddaughters bring up the rear, shutting the door behind them. No kidding — everyone's already waiting for your arrival in the simply decorated room, sitting on their knees the way these foxes do atop comfy-looking cushions. As for who everyone is, you recognize several big names in the den — Kohaku and Nakano amongst them. Komari takes up her place at the head of the line with Kinu, while Miko brings up the rear; you can see that all the foxes in the chamber have been roughly ordered according to their seniority in the den hierarchy. Roughly being the keyword here — you're pretty sure Miko isn't at the bottom of the top, and she's just at the end of the line to be cheeky... So... this is the private ceremony, then, for the civil servants with a better pay grade. You'd have expected more lavish decorations, but as with much of kitsune aesthetic that you've seen in the colonies, there's beauty in simplicity, and it shows in the room. You took to your fox-wife at your side; she gives your hand a reassuring squeeze, then a gentle nudge to the side before sweeping forward, Mai trailing behind her. In that moment, Kiyoko's entire demeanor changes as easily as if she were changing her clothes — warm, gentle and approachable transforms into regal and imperious in every sense of the word. Her presence, the way she carries herself, even her walking gait and the sway of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails as she sweeps towards the dias with a dramatic billow of noble finery. As she takes up her rightful place upon a cushion at the head of the room, it's all you can do to [pc.ra kitsune |find the cushion that's clearly been set out for you next to Miko and try to do the whole sitting-on-your-knees-and-heels thing. It's not as uncomfortable as you might have imagined it to be, but you're not sure that you might be able to keep it up for hours, unused to it as you are. Maybe you should've practiced more... "Oh, hey, if'n it ain't yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Didja get roped in by th' high lady?" You glance over at Miko. The vixen of a shrine maiden is perfectly still and on her best behavior... save for the corner of her mouth she's whispering out of. You kind of did... "Ain't nothin' f'r ya to worry yer head off 'bout. Jus' keep yer cool and do what done comes naturally." There are so many things one could say to that, few of them good, and that's probably precisely why Miko teased you about it. You look up and across the room at Kiyoko, who's started intoning a long, solemn speech in the kitsune mother tongue. While you don't understand any of the words, the gravity of her tone of voice is unmistakable, as is the reaction from almost everyone else in the ceremonial chamber. Then there's Miko, who looks as pleased as if she'd just eaten a ten-course meal all by her lonesome... Somehow, that just makes you all the more worried, which is precisely what she intended. |retreat to the side in order to watch the proceedings. No one glowers at you with silent disapproval, so you can only assume that you're doing something right. You look up and across the room at Kiyoko, who's started intoning a long, solemn speech in the kitsune mother tongue. While you don't understand any of the words, the gravity of her tone of voice is unmistakable, as is the reaction from almost everyone else in the ceremonial chamber. Then there's Miko, who looks as pleased as if she'd just eaten a ten-course meal all by her lonesome... ]
rows.translation: 原来，小娟会在连接你家与那棵树的门口等待你——你的女儿。 [kinu.isInari |她确实把自己那质朴而迷人的形象打扮得更加得体了——她并没有换衣服，只是把自己收拾得干干净净的，至少不再有田野里的那种味道了。我想，她应该是选择听从母亲的建议，但实际上并没有完全照做，这样已经算是最好的结果了。 小娟向你们俩微微鞠了一躬：“妈妈[kinu.Dad]他们应该就在另一边等着我们吧——你们也差不多准备好了，对吧？ |她看起来依旧美得令人惊叹，甚至比她的母亲还要漂亮。她实际上并没有更换平时的服装，但她的举止却显得更加优雅、得体——考虑到她平时的风格，你可能会觉得这几乎是不可能的，但她确实做到了。 小娟向你们母女俩微微鞠了一躬，说道：“早上好，母亲。[kinu.Dad]如果你们愿意，所有人都已经准备好在彼岸迎接你们。 ] 清子倾身过来，亲昵地用脸颊蹭了蹭你的肩膀：“亲爱的，你准备好了吗？” 这本该是你来问她这个问题才对，而不是她。她这么说的方式，让人觉得这是你的重大时刻，而不是她的。 你的狐妖妻子只是笑了笑，然后握住你的手，拉着你一起走了鸟居门……你感觉到有一股轻微的压力正作用于你的身上[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]突然间，你感到一阵剧烈的拉扯感——这种感觉其实你早就应该习惯了。紧接着，你就站在了那片神圣的花园里，小娟紧随在你身后，周围还伴随着一阵空气流动的声音。麻里正在那里等着迎接你，米可和舞站在她的两侧。当清子向前走去时，那位女族长摘下了她头上的金色头饰，向她的君主深深地鞠了一躬，而清子也微微点了点头作为回应。 “我们一直在等待你。 [silly |大友高贵夫人 |妙布大人 ]请跟我们来。您能在今天也与我们同行，真是太慷慨了。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下 |[pc.name] ]我希望你能尽自己所能参与这些仪式。” 你的狐妖妻子轻哼道：“没必要为了简单地跟我们打招呼而搞这些仪式——等会儿再搞吧。我上次参加这样的仪式，已经是两个多世纪以前，而且还是在另一个大洋的另一边了；我只希望这些仪式在这些年里没有发生太大的变化。” “这些传统几乎从来都不会改变，因为也没有理由让它们改变。 [silly |高阶女士 |冥府大人 ]如果说有什么是你可以绝对信赖的，那就是他们，”麻里解释道。她和她的曾孙女们围成一个三角形，将你们三人护在中间，引领你们穿过树根，向上穿过树干，最终来到那棵神圣树木的树枝上。你们的小聚会在一间侧室里进行。米可推开了滑动门，鞠了一躬，示意你们进去。清子第一个走了进去，接着是你和小娟，最后是麻里和她的曾孙女们，他们关上了门。 说真的——所有人都已经在那间装饰简约的房间里等着你的到来，他们像那些狐妖一样，盘腿坐在看起来非常舒适的垫子上。至于那些人是谁每个人你能够认出洞穴里的几个知名角色——其中包括琥珀和中野。麻里和小娟站在队伍的前面，而米可则走在队伍的后面；你可以看到，洞穴里的所有狐妖都已经按照它们在群体中的地位顺序排列好了。大致上来说在这里，“身份”才是关键因素——你很清楚，米可绝对不是最底层的人，她只是因为有点调皮捣蛋，所以排在队伍的末尾而已…… 那么……这就是为那些收入较高的公务员们举办的私人仪式了。你本以为这里会有更加奢华的装饰，但就像你在殖民地看到的许多狐族风格一样，简约之中也蕴含着美，这一点在这间房间里体现得淋漓尽致。你挽着身旁的狐族妻子，她紧紧握住你的手，给予你一种安心的感觉，然后轻轻地将你往旁边一推，自己便向前走去，而舞则跟在她的后面。 就在那一刻，清子的整个举止发生了仿佛更换衣服般迅速的变化——原本温暖、温柔、平易近人，瞬间变得高贵而威严，无论从哪个角度来看都是如此。她的仪态、举止，甚至是她的步态与身形摇摆，都发生了彻底的变化。[kiyoko.kiyokoTails]她那华丽的裙摆随着她的移动而剧烈摆动，仿佛是一阵 noble finery 的风暴。当她坐在房间最前面的垫子上，占据了自己应得的位置时，你只能[pc.ra kitsune |在米可的旁边，找到那个明显是为你准备好的坐垫，然后试着做那个跪着、脚尖着地的动作。其实并没有你想象中那么不舒服，但因为你之前没有练习过，所以也不确定自己能否坚持几个小时……也许你当初应该多练习一下的…… “哦，嘿，如果那不是你的[pc.mf |领主 |女士 ]船……你是不是也被那位高级女官拉拢进来了？” 你瞥了眼米可。那个狡黠的神社少女此刻一动不动，表现得格外乖巧……除了她嘴角那微微上扬的幅度，似乎在偷偷说着什么。 你确实有点…… “没什么好让你为此烦恼的。只要保持冷静，按照自己的方式去做就行了。” 对于这种话，其实有很多种回应方式，但很少有会是好的回应……或许正是因为这个原因，米可才会拿这件事来取笑你吧。你抬头望向房间对面的清子，她正在用狐族的语言发表一段冗长而庄严的演讲。虽然你完全听不懂那些话语，但她的语气中所蕴含的严肃性与庄重感是显而易见的，仪式厅里其他人的反应也同样如此。然后是米可，她看起来开心极了，就好像独自享用了一顿十道菜的大餐一样…… 不知为何，这种情景反而会让你更加担心，而这恰恰就是她想要达到的效果。 |你退到一旁，准备观看接下来的发展。没有人用沉默的不满目光注视着你，所以你可以认为自己的做法是正确的。你抬头看向房间的另一边，看到清子正在用狐族的语言发表一段冗长而庄严的演讲。虽然你完全听不懂那些话的含义，但她语气中的严肃性却是显而易见的，仪式厅里几乎所有人的反应也都证明了这一点。至于米可，她的表情仿佛刚刚独自享用了一顿十道菜的大餐一样开心…… ]
rows.raw: " So as it turns out, Kinu meets you by the gate linking your home and the tree. Your daughter [kinu.isInari |has certainly primped up her rustic, charming persona well past eleven — she hasn't changed her clothes any, but has cleaned up very well and at least doesn't smell of the fields. Guess she's chosen to obey her mother without actually obeying her, which is as good as you suppose things will ever get. Kinu gives the both of you a small bow. "Mom, [kinu.Dad]. They're just about waiting for us on the other side — you're just about ready, right?" |looks stunning as always, just as beautiful as her mother, if not more. She hasn't actually changed her clothes from her usual outfit, but certainly carries herself with much more poise and refinement than what she does in a casual setting — something which you might have thought wasn't possible given how she usually is, but she manages it nevertheless. Kinu gives the both of you a small bow. "Good morning, Mother, [kinu.Dad]. Everyone is ready to receive you on the other side, should you desire it." ] Kiyoko leans over and rubs her cheek on your shoulder affectionately. "Are you prepared, beloved?" You should be the one asking the question, not her. The way she's saying it, she's making it out to be your big day, not hers. Your fox-wife just laughs at that and takes your hand, dragging you after her through the torii gate. There's a faint sense of pressure on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], a sudden wrenching sensation that you really should've gotten used to by now, and then you're standing on the other side in the sacred gardens, Kinu following you soon after with a faint rush of displaced air by your side. Komari is waiting to receive you with Miko and Mai flanking her, and as Kiyoko steps forward the den matron removes her golden headpiece and bows deeply to her liege, receiving a brief nod in return. "We've been waiting for you, [silly |High Lady Ōtomo |Myōbu-Sama ]. Please, follow us. How gracious of you to be with us as well this day, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence |[pc.name] ]; I hope you participate as much as you are able in the proceedings." Your fox-wife tsks. "No need to stand on ceremony to simply greet us, Komari — save that for later. The last time I was at one of these, it was more than two centuries ago and an ocean away; I can only hope that you haven't changed the forms of the ceremony too much in the intervening time." "These traditions hardly ever change for there is no reason for them to, [silly |High Lady |Myōbu-Sama ]. If there's one thing you can safely rely on, it's them," Komari explains as she and her great-great-granddaughters form a triangle about the three of you, escorting you through the roots, upwards into the trunk and out onto one of the sacred tree's branches. Your little party stops at one of the side rooms, whereupon Miko pulls open the sliding door and gestures for you to enter with a bow. Kiyoko is first in, followed by you and Kinu, and then Komari and her great-great-granddaughters bring up the rear, shutting the door behind them. No kidding — everyone's already waiting for your arrival in the simply decorated room, sitting on their knees the way these foxes do atop comfy-looking cushions. As for who everyone is, you recognize several big names in the den — Kohaku and Nakano amongst them. Komari takes up her place at the head of the line with Kinu, while Miko brings up the rear; you can see that all the foxes in the chamber have been roughly ordered according to their seniority in the den hierarchy. Roughly being the keyword here — you're pretty sure Miko isn't at the bottom of the top, and she's just at the end of the line to be cheeky... So... this is the private ceremony, then, for the civil servants with a better pay grade. You'd have expected more lavish decorations, but as with much of kitsune aesthetic that you've seen in the colonies, there's beauty in simplicity, and it shows in the room. You took to your fox-wife at your side; she gives your hand a reassuring squeeze, then a gentle nudge to the side before sweeping forward, Mai trailing behind her. In that moment, Kiyoko's entire demeanor changes as easily as if she were changing her clothes — warm, gentle and approachable transforms into regal and imperious in every sense of the word. Her presence, the way she carries herself, even her walking gait and the sway of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails as she sweeps towards the dias with a dramatic billow of noble finery. As she takes up her rightful place upon a cushion at the head of the room, it's all you can do to [pc.ra kitsune |find the cushion that's clearly been set out for you next to Miko and try to do the whole sitting-on-your-knees-and-heels thing. It's not as uncomfortable as you might have imagined it to be, but you're not sure that you might be able to keep it up for hours, unused to it as you are. Maybe you should've practiced more... "Oh, hey, if'n it ain't yer [pc.mf |lord |lady ]ship. Didja get roped in by th' high lady?" You glance over at Miko. The vixen of a shrine maiden is perfectly still and on her best behavior... save for the corner of her mouth she's whispering out of. You kind of did... "Ain't nothin' f'r ya to worry yer head off 'bout. Jus' keep yer cool and do what done comes naturally." There are so many things one could say to that, few of them good, and that's probably precisely why Miko teased you about it. You look up and across the room at Kiyoko, who's started intoning a long, solemn speech in the kitsune mother tongue. While you don't understand any of the words, the gravity of her tone of voice is unmistakable, as is the reaction from almost everyone else in the ceremonial chamber. Then there's Miko, who looks as pleased as if she'd just eaten a ten-course meal all by her lonesome... Somehow, that just makes you all the more worried, which is precisely what she intended. |retreat to the side in order to watch the proceedings. No one glowers at you with silent disapproval, so you can only assume that you're doing something right. You look up and across the room at Kiyoko, who's started intoning a long, solemn speech in the kitsune mother tongue. While you don't understand any of the words, the gravity of her tone of voice is unmistakable, as is the reaction from almost everyone else in the ceremonial chamber. Then there's Miko, who looks as pleased as if she'd just eaten a ten-course meal all by her lonesome... ] "

rows.original: Then, it begins. While Kiyoko herself says several lines in that same melodic mother tongue, Mai busies herself brewing up some heavy-smelling tea with careful, ritualized motions — as if she were handling a holy treasure instead of just making a pot. Well, to be fair, who's to say that the tea set isn't a holy treasure? Might be, for all you know. You have absolutely no idea what your fox-wife is saying, but the gravitas of the words is distinct; there are some things which don't require understanding for comprehension, after all. At last, though, she ends, and the ceremony begins in earnest. Kinu is the first to go up before her mother — eyes lowered, head bowed, your fox-daughter stops a respectful distance from Kiyoko and waits to be told to approach. Kiyoko says something — presumably just that — and Kinu kneels before her mother as Mai approaches with the tea and serves the both of them before withdrawing. Mother and daughter look each other wordlessly in the eye, and then Kinu drinks first, followed by Kiyoko. It's all gone in but a few sips, and then at last, Kinu [kinu.isInari |sighs a little and removes her headscarf, allowing her ears to pop up freely. They twitch and shiver with excitement and unease alike, your daughter's emotions betraying themselves despite her calm exterior. Mai says several flowing phrases in the kitsune mother tongue, and Kinu leans forward, hands between her knees, head bowed in order to present herself for patting. Kneeling before her mother like this, she looks so different from her usual boisterous self, and even though you know that's not her you swear you can glimpse in that moment the shadow of who she might have been, were she not so adamantly opposed to her mother on the direction of her future. But here and now, there's no mistaking it: this is a ritual form of submission for kitsune.[pc.ra kitsune | You don't even have to think about it to instinctively understand what it is — like Kiyoko said, you know it in your bones. ] Kiyoko's face is completely blank and devoid of emotion as she reaches out and formally pats your daughter on her head, smoothing over each ear one by one before sliding her hand over to the back of Kinu's scalp. Your daughter is trying very, very hard not to fidget in place, but alas, even her self-control has its limits; it's not like she actually exercises it very much to begin with, does she? |gracefully bows her head and presents herself for patting. Despite you knowing how kitsune ears and tails have lives of their own, often independent of the person they're attached to, Kinu is a perfect picture of graceful serenity in all of this, the calm, undisturbed surface of a clear pond. She doesn't give off the sense that she's suppressing her emotions, either — kneeling before her mother, your fox-daughter radiates genuine joy and pleasantness, or at least if she's not feeling as much then it's a very, very good facsimile. But there's no reason to think otherwise than the simple fact that Kinu is just glad to be honored by her mother in this fashion... Mai says several flowing phrases in the kitsune mother tongue, and Kinu leans forward, hands between her knees as she edges closer to the dais; here and now, there's no mistaking it: this is a ritual form of submission for kitsune.[pc.ra kitsune | You don't even have to think about it to instinctively understand what it is — like Kiyoko said, you know it in your bones. ] Delicate and elegant, Kiyoko reaches out and plants the heel of her hand upon your daughter's forehead, fingers spreading out wide to smooth over each ear one by one; she repeats the motion several times before reaching over to work the back of Kinu's head with her fingers. While Kinu is perfectly still, the smile on her face is mirrored only by her mother's, both of them plain for all attending the ceremony to see. Liege and heir are harmonious and united in purpose, and their subjects had better remember that. ] [var0] Time stretches on in that blink of an eye as Kiyoko makes another pass over Kinu's head, fingers sinking into that silky white fur and hair, and then she finally withdraws her hand. Mai comes over with a wooden ladle of scented water and a basin for your fox-wife to rinse and dry her fingers in, and removes both cups from your fox-family before retreating. Both Kiyoko and Kinu say several more formal-sounding lines to each other, then the latter rises slowly to her feet, bows to her mother, and retreats without turning around. There's a small lull in the proceedings as Kinu returns to her place, and then it's Komari's turn to approach and do the same. The formal intonations of what's no doubt an oath of fealty, the serving of the tea, and finally, the patting of the head. You notice that the pot is small; for everyone who comes before Kiyoko to have their head patted, Mai has to go through the ritual of cleaning and cleansing the tea set, brewing another fresh batch of thick, bitter tea, then serving it all over again. Happily, there's adequate time for her to do so, given the not inconsiderable amount of time the ritual takes. One by one, the senior civil servants of the western imperial colonies present themselves to your fox-wife and pledge their loyalty to her; in turn, they receive her acceptance and acknowledgement. Nakano is clearly trying too hard while doing his best not to appear uncomfortable or embarrassed, while Kohaku is as energetic and pleasant as always, even in such a setting. Faces come and go — you think there must be a total of perhaps a dozen or so before [pc.ra kitsune |it's finally your turn to step up to the dais and give your fox-wife a little bow in the fashion that you've seen everyone do. No one is going to correct the champion of Keros, but that just means that you have to be doubly on your toes. Kiyoko just smiles, and bids for you to kneel before her and present yourself for patting. Sure, you can do that, but you don't know any of the words... "That is fine," your fox-wife whispers. "No one will fault you for it. And as for me, this is but a formality, for I have never once doubted your ultimate loyalty and devotion to me as I am to you, beloved. "Now then... the tea?" Mai comes up with her tray once more, and presents you both with your servings; it is as thick and bitter as it smells, leaving an aftertaste on your tongue that can only be described as melancholic. Nothing for it now; your breath catches in your throat as you force your gaze down towards the floorboards, the gazes of a dozen foxes burning expectantly into the back of your neck. Kiyoko's never been a demanding wife, but now more than ever you're distinctly self-conscious of the need to perform under pressure. For the briefest of moments, you feel the warmth of her palm at a distance, and then her fingers are upon you, pressing against your scalp and squeezing in a manner that can only be described as teasing, if not outright perverse. Such affection, and yet such grace. Touching your ears so shamelessly as if she owns them... which you have to admit, she does in a way. Your pulse throbs against your skull, concentrated against the pressure of Kiyoko's fingers, and it's a moment or two before you realize you've stopped breathing and have to consciously start again; you can feel your thoughts unwinding and being thrown into disarray, like a piece of fabric being pulled apart into its constituent threads... None of the others showed any signs of feeling anything like this — is this just because this body is still so new to you? "Mmm," Kiyoko whispers. "Just hold still, beloved, and allow me to accept your fealty. Is that not why you are here today, why you are here before me now? I have always known that I have had yours and you mine... but formalizing matters is always good, is it not?" You don't have an answer for Kiyoko as she moves from your scalp to your ears, smoothing out the fine hairs on the insides and rolling them outwards towards the tips before repeating it again. And again. And again. There's no doubt about it — she's teasing you at this point, making you hold on for as long as you can in front of all her other vassals. First the left ear, hooking her thumb into the concave and lavishing her love all over the insides while sweat beads on your forehead. When she deems that you're ready, Kiyoko starts sinking her thumb deeper and deeper into your ear canal, pushing further and further into that moist warmth even as she brushes lightly against the sensitive hairs on the inside, sending shivers of erotic delight coursing down your spine. Just when you think you're going to fall over from cotton-headedness, your fox-wife withdraws her thumb... only to start all over again on the other side. Oh, she's enjoying this, teasing you in front of everyone. That thumb, pushing in, rolling around and stimulating all the fine, sensitive hairs on the insides of your fox ears — the deep intimacy of toying with your weakest, most sensitive spots both inside and out even while her other fingers engage in a bit of light petting over the whole of your head is a gentle comfort. The soft flow of her fingers across your [pc.hair] makes you feel warm and good inside, and you have to bite back several moans when she hits several particularly sensuous spots. It feels like this is dragging on for far longer than it has for anyone else — maybe it's that Kiyoko is making a point to lavish more love and attention upon you before everyone else, or maybe it's just that your sense of time is completely shot at this point. At this point, you can feel your thoughts starting to dissolve into fluffy pink clouds. This is bad... or if you look at it from a different angle, this is really good. Sure, the sensations running through your skull at the moment are extremely addictive and you're not sure that, having tasted this bliss, you could ever do without it again. But then again, such bliss yearns, begs for you to drink deeply of the cup until you're stupefied and sated... as you have already, repeatedly, of your fox-wife's simple love. Kiyoko changes tack here, reaching around the backs of your ears where they join with your head and running her fingers along the seams, then pushing forward so they flatten against your head; it's in this manner that she pushes over and over again from base to tip, pressing down with her thumb upon the very point and rolling it in and out along the front and back — You've got to resist — [silly |you're not going to lose to headpats here |losing yourself in front of everyone here would be quite the show, to say the least ]. Even so, you can feel your will slipping away by degrees, and the only thing you can say about it is that Kiyoko really knows how to work those ears surreptitiously... ... And then it stops. With a final tousle of your [pc.hair], your beloved fox-wife gives each of your ears a final flick and withdraws her hand, giving you a teasing wink in the process. Everything proceeds as it has for all the others who've gone up before her, minus the words; you return the cups to Mai, retreat and give your fox-wife a loving bow, and then return to your place, your scalp still tingling from the affection that you've received. That was special, you are special, and Kiyoko had no hesitation in declaring that before everyone else. But with you dealt with, the private ceremony is over, for the most part |the ceremony finally ends ]. After several moments of everyone sitting in stock-still silence to allow the mood to settle, Kiyoko rises to her feet and sweeps past everyone to the exit, collecting you on the way. Kinu follows soon after, followed by Komari and Miko; everyone else remains as you step out into the sunlight and make your way to the square where all the branches of the cherry blossom tree join. So... is it over? "The private ceremony, yes," Komari replies with a small smile. "Now, it is time for anyone who wishes to publicly and formally swear fealty to the [silly |myōbu |high lady ] to do so." "They did not do this when I was younger," Kiyoko muses as you enter the plaza proper. "Certainly not in the capital, or my ancestral home. Theoretically, it was done, but even so..." "With all due respect, your mother's arm would have fallen off if she'd tried to pat the head of everyone in your immediate holdings, let alone the province. Here, though, with but a hundred families in the immediate area, it can be done. Given the nature of the people who are sent o the colonies, we are also more relaxed about these matters. Imagine this being the case when the wilderness was a lot larger, civilization was a lot smaller, and people were fewer in number. Such is the case, now mirrored again here." Komari turns to you and chuckles. "I'm sorry you had to sit through all that, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]but at least things will be a little less formal for you and your daughter from here on out. Just relax, enjoy yourself, and allow the rest of the day to flow by."
rows.translation: 然后，一切开始了。当清子用那种充满韵律的母语说出了几句话时，舞则开始用一系列小心翼翼、充满仪式感的动作来泡制这种香气浓重的茶——她对待这一过程，就像是在处理一件神圣的珍宝，而不仅仅是在煮一杯茶而已。嗯，公平地说，谁又能确定那个茶具不是一件珍贵的宝物呢？说不定真的就是呢。你根本不知道你的狐妖妻子在说什么，但她说的话确实带着一种严肃的气氛；毕竟，有些事情并不需要完全理解才能领会其中的含义。终于，仪式开始了。 纪久是第一个在母亲面前走上前的——她低垂着眼睛，低下头，这个被称为“狐妖女儿”的女孩在距离清子一段适当的距离外停下，等待着得到允许才上前。清子说了些什么——大概就是这些吧——然后小娟跪在母亲面前，这时舞端着茶走了过来，为她们两人倒了茶后便退了下去。母女俩无声地对视着，随后小娟先喝了茶，接着清子也喝了。才喝了几口，一切都消失了，终于，小娟[kinu.isInari |她轻轻叹了口气，摘下了头巾，让耳朵得以自由地露出来。那些耳朵因为兴奋与不安而不停地抽动着，你女儿的情绪虽然表面上看得很平静，但实际上已经暴露无遗了。 梅用狐族的语言说出了几句流畅的话语，小娟便向前倾身，双手交叠放在膝盖之间，低着头，准备让人抚摸她。以这样的姿势跪在母亲面前，她看起来与平时那个活泼好动的样子截然不同。尽管你知道那并不是她真正的样子，但在那一刻，你却仿佛能看到，如果她没有如此坚决地反对母亲为她的未来所制定的方向，她本来可能会成为什么样的人。但此刻，毫无疑问：这对于狐妖来说，是一种象征性臣服的仪式。[pc.ra kitsune | 你甚至无需思考，就能凭直觉理解它的含义——就像清子说的，这种感觉会深入你的骨髓。 ] 清子的脸上没有任何表情，她伸出手，正式地拍了拍你女儿的头部，逐一抚平她的两只耳朵，然后将手移到犬的后脑勺上。你的女儿在努力克制自己不要坐立不安，但可惜，就连她的自制力也有极限吧？毕竟她平时也并不经常锻炼这种能力，对吧？ |她优雅地低下头，任由人们轻拍她的头。尽管你早已知道狐耳狐尾往往有着自己的生命，它们的存在往往独立于它们所附着的主体，但小娟却完美地诠释了这种优雅与宁静——就像一片平静无波的清澈池塘表面一样，宁静而安详。她也没有表现出在压抑自己的情绪——当她跪在母亲面前时，这位“狐妖女儿”流露出的确实是真挚的喜悦与愉悦之情；至少，如果她并非真的有这样的感受，那她的表现也已经非常非常逼真了。但没有理由认为不是这样——事实上，小娟只是很高兴能得到母亲的这种认可而已…… 舞用狐族的语言说出了几句流畅的话语，小娟则向前倾身，双手交叠放在膝盖之间，慢慢靠近高台；此刻，再清楚不过了：这其实就是狐族的一种仪式性的臣服表达。[pc.ra kitsune | 你甚至无需思考，就能本能地理解它的含义——就像清子说的，这种感觉会深入你的骨髓。 ]精致而优雅，清子伸出手，将手掌的根部放在你女儿的额头上，手指微微张开，逐一抚平她两侧的耳朵；她重复了这个动作几次，随后又用手指轻轻按摩你女儿的后脑勺。 虽然小娟一动不动，但她脸上的笑容与她母亲的笑容如出一辙，在参加仪式的所有人眼中都清晰可见。君主与继承人之间的关系和谐融洽，目标也是一致的，他们的子民最好记住这一点。 ] [var0] 时间在转瞬即逝之中流逝——基约科又一次从纪奴的头顶上方伸出手，手指深深地陷入那柔软洁白的毛皮之中，最终才将手抽了回来。舞拿着一把木制勺子和一个盆子走了过来，让这位狐妖妻子用这些工具清洗并擦干手指，随后她将两个容器收走，便退了下去。清子与小娟互相说了几句听起来较为正式的话，随后小娟缓缓站起身来，向母亲鞠了一躬，然后头也不回地离开了。当小娟回到自己的位置后，场面暂时陷入了一片寂静，接着轮到麻里上前，做了同样的事情。那些无疑属于效忠誓言的正式用语、奉上茶水的动作，以及最后那轻拍头部的举动——你会注意到，那个茶壶其实很小。每当有人来到清子面前让她轻拍头部时，舞总是要先完成清洗茶具、重新泡制一大壶浓稠苦涩的茶，然后才能再将茶水端上来。幸运的是，考虑到这个仪式所需的时间相当长，她有足够的时间来完成这件事。 一个接一个，西方帝国殖民地的那些高级公务员们纷纷向你的狐妖妻子表示效忠，而她也接受了他们的忠诚与承诺。中野显然在竭力掩饰自己的不自在与尴尬，而琥珀则一如既往地充满活力、待人亲切，即便身处这样的场合也是如此。来来往往的人络绎不绝——你估计，大概有十几个人来过这里吧[pc.ra kitsune |终于轮到你了，走上舞台，按照大家的样子向你的狐狸妻子鞠个躬吧。没人会纠正凯罗斯的冠军，但这恰恰意味着你必须更加谨慎、更加小心。 清子只是微笑着，让你在她面前跪下，让她能够拍拍你的头。当然，你可以这么做，但你根本不知道该说些什么话…… 没关系，”你的狐狸妻子轻声说道，“没有人会因此责怪你。至于我，这只是一种形式而已，因为我从未怀疑过你对我的忠诚与奉献——就像我对你一样，亲爱的。 “那么……现在该喝茶了吧？ 梅再次端上来她的托盘，为你们两人分别送上食物；那食物的味道确实如它的气味般浓烈而苦涩，留在舌尖的余味只能用“忧郁”来形容。此刻，你们简直无话可说——当你们被迫将目光转向地板时，仿佛有十几只狐狸的视线正满怀期待地盯着你们的后颈。 清子从来都不是一个苛刻的妻子，但此刻，你比以往任何时候都更加意识到自己必须在压力下表现出色。有那么一瞬间，你仿佛感受到了她手掌传来的温暖，紧接着她的手指就触到了你的头皮，开始轻轻挤压你，那种动作简直可以用“调戏”来形容，甚至可以说是有些变态。 如此深情，却又如此优雅。她如此毫无顾忌地触碰着你的耳朵，仿佛那些耳朵真正属于她……你必须承认，从某种意义上来说，确实如此。你的脉搏在颅骨中剧烈跳动，完全被清子的手指所压制；过了一两秒钟，你才意识到自己已经停止了呼吸，不得不有意识地重新开始呼吸。你能感觉到自己的思绪正在逐渐混乱，就像一块布料被撕成了无数的细线…… 其他人都没有任何表现出这种感觉的迹象——难道只是因为这个身体对你来说还太陌生吗？ “嗯，”清子轻声说道，“ 别动，我的挚爱，让我接受你的忠诚。你今天来到这里、此刻跪在我面前，不正是为了这个吗？我一直都知道你属于我，而我也属于你……但把这一切正式确定下来，总归是件好事，不是吗？ 当清子从你的头皮移动到你的耳朵，轻轻抚平耳内的细软毛发，再将它们向外卷曲至耳尖时，你确实找不到任何回应她的办法。毫无疑问，她此刻正在戏弄你，逼你在所有她的下属面前尽可能长时间地忍耐下去。 首先，她用拇指勾住你的左耳耳洞，将爱意倾注到那里，与此同时，你的额头上也会冒出汗珠。当她认为你已经准备好了，清子就会将拇指逐渐深入你的耳道，不断向里面推进，同时轻轻触碰耳道内部的敏感毛发，这种刺激会让你感到一阵阵令人愉悦的颤栗。就在你以为自己要被这种愚蠢的行为搞得晕头转向的时候，你的狐狸妻子却收回了她的拇指……然后又在另一边重新开始这一系列动作。 哦，她简直乐在其中，在所有人面前逗弄你。那个拇指不断按压、滚动，刺激着你耳廓内部那些细腻而敏感的毛发——这种触碰既触及了你身体最脆弱、最敏感的部位，同时又用她的其他手指轻柔地抚摸着你的整个头部，这种亲密的感觉实在令人感到无比舒适。她的手指在你身上轻轻滑动[pc.hair]这会让你感到内心温暖而愉悦，当她触碰到那些特别敏感的部位时，你甚至不得不强忍住几声呻吟。这种感觉似乎比对其他人来说要持续得更久——也许是因为清子特意在你之前给予你更多的关爱与关注，又或许只是因为此时你的时间感已经完全混乱了。 到了这个时候，你就可以感受你的思绪开始化作蓬松的粉色云朵。这有点糟糕……不过换个角度看，这也挺不错的。当然，此刻在你脑海中涌现的这些感觉确实令人上瘾，你甚至不确定，一旦体验到了这种幸福，是否还能再回到从前。不过，话说回来，这样的幸福，其实也是人们所渴望的啊。恳求为了让你们能够尽情地品尝这份美妙，直到沉醉其中、心满意足……就像你们已经多次体验过你们那位狐妖妻子那份纯真的爱一样。 此时，清子改变了手法，她将手指伸到你们的耳朵后方，沿着耳朵与头部的连接处轻轻滑动，然后把手指向前推，让它们紧贴在你们的头上；她就这样一遍又一遍地重复这个动作，从耳根一直按摩到耳尖，同时用拇指按压那个关键的位置，再沿着耳朵的前后方向轻轻滑动…… 你必须抵制—— [silly |你在这里绝对不会输给这些简单的操作或简单的触摸动作。 |至少可以说，在这么多人面前放纵自己，绝对会是一场相当“精彩”的表演。 ]即便如此，你还是会逐渐感觉到自己的意志正在慢慢消逝，而对此你唯一能想到的就是——清子确实非常擅长巧妙地运用那些手段…… ……然后，这一切突然停止了。在最后一次轻轻拨弄之后[pc.hair]你心爱的狐妖妻子轻轻弹了弹你的每一只耳朵，然后收回手，同时朝你眨了眨戏弄的眼神。一切过程都和之前那些人一样，只不过没有那些话语而已；你把杯子还给舞，退后一步，向你的狐妖妻子深情地鞠了一躬，然后回到自己的位置上，头皮上仍带着她给予你的那份关爱而微微发麻。那一刻，真的非常特别。你这些仪式都是特别的，而清子毫不犹豫地在所有人面前这样宣布。不过，一旦与你完成了这些私密的仪式，那么大部分来说，这一切就都结束了。 |仪式终于结束了。 ]在所有人都静静地坐着，让气氛慢慢沉淀下来之后，清子站了起来，从大家身边走过，朝着出口走去，途中还叫上了你。不久之后，小娟也跟了上来，接着是麻里和米可；而其他人都留在了原地。当你走出门，走进阳光下，朝着那棵樱花树的所有枝条汇聚在一起的地方走去时，他们依然留在那里。 那么……一切都结束了吗？ “私下的仪式已经结束了，”麻里带着一丝微笑回答道，“现在，愿意公开、正式地宣誓效忠于[silly |命妇 |领主夫人 ]的人，就可以上前了。”“我年轻时可没有这种仪式，”当你走进广场时，清子若有所思地说道，“在首都，或者我的故乡，肯定没有这种习俗。理论上来说，可能是有的，但即便如此……恕我直言，如果您母亲试图抚摸您所在地区所有人的头，她的手臂恐怕都会摔下来，更不用说整个省份的人了。不过在这里，由于周边只有大约一百户家庭，这样做还是可行的。考虑到被派往殖民地的人们的身份背景，我们在这些事情上也更加放松了。试想，在那个时候，荒野的范围要广阔得多，文明的发展程度要低得多，人口数量也少得多，情况就会是另外一番样子了。情况就是如此，现在在这里又一次得到了印证。”麻里转向你，轻笑着说道，“真抱歉让你不得不听完这一切。 [pc.ra kitsune |阁下， ]但从现在开始，对你和你的女儿来说，事情会变得不那么正式了。放松吧，尽情享受这段时光，让剩下的时间自然地流逝吧。
rows.raw: " Then, it begins. While Kiyoko herself says several lines in that same melodic mother tongue, Mai busies herself brewing up some heavy-smelling tea with careful, ritualized motions — as if she were handling a holy treasure instead of just making a pot. Well, to be fair, who's to say that the tea set isn't a holy treasure? Might be, for all you know. You have absolutely no idea what your fox-wife is saying, but the gravitas of the words is distinct; there are some things which don't require understanding for comprehension, after all. At last, though, she ends, and the ceremony begins in earnest. Kinu is the first to go up before her mother — eyes lowered, head bowed, your fox-daughter stops a respectful distance from Kiyoko and waits to be told to approach. Kiyoko says something — presumably just that — and Kinu kneels before her mother as Mai approaches with the tea and serves the both of them before withdrawing. Mother and daughter look each other wordlessly in the eye, and then Kinu drinks first, followed by Kiyoko. It's all gone in but a few sips, and then at last, Kinu [kinu.isInari |sighs a little and removes her headscarf, allowing her ears to pop up freely. They twitch and shiver with excitement and unease alike, your daughter's emotions betraying themselves despite her calm exterior. Mai says several flowing phrases in the kitsune mother tongue, and Kinu leans forward, hands between her knees, head bowed in order to present herself for patting. Kneeling before her mother like this, she looks so different from her usual boisterous self, and even though you know that's not her you swear you can glimpse in that moment the shadow of who she might have been, were she not so adamantly opposed to her mother on the direction of her future. But here and now, there's no mistaking it: this is a ritual form of submission for kitsune.[pc.ra kitsune | You don't even have to think about it to instinctively understand what it is — like Kiyoko said, you know it in your bones. ] Kiyoko's face is completely blank and devoid of emotion as she reaches out and formally pats your daughter on her head, smoothing over each ear one by one before sliding her hand over to the back of Kinu's scalp. Your daughter is trying very, very hard not to fidget in place, but alas, even her self-control has its limits; it's not like she actually exercises it very much to begin with, does she? |gracefully bows her head and presents herself for patting. Despite you knowing how kitsune ears and tails have lives of their own, often independent of the person they're attached to, Kinu is a perfect picture of graceful serenity in all of this, the calm, undisturbed surface of a clear pond. She doesn't give off the sense that she's suppressing her emotions, either — kneeling before her mother, your fox-daughter radiates genuine joy and pleasantness, or at least if she's not feeling as much then it's a very, very good facsimile. But there's no reason to think otherwise than the simple fact that Kinu is just glad to be honored by her mother in this fashion... Mai says several flowing phrases in the kitsune mother tongue, and Kinu leans forward, hands between her knees as she edges closer to the dais; here and now, there's no mistaking it: this is a ritual form of submission for kitsune.[pc.ra kitsune | You don't even have to think about it to instinctively understand what it is — like Kiyoko said, you know it in your bones. ] Delicate and elegant, Kiyoko reaches out and plants the heel of her hand upon your daughter's forehead, fingers spreading out wide to smooth over each ear one by one; she repeats the motion several times before reaching over to work the back of Kinu's head with her fingers. While Kinu is perfectly still, the smile on her face is mirrored only by her mother's, both of them plain for all attending the ceremony to see. Liege and heir are harmonious and united in purpose, and their subjects had better remember that. ] [var0] Time stretches on in that blink of an eye as Kiyoko makes another pass over Kinu's head, fingers sinking into that silky white fur and hair, and then she finally withdraws her hand. Mai comes over with a wooden ladle of scented water and a basin for your fox-wife to rinse and dry her fingers in, and removes both cups from your fox-family before retreating. Both Kiyoko and Kinu say several more formal-sounding lines to each other, then the latter rises slowly to her feet, bows to her mother, and retreats without turning around. There's a small lull in the proceedings as Kinu returns to her place, and then it's Komari's turn to approach and do the same. The formal intonations of what's no doubt an oath of fealty, the serving of the tea, and finally, the patting of the head. You notice that the pot is small; for everyone who comes before Kiyoko to have their head patted, Mai has to go through the ritual of cleaning and cleansing the tea set, brewing another fresh batch of thick, bitter tea, then serving it all over again. Happily, there's adequate time for her to do so, given the not inconsiderable amount of time the ritual takes. One by one, the senior civil servants of the western imperial colonies present themselves to your fox-wife and pledge their loyalty to her; in turn, they receive her acceptance and acknowledgement. Nakano is clearly trying too hard while doing his best not to appear uncomfortable or embarrassed, while Kohaku is as energetic and pleasant as always, even in such a setting. Faces come and go — you think there must be a total of perhaps a dozen or so before [pc.ra kitsune |it's finally your turn to step up to the dais and give your fox-wife a little bow in the fashion that you've seen everyone do. No one is going to correct the champion of Keros, but that just means that you have to be doubly on your toes. Kiyoko just smiles, and bids for you to kneel before her and present yourself for patting. Sure, you can do that, but you don't know any of the words... "That is fine," your fox-wife whispers. "No one will fault you for it. And as for me, this is but a formality, for I have never once doubted your ultimate loyalty and devotion to me as I am to you, beloved. "Now then... the tea?" Mai comes up with her tray once more, and presents you both with your servings; it is as thick and bitter as it smells, leaving an aftertaste on your tongue that can only be described as melancholic. Nothing for it now; your breath catches in your throat as you force your gaze down towards the floorboards, the gazes of a dozen foxes burning expectantly into the back of your neck. Kiyoko's never been a demanding wife, but now more than ever you're distinctly self-conscious of the need to perform under pressure. For the briefest of moments, you feel the warmth of her palm at a distance, and then her fingers are upon you, pressing against your scalp and squeezing in a manner that can only be described as teasing, if not outright perverse. Such affection, and yet such grace. Touching your ears so shamelessly as if she owns them... which you have to admit, she does in a way. Your pulse throbs against your skull, concentrated against the pressure of Kiyoko's fingers, and it's a moment or two before you realize you've stopped breathing and have to consciously start again; you can feel your thoughts unwinding and being thrown into disarray, like a piece of fabric being pulled apart into its constituent threads... None of the others showed any signs of feeling anything like this — is this just because this body is still so new to you? "Mmm," Kiyoko whispers. "Just hold still, beloved, and allow me to accept your fealty. Is that not why you are here today, why you are here before me now? I have always known that I have had yours and you mine... but formalizing matters is always good, is it not?" You don't have an answer for Kiyoko as she moves from your scalp to your ears, smoothing out the fine hairs on the insides and rolling them outwards towards the tips before repeating it again. And again. And again. There's no doubt about it — she's teasing you at this point, making you hold on for as long as you can in front of all her other vassals. First the left ear, hooking her thumb into the concave and lavishing her love all over the insides while sweat beads on your forehead. When she deems that you're ready, Kiyoko starts sinking her thumb deeper and deeper into your ear canal, pushing further and further into that moist warmth even as she brushes lightly against the sensitive hairs on the inside, sending shivers of erotic delight coursing down your spine. Just when you think you're going to fall over from cotton-headedness, your fox-wife withdraws her thumb... only to start all over again on the other side. Oh, she's enjoying this, teasing you in front of everyone. That thumb, pushing in, rolling around and stimulating all the fine, sensitive hairs on the insides of your fox ears — the deep intimacy of toying with your weakest, most sensitive spots both inside and out even while her other fingers engage in a bit of light petting over the whole of your head is a gentle comfort. The soft flow of her fingers across your [pc.hair] makes you feel warm and good inside, and you have to bite back several moans when she hits several particularly sensuous spots. It feels like this is dragging on for far longer than it has for anyone else — maybe it's that Kiyoko is making a point to lavish more love and attention upon you before everyone else, or maybe it's just that your sense of time is completely shot at this point. At this point, you can feel your thoughts starting to dissolve into fluffy pink clouds. This is bad... or if you look at it from a different angle, this is really good. Sure, the sensations running through your skull at the moment are extremely addictive and you're not sure that, having tasted this bliss, you could ever do without it again. But then again, such bliss yearns, begs for you to drink deeply of the cup until you're stupefied and sated... as you have already, repeatedly, of your fox-wife's simple love. Kiyoko changes tack here, reaching around the backs of your ears where they join with your head and running her fingers along the seams, then pushing forward so they flatten against your head; it's in this manner that she pushes over and over again from base to tip, pressing down with her thumb upon the very point and rolling it in and out along the front and back — You've got to resist — [silly |you're not going to lose to headpats here |losing yourself in front of everyone here would be quite the show, to say the least ]. Even so, you can feel your will slipping away by degrees, and the only thing you can say about it is that Kiyoko really knows how to work those ears surreptitiously... ... And then it stops. With a final tousle of your [pc.hair], your beloved fox-wife gives each of your ears a final flick and withdraws her hand, giving you a teasing wink in the process. Everything proceeds as it has for all the others who've gone up before her, minus the words; you return the cups to Mai, retreat and give your fox-wife a loving bow, and then return to your place, your scalp still tingling from the affection that you've received. That was special, you are special, and Kiyoko had no hesitation in declaring that before everyone else. But with you dealt with, the private ceremony is over, for the most part |the ceremony finally ends ]. After several moments of everyone sitting in stock-still silence to allow the mood to settle, Kiyoko rises to her feet and sweeps past everyone to the exit, collecting you on the way. Kinu follows soon after, followed by Komari and Miko; everyone else remains as you step out into the sunlight and make your way to the square where all the branches of the cherry blossom tree join. So... is it over? "The private ceremony, yes," Komari replies with a small smile. "Now, it is time for anyone who wishes to publicly and formally swear fealty to the [silly |myōbu |high lady ] to do so." "They did not do this when I was younger," Kiyoko muses as you enter the plaza proper. "Certainly not in the capital, or my ancestral home. Theoretically, it was done, but even so..." "With all due respect, your mother's arm would have fallen off if she'd tried to pat the head of everyone in your immediate holdings, let alone the province. Here, though, with but a hundred families in the immediate area, it can be done. Given the nature of the people who are sent o the colonies, we are also more relaxed about these matters. Imagine this being the case when the wilderness was a lot larger, civilization was a lot smaller, and people were fewer in number. Such is the case, now mirrored again here." Komari turns to you and chuckles. "I'm sorry you had to sit through all that, [pc.ra kitsune |your Eminence, ]but at least things will be a little less formal for you and your daughter from here on out. Just relax, enjoy yourself, and allow the rest of the day to flow by." "

rows.original: And indeed it does. While refreshments are brought up for you and Kinu, the two of you sit by the edge of the plaza atop one of the higher branches, having found a bench under the shade of one of the bed-sized leaves. Below you, Kiyoko deals with a seemingly endless queue of foxen who come up to her and have their heads patted — this public ceremony is indeed a lot quicker for each individual, with only a few words spoken and a couple formal pats on the head before the next one comes in for the cycle to repeat itself all over again. Even so, there are a lot of people, and you understand why Kiyoko expected this to take all day. Beside you, Kinu [kinu.isInari |has a shallow bowl piled high with crunchy pickled turnip cubes in her lap. You can smell the vinegar from over here, but that doesn't seem to bother your fox-daughter in the least as she grazes on them one by one without so much as thinking about it. It's wholesome food, one imagines, but certainly not something you'd thoughtlessly eat as a snack like what she's doing, judging from the rather unique smell. Her mother looks like she's having fun down there, isn't she? Kinu doesn't even stop munching to speak to you. "I dunno, [kinu.Dad]. Mom always hides her emotions so well when she puts on her public face like this, so it's anyone's guess as to whether she's enjoying it or not." [pc.isChamp |Hey, you know you're more permissive than her mother, but even up here it's usually polite to not talk with one's mouth full. Kinu shrugs and makes a show of swallowing in the most exaggerated fashion. "Sure thing, [kinu.Dad]." Now, what was she about to say? |Looks like a duck, walks like a duck, quacks like a duck, may as well be a duck. Until something happens to disprove it, as far as you can tell her mother is enjoying herself. ] "I honestly don't know, [kinu.Dad]. Just look at her like that. It's no way to live, lying to yourself every day. Maybe it's just your blood inside of me speaking, but I wouldn't be able to take it, not being plain about feeling how I feel. I want people to know if I'm angry or sad or just plain bored and act accordingly. And yeah, I know I'm badmouthing my mother behind her back, but it's not like I'm saying anything she doesn't know already." You look down at Kiyoko in the plaza amidst the breeze and decorations, busily patting people on the head while Miko and Mai usher the line forward one by one. She does know that someday, that's going to be her down there, right? Kinu bites down on another cube of pickled turnip with an audible crunch. "Yeah, sure, someday. But not today. And when that someday comes, I want people to smile at me when they swear their fealty to me, and be genuine about it instead keeping a straight face or doing so because it's expected of them. If they're not happy about it, I want them to show it." ...Is that because she really wants them to be honest with themselves, or because she's terrible at reading people beneath the masks we all wear when out in society? "Harsh, [kinu.Dad]." Harsh. But is it true? "I'm not gonna say yes or no to that one." Because it'll be plain on her face if she tries to lie. Your daughter's simple like that, and it's one of the reasons you love her. "Sheesh, [kinu.Dad]. I just want to live a simple life... or as simple as the circumstances of my birth will allow. Which isn't very much so, but I've learned to come to terms with it and deal with the lot as little as I can. "Which is kind of the point. I know why Mom abdicated her position in the succession, [kinu.Dad]. If I'm seen as ambitionless, content to live a simple life in a backwater where all the unwanted trash of society is sent... no one will ever think of me as a threat. No one will ever think of the colonies as a threat. We can just be left alone and keep on sending back the excess stuff, and people will leave us alone." She really does believe that, doesn't she? Even as what her mother's doing right now could be considered by the paranoid as consolidating the colonies into her own power base? "Yes. Those who were going to think that way were going to be paranoid anyway, [kinu.Dad]. As far as I understand what Mom's told me, there are always going to be those across the ocean who distrust us. But screw those people and what they think; so long as they aren't in any kind of position to anything about us, I couldn't care less." The shallow bowl of pickles is just about empty now; Kinu looks a little wistful, then sighs and leans in against you. "Thanks for hearing me out, [kinu.Dad]. Sometimes I feel like I can talk to you in ways that I can't with Mom — something that should be really obvious, but at the same time it's also something that I find myself being surprised by no matter how often it happens." |has a skewer of three round bite-sized dumplings on a stick, colored pink, green and white; you can smell the sweet glaze they have from over here, but your fox-daughter in the least as she daintily bites them one by one without so much as thinking about it. It's as wholesome as snack food can get, one imagines, but certainly not something you'd thoughtlessly eat as a snack like what she's doing, judging from the rather unique scent. Her mother looks like she's having fun down there, isn't she? Kinu sets her dumplings aside while she speaks. "She is. I am quite impressed that you can read her despite her putting on her public face, [kinu.Dad]. Although given how close the two of you are and always have been, that should not come as a surprise. I can only hope to be as intimate with my future husband as the two of you are, although that is not needed to read him or anyone else, for that matter." You look down at Kiyoko in the plaza amidst the breeze and decorations, busily patting people on the head while Miko and Mai usher the line forward one by one. She does know that someday, that's going to be her down there, right? "I have known that all my life, [kinu.Dad]. Consider that here and now, in this place and at this time, my entire purpose is to be trained and brought up in a fashion such that I may properly administer the Western Imperial Colonies with my future retainers at my side..." That would presumably be Miko and Mai, then. "...Which would be amongst, but not limited to them, yes. If Mother had not been present to administer headpats in both the private and public ceremonies, then I would have — and was fully prepared to — take her place if need be. But since she is here and so are you, [kinu.Dad], such a measure is unnecessary, for which I am glad." Glad that the both of you are here, or glad that the ceremony is proceeding as it ought to be? "Both." Kinu takes a dainty bite out of the middle of the three colored dumplings. "The day will come soon enough, but it is not today that I will sit under the shade of the leaves and receive the adoration of my people. And when that someday comes, I will see their smiles, hear their words, and trust my intuition to tell which are the most genuine of them all. Realistically speaking, I cannot expect to always be wholly, genuinely and unconditionally loved — if that were the case, all my subjects may as well be an army of the artificer's wooden puppets. I do not allow the perfect to be the enemy of the good. Some small disagreement and contentiousness in the right place and at the right time can be helpful, but you will never hear anyone across the ocean say it." Maybe it's that foreign blood in her speaking. "Perhaps, [kinu.Dad]. Of course, there is no way to be sure, but we cannot be certain about many things that are nevertheless pleasant even if they are fantasies, can we?" ... Kinu sighs and leans against you, your fox-daughter placing her head on your shoulder. "This is a pleasant enough sight, is it not? Mother down there, patting the heads of anyone who wants to be patted, acknowledging them one by one." It is. "And yet such an innocuous act might be seen as her consolidating the colonies into her own power base. Perhaps it would be easier to be ambitionless, content to live a simple life in a backwater where all the unwanted trash of society is sent... no one will ever think of me as a threat. No one will ever think of the colonies as a threat. We can just be left alone and keep on fulfilling the quotas... and yet the inevitable will happen. "But it will not be in your lifetime, [kinu.Dad], nor even mine. Yet it will be my task to consider these matters, matters which will have no impact upon my life, but potentially deeply imperil the lives of my descendants. Just as Mother was already considering my future while I was still growing within her womb..." Come now, this day is supposed to be a happy one. Look at Kiyoko down there, she's beaming and having the time of her life — sure, one might be tempted to think that she's merely smiling because her position demands it of her, but you know that she really does like getting close to her own subjects, and by everything you've heard of your fox-daughter through the rumor mill, she takes after her mother in this respect. Kinu says nothing for a little bit, contemplating your words. Then, she yawns her mouth wide and sticks the entire skewer of dumplings down her throat, closing her lips about the bottom in a frankly comical yet disturbing manner; with a sharp yank, she pulls the dumplings of the skewer with a flourish, and swallows. Gods, how did she not choke from that? Pulling the empty wooden skewer and giving it a careful lick, Kinu sets it down on a plate atop the bench and hums pleasantly. "Thank you for taking the time to listen to me speak today, [kinu.Dad]. While we can speak any time we like, it is still not that often that the atmosphere, circumstances and event lend themselves to the natural discussion of several topics." ] The public ceremony drags on for several more hours, with short breaks every now and then for Kiyoko to rest her arm and take refreshments. The afternoon flows by, the rustle of the breeze in the leaves of the sacred tree ever-present, and then as the light starts to turn golden and the sun nears the horizon your fox-wife finally dispenses her last headpat with poised grace. Hm? Kinu isn't by your side — you must've dozed off sometime before then, although you don't remember falling asleep. No doubt off to see her squeeze like always... but then that just means you'll get to spend all the time you want with Kiyoko. Dusting off her hands, your fox-wife finally dismisses a completely nonplussed Mai, picks herself up, then makes her way through the tree and up the branches to finally end up by your side. "Thank you for waiting for me, beloved." Oh, she was doing all the hard parts. All you had to do was to watch from up here and give what moral support you could from such a distance. Oh, right — Kinu wandered off on her own, which means that the both of you probably don't have to wait for her to go home. Is she feeling fine? She was there for literally hours just patting the head of person after person... "I shall have to treat my arm well for the next day or so, but it is not anything I didn't expect from officiating the ceremony," Kiyoko replies with a small dip of her head. Pleasant as always, even when tired; your fox-wife makes a show of falling into your embrace, pushing her body against yours and curling her tails about your legs and thighs in a display of unabashed affection.[kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 | The gentle yet hard roundness of her burgeoning womb and turgid breasts is only make all the more prominent by the warmth of her skin and fur | The full dome of her prominently pregnant belly and mounds of her overfull, milky racks is only made all the more prominent by the warmth of her skin and fur, and the quickening of the kit you put inside of her ]. Kiyoko leans in to give you a little nuzzle on the side of your neck, leaving her scent all over you before finally withdrawing. Hah, even when exhausted, she does know how to make an impression, doesn't she?[pc.ra kitsune | And speaking of leaving impressions, what she did at the private ceremony this morning... A giggle. "Ehehe. I am so sorry... but I could not help but tease you, beloved. Then again, I could not help but tease everyone to some degree, [kinu.isInari |my dear consort |our future son-in-law ] included. Ah, ah, such a terrible failure of mine to exercise self-restraint. Imagine what could have happened had you or I allowed ourselves to go just that bit further in our mischief." Ourselves? [silly |Who is this %"ourselves", kemosabe? |Now she's dragging you along into her mischief, isn't she? ] "All is well, and that is what matters." Kiyoko graces you with another little kiss. "You will come to understand in due time. Like I said before, you will know it in your bones." Gods, what have you signed up for? An eternity of orgasmic headpats? Well, when one puts it that way... maybe it isn't so bad at all. But maybe not in public... just maybe. ] Where's Kinu? You were with her earlier, but your daughter must've left when you dozed off. "Ah, no doubt she is with her lover, doing the things young people do in such situations." Kiyoko purses her lips to let the moment sink in, then continues. "You know, beloved. Naughty, degenerate acts that you and I have indulged in before, such as holding hands and whispering sweet nothings to each other. I do not think that she will be returning with us tonight, so perhaps we should be off ourselves." And she's fine with that? "They are engaged, after all." Well, she knows these things better than you do. Home it is, then. "Yes. Home." Your fox-wife withdraws, takes her hand in yours, and then leads you back through the torii gate and back home. The two of you head back down the path together, into Kiyoko's little shrine, and as you're washing up and getting ready for bed your kitsune wife turns to you. "And what about you, beloved? Did you enjoy yourself today?[pc.ra kitsune | Perhaps my patting of your head was a little more vigorous than was strictly necessary?" Mmm, she's still bringing that up? Now that the two of you are alone, maybe it's time you pat her on the head... you need to pay her back for her gracious and lavish attention earlier this morning, after all. |" It was definitely worth it coming out with her today. Having a faithful fox-wife who's liked by everyone, seeing her acknowledged by everyone... ah, it makes your heart swell with pride to be so lucky as to be intimate with someone as lovely as her. But then again, she already knew that, right? ] "Ehehe. But I suppose I am quite fetching. All right, then." She pats the empty spot on the futon beside her. "Come and sleep, beloved. Today has been a time for rest and relaxation, and tomorrow the world awaits us once more..."
rows.translation: 确实如此。当有人为大家和小娟准备点心时，你们俩便坐在广场边缘的一根较高的树枝上，找了一处被巨大的树叶遮住的长椅休息。在你们下方，清子正在接待那一队似乎永无止境的狐妖们——它们一个个前来，她只是轻轻拍拍它们的头。这种公开的仪式对每一只狐妖来说确实都非常快捷：只需说几句话，轻轻拍几下头，下一只狐妖就会前来，整个过程不断重复。即便如此，还是存在一些很多有那么多人参与其中，你也明白为什么清子预计这件事会花上一整天的时间了。 站在你身边的，是纪努。 [kinu.isInari |她的腿上放着一个浅碗，里面堆满了酥脆的腌萝卜丁。从这里就能闻到醋的味道，但这对你的狐狸女儿似乎丝毫没有影响——她一边若无其事地一颗一颗地吃着这些萝卜丁，一边甚至都没有多想什么。这种食物看起来应该是健康营养的，但根据那股相当独特的气味来看，肯定不是那种可以随意当作零食来吃的东西。 她的妈妈看起来在下面玩得很开心，对吧？ 小娟甚至都没有停下来咀嚼，就直接跟你说话了：“我不知道[kinu.Dad]妈妈每次戴上这种公众形象时，总是能把自己的情绪隐藏得非常好，所以根本没人能猜得出她是否真的喜欢这样做。 [pc.isChamp |嘿，你知道你比她妈妈还要随和吧，但就算在这里，边吃饭边说话通常也是不礼貌的。” 小娟耸了耸肩，然后夸张地做了一个吞咽的动作，说道：“当然啦。[kinu.Dad]现在，她究竟要说什么呢？ |看起来像鸭子，走路像鸭子，叫起来也像鸭子，那它其实就是鸭子吧。除非有事情发生来证明 otherwise，否则从表面上看，它的妈妈应该过得挺开心吧。 ] 说实话，我真的不知道。[kinu.Dad]你就这么看着她吧。每天都在自欺欺人，这样的生活根本不行。也许这只是我体内流淌着的你的血液在说话，但我真的无法忍受——不能不把自己的真实感受说出来。我希望人们能够知道我是生气了、难过，还是只是感到无聊，然后据此做出相应的反应。是啊，我知道我在背后批评我的母亲，但我说的一些话，她本来就已经知道了。 在广场上，微风轻拂，装饰品点缀其间，你低头看着纪代子——她正忙着轻拍人们的头，而米可与舞则一个接一个地引导着队伍向前移动。她心里很清楚，总有一天，那将会成为她的归宿，对吧？ 小娟咬下一块腌萝卜，发出清脆的声响。“是啊，总有一天会那样的。但不是今天。当那一天真正来临时，我希望人们在我面前宣誓效忠时，能够露出笑容，而且是发自内心的笑容，而不是因为别人期望他们这样做而强颜欢笑。如果他们对此并不感到高兴，我也希望他们能够表现出来。……这是因为她真的希望人们能够对自己保持诚实，还是因为她根本不擅长看透我们在社交场合所戴上的那些面具背后的真实面目呢？ 残酷[kinu.Dad]严厉吧……但这是真的吗？” “对于这个问题，我没法给出肯定的回答，也不能给出否定的回答。” 因为如果她试图撒谎，她的表情会立刻暴露出来。你的女儿就是这么单纯，而这也正是你喜欢她的原因之一。 “哎呀[kinu.Dad]这正是我想表达的。我知道妈妈为什么放弃了继承权[kinu.Dad]如果人们认为我缺乏野心，满足于在社会的边缘地区过简单的生活，把那些社会不需要的垃圾都送到那里去……那么就没人会把我视为威胁，也不会把那些殖民地视为威胁。我们就可以被放任不管，继续把那些多余的物品送回去，而人们也不会有什么意见。别打扰我们。她真的是这么认为的，对吧？尽管她母亲现在的所作所为，在那些多疑的人看来，很可能是在将那些殖民地纳入自己的势力范围之中。是的。那些会这么想的人，反正也会变得多疑起来。[kinu.Dad]据妈妈告诉我的，海外总会有那些不信任我们的人。但去他们的吧，他们怎么想都无所谓；只要他们没有能力对我们产生任何影响，我根本不在乎。 那个装着腌菜的浅碗现在差不多空了；小娟看起来有点伤感，然后叹了口气，靠在你身上说道：“谢谢你听我倾诉。[kinu.Dad]有时候，我觉得我可以用一些和妈妈不一样的方式来和你交流——这种感觉本应是很自然的，但无论如何，每次遇到这种情况时，我都会感到有些惊讶。 |有一根棍子上串着三个圆形的小饺子，颜色分别是粉色、绿色和白色；从这里就能闻到它们身上那甜美的糖浆味，而你的狐妖女儿却若无其事地一个一个地咬着它们，丝毫不在意。可以想象，这种食物应该算是非常健康、适合当零食吃了，但从那独特的香味来看，显然不是那种可以随意当作零食来吃的食品。 她的妈妈看起来在那里玩得很开心，对吧？ 小娟一边说话，一边把饺子放在一边。“她确实是这样。你能看穿她的伪装，实在让我印象深刻。[kinu.Dad]虽然你们两个关系一直都很亲密，所以这件事也不应该让人感到意外。我只希望能和未来的丈夫建立起像你们俩那样的亲密关系，不过其实，这对于了解他或者其他人来说，并不是必需的。在微风与装饰品的环绕中，你俯视着广场上的清子——她正忙着轻拍人们的头，而米可与舞则一个接一个地引导着队伍前进。她心里肯定明白，总有一天，自己也会处在她的位置上，对吧？ 我一生都明白这一点。[kinu.Dad]请相信，在此刻、在这个地方，我的唯一目的就是接受训练，以便将来能够在我的亲信们的协助下，妥善管理西境帝国殖民地。那么，应该就是米可与舞吧。” “……没错，除了她们之外，还有其他人也可能承担这个责任。如果母亲没有在那些公开或私下的场合亲自安抚她们，那么如果有需要的话，我完全愿意——也确实做好了准备——来代替她。但既然她在这里，你们也在，[kinu.Dad]这样的措施其实没有必要，为此我感到很高兴。” 是高兴你们俩都能来到这里，还是高兴仪式正在按预定的方式顺利进行呢？ 两者都是。”小娟轻轻咬了一口那三个彩色饺子中的中间那个。“那一天很快就会到来，但今天还不是我坐在树荫下，接受人民崇拜的时刻。而当那一天真正来临时，我会看到他们的笑容，听到他们的话语，然后相信自己的直觉，来判断其中哪些人的感情才是最真挚的。说实话，我并不能期望自己总能得到完全、真诚且无条件的爱——如果真是那样的话，我的所有臣民简直就像工匠制作的木偶一样。我不会让“完美”成为“善良”的敌人。在适当的时间和地点，一些小的分歧和争论反而可能有益处，但你永远听不到有人在海洋的另一边这么说。 也许，正是她话语中那种“外来”的口音在起作用吧。 也许，[kinu.Dad]当然，我们无法确定，但对于许多虽然只是幻想，但却依然令人愉悦的事物，我们其实也无法确定它们是否真实存在，对吧？ 纪久叹了口气，靠在你的身上，她的狐妖女儿把头靠在了你的肩膀上。“这一幕看起来还挺温馨的，不是吗？下面的母亲，正在抚摸每一个愿意被抚摸的人的头，一一地给予他们的关怀与认可。确实如此。” “然而，这样一种看似无害的行为，却可能被看作是她在将那些殖民地纳入自己的势力范围。或许，如果她没有野心，满足于在社会的边缘地带过简单的生活，反而会更好吧——因为那些社会中的不良现象和垃圾，往往都会被送到这样的地方去。…没有人会认为我会构成威胁。也没有人会认为这些殖民地会构成威胁。我们只需要被放过，继续完成那些指标就行了……然而，不可避免的事情终究还是会发生。 纪久沉默了一会儿，似乎在认真思考你的话。然后，她张大嘴巴，将整根饺子串一股脑地吞了下去，嘴唇紧紧地包住饺子的下装，这个动作既滑稽又有些令人不安；最后，她猛地一拉，将饺子从嘴里拉出来，然后又吞了下去。 天啊，她怎么没被那东西噎到呢？ 拔出那根空木签，仔细地舔了舔，小娟把它放在长凳上的盘子里，然后愉快地哼起了小曲：“感谢大家今天抽出时间听我讲话。[kinu.Dad]虽然我们可以随时聊天，但事实上，真正适合讨论各种话题的氛围、环境和时机并不多见。 ] 这场公开仪式又持续了好几个小时，期间偶尔会有短暂的休息时间，让纪代子可以休息一下手臂、吃点东西。下午渐渐过去，神圣树木的叶子在微风中沙沙作响，声音始终伴随着仪式的进行。直到天色开始变金，太阳渐渐接近地平线时，你的狐妖妻子终于以一种优雅而从容的动作，最后一次轻拍你的头，表示仪式已经结束。 嗯？小娟并没有在你身边——肯定是在那之前你不知不觉睡着了，虽然你不记得自己是怎么入睡的。她应该像往常一样去陪她了吧……不过这样一来，你就能够尽情地和清子相处了。你的狐妖妻子擦了擦手，终于打发走了那个完全摸不着头脑的舞，然后站起身来，穿过树林，沿着树枝爬了上去，最终来到了你的身边。 谢谢你等我，亲爱的。” 哦，所有辛苦的事情都是她在做。你只需要从这里远远地看着，从这样的距离给予她精神上的支持而已。对了——小娟是自己走开去了，这意味着你们俩可能不需要等她回家了。她现在感觉还好吗？她竟然在那里待了几个小时，一直不停地抚摸着一个个人的头…… 在接下来的一两天里，我得好好照顾我的手臂，但这种事在主持仪式时是预料之中的，”清子微微低下头回答道。她总是这么讨人喜欢，即使累了也是如此；你的狐妖妻子总会故意扑进你的怀里，将自己的身体紧贴着你，还把尾巴缠在你的腿上，毫不掩饰地表达她的爱意。[kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 | ]包括在内。啊，啊，我真是太缺乏自制力了，真是犯了大错。想象一下，如果你我当时再放任自己多做一点恶作剧，会发生什么事情啊。 我们自己？ [silly |这个“我们自己”到底是谁啊，kemosabe？ |现在她正在拉着你一起参与她的恶作剧，对吧？ ] 一切都好，这才是最重要的。”清子又轻轻地吻了你一下。“随着时间的推移，你会慢慢明白的。就像我之前说的，你会从骨子里感受到这一点。” “啊，毫无疑问，她现在一定和她的恋人在一起，做着年轻人在这种情况下会做的事情吧。清子紧抿着嘴唇，让这一刻的意义在心中沉淀，然后继续说道：‘你知道的，亲爱的。我们以前一起做过的一些调皮、堕落的事情，比如手拉手、互相低语甜言蜜语……我觉得她今晚应该不会和我们一起回来了，所以也许我们应该自己继续做那些事情吧。她对此没有意见吗？” “毕竟他们已经订婚了。” 嗯，这些事情她比你更清楚。那么，就是回家了。 “是的，回家。” 你的狐妖妻子牵着你的手，带着你穿过鸟居一起回家吧。你们俩沿着小路一起返回，走进清子的小神社。当你们洗漱完毕准备睡觉时，你的九尾狐妻子转向你说道： “那么你呢，亲爱的？今天过得开心吗？[pc.ra kitsune | 也许我轻拍你头部的动作有点太用力了，其实并没有必要那么用力吧？” “嗯，她还在提起这件事？现在你们俩单独在一起了，也许该是时候你轻拍她说真的……你总得报答她吧，毕竟今天早上她可是给了你如此慷慨、如此周到的关怀。 |今天和她一起出门，真的非常值得。拥有这样一个深受大家喜爱的忠诚妻子，看到她得到所有人的认可……啊，能够与如此美好的人亲密相处，这种幸运真的会让人感到无比自豪。不过，她自己应该早就意识到了这一点吧？ ] 呵呵，不过我想我确实挺迷人的吧。那好吧。”她轻拍着身旁蒲团上的空位，“过来睡吧，亲爱的。今天是我们休息放松的日子，而明天，世界又会等待着我们……
rows.raw: " And indeed it does. While refreshments are brought up for you and Kinu, the two of you sit by the edge of the plaza atop one of the higher branches, having found a bench under the shade of one of the bed-sized leaves. Below you, Kiyoko deals with a seemingly endless queue of foxen who come up to her and have their heads patted — this public ceremony is indeed a lot quicker for each individual, with only a few words spoken and a couple formal pats on the head before the next one comes in for the cycle to repeat itself all over again. Even so, there are a lot of people, and you understand why Kiyoko expected this to take all day. Beside you, Kinu [kinu.isInari |has a shallow bowl piled high with crunchy pickled turnip cubes in her lap. You can smell the vinegar from over here, but that doesn't seem to bother your fox-daughter in the least as she grazes on them one by one without so much as thinking about it. It's wholesome food, one imagines, but certainly not something you'd thoughtlessly eat as a snack like what she's doing, judging from the rather unique smell. Her mother looks like she's having fun down there, isn't she? Kinu doesn't even stop munching to speak to you. "I dunno, [kinu.Dad]. Mom always hides her emotions so well when she puts on her public face like this, so it's anyone's guess as to whether she's enjoying it or not." [pc.isChamp |Hey, you know you're more permissive than her mother, but even up here it's usually polite to not talk with one's mouth full. Kinu shrugs and makes a show of swallowing in the most exaggerated fashion. "Sure thing, [kinu.Dad]." Now, what was she about to say? |Looks like a duck, walks like a duck, quacks like a duck, may as well be a duck. Until something happens to disprove it, as far as you can tell her mother is enjoying herself. ] "I honestly don't know, [kinu.Dad]. Just look at her like that. It's no way to live, lying to yourself every day. Maybe it's just your blood inside of me speaking, but I wouldn't be able to take it, not being plain about feeling how I feel. I want people to know if I'm angry or sad or just plain bored and act accordingly. And yeah, I know I'm badmouthing my mother behind her back, but it's not like I'm saying anything she doesn't know already." You look down at Kiyoko in the plaza amidst the breeze and decorations, busily patting people on the head while Miko and Mai usher the line forward one by one. She does know that someday, that's going to be her down there, right? Kinu bites down on another cube of pickled turnip with an audible crunch. "Yeah, sure, someday. But not today. And when that someday comes, I want people to smile at me when they swear their fealty to me, and be genuine about it instead keeping a straight face or doing so because it's expected of them. If they're not happy about it, I want them to show it." ...Is that because she really wants them to be honest with themselves, or because she's terrible at reading people beneath the masks we all wear when out in society? "Harsh, [kinu.Dad]." Harsh. But is it true? "I'm not gonna say yes or no to that one." Because it'll be plain on her face if she tries to lie. Your daughter's simple like that, and it's one of the reasons you love her. "Sheesh, [kinu.Dad]. I just want to live a simple life... or as simple as the circumstances of my birth will allow. Which isn't very much so, but I've learned to come to terms with it and deal with the lot as little as I can. "Which is kind of the point. I know why Mom abdicated her position in the succession, [kinu.Dad]. If I'm seen as ambitionless, content to live a simple life in a backwater where all the unwanted trash of society is sent... no one will ever think of me as a threat. No one will ever think of the colonies as a threat. We can just be left alone and keep on sending back the excess stuff, and people will leave us alone." She really does believe that, doesn't she? Even as what her mother's doing right now could be considered by the paranoid as consolidating the colonies into her own power base? "Yes. Those who were going to think that way were going to be paranoid anyway, [kinu.Dad]. As far as I understand what Mom's told me, there are always going to be those across the ocean who distrust us. But screw those people and what they think; so long as they aren't in any kind of position to anything about us, I couldn't care less." The shallow bowl of pickles is just about empty now; Kinu looks a little wistful, then sighs and leans in against you. "Thanks for hearing me out, [kinu.Dad]. Sometimes I feel like I can talk to you in ways that I can't with Mom — something that should be really obvious, but at the same time it's also something that I find myself being surprised by no matter how often it happens." |has a skewer of three round bite-sized dumplings on a stick, colored pink, green and white; you can smell the sweet glaze they have from over here, but your fox-daughter in the least as she daintily bites them one by one without so much as thinking about it. It's as wholesome as snack food can get, one imagines, but certainly not something you'd thoughtlessly eat as a snack like what she's doing, judging from the rather unique scent. Her mother looks like she's having fun down there, isn't she? Kinu sets her dumplings aside while she speaks. "She is. I am quite impressed that you can read her despite her putting on her public face, [kinu.Dad]. Although given how close the two of you are and always have been, that should not come as a surprise. I can only hope to be as intimate with my future husband as the two of you are, although that is not needed to read him or anyone else, for that matter." You look down at Kiyoko in the plaza amidst the breeze and decorations, busily patting people on the head while Miko and Mai usher the line forward one by one. She does know that someday, that's going to be her down there, right? "I have known that all my life, [kinu.Dad]. Consider that here and now, in this place and at this time, my entire purpose is to be trained and brought up in a fashion such that I may properly administer the Western Imperial Colonies with my future retainers at my side..." That would presumably be Miko and Mai, then. "...Which would be amongst, but not limited to them, yes. If Mother had not been present to administer headpats in both the private and public ceremonies, then I would have — and was fully prepared to — take her place if need be. But since she is here and so are you, [kinu.Dad], such a measure is unnecessary, for which I am glad." Glad that the both of you are here, or glad that the ceremony is proceeding as it ought to be? "Both." Kinu takes a dainty bite out of the middle of the three colored dumplings. "The day will come soon enough, but it is not today that I will sit under the shade of the leaves and receive the adoration of my people. And when that someday comes, I will see their smiles, hear their words, and trust my intuition to tell which are the most genuine of them all. Realistically speaking, I cannot expect to always be wholly, genuinely and unconditionally loved — if that were the case, all my subjects may as well be an army of the artificer's wooden puppets. I do not allow the perfect to be the enemy of the good. Some small disagreement and contentiousness in the right place and at the right time can be helpful, but you will never hear anyone across the ocean say it." Maybe it's that foreign blood in her speaking. "Perhaps, [kinu.Dad]. Of course, there is no way to be sure, but we cannot be certain about many things that are nevertheless pleasant even if they are fantasies, can we?" ... Kinu sighs and leans against you, your fox-daughter placing her head on your shoulder. "This is a pleasant enough sight, is it not? Mother down there, patting the heads of anyone who wants to be patted, acknowledging them one by one." It is. "And yet such an innocuous act might be seen as her consolidating the colonies into her own power base. Perhaps it would be easier to be ambitionless, content to live a simple life in a backwater where all the unwanted trash of society is sent... no one will ever think of me as a threat. No one will ever think of the colonies as a threat. We can just be left alone and keep on fulfilling the quotas... and yet the inevitable will happen. "But it will not be in your lifetime, [kinu.Dad], nor even mine. Yet it will be my task to consider these matters, matters which will have no impact upon my life, but potentially deeply imperil the lives of my descendants. Just as Mother was already considering my future while I was still growing within her womb..." Come now, this day is supposed to be a happy one. Look at Kiyoko down there, she's beaming and having the time of her life — sure, one might be tempted to think that she's merely smiling because her position demands it of her, but you know that she really does like getting close to her own subjects, and by everything you've heard of your fox-daughter through the rumor mill, she takes after her mother in this respect. Kinu says nothing for a little bit, contemplating your words. Then, she yawns her mouth wide and sticks the entire skewer of dumplings down her throat, closing her lips about the bottom in a frankly comical yet disturbing manner; with a sharp yank, she pulls the dumplings of the skewer with a flourish, and swallows. Gods, how did she not choke from that? Pulling the empty wooden skewer and giving it a careful lick, Kinu sets it down on a plate atop the bench and hums pleasantly. "Thank you for taking the time to listen to me speak today, [kinu.Dad]. While we can speak any time we like, it is still not that often that the atmosphere, circumstances and event lend themselves to the natural discussion of several topics." ] The public ceremony drags on for several more hours, with short breaks every now and then for Kiyoko to rest her arm and take refreshments. The afternoon flows by, the rustle of the breeze in the leaves of the sacred tree ever-present, and then as the light starts to turn golden and the sun nears the horizon your fox-wife finally dispenses her last headpat with poised grace. Hm? Kinu isn't by your side — you must've dozed off sometime before then, although you don't remember falling asleep. No doubt off to see her squeeze like always... but then that just means you'll get to spend all the time you want with Kiyoko. Dusting off her hands, your fox-wife finally dismisses a completely nonplussed Mai, picks herself up, then makes her way through the tree and up the branches to finally end up by your side. "Thank you for waiting for me, beloved." Oh, she was doing all the hard parts. All you had to do was to watch from up here and give what moral support you could from such a distance. Oh, right — Kinu wandered off on her own, which means that the both of you probably don't have to wait for her to go home. Is she feeling fine? She was there for literally hours just patting the head of person after person... "I shall have to treat my arm well for the next day or so, but it is not anything I didn't expect from officiating the ceremony," Kiyoko replies with a small dip of her head. Pleasant as always, even when tired; your fox-wife makes a show of falling into your embrace, pushing her body against yours and curling her tails about your legs and thighs in a display of unabashed affection.[kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 | The gentle yet hard roundness of her burgeoning womb and turgid breasts is only make all the more prominent by the warmth of her skin and fur | The full dome of her prominently pregnant belly and mounds of her overfull, milky racks is only made all the more prominent by the warmth of her skin and fur, and the quickening of the kit you put inside of her ]. Kiyoko leans in to give you a little nuzzle on the side of your neck, leaving her scent all over you before finally withdrawing. Hah, even when exhausted, she does know how to make an impression, doesn't she?[pc.ra kitsune | And speaking of leaving impressions, what she did at the private ceremony this morning... A giggle. "Ehehe. I am so sorry... but I could not help but tease you, beloved. Then again, I could not help but tease everyone to some degree, [kinu.isInari |my dear consort |our future son-in-law ] included. Ah, ah, such a terrible failure of mine to exercise self-restraint. Imagine what could have happened had you or I allowed ourselves to go just that bit further in our mischief." Ourselves? [silly |Who is this %"ourselves", kemosabe? |Now she's dragging you along into her mischief, isn't she? ] "All is well, and that is what matters." Kiyoko graces you with another little kiss. "You will come to understand in due time. Like I said before, you will know it in your bones." Gods, what have you signed up for? An eternity of orgasmic headpats? Well, when one puts it that way... maybe it isn't so bad at all. But maybe not in public... just maybe. ] Where's Kinu? You were with her earlier, but your daughter must've left when you dozed off. "Ah, no doubt she is with her lover, doing the things young people do in such situations." Kiyoko purses her lips to let the moment sink in, then continues. "You know, beloved. Naughty, degenerate acts that you and I have indulged in before, such as holding hands and whispering sweet nothings to each other. I do not think that she will be returning with us tonight, so perhaps we should be off ourselves." And she's fine with that? "They are engaged, after all." Well, she knows these things better than you do. Home it is, then. "Yes. Home." Your fox-wife withdraws, takes her hand in yours, and then leads you back through the torii gate and back home. The two of you head back down the path together, into Kiyoko's little shrine, and as you're washing up and getting ready for bed your kitsune wife turns to you. "And what about you, beloved? Did you enjoy yourself today?[pc.ra kitsune | Perhaps my patting of your head was a little more vigorous than was strictly necessary?" Mmm, she's still bringing that up? Now that the two of you are alone, maybe it's time you pat her on the head... you need to pay her back for her gracious and lavish attention earlier this morning, after all. |" It was definitely worth it coming out with her today. Having a faithful fox-wife who's liked by everyone, seeing her acknowledged by everyone... ah, it makes your heart swell with pride to be so lucky as to be intimate with someone as lovely as her. But then again, she already knew that, right? ] "Ehehe. But I suppose I am quite fetching. All right, then." She pats the empty spot on the futon beside her. "Come and sleep, beloved. Today has been a time for rest and relaxation, and tomorrow the world awaits us once more..." "
