Maybe in that one moment of weakness you see disappointment in her, but it's only because you've known her so long and so well that you even had a chance to see it to begin with, when your fox-wife comports herself in the blink of an eye. Half-closing her eyes, Kiyoko bows her head and tilts her gaze a little to the side. "If that is your wish, beloved." It's not anything to do with her, to be honest. You're just worried — [pc.ra kitsune |despite you having had this body for a while, you haven't really gotten the chance to learn the minutiae of being a kitsune, not when you've been running around the Marches and its environs after Kasyrra. Sure, no one's going to say anything given who you are, but you've at least managed to pick up a bit on how that works. That, and... well, you still haven't gotten used to the petting yet, while everyone else surely has had years to get at least halfway inured to receiving headpats. If Kiyoko fondles your ears so forcefully and fondly while in a serious ceremony of state, you're not sure what you might just do if it came down to that. Just having them touched is... ah... your body still really hasn't gotten used to it, and you don't know if it ever will. You just don't want to wind up doing something that might embarrass her. |this does sound like quite the important event, and you've never heard of it until right now. There'll be another time, presumably, and in between then — once the matter of Kas is over, that is — you can properly devote your time to fitting in with her people as best as you can. But not now. And a good night to her, then. ] The two of you watch as Kinu retreats from view, the last you see of her being her five white tails whisking away from the door. ] At last, Kiyoko turns back to you, a small smile on her lips. "Well, that's that. [dayNight |Shall we then enjoy the rest of our day together, then? It is not often that we get to sit down and simply relax at home. Perhaps some day all of this will become mundane... but this is not that day." And so you do. Time flies while you're having fun, and before you know it, dusk has fallen and you're |Why don't we turn in as well? We'll need our energy for tomorrow." And so it happens that you find yourself ] sharing a bed yet again with Kiyoko, her tails draped over you as the both of you doze off in each other's embrace. By the time you wake up the next day, though, she's already gone, having left a small note on the sitting room table: Thank you for watching the home while our daughter and I are away, beloved. I've left a small meal in the kitchen to keep warm for you; we should be home by sundown. Please, take a moment to enjoy yourself this day and forget the worries of the world. And so you do. Housesitting is surprisingly less boring than you imagined it'd be — perhaps it's how different Kiyoko's home is from most of the Marches, watching the fields sway in the wind — or maybe it's knowing that it's your home as well. Time passes in the blink of an eye, you find and finish the meal that Kiyoko has left for you, and true to her word, both she and Kinu step through the gate by the time the sun's touching the lip of the crater. Stepping up, you take your fox-wife by the hand and lead her back indoors, where she collapses on one of the cushions with a faint sigh. Was it that tiring? "My arm aches," Kiyoko replies matter-of-factly in one of her rare direct complaints. "But it was necessary, and a small matter besides." Just how many peoples' heads did she pat? "Anyone in the colonies who could be considered a civil servant. Strictly speaking, there were two ceremonies — a more contained and private one for ranking officials, and another for, well, everyone else. There is no need to make your task any more perilous than it already is... you should not make me worry for you, hmm? ]" Since she asked so nicely, you can't help but oblige. rows.translation: 清子的目光中闪过一丝什么。或许在那一瞬间的软弱中，你能从中看到失望，但只有因为你与她相识已久、非常了解她，你才有机会察觉到这一点——因为你的狐妖妻子转眼间就能改变自己的表现。清子半闭双眼，低下头，将目光稍微偏向一侧。 “如果那是你的愿望，亲爱的。” 说实话，这与她本身并无关系。你只是感到担心而已[pc.ra kitsune 还有……嗯，你可能还没习惯别人抚摸你，而其他人肯定已经习惯了被人轻轻拍拍头这种举动，而且这种习惯也已经养成很多年了。如果清子在一个正式的场合里如此用力且充满爱意地抚摸你的耳朵，你真的不知道自己会做出什么反应来。只要让它们被触碰一下……啊……你的身体其实还真的没有适应这种感觉，而且你也不确定自己是否永远都无法适应。你只是不想做出可能会让她难堪的事情而已。 |这确实听起来是一件非常重要的事件，而你直到现在才听说它。你只是不想自己犯错，或者在所有人面前让她难堪而已。应该还有其他机会的，等卡丝的事情结束后，你就可以专心花时间去尽可能地融入她的圈子了。但不是现在，这次不行。 ][pc.bgMulti noblescion slumrat | 此外，你本身出身贵族——虽然你的地位从未高到足以在这些仪式中获得发言权，但你非常清楚，这样的失礼行为会给她带来多大的麻烦。 | 此外，考虑到你出生时的那些不幸境遇，在这样的环境中你会感到格格不入。当然，从那以后你在社会上取得了很大的成就，但那种尴尬的感觉依然存在。正如俗话所说：你可以把老鼠从贫民窟里带走，但却无法消除贫民窟本身。 ] 亲爱的，你不必向我解释。我一直相信，你做的每一件事都有充分的理由。那么，如果你决定不陪我一起去的话[party.has kiyoko |在我处理完自己职责范围内的事情之后，你应该不会介意稍等片刻吧，嗯。 |在我们女儿和我忙于处理工作上的事务时，你可以帮忙照看一下房子，好吗？ rows.original: The ex-cultist Quintillus — wearing a mix of cultist robe scraps and peasant clothing — is hanging out at one of the tavern's booths. Although he's alone, he has a book and a drink on the table for company; maybe he'd appreciate you stopping by for a chat.
rows.translation: 那位曾经加入邪教的昆蒂卢斯——身上穿着杂乱无章的邪教袍子和农民服装——正坐在酒馆的一个角落里。虽然他独自一人，但桌上放着一本书和一杯酒，似乎在等待陪伴；或许他会很高兴有你过来陪他聊聊天。

Given how much he drinks, that's probably for the best that he's focusing on catching his breath rather than getting hammered.

        就把我们当成平等的朋友吧，好吗？等我真正恢复了经济状况，一定会把钱还给你的。你明白我的意思吧？”
        
        你翻了个白眼，接过了那个杯子，但心里还是觉得，如果他连点杯饮料都这么敷衍了事，那他的诚意也实在不怎么样啊。无论如何，你都得把它拿走喝掉，最后再把杯子还给泰勒族。
rows.raw:
"
        "Huh?" The taeleer seems caught off-guard by your topic but realizes his mistake. "Oh, right! I owe you, don't I? Well... uh..."
        
        Quintillus looks around for a moment before grabbing his own mug and sliding it across the table to you.
        
        "Consider us even, yes? I'll er... pay you back when I'm actually back on my feet. You understand, right?"
        
        You roll your eyes and take the mug, yet can't help but feel that he isn't so serious if he half-heartedly can't even order a drink. Regardless, you take it and down it before ultimately returning the mug to the taeleer.
    "

rows.original: [flags.QUINTILLUS_RECRUITED |[quin.relationshipRange 0 10 16 20 |"Admittedly, I am... not used to this." Quin's pink eyes close, and he rests his chin against his knuckles. "But, it's not an awful situation I find myself in. Being your ally, Garth continues offering me a room. But even still, I get strange looks every now and then. Plus, there are all the people rushing to ask me about our adventures." It sounds like he isn't enjoying himself. Is he regretting your help? Those eyes of his open and glare at you. "Do I regret you aiding me to escape the cultists? No. No, I think I'm pretty damn content with this over any of that miserable shit. Point is, things could be going better. I'm hoping you'll make more things interesting, though. One day, it'd be nice to earn enough to head back to the Alliance and see if my mom is still around." He barely talks about his parents, yet you can understand that much. Your situation may not be identical to every facet of his, but you've caught him looking out the window quite often. Hopefully, his situation will improve enough that Quin will find some level of peace. |At your inquiry, the pink-eyed bunny boy shoots you a still rare, yet increasingly more common smile. "I wasn't sure it was going to be possible, but... I am enjoying myself. When I'm with you[var0 | and our companions ], it feels like I can kick back, relax and be... me. I haven't felt that way in a long time, [pc.name]." Dost thine ears deceive you? [pc.hasEmoteEars |You flick your ears just to make sure you aren't hearing incorrectly. ]Did Quin just admit that you were good company? You shoot him a teasing grin as you rib him, earning an exaggerated eye roll. "Alright alright, I get it. You don't have to be so dramatic." He nudges your shin with a [quin.hasPaws |paw |foot ]. "Let's get on with it before I give myself a toothache from all this sweetness." |"We've certainly gotten close, wouldn't you say, [pc.name]?" Quin gives you a sweet, yet shy, smile. "My life hasn't gone the way I'd hoped it would, but now that I am where I am, I don't think I'd choose to change a whole lot." What would he want to change? Your question makes him hum in thought, steepling his hands and stretching his arms back and over his head. You can hear a couple of loud pops come from his back as he thinks. "Obviously I'd like the whole thing with Tollus, the cult, and Kasyrra to be resolved and over with. I'd like to visit back home; visit my mom some more." He pauses before shooting you a sly look. "Maybe you could make an honest man out of me. If anyone could, it'd be you." Charmer. "Guilty as charged." |Your husband's grin is instantaneous. "I've got an amazing [pc.mfn |husband |wife |partner ], [quin.hasPCKids |some adorable kids with said [pc.mfn|husband|wife|partner], and all the adventure I can handle |and while I'd love to have a few kids of our own running around eventually, with all the trouble we get into we've got our hands more than full. ]" He gives you what may be the widest, sweetest smile you've ever seen on him. "I'm happy, [pc.name]. The only way it could get better is if I was the richest man in the world. That way I could pamper you to death. " Does he still want to go back home? "Sometimes I think about how it would be to go for a visit, but now? You're my home. I'll go with you anywhere." ] |So what sort of deal did he make to have Garth allow him to stay? "He didn't tell you?" Quintillus looks between you and the bartender for a moment before moving a hand to tap his book. His fingers pop with magic, raising them just-in-time for it to spin open. The tome's contents are notes, each detailing the cult and its practices. "I'm helping him prepare a guide about the cult so that the local leaders can be on the lookout for any of Tollus' spies." How is the spy-hunting going? Have his notes provided any leads or led to any captures? Quintillus shakes his head, setting his palm flat against his tome and turning his pink gaze toward one of the Frost Hound's windows. "No, and I don't expect it ever will. Tollus' agents have no reason to infiltrate the town anymore. Not since he completed that ritual, anyway. Still, it's better to be prepared. While I wasn't exactly high ranking — far from it, actually — there are still tells that can be caught if you know what you're looking for." ]
rows.translation: [flags.QUINTILLUS_RECRUITED |[quin.relationshipRange 0 10 16 20 |“说实话，我……还不习惯这种生活。”昆因闭上粉色双眼，把下巴抵在指关节上。“不过，我现在的处境也不算糟。因为我是你的盟友，加斯一直愿意给我提供房间。但即便如此，我偶尔还是会遭到异样的目光。另外，还有一大群人争着来问我们冒险的事情。” 听起来他过得并不开心。他后悔接受你的帮助了吗？ 他睁开双眼，瞪了你一眼。“我后悔你帮我逃离邪教徒吗？不。不，我觉得现在这样比那堆悲惨的狗屁好太多了。重点是，事情本来还能更顺利些。不过，我希望你能让生活变得更有趣。也许有一天，能赚够钱回到联盟，看看我母亲是否还在那里，那就好了。” 他很少谈论父母，但这点你完全能够理解。你们的处境或许并非处处相同，可你经常看到他望向窗外。希望他的生活能好转到足以让昆因获得些许平静。 |听到你的询问，粉眼睛的兔男孩向你露出一个依然少见、却越来越常见的笑容。 “我之前不确定这有没有可能，但……我确实过得很开心。当我和你[var0 |以及我们的同伴 ]待在一起时，我觉得自己可以放松下来，做回……真正的自己。我已经很久没有过这种感觉了，[pc.name]。” 难道是你的耳朵欺骗了你？[pc.hasEmoteEars |你抖了抖耳朵，确认自己没有听错。 ]昆因刚才真的承认你是个好伙伴吗？你带着调侃的笑容取笑他，换来一个夸张的白眼。 “好吧好吧，我明白了。你用不着这么夸张。”他用一只[quin.hasPaws |爪子 |脚 ]碰了碰你的小腿。“趁这些甜言蜜语还没让我牙疼，我们赶紧继续吧。” |“我们确实已经很亲近了，你说对吧，[pc.name]？”昆因向你露出甜蜜又羞涩的笑容。“我的人生没有按照希望的方向发展，但既然已经走到今天，我想自己不会愿意改变太多事情。” 那他会想改变什么？ 你的问题让他若有所思地哼了一声，十指指尖相抵，又把双臂伸到脑后。思考时，你听见他的背部传来几声响亮的咔哒声。 “显然，我希望托勒斯、邪教和卡希拉的整件事能够解决并彻底结束。我想回家看看；多陪陪我母亲。”他顿了一下，随后狡黠地看向你。“也许你能让我安定下来，成为一个正经男人。要是有人能做到，那一定是你。” 真会哄人。 “这项罪名我认了。” |你丈夫的脸上瞬间绽开笑容。 “我有一位了不起的[pc.mfn |丈夫 |妻子 |伴侣 ]，[quin.hasPCKids |有几个和这位[pc.mfn|丈夫|妻子|伴侣]生下的可爱孩子，还有多到足以让我满足的冒险 |虽然我希望将来能有几个属于我们的孩子在身边跑来跑去，但我们遇到的麻烦已经够多，忙得根本腾不出手。 ]” 他向你露出了你见过的、或许也是他此生最灿烂最甜蜜的笑容。 “我很幸福，[pc.name]。唯一能让生活变得更好的办法，就是让我成为世上最富有的男人。那样我就能把你宠上天了。 ” 他还想回家吗？ “有时我会想，回去探望一次会是什么感觉；但现在呢？你就是我的家。无论你去哪里，我都会跟着你。” ] |他究竟和加斯达成了什么交易，才得以留下来？ “他没告诉你吗？”昆蒂卢斯看看你，又看看酒保，随后抬手敲了敲自己的书。他的指间迸出魔法，及时抬手让书本旋转着翻开。书里写满了笔记，每一页都详细记录着邪教及其行事方式。“我正在帮他编写一本关于邪教的指南，好让本地领袖留意托勒斯的间谍。” 搜捕间谍的工作进展如何？他的笔记有没有提供线索，或是让他们抓到什么人？ 昆蒂卢斯摇摇头，把手掌平放在书上，粉色目光转向霜犬旅店的一扇窗户。“没有，我也不觉得以后会有。托勒斯的手下已经没有理由再潜入镇里了。至少，他完成那场仪式后就没有了。不过，有备无患总归更好。我当时的地位算不上高——事实上差得远——但只要知道该找什么，依然能够发现一些破绽。” ]

rows.raw: "How is he adapting to being your companion?"

rows.original: What's his arrangement with Garth, exactly?
rows.translation: 他和加斯之间到底有什么约定？

rows.original: [flags.QUINTILLUS_CULT_TALKED |"I'm... not sure what else I could tell you that I haven't already. I really only ran messages and had a lot of sex. If you're wanting some deeper insight into their grand plans, I don't have any. Besides being a dubious sex cult, I wasn't really aware of just what kinds of things they were actually doing until the whole mountain explosion. They liked to talk a lot about big plans, but didn't actually go into any detail about them." |Quintillus hesitates, yet ultimately moves his hands down to the table and rests them palms down. You can see the fur on his arms rise, both of his ears sulking lower. "There is one thing." Quintillus points a finger at you. "You're an unexpected cog to them. They were always really big on plans and absurd things like prophecies, especially Tollus and his inner circle. I outright despised the man and his insanities but the cult was welcoming to someone with my talents. But someone like you is on a completely different level; you should try to understand just how big your little interruption at that temple was, [pc.name]. This cult has been planning things for a long time but even the best plans fail. I can tell you that what happened that night was something a lot of the others had no idea would happen. They only fell in line because of Tollus' grasp over them... but the more you push back, I'll bet the cult will begin collapsing in on itself as that fanaticism is challenged." [party.has cait |Cait's smile wanes, her hopeful eyes looking to you before it rekindles. "It's okay, [pc.name]. We'll find our lead eventually, I'm sure. If Quintillus can't tell us anything else, we'll need to find that info somewhere else. Right?" ] ]
rows.translation: [flags.QUINTILLUS_CULT_TALKED |“我……不确定还有什么是我没告诉过你的。我真的只是负责传话，还有跟人上床。要是你想深入了解他们的宏伟计划，我可什么都不知道。除了那是个可疑的性爱邪教之外，在整座山爆炸之前，我其实并不清楚他们究竟在做些什么。他们很喜欢谈论宏图大计，却从不透露任何细节。” |昆蒂卢斯犹豫了一下，最终还是把双手放到桌面上，掌心朝下。你能看到他手臂上的毛发竖了起来，两只耳朵也无精打采地垂得更低。 “有一件事。”昆蒂卢斯伸出一根手指指向你。“对他们而言，你是个意料之外的变数。他们一向极其看重计划，还有预言之类荒唐的东西，尤其是托勒斯和他的核心圈子。我打心底厌恶那个男人和他的疯言疯语，但这个教团确实愿意接纳像我这样有才能的人。可你这种人完全是另一个层次；你该明白，那晚你在神庙里造成的小小干扰究竟有多么重大，[pc.name]。这个教团已经谋划了很久，但再完美的计划也会失败。我可以告诉你，那晚发生的事情，许多教徒根本不知道会发生。他们只是因为托勒斯牢牢控制着他们，才会服从命令……可只要你不断反抗，我敢说，随着那份狂热受到挑战，教团会开始从内部崩塌。” [party.has cait |凯特脸上的笑容淡了下去，满怀希望的目光投向你，随后又重新振作起来。“没事的，[pc.name]。我们迟早会找到线索，我相信。既然昆蒂卢斯已经无法告诉我们更多，那我们就得去别处寻找情报。对吧？” ] ]

rows.original: What can he tell you about Tollus's cult?
rows.translation: 他又能告诉你关于托勒斯教派的哪些事情呢？
rows.raw: "What can he tell you about Tollus's cult?"

rows.original: Mentioning his name earns you pink-eyed glare from the furry taeleer, but the man manages to refrain from an outburst. Quin crosses his arms as his leg bounces restlessly, his [quin.hasPaws |foot thumping |heel smacking ] against the floor noisily. "He's a cunt, plain and simple. He doesn't give two shits about the lives around him and the only worth a person has is measured by what they can do for him. I hate people like that." There seems to be a more personal aspect of things with Tollus that he isn't mentioning. You have a hard time believing that he holds that much hatred for someone who hasn't personally wronged him. "You're not wrong, [pc.name]. He had somewhat of a heavy hand in how I ended up with the cult. Tollus was the one who got into my friend's head and inducted her into his cult. He's inadvertently responsible for everything that went wrong in my life and I fucking hate him for it. [quin.trained |I know I'm also partly responsible for just going along with it, but it's hard to let go of that hate. ]" Fair enough.
rows.translation: 仅仅提起他的名字，就惹来这名毛茸茸的泰勒人用粉色双眼怒瞪，不过他还是设法忍住，没有当场发作。昆因抱起双臂，腿则焦躁不安地上下抖动，[quin.hasPaws |脚掌砰砰 |脚后跟啪啪 ]敲打着地板，发出响亮的声音。 “他就是个混蛋，没什么好说的。他根本不在乎身边人的性命，衡量一个人价值的唯一标准，就是对方能为他做些什么。我痛恨这种人。” 他与托勒斯之间似乎还有一些更私人的恩怨没有说出口。你很难相信，他会如此憎恨一个从未亲自伤害过他的人。 “你没说错，[pc.name]。我最终加入邪教，他在其中出了不少力。就是托勒斯蛊惑了我的朋友，把她拉进了自己的邪教。我的人生后来发生的一切坏事，间接来说全都是他的责任，我他妈因此恨透了他。[quin.trained |我知道，自己当初只是随波逐流，也要负一部分责任，但那份仇恨真的很难放下。 ]” 这也说得过去。

rows.original:
"Orcs and mercenaries; it sounds like some easterner's fantasy tales," Quin crosses his arms, both of his ears lowering slightly above his head. "Truth be told, this place is fairly interesting to me. The place is filled with wyverns and manticores – both of which aren't common back home. Not to mention, it leads underground to Khor'minos and the idea of an entire underground civil action is fascinating."
    
                    The taeleer tosses his hands forward, letting them arc until gesturing at the ground beneath you both.
                    
                    "The true question is if there's anything else hidden around here. The nearby mountains are hollow, so it stands to reason there's a few more treasures hidden around in craggy recesses."

                    这名泰勒人将双手向前一挥，手臂划过一道弧线，最终指向你们脚下的地面。
                    
                    “真正的问题是，这附近还藏着些什么。周围的山脉内部都是空的，所以那些崎岖的岩缝深处理应还藏着几处宝藏。”

Quintillus looks around, sizing up the various trees and taking in the [dayNight|day|night]time sky above them.

                "Well, it's a forest. And an old one, if you hear the locals out."
                
                Thanks for the sarcastic commentary.
                
                "You asked," he says dryly. "That being said, even though I haven't been here long, there's more than enough gossip around town to get a feel of what's kicking around here." 
                
                Quin hoists his journal into view and taps on the cover before cracking it open and reading from it. "[var0
                    |The plant girls we keep running into are unique and definitely pretty, but if they keep picking fights with us, I've noticed they're particularly weak to fire.
                    |[QUEST_MILKY_HONEY.isCompleted|We've dealt with the hornets, so we don't need to worry about them trying to fuck and egg us on the battlefield anymore.|There are some shameful — and sexily scandalous — whispers about bodacious hornets stuffing people with eggs around these parts. I'd be careful not to get caught unawares; or do, if that's what you're into.]
                    |[flags.DRYADS_INTRO|We've met Grianne, the absolute cutie, so we know for certain now that the forest has Dryads. If we get the chance, I'd like to visit them again – their magic is pretty unique, and I'd like to learn more.|I feel magic darting about and beneath when we pass through here. It's like nothing I've ever felt before. It makes me think of those tales of Dryads. Since the locals claim this place is old, it's not too far-fetched to hope something interesting like that happens, right?]
                    |The town primarily uses this place for logging, so if we're ever in need of it for anything, here would be a pretty good place to source it.
                    |There's some rumors about a fountain or spring that can help wanderers. We could use any help we can get, so we should keep an eye out for it.
                    |[QUEST_HOWLING_DARK.isCompleted|You're the big boss of the lupine now, [pc.name], so I don't think we need to worry about any more ambushes. That being said, be cautious when you're poking at older sections of the woods, alright?|There were some pretty serious mentions about a mine collapse nearby that trapped a bunch of workers. Something about that paired with all the corruption spreading around has my fur standing on end. Make sure to keep an eye out, yeah?]
                ]"
rows.translation:
昆蒂卢斯环顾四周，打量着形形色色的树木，也观察着它们上方[dayNight|白昼|夜晚]的天空。

                “嗯，这是一片森林。而且照当地人的说法，还是一片古老的森林。”
                
                多谢他这番挖苦人的评论。
                
                “是你问的。”他干巴巴地说道。“不过话说回来，虽然我来这里没多久，但镇上的闲谈已经足够让我大致了解这里都有些什么了。” 
                
                昆因把日志举到你面前，敲了敲封面，随后翻开书读了起来。“[var0
                    |我们不断遇到的那些植物女孩既独特又漂亮，但如果她们还要找我们打架，我注意到她们尤其怕火。
                    |[QUEST_MILKY_HONEY.isCompleted|我们已经解决了那些大黄蜂，所以不用再担心她们在战场上把我们干翻、往我们体内产卵了。|这一带流传着一些羞于启齿——又香艳得令人浮想联翩——的传闻，说是那些身材火辣的大黄蜂会往人体内塞卵。最好小心点，别被她们逮个措手不及；当然，如果你就好这一口，那也随你。]
                    |[flags.DRYADS_INTRO|我们已经见过格里安妮那个绝对可爱的小家伙，所以现在可以确定森林里确实有树妖。有机会的话，我想再去拜访她们——她们的魔法相当独特，我想多了解一些。|我们经过这里时，我能感觉到魔法在四周和地下飞快流动。那种感觉是我从未体验过的，会让我想起那些关于树妖的传说。既然当地人说这片森林十分古老，那么期待这里发生些有趣的事，应该也不算太异想天开吧？]
                    |镇上主要把这里当作伐木场，所以如果我们什么时候需要木材，这里会是个相当不错的来源。
                    |有传言说这里有一座能帮助旅人的喷泉或泉眼。我们能得到的帮助越多越好，所以应该留意一下。
                    |[QUEST_HOWLING_DARK.isCompleted|你现在是狼人们的老大了，[pc.name]，所以我想我们不用再担心遭到伏击。不过，探索森林里更古老的区域时还是小心些，好吗？|附近似乎有一座矿井发生了严重坍塌，困住了一大群工人。再加上四处蔓延的腐化，这两件事凑在一起，光是想想就让我毛骨悚然。记得留意周围，好吗？]
                ]”

rows.original:
"This place isn't my most favorite," he grumbles, "but I'm more familiar here than other places because of the cult's presence."

                Quintillus sighs, clearly brought down by his own mention of the evildoers. However, you need him to focus; does he have anything else to add?
                
                "Yeah," he answers, grumpily rubbing between his ears. "[var0
                    |While we've managed to stop some of their plans, I have a feeling there's more going on here. I still wouldn't risk tempting fate, but at least we've thrown a notch into some of those assholes plans.
                    |We've taken out most of the cult presence here, so I think we can relax a bit and take it easy. Of course, there's still other things lurking around — like those renegade centaurs and various other corrupted folk and demons — but I think we can breathe deep, if nothing else.
                    |Don't stay here too long. As it stands, it's full of cult members and every single one of them is gunning for you – when they aren't cock or pussy drunk, at least. We shouldn't tempt that fate until we can figure out a way to deal with their numbers here; maybe finally get this place as peaceful as it should be.
                ]"
                
                Anything else?

                Quin considers for a moment, expression turning thoughtful. "The Pupperidge Farm is nearby; if we get the chance, we should pay them a visit. They make some fantastic meals, and they're pretty easy on the eyes, too."
rows.translation:
“这里算不上我最喜欢的地方，”他抱怨道，“但邪教在这一带有活动，所以相比其他地方，我对这里反而更熟悉。”

                昆蒂卢斯叹了口气，显然一提起那群恶徒，心情就低落了下去。不过，你需要他集中精神；他还有别的要补充吗？
                
                “有。”他闷闷不乐地揉着两耳之间答道。“[var0
                    |虽然我们已经阻止了他们的一些计划，但我总觉得这里还有更多事情在暗中发生。我依然不会冒险去试探命运，不过至少我们已经给那些混蛋的计划添了些堵。
                    |我们已经清除了这里的大部分邪教势力，所以我想我们可以稍微放松一下，好好喘口气。当然，这附近仍有别的东西游荡——比如那些叛乱的半人马，以及各种遭到腐化的人和恶魔——但至少我觉得我们可以稍微安心一些。
                    |别在这里待太久。就目前而言，这地方到处都是邪教徒，而且每一个都在盯着你——至少在他们没被阴茎或阴道迷得神魂颠倒时是如此。在我们找到办法应付这里的人数优势之前，最好别去冒这个险；也许最终还能让这个地方恢复它本该拥有的安宁。
                ]”
                
                还有别的吗？

                昆因思索片刻，神情变得若有所思。“帕珀里奇农场就在附近；有机会的话，我们应该去拜访一下。他们做的饭菜非常美味，而且人也相当养眼。”

rows.original: Just before Quintillus can answer, a chilly wind rolls through the camp and makes him stop in motion. You can see it on his face, bunny ears lowering above his sour scowl. "I hate it here. Sure, [quin.relationshipRange 0 16|there are plenty of lads and ladies lurking around that are perfect for cuddling and fucking by a fire... but it is TOO. FUCKING. COLD!|this presents the perfect opportunity for us to cuddle and fuck while we keep each other warm but, and I cannot stress this enough, it is still TOO. FUCKING. COLD!]" Quin grabs his cloak and pulls his hood up, clamping it tight around his face and shoulders with a grumble. Despite all his fur, it isn't heavily layered; as much as he has, it's not terribly warm for someone wearing what he is. Does he have anything else to add? Muffled beneath his cloak as he is, you still manage to catch what else he says. "There's supposed to be some sort of temple to the east – something about fire? If the rumors are to be trusted, anyway. To the north is the Winter City, and to the east of that is some sort of fancy tree. If I have any say in this whatsoever, I vote we visit the fire temple first."
rows.translation: 昆蒂卢斯刚要回答，一阵寒风便卷过营地，让他的动作顿时僵住。你从他脸上就能看出来——兔耳垂在上方，脸上挂着阴沉的怒容。 “我讨厌这里。好吧，[quin.relationshipRange 0 16|这附近确实潜伏着不少小伙和姑娘，特别适合围着火堆抱在一起做爱……但这里真的太、他、妈、冷、了！|这倒是给了我们一个绝佳机会，可以抱在一起做爱、相互取暖；但我必须再三强调，这里还是太、他、妈、冷、了！]” 昆因抓起斗篷戴上兜帽，一边抱怨，一边把兜帽紧紧裹住脸和肩膀。他身上的毛虽然不少，却并不浓密；穿着现在这身衣服，那些毛根本提供不了多少保暖效果。 他还有别的要补充吗？ 尽管声音被斗篷闷住了，你还是听清了他接下来说的话。“据说东边有某种神庙——好像跟火有关？至少传言是这么说的。北边是冬城，再往它东边则有一棵看起来很气派的树。如果我的意见能算数，我投票先去火之神殿。”

"I thought that the Frostwoods were bad but no no no – this place? This place is so much fucking worse." 

                    Quin's been doing his best to keep warm, even going so far as to keep himself almost constantly lit in his attempts. He's also commandeered several blankets, wrapping himself tight in them to create a heat cocoon to ward off the offending elements.
                    
                    [quin.relationshipRange 0 16
                    |Besides his vocal hatred of the cold, does he have any other insights?
                    |He shifts them around just enough for one pink eye to squint out at you imploringly from behind his makeshift shield.
                    
                    "Come join me, honey? It's awful in here without you."
                    
                    [pc.dcb|...Just for a moment.|...How could you resist?|You're always down for cuddles!!!]
                    
                    He shoots you a victorious grin when you shuffle towards him, his arms spreading the blankets for you to squeeze into his fluffy heat sanctum to press against his magic-warmed body.
                    
                    His body melts against you, greedily absorbing your body heat with prejudice.
                    
                    Besides the cold, does he have any other insights?
                    ]
                    
                    "The glaring thing here is [var0
                        |the valkyries. They extended you a personal invitation to their home base; that's really fucking cool, but it does make me wonder what they've got kicking around up here.
                        |whatever bullshit the cult has going on that's also stirred up the locals here. Whatever it is, it's definitely not fucking sunshine and rainbows. I say we deal with it and fast.
                    ]"

"It's both just as creepy yet equally fascinating as I thought down here." Quin tugs out his journal, eyes squinting as he flips through the pages. Between the fire and the natural light the fungus gives off, he's got just enough to look at his pages.

                "Those golems we keep bumping into are a pain, but it makes me wonder if those are naturally occurring or if something animated them. If the batfolk and miners didn't keep attacking us I'd be inclined to ask them, but until then we'll just have to keep beating them up. The imps suck ass here, too."
                
                Anything else?
                
                The taeleer hums in thought. "I'd make sure to explore what we can. There are a lot of places that something could be tucked away or hiding in."
rows.translation:
“这下面果然和我想的一样，既阴森又迷人。”昆因抽出日志，眯着眼睛翻动书页。火光加上真菌散发的天然光芒，勉强足够让他看清纸上的内容。

                “我们不断撞见的那些魔像很麻烦，但它们也让我好奇，究竟是自然形成的，还是有什么东西赋予了它们行动能力。要是那些蝙蝠族和矿工没有总是袭击我们，我还真想问问他们；不过在那之前，我们只能继续把他们揍趴下。这里的小恶魔也烂透了。”
                
                还有别的吗？
                
                这名泰勒人沉吟片刻。“我会尽量把能探索的地方都查一遍。这里有太多角落可以藏匿东西了。”

rows.original:
Quin barely has his mouth open before a harsh blast of wind nearly knocks the poor guy over right where he's seated. He gives the space around him a harsh glare like it's personally responsible for this grievous offense before he tries again, eyes still squinted like he's daring the wind to try again.

                "[silly|It's fucking wimdy|It's windier than a harpy's ass up here.]"
                
                That didn't even make any sense!
                
                "I don't care," he sniffs, crossing his arms. "It's annoying. The one thing I can appreciate about it is that at least it isn't a freezing wind."
                
                Does he have anything useful to add that isn't obvious?
                
                One ear twitches, the expression on his face turning thoughtful. "I heard there's both a village of vulperine nearby as well as some sort of harpy nest. I'd keep an eye out in case any of them decide to pay us a visit. This would also be the perfect place for wyverns; maybe if you play them a tune, it'll lull them to sleep. Who knows, though?"
                
                He pulls his cloak closer around his shoulders as another rush of wind sends his hair whipping around his face, leaving only his pursed lips visible to you.
rows.translation:
昆因才刚张开嘴，一阵猛烈的狂风便差点把这个可怜家伙从座位上掀翻。他恶狠狠地瞪着周围，仿佛这片空间应当为如此恶劣的冒犯亲自负责；随后他再次尝试开口，眼睛依旧眯着，像是在挑衅风再来一次。

                “[silly|这风他妈也太疯了|这里的风比鹰身女妖的屁股还大。]”
                
                那句话根本毫无道理！
                
                “我不在乎。”他吸了吸鼻子，双臂交叉。“就是很烦人。唯一值得庆幸的是，至少这不是一阵冻人的寒风。”
                
                除了显而易见的事情，他还有什么有用的补充吗？
                
                一只耳朵抽动了一下，他脸上的神情也变得若有所思。“我听说附近既有一座狐族村庄，也有某种鹰身女妖巢穴。最好留意一下，免得她们中的谁决定过来拜访我们。这里同样非常适合飞龙生活；也许你给它们吹首曲子，就能哄它们睡着。谁知道呢？”
                
                又一阵狂风吹得他的头发在脸边乱舞，他把斗篷在肩头裹得更紧；你只能看到他紧抿的双唇。

rows.original:
"It's wet and I can feel the salt fusing with my fur." Quin says miserably, looking every inch a drowned rabbit with the way his ears droop.

                It's not that bad...
                
                "The air is wet and it feels like regret the morning after a drunken romp in a horse stable." He grumbles, trying and failing at using his pink flames to dry out his fur.
                
                Does he have anything to add that isn't just a complaint?
                
                "No," he says, before begrudgingly tacking on, "well, yes. In Khor'minos, they made mention of a massive dragon that used to make its lair here named Saltmantle; said its skeleton was still kicking around on the coast. Corruption aside, I'd be especially careful here – you never know what kind of old shit is still lurking around."
rows.translation:
“这里湿乎乎的，我能感觉到盐都快和我的毛粘在一起了。”昆因痛苦地说道，双耳耷拉着，活像一只落汤兔。

                也没有那么糟……
                
                “空气湿得要命，感觉就像喝醉后在马厩里胡搞一晚，第二天早晨涌上来的悔意。”他抱怨着，试图用粉色火焰烘干毛发，却以失败告终。
                
                除了抱怨之外，他还有什么要补充的吗？
                
                “没有。”他说完，又不情不愿地补充道，“好吧，有。在科尔米诺斯时，他们提过一头名叫盐壳的巨龙，过去曾在这里筑巢；据说它的骨架至今还留在海岸上。暂且不论腐化，我建议在这里格外小心——谁也不知道还有什么古老的鬼东西潜伏在附近。”

rows.original:
[flags.QUINTILLUS_TALKONS_TALKED
        |He mentioned Taelia's Talons, and you're curious: who are they?

        The grin that springs to his [quin.lips] hints he wanted you to ask.
        |He mentioned a group before you gathered things for him; what can he tell you about the Talons or whatever?
        
        "You caught that," he mumbles, sounding surprised. "Really? I... I'm impressed."
    ] Quin grabs his tome, turning back its pages to the very front cover. A twist of his wrist opens it wide, showing the very first page. A crest of two short-eared and long-eared hares clasping a saber is etched into the pages in thick black ink. Quin taps his finger on the short rabbit.

    "This is the crest of the Tael Alliance; the unified powers of both taeleer kind. Those of us who separated in the fall of the Empire and those who escaped as slaves formed it as a unified nation to combine our power. Our kind is pretty useful — since we breed like rabbits when we want to — and has a long history with slavery, after all. But, that's beside the point. Look here, at the saber..."
    
    Quin drifts the digit higher, his finger glowing with magical heat. The ink pales and brightens, slowly vanishing until text clearly marks the sword. [pc.isCunning
        |Although you aren't an expert, your sharp mind can decipher the words.
        |Not that you can read it, anyway. What does it say?
    ]
    
    "Err To Whisper," Quin echoes solemnly. "The creed of the Talons. Our members always."
    
    Wait, he's part of this group? Why was he with the Cult if he's part of some foreign power's secret exclusive order?
    
    "First off, it's not some secret order. It's more of a specialized branch of our military that's just difficult to get into. It's not that different than, say, the Khor'minos navy having specialized storm mages." After that he seems to deflate, ears drooping as he slowly closes the cover of his tome. He rubs a hand through his hair, fussing with it as he builds up the courage to continue.
    
    "I flunked my initiation. It consists of a rigorous trial period and subsequent training that in total takes a minimum of six months, during which celibacy is required. The Talons do a lot with more volatile types of magic and being able to be in control of yourself despite things like libido, surging frustrations and other emotional difficulties is required. I wasn't able to stay celibate during my trials and flunked out."

    Quin seems to come to a conclusion before pulling free a loose piece of paper from his tome, setting it on the table and sliding it towards you. "Here. I committed the Talon's Creed to memory a long time ago."
rows.translation:
[flags.QUINTILLUS_TALKONS_TALKED
        |他提过塔莉娅之爪，而你对此很好奇：他们是什么人？

        他[quin.lips]上浮现的笑容暗示着，他一直希望你这样问。
        |在你替他收集物品之前，他提到过一个组织；关于那个什么“利爪”，他能告诉你些什么？
        
        “你注意到了。”他低声说道，语气颇为惊讶。“真的？我……我很佩服。”
    ]昆因拿起书册，将书页翻回最前面的封面。他转动手腕，把书完全展开，露出第一页。厚重的黑色墨水在纸上勾勒出一枚纹章：一只短耳兔与一只长耳野兔共同握着一柄军刀。昆因用手指点了点那只短耳兔。

    “这是泰尔联盟的纹章，代表泰勒尔族双方统一起来的力量。帝国覆灭时与众人分离的族人，以及摆脱奴隶身份逃出来的族人，共同建立了这个统一国家，集结彼此的力量。毕竟，我们这个种族相当有用——只要愿意，我们繁殖起来就和兔子一样快——而且与奴役有着漫长的历史。不过，那不是重点。看这里，看这把军刀……”
    
    昆因把手指向上移去，指尖散发着魔法热力。墨迹逐渐变淡、发亮，最后缓缓消失，直到一行文字清晰地标在剑身上。[pc.isCunning
        |虽然你不是专家，但凭借敏锐的头脑，依然能够辨认出那些文字。
        |反正你也看不懂。上面写了什么？
    ]
    
    “错以低语。”昆因庄重地复述道。“这是利爪的信条，也是我们成员始终遵循的准则。”
    
    等等，他也是这个组织的一员？如果他属于某个外国势力秘密而排外的组织，为什么又会和邪教待在一起？
    
    “首先，那不是什么秘密组织。它更像是我们军队里一个难以加入的特种部门。就好比科尔米诺斯海军拥有专门的风暴法师，并没有太大不同。”说完，他像泄了气似的垮下来，耳朵低垂，慢慢合上书册封面。他伸手捋过头发，烦躁地摆弄着，努力鼓起继续说下去的勇气。
    
    “我的入会试炼失败了。试炼包括一段严格的考察期和后续训练，整个过程最少要持续六个月，期间必须禁欲。利爪经常接触较为不稳定的魔法，因此不论面对性欲、不断积累的挫败感还是其他情绪困难，都必须有能力控制自己。我没能在试炼期间保持禁欲，所以被淘汰了。”

    昆因似乎下定了决心，从书册里抽出一张松散的纸，放到桌上推向你。“给。我很久以前就把《利爪信条》背下来了。”

rows.original: Ask him about his care routine.

"My name is Quintillus Maros. I'm the only child of Magnus Maros and Violet Maros — which, for a taeleer family, is quite impressive let me assure you. Most taeleer families pump out children by the dozens." He hums in thought, tapping his fingers against the wood of the table. "I grew up in the Warrens, in the western end of the Tael Alliance — think partially buried houses that allow for growing things on top of the buildings while conserving space." He tugs out his book and flips to a specific page with memorized ease. It shows sketches of half-buried houses with small gardens on top. He slides it towards you so you can get a clearer look at it. "It was a sort of quaint, quiet little place, though that didn't stop me from finding trouble to get myself into." Oh? Do tell. "Well... [rand |there was this neighbor who was real crotchety, [silly |a real Karen, you know? |a major bitch, you know? ] She liked to turn the smallest inconveniences into huge deals and wanted everyone to know about how much it ruined her day. She'd always complain about how us kids would play too loud or run too close to her burrow; basically just be mad at kids for being kids." Quin lets out a snorting laugh, leaning forward as he starts to get into his story-telling. "So whenever she'd leave her laundry out to dry, one of us kids would steal one of her socks and bury it. Only the left ones though. For the longest time she thought it was a very angry spirit with a grudge, since the summer before we started doing it she'd warded her house and garden — never figured out why, but I heard a couple of the moms gossiping about it a couple of times — until we got caught after a couple of months of doing it." How mad was she? "Oh she was furious – demanded we all return every single sock we took on top of 'additional compensation'. A lot of us kids ended up doing some community service work for it, but we all agreed it was worth it." He sighs and leans back in his booth seat. |there was the time I nearly set my house on fire playing with my dad's spellbook." That sounds like it has a story behind it. "It isn't a huge one. My dad didn't keep his spellstuff locked up too well when I was younger. Once when I was six, I managed to get my hands on one of his spellbooks. It was right about that time that my family discovered I had inherited my great-grandmother's aptitude for spellwork, especially flame-based magic." Quin brings up a hand and watches as two of his fingers alight with bright pink fire. "Set a blanket or two on fire when I panicked, but my dad made sure to keep his stuff tightly locked up from then on." Your bunny companion snickers. "Mom was mad after she made sure the both of us were okay." |there was an auntie a few burrows down that spent most of her free time practicing art. She taught me the basics of how to draw when I was younger. Apparently I got into her art stuff when she was watching me for my parents and instead of being mad at me for getting paint on her walls, she decided that I made the perfect apprentice. I never really got the hang of anything other than charcoal sketching, but I still wonder how she's doing from time to time." |I had this one friend; Catherine, her name was. White hair, purple eyes – big dreams of learning magic even though her parents were bakers and wanted her to take over for them when they were older. We'd get into so much shit together." The bunnyboy grins, pink eyes sparking in delight before beginning again. What was she like? "Smart as a whip, that one. She'd always pester the old retired adventurers around the Burrows to teach her things, hunting for every scrap of knowledge her big brain could handle. Accidentally froze a bunch of crops once while practicing something she wasn't supposed to – got in a lot of trouble with that one, for sure." What happened after that? "She got into a massive fight with her parents and ended up leaving that night; caught the first caravan out of Taelia and I haven't seen her since." ] His enthusiastic retelling melts into something more melancholy as he leans back in his seat and tugs his book closer towards him, a small smile playing on his lips. "I miss it, honestly. Didn't think I'd end up here back when I was dreaming of my future as a bright-eyed little trouble-maker." What did he want to do when he was younger? [flags.QUINTILLUS_TALONS_TALKED |He hesitates for a moment before continuing. "I mentioned that I flunked out of my initiation trials for joining the Talons, right? I spent a lot of my youth idolizing them and working my way up to being able to just try out for them. There wasn't really anything else I wanted to do and I didn't really plan for anything else should I fail to get in. [quin.trained |I'm just now starting to get back on my feet and figure out where to go from here, thanks to you |I'm... Not quite sure where to go from here, but I'll figure it out ]. |"It doesn't really matter now anyways. Anything else you wanna talk about?" The smile Quin gives you is wry and depressing, as if he thought it truly didn't mean anything anymore. ]
rows.translation: “我叫昆蒂卢斯·马罗斯，是马格努斯·马罗斯和维奥莱特·马罗斯唯一的孩子——我向你保证，对一个泰勒尔家庭来说，这可是相当了不起。多数泰勒尔家庭都会一窝接一窝地生孩子。”他若有所思地哼着，手指敲打桌面木板。“我在泰尔联盟西端的兔穴区长大——你可以想象一下半埋在地下的房屋，既能在屋顶种植东西，又节省空间。”他抽出书本，熟练地翻到特定一页。上面画着几座半埋式房屋，屋顶各有一座小花园。他把书推向你，让你能看得更清楚。“那地方古朴安静，不过这并没能阻止我四处惹麻烦。” 哦？说来听听。 “嗯……[rand |我们有个邻居脾气特别坏，[silly |就是典型的‘凯伦’，你懂吧？ |就是个十足的泼妇，懂吧？ ]她喜欢把最小的不便闹成天大的事情，还要让所有人都知道那件事怎样毁了她的一天。她总抱怨我们这些孩子玩得太吵，或是跑得离她的洞穴太近；基本上就是因为孩子像个孩子而生气。”昆因发出一声嗤笑，身体向前倾去，逐渐沉浸在自己的故事里。“所以每当她把衣服晾在外面，我们这些孩子就会偷走她的一只袜子，然后埋起来。不过只偷左脚的。我们开始这样做之前的那个夏天，她曾给房屋和花园施过防护——我始终没弄明白为什么，只是有几次听到几位母亲谈论这件事——所以很长一段时间里，她都以为这是某个怀恨在心的愤怒幽灵干的；直到几个月后，我们才被抓住。” 她有多生气？ “哦，她气疯了——要求我们归还偷走的每一只袜子，还要支付‘额外补偿’。我们很多孩子最后都为此做了些社区劳动，但大家一致认为很值得。”他叹了口气，靠回卡座。 |还有一次，我玩父亲的法术书，差点把房子烧了。” 那听起来背后有个故事。 “故事其实不长。我小时候，父亲没把施法用品锁得多严。六岁那年，我有一次成功拿到他的一本法术书。也正是在那时候，家里发现我继承了曾祖母施法方面的天赋，尤其擅长火焰魔法。”昆因抬起一只手，看着两根手指燃起明亮的粉色火焰。“我吓慌了，点着了一两条毯子；不过从那以后，父亲便把自己的东西牢牢锁了起来。”你的兔子同伴窃笑起来。“母亲先确认我们两个都没事，然后大发雷霆。” |几个兔穴外住着一位阿姨，空闲时间大多用来练习绘画。我小时候，她教过我绘画的基础知识。听说有一次父母把我交给她照看，我摆弄了她的画具；可她没有因为我把颜料弄到墙上而生气，反而认定我是个完美的学徒。除木炭素描外，我一直没真正掌握别的东西，但偶尔还是会想知道她现在过得怎样。” |我以前有个朋友，名叫卡瑟琳。她有一头白发和一双紫眼睛——明明父母都是面包师，希望她长大后接手生意，她却一心梦想学习魔法。我们两个一起闯过不知道多少祸。”兔男孩咧嘴笑起来，粉色双眼闪着喜悦的光芒，随后继续说了下去。 她是什么样的人？ “她聪明得不得了。总会纠缠兔穴区那些退休的老冒险者，要他们教她本领，拼命搜寻她那聪明脑袋所能容纳的每一丁点知识。有一次，她练习了本不该碰的东西，意外冻坏了一大片庄稼——那次她肯定惹上了大麻烦。” 后来发生了什么？ “她和父母大吵了一架，当晚便离家出走；搭上第一支离开塔莉娅的商队，此后我再也没见过她。” ] 他兴致勃勃的讲述逐渐染上忧郁；他靠回座位，把书拉近了些，嘴角挂着淡淡的微笑。 “说实话，我很想念那里。小时候那个眼睛明亮、整天惹麻烦的我畅想未来时，可没想到最后会来到这里。” 他小时候想做什么？ [flags.QUINTILLUS_TALONS_TALKED |他犹豫了一下才继续说道。“我提过自己没能通过加入利爪的入会试炼，对吧？年轻时，我一直把他们当作偶像，努力磨炼自己，只为获得参加选拔的资格。我真的没想过要做别的事，也没为落选后的生活制定过任何计划。[quin.trained |多亏了你，我现在才刚重新站稳脚跟，开始思考今后该去向何方 |我……还不太确定今后该去向何方，但总会想明白的 ]。 |“反正现在已经不重要了。你还想聊别的吗？”昆因给了你一个苦涩而消沉的笑容，仿佛他真心认为那些梦想已经毫无意义。 ]
rows.raw: ' "My name is Quintillus Maros. I'm the only child of Magnus Maros and Violet Maros — which, for a taeleer family, is quite impressive let me assure you. Most taeleer families pump out children by the dozens." He hums in thought, tapping his fingers against the wood of the table. "I grew up in the Warrens, in the western end of the Tael Alliance — think partially buried houses that allow for growing things on top of the buildings while conserving space." He tugs out his book and flips to a specific page with memorized ease. It shows sketches of half-buried houses with small gardens on top. He slides it towards you so you can get a clearer look at it. "It was a sort of quaint, quiet little place, though that didn't stop me from finding trouble to get myself into." Oh? Do tell. "Well... [rand |there was this neighbor who was real crotchety, [silly |a real Karen, you know? |a major bitch, you know? ] She liked to turn the smallest inconveniences into huge deals and wanted everyone to know about how much it ruined her day. She'd always complain about how us kids would play too loud or run too close to her burrow; basically just be mad at kids for being kids." Quin lets out a snorting laugh, leaning forward as he starts to get into his story-telling. "So whenever she'd leave her laundry out to dry, one of us kids would steal one of her socks and bury it. Only the left ones though. For the longest time she thought it was a very angry spirit with a grudge, since the summer before we started doing it she'd warded her house and garden — never figured out why, but I heard a couple of the moms gossiping about it a couple of times — until we got caught after a couple of months of doing it." How mad was she? "Oh she was furious – demanded we all return every single sock we took on top of 'additional compensation'. A lot of us kids ended up doing some community service work for it, but we all agreed it was worth it." He sighs and leans back in his booth seat. |there was the time I nearly set my house on fire playing with my dad's spellbook." That sounds like it has a story behind it. "It isn't a huge one. My dad didn't keep his spellstuff locked up too well when I was younger. Once when I was six, I managed to get my hands on one of his spellbooks. It was right about that time that my family discovered I had inherited my great-grandmother's aptitude for spellwork, especially flame-based magic." Quin brings up a hand and watches as two of his fingers alight with bright pink fire. "Set a blanket or two on fire when I panicked, but my dad made sure to keep his stuff tightly locked up from then on." Your bunny companion snickers. "Mom was mad after she made sure the both of us were okay." |there was an auntie a few burrows down that spent most of her free time practicing art. She taught me the basics of how to draw when I was younger. Apparently I got into her art stuff when she was watching me for my parents and instead of being mad at me for getting paint on her walls, she decided that I made the perfect apprentice. I never really got the hang of anything other than charcoal sketching, but I still wonder how she's doing from time to time." |I had this one friend; Catherine, her name was. White hair, purple eyes – big dreams of learning magic even though her parents were bakers and wanted her to take over for them when they were older. We'd get into so much shit together." The bunnyboy grins, pink eyes sparking in delight before beginning again. What was she like? "Smart as a whip, that one. She'd always pester the old retired adventurers around the Burrows to teach her things, hunting for every scrap of knowledge her big brain could handle. Accidentally froze a bunch of crops once while practicing something she wasn't supposed to – got in a lot of trouble with that one, for sure." What happened after that? "She got into a massive fight with her parents and ended up leaving that night; caught the first caravan out of Taelia and I haven't seen her since." ] His enthusiastic retelling melts into something more melancholy as he leans back in his seat and tugs his book closer towards him, a small smile playing on his lips. "I miss it, honestly. Didn't think I'd end up here back when I was dreaming of my future as a bright-eyed little trouble-maker." What did he want to do when he was younger? [flags.QUINTILLUS_TALONS_TALKED |He hesitates for a moment before continuing. "I mentioned that I flunked out of my initiation trials for joining the Talons, right? I spent a lot of my youth idolizing them and working my way up to being able to just try out for them. There wasn't really anything else I wanted to do and I didn't really plan for anything else should I fail to get in. [quin.trained |I'm just now starting to get back on my feet and figure out where to go from here, thanks to you |I'm... Not quite sure where to go from here, but I'll figure it out ]. |"It doesn't really matter now anyways. Anything else you wanna talk about?" The smile Quin gives you is wry and depressing, as if he thought it truly didn't mean anything anymore. ] '

rows.original:
"My magic?" 

    It's unique.
    
    "I guess it could be considered unique, if that's how you decide to look at it," Quin starts, raising his hand and allowing it to alight with pink flame. It dances across his hand, flickering between extended fingers. "I started learning the basics of magic when I was young and I got into my dad's old adventuring stuff. We learned I had a bit of an aptitude for it which he was really excited for; he'd really only dabbled in magic and my mom was particularly good at hitting things and swinging swords — which she did not hesitate to have me learn when I started focusing too much on the magic side of things — so it hadn't really been present in my family since my great-grandmother was still around." Quin condenses the flame in his hand, letting it pop and hiss before extinguishing it entirely.
    
    Okay, but that doesn't explain the whole, lighting-himself-on-fire bit or the lust magic.
    
    "I'm getting there," he says, pointing a finger at you. "The 'lighting-myself-on-fire' thing is a Talon thing. It boosts my abilities while I'm channeling and makes it harder to get hit. The lust magic was stuff I picked up during my time in the Cult. I can use them separately, but I figured out that combining the two types makes it extremely difficult to resist and can lead to easy incapacitation, especially towards Cult members who are already incredibly horny."
    
    "Besides those, are there other types of magic he can use?
    
    Quintillus hums, rubbing his chin thoughtfully. "There's no reason why I shouldn't be able to. I have a solid foundation for both Black and White magic, even if I'm a bit rusty with things other than flame and lust. I'll get back to you on that."
rows.translation:
“我的魔法？” 

    很独特。
    
    “如果你选择从那个角度看，或许确实可以算独特。”昆因一边说，一边抬起手，让粉色火焰在掌中燃起。火焰在他手上跳动，在伸展的指间明灭闪烁。“我小时候翻到父亲从前冒险时留下的东西，便开始学习魔法基础。后来我们发现我在这方面有些天赋，父亲为此兴奋极了；他自己只粗浅接触过魔法，而母亲尤其擅长敲打东西和挥舞刀剑——当我太过专注于魔法时，她也毫不犹豫地让我学习这些——所以自曾祖母还在世以来，家里就再没有过多少魔法传承。”昆因压缩掌中的火焰，任它噼啪作响，随后彻底熄灭。
    
    好吧，但这并不能解释他把自己点着的做法，也没解释情欲魔法。
    
    “我正要说到那里。”他伸出一根手指指着你。“‘把自己点着’是利爪的一种技巧。它能在我引导魔力时增强能力，也让我更难被击中。情欲魔法则是我待在邪教期间学来的。我可以分别使用两者，但后来发现，把这两类魔法结合起来会让人极难抵抗，也能轻易使目标丧失行动能力，尤其是那些本就欲火中烧的邪教成员。”
    
    “除了这些，他还能使用其他种类的魔法吗？
    
    昆蒂卢斯哼了一声，若有所思地摩挲下巴。“没有理由不行。我在黑魔法和白魔法方面都有扎实的基础，只是除了火焰和情欲之外，其他方面稍微有些生疏。我以后再告诉你结果。”

rows.original: He mentioned his parents before. "There's not a huge amount to tell. They met as young adventurers and fell in love. They traveled together for a while before they decided to settle down and have a family. It's a pretty standard Taelian tale." Surely there has to be more to it than that. "Sure there is." Quin takes a sip of his drink, letting that sit before grinning at you and continuing. "My dad became a Talon when I was young and I wanted to follow in his footsteps. I thought he was the coolest, you know? Though after he joined, he was constantly gone. I haven't seen him in almost a decade and a half. It's just been my mother and I for a while now." He really doesn't have any siblings? From what you know, taeleer tend to have large families. He shrugs, fingers idly playing with the pages of his book while he talks. "None. My father became a Talon maybe... eight years after I was born? His position afforded us a very small noble title and a nicer home, but I'm not sure that never seeing him again was worth it." Wait, he's some kind of noble? "Not really; it's only in the barest sense of the word. We've got a name and a crest, but that's genuinely about it. It's not a title with any weight behind them or large tracts of land; nothing of the sort. It's really nothing to write home about." And what about his mom? "My mom did random jobs here and there while raising me. Dad's earnings kept us afloat but she both hated being idle and wanted funds for the extras, so whenever anyone had something that needed fixing or found some wildlife that needed smacking, they'd come to her. Since it was just the two of us, we grew really close."
rows.translation: 他之前提到过自己的父母。 “没什么特别多的事情可讲。他们年轻时都是冒险者，相遇后便坠入爱河。两人共同旅行了一段时间，之后决定安定下来，组建家庭。这是相当标准的塔莉娅故事。” 事情肯定不止这么简单。 “当然不止。” 昆因抿了一口饮料，任这句话稍稍沉淀，随后咧嘴看着你，继续讲了下去。 “我小时候，父亲成了利爪的一员，而我也想追随他的脚步。我觉得他酷毙了，你懂吧？可他加入之后，总是离家在外。我已经差不多十五年没见过他了。这么多年来，家里一直只有我和母亲。” 他真的没有任何兄弟姐妹吗？据你所知，泰勒尔族通常拥有大家庭。 他耸了耸肩，说话时，手指漫不经心地拨弄书页。“一个也没有。我父亲大概是在我出生……八年后成为利爪的？那个职位给我们带来了一个极小的贵族头衔和一栋更好的房子，但我不确定从此再也见不到他是否值得。” 等等，他算是某种贵族？ “不算；只有最勉强的意义上能这么说。我们有一个名号和一枚家徽，但真的仅此而已。那头衔既没有任何实际分量，也不附带大片领地；完全不是那么回事。实在没什么值得大书特书的。” 那他母亲呢？ “母亲抚养我时，会四处接些零工。父亲的收入足够我们维持生活，可她既讨厌闲着，也想赚些钱添置额外的东西；所以每当有人需要修理什么，或发现某只野兽需要教训，他们都会找她。因为一直只有我们两个人，所以关系变得非常亲密。”

rows.original: With how he talks about the Talons, there has to be more to it than just not being able to keep it in his pants for six months. [quin.relationshipRange 0 10 |Quin tugs on one of his ears in discomfort, before meeting your gaze. "It's something deeply personal, [pc.name]. We aren't close enough for me to feel comfortable talking about it with you. Please respect that." |Quin goes very quiet at your probing, not even his ears moving. He seems to be deep in thought, before he comes to a conclusion. "Alright, [pc.name]. Since you rescued me, and seem to care about me for whatever reason, I owe you that much, at least." He takes a large gulp of liquid courage before talking again. "I had a very close friend at the time, another taeleer named Sirena, who started getting mixed up with some cult members that happened to be nearby. I was in the midst of my initiation trial when she met them and we didn't spend nearly enough time together as we used to. I don't know if she felt alone, or betrayed, or whatever it was that was floating through her head at the time, but she ended up joining them. I'd just flunked my trials, and I was worried about her — truly, genuinely worried — so when she asked me to come with her, I did. Call me a fool or whatever you like, but I wasn't going to abandon a friend in need." So it's not just [pc.dcb |jackasses |jerks |meanies ], the Cult preys on people in bad spots too. Quin nods his head. "While some of them are absolutely horrible, some were just people who met the wrong crowd at the wrong time. If that's all, can we talk about literally anything else?" ]

Call me a fool or whatever you like, but I wasn't going to abandon a friend in need." So it's not just [pc.dcb |jackasses |jerks |meanies ], the Cult preys on people in bad spots too. Quin nods his head. "While some of them are absolutely horrible, some were just people who met the wrong crowd at the wrong time. If that's all, can we talk about literally anything else?" ] "

rows.original: [quin.hasPaws |How are his new paws treating him? Quin grins at you, reaching down and grabbing his ankle to hoist it up onto his lap. He adjusts the fluffy paw so that a pale pink paw pad faces you. There's no signs of any dirt in his fur or any scuffing on the paw pad itself. It looks like, even though it's completely different now, he's still keeping up with his skin (fur?) care when it comes to his feet. "It took a little bit of research and some asking around, but I was able to find good substitutes for soaps and other care products that fit the new fur and pads better. I also don't know if it was just the alchemy that was used or if paws are just built that differently, but they're a lot more sensitive now." [pc.isBimbo |Quin looks up to see what must be the blatant longing on your face, sighing as he wiggles his toes at you. "Go on. I can see the longing. Just be gentle." His ears flatten at your excited squeal and you reach forward to poke at his paw pads. They're soft, squishy, and everything you were hoping they'd be. Quin indulges you for a moment before pulling his paw back, amusement written plainly on his face. "Better now?" Much! |Well, to be fair, his other feet had a lot of experience that these new paws just don't have. Maybe the sensitivity will wear off in time? "Maybe. Anyways," he moves his paw back to the ground, causing a muffled 'thump!' from the impact. "Thanks again for making this happen. I really appreciate it." ] |[pc.dcb |The fuck is up with him not wearing shoes. |What's the story with him going around barefoot anyway? |So like, why doesn't he wear shoes? ] Quin reaches down, grabbing his own ankle and hoisting it up into his lap. True enough, he's barefoot. As often as he walks, however, his foot seems perfect; a beautiful arch, no bunions, and an otherworldly group of toes all aligned and nails trimmed. The bunny runs his palm across the bottom, pressing his fingers against the blemish-free skin. "Taeleer are naturally fast. In my case, I run much quicker without shoes... but it's also because I end up rubbing my feet down and washing them once a day if possible." That's a lot of self-hygiene for his feet. Though given how soft and smooth his fur looks, his hygiene clearly matters a lot to him. But doesn't he ever bother wearing shoes? "Nope." The way Quin arches his brow, it seems like he can't fathom why you'd bother asking. "I mean, what's going to hurt me? I've run around barefoot pretty much my entire life. Talons training involves working every part of the body, including your feet; one doesn't need some small rock or want to rely on a good boot to complete a job, especially in cases where one couldn't guarantee being properly clothed." Quin lets his foot drop back to the [atCamp|ground|floor], looking down at your feet for a moment before smirking up at you. "You're not jealous, are you?" He teases. Even among taeleer, it's pretty rare to get to the point where you can rock out with your toes out all the time... much less this far north. That part is entirely my shtick, [pc.name]. rows.translation: [quin.hasPaws |他用新爪子感觉怎么样？ 昆因朝你咧嘴一笑，俯身抓住脚踝，将它抬到膝上。他调整了一下毛茸茸的爪子，让淡粉色肉垫正对着你。毛发里看不出任何污垢，肉垫本身也没有磨损。看来，即使双脚如今彻底变了样，他依然没有疏忽对脚部皮肤（或者说毛发？）的护理。 “我稍微做了些研究，又四处打听了一番，终于找到了更适合新毛发和肉垫的肥皂与其他护理用品替代品。我也不清楚这是炼金术造成的，还是爪子本来构造就有这么大差别，不过它们现在敏感多了。” [pc.isBimbo |昆因抬头看见你脸上毫不掩饰的渴望，叹了口气，朝你动了动脚趾。“来吧。我看得出你有多想摸。轻一点就好。” 你兴奋地尖叫一声，吓得他双耳向后贴平；你随即伸手戳了戳他的肉垫。它们又软又有弹性，完全和你期待的一样。昆因纵容你摸了一会儿，才把爪子收回，脸上的笑意一览无余。 “现在满足了？” 太满足了！ |不过说句公道话，他原来的双脚有着这些新爪子尚未积累的丰富经验。也许随着时间推移，它们就不会这么敏感了？ “也许吧。总之，”他把爪子放回地面，落下时发出沉闷的“砰！”声。“还是要再次谢谢你帮我实现这件事。我真的很感激。” ] |[pc.dcb |他妈的，他为什么不穿鞋？ |话说，他为什么总是赤脚到处走？ |所以，他为什么不穿鞋呢？ ] 昆因俯身抓住自己的脚踝，将它抬到膝上。他的确赤着脚。不过，尽管经常走路，那只脚看起来依然完美：足弓优美，没有拇囊炎，一排仿佛不属于尘世的脚趾整齐排列，趾甲也修剪得十分整洁。兔族用手掌抚过脚底，手指按在毫无瑕疵的皮肤上。 “泰勒族天生速度很快。就我而言，不穿鞋能跑得快得多……不过也因为只要条件允许，我每天都会按摩、清洗双脚。” 他在双脚卫生上投入得真不少。不过，看看他柔软顺滑的毛发，显然个人清洁对他十分重要。但他就从来不考虑穿鞋吗？ “不穿。”昆因挑起眉毛，仿佛根本无法理解你为什么要问。“我是说，有什么能伤到我？我这辈子几乎一直赤脚跑来跑去。塔莉娅之爪的训练会锻炼身体的每一个部位，其中自然包括双脚；一个人不能被区区小石子妨碍，也不能指望总有双好靴子帮自己完成任务，尤其是在无法保证衣着齐全的场合。” 昆因把脚重新放回[atCamp|地面|地板]，低头看了看你的双脚，随即抬眼朝你得意一笑。 “你该不会是在嫉妒吧？”他调侃道。“很遗憾，就算拥有合适类型的双脚，你也得花上好几年才能把它们锻炼得如此坚韧。即使在泰勒族中，能达到随时露着脚趾自在行动的程度也相当罕见……在这么靠北的地方更是如此。这完完全全是我的招牌，[pc.name]。除非你也像我一样，是个高大、火热、专揍邪教徒的兔子。” ]

rows.original:
He seems to care a lot about his appearance. Is there a reason why he puts so much into it?

    Almost like a switch is flipped, Quin's pink eyes zero in on you at your question. It's almost like he's vibrating in his seat. "You genuinely want to know? I can talk about this for a while, you know."
    
    You're almost afraid to say yes. Nonetheless, you gesture at Quin to continue, getting comfortable on your side of the booth. Your words garner an excited smile from your taeleer companion, who leans forward and pushes an ear forward.
    
    He wiggles it once. "Go on, touch it!"
    
    [pc.dcb
        |You refuse.
    
        The hare rolls his eyes and pulls back but continues, undeterred.
        |You hesitantly reach out, touching the taeleer's ear. It's extremely soft, the fur rubbing against your palm and almost trying to tug you into its warmth. 
        |You instantly reach out, touching the taeleer's ear. It's extremely soft, the fur rubbing against your palm and almost trying to tug you into its warmth. You let out a giggle, gently raising it and rubbing it against your cheek much to Quin's chagrin.
    ]
    
    "I regularly use aspects of my flame magic to bathe my fur so it's soft. That's my secret. Being mostly flame resistant makes it easier to fluff out the fur and manage all the tangles. If I leave it be it gets all rough since my family's always had bad fur. After my dad deployed the last time, I would sit with my mom and we'd brush each other's hair and stuff. We'd spend hours getting ourselves all prettied up. That's really when I started putting effort into my appearance." Quin puffs his chest out with obvious pride, preening with delight. "When I got older I kept up with it and added extra steps."
    
    [pc.isDK
        |He
        |He leans back and
    ] tugs one leg up and across his lap, resting his ankle against the knee of his other leg. The movement draws attention to his [quin.hasPaws|pawpad|naked foot] where, despite the rough terrain, remains clean and blemish free.
    
    "[quin.hasPaws
        |While I don't have to worry as much as I did when I still had feet, I still make sure to take care of these bad boys so they can keep up with all the beatings I put them through.
        |I know I put my feet through a lot of beatings, but shoes are annoying and I honestly work better without them. Gotta make sure the things that take care of me get taken care of in return, you know?
    ]" 
    
    Quintillus gives you a small genuine smile. "Thanks for asking about it. I know it can be considered vain, but I like to look and feel nice. I used to get a lot of ribbing for it when I was a teen."
rows.translation:
他似乎非常在意自己的外表。为什么会在这方面投入这么多精力？

    听见你的问题，昆因的粉色双眼仿佛开关被拨动一般，瞬间紧盯着你。他坐在座位上，几乎兴奋得浑身发颤。“你是真想知道？我可会讲很久哦。”
    
    你几乎不敢回答“是”。尽管如此，你还是示意昆因继续，自己则在卡座另一侧坐得更舒服些。你的回答让泰勒族同伴露出兴奋的笑容；他身体前倾，把一只耳朵递到前面。
    
    他动了动耳朵。“来，摸摸看！”
    
    [pc.dcb
        |你拒绝了。
    
        兔族翻了个白眼，把耳朵收回，却毫不气馁地继续说了下去。
        |你迟疑着伸出手，摸了摸泰勒族的耳朵。它柔软至极，毛发摩挲着你的掌心，几乎要把你拉进那片温暖之中。
        |你立刻伸出手，摸上泰勒族的耳朵。它柔软至极，毛发摩挲着你的掌心，几乎要把你拉进那片温暖之中。你咯咯笑着，轻轻托起耳朵，在昆因懊恼的目光中拿它蹭了蹭自己的脸颊。
    ]
    
    “我经常运用火焰魔法的某些特性来清洁毛发，让它保持柔软。这就是我的秘诀。身体几乎免疫火焰，也让我更容易把毛发弄得蓬松、梳开所有打结。要是置之不理，它很快就会变得粗糙，我们家的毛发一直都不怎么样。我父亲最后一次出征以后，我常和母亲坐在一起，互相梳理头发之类的。我们会花上好几个小时，把彼此打扮得漂漂亮亮。正是从那时起，我才真正开始在外表上下功夫。”昆因明显骄傲地挺起胸膛，得意地整理起自己。“长大以后，我一直保持这个习惯，又增加了更多步骤。”
    
    [pc.isDK
        |他
        |他向后一靠，接着
    ]抬起一条腿横放在膝上，让脚踝搭在另一条腿的膝盖上。这个动作把视线引向他的[quin.hasPaws|肉垫|赤裸脚掌]；尽管这里地形粗糙，那里依旧干净无瑕。
    
    “[quin.hasPaws
        |虽然不必再像还有双脚时那样担心，但我仍会认真照顾这些宝贝，确保它们承受得住我给它们安排的各种苦差。
        |我知道自己的双脚经常饱受折腾，可鞋子很烦人，而且老实说，不穿鞋时我表现得更好。照顾我的部位，自然也该得到相应的照顾，你懂吧？
    ]”
    
    昆蒂卢斯朝你露出真诚的浅笑。“谢谢你愿意问这些。我知道这样可能显得爱慕虚荣，但我喜欢让自己看起来舒心、感觉舒服。十几岁的时候，我没少因此被人取笑。”

rows.original: What does he plan to do now? He's taking refuge in the Frost Hound for now, but surely he's got an idea of what he'd like to do soon? Quin's ears sag a bit, but just for a moment. Yet the taeleer catches his stride, looking down at his outfit for a moment before returning his pink gaze to you. "For now, I plan to help the village out this way," he starts, tapping on his journal. "I need a bit to cool down and rest after... all that... and then I can start taking on work around Hawkethorne. Even without counting the cult's teachings, I'm still a decent mage and I've got other things I'm good at. I'm sure I can find something." It looks like Quin's pride is one of the few things he has left, and he's determined to pick himself back up on his own. Either way, giving him some time to work out his new normal might be the way to go.
rows.translation: 他接下来有什么打算？眼下他暂时在霜冻猎犬避难，但肯定也想过不久之后要做些什么吧？ 昆因的耳朵垂下少许，不过只持续了一瞬。这名泰勒人很快便重新振作起来，低头看了一眼自己的衣着，然后再次用粉色的双眼望向你。 “目前，我打算用这种方式帮助村子，”他一边说，一边轻敲自己的日志，“经历了……那一切之后，我需要一点时间冷静下来，好好休息，然后便可以开始在鹰棘镇附近接些工作。即便不算邪教传授的东西，我仍是一名不错的法师，也还有其他擅长的事情。我肯定能找到某种工作。” 看来，骄傲是昆因所剩无几的东西之一，而他决心靠自己重新站起来。不管怎样，给他一点时间适应新的生活或许才是正确的选择。

rows.original: [pc.dcb |Looks like he's still fucking around in the Frost Hound. Is he ever gonna make good on what he said previously? |You're just wanting to check in: how are things going on his end? |So how's he doing? ] "I consider myself a proud taeleer man, [pc.name], you know?" Quintillus starts, voice strained. "That being said, I find myself in a difficult spot." You're surprised to see his cheeks flush red; though you lose sight of it as his ears sag and Quin leans over the booth's table, burying his face in his palms shamefully. "I can't find any work – no one will pick up an ex-cultist for help. Garth has been more than accommodating in my staying here, but I fled literally with just the clothes on my back and whatever I had on me; I can't buy gear without funds." He can't find any work at all? You thought for sure that his magic would make him at least somewhat sought after; and, if not that, then his speed would make him perfect for running messages. "Nothing," he says – his voice is muffled, but you can still hear the tinge of misery laced in his words. Quintillus shakes his head and finally lowers his hands. "It comes down to a matter of trust. I may have cut up my robes and renounced the cult, but the distrust runs deep. No one's willing to take a chance on me." [pc.dcb |Okay, and? What's he leading up to? |Since his plans don't seem to be working out, what's next for him? |So, like, what's he gonna do?? ] Quin hesitates, tugging nervously on an ear. After a moment he seems to steel himself and takes a deep breath, honey-pink eyes meet yours. "Actually... I was wondering if you had room for one more? I can guarantee my skills are up to par to travel with you shoulder-to-shoulder. I'm skilled in various magics and I'm not bad with a blade either. My time with the cult has taught me plenty about both seduction and the way they think; given that you're going to be facing them and no doubt getting into risqué situations, I think this arrangement might benefit the both of us. "You didn't have to save me, but you did anyway. Either you liked what I had to offer in our brief fight together or you're kind to a fault, but either way it means I've got a chance to tag along with you and at least try to make things right here." You think for a moment, and your silence is enough for his face to scrunch. Clearly this entire situation is taxing on his pride, but he's making more than a little effort to set that aside and ask for help. What do you want to do?
rows.translation: [pc.dcb |看来他还在霜犬酒馆里无所事事。他到底打不打算兑现之前说过的话？ |你只是想来了解一下：他这边进展如何？ |所以，他最近过得怎么样？ ] “我认为自己是个值得骄傲的泰勒族男人，[pc.name]，你知道吧？”昆蒂卢斯声音紧绷地开口。“话虽如此，我现在陷入了困境。” 你惊讶地看见他双颊泛红；不过，他很快垂下双耳，俯身趴到卡座桌上，羞愧地把脸埋进掌心，让那抹红色从你眼前消失了。 “我找不到任何工作——没人肯雇一个前邪教徒。加斯愿意让我住在这里，已经帮了我太多，可我逃出来时真的只带着身上的衣服和随身物品；没有钱，我就买不起装备。” 他真的任何工作都找不到？你本以为凭他的魔法，至少会有些人想要雇他；即使不用魔法，他的速度也很适合替人传递消息。 “什么都没有。”他的声音有些含糊，但你仍能听出话语中掺杂的痛苦。昆蒂卢斯摇摇头，终于放下双手。“归根结底是信任问题。我或许剪碎了长袍，也脱离了邪教，可不信任早已根深蒂固。没人愿意在我身上冒险。” [pc.dcb |行吧，所以呢？他到底想说什么？ |既然他的计划行不通，接下来准备怎么办？ |所以，他接下来到底要怎么办？？ ] 昆因迟疑片刻，紧张地拉扯着一只耳朵。过了一会儿，他似乎终于下定决心，深吸一口气，蜜粉色双眼与你对视。“其实……我在想，你那边能不能再容下一个人？我保证自己的本领足够与你并肩旅行。我精通多种魔法，剑术也不差。在邪教中的经历让我十分了解诱惑手段和他们的思维方式；既然你今后还要对付他们，肯定也会卷进各种香艳场面，我觉得这种安排对我们双方都有好处。 “你本来不必救我，却还是那么做了。要么你喜欢我们短暂并肩战斗时我展现的本领，要么你善良得过了头；无论如何，这都代表我有机会和你同行，至少能试着在这里弥补自己的过错。” 你思考了一会儿，而你的沉默已经足以让他皱起脸。显然，整件事让他的自尊备受煎熬，可他确实非常努力地把骄傲放到一旁，开口求助。 你打算怎么做？
rows.raw: " [pc.dcb |Looks like he's still fucking around in the Frost Hound. Is he ever gonna make good on what he said previously? |You're just wanting to check in: how are things going on his end? |So how's he doing? ] "I consider myself a proud taeleer man, [pc.name], you know?" Quintillus starts, voice strained. "That being said, I find myself in a difficult spot." You're surprised to see his cheeks flush red; though you lose sight of it as his ears sag and Quin leans over the booth's table, burying his face in his palms shamefully. "I can't find any work – no one will pick up an ex-cultist for help. Garth has been more than accommodating in my staying here, but I fled literally with just the clothes on my back and whatever I had on me; I can't buy gear without funds." He can't find any work at all? You thought for sure that his magic would make him at least somewhat sought after; and, if not that, then his speed would make him perfect for running messages. "Nothing," he says – his voice is muffled, but you can still hear the tinge of misery laced in his words. Quintillus shakes his head and finally lowers his hands. "It comes down to a matter of trust. I may have cut up my robes and renounced the cult, but the distrust runs deep. No one's willing to take a chance on me." [pc.dcb |Okay, and? What's he leading up to? |Since his plans don't seem to be working out, what's next for him? |So, like, what's he gonna do?? ] Quin hesitates, tugging nervously on an ear. After a moment he seems to steel himself and takes a deep breath, honey-pink eyes meet yours. "Actually... I was wondering if you had room for one more? I can guarantee my skills are up to par to travel with you shoulder-to-shoulder. I'm skilled in various magics and I'm not bad with a blade either. My time with the cult has taught me plenty about both seduction and the way they think; given that you're going to be facing them and no doubt getting into risqué situations, I think this arrangement might benefit the both of us. "You didn't have to save me, but you did anyway. Either you liked what I had to offer in our brief fight together or you're kind to a fault, but either way it means I've got a chance to tag along with you and at least try to make things right here." You think for a moment, and your silence is enough for his face to scrunch. Clearly this entire situation is taxing on his pride, but he's making more than a little effort to set that aside and ask for help. What do you want to do? "

rows.original:
His ears shoot up, ramrod straight, at your acceptance. He's unable to school his face, pink eyes shining with relief. You can see his tail-fluff wiggling furiously from where you're standing, proving to you just how nervous he was and just how relieved he is.

        "Shitfuck, I would have sworn you were going to say no," he lets out a heavy breath and his shoulders slump, tension easing.
        
        With a reaction like that, is he sure his pride was what was holding him back?
        
        Quin grimaces, but it fades a moment later. "My pride will recover... eventually... My welfare is more important than my ego right now, even if it smarts horribly."
        
        What else is he needing to be battle ready?
        
        Quintillus reaches over to his book and tugs it across the table, opening it wide. The way he flips the pages with care gives you your first real impression that it's probably more like a personal journal than a guide or just something he uses for paper. Writings and sketches alike cover each page as he turns them, finally settling on a clean page. Without any ceremony, he presses his finger to the paper; as it slips across the surface, ash trails in its wake and marks the paper until it forms an image of those charms you've seen cultists carrying.
        
        "It's simple: I need equipment. I have a weapon already, and my journal doubles as a spellcasting focus for my spells. Wizard Rings are expensive enough that I don't have the funds for them, and I don't have a charm of my own."
        
        You haven't seen any kind of weapon on him; surely he's not going to be punching anything?
        
        Quin snorts, well and truly amused. "Me? Punching people? Do I really look like that kind of bunny?"
        
        The taeleer reaches into a section of his torn cloak, fishing around and pulling out a dagger carved with runes. He sets it softly on the table, handle facing you, so the blade doesn't accidentally mark the wood beneath it. Picking it up, you turn it this way and that in your grasp while pink eyes watch your motions.
        
        [pc.dcb
            |Where the fuck was he keeping that?
            |Where did he even have that stashed?
            |Where did he, like, even have that??
        ]
        
        "Cultists are basically naked under these cloaks. If I wanted to keep anything on me and not risk it being stolen I had to be smart, so I sewed some pockets in mine." He tugs on the cloak, showing you the barely-perceptible pockets on the inside of the butchered garb. "Sometimes you just want to stop and eat a snack during an orgy, you know?"
        
        If he had pockets, why doesn't he have his own charm?
        
        "I already had my journal and my dagger on me when I fled; I didn't have time to grab anything else." Quin tears the parchment out of his journal and slides it to you. "Besides that, I never had a charm to begin with. Only some members have them, and I wasn't one of them. When you've got them, return to me."
rows.translation:
听见你答应，他的耳朵立刻竖得笔直。他无法控制自己的表情，粉色双眼闪烁着如释重负的光芒。你站在原地便能看见他毛茸茸的尾巴疯狂摆动，足以证明他先前有多紧张，如今又有多安心。

        “操他妈的，我还以为你肯定会拒绝。”他长长吐出一口气，双肩随之垂下，紧绷也渐渐消退。
        
        反应这么强烈，他确定之前真正阻碍自己的只是自尊吗？
        
        昆因皱起脸，但神情片刻后便恢复平静。“我的自尊会恢复的……总有一天……眼下，我过得好不好比自尊更重要，即使这滋味痛苦得要命。”
        
        他还需要什么才能做好战斗准备？
        
        昆蒂卢斯伸手拉过自己的书，在桌上摊开。他小心翻页的动作第一次让你真正意识到，与其说这是一本指南或单纯用来写字的东西，它或许更像私人日记。他翻过的每一页都写满文字、绘有草图，最后终于停在一张空白页上。他没有任何铺垫，直接把手指按上纸面；随着指尖滑过，灰烬在身后留下痕迹，一路标记纸张，最终形成了你曾见邪教徒携带的那种护符图案。
        
        “很简单：我需要装备。我已经有武器，日记也能兼作施法媒介。巫师戒指贵得我根本买不起，我自己也没有护符。”
        
        你从没在他身上看见任何武器；他总不会打算挥拳揍人吧？
        
        昆因哼笑一声，显然真的被逗乐了。“我？挥拳揍人？我看起来真像那种兔子？”
        
        泰勒族把手伸进破烂斗篷的一处，摸索片刻后抽出一把刻有符文的匕首。他把匕首轻轻放在桌上，刀柄朝向你，免得刀刃不小心在下方木头上留下划痕。你拿起匕首，在手中来回翻看；粉色双眼则一直注视着你的动作。
        
        [pc.dcb
            |他他妈的把那东西藏在哪儿了？
            |他到底把那东西藏在哪里？
            |所以，他到底是把那东西藏在哪里的？？
        ]
        
        “邪教徒在这些斗篷下面基本等于一丝不挂。要想随身带东西又不被偷，我就得聪明点，于是在自己的斗篷里缝了几个口袋。”他拉起斗篷，让你看见残破衣物内侧那些几乎无法察觉的口袋。“有时候，参加乱交时就是会想停下来吃点零食，你懂吧？”
        
        既然他有口袋，为什么没带自己的护符？
        
        “我逃走时，身上本来就带着日记和匕首；根本没时间再拿别的东西。”昆因从日记里撕下那张纸，推到你面前。“除此以外，我本来就没有护符。只有部分成员会配发，而我不在其中。东西凑齐以后就回来找我。”

rows.original:
His ears droop at your refusal, matching the way his shoulders slump and the way his tail lies listlessly against the booth seat.

        "I can't really blame you; I was part of the Cult, after all. There's nothing saying I'm that trustworthy and all that." He gives you a pained smile. "Thanks again for rescuing me, [pc.name]. I think... I think I'll try to head back home; see my mom again. No use sticking around here if I can't actually be of any help, you know?"
        
        Quin gathers what few things he has, nods to you, and heads for the entrance.
        
        The last you see of him is his fluffy tail disappearing beyond the Frost Hound's doors.
rows.translation:
听到你的拒绝，他的耳朵耷拉下来，肩膀也随之垮下，尾巴无精打采地贴在卡座上。

        “我也不能怪你，毕竟我曾经是邪教的一员。没有任何事情能证明我有多值得信任之类的。”他朝你露出苦涩的笑容。“再次谢谢你救了我，[pc.name]。我想……我想我会试着回家，再去见见妈妈。要是我根本帮不上忙，继续留在这里也没有意义，对吧？”
        
        昆因收拾好自己仅有的几件东西，朝你点点头，随后走向入口。
        
        你最后看到的，是他那条蓬松的尾巴消失在霜冻猎犬的大门外。

rows.original: You set the charm and ring down on the booth's table, Quin leaning forward to examine it. His ears perk up, mottled brown appendages twitching in surprise. "You... actually got it for me." Shock is evident in his voice, pink eyes raising to look at you. Did he doubt you'd be able to do it? [flags.QUINTILLUS_SEX_OFFERED |You already asked him for sex; it shouldn't be so surprising that you'd want him tagging along with you. ] The ex-cultist shakes his head. "I didn't doubt you were capable in the slightest – don't forget, I've seen you fight. I just... I'm surprised." Quintillus slides out of his seat, standing up and looking [pc.isHeight 65 |up |down ] at you with the familiar relief he displayed at your rescue. "You actually trust me, at least enough to have me watch your back in battle; that's what shocked me. Half this town thinks I'm a spy while the other wouldn't piss on me if I was on fire – not my fire but actual fire. You've given me the last things I need to actually stand a fighting chance!" He reaches for the ring, turning it over in his palm and examining it with a shrewd eye. It must pass inspection because he nods and slides it onto a finger. Then, he picks up the charm. Part of his lip curls in distaste, but he pockets it anyway. Quin looks at you with a small grin. "As promised, I'll follow your lead. If there's anyone you need charmed just say the word, and I'll see what I can do. Whether it be wrestling into their sheets or wrestling them to the dirt, never let it be said that I'm not a man of my word. There's just... one last thing." The taeleer takes a deep breath before pink eyes hold your stare steady. "There's a chance we'll eventually come to heads with Tollus himself. If it's at all possible, please let me be the one to deal with him. I've got a grudge the size of Taelia to settle with that shithead." You'll see what happens. Quintillus has joined your party!

rows.original: "[pc.name], do you have a minute?" Casting a curious gaze on your companion, it's obvious that the normally suave bunnyboy is uncharacteristically nervous. [pc.isDK |If he makes it quick. |Sure. What's up? ] "I'll make it quick. Listen, I've noticed that you happen to have an alchemy kit on you, and you aren't half bad with it. I was wondering if you could help me out with something." He's asking you for help? What exactly did he have in mind? "I like my feet, but... what I really want are paws." Paws? "Yes, paws. There isn't really a huge rhyme or reason to it. I've always been envious of other taeleer that had them when I was younger, and I'm absolutely shit at alchemy so I wasn't able to make it happen on my own." He tugs on an ear with two fingers, obviously embarrassed. "If you don't want to waste time with it, pretend I never said anything. Just think it over, will you?"
