        His pink eyes look you over before he finally laughs and nods. "Yeah. Next time. Maybe tomorrow, even. I won't ever turn you down if you need someone to run with, [pc.name]."
rows.translation:
你并没有模仿他的姿势，但也没有对他过于宽容、让他轻易取胜。与他进行一场公平的竞争，既是锻炼自己身材的好方法，也能增进彼此的感情。更不用说，这样你还能了解泰勒到底有多快——虽然你救了他脱离了那个邪教组织，但在他努力训练的时候，你其实从未真正看过他到底能跑多快。

        你们两个人同时从起跑线出发，在第一圈的前半段时间里，始终保持着并驾齐驱的状态，没有任何落后或领先的情况。 [pc.agilityRange 0 42 66
            |然而，在接下来的半圈时间里，情况发生了迅速的变化：在弯道处，昆因轻松地超过了你，甚至在第二圈时拉开了明显的领先优势。不过，泰勒族丝毫没有减缓冲刺的速度；反而是你在感到自己的敏捷性在关键时刻开始下降时，逐渐放慢了速度。
            
            在第二圈时，你才刚刚跑完四分之一的距离，而他已经快要完成整个圈程了。他甚至还没有改变自己平时的慢跑节奏，又一次超过了你。昆蒂卢斯在奔跑过程中突然转身，脸上带着微笑，然后开始慢跑起来。
            
            别担心，我大半生都在跑步。在联盟里，尤其是像这样的赛道上，泰勒族坚持跑步是为了保持健康。因为你永远不知道地下通道会出现在哪里，所以拥有安全的跑步路线是非常重要的。他转过身，继续奔跑……而当你即将完成第三圈时，他开始以轻松的步伐进行第四圈的跑动。

“公平与否，”他边笑着说，边跟在你旁边小跑着。这很有趣，对吧？
            
            [pc.isDK
                |你想要赢。
                |即使你被彻底击败了，他说的也是对的。
            ]我想是的。”

那位曾经加入过邪教的人拍了拍你的肩膀，然后指向终点线说道：“这就是斗志……现在，让我们好好完成这件事吧！
            |你在进入第二圈时还保持着这个速度，直到突然感到自己在冲刺阶段开始吃力起来。昆因会露出会心的笑容，然后加快步伐，逐渐拉开与你之间的距离。每多出那么几步，你就越清楚地意识到，他其实还有更多的能量可以释放出来。要想击败他，唯一的办法就是在比赛后期全力压制他，但只要他继续保持领先优势，这个机会就会越来越渺茫。

第三圈开始了，而泰勒却给了你一个意外：他在你开始加速的同一瞬间也加大了力度，但与你的短暂冲刺不同，他采用的是一种有力且流畅的步伐，迅速拉开了与你的距离。这一动作看起来几乎就像是一次跳跃，但看他落地后的奔跑方式，你会不禁怀疑他的种族是否拥有某种与生俱来的奔跑能力。就在那一瞬间，你就被远远甩在了后面，而你耗费的所有精力也只是让距离缩短了几米而已。当终点线逐渐出现在视线中时，人们清楚地看到，他就是赢家。
            |但不仅仅是第一圈：第二圈也是如此。当你们俩都即将进入第三圈时，他那迫不及待的得意笑容愈发明显了。你们加快了冲刺的速度，而他也不时用眼角的余光留意着你的步伐。

“没错，”尽管距离很近，他还是朝你喊道。太棒了！你速度也真快！”

“那当然啦！”

你加紧了速度，注意到昆因已经不再只是单纯地冲刺了——他在奔跑过程中改变了步幅，变得更长，看起来几乎像是在向前跳跃。尽管它的腿看起来像人类的腿，但泰勒尔的腿部肌肉力量极为强大，因此它能够通过有控制的弹跳来弥补速度上的差距——这简直就像在观看一只野兔不断跳跃以躲避捕食者一样。
            
            马拉赫的后宫啊……你真……速度很快！”

你能感觉到他的体力正在逐渐消耗，但你也明白这场竞争有多激烈。尽管他一心想要获胜，你仍然保持着领先优势，而且你根本没有打算放弃这个优势。是啊，你也是！但最终只有一个人能赢得这场竞争，昆因！”
 

他低声说道，声音小到几乎听不见。当你们俩一起进入最后的冲刺阶段时，他显然已经认定自己会失败。
        ]
        
        你们俩都冲过了终点线，那个高个子的男子深深地吸了一口气。 [pc.isAgile
            |为了掩盖自己那微小的失败
            |放松身心
        ]而在你独自一人在赛道上喘息、恢复体力的时候[party.has quin
            |虽然你们俩都要离开，但在收拾东西的时候，你还是落后了他几步。
            |你拿起自己的东西，轻轻推了他一下，让他有空间继续逃跑。
        ]下次吧，对吧？”

他那双粉红色的眼睛仔细地打量了你一番，最终笑了笑，点了点头。“嗯，下次。也许明天就能吧。如果你需要有人陪你一起跑的话，我绝对不会拒绝的。[pc.name]。”
rows.raw:
"
        You don't mirror his pose, but you don't give him the all-too-easy spanking either. Running a fair race with him will be a good way to work on your fatty body and do a little bonding, after all. Not to mention let you get a gauge of just how fast the taeleer can be; you may have saved him from the cult, but you never really got a good look at just how fast he could run when he's trying to train.

        Both of you take off the starting line and, for the first half of the first lap, are neck-and-neck without any issues. [pc.agilityRange 0 42 66
            |That very rapidly changes, however, in the following half; you find Quin easily outpacing you on the bend and even getting a prominent lead into his second lap. The taeleer doesn't break his sprint in the slightest, though; you're the one slowing down as you feel your agility failing you in your moment of need.
            
            On lap two, you're not even a quarter of the way in as he's wrapping it up. He still hasn't even broken his casual sprinting stride, either, as he overlaps you a second time. Quintillus spins mid-stride, smiling as he swaps to a backwards jog.
            
            "Don't worry about it: I've been running for most of my life. Taeleer do it to stay healthy back in the Alliance, especially on tracks like this. You never know where burrows are, so keeping safe spaces to run is always vital."
            
            He turns around and keeps running... and as you start closing your third lap, he takes up a light jog to run a casual fourth lap.
            
            "Fair or not," he chuckles, trotting beside you. "This is fun, right?"
            
            [pc.isDK
                |You wanted to win.
                |Even if you got completely blown up, he's not wrong.
            ] "I guess so."
            
            The ex-cultist pats your back, nodding toward the finish line. "That's the spirit... now let's finish it properly!"
            |You maintain it into the second lap before you feel yourself starting to struggle in the sprinting pace. Quin steps it up with a knowing grin and slips a few feet out ahead of you, each bit of distance making you realize that he still has more in the chamber to feed. The only way you're going to beat him is to overpower him towards the end, but that window is closing the more he pushes out ahead.
            
            The third lap arrives and the taeleer surprises you: he digs in the same instant you do, but unlike your burst of speed he instead leaps ahead in a powerful, gliding stride. It looks almost like a hop but the way he lands and keeps running makes you wonder if it's some sort of natural running ability his kind has. You're daftly left in the dust in that single motion and all the energy you muster only serves to cut the distance to a few meters. As the finish line comes into view, it's plainly obvious he's the winner.
            |But it's not just the first lap: it's the second one, too. His eager smirk grows as you both approach the third lap, sprinting harder and matching your stride with a glance out of the corner of his eye.
            
            "Yeah," he shouts over at you despite the short distance. "That's it! You're fast, too!"
            
            "Of course I am!"
            
            You run just a touch harder, noticing that Quin isn't just sprinting anymore; his stride changes mid-run into a longer one that looks almost like he's jumping forward. Despite his human-like legs, the taeleer's leg muscles are so powerful that he compensates for the differences in your sheer speed with controlled springs: it's just like watching a hare consecutively hop to elude predators.
            
            "Mallach's harem," he huffs. "You're... fast!"
            
            You feel the energy sapping from him but know how tight this race is. You still have the lead despite his desire to win and you don't plan on giving it up. "Yeah, so are you! But only one of us is going to win this, Quin!"
            
            He mumbles just soft enough to go unheard, lowering his head as you both race into the final sprint with him assuredly the loser.
        ]
        
        You both cross the finish line, the taeleer man taking a long deep breath [pc.isAgile
            |to drown out his narrow loss
            |to unwind
        ] while you pant and recover on your own side of the track. [party.has quin
            |Although you both are leaving, you're a few steps behind him in gathering your things.
            |You get all of your things and give him a small shove as you give him his space to keep running.
        ] "Next time, right?"
        
        His pink eyes look you over before he finally laughs and nods. "Yeah. Next time. Maybe tomorrow, even. I won't ever turn you down if you need someone to run with, [pc.name].""

rows.original:
[party.has quin
        |As you enter the store, Quintillus steps a bit further ahead of you and moves to Ivris first; he actually reaches into one of his belt bags and pulls out his familiar book.
        |The same time you enter Ivris' shop, an all-too-familiar taeleer passes you by: Quintillus. He enters the store with his signature book in hand, smirking over at the wyld elf and shaking it for emphasis.
    ]
    
    "Ivris, I was wanting to talk to you: do you remember before when I visited you and mentioned I was looking for a specific regent?"
    
    The alchemist tilts her head, her hand moving to rest at the corner of her blindfolded eye.
    
    "Quin, right? Yes... you were looking for a type of ivy, I believe?"
    
    The two chatter amongst each other as if you're not even there, but you do manage to catch quite a few important parts in the talk: as brief as it is, it looks like Quintillus is trying his hand at preparing contraceptives and virility boosters alike. However, most of his alchemical knowledge isn't useful in the north; what little he knows are old recipes or use regents one can only find further south. Ivris, to her credit, is quick to give him ideas and suggestions to replace or fix the lack, but it's ultimately a discussion that isn't going to be useful for you. Your knowledge of alchemy at this point is beyond Quin's easy understanding and you already know everything that Ivris is willing to teach. 
    
    When he finally closes his book and steps aside, he simply blushes and scratches the back of his head.
    
    "Heh... sorry, [pc.name]," he says, one of his ears lowering to further show the awkwardness he's feeling. "I guess I got carried away. She's all yours now."
    
    "It's fine. Next time, though, maybe do that when you have free time?"
    
    Your words let Quin relax, but it's clear the taeleer is trying to think of a means to apologize. Finally, he gives you a nudge and smile.
    
    "Just say I owe you one for letting me talk with my study buddy. Cute as she is, though, she's not the kind of girl I like to generally end up with. If you ever convince her-"
    
    Ivris clears her throat, interrupting him and saving both of you from his new line of thinking.[party.has quin
        |
        | In the meantime, he uses it as a perfect opportunity to leave you two alone and no doubt slink back to the Frost Hound.
    ]
    
    "[pc.name], I apologize." She dons her familiar smile and gestures you up to her counter. "How may I help you today?"
rows.translation:
[party.has quin
        |当你走进商店时，昆蒂卢斯走在你的前面，首先走向了艾薇莉丝；他实际上从腰间的包里拿出了那本他熟悉的书。
        |就在你走进艾薇莉丝的商店的那一刻，一个你再熟悉不过的身影从你身边经过——那就是昆蒂卢斯。他手里拿着他那本标志性的笔记本走进了商店，一边笑着看着那个野精灵，一边还不停地摇晃着笔记本以强调他的态度。
    ]
    
    艾薇莉丝，我有事想跟你说：你还记得之前我去看你时，提到我在寻找一位特定的摄政王吗？”
    
    这位炼金术士歪了歪头，手轻轻放在她被蒙住的眼睛那一侧。
    
    昆因特，对吧？是的……我记得你当时在寻找某种常春藤植物吧？”
    
    两人一边聊天，一边似乎完全没注意到你的存在，但你还是听进了不少重要的内容：虽然他们的对话很简短，但看起来昆蒂卢斯正在尝试制作避孕药以及增强性功能的药物。然而，他的大多数炼金知识在北方并不实用；他所掌握的那些知识，要么是过时的配方，要么是需要使用一些在更南边才能找到的材料。值得称赞的是，艾薇莉丝很快就想出了各种办法和建议，来弥补这些不足，但最终这些讨论对你来说可能并没有太大帮助。此时，你对炼金术的了解已经超出了昆因的理解范围，而且你也已经掌握了艾薇莉丝愿意传授的所有知识。
    
    当他终于合上书，走到一旁时，他只是脸红了，然后挠了挠后脑勺。
    
    呵呵……抱歉，[pc.name]，是啊，”他说，其中一只耳朵耷了下来，进一步表现出他此刻的尴尬。“我想我有点太冲动了。现在她完全属于你了。”
    
    “没关系。不过下次，或许可以在你有空的时候再做这件事吧？”
    
    你的话让昆因放松了下来，但很明显，这个泰勒尔仍在想办法为自己道歉。最后，他轻轻推了你一下，然后笑了。
    
    “你就说我欠你一个人情吧，多亏你让我能和我的学习伙伴聊天。虽然她很可爱，但一般来说，她并不是我喜欢的类型。要是你能说服她的话……
    
    艾薇莉丝清了清嗓子，打断了他，从而让你们俩都免于听他继续说那些话。[party.has quin
        |
        | 与此同时，他趁这个机会让你们俩单独相处，然后肯定又会偷偷溜回霜冻猎犬那里。
    ]
    
    "[pc.name]，真的很抱歉。”她露出了那熟悉的微笑，示意你走到她的柜台前。“今天有什么可以帮到您的吗？

rows.original: As you return to the Frost Hound, you notice it's a bit... rowdier. In particular, you see two mercenaries who hang around town in full armor, prodding a finger into Quin's chest.[party.has quin | You don't know when, but he's slipped ahead and already made his way back to his booth! ] "[silly |My friend doesn't like you, |What'd you say to me? ]" the mercenary man yells. "[silly |We're wanted men! |You looking to fight me!? ]" The taeleer, in complete stark opposition to the yelling duo, is completely relaxed. He takes a long drink from his cup before setting it down and looking up at the man. "I don't want any trouble." [silly |The man leans in and turns his hand upside down, pointing upwards at the taeleer's chin. "YOU'LL BE DEAD!" |The man winds a punch back but his buddy grabs his arm and pushes him away. ] "Enough! Stop meddling with this cult freak and let's go! Jen is waiting for us to bring back our scout reports on the deserters!" The bronze-clad mercenary looks at his friend, then back to the taeleer, but finally scoffs and storms off. He passes you without even a moment of hesitation, but his buddy stays long enough to look around the bar. Garth isn't too pleased about the altercation but is at least calming down now that it seems largely defused. As you move closer, though, Quintillus waves you over; the other mercenary hasn't left yet, weirdly enough, and it looks like the two are at least friendly. You approach just long enough to see the other man turn to Quin and cross his arms. "Next time, don't taunt him. That guy is strong enough to rip the tusk out of an orc's mouth and you're over here playing games?" Those pink eyes flit over to you and the taeleer smirks. "Well, I'm not worried about how strong that guy is: I think I might know someone tougher." Despite his knowing gaze, the mercenary doesn't follow and simply sighs. He reaches into his pocket and pulls a pouch out, tossing it onto the nearby table. "Just pay our tab with that. Seriously, you need to remember that not all of us are bad." His final words make the taeleer uncomfortable, giving him a perfect opportunity to leave... but as he does, you're left at the booth with Quin in a moment of very awkward silence. You don't know what happened between them and you're not certain he'd tell you, so right now you have only two choices: stand with him or ignore it.
rows.translation: 回到霜狼旅店时，你发现这里变得有些……更加喧闹。尤其引人注目的是两个全副武装、时常在镇上出没的佣兵；其中一人正用手指戳着昆因的胸膛。[party.has quin |你不知道他是什么时候溜到前面的，可他竟然已经先一步回到了自己的卡座！ ] “嗯，[silly |我朋友不喜欢你， |你刚才对我说什么？ ]”男佣兵大喊。“[silly |我们可是通缉犯！ |你想跟我打架吗！？ ]” 与大吼大叫的两人形成鲜明对比，塔艾勒尔显得无比放松。他长长喝了一口杯中饮料，随后放下杯子，抬头看向男人。 “我不想惹麻烦。” [silly |男人凑近，将手掌倒转，向上指着塔艾勒尔的下巴。“你死定了！” |男人收拳蓄力，但他的同伴抓住手臂，将他推开。 ] “够了！别再招惹这个邪教怪胎，我们走！珍还等着我们带回关于逃兵的侦察报告！” 身穿青铜甲的佣兵看看自己的朋友，又看看塔艾勒尔，最后冷哼一声，怒气冲冲地离开。他从你身旁经过时没有丝毫迟疑，可他的同伴留下来，又在酒馆里环顾了一圈。加斯对这场冲突颇为不满，不过眼看事态基本平息，他至少正渐渐消气。然而，就在你靠近时，昆蒂卢斯挥手叫你过去；奇怪的是，另一个佣兵还没离开，而且两人看起来至少关系还算友好。 你走近时，恰好看到另一个男人转向昆因，抱起双臂。 “下次别再挑衅他。那家伙强壮到能从兽人嘴里拔下獠牙，你居然还敢耍他？” 那双粉色眼睛瞥向你，塔艾勒尔露出坏笑。“好吧，我不担心那家伙有多强：我想，我或许认识一个更厉害的人。” 尽管昆因的目光意味深长，佣兵却没能理解，只是叹了口气。他把手伸进口袋，掏出一个钱袋，扔到旁边的桌上。 “拿这些钱结清我们的酒账。说真的，你得记住，我们并不都是坏人。” 最后那句话令塔艾勒尔感到不自在，也给了佣兵离开的绝佳机会……可等他走后，你和昆因留在卡座旁，陷入片刻无比尴尬的沉默。你不知道他们之间发生过什么，也不确定昆因愿不愿意告诉你，所以眼下只有两个选择：支持他，或者对此视而不见。

As you move closer, though, Quintillus waves you over; the other mercenary hasn't left yet, weirdly enough, and it looks like the two are at least friendly. You approach just long enough to see the other man turn to Quin and cross his arms. "Next time, don't taunt him. That guy is strong enough to rip the tusk out of an orc's mouth and you're over here playing games?" Those pink eyes flit over to you and the taeleer smirks. "Well, I'm not worried about how strong that guy is: I think I might know someone tougher." Despite his knowing gaze, the mercenary doesn't follow and simply sighs. He reaches into his pocket and pulls a pouch out, tossing it onto the nearby table. "Just pay our tab with that. Seriously, you need to remember that not all of us are bad." His final words make the taeleer uncomfortable, giving him a perfect opportunity to leave... but as he does, you're left at the booth with Quin in a moment of very awkward silence. You don't know what happened between them and you're not certain he'd tell you, so right now you have only two choices: stand with him or ignore it."

rows.original: "Quin, don't let him get to you. He's just-" "No," the taeleer sighs, taking the pouch and then looking back at you. "He's right. I shouldn't treat idiots worse than they deserve. You treating me differently is the only reason I didn't get caught and killed." He ensures the pouch is secure on his belt and motions towards the bar; Garth waves back and it's obvious that the tab is transferred onto his own. Even without the full story, it looks like those mercenaries didn't give him too hard of a time. But the ex-cultist does take a long look at you and finally chuckle. "You really were about to try and give me some big comforting speech, huh?" "No," you quickly spiel back. "I was just going to suggest you ignore him. That was it. But it looks like that'd have been enough for you anyway; don't dwell on it, alright?" Quintillus laughs and flops back in his chair. "Really? You surprise me sometimes, [pc.name]. Well, I am glad you said something. I guess I sometimes forget I have some friends here in the north." No problem. But now that he's all squared up, [party.has quin |you tap the booth's table to signify what you really want. "Let's get going, shall we? No getting into any more trouble, got it?" He rolls his eyes but gets up regardless. "Fine... but I won't mind if you change your mind. Staying a little bit longer should be fun, too; it's only fair that I at least enjoy a few drinks if I'm paying off their tab, right?" |you give him a small wave, leaving him to his business and getting back to what you came here for. Hopefully he won't get into any extra trouble while you're not looking. ]
rows.translation: “昆因，别把他的话放在心上。他只是——” “不，”塔艾勒尔叹了口气，拿起钱袋，回头看向你。“他说得对。我不该对那些蠢货做出超过他们应得程度的恶劣行为。正因为你愿意区别对待我，我才没有被抓住杀掉。” 他确认钱袋已经牢牢系在腰带上，然后朝吧台示意；加斯挥手回应，显然已经把那笔酒账转到昆因名下。即使不了解事情的全貌，看起来那些佣兵也没有太过为难他。不过，这名前邪教徒确实久久注视着你，最后轻笑起来。 “你刚才真的准备对我发表一番郑重其事的安慰演说，是吧？” “没有，”你飞快反驳。“我只是想建议你别理他。就这样。不过，看来光是这样对你而言就足够了；别老想着这件事，好吗？” 昆蒂卢斯笑了起来，向后一仰，瘫坐在椅子上。 “真的？[pc.name]，你有时真让我意外。好吧，我确实很高兴你开了口。我想，我偶尔会忘记自己在北方也有一些朋友。” 不用客气。不过，既然他现在已经把事情处理妥当，[party.has quin |你轻敲卡座的桌面，表示自己真正想做什么。“我们走吧，好吗？别再惹上更多麻烦，明白了吗？” 他翻了个白眼，但还是站起身来。“好吧……不过你要是改变主意，我也不介意。再多待一会儿应该也挺有趣；既然我要替他们付酒账，至少也该让我喝上几杯，对吧？” |你向他轻轻挥手，让他继续忙自己的事，自己则回去处理来这里原本要做的事情。希望趁你不注意时，他不会再惹上额外的麻烦。 ]

rows.original: As you near one of Hawkethorne's gates, you and Quin are stopped in a very unceremonious way: one of the gate guards points a spear at the taeleer. "Hold a moment: aren't you that cultist that was allowed in a while back? What are you still doing here when you should be leaving?" The taeleer hesitates, looking between you and the spear before he finally pushes the spear aside. "Excuse me? I was allowed to stay! The others-" The man scoffs at him and keeps his spear low but still aimed toward the taeleer. "Really? You think they let you stay because we wanted you to stick around? The sooner you leave, the better. We never know when you're going to stab us in the back one night; what'll we do when you open the gates and let that cult in here to do something worse than whatever it was you guys did at the temple!?" Quintillus is visibly angered at this, but all he can do is clench his fists. The citizens of Hawkethorne around you are all watching to see if he does anything, no doubt hoping it'll warrant giving them a reason to turn on him. The only one who might stand up for him here is you. The only question is if you should or shouldn't.
rows.translation: 当你靠近鹰棘镇的一座大门时，你和昆因以一种极不客气的方式被拦了下来：一名城门守卫用长矛指着这位泰勒族人。 “等一下：你不就是前段时间获准进城的那个邪教徒吗？你早该离开了，为什么还待在这里？” 泰勒族人犹豫了。他先看看你，又看看长矛，最终伸手将矛尖推向一旁。“你说什么？我已经获准留下！其他人——” 那人嗤之以鼻，仍压低长矛，却继续将矛尖对准泰勒族人。 “是吗？你以为他们允许你留下，就代表我们希望你继续待在这里？你越早离开越好。谁知道哪天晚上你会不会从背后捅我们一刀？要是你打开城门，把邪教徒放进来，让他们干出比你们在神庙里做的事更加恶劣的勾当，我们怎么办！？” 昆蒂卢斯显然被激怒了，可他只能攥紧双拳。周围的鹰棘镇居民全都盯着他，等着看他会不会做出什么举动；他们无疑正盼望他给自己一个群起而攻之的理由。 此刻，唯一可能站出来替他说话的人只有你。问题只在于，你究竟该不该这样做。

rows.original:
"Stop," you speak loud enough for everyone nearby to hear, too. You push the spear away from Quin and step somewhat between the two [pc.isHeight 50
            |meeting his gaze
            |despite being so much shorter than the guard
        ]. "You all let him in and he's helping me fight the cult. None of you helped when Cait was calling for help, did you?'
        
        The gate guard pales at that reminder, quickly averting his gaze from the two of you. "Th-that's not-"
        
        "No, it's not the same. But he left the cult and he hasn't done anything to anyone. He isn't going to open the doors at night, either. You guys are the ones who keep the town safe, right? So stop trying to cast blame elsewhere."
        
        The man is left speechless from those statements alone. He looks between you and the taeleer as if trying to devise some means of getting a foothold again, but finally yields and turns to move back to his post.
        
        The moment he's gone, Quintillus smiles. The way his ears bob shows just how happy he is with that even if saying something right now isn't the right thing to do. All the eyes on the pair of you are already moving elsewhere, leaving you back to your business. Something tells you that Quintillus won't forget this... and something hopefully will be done by the guards to ensure a situation like this doesn't occur again. Next time it could easily end up causing a worse incident and you don't want it to escalate any further than this.
        
        You shake those thoughts and take the lead again, though, eager to move on and keep about your business before you get mired down by someone else wanting to point fingers at Quin.

住手，”你大声说道，让周围所有人都能听到。你将长矛从昆因身上推开，然后站在他们两人中间。 [pc.isHeight 50
            |与他对视
            |尽管它的长度远远短于那道守卫……
        ]你们全都让他进了镇子，现在他还在帮助我对抗那个邪教组织。可是当凯特求救的时候，你们却没有一个人伸出援手，对吧？”
        
        门卫听到这话顿时面露难色，迅速将目光从你们两人身上移开：“那、那不一样……”
        
        “不，确实不一样。但他已经离开了那个邪教组织，也没有伤害过任何人。而且他晚上也不会去开门。守护这个小镇安全的应该是你们吧？所以别再试图把责任推到别人身上了。
        
        仅仅听那些话，那个人就无话可说了。他目光在你和泰勒族之间来回扫视，似乎在试图寻找重新站稳脚跟的方法，但最终还是放弃了，转身回到了自己的位置。
        
        等他走后，昆蒂卢斯露出了微笑。他耳朵抖动的样子清楚地表明，他对此感到非常开心，尽管现在说些什么可能并不是最恰当的做法。所有人的目光都已经转移到了你们俩身上以外的地方，你们也就得以继续做自己的事情了。不过，你有种预感，昆蒂卢斯绝对不会忘记这件事的。希望守卫们能采取一些措施，确保这种事情不再发生。下次如果再发生，很可能会引发更严重的后果，而我们肯定不希望事情进一步恶化。

rows.raw: "You rescued Quin because he's not like the others. You need to stop this sort of treatment now before it gets worse."

rows.original:
The silence between the two doesn't get filled with any defenses. The taeleer looks at you but sees your lack of involvement as a betrayal, quickly lowering his head in shame before turning toward the guard.

        "I apologize," he mutters. "I had no idea what the cult-"
        
        The guard finally lowers the spear the rest of the way, laughing at the taeleer.
        
        "You think I care if you knew what they were doing? You expect me to believe you had no idea at all when you met those weirdos?"
        
        Quintillus lets him talk but doesn't give him an answer; instead, the taeleer walks past the gate and lets everyone snicker at his back. You follow along, too, but realize that it may not be so impossible for Quin to have been out of the loop. He doesn't look guilty right now: he looks like someone who was betrayed. But given how public this is and how you just left him to dry, it's unlikely you'll get him to talk about it. You'll just have to hope he'll find a way to earn the town's trust on his own.
        
        In the meantime, you have an adventure to get back to.

rows.original:
Has he been to visit them recently?

    "Of course! I visit them whenever I get the chance. They're growing so quickly; it seems like there's something new every time I visit them. [rand
        |Teela has the cutest chuffs, and Magnus has already managed to lift his head.
        |You know they're already starting to roll over? It's crazy how fast they're growing.
        |Our daughter smiled at me already, smiled! She's absolutely adorable. We'll have to beat the boys off her with a stick, I swear.
        |Our son is already trying to push himself up. He's bound and determined to explore.
    ] I'm afraid I'm going to blink and they'll be all grown up, you know?"
    
    How does he feel, being a dad?
    
    "I've always wanted a big family, one day; give any kids I had a lot of siblings, so they wouldn't grow up without that sibling support like I did. My mom did a lot — and so did my dad, when he was with us — but maybe things wouldn't have gone the way they did if I'd had someone to tell me I was an idiot and a moron a lot earlier." He shrugs, one ear twitching like it was physically trying to brush past it. "[quin.trained
        |I want to make sure I do right by them.
        |I need to figure out what to do," he starts, somber and not quite bashful. "I don't want them to grow up disappointed in their old man.
    ]"
    
    [var0
        |What about his other kids?
        
        Quin hums thoughtfully, planting one ankle on his knee as he chats. "I'd like to be involved in their lives too, should they want it. At the very least I plan to introduce them to each other and try to foster some familial ties so they can be there for each other if I'm ever not able to.[quin.relationshipRange 16 
            | You're important to me [pc.name], so it'd make me happy if you were in their lives, too.
        ]"
    ]
rows.translation:
他最近去看过孩子们吗？

    “当然！只要有机会，我就会去看他们。他们长得太快了；每次见面，好像都会出现某种新变化。[rand
        |缇拉发出的轻哼最可爱了，马格努斯甚至已经能抬起头。
        |你知道他们已经开始学着翻身了吗？长得这么快，简直不可思议。
        |我们的女儿已经对我笑过了，真的笑了！她可爱得不得了。我敢说，以后我们得拿棍子赶走那些追她的小子。
        |我们的儿子已经试着撑起身体了。他铁了心想要到处探索。
    ]我真怕只是眨眨眼，他们就全都长大成人了，你懂吧？”
    
    当了父亲，他有什么感受？
    
    “我一直希望有朝一日能拥有一个大家庭；让自己的孩子有很多兄弟姐妹，不会像我一样，在成长过程中缺少手足的支持。母亲为我做了很多——父亲和我们在一起时也是如此——不过，要是当初有个人能更早告诉我，自己究竟有多蠢、多白痴，事情也许就不会发展成后来的样子。”他耸耸肩，一只耳朵轻轻抽动，仿佛真的想把这件事抛到脑后。“[quin.trained
        |我想确保自己好好对待他们。
        |我得想清楚今后该怎么做。”他神情严肃地开口，却又不太像在害羞。“我不希望他们长大后对自己的老爸失望。
    ]”
    
    [var0
        |那他的其他孩子呢？
        
        昆因若有所思地哼了一声，边说边把一只脚踝架到膝盖上。“如果他们愿意，我也希望能参与他们的人生。至少，我打算让孩子们彼此认识，试着培养一些亲情纽带；这样一来，假如哪天我无法陪伴，他们也能相互扶持。[quin.relationshipRange 16
            |你对我很重要，[pc.name]，所以如果你也能成为他们生活中的一部分，我会非常开心。
        ]”
    ]

rows.original: [flags.VIOLETTE_MET |Walking into the nursery greets you with the sight of your mother-in-law, her long brown hair settled in soft curls as she rocks your daughter Teela in her arms. Quin stands next to her in modest clothing, blowing raspberries against the cheeks of your baby boy. Upon seeing you, Violette's honey pink eyes light up, sliding your daughter to her son who takes hold of her with expert precision. "[pc.name]! There's my favorite [pc.mf|son|daughter]-in-law!" She wraps her arms around you in a quick hug before taking a step back and giving you a thorough twice-over, gently squeezing your arms where her hands remain. "How are you feeling? Doing alright?" |Stepping into the nursery greets you with the sight of your bunny-[quin.relationshipRange 0 16|friend|lover], dressed in the modest clothing he's picked up since the birth of your kids. He's holding your son, blowing raspberries on Magnus' cheeks, earning ear-splitting giggles from the little look-alike. It's then that you notice the taeleer woman standing next to him, holding your daughter. She has the same curly brown hair that Quin does, and when she turns slightly, you can see the same honey-pink in her eyes that your companion does. Your arrival doesn't go unnoticed, as you see one of Quin's ears twitch before he turns towards you, eyes lighting up when he sees you. He balances Magnus in one arm, beckoning you over and gesturing to the woman at his side. "[pc.name], I want you to meet someone. This is Violette, my mother. Mom, this is [pc.name], who I mentioned in my letter." The newly-named Violette glances from Quin to you, back to Quin, before settling firmly on you again. She gestures for Quin to take your daughter before sliding up to you and folding you into a tight, warm hug. "None of that Violette nonsense, you hear? You call me Mom." She takes a step back before giving you a very intense twice-over, looking for any perceived discomfort. "How are you feeling? Doing alright?" ] [pc.isBimbo |You're okie dokie! And like, it's so cool to see her! Where'd she come from? |You're doing fine. Though you are curious as to what she's doing here. ] "I wrote back home when you told me you were pregnant, remember?" Quin says, expertly juggling two squirmy taeleer babies. "I didn't expect that you'd come to visit though." "And miss the chance to meet my grandkids? Absolutely not." She huffs, as if he was silly for thinking that she wouldn't come visit despite the state of the world right now. "I was surprised to [quin.trained |receive a letter saying I was gonna be a grandma |suddenly hear from my son again — much less with news that I was going to be grandma — especially since I haven’t heard from him in a long while ]," Violette tugs a lovingly-creased letter out of the pocket of her side pouch, excitedly rambling as she waves it delightedly. "I'm definitely not complaining though, since [quin.trained |it seems like he's finally starting to get back on the right track. And I’ve always wanted to be a grandma |I've always wanted grandkids ]." She suddenly scowls mid-breath, "I wanted to be here for the birth, but I had a lot of things to wrap up back home. On top of that, with the roads being as unsafe as they are recently, my travel got held up more than I would have liked. I'm also not young anymore, and I'm definitely more out of practice from my adventuring days than I thought I was." "But you're okay, right?" Quin asks, worried. Teela takes the brief distraction to reach up and grip onto one of his ears, baby-strength in full effect as she tugs it into her mouth to teethe on. Her dad grunts, trying to gently tug his ear from her at the same time as not waking your son, who's fallen asleep in his other arm. "Oh, don't you fuss, I'm alright." Violette says, scooping Magnus into her arms so Quin can rescue his poor ear. "I may be rusty, but I'm tougher than I look." Will she be here long? "I think I'll be here for a few days, but I can't stay too long, since I've gotta get back home. Gwyn's been darling enough to offer me a place to stay for my visit, so don't you worry about little old me. But do be a dear and drop by to see me, okay?"
rows.translation: [flags.VIOLETTE_MET |走进育儿室，你看到昆因的母亲将一头棕色长发烫成柔软卷发，正抱着女儿缇拉轻轻摇晃。昆因穿着朴素衣物站在一旁，对着你家男宝宝的脸颊吹噗噗声。见到你，维奥莱特蜜粉色的眼睛顿时亮起，把女儿递给自己的儿子；他以熟练而精准的动作稳稳接住。 “[pc.name]！我最喜欢的[pc.mf|女婿|儿媳]来了！”她飞快地抱了你一下，随后退开一步，把你从头到脚仔细看了两遍，双手仍留在你臂上轻轻捏着。“感觉怎么样？还好吗？” |走进育儿室，你看见兔子[quin.relationshipRange 0 16|朋友|恋人]。自从孩子出生后，他便换上了自己挑选的朴素衣服。他抱着你们的儿子，对马格努斯的脸颊吹噗噗声，逗得这个小翻版发出震耳欲聋的咯咯笑。 这时你才注意到站在他身旁、抱着女儿的泰勒尔女子。她有着与昆因相同的棕色卷发；当她稍稍转身时，你也看见了与你同伴如出一辙的蜜粉色双眼。 你的到来并未被忽视。昆因一只耳朵抽动，随后转向你；见到你时，他的双眼顿时亮起。他用一条胳膊稳稳托住马格努斯，招手让你过去，又示意身旁的女子。 “[pc.name]，我想介绍个人给你认识。这是维奥莱特，我母亲。妈，这位是[pc.name]，就是我信里提到的那个人。” 刚得知姓名的维奥莱特先看看昆因，又看看你，再看回昆因，最后把目光牢牢落回你身上。她示意昆因接过女儿，随后走近，将你揽入一个紧密而温暖的拥抱。 “别叫维奥莱特那么生分，听见没？叫我妈妈。”她退开一步，再次极其仔细地上下打量你，寻找任何不适的迹象。“感觉怎么样？还好吗？” ] [pc.isBimbo |你一切都好！而且，能见到她真的超酷！她是从哪里来的？ |你感觉很好。不过，你确实好奇她为什么会在这里。 ] “我得知你怀孕后给家里写了信，还记得吗？”昆因熟练地应付着两个扭来扭去的泰勒尔宝宝。“不过我没想到你真会过来。” “让我错过见孙辈的机会？绝不可能。”她哼了一声，仿佛他居然认为如今世道如此，她便不会前来探望，实在可笑。“我很惊讶自己会[quin.trained |收到一封说我就要当奶奶的信 |突然又收到儿子的消息——更别说还说我要当奶奶了——毕竟我已经很久没有他的音讯 ]。”维奥莱特从腰包口袋里掏出一封被珍爱地折出褶皱的信，一边兴奋地挥舞，一边滔滔不绝。“当然，我绝不会抱怨，毕竟[quin.trained |看起来他终于开始重回正轨。而且我一直想当奶奶 |我一直想要孙辈 ]。”她说到一半忽然皱起眉，“我本来想赶上孩子出生，可家里还有许多事必须处理。再加上最近道路不安全，行程耽搁得远比我希望的久。我也不年轻了；现在才发现，自己荒废冒险本领的程度比想象中更严重。” “可你没事吧？”昆因担忧地问。缇拉趁他分心伸手抓住一只耳朵，使出婴儿的全部力气，把它扯进嘴里磨牙。她父亲低哼着，既想把耳朵轻轻抽回来，又怕吵醒另一条手臂里已经睡着的儿子。 “哎呀，别瞎操心，我没事。”维奥莱特把马格努斯接进怀中，好让昆因拯救自己可怜的耳朵。“我的本事或许生疏了，可我比看起来结实。” 她会在这里待很久吗？ “我想会待上几天，但不能太久，毕竟还得回家。格温很贴心，愿意在我来访期间给我一个住处，所以别为我这个老太婆操心。不过要乖乖常来看看我，好吗？”

"I was surprised to [quin.trained |receive a letter saying I was gonna be a grandma |suddenly hear from my son again — much less with news that I was going to be grandma — especially since I haven’t heard from him in a long while ]," Violette tugs a lovingly-creased letter out of the pocket of her side pouch, excitedly rambling as she waves it delightedly. "I'm definitely not complaining though, since [quin.trained |it seems like he's finally starting to get back on the right track. And I’ve always wanted to be a grandma |I've always wanted grandkids ]." She suddenly scowls mid-breath, "I wanted to be here for the birth, but I had a lot of things to wrap up back home. On top of that, with the roads being as unsafe as they are recently, my travel got held up more than I would have liked. I'm also not young anymore, and I'm definitely more out of practice from my adventuring days than I thought I was." "But you're okay, right?" Quin asks, worried. Teela takes the brief distraction to reach up and grip onto one of his ears, baby-strength in full effect as she tugs it into her mouth to teethe on. Her dad grunts, trying to gently tug his ear from her at the same time as not waking your son, who's fallen asleep in his other arm. "Oh, don't you fuss, I'm alright." Violette says, scooping Magnus into her arms so Quin can rescue his poor ear. "I may be rusty, but I'm tougher than I look." Will she be here long? "I think I'll be here for a few days, but I can't stay too long, since I've gotta get back home. Gwyn's been darling enough to offer me a place to stay for my visit, so don't you worry about little old me. But do be a dear and drop by to see me, okay?" "

rows.original:
Violette is a petite taeleer woman standing roughly 5'6" tall, with long, curly brown hair put in a low-wrapped ponytail and draped over one shoulder. Her eyes are the same honey-pink color as her son's, and her long, perky ears have the same mottled spots as her son and grandson. She's got fluffy tufts of fur around her wrists and a soft fluffy mane of fur around her neck, but you can't see if she's got more elsewhere.

    She wears an ankle-length dress, with a matching corset vest over top of it. Across her waist lies a sturdy belt with several pouches attached, rustling with every step she takes. Leather boots adorn each foot, sturdy and well-worn.
rows.translation:
维奥莱特是一名身材娇小的泰勒族女性，身高约5英尺6英寸。她把棕色长卷发扎成低低缠绕的马尾，垂在一侧肩头。她的双眼与儿子一样呈蜜粉色，那对细长挺立的耳朵上也带着和儿孙相同的斑驳花纹。她的手腕周围生着蓬松的簇毛，颈间则环绕着柔软蓬松的鬃毛，但你看不出她身体其他部位是否也覆盖着毛发。

    她穿着一条长及脚踝的连衣裙，外面套着相配的束腰背心。腰间系着一条结实的腰带，上面挂着好几个小袋，每走一步都会沙沙作响。她的双脚穿着结实耐用、已有不少磨损痕迹的皮靴。

"For you? I'll never run out of hugs." |[pc.dcb |So here's what's gonna happen: she's gonna open her arms, and you're going to get a nice fucking hug. |Is she possibly open to a hug? |Does she like hugs? "I'm always open for hugs, especially for [quin.married|family|you]. Come here, sweetie." ] You sink into her arms with little grace, wrapping yours around the former warrior-bunny who's gone soft with age. She's warm in all the ways a mom is, her embrace soft yet fierce with underlying protectiveness. It's a sleepy sort of warmth, one that makes your stomach fuzzy and lets you forget — for just a moment — everything that awaits you outside this building. It's a couple of minutes before you manage to pull yourself away from her. Violette gives you a soft smile, hands crossed over one another and resting in front of her belly, like she's trying to prevent herself from reaching out and pulling you back in. Not that you would've minded that. "Better?" She asks softly. Better.

rows.original: You'd like to know more about her. "Me?" Violette's ears perk in surprise, twitching slightly. "You flatter me. What specifically?" Just anything; her life before, her husband, her life now. You just want to get to know her.[party.has quin | "It's been a while since I've gotten to hear you tell stories, Mom." He grins, turning to you. "She always gets heart-eyed when she talks about meeting my dad." He deftly dodges a smack from Violette, snickering all the while. ] "You just want to hear an old woman ramble... Oh, where should I start?" She hums, leading you to a table to take a seat, patting the spot next to her. You follow her lead, taking the seat and turning to give her your attention. [party.has quin |Quin trails right behind you, just as eager as you are to hear these stories from his mom. ] "Let's see... My parents met when they were adventurers; they got together and settled down after a full decade of traveling. It's not all that uncommon to see a dynamic like that, back home in Taelia. Though I was an only child, which was rare for a taeleer family. My mom got really sick not too long after having me, you see; she never quite got over what it was she had and her body wasn't able to carry any more kids after the illness was done with her. "As for my childhood, I grew up on a farm. I loved playing in the mud and helping out when I could, but I always wanted to see more, do unique things, maybe go out and kick some ass — the basics, you know? I applied to an adventurer's guild the moment I came of age." Why an adventurer's guild? Surely there were other ways she could do what she wanted. "That was part of the problem, see — I didn't know what I wanted to do, but by the gods I was gonna do something! While I wasn't magically inclined, I was quick, good with a blade, and I could take a hit. The adventurer's guild I signed with put me in contact with a decent group in need of some extra bodies, and I went gladly." She sighs, voice taking on a bit of a dreamy tone. Is that around when she met her husband? "It is!" She beams. "Magnus and I signed up around the same time and joined up with the same group. He was certainly a handsome man, but boy was he shy. The only way he'd actually work up the courage to me was behind a set of playing cards – I was actually the one who asked him out first. He was such a sweetheart; he just about had a conniption when we found out I was pregnant, though. Proposed to me on the spot and insisted on taking me home to meet his family." Her expression turns wistful as she reminisces. What happened after that? "Well... we left the group and headed back home to the Alliance. I met his family, we bought a house, and a few months later, out popped Quintillus! We had saved enough from our adventuring time that neither of us had to work straight away, but Magnus still wanted to find a way to support us. He started looking into ways he could make use of his abilities, and set his eyes on Taelia's Talons. It took a while, but he got in! He was so excited..." She trails off, expression falling. "Is there anything else, dear?"
rows.translation: 你想更加了解她。 “我？”维奥莱特惊讶地竖起双耳，耳朵微微抽动。“你太抬举我了。具体想知道什么？” 什么都可以；她从前的生活、她的丈夫，还有她现在的生活。你只是想更加了解她。[party.has quin | “我已经很久没听你讲故事了，妈妈。”他咧嘴一笑，又转向你。“她每次谈到与我父亲相遇的经历，眼睛都会变成爱心。”维奥莱特抬手拍去，他却灵巧躲开，始终窃笑个不停。 ] “你只是想听一个老妇人唠叨……哦，我该从哪里说起？”她轻哼着把你领到一张桌旁坐下，拍了拍身边的位置。你依照她的意思坐下，转过身，专心听她讲述。[party.has quin |昆因紧跟在你身后，同样迫不及待地想听母亲讲述这些故事。 ] “让我想想……我的父母是在当冒险者时认识的；他们旅行了整整十年，之后走到一起并定居下来。在我的故乡泰莉娅，这样的经历并不罕见。不过，我确实是独生女，这对泰勒族家庭来说很少见。你看，我母亲生下我后不久便患了重病；她始终没有彻底摆脱那场疾病，而等病魔终于放过她时，她的身体已经无法再孕育其他孩子。 “至于童年，我在一座农场长大。我喜欢在泥地里玩耍，也喜欢尽己所能帮忙，但我始终想看看更广阔的世界、做些不同寻常的事，也许出去狠狠教训几个坏蛋——都是些很普通的愿望，你明白吧？所以，刚一成年，我就申请加入了冒险者公会。” 为什么选择冒险者公会？她想做那些事情，肯定还有其他方法。 “问题就在这里——我根本不知道自己想做什么，可诸神在上，我一定要做出点事情来！虽然我没有魔法天赋，但我动作敏捷、擅长用剑，也很耐打。我签约的冒险者公会帮我联系到了一支需要补充人手的优秀队伍，而我也欣然加入。”她叹了口气，声音染上一丝梦幻般的语调。 她就是在那时遇到丈夫的吗？ “没错！”她喜笑颜开。“马格努斯和我差不多同时签约，又加入了同一支队伍。他确实十分英俊，可天哪，他实在太害羞了。只有躲在一副纸牌后面，他才有勇气接近我——其实，最初是我主动约他出去的。他真是个甜心；不过，我们发现我怀孕时，他几乎当场惊慌失措。他立刻向我求婚，坚持带我回家拜见家人。”回忆往事时，她的表情变得怀念而感伤。 后来发生了什么？ “后来……我们离开队伍，回到联盟的故乡。我见了他的家人，我们买下一栋房子；几个月后，昆蒂卢斯便呱呱坠地！冒险期间攒下的钱足以让我们暂时不必工作，但马格努斯仍然想找到养家的方式。他开始寻找能够发挥自己能力的工作，最后把目光投向了塔莉娅之爪。虽然花了一些时间，但他成功加入了！他当时那么兴奋……”她的声音逐渐低落，脸上的表情也黯淡下来。 “亲爱的，还有什么想问的吗？”

rows.original:
The roads really aren't safe right now; is she okay?

    Violette smiles but waves you off. "I may be a bit rusty, but I still do alright." She brings her arms up and flexes. The muscles contract more than enough for you to see her bulging biceps under what you thought was a soft padding of fat. "I lost my sword though. I'll buy another one before I leave."
rows.translation:
现在的道路实在算不上安全，她一个人没问题吗？

    维奥莱特笑着摆摆手。“我也许有些生疏了，但身手还过得去。”她抬起双臂发力绷紧肌肉。原先看似柔软脂肪的部位随之隆起，让你清楚看见她鼓胀的肱二头肌。“不过我的剑丢了。出发前我会再买一把。”

rows.original: The bunny matriarch lights up, ears wiggling happily. "Quin was the fussiest baby, can you believe it? Always wanting to crawl around and explore, never slowing down and making his dad and I chase after him — and he was always, always getting into things, especially what he wasn't supposed to. It was like the words %"Don't touch that" really meant %"Please, help yourself"." [party.has quin |"Mom, please." Quin pleads, ears folded tight against his head. There's a deep red flush across his cheeks, and he looks like he's two seconds from crawling under the nearest rock and hiding there until she leaves. "Oh, hush you," she huffs, planting her hands on her hips. "I've always wanted to engage in the time honored tradition of embarrassing my son in front of his partner, and now I get to." Please, go on! "Not you too!" He groans. |He's definitely the type to get into things he shouldn't be getting into, given how you met him. ] "It was actually during one of these incidents that we learned he had an aptitude for magic. Almost set our house on fire, I swear." How'd that end up going? "Well, I wasn't all that happy about it at first. His dad, though — his dad was so excited about it. Magic doesn't run in his side of the family, and no one in mine's really been able to use it since my Gran. Magnus dug out a bunch of old books he'd kept since our adventuring days and took Quin out to practice a bunch after that. Came home more than once missing an eyebrow or two, but I'd never seen them so excited and laugh-happy so I couldn't really tell them to stop." She sighs. "Those were some happy days."

Magnus dug out a bunch of old books he'd kept since our adventuring days and took Quin out to practice a bunch after that. Came home more than once missing an eyebrow or two, but I'd never seen them so excited and laugh-happy so I couldn't really tell them to stop." She sighs. "Those were some happy days." '

rows.original: "We've got tons of extended family, but as for my side it's just me. My parents have been gone for some 10 years now and I don't have any aunts, uncles or siblings." She gives you an almost pained smile. What about her husband's family? Violette brightens up at your question. "He has such a large family! Twelve brothers and sisters, almost all of them with families of their own. It was like a baby bunny horde when we'd gather for family get-togethers. They're all grown up now too, just like Quin; all off having their own adventures." She sighs wistfully. How many cousins does Quin have, exactly? "A whopping 86, if you don't count the ones that have married into the family!" [party.has quin |Violette suddenly pivots towards Quin, eyes twinkling. "Did you know that Vera had a baby?" Quin gasps, eyes going wide and grin growing across his face. "She did not!" "She did! And Anton brought home a partner — a lovely man by the name of Byron; said they were already thinking about settling down and adopting!" Your bunny boy groans, ears drooping. "I've missed so much," he laments. "I'll be sure to tell them that you're thinking of them, and that their troublemaker of a cousin has a truly wonderful person to watch his back. They'll be so jealous that I've gotten to see you and the kids first. They've been clambering ever since I got your letter." They share a few chuckles before she smiles. "Is there anything else you wanted to talk about, dear?" |That's a pretty large family! "It's pretty average sized for a taeleer family, but I understand what you mean, coming from such a small family myself. I'm as happy as can be knowing I'm a grandmother now." Did Quin tell her that he named your boy after his dad? "He did," she says quietly, her eyes shining. The smile she gives you is watery, and full of unspoken emotion as she twiddles with the ring on her left hand. "It means the world to me. I know Magnus would've burst into tears the moment he heard it." Violette clears her throat and dabs at her eyes, reaching for her composure. "Is there anything else you wanted to talk about, dear?" ]
rows.translation: “我们的旁系亲属多得不得了，不过我这边就只剩下我了。我的父母大约十年前就已经去世，我也没有姑姑、叔叔或兄弟姐妹。”她朝你露出一个近乎痛苦的微笑。 那她丈夫的家人呢？ 听到你的问题，维奥莱特顿时眼前一亮。“他有一个好大的家庭！他有十二个兄弟姐妹，而且几乎每个人都组建了自己的家庭。以前全家聚会时，那场面简直像是一大群兔宝宝聚在一起。现在他们也都长大了，和昆因一样，各自在外面经历着自己的冒险。”她怅然地叹了口气。 昆因究竟有多少个堂表兄弟姐妹？ “整整八十六个，而且还没把嫁娶进家门的人算进去！”[party.has quin |维奥莱特突然转向昆因，双眼闪闪发亮。“你知道薇拉生宝宝了吗？” 昆因倒吸一口气，眼睛睁得滚圆，脸上也露出了灿烂的笑容。“才没有呢！” “她真的生了！安东还带回来一位伴侣——一个名叫拜伦的可爱男人；他们说已经在考虑定居下来，然后领养孩子了！” 你的兔子男孩耷拉下耳朵，发出一声懊恼的呻吟。“我错过了好多事，”他悲叹道。 “我一定会告诉他们，你一直惦记着大家，也会告诉他们，他们那个爱惹麻烦的堂表兄弟有一位非常了不起的人照应着。他们一定会嫉妒我第一个见到了你和孩子们。自从我收到你的信，他们就一直吵着也想来看你。” 他们一起笑了几声，随后她露出了微笑。 “亲爱的，你还想聊些别的什么吗？” |那还真是一个庞大的家庭！ “对泰勒族家庭来说，这只能算平均规模，不过我自己来自一个小家庭，所以我明白你的意思。一想到自己现在已经当上了祖母，我就高兴得不得了。” 昆因有告诉她，他用父亲的名字给你们的男孩命名吗？ “他说了，”她轻声回答，双眼泛着光芒。她一边摆弄左手的戒指，一边向你露出含泪的微笑，其中饱含着无法言表的情感。“这对我意义非凡。我知道，马格努斯听到后一定会当场哭出来。” 维奥莱特清了清嗓子，抹去眼角的泪水，努力重拾平静。 “亲爱的，你还想聊些别的什么吗？” ]

rows.original: Does she have any advice? "[rand |Don't wait or make excuses to do things for each other, just do them. You never know when or if something will happen and one of you doesn't come home again. |It's always a good time to stop and smell the roses. Ignoring them leads you to eventually forget why you've planted them in the first place. |Don't believe what others tell you your kids will be, they'll tell you themselves." What does she mean by that? "If a kid shows a lot of interest in books and more scholarly pursuits, believe them; if they show a lot of interest in the physical, believe them. Don't try to make them into something they can't or don't want to be. At the same time, I've never heard of anyone being harmed by learning a solid, well rounded set of skills. |Kids start developing their own personalities incredibly young; yours will soon, if they haven't already. Be there to support that development. |I know it doesn't apply much here," she says, gesturing at the nursery, "but sleep when the baby sleeps. You won't be getting a whole lot of it in the first few years. ]"

rows.original:
[party.has viviane|As the [party.som||two|three] of you walk up to Viviane's weathered door, she steps in front of you[party.som||| and [comp2.name]]. She reaches forward and presses her hand against the thick wood and whispers some eldritch incantation under her breath. The entrance pulses with blue light for but a moment before fading away, leaving behind only the mundane entryway. 

    She reaches to the door's handle and pushes the portal open. "Shall we?" the witch says with a sweeping invitation as she holds the door for you[party.som||| and [comp2.name]].
    
    You accept her invitation and step into her ancestral dwelling, stirring up some of the slight dust that had settled during her time spent traveling with you. "Hmmm... I should see if I can find Grandmother's enchantment recipe for the automated broom lying around somewhere if I'm going to be away this often, shouldn't I?[silly| The one she got from that mecian should suffice...]" Viv mutters to herself as she shuts the door. "To the seating room, then."
    
    The [party.som||pair|three] of you travel the short distance to your usual gathering place within the house and take your now-customary places. "So, why'd you want to visit this home of mine?[var0| I've gotten the chance to make a few stops during our travels and have been able to restock my alchemy supplies, should you wish to buy some odds and ends. I also have some special projects I've either worked on or found, if those are more your speed.]"
    
    |[party.Yall] walk up the steps of the witch's porch and to the weathered door. Even through the thick wood, you can hear standard commotion of Viviane hard at work on her latest magical advancements. A quick rap on the door, however, is still enough to rouse her attention and summon her to the door. She opens it almost immediately, greeting you with her usual [viviane.isDemon|smirk|smile] and revealing bow. 
    
    "Why[viviane.fucked| hello, [pc.mascFem|handsome|gorgeous].|, if it isn't my favorite visitor!] Come in, come in." She waves [party.som|you|the two of you|the three of you] in and leads you to the increasingly worn-in seats in the living room, that you may [party.solo||all ]sit and converse. 
    
    "Well, [viviane.isDemon|[party.solo|what brings my lovely corruptor to my humble abode?|what brings the [pc.title] to this den of mine?]|[flags.VIV_DATE|my dear, what do you need of this humble witch?|what does the [pc.title] need of this humble witch?]][var0| I've gotten the chance to make a few stops since we last saw one another and have been able to restock my alchemy supplies, should you wish to buy some odds and ends. I also have some special projects I've either worked on or found during my travels, if those are more your speed.]"]
rows.translation:
[party.has viviane|当你们[party.som||两人|三人]走近薇薇安那扇饱经风霜的大门时，她走到你[party.som|||和[comp2.name]]前面。她伸出手掌按住厚重的木门，低声念出某种诡秘咒语。入口泛起蓝光，片刻后便消退无踪，只留下一道平凡无奇的门扉。

    她伸手握住门把，将门推开。“请进？”女巫替你[party.som|||和[comp2.name]]扶住门扉，挥手邀请。
    
    你接受邀请，踏进她祖传的住宅；薇薇安随你旅行期间，屋里积下了一层薄薄的灰尘，如今被你们的脚步搅动起来。“嗯……既然我以后经常要离开，或许该看看能否找到祖母给自动扫帚附魔的配方，对吧？[silly|她从那个机械族手里得到的配方应该够用了……]”薇芙关门时自言自语。“那么，去会客室吧。”
    
    你们[party.som||两人|三人]走过屋内短短一段距离，来到平时聚会的地方，在如今已成习惯的位置落座。“所以，你为什么想来看看我的这处住所？[var0|旅途中，我有机会在几处地方停留，也得以重新补充炼金用品；如果你想买些零碎东西，我这里正好有货。另外，我还有一些自己完成或偶然找到的特殊项目，若是你更喜欢那一类东西，也可以看看。]”
    
    |[party.Yall]登上女巫门廊的台阶，来到那扇饱经风霜的大门前。即使隔着厚重的木门，你也能听见薇薇安埋头研究最新魔法进展时发出的寻常动静。不过，轻轻敲门依然足以吸引她的注意，将她唤到门边。她几乎立刻打开大门，带着一贯的[viviane.isDemon|坏笑|微笑]和露胸鞠躬迎接你。
    
    “哎呀[viviane.fucked|，你好啊，[pc.mascFem|帅哥|美人]。|，这不是我最喜欢的访客吗！]进来，快进来。”她挥手招呼[party.som|你|你们两人|你们三人]进屋，带你们来到客厅里那几张日渐坐旧的椅子旁，让你们可以[party.solo||一起]坐下来交谈。
    
    “那么，[viviane.isDemon|[party.solo|是什么把我可爱的腐化者带到寒舍来了？|是什么把[pc.title]带到我的巢穴来了？]|[flags.VIV_DATE|亲爱的，你需要这位卑微的女巫做些什么？|[pc.title]需要这位卑微的女巫做些什么？]][var0|自从上次见面以来，我有机会在几处地方停留，也得以重新补充炼金用品；如果你想买些零碎东西，我这里正好有货。另外，旅途中我还完成或找到了一些特殊项目，若是你更喜欢那一类东西，也可以看看。]”]

    薇薇安独自坐在她的桌子旁。[rand|她在面前的纸上草草记着笔记|正在埋头研读一本奥术典籍]。她旁边放着一碗吃了一半的[var0|粥|炖菜]，她偶尔会再吃一口。对面则放着一杯还冒着热气的茶，只差几口就满了。
rows.raw: "\\n\\n\n    Viviane is sitting alone at her table, [rand|scrawling notes onto a pad of paper in front of her|poring over an arcane tome]. Nearby, she's got a half-eaten bowl of [var0|porridge|stew] that she'll occasionally take another bite of. A cup of still-steaming tea sits opposite of that, only a few sips shy of full. "

rows.original:
You approach the bookworm of a witch at her seat, though she doesn't notice you until you're next to her. When she finally does, she looks up from her work, slightly startled, and offers you a seat.

    "Why hello, [pc.name]. Always a pleasure to see you. What brings you over here this [var0|morning|afternoon|evening|fine night]?"
rows.translation:
你走到那位埋头读书的女巫身边，但她直到你站在她旁边才注意到你。当她终于注意到你时，她从书本上抬起头，略显惊讶，然后邀请你坐下。

    “哟，你好啊，[pc.name]。总是很高兴见到你。今天这个[var0|早晨|下午|晚上|美好的夜晚]，是什么风把你吹到这儿来的？”

rows.original: "Ah, Agnimitra..." Viv pauses in thought, a hand gracing her chin as her eyes [party.has agni|fall on the phoenix in question|gaze forward in thought]. [viv.isDemon |"Well, frankly, I wish she'd written a journal. Or taken some notes. Or anything at all. She's lived for thousands of years, and she can tell us so little. She's forgotten more than anyone else could ever even dream of knowing. [silly|All those moments lost like tears in rain|And yet, she's done nothing to stop such incredible loss]. Think about how valuable a primary source like her could have been for researchers everywhere! It's tragic and infuriating, to be perfectly honest. She's a performer and she couldn't even be assed to compose some songs? Truly, a travesty unlike any other." |"To be perfectly honest, I don't know her that well, but she kinda makes me sad. To have lived that long, and forgotten so much seems honestly heartbreaking to me, more than anything else. When all the memories you have throughout a lifespan spanning thousands of years are of the extreme highs and lows, and people fade to little more than feelings and moments... I think it's a good thing she's as well-adjusted as she is. Or seems to be, at least. She's got a passion for life that belies her age and instead much better reflects her fiery nature—literally and figuratively." The witch lets out a slight chuckle at that last bit, before returning to her prior somber tone. "Given her musical talents, it makes one wonder if she's composed any of the songs that've survived the ages. Or if she'd even know if she had anymore. All in all, all Agni makes me think of is of some wisdom offered by the advisor to an ancient highlander [silly|Q|q]ueen: 'who wants to live forever?'" ] "Is there anything or anyone else you wanted to ask me about?"

I just hope she gets the chance to pass it on; it would be a shame for such a unique magic style to die out." Viv tilts her head in the dullahan's direction, watching her mill about, before resuming. "I'll admit, I am curious about her nature. How it all works, why, all of that stuff. It's all so fascinating. I'd never do anything without her consent, of course, but I can't help but think of the research opportunities. I doubt even the finest scholars of Estelore ever had such an opportunity. "Ah, [viv.isDemon|Azyrran? Honestly, I'm a little disappointed, [pc.name]. You had such a perfect opportunity with the hive. All you had to do was make sure Azyrran and Liaden had a little slip and you'd have a bunch of mindless hornets at your beck and call. But the past is the past, I suppose."

    Any thoughts on the hornet herself?
    
    "Well, [azzy.kdb|she's a bit of a goody-goody for my tastes. [silly|Not to mention how hard she leans into the disaster lesbian archetype. I mean, really.|She seems alright, otherwise, I suppose. Enthusiastic and horny, but I suppose that comes with the whole hornet territory, really.]|my real interest is that spear of hers. The one with the dragon in it. I'd ask her about it, but I'm pretty sure she'd try to egg me. Otherwise, it's like having another Arona that's a bit too smart for her own good.|if she wanted to be a bimbo, I really don't see why she didn't just join the rest of her sisters in the first place! I mean really, it would have saved so much time and effort.]"
    
    |Azzy? She's alright. I respect her courage in both leaving her hive and in returning to it in the name of saving it. She was faced with some impossible choices and did her best; an admirable act in any circumstance. [azzy.kdb|She's certainly valiant. She's also a bit flirty, though I'm not particularly interested. Eggs are distinctly not my thing. Nor is addictive venom, for that matter.|Well, she's more aggressive now, to say the least. Very... assertive? While I'm fascinated by that spear of hers, from what I understand, it's got very specific requirements about who wields it, and I also think it might object to many of my investigatory methods. Especially with that dragon pride.|The choice to become a bimbo, even temporarily, after what her race went through is certainly a choice. It's definitely not an interest of mine; I can't even imagine giving up my mind. She's sweet, though, if a bit... empty in the head.]"
    ]
    
    "So, any other companions of ours you want to talk about?"
rows.translation:
啊， [viv.isDemon|阿兹兰？说实话，我有点失望[pc.name]你本来拥有一个绝佳的机会来利用那些蜂群。你只需要确保阿兹兰和莉娅登稍有失误，那么一大群听你指挥的蜂群就会出现在你面前。不过，过去的事就让它过去吧。”

    对于那只蜂本身，你有什么看法吗？
    
    “嗯， [azzy.kdb|在我看来，她有点太古板、太守规矩了。 [silly|更不用说她是多么符合“灾难中的女同性恋者”这一典型形象了。我是说，真的，太符合了。|她看起来挺不错的，至少我是这么认为的。她充满热情，也很有性欲，不过我想，这些特点应该也是属于“大黄蜂领域”的人才会有的吧。]|我真正感兴趣的是她那把剑——那把上面有龙图案的剑。我想问她关于那把剑的事情，但我很确定她会故意逗弄我。不然的话，那把剑就有点像另一个“阿罗娜”了——聪明得反而会给自己带来麻烦。|如果她就想装成那种花瓶女郎的话，那我真不明白她当初为什么不干脆跟着她的姐妹们一起这么做呢！说真的，这样反而能节省很多时间和精力。]"
    
    |阿齐？她没事的。我非常钦佩她的勇气——无论是离开自己的蜂巢，还是为了拯救它而重返那里。她面对了一些看似无解的选择，但还是尽了最大努力；在任何情况下，这种行为都值得尊敬。 [azzy.kdb|她确实很勇敢。不过她也有点爱调情，不过我对此并不感兴趣。鸡蛋显然不是我的菜……同样，那种会上瘾的毒液也不是我喜欢的。|嗯，至少可以说，她现在变得更强硬了，也更加果断了。她的那种行事风格……真的很强势。虽然我很感兴趣她使用的那把长矛，但据我所知，使用这把长矛的人必须符合一些特定的条件；而且我觉得，她的这种行事方式可能会与我很多调查方法产生冲突。尤其是考虑到她那龙族的骄傲性格的话。|在经历了她所在的种族所经历的一切之后，选择暂时成为一个花瓶女性，这无疑是一种个人选择。但这绝对不是我感兴趣的事情；我甚至无法想象自己会放弃自己的原则。不过，她人倒是挺可爱的，只是脑子有点……空空荡荡的吧。]"
    ]
    
    那么，还有其他我们的同伴你想谈谈吗？

rows.original:
[viv.isDemon|"Ah, Brienne, our resident am[silly|oo|a]zonian cowgirl. Truly, a marvel of transformative magic. To go wholesale from a towering and muscled minotaur to a feminine form—and one that both conforms to and defies the sexual dimorphism of her race, at that—is a feat beyond just about any item I've crafted or even encountered in my years of research. I'd love to study her, to see if I can piece together any of the residual magicks. [flags.BRIENNE_FIRE_SET|Not to mention that flame outfit of hers. Enchantments that enable someone untrained like her to wield magic—even just limited to one element—are rare beyond measure. ]But I suppose you'd like to hear what I think about her as a person, not as a research subject?"

    You would.
    
    "Well, I think that she's about as devoted to you as I am to my research, which says quite a bit. It's rare to see anyone with that much love for someone else, especially given how willing she is to share you. With Brienne's strength[flags.BRIENNE_FIRE_SET| and the magic made available to her], she's a valuable asset. Not one to be used lightly—except perhaps in the bedroom, where she may well enjoy such things, I suppose."
    |"Brienne, huh? She fascinates me, and it's a shame the armor that transformed her was destroyed afterwards. Still, you're not here to listen to me wax disappointed about lost research opportunities, I suppose. You want my thoughts on our cowgirl as a person."
    
    Indeed you do.
    
    "Well, I think she's a genuinely warm person[flags.BRIENNE_FIRE_SET|—even without that fire outfit of hers—|, ]and a valuable companion, to say the least. She's completely enamoured of you[viv.fucked|, not that I can blame her|, and it shows in her every action]. She's also incredibly strong, both physically and personally. I'll admit, I don't talk to her too much, but when I do, our interactions are generally pleasant."
    ]
    
    "Now then, anyone else you want to discuss?"
rows.translation:
[viv.isDemon|啊，布蕾妮，我们的常驻居民啊[silly|哦哦|a]佐尼安女牛仔。真的，这是一种令人惊叹的变形魔法。能够将一个高大魁梧的弥诺陶洛斯彻底转变为女性形态——而且这种形态既符合她所属种族的性别特征，又打破了这些特征的限制——这绝对是我这些年来研究中所见到或制造出的任何物品都无法比拟的成就。我非常想深入研究她，看看是否能够破解其中残留的魔法机制。 [flags.BRIENNE_FIRE_SET|更不用说她那身火焰色的服装了。那种能让像她这样没有受过训练的人也能使用魔法的咒语——哪怕只是能操控某种单一元素——实在是极为罕见。 ]但我想，你更想听听我对她作为一个人的看法，而不是作为一个研究对象的看法吧？”

    “你确实想听。”
    
    “嗯，我认为她对你的忠诚程度，和我对研究的投入程度是一样的，这一点很能说明问题。能够看到有人对另一个人怀有如此深厚的感情，实在是非常难得的，尤其是考虑到她如此愿意与你分享彼此的生活。以布蕾妮这样的性格和能力[flags.BRIENNE_FIRE_SET| 以及那些被赋予她的神奇力量]她可是一笔宝贵的财富。这样的人可不能随便使用——除非是在卧室里，我想在那种情况下，她可能会乐在其中吧。
    |布蕾妮，啊？她真的让我很着迷，可惜那套让她变成那种形态的盔甲后来被毁掉了。不过，你来这里应该不是为了听我抱怨那些错失的研究机会的，对吧？你其实是想听听我对这个‘女牛仔’这个人物的看法。”
    
    “没错，正是这个目的。”
    
    “嗯，我觉得她真的是一个非常温暖的人[flags.BRIENNE_FIRE_SET|——即使不算她那身火焰服装——|，]至少可以说，她是一个非常值得信赖的伙伴。她对你充满了倾慕之情。[viv.fucked|其实我也不能责怪她。|这一点从她的每一个行动中都能体现出来。]她无论在体力上还是性格上，都表现得非常坚强。我得承认，我和她并不经常交谈，但每次交谈时，我们的互动都相当愉快。
    ]
    
    那么，还有其他人你想讨论的事情吗？

And her skillset? "Much of her abilities are very much in-line with her personality: supportive[flags.VIV_WITCH_GEAR|, especially since I gave her that outfit]. She's got some offensive skills mixed in, sure, but either way, she's still an incredibly valuable teammate to have."] "Any other companions you'd like to hear my thoughts on?" "

rows.original: [viv.isDemon|"Ah, our adorable little princess. Such a sad tale. But it does leave her ripe for exploitation. [ryn.confidenceRange 50|Just look at how quickly she latched onto you. All you had to do was show her a little affection and she's wrapped around your finger.[ryn.highLibido| And you've even gone and made her all excitable. Why, she practically starts leaking at the slightest tease now.]|I bet she'd listen to anyone who spoke to her authoritatively enough. A nudge, gentle or not-so, in the right direction, and you've got yourself an elven kingdom in the palm of your hand. If you really wanted to toy with her, I suppose you could also build up that confidence of hers; she'd probably jump at the first sign of affection. After that, it wouldn't be hard to have her under your thumb.[ryn.highLibido| You've already got her leaking and shuddering at the slightest tease. It's practically perfect.]]" Any thoughts on Etheryn's situation overall, besides her exploitability? "Well, since you asked: it's fascinating. That cage of hers is an enchantment unlike any I've ever seen, and I'd much like to learn more of how it works. Its current use is crude and cruel, but if I could get ahold of Alissa's methods, it opens the door to so many possibilities. [etheryn.cageEverRemoved|A shame it's lost its enchantment. I could have learned so much from it|Should you ever manage to get it off, please give it to me for a proper inspection]." |"Oh, Ryn. That poor girl. She's been through so much. Makes me just want to hug her, sometimes. [ryn.confidenceRange 50|I'm glad that you've helped her as much as you have. She really seems like she's come into her own since you two met. And she clearly knows how much of that help has come from you: you can see it in her every mannerism when you two interact. Hell, even when you're not around, if she gets to talking about you. Sometimes, I'll compliment her or get her talking about her beloved champion just to try to help her further out of her shell and see her smile, but that's only possible because of the legwork you put in.|Any time I try to talk to her, I'm afraid she's going to run off like a scared deer. Not that I blame her, mind you—after what she's been through, I don't know what else she could be like.]" Any thoughts on Ryn's situation otherwise? "I think she's got a lot of work ahead of her, and an impossible burden. The elves are likely to be picking up after Kasyrra and Alissa's handiwork for years, if not decades, to come. The nobility in shambles, the treasury drained, and the queen turned into a demon? There's... not a lot to work with there. But I have faith in our dear girl. rows.translation: [viv.isDemon|“啊，我们可爱的小公主。多么悲惨的故事。不过，这也让她非常适合被人利用。[ryn.confidenceRange 50|瞧瞧她多快就依赖上了你。你只需表现出一点关爱，她就任你摆布了。[ryn.highLibido|而且，你甚至还把她变得如此容易兴奋。哎呀，如今只要稍加挑逗，她几乎就会开始流水。]|我敢打赌，只要语气足够威严，无论谁说话，她都会乖乖听从。只需朝正确的方向推上一把，无论温柔与否，整个精灵王国就会落入你的掌心。假如你真想玩弄她，我想，你还可以慢慢培养她的自信；只要有人流露一丝关爱，她大概就会迫不及待地扑上去。到了那时，要把她牢牢控制在手中就不难了。[ryn.highLibido|如今，你只需轻轻挑逗，她就会流水颤抖。简直完美。]]” 除了她容易被人利用之外，你对伊瑟琳的整体处境还有什么看法？ “既然你问了：这件事十分有趣。她的笼子上附着一种我前所未见的魔法，我很想进一步了解它的运作方式。目前的用途粗野而残酷，可如果我能掌握艾莉莎的方法，它就能开启无数可能性。[etheryn.cageEverRemoved|可惜它已经失去魔力。否则我本能从中学到很多东西|假如你有朝一日成功取下它，请把它交给我好好检查]。” |“噢，小琳。可怜的姑娘。她经历了太多苦难。有时候，我真想抱抱她。[ryn.confidenceRange 50|我很高兴你为她提供了这么多帮助。自从你们相遇以来，她似乎真的找到了自我。而且，她显然也清楚自己从你这里得到了多少帮助：你们互动时，她的一举一动都能表明这一点。见鬼，即使你不在身边，只要她谈起你，也同样明显。有时，我会称赞她，或者引导她谈论深爱的勇者，努力帮助她进一步走出自己的外壳，看看她的笑容；不过，这一切只有因为你事先做了那么多工作才有可能。|每次试着和她交谈，我都担心她会像受惊的鹿一样逃掉。我不是在责怪她——经历了那一切之后，我实在想不出她还能变成什么样。]” 那么，对于小琳的处境，你还有别的看法吗？ “我想，她面前还有许多工作要做，也背负着几乎不可能承受的重担。未来数年，乃至数十年，精灵们很可能都得收拾卡希拉和艾莉莎留下的残局。贵族体系分崩离析，国库空虚，女王还变成了恶魔？那里……实在没剩下多少可用的东西。不过，我相信我们亲爱的姑娘。她很坚强[ryn.lowConfidence|，只是自己还不知道]。”] “那么，你还想听我评价哪位同行的旅伴？”

rows.original:
"Kiyoko, huh?[viv.isDemon| Well, she's a kitsune noble, which are apparently additive in terms of formality and stiffness[silly|, probably through increasing the size of the stick up her ass. Maybe that's why she doesn't let you try anal: no room up there...]. Don't get me wrong, I've seen how capable she is of being playful, especially around you, but for the most part, she's not exactly warm and welcoming. She's every bit as soulless as I am, but has more caveats, it seems. Still, her magic is at least interesting, and it makes me wonder how much of that I could replicate.|" Viviane shrugs. "To be perfectly honest, it's hard to have an opinion on her. She doesn't really interact with the rest of us much, and when she does, she seems aloof and stiff. She's been through a lot, sure, but it often feels like the only one she particularly cares about is you. I don't know enough about her parenting skills to have any thoughts on that, either."]

“清子，嗯？[viv.isDemon| 嗯，她是一位狐妖贵族，而贵族在正式和拘谨方面似乎是叠加的[silly|，大概是靠把她屁股里那根棍子越捅越深吧。也许这就是她为什么不让你走后门：那上面根本没地方……]。别误会，我见过她有多能玩闹，尤其是在你身边时，但大体上，她并不算热情好客。她和我一样没心没肺，只不过她似乎有更多附加条件。不过，她的魔法至少挺有意思，这让我好奇自己能复制多少。|”薇薇安耸了耸肩。“说实话，我对她很难有什么看法。她不太和我们其他人来往，就算来往，也显得冷淡而生硬。她确实经历了很多，但很多时候感觉她唯一真正在乎的人就是你。至于她的育儿本事，我了解得也不够，没什么可说的。”]

rows.original:
[viv.isDemon|"Well, Quintillus is an interesting one, to say the least. I don't trust him, obviously, but I don't trust anyone, so you really shouldn't judge him based on that. He was wise enough to leave the cult of his own volition, which is good. I'm not sure how he got free of that control Tollus tends to have, but then again, Quin does seem to have some mind-oriented magic at his disposal as well. Or perhaps he was just never truly under Tollus's sway. All interesting possibilities. I look forward to finding out what the answer is when the time comes."

    Are her thoughts on him all related to his history as a cultist?
    
    "I mean, I suppose I could go on about how he's skilled at a magic I'm not particularly familiar with or his weapon use or any of that, but none of those have quite the mystery to be solved, now do they?"
    
    You guess not.
    
    "Exactly. Now, any other members of our diverse group that you'd like my thoughts on?"
    |"Quin? I think that just about everyone deserves a second chance, and he's actively trying for one. He even left the cult of his own volition, as far as we can tell. As such, I'm doing my best to keep an open mind. I don't distrust him, per say, but I don't trust him, either."
    
    Any thoughts on anything else about him?
    
    
    "Well, he's a skilled mage, for sure. It takes practice to use magic that fluently in combat, especially when mixing it with any other fighting styles. I'm not particularly familiar with his specific brand of magic, I'll admit, so beyond that, I can't say much. Still, it's served him and us well, so I'll take it."
    
    "Now, any other members of our merry band of misfits you want my thoughts on?"]
rows.translation:
[viv.isDemon|“至少可以说，昆蒂卢斯是个有意思的人。显然，我不信任他，不过我谁也不信任，所以你实在不该据此评判他。他足够明智，主动离开了邪教，这一点很好。我不清楚他如何挣脱了托勒斯惯常施加的控制；不过话说回来，昆因似乎也掌握着某种精神魔法。又或许，他从未真正受到托勒斯操控。都是有趣的可能性。我很期待时机成熟时揭晓答案。”

    她对他的看法，全都与他曾是邪教徒的经历有关吗？
    
    “我是说，我当然可以继续谈论他有多擅长一种我不太熟悉的魔法，或者怎样使用武器，诸如此类；可是那些事情并没有什么谜团需要解开，不是吗？”
    
    你觉得确实如此。
    
    “正是。那么，我们这个形形色色的团队里，你还想听我评价哪一位成员？”
    |“昆因？我认为几乎每个人都应当得到第二次机会，而他正积极争取这样的机会。就我们所知，他甚至是自愿离开邪教的。因此，我正尽力保持开放的态度。倒也不能说我不信任他，但我同样没有信任他。”
    
    关于他的其他方面，她还有什么看法？
    
    
    “嗯，他确实是位技艺高超的法师。在战斗中如此流畅地施展魔法需要大量练习，尤其是还要将魔法与其他战斗风格结合起来时。坦白说，我对他那种独特的魔法并不熟悉，所以除此之外也说不出太多。不过，它一直都让他和我们受益，所以我乐于接受。”
    
    “那么，我们这个由一群怪人组成的欢乐团队里，你还想听我评价谁？”]

rows.original: "Oh, it's wonderful. I've never felt so free." How so? "Well, my dear, all those little thoughts and concerns in my head are just gone. Doubts? None. No more of those nagging questions of, 'oh, is this unethical?' or 'what if this changes me somehow I don't like and I have to go through the effort of getting myself back to the way I was?' Just certainty." That's [pc.dcb|quite the benefit|concerning|weird]. [pc.dcb|"Oh, indeed," she says. "|"Hardly. It just means I'm that much more effective in my research. |"If you say so, my dear," the witch says, suppressing a chuckle. "]Think of the possibilities! So many ideas I could never have even dreamed of before because I was so very limited in my view. So unambitious. Now, I'm more free than I've ever been before, and it's all thanks to you." [pc.dcb|Good. She'd better put that newfound freedom to use in your favor, then.|It seems you'll have to keep an even closer eye on your demon companion, lest she do something dangerous.|Oh! You're glad you could help. Being free is good.] [flags.VIV_DEMON_TALK||"Oh, that does remind me, [pc.name]: I've got a gift for you. You see, because it is through you that I ended up like this, I thought it fitting that I give you the fruit of my research." The demoness extends a hand. It's wrapped around a [var0|familiar pink crystal|pink crystal not unlike what you saw come out of Alissa in the Winter City]. "My soul, all for you. I've got lots of ideas for how you might use it, but I figured I'd let you hold onto this beautiful gem until you're ready to use it."]
rows.translation: “哦，这真是太棒了。我从未感到如此自由。” “怎么说？” “嗯，亲爱的，我脑子里那些细碎的念头和顾虑全都消失了。疑虑？没有。再也不会有那些烦人的疑问了，比如‘哦，这样做是不是不道德？’或者‘万一这让我变成某种我不喜欢的样子，我还得费劲把自己变回去呢？’只剩下确定。” 这可真是[pc.dcb|好处多多|令人担忧|奇怪]。 [pc.dcb|“哦，确实如此，”她说。“|“哪里的话。这只意味着我在研究上效率高得多了。|“既然你这么说，亲爱的，”女巫强忍住笑说道。]想想那些可能性吧！有那么多想法，我以前连做梦都想不到，因为我的眼界太过狭隘。太没有野心了。而现在，我比以往任何时候都更自由，这一切都要归功于你。” [pc.dcb|很好。那么她最好把这份新获得的自由用于为你谋利。|看来你得把你的恶魔同伴盯得更紧一些了，免得她做出什么危险的事来。|哦！你很高兴自己能帮上忙。自由自在是件好事。] [flags.VIV_DEMON_TALK||“哦，这倒提醒我了，[pc.name]：我给你准备了一份礼物。你看，正是因为你，我才变成现在这个样子，所以我觉得，把我的研究成果当作礼物送给你很合适。”女恶魔伸出一只手。手里握着一颗[var0|熟悉的粉色水晶|和你们在冬城看到从艾莉莎身上出来的那种很像的粉色水晶]。“我的灵魂，全都给你。关于怎么用它，我有很多想法，但我想先让你保管这颗美丽的宝石，等你准备好使用它的时候再说。”]

rows.original: [viv.isDemon |"Ah, my lovely form-changing capabilities. They're ever so useful, though I do vastly prefer the two shapes of mine to which you're most accustomed: gorgeous human witch and perfected demon. Still, just having the option of morphing my body beyond even alchemy's capabilities is one of the greatest tools I could ever imagine, and with its limit being my imagination, well... I have some ideas, to say the least." Like what? "Well, during my youth, I tried a variety of body types. I even changed myself into a stud of a man for a while. Both with and without a dick. Gotta say, I get the appeal. I prefer not having one on a consistent basis, but it was certainly an experience, and not altogether unpleasant." Wait, she did? Could she do that again? "Oh yes, I did, and yes, I could. I wouldn't keep that form, but I'd be willing to take it for nights of fun and the like, be it a fully male body type or just growing a dick." You'll have to keep that in mind. |"Ah, that. Well, you see, when someone is exposed to a lot of magic, they become more reactive than most, both in terms of alchemy and just general magic. You're living proof: you've been doused with so much magic that you can eat a raw alchemical ingredient and experience bodily changes. I'm the same way." How did she get like that? "Doesn't take too much to figure out. I've been working with magic my entire life—be it alchemy or enchanting or summoning or basic spells—and I've been using said enchantments to morph my body for as long as I can recall. I've experimented with unstable magic and both called and bound the spirits of more creatures than I could count. I've done a lot of magic. So, now, I'm like you: a bite of the wrong thing is enough to morph me. Useful for my research, annoying for day-to-day life. As such, I always keep some transformatives stocked up to return to my normal body." Did she ever try any other body types? "Oh, of course. Dozens. My teenage years were filled with experimentation of the bodily sort—more than I understand is usual for a teenager, at that. I even tried out a masculine body for a while, and dabbled with having a penis. Both were certainly interesting, and I can see their appeals, but in the end, I like this form best." She gestures with both hands across her body, punctuating her opinion on the matter. Would she ever be willing to take those forms again? "Perhaps, though if I did, it would only be temporary. Let me think on it, alright?" Alright. ]

"Doesn't take too much to figure out. I've been working with magic my entire life—be it alchemy or enchanting or summoning or basic spells—and I've been using said enchantments to morph my body for as long as I can recall. She gestures with both hands across her body, punctuating her opinion on the matter. Would she ever be willing to take those forms again? "Perhaps, though if I did, it would only be temporary. rows.original:
[flags.VIV_EVERGREEN_TALK|"Well, there's Lady Evergreen. I don't know what to think of her, to be honest. I'd heard stories from my mother about a powerful witch in the Frostwood, so I suppose it must have been her mother, then, or perhaps her grandmother.

    "Still, whatever else she is, she's an incredibly powerful mage. Dealing in direct body transmutation is... dangerous, to say the least. It's easily the most volatile of the magics, more than even raw elemental evocation. [QUEST_MATIHA_REVENGE.isCompleted|Then again, I suppose Matiha's mistakes taught you that much. Still, i|I]t's not to be trifled with—bodies are complex and fragile, and it's startlingly easy to make a horrible mistake even with precautions taken—and Lady Evergreen does it with a casual efficiency that demonstrates a lot of power and prowess. Frankly? I'm both fascinated and intimidated by it and her.[viv.isDemon| I do wonder if I couldn't manage to swipe a few of her books without her noticing... Eh, it's probably not worth the risk. She's powerful enough that I'd prefer to stay intact rather than risk her wrath. Especially outnumbered like that.]" Viv pauses for a moment, then tacks on, "Senja's a sweetheart though."
    
    |"Well, I've heard mention of a 'Lady Evergreen' in the Frostwood from your compatriots. I'd be interested in meeting her at some point. My mother used to tell me to be wary of the Frostwood, because there was a powerful witch who would steal children away. Of course, I stopped believing in that a long time ago, but perhaps it's rooted in some truth after all. Worth investigating."
    
    ]
    
    [QUEST_MATIHA_REVENGE.isCompleted| 
    What of Matiha? How does Viv feel about her in the aftermath of, well, everything that happened?
    
    "Well, she's every bit as reckless as I'd expected from what I'd [flags.VIV_BQ1|seen|heard]. Gods, every single part of her plan gives me a headache. From fucking with the Ways to using transmutation magic on her body directly, it's all just arrogance and madness. [viv.isDemon|I'm willing to do a lot in the name of acquiring knowledge, but if everything ends up destroyed, what the fuck was the point? I mean, hells, having the Astrida sent after you alone is usually not worth the cost.|The amount of hubris required staggers me. I know I can be reckless—Nareva knows that if you hadn't warned me about the succubus milk, I'd probably be a demon, for example—but... it just seems like her every act was more about proving superiority and gaining power whatever the cost than anything else. And for all my folly, I just... don't get it.]"
    
    |[flags.VIV_BQ1|What about Matiha, Berwyn's mistress?
    
    "Ah, her? She's reckless. Her enchanting methods alone tell me that much; she made liquid ley crystal for it. There are few things more volatile than that process, and they're both lucky to be alive if that's how she was going about enchanting anything. It's also far less repeatable a process, not that she seemed to care.[viv.isDemon|Still, it's a shame I didn't get to spend more time appraising it. It may be folly, but if she managed to do it alone without blowing herself to bits, then perhaps her research could still be of use to me.]"
    
    |[flags.BERWYN_QUEST_COMPLETE|
    
    What about Matiha, Berwyn's mistress?
    
    "Prior to meeting you, nothing, but since then I've heard nothing good. Though I would be fascinated by how she teleported her tower so. Such magic is beyond my own knowledge, but I imagine it is fraught with risk. Otherwise, I know nothing of her, really."
    
    |[flags.BERWYN_MET| 
    What about that half-lupine summoner you've seen in the foothills? He's talked about his mistress, does Viv know anything about her?
    
    "Not a thing. It's a little ways away for my tastes, and I was fairly secluded."
    ]]]]
    
    [QUEST_MILKY_HONEY.isCompleted|
    Well, Jyrranaz was a magic researcher of sorts. What did Viv think of her?
    
    [viv.isDemon|"Frankly, she was fascinating. I'd love to spend time studying her, and poring over her research. While it's not normally something I'd take interest in, no harm in looking. Well, maybe a little harm, but that's the fun of it. Who knows, maybe she'd even discuss some of it with me. I bet you could get her over to serving you instead of Kasyrra, you know. Get her to put that mind to research in your name, and you never know what she might turn up."|"She scares me, to think that someone like her exists. Not even a full demon and yet so willing to use others in that way, and in the service of a demon? Frankly, I'm afraid to imagine what would happen if she slipped any further. Some part of me thinks you should destroy her research, to be honest. Normally I'd never suggest such a thing, but I also believe that perhaps that knowledge should never be seen by anyone. I hadn't thought knowledge could be evil, but she makes me doubt that."]
    
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.VIV_EVERGREEN_TALK|嗯，还有常青女士。说实话，我真不知道该如何看待她。我母亲曾经给我讲过关于霜木林里那位强大女巫的故事，所以我想，那个人应该就是她的母亲，或者她的祖母吧。

    “不管她究竟是什么身份，她确实是一位实力极其强大的法师。进行直接的身体转化这种魔法……至少可以说，是非常危险的。这种魔法比单纯的元素操控还要不稳定得多。 [QUEST_MATIHA_REVENGE.isCompleted|不过，我想玛蒂哈的那些错误确实让你学到了很多东西。不过，我还是……|我]这绝非儿戏——人类的身体既复杂又脆弱，即便采取了各种预防措施，也极容易犯下严重的错误。而常青女士却能以一种如此从容、高效的方式完成这些操作，这无疑体现了她强大的能力与精湛的技术。说实话？我对她以及她的能力既感到着迷，又感到敬畏。[viv.isDemon| 我确实在想，是否可以趁她没注意的时候偷偷拿走她几本书……不过，这个风险可能太大了。她实力强大，我宁愿自己平安无事，也不想招惹她的怒火。尤其是当前我们的人数处于劣势的情况下。]薇芙停顿了一下，然后补充道：‘不过森娅确实是个很贴心的人。
    
    |嗯，我听你的同胞们提到过弗罗斯特伍德里有一位‘常青女士’。我有兴趣在某个时候见见她。我母亲以前总告诫我要小心弗罗斯特伍德，因为那里住着一位会抓走孩子的强大女巫。当然，我很久以前就不再相信这种事了，但也许其中确实有些真相。值得调查一下。
    
    ]
    
    [QUEST_MATIHA_REVENGE.isCompleted| 
    那么，玛蒂哈呢？在发生了所有那些事情之后，薇芙对她究竟有什么感觉呢？
    
    “嗯，她确实和我预想中的一样鲁莽。 [flags.VIV_BQ1|看到过|听到了]天啊，她的计划简直让我的脑袋都疼了。从扰乱那些古老的规则，到直接对她的身体使用转化魔法，这一切都充满了傲慢与疯狂。 [viv.isDemon|为了获取知识，我愿意付出很多代价，但如果最终一切都付诸东流，那这一切到底有什么意义呢？说真的，让阿斯特里达单独去对付你，通常是不值得的。|这种傲慢的程度实在让我感到震惊。我知道自己有时候会做出一些鲁莽的行为——娜瑞瓦也明白这一点，因为如果你没有提醒我关于那个女妖之乳的事情，我很可能早就变成恶魔了……但是……她的每一个举动似乎都只是为了证明自己的优越性、不惜任何代价地获取权力，而不是其他任何原因。尽管我犯了很多愚蠢的错误，但我就是……无法理解这一点。]"
    
    |[flags.VIV_BQ1|那么，贝尔温的情妇玛蒂哈呢？
    
    “啊，她啊？她可真是个鲁莽的人。仅仅是她那些迷人的做法就已经说明了很多问题了——她竟然用液态莱晶来进行那些实验。几乎没有什么过程比这更危险的了，如果她真的是用这种方式来进行魔法的施放，那么他们俩能活下来就已经算是幸运了。而且，这种做法的可重复性也非常低，不过她似乎根本不在乎这些。[viv.isDemon|不过，真遗憾我没有更多时间来仔细研究它。这或许有些愚蠢，但如果她能够独自完成这项工作，而且没有因此陷入困境，那么她的研究成果或许仍然能对我有所帮助。]"
    
    |[flags.BERWYN_QUEST_COMPLETE|
    
    那么，贝尔温的情妇玛蒂哈呢？
    
    “在遇见你之前，我对她一无所知；但自从那以后，我就再没听到过关于她的任何好消息。虽然她那种将自己的塔楼传送出去的能力确实让我感到非常好奇——这样的魔法超出了我的认知范围，但我猜其中肯定隐藏着巨大的风险。除此之外，我真的对她一无所知。
    
    |[flags.BERWYN_MET| 
    你在山脚下看到的那个半狼人召唤师怎么样？他提到过他的情人，薇芙是否知道些什么关于她的事情？
    
    “一无所知。对我来说，她的风格有点太另类了，而且我当时也处于相对隐居的状态。
    ]]]]
    
    [QUEST_MILKY_HONEY.isCompleted|
    嗯，吉拉娜兹算是一种魔法研究者吧。薇芙对她有什么看法呢？
    
    [viv.isDemon|坦白说，她真的很吸引人。我非常愿意花时间研究她的工作，仔细阅读她的研究资料。虽然这类事情通常不会引起我的兴趣，但试试也无妨。嗯，也许会有一点麻烦，但这就是其中的乐趣所在。谁知道呢，也许她还会和我讨论一些这些内容呢。我打赌，你完全有可能让她来为你服务，而不是让卡希拉来做这件事。让她以你的名义进行研究，谁知道她会发现些什么呢。|她让我感到恐惧，想到世上竟然会有这样的人。她甚至算不上一个真正的恶魔，却如此热衷于利用他人，而且还是为了某个恶魔的利益？说实话，我都不敢想象如果她再继续这样下去，会发生什么。内心有个声音在告诉我，你应该毁掉她的研究。通常我永远不会提出这样的建议，但我也认为，那些知识或许永远都不应该被人知道。我以前从没想过知识也会带来邪恶，但她让我开始怀疑这一点了。]
    
    ]

But eventually, the gasps die down. With one hand, she nudges you into rolling on your side — and avoiding as much of the [pc.cumVol 5000 |mess |wet spot ] you've made beneath you and sighs happily. "Good [pc.boyGirl]," she murmurs. "Definitely a good [pc.boyGirl]. It really is such a lovely spell, if it can make you do this for me..." Or was it there all along? — but when she starts to apply it to your [pc.furColor] fur, you can't help but [pc.raMulti catfolk leothran manticore lupine cowgirl minotaur |purr |purr |purr |[silly |ruuu |whine ] |moo |moo |coo ] happily in response.
